name: Amethyst Necromancer
description: Feeling a bit gloomy with a side of bitter and have no one to talk to? HEY! Your a Necromancer! You can just make your friends!

name: Amethyst Universe Armor (0 AC)
description: When you equip this armor, you'll find it's easy to be kind to smaller men.

name: Amethyst Universe Armor (AC)
description: When you equip this armor, you'll find it's easy to be kind to smaller men.

name: Amor e Alegria
description: The theme is Love and Happiness, so dance your heart out! Your body wasn't made to sit still or alone. (Item is CC)

name: Amor e Folia
description: The theme is Love and Revelry, so dance your heart out! Your body wasn't made to sit still or alone.

name: Ancient Creature (Armor)
description: The body of a transformed creature from beyond the beginning of time. The change happened from within, seeding in their weakened minds. It took ages for their old skin to slough off completely.

name: Ancient Cryomancer
description: Before today's Cryomancer harnessed the power of Ice, Ancient Cryomancer already knew its power.

name: Ancient CryptKeeper (Armor)
description: There is no further need to train a keeper as it is now given its own territory in the Eergcast Catacombs and their right to be called a master. All humane feelings and reasoning have now washed away to make room for endless knowledge of black magic and a craving for souls of the recently deceased.

name: Ancient Evil Commander
description: Not available to commander new evil minions. Only ancient ones.

name: Ancient Explorer
description: Once worn by temple priests in the northern Sandsea, frequent mishaps by mischievous spirits forced them to abandon their sacred values to tame them. They have been slaying spirits since, but their gilded attire is all that remain of who they once were.

name: Ancient FlameMaster (AC)
description: Legend says that the Ancient Flamemasters carried the power of fire within their very bones. They never feared darkness or cold, as they could call fire from within.

name: Ancient FlameMaster (Special)
description: Legend says that the Ancient Flamemasters carried the power of fire within their very bones. They never feared darkness or cold, as they could call fire from within.

name: Ancient Knight (0 AC)
description: Long before the Guardian Tower rose in the heart of Battleon, an order of knights roamed the land, dedicated to helping those in need. Now you, too, can fight as they did.

name: Ancient Knight (AC)
description: Long before the Guardian Tower rose in the heart of Battleon, an order of knights roamed the land, dedicated to helping those in need. Now you, too, can fight as they did.

name: Ancient Koi Ningyo
description: The aquatic nations which dwell under the Seven Seas of Yokai must defeat a ningyo in battle before they can be considered warriors. Legend also has it that eating a ningyo's flesh may grant immortality… but no one has proven it true. Yet.

name: Ancient Nightmare (0 AC)
description: Deep in the shadows, the Queen's creatures stalk the realm. Waiting for the unwary to come closer… closer… before they strike.

name: Ancient Nightmare (AC)
description: Deep in the shadows, the Queen's creatures stalk the realm. Waiting for the unwary to come closer… closer… before they strike.

name: Ancient Shogun Armor
description: A samurai should always be prepared for death - whether his own or someone else's. (Item does 40% more damage to human tagged monsters when equipped.)

name: Ancient Time Voyager
description: Throughout time, they have seen civilizations rise and fall. As one falls, a new one rises from the ashes. Now they're here to watch the end of Lore. What will become of its ashes?

name: Ancient Undead Warrior (AC)
description: You've defeated Blightbringer's Shadow Man and witnessed the beginning of the Undead Legion through the eyes of its first General!

name: Ancient Undead Warrior (Merge)
description: You've defeated Blightbringer's Shadow Man and witnessed the beginning of the Undead Legion through the eyes of its first General!

name: Ancient Wanderer
description: This wanderer has traveled far from his home port in the Sandsea. How he ended up here, we may never know.

name: Angel Avengers Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Angel Avengers Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Angel Champion
description: Crafted by _Aegis_, only the most noble and upright warriors feel comfortable in this most Good of armors. Wear it well, Hero, and remember to always fight on the side of right!

name: Angel of Azaveyr
description: In another time and space, the Angel and a Shadow drove Dragons out of her homeland because of a great betrayal. Even the Avatars came to fear what their influence could do. But in this World, the Angel's legends go unsung.

name: Angelic Neesha (0 AC)
description: An attendant of the Archangel Nulgath. She accompanied him when he flew into a portal that threatened to swallow the world. Her great deeds are remembered and retold countlessly. (Female art only)

name: Angelic Neesha (AC)
description: An attendant of the Archangel Nulgath. She accompanied him when he flew into a portal that threatened to swallow the world. Her great deeds are remembered and retold countlessly. (Female art only)

name: Angelica Wetsuit
description: Light yet durable, this wetsuit's sure to catch eyes. The pure and angelic aesthetic often fools seaborne predators. They'll break their teeth on you.

name: Angry Broccoli (Armor)
description: Monster? No, I Am Not A Monster… I am… ANGRY BROCCOLI!

name: Animancer
description: Honored masters of fate protect the fallen from the final touch of death. They take it upon themselves to bring heros back to life, dooming their souls to oblivion in exchange for giving the world just a little more justice.

name: Annihilator Of Order
description: On the fields of Battle On, at the fall of Order, where no adventurer or monster may fail to give an answer, an Evil Hero will arise. Order must fall.

name: Anointed Grandmaster Gramiel
description: The garb of a Celestial who wanted a simple life. Trickery robbed him of his wish. Gramiel dedicated his entire existence to destroying all beasts, and vindicating his lost love.

name: Anseri Destroyer
description: Birds evolved from dinosaurs… that is magic in my book! Charge into battle on the back of one of Lore's fiercest creatures and demolish your opponents!

name: Anti-Kaiju Agent (0 AC)
description: Well-equipped to defend against threats of massive scale? Don't stop there. Destroy the Kaiju if necessary, or detain them. Who wouldn't want a walking hurricane as a pet?

name: Anti-Kaiju Agent (AC)
description: Well-equipped to defend against threats of massive scale? Don't stop there. Destroy the Kaiju if necessary, or detain them. Who wouldn't want a walking hurricane as a pet?

name: Anti-Kolyaban Armor
description: For those who do not wish to follow Kolyaban and her twisted ways.

name: Anti-Storm War Tank
description: During the war against the storm, Queen Victoria commissioned Magus Felix for armor that could withstand lightning. The result was monstrous, a specter from Greenguard's own tyrannical past. (This item is fully color-customizable.)

name: Anti-Storm Warbeast
description: During the war against the storm, Queen Victoria commissioned Magus Felix for armor that could withstand lightning. The result was monstrous - a specter from Greenguard's own tyrannical past.

name: Antiquated Shadowslayer
description: ShadowSlayers have battled the creatures of darkness for as long as we can remember… and always will.

name: Antique Hunter (Armor) (0 AC)
description: Antique hunters explore lore selectively looking for rare and powerful artifacts to aid them in their battles and adventures.

name: Antique Hunter (Armor) (AC)
description: Antique hunters explore the dark corners of lore, selectively looking for rare and powerful artifacts to aid them in their battles and adventures.

name: AntiTitan Corps (Armor)
description: Brown, Brawn, and Strong! The members of the AntiTitan Corp strive to slay the most ferocious beasts that no other warrior dare encounter.

name: Anubis Armor
description: The regal attire tailored to the jackal-headed god of the afterlife. His reincarnations can be found patrolling the Sek-Duat Pyramids as his undying Deathguards.

name: Ao Tsuki
description: Once in a blue moon, the blood of legendary beasts flows into the palms of this mysterious organization. (CC to Trim)

name: Apa's Outfit
description: Along with her twin, Eta, Apa has been entrusted by the Crystallis administration to oversee all of the soldiers on the Shinkansen.

name: Apocalyptic BladeMaster (Armor)
description: This Blademaster reached the pinnacle of mastery by witnessing visions of apocalypse. Drained of will, and filled with nihility - they have become nothing but a blade, prophesized to cut the world in two.

name: Apocalyptic Conjurer
description: The magic of the Apocalyptic Conjurer lies and delights, slowly unravelling the fabric of reality the more spells they cast. This power is drawn from an Apocalyptic Entity who resides in between realms, waiting to take the stage.

name: Apocalyptic Conquerer
description: When the world ends, you will learn to bow in the wake of the ruins! Prepare for your submission!

name: Apocalyptic Darkblood (Armor)
description: Darkblood revered and feared by their kinder brethren. They seek a new beginning by pursuing the end. Hard truths forced them to turn their backs on The Mother.

name: Apocalyptic DeathBringer
description: Death is coming for those who dwell in Lore. This is the beginning to your end!

name: Apocalyptic Deathlord Armor
description: To ascend to the greatness you deserve, many sacrifices will be required:

name: Apocalyptic DeathLord's Knight
description: To ascend to the greatness you deserve, many sacrifices will be required:

name: Apocalyptic DeathLord's Wight
description: To ascend to the greatness you deserve, many sacrifices will be required:

name: Apocalyptic Desert Warrior
description: The desert is already unforgiving, but when the apocalypse rears its ugly head - you'll be ready.

name: Apocalyptic Dracolich (Armor)
description: An ancient prophecy fortells: when the dracoliches rise, the end of the world is near… Which side you will battle on when hordes of undead dragons fall upon Lore?

name: Apocalyptic Draconian
description: An ancient prophecy fortells: when the dracoliches rise, the end of the world is near… Which side you will battle on when hordes of undead dragons fall upon Lore?

name: Apocalyptic DracoWarrior
description: An ancient prophecy fortells: when the dracoliches rise, the end of the world is near… Which side you will battle on when hordes of undead dragons fall upon Lore?

name: Apocalyptic DragonKing (Armor)
description: These fierce DragonKing's have survived through the most imminent danger and destruction.

name: Apocalyptic DragonLord (Armor)
description: These fierce DragonLord's have survived through the most imminent danger and destruction.

name: Apocalyptic Illusionist (Armor)
description: The magic of the Apocalyptic Illusionist lies and delights, slowly unravelling the fabric of reality the more spells they cast. This power is drawn from an Apocalyptic Entity who resides in between realms, waiting to take the stage.

name: Apocalyptic LichKing
description: With an army of undead, you can destroy the world… all you need to do is create it!

name: Apocalyptic Necromancer
description: With an army of undead, you can destroy the world… all you need to do is create it!

name: Apocalyptic Plunderer
description: When the apocalypse happens; there will be those who fight to protect those who can't protect themselves and those who will take what is left for themselves. Who will you be?

name: Apocalyptic Reaver (Armor)
description: This Blademaster reached the pinnacle of mastery by witnessing visions of apocalypse. Drained of will, and filled with nihility - they have become nothing but a blade, prophesized to cut the world in two.

name: Apocalyptic Warlord
description: First fire reigned from the sky. Then they came. That's when the real terror began.

name: Apocalyptic Werepyre (Armor)
description: The terrible combination of vampire and werewolf, these loners never truly fit in with either race making them outcasts and dangerous to all creatures of the night.

name: Apophis Medjai
description: The elite warriors of Apophis were called the Medjai. Under the Shadow of the Umbral Sun, they hunted their master's enemies in the name of their Pharaoh. Chaos reigned, and the sandstorms bent to their will.

name: Apprentice Mage Jaania
description: This isn't your world's Jaania. In another timeline, she became the "Hero" of another story. But, this is your story. Who will this righteous heart be to you?

name: Apprentice Necrobard
description: Music echoes through the crypts. Though the songs of the Necrobard seep into the souls of the dead, the decadent living are entranced by their forbidden music. Many find themselves with rich and disgustingly powerful patrons.

name: Apprentice of Awe
description: Garments given to new members of Lore's Conservators. This item gives 15% more rep, gold, XP, and class points when equipped.

name: Apprentice of Flames
description: AHAHAH! BURN THE WORLD! BURN IT ALL DOWN! NO REMORSE NO REGRET JUST FIRE! AHAHAHA

name: Apprentice of the Light
description: Your journey for Good and the Light begins here!

name: Apricot Blossom Ao Dai
description: ﻿The Ao Dai is a form-fitting garment that covers all bases, yet hides nothing. Though it invokes gentleness and nostalgia, it represents strong people who will always perservere through hardship with grace.

name: Aquamer First Mate
description: With so many ships traveling in and out of Lolosia, there's always a need for new First Mates… I wonder what keeps happening to the old ones?

name: Aquamer Scallywag
description: With so many ships traveling in and out of Lolosia, there's always a need for new First Mates… I wonder what keeps happening to the old ones?

name: AquaPyrrus Priest-Mage
description: Priests of Feverfew always make a splash whether they're healing the sick or helping in the war efforts.

name: Aquataine Chanteuse (0 AC)
description: With mastery over water and waves, the Aquataine Chanteuse dazzles the masses by combining the wonders of the sea and sky. The ocean crosses the clouds, and splits the light into an array of vibrant colors.

name: Aquataine Chanteuse (AC)
description: With mastery over water and waves, the Aquataine Chanteuse dazzles the masses by combining the wonders of the sea and sky. The ocean crosses the clouds, and splits the light into an array of vibrant colors.

name: Aquatic Defender
description: Does something actually seem fishy or are you smelling yourself?

name: Aquatic Nereidian Majesty (0 AC)
description: Deep below the waves, an entire civilization flourishes. The Nereidian people rule a vast underwater realm, but one that has never been fully explored by humans.

name: Aquatic Nereidian Majesty (AC)
description: Deep below the waves, an entire civilization flourishes. The Nereidian people rule a vast underwater realm, but one that has never been fully explored by humans.

name: Aquatic Warrior (0 AC)
description: Awash in love and loyalty, Aquatic Warriors have pledged to follow the Avatar of Water until the very seas run dry.

name: Aquatic Warrior (AC)
description: Awash in love and loyalty, Aquatic Warriors have pledged to follow the Avatar of Water until the very seas run dry.

name: Aquatica Vires
description: Have the power and Might of water at your fingertips while wearing this armor. Created by a madman who only wanted be one with the ocean and its inhabitants, this armor will indeed allow you into the depths of the seas. Just make sure the natives aren't restless.

name: Aqueduct Conjurer
description: Over the years, road blocks and other large structures have hindered you on your joumey. Not any more! /Equip this and no barrier that Chaos throws at you can stand in your way!

name: AQW Golden Destiny Armor
description: Fight alongside your brothers and sisters to rid Lore of the Ebilness that plagues it…. Congrats! Chairman Platinum has been eradicated. For defeating him here is this awesome armor! Never really liked that color anyways!

name: Arachnid Curse Broker
description: The spider weaves a web of magic, lies, and death. This broker of curses offers mastery over all three for the right price. Their prey writhes in their inescapable trap.

name: Arachnid Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Don't get yourself caught in this commander's web, it'll be the last thing ye ever do!

name: Arachnid Naval Commander (AC)
description: Don't get yourself caught in this commander's web, it'll be the last thing ye ever do!

name: ArachnoFury
description: Sling around the web fighting villains and staying away from newsmen who demand pictures.

name: Arachnomancer Armor
description: Masterfully crafted by your eight-legged comrades, this armor allows you to harness the powers of the Arachnid!

name: Arachnomancer Mail
description: The creepy crawly armor of the Arachnomancer.

name: Arachnophobia2.0
description: Afraid of spiders? Not anymore! Arachnids will fear you in this slaying armor. The itsy bitsy spider has met its match.

name: Arachnosapien
description: The Dreadspiders are forcing themselves to evolve. This is a human-hybrid with dangerous potential. It adopts the likeness of lifeforms the Dreadspiders now consider their greatest foes.

name: Araknus
description: SPIDEYYYYYY!

name: Arata Gamer Gear (AC)
description: The gear a gamer uses can make the difference between victory and defeat! (CC to Base)

name: Arata Gamer Gear (Non-AC)
description: The gear a gamer uses can make the difference between victory and defeat! (CC to Base)

name: Araw At Tala
description: Maligayang Araw ng Kalayaan sa lahat ng manlalaro sa Pilipinas. // Happy Independence Day to all our players in the Philippines. Laban! Battle on!

name: Arbor Armor
description: Your bark is worse than your… bark! You might have to stand very still for a very long time for this armor to take shape. Plant a tree this Earth Day and dress up as one, too!

name: Arboreal Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: Arcangrove contains many dark and deep swamps, perfect for concealing pirate hideaways. That is why YOU are so needed. With a trusty Mudluk to guide you, you've cleaned out hundreds of camps.

name: Arboreal Pirate Captain (AC)
description: Arcangrove contains many dark and deep swamps, perfect for concealing pirate hideaways. That is why YOU are so needed. With a trusty Mudluk to guide you, you've cleaned out hundreds of camps.

name: Arcana's Vesture
description: To master the elements, you must master yourself. Arcana teaches her student that the limitless power of magic must be handled with a healthy mix of curiosity and discipline.

name: Arcana Voyager
description: The Arcana Invoker has consumed the flesh of a primordial, granted the ability to invoke their names and call upon their divine power. They continue the cycle of destiny, and command fate.

name: Arcane Apocalyptic LichKing
description: With an army of undead, you can destroy the world… all you need to do is create it!

name: Arcane Apocalyptic Necromancer
description: With an army of undead, you can destroy the world… all you need to do is create it!

name: Arcane Battle Armor
description: Magi who have excelled in the way of the Arcane seek to broaden their combative intellect. Only those who have mastered Magic can call themselves Battle Magi.

name: Arcane CryptKeeper (Armor)
description: The keeper's black magic evolved and so does its knowledge of the catacombs it is charged to keep, but their humane feelings are nearly eroded by the corruption that is close to consuming their souls.

name: Arcane Dark Caster Armor (AC)
description: You have mastered every form of the arcane. Even among the Dark Casters, you are a legend. There is no higher honor. (This item cannot be sold until April 6th)

name: Arcane Dark Caster Armor (Merge)
description: You have mastered every form of the arcane. Even among the Dark Casters, you are a legend. There is no higher honor. (This item cannot be sold until April 6th)

name: Arcane DataKnight Armor
description: Battle alongside the Dragons of Time as you attempt to command the universe!

name: Arcane Guardian (Armor)
description: Robes styled after one of the founders of magecraft. In a time when magic was an unknown and terrifying force of nature, these brave and ingenuitive pioneers crafted the first spells known to humankind.

name: Arcane Hex of Nulgath (Rare)
description: Nulgath says, "Perhaps wielding the arcane is more your style. Lightly armored, Hex Voids are the mystic breeds in my legion. They can decimate my enemies with black magic, elements, and curses."

name: Arcane LightCaster (0 AC)
description: The Order of the LightCasters was formed to support the Champion of Light. Only those who dedicate themselves to the study of the deepest mysteries become Arcane LightCasters.

name: Arcane LightCaster (AC)
description: The Order of the LightCasters was formed to support the Champion of Light. Only those who dedicate themselves to the study of the deepest mysteries become Arcane LightCasters.

name: Arcane Lovecaster
description: The future is now, the the darkness is eternal… or is it? Beleen seems to have taken over.

name: Arcane Obsidia Outfit
description: Elegantly glide into the gala like a shadow, and revel in a night of dark spells and promises.

name: Arcane of Nulgath
description: The Arcane magics hold so much power. Let me allow you more control of your armor. (color custom)

name: Arcane Pirate Captain
description: Some pirates tend to use a little or a lot of mana, allowing them to be aligned to the mana plane. These types of pirates prefer the night because of their need to watch the stars to stay connected to that realm.

name: Arcane Rouge
description: Love isn't always carried on feathery wings or pink arrows. The Arcane Rouge are experts in magic, stealth, and the affairs of the heart. Levy a fair deal with them, and they'll make sure no one gets in the way of your affections.

name: Arcane StoneCrusher (AC)
description: StoneCrushers use their magic to command the rocky foundation of Lore itself. Though indisputably the source of all life, Earth's primal power is just as formidable as every other element and should never be underestimated.

name: Arcane StoneCrusher (Non-AC)
description: StoneCrushers use their magic to command the rocky foundation of Lore itself. Though indisputably the source of all life, Earth's primal power is just as formidable as every other element and should never be underestimated.

name: Arcane Underworld Warrior (0 AC)
description: These warriors have truly become one with the Underworld, showing their full allegiance to Dage the Evil.

name: Arcane Underworld Warrior (AC)
description: These warriors have truly become one with the Underworld, showing their full allegiance to Dage the Evil.

name: Arcane Warfiend of Nulgath
description: Hoping to get even a small amount of Adimonde's power, the Warfiends of Nulgath follow his every order.

name: Arcangrove Invoker
description: Invoker's power are so great they've transcended the physical and become one with magic. (Gives 15% more rep and 3% more Class Points when equipped)

name: Arcanist Robes
description: Mages who specialize in arcane magics truly understand the power bestowed within this ancient art. These robes were tailored by your fellow player, Trydeth!

name: Arcanist's Lovely Robes (0 AC)
description: Mages who specialize in arcane magics truly understand the power bestowed within this ancient art. These robes were tailored by your fellow player, Trydeth!

name: Arcanist's Lovely Robes (AC)
description: Mages who specialize in arcane magics truly understand the power bestowed within this ancient art. These robes were tailored by your fellow player, Trydeth!

name: Arch Broodfiend of Nulgath
description: Infect the world with Nulgath's darkness and bring strength and victory to the Nation! (The eyes and trim on this set are color customizable).

name: Arch DoomKnight
description: The Arch Doomknights were once a duo of corrupt dragonslayers who traded their lives to become death knights in their quest for power and fame.

name: Arch Lich
description: Light does not always equal right. One of the most powerful magic-wielders in the Celestial Realm, the Arch Lich controls entire legions of undead reanimated with the power of Light.

name: Arch Vaxen Loremaster
description: Clothed in regal splendor, there's only one person whose lore you need to record: Vaxen's.

name: Archaeus
description: An armor designed by Archaeus, former coliseum master who later turned his attention to crafting weapons and armor for survival in that arena.

name: ArchAngel Nulgath (Armor)
description: At first, Nulgath may seem frightening when approached. However, he is an ArchBeing that wishes to cleanse darkness and make way for the light. The armor he wears is fashioned after his love for castles and grand sanctuaries.

name: Archangel of Mysteries
description: The third Celestial created by The Bright One, meant to realize his brethren's true purpose…should Azalith fail. This fate was a mystery, even to his elder sisters.

name: ArchAngel's Defender
description: All hail ArchAngel Nulgath, greatest guardian the Mirror Realm has ever known! Defend him with your blade, your breath, and if need be, your blood.

name: ArchBeing Nulgath
description: At first, Nulgath may seem frightening when approached. However, he is an ArchBeing that wishes to cleanse darkness and make way for the light. The armor he wears is fashioned after his love for castles and grand sanctuaries.

name: Archdemon
description: Modeled after samples obtained from the lore of AdventureQuest, the Archdemon was one of Stragath's most powerful demonic servants.

name: ArchDoom Fiend
description: The ArchDoom Fiend is born from the victorious and the defeated. To win a venerated spot as one of Nulgath's greatest warriors, his fiends devour each other until one remains.

name: Archfiend Armor (1)
description: Four eyes. All the better to see you with.

name: ArchFiend Armor (2)
description: The mighty ArchFiends of the Abyss draw power from the eternal darkness, and wash over their foes in a wave of carnage. Conscripted into service for the Abyssal Army for an eternity, ArchFiends are forever loyal.

name: Archfiend DeathLord
description: (Item does 30% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)For Nulgath and Nation! The ArchFiend Deathlords are superior human DeathKnights of the Nulgath Nation who lead Void Highlords to battle!

name: ArchFiend DoomLord
description: Not even the dark magic of the Shadowscythe is enough to satisfy this soul's lust for power. This item does 35% more damage to any monster, and gives 25% more class points, XP, gold, and rep when equipped.

name: Archfiend DragonKnight (Armor)
description: The knights are special, they command dragons along with hamessing all the power that Nulgath bestows on his Voids.

name: Archfiend DragonLord (Armor)
description: The power of the Voids along with harnessing the strength of dragons given to DragonLords? Now that is a combination straight out of the Void.

name: Archfiend Genisis
description: Nulgath does not need time machines to exterminate his opponents. He can take them out before they are even born.

name: ArchFiend Healer
description: Healers of the ArchFiend serve the darkness, Evil, but above all… they serve their Master, Nulgath!

name: ArchFiend Loyalist (Armor)
description: All hail ArchFiend Nulgath, the greatest ruler our world AND the OverSoul has ever known! Defend him with your blade, your breath, and if need be, your blood. You were wise to defect back to his side, hero!

name: ArchFiend Mage
description: Mages of the ArchFiend serve the darkness, Evil, but above all… they serve their Master, Nulgath!

name: ArchFiend of the ShadowFlame
description: The burning desire for conquering and serving the Archfiend shows through these warriors.

name: ArchFiend Overlord Armor (AC)
description: Seated at the right-hand of Nulgath the Archfiend, his Overlord oversees the hordes of Nation followers as they race to conquer all the corners of Lore and the Oversoul for their Master.

name: ArchFiend Overlord Armor (Special)
description: Seated at the right-hand of Nulgath the Archfiend, his Overlord oversees the hordes of Nation followers as they race to conquer all the corners of Lore and the Oversoul for their Master.

name: Archfiend Rodeleros (Armor)
description: Rodeleros was once a Wind Elemental known as the Swordmaiden. Her loyalty to Avatar Khazri was absolute, and she became an Archfiend to conquer in her Lady's name. Her blades could cut anything, even Darkness and Light.

name: ArchFiend Rogue
description: Rogues of the ArchFiend serve the darkness, Evil, but above all… they serve their Master, Nulgath!

name: Archfiend's BladeMaster
description: The Archfiend's BladeMaster has studied all forms of edged weaponry.. for NULGATH!

name: ArchFiend's Bloodcaller (AC)
description: A weaker warrior in the Nulgath Nation that starts its unending servitude by acting as grunts to the commander, but not the Archfiend himself, but their eight eyes are still remarkably intimidating.

name: ArchFiend's Bloodcaller (Legend)
description: A weaker warrior in the Nulgath Nation that starts its unending servitude by acting as grunts to the commander, but not the Archfiend himself, but their eight eyes are still remarkably intimidating.

name: ArchFiend's Bloodkeeper
description: A weaker warrior in the Nulgath Nation that starts its unending servitude by acting as grunts to the commander, but not the Archfiend himself, but their eight eyes are still remarkably intimidating.

name: ArchFiend's Commandant (0 AC)
description: The ArchFiend's Commandant is entrusted to review, vet, and test those whom Nulgath is considering for further advancement. It is a position very rarely granted.

name: ArchFiend's Commandant (AC)
description: The ArchFiend's Commandants is entrusted to review, vet, and test those whom Nulgath is considering for further advancement. It is a position very rarely granted.

name: ArchFiend's Commandant (Temporary)
description: You are Nulgath's Top Lieutenant. Congratulations!

name: ArchFiend's Dark Paladin
description: Good or Evil… all heroes will eventually fall under the spell of the ArchFiend.

name: ArchFiend's Judge (0 AC)
description: The ArchFiend's Judges advise the Commandants entrusted to review, vet, and test those whom Nulgath is considering for further advancement.

name: ArchFiend's Judge (AC)
description: The ArchFiend's Judges advise the Commandants entrusted to review, vet, and test those whom Nulgath is considering for further advancement.

name: ArchFiend's Paladin (Armor)
description: Good or Evil… all heroes will eventually fall under the spell of the ArchFiend.

name: ArchFiend's Shielded Dark Paladin
description: Good or Evil… all heroes will eventually fall under the spell of the ArchFiend.

name: ArchFiend's Shielded Paladin
description: Good or Evil… all heroes will eventually fall under the spell of the ArchFiend.

name: ArchFiend's Transcendence (Armor)
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: ArchFiend's Warlord (0 AC)
description: The ArchFiend's Warlord is entrusted to train, try, and test those whom Nulgath is considering for further advancement. It is a position very rarely granted.

name: ArchFiend's Warlord (AC)
description: The ArchFiend's Warlord is entrusted to train, try, and test those whom Nulgath is considering for further advancement. It is a position very rarely granted.

name: ArchFiend Stormbringer (0 AC)
description: Fiends that have mastered the storms. Their thunder and hail scars and claims the land. The ground becomes flesh and the trees become bone.

name: ArchFiend Stormbringer (AC)
description: Fiends that have mastered the storms. Their thunder and hail scars and claims the land. The ground becomes flesh and the trees become bone.

name: ArchFiend Thunderlord (0 AC)
description: Fiends that have mastered the storms. Their thunder and hail scars and claims the land. The ground becomes flesh and the trees become bone.

name: ArchFiend Thunderlord (AC)
description: Fiends that have mastered the storms. Their thunder and hail scars and claims the land. The ground becomes flesh and the trees become bone.

name: Archfiend Titan (0 AC)
description: Archfiend Titans serve as tanks in battle, drawing fire from the mages and paladins sent to attack Nulgath's forces.

name: Archfiend Titan (AC)
description: Archfiend Titans serve as tanks in battle, drawing fire from the mages and paladins sent to attack Nulgath's forces.

name: Archfiend Vigneron (Armor)
description: The Archfiend of Bloodthirst and War. Once a common Vampire, Vigneron drowned himself in blood during his reign of terror. Thousands of lives drained into his throat. Even his former kin feared he would drive them all to starvation.

name: Archfiend Warlord
description: The highest rank of the fiends, no mortal shall breath around this beast. Ruthless and hungry, its high quantity of Void Energy exhale a strong smell of death by miles.

name: ArchFiend Warrior
description: Warriors of the ArchFiend serve the darkness, Evil, but above all… they serve their Master, Nulgath!

name: Archivist of Eras
description: The Archivist serves as the observer of the flow, holding the power to revise timelines as they deviate.

name: ArchMage's Rage
description: Robes of the Blue Mage. Unleash the fury of Warlic's rage, just watch your mana. NEEDS ITEM ANIMATION

name: ArchMage's Robes
description: Mana is a permeating force, present in all life and space. ArchMage guide the course of free-flowing mana in the air, creating phenomena in the physical world and altering its course.

name: Archmaster of Awe
description: The armor of a high ranking Lore's Conservators member. Very few have made it to this point. This item does 20% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.

name: Archon Creationist
description: Archonist Creationists, known as the Elite AC Squad, play a vital role in the ongoing development of our digital universe by controlling the dark matter that directs the flow of the mainstream.

name: ArchPaladin Armor
description: As a warrior in one of the Paladin Order’s highest ranks, you have access to powers the likes of which Lore has not yet seen. Use your newfound abilities to fight for virtue and justice, because darkness will flee at the very sight of your righteous light!

name: ArchVoid Healer
description: Healers of the ArchFiend serve the darkness, Evil, but above all… they server their Master, Nulgath!

name: ArchVoid Mage
description: Mages of the ArchFiend serve the darkness, Evil, but above all… they server their Master, Nulgath!

name: ArchVoid Rogue
description: Rogues of the ArchFiend serve the darkness, Evil, but above all… they server their Master, Nulgath!

name: ArchVoid Warrior
description: Warriors of the ArchFiend serve the darkness, Evil, but above all… they server their Master, Nulgath!

name: Archwraith (Armor)
description: Even though you have defeated the Archwraith, it seems as though he has he's taken something rather important from you… your soul!

name: Arctic Defender
description: All right stop, let's battle and defend. Ice is back to fight til the end. To the extreme I rock the cold like a villain, light up the field then sit back chillin'.

name: Arctic Dragonslayer
description: This prestigious armor is worn by a renowned sect of Dragonslayers who specialize in defeating the icy dragonbrood dwelling in the Northlands. Arctic Dragonslayers are believed to be magically attuned with the Aurora Borealis given the fact that the entire armor is Color Custom.

name: Arctic Eldritch
description: The icy rift continues to spew forth the most twisted of creatures… and now you can be one too!

name: Arctic Invader
description: You are ready to explore the Northlands!

name: Arctic Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Only the heartiest heroes are BRRRR-ave enough to sail the frozen seas that border the Northlands!

name: Arctic Naval Commander (AC)
description: Only the heartiest heroes are BRRRR-ave enough to sail the frozen seas that border the Northlands!

name: Arctic Necro-Draugr
description: An arrogant necromancer tried to harness a soul too cold to control. Their marrow froze, and ice burst forth. Trapped within their own body, the necromancer became a puppet.

name: Ardent Familiar Raiment
description: Ardent Familiars actively seek out combat, enjoying the fleeting flickers of life only found between life and death.

name: Ardent Shadowslayer
description: You battle the shadows, but that doesn't mean you have stay in them ALL the time.

name: Arena Rockstar
description: Are you ready to ROCK!? Click on this armor's back arm to change your hand into the iconic music fan's horns symbol \m/

name: Arena Warrior
description: ARE YOU NOT ENTERTAINED?

name: Arjuna
description: Through your courage, strength and humility, truth and justice will spread throughout the land.

name: Armadura da Pátria
description: Este novo traje mostrará sua verdadeira lealdade!

name: Armed Draconic Yokai Assassin
description: Members of the jizamurai families hidden in the Yokai Isles are assassins that are as fast as the wind, and can be just as invisible. Their inhuman skills come from drinking dragon blood. (Item is CC)

name: Armed Underworld Dark Ops
description: The Legion will march beyond the horizon of time. With knowledge smuggled to them from the future, their Lord arms them for warfare that will be immortalized in history to come.

name: Armed Underworld Stealth Ops (0 AC)
description: The Legion will march beyond the horizon of time. With knowledge smuggled to them from the future, their Lord arms them for warfare that will be immortalized in history to come.

name: Armed Underworld Stealth Ops (AC)
description: The Legion will march beyond the horizon of time. With knowledge smuggled to them from the future, their Lord arms them for warfare that will be immortalized in history to come.

name: Armor of Awe (Armor)
description: This insanely AWE-some armor is for the few the proud, those who stand up, draw their weapons and yell BattleOn! Gives 25% more rep, gold, XP, and class points when equipped.

name: Armor of Aww
description: AWWWW! Could this be the real thing? The Wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive powers… of ADORABLENESS!

name: Armor of Aya
description: Aya, lady of the Dunes, knows all that pass through the Sandsea and the Realms of the Djinn. Secrets are borne to her ears upon the wind, and she keeps them in a jeweled casket by her side.

name: Armor of Azalith
description: You can feel the dark power pulsing off this armor. It is a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Armor of Elim
description: This is the armor of the hero who gave his life defending the world from Kezeroth's first attempt to destroy Lore, thousands of years ago.

name: Armor of the Skulls
description: This hellashish armor is infused with the skulls of your vanquished enemies.

name: Armor of the Sun
description: This scorching armor will provide protection even in the most sizzling of battles.

name: Armor of Valthos
description: Valthos, Guardian of the Djinn Realm, targets his enemies' weaknesses. He is undefeated in single combat, and hoped to someday become Crulon's second in command.

name: Armor of War
description: The Apocalypse is upon us! Prepare yourself for the fire and brimstone! Doesn't hurt to look radical when the world is starting anew.

name: Armor of Zular
description: Zular is the oldest, and some say, wisest, of the Djinn Realm Guardians. When Crulon joined their ranks, he was the warrior set to shadow him on his first watchpost.

name: Armor-Shaped Giftbox
description: A present shaped like an armor! Save this and it will magiclly open at the start of the new year. No peeking!

name: Armor-shaped Present
description: A present in shape of an armor.

name: Armored Cosmic Void (0 AC)
description: Mortals of strict discipline and focused minds are asked to meditate in the hostile depths of the Fiend's Void. Their bodies dissolve in an excruciatingly painful process, but what emerges is a cosmic body of near-limitless strength.

name: Armored Cosmic Void (AC)
description: Mortals of strict discipline and focused minds are asked to meditate in the hostile depths of the Fiend's Void. Their bodies dissolve in an excruciatingly painful process, but what emerges is a cosmic body of near-limitless strength.

name: Armored Defender of Battleon
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Armored Dwarfhold Prospector
description: The mountains' shifting veins are laden with gold and precious gems. Dwarves have an affinity for finding deposits, but the mountain won't give up its riches for free. This gem studded armor protects them from being swallowed by the dangers of the depths.

name: Armored Extraterrene
description: Forged with impenetrable ore, this extraterrestrial battle suit offers its owner total protection from opposing forces. Now, if only something could be done about that fiendish complexion…

name: Armored Hashashin Armor
description: An elusive assassin sect, the Armored Hashashin was built for victory and designed created by your fellow player, Rohan!

name: Armored Royal Prince
description: You may have guards and maids to do your bidding but you also like to get your hands dirty! Crafted by the Hero that goes by Royal Knight.

name: Armored Snug Bear
description: A bear necessity for those who wish to stay snuggle wuggle warm and moderately protected as well.

name: Armored Turdraken Slayer
description: Go after that Turdraken and make sure there are plenty of leftovers for sandwiches!

name: Armored Victor of Battleon
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Armure l'Amour (AC)
description: For those who don't always want to wear their hearts on their sleeves. (Now it's on your gauntlet!)

name: Armure l'Amour (Legend)
description: For those who don't always want to wear their hearts on their sleeves. (Now it's on your gauntlet!)

name: Artifact Hunter (Armor) (AC)
description: Artifact hunters explore Lore selectively looking for rare and powerful artifacts to aid them in their battles and adventures.

name: Artifact Hunter (Armor) (Merge)
description: Artifact hunters explore Lore selectively looking for rare and powerful artifacts to aid them in their battles and adventures.

name: Artix Panel Survivor
description: You are on eof the few who attended an Artix Entertainment panel… and survived! /cheer

name: Artix's Golden Paladin Armor
description: The Paladins of Lore salute you, Hero. May your battles against the undead be always victorious! Battle ON!

name: Artix's Wedding Party
description: Nice plate mail, Wedding Warrior! Now you just need to find a Wedding Rogue, a Wedding Mage and a Wedding Healer. That's what you meant by "wedding party", right?

name: Ascendant
description: Ascendants are Atealan mages who can bend the power of the cosmos to their will, gaining power from the six zodiac signs of the Atealans to channel in battle.

name: Ascendant Asgardian Plate
description: When mortals first lost their lives to war, some were not content to let their warriors sleep in dirt. They were sanctified in flames, and rose into the sky, high enough to shine beside the stars.

name: Ascended DarkCaster
description: Ascend into darkness and fulfill your destiny! Unleash your full potential as the greatest Undead Legion DarkCaster the world has ever seen!

name: Ascended Dragon of Time
description: The Eternal Dragon of Time is one of the most powerful beings Lore has ever seen. Torn by war, corrupted by Chaos, and reborn anew to walk Lore once more - wield the power wisely.

name: Ascended Legion Evoker
description: The Lord of the Legion began perfecting his craft when the practice of dark magic and necromancy was still in its infancy. The Evokers continue his studies, manipulating the Darkness of the ancients.

name: Ascended Paladin
description: To join the exalted ranks of the Ascended Paladins, one must be the purest of the pure.

name: Ascended SoulWeaver
description: To become a SoulWeaver you must bond with an Elemental Spirit partner. Together, using the Spirit Looms you have forged, you may weave wonderful cloth that cannot be destroyed.

name: Ascended Voidcaster (0 AC)
description: Those who sign Nulgath's contract gain access to the infinite wellspring of arcane energy contained within the void. Those who ascend find themselves consumed by the power.

name: Ascended VoidCaster (AC)
description: Those who sign Nulgath's contract gain access to the infinite wellspring of arcane energy contained within the void. Those who ascend find themselves consumed by the power.

name: Ascent To Protect
description: Those who wear this armor shall ascend to the ranks of holy power!

name: Asgardian Knight (0 AC)
description: Asgardians are capable of drawing power from auroras, allowing them to light their way through the moonless Frostvals.

name: Asgardian Knight (AC)
description: Asgardians are capable of drawing power from auroras, allowing them to light their way through the moonless Frostvals.

name: Asgardian Plate
description: Forged in the land of the gods, this Thundering plate commands the fury and anger of the gods it was forged by. Every step you take booms with the fury of a thunderstorm. Every strike cracks with the intensity of lighting.

name: Asgir Armor
description: The Asgir'Rook tribe was once thought to be little more than legend. The power of their mystical tattoos is very real, however…

name: Ashen Nymph
description: Nature is your boutique when clothes made of spring leaves are in style. They're eco-friendly too.

name: Asherion Armor
description: DoomKnights never give up. Never give in. And NEVER bow to anyone.

name: Ashray Elf Warden
description: ﻿The Ashray Water Elves served the Avatar Neso as Wardens of her Champion and of the Temple of Water. They rode tidal waves into battle to spread the ocean, yet they disappeared when the tide fell low.

name: Ashray Pyromancer
description: ﻿There is a sickness unique to the shores of Ashray, one that calls the villagers to the sea and never lets them go. Those that have studied pyromancy are able to resist its call, and handily defend their home from tentacled terrors.

name: Ashray Villager
description: ﻿﻿The villagers of Ashray rely heavily on the sea for their livelihoods. They consider it a second home, able to navigate the waves even in the dead of night as they sing and dance.

name: Asmat Warrior
description: Traditionally made of straw, Ewer clothing and accessories are worn by the men and women of Western Nunsantara for ceremonies.

name: Aspiring Admiral of Crystallis (0 AC)
description: The Archivist has assigned the Crystallis Admiral to reclaim what belongs to her…What could she have lost?

name: Aspiring Admiral of Crystallis (AC)
description: The Archivist has assigned the Crystallis Admiral to reclaim what belongs to her…What could she have lost?

name: Aspiring Necromancer (Armor)
description: Zorbak says, "Mehehehehe. So you want to be a Necromancer? You'll have to try harder than that!"

name: Assassin Armor
description: Much like a ninja, an assassin is stealthy and quick.

name: Assassin Commander (AC)
description: To eliminate the competition or figurehead, this leather getup must be prepared for inclement weather or blown covers.

name: Assassin Commander (Legend)
description: To eliminate the competition or figurehead, this leather getup must be prepared for inclement weather or blown covers.

name: Assassin of Nulgath (AC)
description: Open wide. One bite delivers a lasting, but agonizing burn that puts the opponent on the brink of a swift death. Could it be that another phantom dwells inside?

name: Assassin of Nulgath (Legend)
description: Open wide. One bite delivers a lasting, but agonizing burn that puts the opponent on the brink of a swift death. Could it be that another phantom dwells inside?

name: Assassin of Resolution
description: Like the Paladins of Resolution, this sect of assassins are dedicated to upholding New Year's resolutions through their mastery of stealth and speed!

name: Assassin of Shadows
description: Darkness falls across the land, and the midnight hour is close at hand… Wise heroes avoid you on Friday the 13th, when your power is at its strongest.

name: Assassin of the Sands
description: Sandsea assassins have to be specially trained. They learn how to walk silently on sand, how to not leave footprints, and most of all, how to eliminate their target and leave unnoticed.

name: Assassin of Vokun
description: Vokun's personal bodyguards, they move about the shadows of the Forgotten Tombs unnoticed.

name: Assassins of the Abyss Armor
description: Deep within Dage's Legion lies the dark Assassins of the Abyss. These highly trained assassins are able to move swiftly through the Nation's ranks, giving their enemies a whole meaning of pain!

name: Assault Gear
description: When a job needs doin' it get it done by these top covert ops. Quick effective and a force to be reckoned with.

name: Astral Celestial
description: The light of the Celestial condenses, leaving flickers of starlight. They become one with the fabric of the universe. Celestials hope that this is what becomes of them when they near death, ready to embrace their creator once again.

name: Astral Dragonknight (Armor)
description: Their claws can tear through the fabrics of space, and from their breath comes newborn stars. These Astral Dragons were born deep in the cosmos, fated to serve a sovereign who has yet to claim their crown.CC to Trim, Accessory)

name: Astral Entity
description: Raw mana has taken on the form of the human body, completely encompassing you in a self-existing para-elemental plane of pure magic. Your being no longer belongs to the physical world.

name: Astral Guardian (AC)
description: You have been chosen to defend section of the multiverse from all threats physical, ethereal, celestial or infernal.

name: Astral Guardian (Special)
description: You have been chosen to defend section of the multiverse from all threats physical, ethereal, celestial or infernal.

name: Astral Mantle
description: Mystical threads weave their way through the sublime cloth that surrounds you. Mana energy flows freely in the air around you, and you feel almost… divine.

name: Astral Star Captain
description: I will travel across the space, searching far and wide. To protect those is my real cause to save my galaxy!

name: Astral Symbiote
description: You become one with the fabric of space, spread across galaxies and stars, nowhere and everywhere.

name: Astral Vacuum Black
description: Travelling through timespace can color the body with the stars and nebulas that hang around the cosmos in exchange for a split body. That's why timespace travel should be left to professionals.

name: Astral Vacuum Blue
description: Travelling through timespace can color the body with the stars and nebulas that hang around the cosmos in exchange for a split body. That's why timespace travel should be left to professionals.

name: Astral Vacuum Green
description: Travelling through timespace can color the body with the stars and nebulas that hang around the cosmos in exchange for a split body. That's why timespace travel should be left to professionals.

name: Astral Vacuum Pink
description: Travelling through timespace can color the body with the stars and nebulas that hang around the cosmos in exchange for a split body. That's why timespace travel should be left to professionals.

name: Astral Wanderer (AC)
description: You are one of the few who are able to walk the paths of strange particles that connect all astral bodles in the multiverse together.

name: Astral Wanderer (Special)
description: You are one of the few who are able to walk the paths of strange particles that connect all astral bodles in the multiverse together.

name: Astravia Occult Club
description: Mystery enthusiasts obsessed with the secrets of a secluded and advanced civilization. What were their castles built on? Alien wisdom? Eldritch spirits? It's a topic of hot debate!

name: Astravian Adept
description: Any mortal can become Astravian if they wish, and become vessels for a darker power than they ever imagined. But nothing in life is free… will YOU choose to become one of the Beloved?

name: Astravian Advisor
description: The standard costume for the advisor to King Drago, donning the Astravian royals' white and red theme.

name: Astravian Animancer
description: In an alternate reality, a rogue Astravian Animancer made a desperate attempt to unseal an Arcana fragment in Mystcroft. The ill-thought attempt unleashed a curse that fused human flesh with the spirits of Creatues of Madness, binding both with the Animancer's desire for havoc.

name: Astravian Buccaneer (0 AC)
description: Dissatisfied by their lot in life, these Astravians trekked through the snow to the coast. Here, the color black isn't for commoners. It's worn by the fierce seafarers that answer to the stars, not a lowly King.

name: Astravian Buccaneer (AC)
description: Dissatisfied by their lot in life, these Astravians trekked through the snow to the coast. Here, the color black isn't for commoners. It's worn by the fierce seafarers that answer to the stars, not a lowly King.

name: Astravian Cloaked Enforcer
description: Wicked officers cut from the same cloth as their indulgent and cruel ruler. Remember, white is worn by the noble. They likened themselves to the glowing stars in a sea of black void.

name: Astravian Corsair
description: Nobility from Astravia that believed in the same conquest as their tyrant King, but set sail to take everything for themselves. The stars guide their sails, and sailors fear that they grant the corsair's every greedy wish.

name: Astravian Court Alchemist
description: In one era, the colour of brilliant crimson and gold feathers were symbols of divine protection. In another, they became marks of power, wealth, and ambition. The last King of Astravia seeks no further definition for trivial tokens.

name: Astravian Enforcer
description: Wicked officers cut from the same cloth as their indulgent and cruel ruler. Remember, white is worn by the noble. They likened themselves to the glowing stars in a sea of black void.

name: Astravian General
description: If the Ruler is the head of the Kingdom of Astravia, then the Generals are their bloodied hands. More often not, their white armor was dyed red by their great deeds. Regulus and Titania wished for the peaceful age their Prince would usher in. One where their armor would shine instead of bleed.

name: Astravian Mercenary's Garb (AC)
description: After having left the army, many took on the job of mercenaries. In Astravia, even hoping for peace is considered a delusion.

name: Astravian Mercenary's Garb (Legend)
description: After having left the army, many took on the job of mercenaries. In Astravia, even hoping for peace is considered a delusion.

name: Astravian Mercenary's Jacket
description: After having left the army, many took on the job of mercenaries. In Astravia, even hoping for peace is considered a delusion.

name: Astravian Musician
description: Astravia was once a kingdom blessed with many artists and musicians, but due to the constant state of war under King Drago's reign, that is no longer the case.

name: Astravian Naval Rebel (0 AC)
description: This corsair took the white noble coat of a noble and drenched them in the colors of Astravia's commoners. They give refuge to fleeing Astravian refugees, and exact bloody sentences on oppressors.

name: Astravian Naval Rebel (AC)
description: This corsair took the white noble coat of a noble and drenched them in the colors of Astravia's commoners. They give refuge to fleeing Astravian refugees, and exact bloody sentences on oppressors.

name: Astravian Officer
description: The standard costume for the officer of Astravia, donning the Astravian's theme.

name: Astravian Oracle
description: May the stars guide you ever onwards as you battle towards your destiny.

name: Astravian Royal Guard (Armor)
description: A group of elite soldiers, formed solely to protect King Drago, by the order of Drago himself.

name: Astravian Royal Secretary
description: For every noble, business, and underground syndicate, there is a sharply dressed secretary to handle the timetable. You want to talk to the boss? They're too busy. You want to accuse them of a wrong doing? Refer to our FAQ under the section "You can't prove anything."

name: Astravian Secretary
description: For every noble, business, and underground syndicate, there is a sharply dressed secretary to handle the timetable. You want to talk to the boss? They're too busy. You want to accuse them of a wrong doing? Refer to our FAQ under the section "You can't prove anything."

name: Astravian Shadow Adept
description: Any mortal can become Astravian if they wish, and become vessels for a darker power than they ever imagined. But nothing in life is free… will YOU choose to become one of the Beloved?

name: Astravian Soldier (Armor)
description: The only way an aspiring Astravian can get closer to the stars is by joining the army. They start as a lowly foot soldier, but as their martial powers grow, so do their egos.

name: Astravian Urban Duelist
description: Rebellious Astravians took to counter culture fashion trends, tattoos, and unsanctioned blade mastery. They proudly wore black during the reign of King Drakonis, and were one of the first to fight back when King Drago exercised his tyranny.

name: Astravian Violinist
description: Astravia was once a kingdom blessed with many artists and musicians, but due to the constant state of war under King Drago's reign, that is no longer the case.

name: Astrium Armor
description: The Astrium Concord are the forgotten watchers. The true force behind the Solaris and Lunaris cults, keeping the balance.

name: Astro Riftbreaker
description: These interstellar travelers chase after the edge of the infinite cosmos. They use nebular energy to hop from one star system to the next. If life exists somewhere out in space, they've already been there.

name: Astro Seer
description: A visitor from the planet Jonu, a world lightyears away that neighbours a giant black hole. Vibrant violet quasars pulse in its night sky. They've come to Lore to see if the grass is greener.

name: Astro Voyager
description: A visitor from the planet Jonu, a world lightyears away, that neighbours a giant black hole. Vibrant violet quasars pulse in its night sky. They've come to Lore to see if the grass is greener.

name: Astromancer
description: By the light of the North Star, you battle your way through an almost-infinite horde of foes. But as long as you stay true and keep to the course you've set, you'll reach the eternal glory you seek.

name: Astromancer Mage
description: These mages look to the stars for their divination powers. Reading the night sky to foresee omens, much can be learned from an Astromancer.

name: Astromancer's Apprentice
description: By the light of the North Star, you battle your way through an almost-infinite horde of foes. But as long as you stay true and keep to the course you've set, you'll reach the eternal glory you seek.

name: Astrum Vela Mage
description: These mages are tasked with an ancient mission - protecting the sanctity of Lore. Their veil falls over the stars, shielding Lore from the wandering eyes of the heavens.

name: Astute Dress
description: For the woman on the go! (color custom) (Warning: Males will see no effect from wearing this item.)

name: Atlas Elite (Armor)
description: Blades honed by time and experience, few Warriors of the present day can hope to stand a chance against these Elites. Only time and inevitability can leave their mark on tarnished gold.

name: Atlas Knight (Armor)
description: The Atlas Knights serve as King Zedek's loyal pride. Inspired by his dreams and fortitude, they'll pave the way for their liege's ascension, no matter how long it takes.

name: Atlas Light Mage (Armor)
description: The scholars of Atlas were given all the time they needed to master their craft. Spells and potions that would have needed generations to refine were perfected in the hands of the original dreamer.

name: Atlas Wedding Attire
description: Weddings are a joyous occasion in Atlas. Some marry for love, others to secure their future. And when the Kingdom of the Millennium King drifts towards the sunset, his brides are never seen again.

name: Audioroid (AC)
description: UNCE UNCE UNCE *beep bzzzt* UNCE UNCE SKRRRRRZZT

name: Audioroid (Non-AC)
description: UNCE UNCE UNCE *beep bzzzt* UNCE UNCE SKRRRRRZZT

name: Aulorian
description: Let the golden reflections show you the way!

name: Aure Knight
description: A stoic knight of legend who achieved valiant feats of heroism in the name of their homeland. As time passed, mountains moved and oceans shifted. The Kingdom they served sunk into the nether, and the knight followed, loyal to the end.

name: Aureate Aegis
description: A new breed of warrior was born in the unforgiving darkness of the mountain's veins. Chaos Lord Vath's conquest will not happen again, even if the Dwarves must risk the mountain's fury by draining enchanted gold from its heart.

name: Aureate Shield Aegis
description: A new breed of warrior was born in the unforgiving darkness of the mountain's veins. Chaos Lord Vath's conquest will not happen again, even if the Dwarves must risk the mountain's fury by draining enchanted gold from its heart.

name: Aureate White Tiger
description: A warrior who trained under the stars at the Shrine of the Four Cardinal Directions. The White Tiger Constellation blessed these devotees with might and ambition. Armed with fists alone, they hunt Dragons.

name: Auric Leonine Archer
description: A lovely gold and white armor (or maybe it's black and blue) fitting for the Archer's of Pyrewatch.

name: Aurola's Armor
description: Before Prince Darkon journeyed to the First Observatory, he fastened his chestplate to his most trusted knight. Until he returned, Aurola would guard Suki with her life. Darkon's armor would protect Aurola in turn. And so, the Prince and the former pauper said their farewells.

name: Aurola's Casual Wear
description: A sporty outfit meant to help Aurola blend in with the younger crowds in Astravia. Those denim shorts aren't going anywhere so Darkon was confused about why she needed suspenders. Regulus put it simply – You can't fight crime without being stylish.

name: Aurora Caller
description: A sect of Luminomancers, Aurora Callers summon the northern lights and draw power from the bright magic contained inside them.

name: Aurora Carnaval
description: Dance until the sun falls out of the sky, and light up the streets until they outshine the stars!

name: Auroral DoomKnight
description: This auroral armor is an anomaly among its kind. It was forged from the body of a dead Doom Spirit that gorged on stars until their light led to its demise. Now, those constellations are trapped in your shadow.

name: Auroran Cryomagus (0 AC)
description: A Cryomagus embodies the gentle and myserious facet of snowfall. Their magic and wisdom is as ancient and vast as the aurora that only appears before ice.

name: Auroran Cryomagus (AC)
description: A Cryomagus embodies the gentle and myserious facet of snowfall. Their magic and wisdom is as ancient and vast as the aurora that only appears before ice.

name: Aurus Via Armor
description: *No description*

name: AUS Rugby Armor
description: You'll be on the ball when you /equip this AUS-some rugby armor! Crowds of your /party members will /cheer as your crit-ically score against your enemies!

name: Auspicious Arch Mammona Raiment
description: Known for their great intellect and influence, the Arch Mammonae are pursuers of wealth and value only following mortals who catch their perceptive eye.

name: Auspicious ShadowSlayer (0 AC)
description: These ShadowSlayer's toil in defense of the Crown.  Stationed in Darkovia, they hold the line against the Vampires and Weres.

name: Auspicious ShadowSlayer (AC)
description: These ShadowSlayer's toil in defense of the Crown.  Stationed in Darkovia, they hold the line against the Vampires and Weres.

name: Austere Shadowslayer (AC)
description: To be devoted to one's task and to Have few wants is the way of the Shadowslayer. What meager possessions they carry on their person is all that they need. Don these garments and overcome greed.

name: Austere Shadowslayer (Legend)
description: To be devoted to one's task and to Have few wants is the way of the Shadowslayer. What meager possessions they carry on their person is all that they need. Don these garments and overcome greed.

name: Autumn Days Outfit
description: After a long day of battling, /rest before you go back to training at night. A hero's work is never done!

name: Autumn Nymph
description: Nature is your boutique when clothes made of autumn leaves are in style. They're eco-friendly and amazing to wear for a harvest celebration too.

name: Autumn Sienna Undertaker
description: A warm sienna suit made from luxurious velvet. Fall under the leaves, and let the Undertaker usher you to the next world.

name: Autumn Undertaker (AC)
description: A warm sienna suit made from luxurious velvet. Fall under the leaves, and let the Undertaker usher you to the next world.

name: Autumn Undertaker (Legend)
description: A warm sienna suit made from luxurious velvet. Fall under the leaves, and let the Undertaker usher you to the next world.

name: Autumnal Civilian
description: The season when your clothes become as comfy as knitted blankets. Fall is the season to get corny, appreciate the rare blooms, and marvel at the changing colors.

name: Autumniphile
description: The season when your clothes become as comfy as knitted blankets. Fall is the season to get comy, appreciate the rare blooms, and marvel at the changing colors.

name: Avarice of the Legion
description: Avarice is a trait that many in the Legion possess. They crave loot, gold, and glory.

name: Avatar of Conquest
description: The spirit of the Horseman of Conquest has possessed your body and lent you his strength and power. Your voice commands the masses to kneel, and they do so with a smile.

name: Avatar of Death (1)
description: What power do you hold that you can manifest as the Avatar of Death itself?

name: Avatar of Death (2)
description: The spirit of the Horseman of Death has possessed your body. Kill by sword, famine and plague, and by the wild beasts of the earth.

name: Avatar of Famine
description: The spirit of the Horseman of Famine has possessed you. You are the Law-Giver, the Dark Rider, and the embodiment of disparity. Suffering is man-made.

name: Avatar Of Life (AC)
description: The most revered of the Avatars. They rarely set foot on the ground, preferring the feel of being a cloud. (This is the AC shortcut version of the Armor)

name: Avatar Of Life (Merge)
description: The most revered of the Avatars. They rarely set foot on the ground, preferring the feel of being a cloud. This ability would cause them sometimes to be mistaken for ghosts.

name: Avatar of Spirits (Armor)
description: Guiding lost Souls to the Celestial Realm, you must be wise, fair and bestow a presende of calm understanding. Do this and you will be an Avatar of Souls.

name: Avatar Of Time (Armor)
description: As the Avatar of Time there's no time like the present to be high-tech and contemporary.

name: Avatar of War
description: The spirit of the Horseman of War possesses your body and lends you his power. War doesn't just claim warriors. The wrath and tears of innocent, the old, and the young are claimed by the Crimson Rider.

name: Avatar's Flame
description: The Elemental Avatars act through their Champions on Lore. The power, passion, and energy they bestow burning with an intensity that would sear a normal mortal's mind and body.

name: Avis Magi
description: Fly headstrong into battle as an Avis Magi, master of the birds. Give a whole new meaning to fowl play!

name: Avomancer
description: No bones about it this the gravy train of armors. Anything else for Harvest would just be fowl.

name: Awakened Doomknight Tyrant
description: Devastatingly powerful, a Shadowscythe General of this caliber has the might to test even the former Emperor's authority. Through battle and bloodshed, order is maintained in darkness.

name: Awakened Vordred
description: GUESS WHO'S BACK IN HIGH DEFINITION! BUT, IT'S NOT ENOUGH. MORE SKULLS. MORE DEATH. MORE SCREENTIME FOR VORDRED.

name: Awards Show Outfit
description: Walk the red carpet in this stylish frock while rocking to the Zardile Rock!

name: Awards Show Tux
description: Walk the red carpet in this stylish frock while rocking to the Zardile Rock!

name: Awescended
description: A symbol of the preservation of Lore's history. This item gives 30% more gold and 50% more class points and rep when equipped.

name: Awescended (IoDA)
description: A symbol of the preservation of Lore's history. This item gives 30% more gold and 50% more class points and rep when equipped.

name: Axeros Moult
description: The human body can only endure so much that Axeros dedicated his entire life finding and creating what he called the "perfect vessel". This obsession eventually lead to his demise. But he didn't stop there.

name: Azalith's Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: The voyagers who encounter the first Infernal aren't interested in plunder. They seek to rebel, crush crowns, and claim the seas as their own, even if it means they'll fall.

name: Azalith's Naval Commander (AC)
description: The voyagers who encounter the first Infernal aren't interested in plunder. They seek to rebel, crush crowns, and claim the seas as their own, even if it means they'll fall.

name: Azul Forest Warrior
description: You unlocked this badge by purchasing an upgrade through Paymentez! Battle On!

name: Azure Cleric Of Time
description: It's said "Time heals all wounds", wise words for a Cleric.

name: Azure Dragonknight
description: Prove your worth and you too may be invited to become a DragonKnight! The azure hue of the armor signifies a pure heart and a strong arm

name: Azure Necromancer
description: "I got a whole undead army in my hands. I got a whole undead army in my hands. I got an undead army in my hands." (Sang in D minor)

name: Azure SpitFire
description: The Azure Spitfire mercenaries, unlike the Crimson SpitFire mercenaries use cunning skills and deception to beat out their brethren in a long standing contest that dates back to times long forgotten. Only the bounties given out by the Deathshead Destroyers will decide which can will reign supreme.

name: Azurefall Dragonblood
description: The descendants of Ice Dragons, mightier than their forebears because of mixed blood. Though they had no scales of their own, they wore hide gifted to them by their Draconic kin.

name: BabyDoll Slayer
description: Tossed aside like so many broken toys…

name: BaconCat Commander
description: Rally your troops Commander the army of the LaserSharks cannot win!

name: Bad Romancer
description: I want your mauve, I want your cerise, I want your fuchsia, pretty pretty please. (Suggested by the pink-loving Hero, Hancok!)

name: Badger Brigade Armor
description: Badger us for a fight! We dare you!

name: Bagged Undead
description: Hey guys! Check out my- oh fiddlesticks. I'm not allowed to talk. Ah, well. C'est la vie. AROOOOO!

name: Bagged Undead (temp)
description: Hey guys! Check out my- oh fiddlesticks. I'm not allowed to talk. Ah, well. C'est la vie. AROOOOO!

name: Bainneach Mór Suit
description: Adh Mor Ort, my friend! May you always find victory in battle, a life full of happiness, and even greater rewards than those you seek.

name: Bakunawa's Guard
description: Your quest is to follow the Bakunawa, the serpent who eats moons, no matter where it journeys. Your mission: to protect the seventh moon, the sea, and the safety of your people.

name: Ballroom Dress
description: Be back before midnight! (Girls Only.)

name: BallyCool Armor
description: Ballyhoo was beside herself with excitement for the holidays. The best part was naming her new outfit.

name: BallyCool Outfit
description: Ballyhoo was beside herself with excitement for the holidays. The best part was naming her new outfit.

name: Ballyhoo's Outfit
description: If these are Ballyhoo's clothes… then what is she wearing right now?!

name: Banana Suit
description: Peanut Butter Jelly Time! This is one classic costume. Happy Mogloween!

description: What the bandits wore during the age of yore.. in Lore.

description: Wall hallo thar.

description: *No description*

description: The attire of the Darkwolf Bandits.

name: Bandit Drakath (Temp)
description: *No description*

name: Banished Brawler
description: Banished, but not beaten. You walk. Searching for your purpose. For your place and time. And also, for things to stab with your sweet armblades.

name: Banisher Armor
description: A gilded armor for a golden hero, you'll outshine your enemies with this awesome plate designed by Blake Don.

name: Banshee Dress
description: A banshee is unwelcome no matter where they go. Their walls fortell of loss. Everyone, whether they know it or not, has something to lose.

name: Barbaric Tribesman
description: Barbarians fight with the ferocity of a wild animal.

name: Barber Armor
description: Hair today, gone tomorrow! Be a barber and control the destiny of your friends and neighbors.

name: Bard (Armor)
description: Music rocks your world, and the battlefield. Your special abilities allow you to stay in tune with those around you, whether your powers are used to heal or to hurt.

name: Bareboru Uniform
description: Get ready to game in your own customizable Jersey!

name: Barista (Armor)
description: Air-breathers need coffee to live, and the dead need coffee to feel some semblance of being alive. Baristas are an essential professional service.

name: Bark Caster
description: Puns are the ROOT of all Evil.

name: Baron Sundae Armor
description: The deliciously menacing Baron Sundae with his magically sweet wares. Careful of the ice cream it might melt.

name: Baron Sunday (Armor)
description: Party like an undead voodoo dude!

name: Barong Outfit
description: Maligayang Araw ng Kalayaan sa lahat ng manlalaro sa Pilipinas.

name: Basilisk Ranger
description: The Basilisk is easily the most deadly of the four legendary beasts of Greenguard Forest. Its stare is as deadly as its venomous bite. No hunter would dare track this beast… until you proved it could be defeated.

name: Bat Vigilante
description: What makes a night-happy cowboy a little odd is the fact they are attired as if they were soldiers. They treat unsuspecting abductions as a sport and are most active every new moon when the night covers almost every victim's surroundings, making their "game" easier to play.

name: Battle Berserker
description: The Berserker is one of the most feared of all warriors. They romp through all enemies without a thought to their own welfare, taking down innumerable foes.

name: Battle Bride and Groom
description: As long as we both shall live. Possibly even longer.

name: Battle Cleric of the Dragon
description: The Priests of the Dragon suspect dragon's blood may run in the veins of Swordhaven's royal family, if only a thin stream. Battle Clerics have sworn to guard both the priests of their order and members of the royal family until death… and beyond.

name: Battle Frost King and Queen
description: Only the most worthy of royalty can tame the frigid northlands!

name: Battle Oracle
description: Oracles are strong healers and can see into everyone's future, past and present, even if they don't know it! They are excellent at maintaining the health and status of their friends. They can also notify their friends of their opponents weaknesses and strengths, making them the perfect ones to accept a party invite from.

name: Battle Party Gear
description: Battle your way right into the New Year!

name: Battle Priest of the Sky
description: Inspired by Player Enzanijuiin, you can now take to the sky and conjure those spells that require a higher altitude! Your spells keep casting me higher than I ever been casted before!

name: Battle Q-Pid
description: Those who say robots don't show emotions have never seen a Q-Pid unit. These fighting machines are capable of giving dating advice and can help write a mean love song uploaded straight from the motherboard.

name: Battle Ready Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: A Naval Commander that claimed the Blood Isles for themselves. They sunk ships, unknowingly feeding a wrathful song gallons of blood, until they too became red mist in sea. (Click hand to shift hand)

description: A Naval Commander that claimed the Blood Isles for themselves. They sunk ships, unknowingly feeding a wrathful song gallons of blood, until they too became red mist in sea. (Click hand to shift hand)

name: Battle Tested Axe Master
description: Zhilo's battle-hardened suit of blue and white plate. It has saved him from dozens of near-fatal attacks. May it do the same for you.

name: Battle Track Suit
description: In this gear, you can outrun any enemy, but why would you?

name: Battle Zeke (Armor)
description: If you stay up ALL WEEK and leave the X-Bot on overnight, every night, this is what happens. Time to take your sub-standard construction out on gamers all over the globe!

name: BattleGems Shirt
description: 103% Cotton-poly blend Artix Ent shirts will NOT protect you from brutal uni-corn-y puns. They WILL protect you from lack of style and bad fashion choices.

name: BattleLord of Ravens (Armor)
description: The lord of many names, he who calls the warriors home — the Ravenlord rules from the Final Battlefield in the North.

name: BattleMage Armor (AC)
description: Battlemages focus on taking down their opponents as quickly as possible. They are capable of focusing greater amounts of mana into each spell for the maximum effect. They specialize in wearing heavy armor for defense in order to spend all of their mana on offensive spells.

name: BattleMage Armor (Non-AC)
