name: Battlemage of Light
description: Using spells calling on the Light, these Battlemages are feared throughout the darker parts of Lore.

name: BattleMage of Love Armor
description: Battlemages focus on taking down their opponents as quickly as possible. It might be hard given their enemies won't be able to take them seriously looking like this. (Suggested by Caim)

description: A legendary Warrior from the OverSoul, Tharr followed Nulgath the ArchFiend through the portal. His goal: to find new battlefields to conquer and opponents to crush.

name: BattleOn Destroyer
description: BattleOn has seen much strife over the years. It has always persevered. Help destroy that record they've fought so hard to maintain.

name: Battleon Warlord

description: You wear skin, you absorb Druuz power and skill. Druuz live on in you. Respect.

name: Beast Warrior Armor
description: Graaawwwwwrrr!

description: Ruthless as the beasts whose hides they've taken for their own, these battlemages hunt apex predators and legends. The more they devour, the more powerful their magic grows.

description: Harness the power of Ke and destroy all the planets you want in 5 minutes but may actually take 50 episodes.

name: Bellhop Minion
description: Unless you can defeat my bellhops!

name: Beloved Blessing Garb
description: A personalized outfit tailored for a ceremony that will bind your heart to another's. May the gods and the earth itself smile upon your joy.

name: Benediction
description: Several suits of this armor were discovered deep in the heart of Lightguard Keep, forgotten by Time. We believe that they are the suits of high-ranking members of the original Order of Paladins, worn to welcome newly-ascended warriors into their ranks.

name: Benevolent Yukata
description: The Empress' oracle has read your horoscope and declares: this will be a VERY auspicious year for you, no matter what sign you were born under.

name: Berserker Armor
description: Mad with rage, a Berserker is a warrior fueled by fury!

name: Berserker Bunny
description: These mysterious beasts seem to have traveled here from another dimension.

name: Berserker Champion
description: These Berserkers have won countless battles and their thirst for combat is never ending. The mere sight of one of these juggernauts will strike fear into the enemy and in most cases send them running before the battle has begun!

name: Bestial Warlord (0 AC)
description: Warlords of Dage the Evil that have been awarded with a larger portion of his soul. All members of the Legion have a fragment of Dage's soul, but the Bestial Warlords are capable of harnessing the ferocity of the Beast.

description: Warlords of Dage the Evil that have been awarded with a larger portion of his soul. All members of the Legion have a fragment of Dage's soul, but the Bestial Warlords are capable of harnessing the ferocity of the Beast.

name: Big Love Formal Wear

name: Bio-War Cultist (AC)

name: Bio-War Cultist (Special)
description: They say war does strange things to you. Turning you into a half human half bio creature is one of them.

name: Biobeast Master

name: Bioluminous
description: The glowing stones deep within the Tower of Doom make for an incredible accent to this incredible armor.

name: Bioluminous Amanita
description: The glowing stones deep within the Tower of Doom make an incredible accent to this incredible armor.

name: Bionic Bunny

name: Bitterblade Rogue
description: The frozen tundra of the Northlands is home to these nomadic rogues.

name: BitterCrystal Mage Robes
description: Your enemies will freeze in fear when you step onto the battlefield!

name: Black Bishop
description: In skilled hands, Bishops become forks of lightening, surgically infiltrating the enemy ranks and wreaking havoc among the back line.

name: Black Blood Fiend of Nulgath (0 AC)

This classy getup clearly displays a childish nature so be careful when putting it on. Bubble says you might feel an urge to act outside your age.

description: The armor of the Celestial Realm's most loyal and dedicated long-time guardians!

name: Celestial ArchFiend
description: Even Celestials can't escape dark desires, but somehow, those who sought out the Nation have not fallen. They retain their full majesty while wielding the voracious hunger of the Fiend's Void.

name: Celestial Avenger Armor

name: Celestial Bard

description: Sing, oh sing, of glory and our joyous victory! The light still shines, the dark has gone, and our celestial realm is free.

name: Celestial Guardian (1) (Legend)
description: Elite members of Aranx's disciples show great respect for Aranx by applying turquoise stones to their uniforms. The stones and the white/silver color are said to represent the sky at its brightest, allowing the disciples to appear more welcoming.

name: Celestial Healer
description: By channeling the bright power that courses through the ley lines that weave through the Celestial Realm, these healers are able to work almost miraculous feats of medical magic.

name: Celestial Knight (Armor)
description: Graced by the light, it is your heart's desire to spread it to those who need a little bit of encouragement every now and then. Your happiness is as clear as the sky that colors your majestic armor.

name: Celestial Lieutenant
description: The Celestials wage a never ending battle on the Infernals for control of the realm.

name: Celestial Lieutenant Temp
description: *No description*

name: Celestial Love Commander
description: A champion of pink and pretty things have earned themselves the sweet privilege to don the title as Beleen's Celestial Commander. Defend the cute, big-eyed animals and empower the world around you with joy and excitement. The perk is free jawbreakers for all commanders.

name: Celestial Naval Commander (AC)
description: Who said pirates can't have a good side? These peaceful privateer's work hard to shine pirates in a better light.

name: Celestial Naval Commander (Special)
description: Who said pirates can't have a good side? These peaceful privateer's work hard to shine pirates in a better light.

name: Celestial Nomad
description: The Bright One was born from a miracle, and gives pieces of itself to make more. The Celestial Wanderers are on a pilgrimage to find and recieve these blessings to better the world.

name: Celestial Oaklore Knight (0 AC)
description: Granting their magic to the forges of Oaklore, the Celestials lend their power to valiant knights that defend the innocent.

name: Celestial Oaklore Knight (AC)
description: Granting their magic to the forges of Oaklore, the Celestials lend their power to valiant knights that defend the innocent.

name: Celestial of Mysteries
description: The third Celestial created by The Bright One, meant to realize his brethren's true purpose…should Azalith fail. This fate was a mystery, even to his elder sisters.

name: Celestial Paladin (1)
description: This ethereal armor transcends beyond the powers of Good, you're now a Paladin on an entire new level.

name: Celestial Paladin (2)
description: Warriors of Light who thrive in the dark. The night is the domain of the stars, and those who harness their power will never know fear.

name: Celestial Pirate Commander
description: Whether you sail the seas or the skies, victory is always within your reach.(Item does 30% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)

name: Celestial Pyromancer
description: The blood and magical power of Celestial Pyromancers burn in their veins, a force that very few mortals can oppose.

name: Celestial Qipao
description: This heavenly outfit is a collaboration between Dragonrune Hall and Yokai Isles' fashion designers. It's a patch of the silver river that separated the stars Vega and Altair.

name: Celestial Sandknight
description: The Sandknights are those who devote themselves to the desert and all the life it supports. They maintain order in the lawless desert. Taking up the mantle, you now serve to protect all those who call the Sandsea home.

name: Celestial Slayer
description: There is too much Good in the world, time to spread foment!

name: Celestial StarMage
description: The stars aligned bestowing their magic on these mages!

name: Celestial Summoner
description: Creatures summoned by your celestial magic can be trusted implicitly… as long as you return their loyalty.

name: Celestial Symbiote
description: The Bright One has taken a mortal body, and planted a Celestial seed in their chest. It fills them with ethereal light and a great purpose.

name: Celestial Templar Guardian
description: Sworn to protect and serve, the Celestial Templar Guardians will defend any who seek refuge from the terrors that lurk in the Shadows.

name: Celestial Vampire Monarch (0 AC)
description: If the vampiric court was ever favored by the Celestials, they would become wreathed in white and light. But, their thirst for blood is needed in the ever present conflict with the infernals.

name: Celestial Vampire Monarch (AC)
description: If the vampiric court was ever favored by the Celestials, they would become wreathed in white and light. But, their thirst for blood is needed in the ever present conflict with the infernals.

name: Celestial Wanderer
description: The bright power emanating from this armor soothes your spirit and renews your flagging energy. It is a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Celestial Warrior (AC)
description: Olympian feats of athleticism, herculean strength, and a healthy lust for the field of battle. Celestial Warriors are Achilles without the heel.

name: Celestial Warrior (Legend)
description: Oplympian feats of athleticism, herculean strength, and a healthy lust for the field of battle. Celestial Warriors are Achilles without the heel.

name: Celestine Armor
description: A divine look for a supernatural hero.

name: Celtic Caster
description: You'll be clothed in the magic of the forest when you don this Celtic caster's garb. Happy Lucky Day!

name: Celtic Cutthroat
description: You've got a heavy brogue, rogue. But you don't need to be understood when you have daggers to speak for you. Happy Lucky Day!

name: Celtic Destroyer
description: Strike fear into the hearts of your enemies as you rain destruction down upon them. Bloodcurdling cries and a stylish plaid kilt only up the intimidation factor.

name: Celtic Disaster
description: Yikes! They weren't kidding, this is a disaster, Happy Unlucky Day 2015, you're going to need it.

name: Celtic Luck Weaver
description: May the wind be always at your back, may the sun shine warm upon your face, the rains fall soft upon your fields and until we meet again, may all your adventures prove lucky!

name: Celtic Warrior
description: Celtics are raised to be warriors from childhood. Some tribes would paint their bodies before running into battle.

name: Centaur Lord
description: Centaur warriors have long been some of Lore's fiercest and fastest fighters. With 4 hooves and as many blades as they can carry, they are a force to be reckoned with.

name: Centaurion Sentinel
description: A civilization locked black holes into the bodies of once valiant and noble Centurions, setting them loose into the space. Who weaponized them, and why give them free reign to choose what to obliterate? It's a mystery that'll go unsolved.

name: Centroavante Armor
description: Obrigado for supporting AQWorlds through Paymentez!

name: Centurion Bone Crusher
description: Nulgath's commanders break every recruit done to their bare bones before building them back up, and you skeleton, are no exception.

name: Centurion of the Sky
description: Soar to grater heights with this armor. Fell the air wrap around you in a luxurious layer of protection as you head, determined and unwavering, into battle.

name: Cerberus (Armor)
description: The bestial guardian of the Underworld, Cerberus calls no man master. He's always somewhat resistant to housebreaking, so if you keep your distance chances are you'll keep your head as well!

name: Ceremonial Attire
description: Whether leading an army in battle or planning your next adventure in Yulgar's Inn, you'll look like a hero.

name: Ceremonial Elven Winter Garb (0 AC)
description: Garb worn during the Winter Equinox, a celebrated day when the ancestors of the Ice Elves broke away from Camlan. The Northlands breathed frost into their lungs, allow them to thrive…for a time.

name: Ceremonial Elven Winter Garb (AC)
description: Garb worn during the Winter Equinox, a celebrated day when the ancestors of the Ice Elves broke away from Camlan. The Northlands breathed frost into their lungs, allow them to thrive…for a time.

name: Ceremonial Elven Winter Garb (Legend)
description: Garb worn during the Winter Equinox, a celebrated day when the ancestors of the Ice Elves broke away from Camlan. The Northlands breathed frost into their lungs, allow them to thrive…for a time.

name: Ceremonial Jade Samurai
description: By decree of the Emperor of Yokai Isle, only the noblest, most loyal warriors are worthy of equipping the royal Jade Samurai gear.

name: Ceremonial Legion Armor (AC)
description: The reflecting light that brightens the metallic silver that comprises this regal suit acts as a mirror, but what it reveals cannot be seen in plain mind, but rather by a sharp minded subconscious.

name: Ceremonial Legion Armor (Legend)
description: The reflecting light that brightens the metallic silver that comprises this regal suit acts as a mirror, but what it reveals cannot be seen in plain mind, but rather by a sharp minded subconscious.

name: Ceremonial Nation Armor (AC)
description: The reflecting light that brightens the metallic silver that comprises this regal suit acts as a mirror, but what it reveals cannot be seen in plain mind, but rather by a sharp minded subconscious.

name: Ceremonial Nation Armor (Legend)
description: The reflecting light that brightens the metallic silver that comprises this regal suit acts as a mirror, but what it reveals cannot be seen in plain mind, but rather by a sharp minded subconscious.

name: Ceremonial Seraph Armor (AC)
description: The reflecting light that brightens the metallic silver that comprises this regal suit acts as a mirror, but what it reveals cannot be seen in plain mind, but rather by a sharp minded subconscious.

name: Ceremonial Seraph Armor (Legend)
description: The reflecting light that brightens the metallic silver that comprises this regal suit acts as a mirror, but what it reveals cannot be seen in plain mind, but rather by a sharp minded subconscious.

name: Ceremonial Suit of Misfortune (0 AC)
description: Regalia that Dage the Evil saves for special occasions. What could those be? Weddings? Funerals? Graduations? Your piano recital? Regardless of what this is for, dedicated Legionnaires are welcome to match his style.

name: Ceremonial Suit of Misfortune (AC)
description: Regalia that Dage the Evil saves for special occasions. What could those be? Weddings? Funerals? Graduations? Your piano recital? Regardless of what this is for, dedicated Legionnaires are welcome to match his style.

name: Ceremonial Temple Outfit
description: Celebrate the Thai new year in festive style!

name: Ceremonial Underworld Suit (0 AC)
description: Regalia that Dage the Evil saves for special occasions. What could those be? Weddings? Funerals? Graduations? Your piano recital? Regardless of what this is for, dedicated Legionnaires are welcome to match his style.

name: Ceremonial Underworld Suit (AC)
description: Regalia that Dage the Evil saves for special occasions. What could those be? Weddings? Funerals? Graduations? Your piano recital? Regardless of what this is for, dedicated Legionnaires are welcome to match his style.

name: Cerise Dragon Spirit
description: New year, new look, new intimidation techniques. Nothing screams "RAWR" more than a genuine dragon armor. Just try to hold back that fiery spirit and only bite off the heads of your enemies. You may need your friends one day.

name: Cerulean Dragon Spirit
description: Cool, calm and collected, this dragon armor will soothe your opponent until the dread of your mighty claws rack across his or her body. But by then, it will be to late and the enemy will have no hope left. At least the last thing he or she will see is the calm blue of your scales.

name: Cerulean Dragonhealer's Wanderer
description: These roaming Priests of Etherstorm are attuned to the land and the Dragons, helping those in need. These priests draw strength from Water.

name: Cerulean Dragonpriest Robes
description: Healers of Etherstorm are one with the Dragons and elements. These healers draw their power from Water.

name: Cerulean Sorceress
description: So scarlet red isn't your color? Well thankfully the Sorceress had some other colors made..

name: Chained Chaos
description: Chaos has no boundaries. It doesn't feel sympathy for the poor and the weak. And most of all, Chaos will not rest till every last enemy is destroyed!

name: Chained Chaos in Shadow (0 AC)
description: Chaos has no boundaries. It doesn't feel sympathy for the poor and the weak. And most of all, Chaos will not rest till every last enemy is destroyed! (Item has color- customization)

name: Chained Chaos in Shadow (AC)
description: Chaos has no boundaries. It doesn't feel sympathy for the poor and the weak. And most of all, Chaos will not rest till every last enemy is destroyed! (Item has color- customization)

name: Champion Lynaria Armor
description: The shining Light of the rebellion, and wielded miracles to protect the people - the tyrant's forces. Everyone deserves a chance, and you can only do better tomorrow if you're alive. Her mercy kept Greenguard from being flooded with blood.

name: Champion of Celestial Glory
description: Malgor of the Mirror Realm is Hope personified. Lauded and adored, the Lord of Exalted Light is the guardian of all. Even if only one heart beats, Malgor will never give into despair. He will protect them to the very end.

name: Champion Of Ice
description: To withstand the freezing north is to become its champion especially at any winter sport like defending glacial villages.

name: Champion Of Light (Armor)
description: Even a speck of light can be found in the pitch black shadows and someone unexpected was chosen to carry it. In earning her gratitude, Gravelyn presents a replica of her gleaming platinum armor to you.

name: Champion Of Order
description: On the fields of Battle On, at the fall of Chaos, where no adventurer or monster may fail to give an answer, a Hero will arise. Chaos must fall.

name: Champion of Stalagbite
description: The Chaotic Dragon has chosen you as his Champion. Serve him well or you might end up as lunch.

name: Champion of the North
description: It takes a great warrior to survive the harsh environment of the Frozen Northlands. Your spirit, your body, and your armor now reflects the ferocity of winter.

name: Champion Snowboarder
description: Time to head to Mount Frost and show off your sweet snowboarding skills!

name: Champions of the Rainbow Armor
description: Your foes will witness a whole new spectrum of pain!!!

name: Chaonslaught Warrior (Armor)
description: What happens when you mix Chaos and modern technology? How about the greatest killing machine to come along since the T-1000.

name: Chaorrupted AntiTitan Corps
description: Brown, Brawn, and Strong! The members of the AntiTitan Corp strive to slay the most ferocious beasts that no other warrior dare encounter.

name: Chaorrupted Arcana Mage
description: *No description*

name: Chaorrupted Artix & Beleen
description: Oh great… the staff members have been chaorrupted? Who's going to run the game? Guys suit up as Chaotic Artix and girls as Chaotic Beleen and have fun causing chaos.

name: Chaorrupted Cysero & Alina
description: Oh great…. the staff members have been chaorrupted? Who's going to run the game? Guys suit up as Chaotic Cysero and girls as Chaotic Alina and have fun causing chaos.

name: Chaorrupted Defender
description: Tragically, those closest and most loyal to King Alteon were unable to escape chaorruption.

name: Chaorrupted DragonRider
description: The power of Chaos makes it MUCH easier to control a dragon. Why didn't we think of this before?

name: Chaorrupted Guard Suit
description: Drakath needs to make sure all his staff are loyal to him. What better way than through Chaos!

name: Chaorrupted Lycan Hunter (Armor)
description: You're the Alpha Hunter, time to pack from silver and bag some furbags.

name: Chaorrupted Pirate
description: Ye'd best be careful when sailing the seas of Lore.. things can get Chaotic

name: Chaorrupted Sorcerer
description: What was once a sorcerer in Nulgath the ArchFiend's army has been chaorrupted, tainted by the chaos permeating the tunnels under Crownsreach.

name: Chaorrupted Usurper
description: What was once a creature of Nulgath the ArchFiend's void has been chaorrupted, tainted by the chaos permeating the tunnels under Crownsreach. (This armor displays female art for all heroes.)

name: Chaos Abada Outfit
description: /Cheer for the Chaos Block and celebrate Carnaval in style!

name: Chaos Avenger Armor
description: In one timeline, The Hero managed to defeat Drakath and get a hold of their Chaos Amulet. Instead of becoming the Slayer who tried to destroy Lore, The Hero became the Avenger that saved it.

name: Chaos Bandit (Armor)
description: This bandit's armor must have been looted from a nearby camp during Drakath's attack on Battleon. Look, the chaorruption has already started seeping into it. O_O

name: Chaos Berserker
description: With the power of Chaos comes great responsi… wait, who are we kidding? CHAOS!!!!!

name: Chaos Berserker Armor
description: With the power of Chaos comes great responsi… wait, who are we kidding? CHAOS!!!!!

name: Chaos Breaker
description: Fighting for the cause of Order, you are the ultimate enemy of Chaos.

name: Chaos Cannoneer
description: Blend in among them, and use your mecha power to slay the Chaorrupted creatures of Lore!

name: Chaos Champion Prime (Armor)
description: Chaos reigns?? HAHAHAHAHAAAA! This armor is PROOF you've taken down the Champion of Chaos! (Gives 5% more damage against Chaos monsters AND 5% more XP!)

name: Chaos Chicken Self
description: After the Embero Spell was cast, it was revealed that your true inner form is that of a chaos chicken! You have an unpredictable nature, a tendency bawk at inappropriate moments, and the ability to induce nightmares in city-bred folk.

name: Chaos Claws Suit
description: You have been very, very, VERY naughty this year…

name: Chaos Conqueror (Armor)
description: Good good, let the purple flow through you. You were once the learner but now you are the master of Chaos.

name: Chaos Cyclops
description: The Chaos Cyclops is a newly-established merc military group formed by Drakath after Malgor's invasion in Arcangrove! Acting as Drakath's "eyes for hire", these soldiers from different walks of (chaotic) life unite and fight against the Shadowflame militia!

name: Chaos Destroyer (Armor)
description: Wanna destroy Chaos? You’re gonna need some heavy duty armor. Now that you’re incredibly protected against Chaos, you might want to buff those thighs so you can actually move around…

name: Chaos Doom Robe
description: The robes that once clothed a Chaos Mage now belong to you! Chaos makes you look slimming.

name: Chaos Dragon Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: YARRRR! Only a true Chaos Dragon Pirate could steal as many gems as you have right out from under the noses of those mountain dwaves.

name: Chaos Dragon Pirate Captain (AC)
description: YARRRR! Only a true Chaos Dragon Pirate could steal as many gems as you have right out from under the noses of those mountain dwaves.

name: Chaos Dragon Slayer
description: Nothing says "I beat this thing" like making an armor out of its carapace.

name: Chaos Executioner
description: Chaos has completely consumed you. Your free-will is as much alive as your clientele. But it turns out, in the end, that your clients never say one thing about you…

name: Chaos Eye Shirt
description: 103% Cotton-poly blend Artix Ent shirts will NOT protect you from typos, feathers and disembodied giggling. They WILL protect you from lack of st-EYE-le and bad fashion choices.

name: Chaos Fiend (0 AC)
description: The fiends were not infected by Chaos. It grew from within. Wounds opened, and transformed into eyes.

name: Chaos Fiend (AC)
description: The fiends were not infected by Chaos. It grew from within. Wounds opened, and transformed into eyes.

name: Chaos Giftbox Armor 2017 Mem
description: Tinsel says "Happy Frostval, Hero!" Keep cosmically fancy in a gorgeous nebula wrapped giftbox this holiday season! (Does NOT transform)

name: Chaos Healer
description: Chaos Healers are servants of chaos who use their powers to effect the sick, weak, and injured and either heal or kill them. Their insane healing magic is often the difference between groups of victory or doom, but you can never tell which.

name: Chaos Hunter (1)
description: Ye be wearin' this armor to hunt the chaos kraken!

name: Chaos Hunter (2)
description: You've had enough of Drakath and his Minions. Time to take back Lore from Chaos!

name: Chaos Hunter Brown
description: Ye be wearin' this armor to hunt the chaos kraken!

name: Chaos HydraSlayer
description: Crafted from the scales of the Hydra, everyone will know which gallant warrior slayed the ferocious beast!

name: Chaos Lionfang Armor
description: This trophy armor is proof that you've vanquished Chaoslord Lionfang in combat! Thunderforge has been saved, and Chaos has been dealt another blow!

name: Chaos Lord Alteon (Armor)
description: After you defeat a chaos lord, there's no reason not to steal their clothes.

name: Chaos Loremaster
description: The Loremasters have learned that there are many different fields of study… and to truly understand Chaos, you must fully immerse yourself in it.

name: Chaos Mage (Armor) (1)
description: Chaotic magic courses through veins. Your chaotic power enable you to cast powerful spells.

name: Chaos Mage (Armor) (2)
description: Chaos courses through you veins. Your arcane powers enable you to cast unpredictably dangerous spells.

name: Chaos Mage Robe
description: The power of Chaos has subsumed the humanity of these mages. No longer do they fight Chaos… now they fight FOR Chaos!

name: Chaos Magus
description: When Magus' fall, they fall harder than anything else. Chaotic power is a dangerous thing to bestow on an already powerful battlemage.

name: Chaos Manticore Trainer
description: Classic manticore training armor which has been infected by Chaos in training the Chaos Manticore.

name: Chaos Merdrac
description: The land-form of a Merdraconian twisted by Chaos.

name: Chaos Mountain Breaker
description: You BROKE that mountain.

name: Chaos Myconian
description: Chaos has infected all things - even the fungi! Be very careful when ingesting mushrooms… who knows what effect they will have.

name: Chaos Naval Commander
description: T' fury o' t' seven seas be no match for t' wrath o' Chaos!

name: Chaos Overlord
description: When being a simple Chaos Lord isn't enough. As an Overlord you want to bring Chaos to ALLLLL realms in Lore!

name: Chaos Paragon (Armor)
description: For those who wish to be chaotic but know the one true ruler is Dage, not Drakath.

name: Chaos Pirate Crew
description: This is what happens when pirates think they can battle Chaos and win. They become one with Chaos, and then sow Chaos wherever they go.

name: Chaos Poncho
description: You may follow Chaos, but that does not mean you can't do it in STYLE!

name: Chaos Punk
description: Sometimes, you gotta save a dragon from a princess. What can ya do?

name: Chaos PuppetMaster
description: The Queen of Monsters was a heartless manipulator, using her son - Drakath - as a pawn in her quest to return to our world. Recognize her skill and celebrate her ruthlessness. BOW DOWN.

name: Chaos Queen Beleen (Armor)
description: Embrace the power of pink… AND CHAOS!!!

name: Chaos Reaper
description: There is nowhere for the sane mind to hide that the insane cannot find you. When a Chaos Reaper comes for you, there is nowhere to run.

name: Chaos Robes
description: "Healer" isn't quite the term I'd use because these healers try to infect you with Chaos, not rid you of it.

name: Chaos Rogue (1)
description: Chaos Rogues follow their own set of rules. with a combination of stealth, madness and chaoruption, you take your enemies by surprise.

name: Chaos Rogue (2)
description: You can be chaotic and still hide in the shadows, like every other rogue!

name: Chaos Rogue Armor
description: You can be chaotic and still hide in the shadows, like every other rogue!

name: Chaos Shaper (Armor)
description: You have come to understand that Chaos is a tool that can be used for neither good nor evil. Mastering it could make you powerful beyond imagining. Lest you lose yourself…

name: Chaos Shirt
description: Are you a fan of Chaos? Wear this shirt with pride and represent your favorite faction!

name: Chaos Shogun Armor
description: Excelling in defense and offense, the armor of the Chaos Shogun Kitsune is one of the most intimidating in all of Lore. No one knows for sure where--and when--this elaborate armor was created.

name: Chaos Slayer
description: This armor is covered in the remains of the monsters you have slain! With every step you take, you show chaos that you are the one to be feared!

name: Chaos Soul Stealer
description: There are many ways the forces of chaos attain their energy. Some feed off of chaos energy from the corruption Drakath had left in his wake while some feed off of those affected by chaos.

name: Chaos SpyGames
description: Eye spy with my little eye… a Hero who is taking on Chaos!

name: Chaos Strike Uniform
description: When your school teaches disruption and mayhem… For CHAOS!

name: Chaos Symbiote Armor
description: Chaorrupted armor from an unknown origin. The wearer of this armor may not be able to resist the call of Chaos.

name: Chaos Varsity Team
description: Rah rah rah! #Team Chaos! (Requires Rank 10 Chaos)

name: Chaos Warrior (Armor) (1)
description: There are those who are controlled by Chaos and those who control it! You have BECOME Chaos, fighting to further its chaorrupted cause!

name: Chaos Warrior (Armor) (2)
description: The heart of a chaos warrior is filled with rage and insanity. Your skills with weapons in close combat makes you an unpredictable force on the battle field.

name: Chaos Watcher
description: Eye see you, eye see you, flying through a dream, eye see you.

name: Chaos Wolfy
description: A life of a teenage wolf is Chaos…when in high school!!! BAH HA HA!!!

name: Chaos Wraith Robes
description: This wretched fraction of corruption escaped from the claws of Chaos' current Champion, taking on a form unique to the wantonly violent sensibilities of its current host.

name: ChaosChrono Distorter
description: While there are those who either look to protect the balance between time and space or bring about its end, there are those only wish is to create disorder in time!

name: ChaosFang Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: The means justifies the ends, when you lead a crew as viciously dedicated to Good as the ChaosFang Naval Commander does.

name: ChaosFang Naval Commander (AC)
description: The means justifies the ends, when you lead a crew as viciously dedicated to Good as the ChaosFang Naval Commander does.

name: ChaosWeaver Cleric (Armor)
description: Those who have mastered the special type of ChaosWeaver magic wielded by its clerics are almost unstoppable!

name: ChaosWeaver Hunter
description: You've lost count of how many ChaosWeavers you slew to create THIS gear!

name: Chaotic Astral Star Captain
description: I will travel across the space, causing chaos far and wide. To destroy those is my real cause to start mutiny.

name: Chaotic Banneret
description: Demonhunters need to have a second career, for all those times when there are no demons around. Hikari is also a blacksmith who takes all the Chaos loose in parts of Lore and crafts it into epic gear.

name: Chaotic Beach Lounger (0 AC)
description: You'e at the beach for leisure, but just being there stirs up Chaos.

name: Chaotic Beach Lounger (AC)
description: You'e at the beach for leisure, but just being there stirs up Chaos.

name: Chaotic Captain (0 AC)
description: Chaos sails the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Captain (AC)
description: Chaos sails the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Casual Wear
description: Rep your favorite faction as you /rest after battle. CHAOS!

name: Chaotic Chrono Warrior
description: Throughout time, there has always been chaos. During these events, THEY have always been there watching…

name: Chaotic Crew Member (0 AC)
description: Chaos sails the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Crew Member (AC)
description: Chaos sails the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic DragonKnight
description: There are some who proctect the land from those that would like to cause nothing but chaos. These are the chaotic ones.

name: Chaotic DragonLord
description: The power of Chaos makes it MUCH easier to control a dragon. Why didn't we think of this before?

name: Chaotic Fiend of Nulgath
description: When Nulgath the ArchFiend embraced the power of Chaos, no power on Lore could stop him!

name: Chaotic Fleet
description: And just when you thought the skies were safe! Smells like Chaos in the air!

name: Chaotic Healer
description: For clerics of Chaos who wish to wield its power.

name: Chaotic Healer Armor
description: For clerics of Chaos who wish to wield its power.

name: Chaotic Knight
description: Some residential chaos has lingered inside that plate for years even after the fall of the 13 Lords of Chaos. Since then, it has become dormant, slowly distorting the armor into a nightmare of its own.

name: Chaotic Lost Warrior
description: This brave warrior was killed in battle with the Sludgelord long ago, and now fights on the side of Chaos underneath Swordhaven.

name: Chaotic Mage
description: For those who worship Chaos, and wish to wield its power.

name: Chaotic Mage Armor
description: For those who worship Chaos, and wish to wield its power.

name: Chaotic MonsterHunter
description: A true hero will always fight to save Lore, no matter how deep or dark the chaorruption has spread.

name: Chaotic Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Have you ever wondered what Drakath would have been like had he turned to piracy? Well, wonder no more!

name: Chaotic Naval Commander (AC)
description: Have you ever wondered what Drakath would have been like had he turned to piracy? Well, wonder no more!

name: Chaotic Pathshaper
description: Followers of Chaos, and the potential it has yet to reach. Their power to spread chaorruption is nearing the level of their Lords, and a great truth. To reshape, recreate, and rewrite…

name: Chaotic Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: Avast! These pirates have fallen prey to Chaos, and are now a force for Chaotic Evil on the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Pirate Captain (AC)
description: Avast! These pirates have fallen prey to Chaos, and are now a force for Chaotic Evil on the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Rugby Armor
description: You'll be on the ball when you /equip this AUS-some rugby armor! Crowds of your /party members will /cheer as your crit-ically score against your enemies!

name: Chaotic Savage
description: These Berserkers have been overcome, but they STILL fight Chaos wherever and whenever they come across it. For Humanity!

name: Chaotic Shadows Armor
description: Be one with the shadows, ye lurker of doom. Embrace the umbral portion of your soul and succumb to the call of chaos.

name: Chaotic Sorcerer
description: Magic imbued with Chaos is much stronger - it is no wonder that so many Sorcerers and Sorceress' fall prey to its lure.

name: Chaotic Spellsword of Light
description: The whispers… STOP THE WHISPERS!

name: Chaotic Summer Leisure Wear (0 AC)
description: Bring Chaos to the beach, and kill the ocean. Slay the ocean. Before you even think about sun tanning, tear the sand apart with Chaos. This message was approved by Xang after she had some sort of ordeal on the coast.

name: Chaotic Summer Leisure Wear (AC)
description: Bring Chaos to the beach, and kill the ocean. Slay the ocean. Before you even think about sun tanning, tear the sand apart with Chaos. This message was approved by Xang after she had some sort of ordeal on the coast.

name: Chaotic Summer Tattoos (0 AC)
description: Bring Chaos to the beach, and kill the ocean. Slay the ocean. Before you even think about sun tanning, tear the sand apart with Chaos. This message was approved by Xang after she had some sort of ordeal on the coast.

name: Chaotic Summer Tattoos (AC)
description: Bring Chaos to the beach, and kill the ocean. Slay the ocean. Before you even think about sun tanning, tear the sand apart with Chaos. This message was approved by Xang after she had some sort of ordeal on the coast.

name: Chaotic Switchin' Queen
description: Embrace the power of pink… AND CHAOS!!!

name: Chaotic Timemaster
description: A Chronomancer can rise to the level of TimeMaster with enough skill and power but with Chaos and Time at your command the task was simple for you.

name: Chaotic WarMage
description: The power of Chaos can be used in many different ways. The Chaotic WarMage uses it to boost their own personal power in battle.

name: Chaotic Witch + Warlock (0 AC)
description: Most mages use mana to power their spells. But Chaotic Witches and Warlocks choose to use a more unpredictable, but arguably more powerful substance… Chaos itself.

name: Chaotic Witch + Warlock (AC)
description: Most mages use mana to power their spells. But Chaotic Witches and Warlocks choose to use a more unpredictable, but arguably more powerful substance… Chaos itself.

name: Chaotic Wraith of Time
description: This wretched fraction of corruption escaped from the claws of Chaos' current Champion, taking on a form unique to the wantonly violent sensibilities of its current host.

name: Chaotic Yukata
description: The Empress' oracle has read your horoscope and declares: this will be a VERY chaotic year for you, no matter what sign you were born under.

name: Charged Cryptborg
description: Some are chosen to undergo even further changes - the Deadtech has taken almost full hold of them. Who knows how much more they can handle.

name: Charged Ninja (Armor)
description: The ruins give the ninja a powerful strike as they land their blows and cloak them as they vanish from sight.

name: Charming Couture
description: You always want to look your best when you're with the one you love. Now, you will!

name: Charon (Armor)
description: Those who challenge Charon do so at a peril of their soul. The Boatman's wrath is not to be tempted.

name: Chartreuse Paladin
description: You walk amongst the trees as their sole protector.

name: Cheer Bringer
description: What better way to feel the joy of the seasons than to be wrapped up like a gift!? (Color Customizable)

name: Cheer Lover
description: /Cheer for the team you love!

name: CheerCaster Armor
description: CheerCasters are human mages who have tapped into one of the most powerful emotions on Lore -- joy. During the Frostval holiday season, their magic is at its most powerful.

name: Cheery SnowAngel (0 AC)
description: No matter what color you choose to wear, the purity of a snow angel's spirit shines brighter than the North Star.

name: Cheery SnowAngel (AC)
description: No matter what color you choose to wear, the purity of a snow angel's spirit shines brighter than the North Star.

name: Chelicera
description: Tred carefully or you will be caught up in their web of destruction.

name: Cherry Blossom Fairy
description: Soft as snow, yet bright as spring. Dance alongside the graceful bloom and fall of cherry blossom petals.

name: Cherry Blossom Love Yukata
description: Hero's Heart Day is always a festive time in Akiba and this year is no different! Big Mama had these custom made so the loveliest hero of lore could don them for all to fawn over!

name: Chewboglinster
description: May the 4th be with you!

name: Chibi Nulgath Armor
description: Chubby little wubby all stuffed with love, he's Nully the Fiend, Nully the Fiend.

name: Chic AX Swimwear (0 AC)
description: New for 2021 from AX Fashion: you'll look hot enough in this chic swimwear to /slay your enemies and /stun your friends.

name: Chic AX Swimwear (AC)
description: New for 2021 from AX Fashion: you'll look hot enough in this chic swimwear to /slay your enemies and /stun your friends.

name: Chicken Cow Knight
description: These brave bovine knights aren't chicken and never run away from a fight!

name: Chicken Self
description: After the Embero shell spell was cast, it was revealed that your true inner form is that of a chaos chicken! You have an unpredictable nature, a tendency bawk at inappropriate moments, and the ability to induce nightmares in city-bred folk.

name: Chicken Suit
description: Who ya callin' chicken?! Oh wait…

name: ChickenCow BeastMaster
description: Zeuster would approve of a hero who cares so much for the members of his flock.

name: Chickencow Suit
description: Modeled after an endangered species in DragonFable, the chickencow are able to access the powers of both beef and poultry at once!

name: ChickenCowboy
description: CLUCK CLUCK MOOOOOOVE'EM OUT! YEEEEHAW! Giddyup Heroes!

name: ChickencowMancer
description: The power of the Chickencow compels you.. to battle!

name: Chickenman Suit
description: Not many people can pull off the ChickenMan fashion statement. But you cockadoodle-DO!

name: Chill Hoodie Outfit
description: Not a fan of wool or puff? Then spend your holidays the cool way! In gear that keeps out the cold, and eyes off of your back.

name: Chill Neighbor
description: Your whole deal is that you're chill, and lowkey don't care about much. (Don't forget to take your hands out of your pocket when you run.)

name: Chimera Parasitoid
description: A perfect creation, fusing the deadliest weapons of multiple parasitic predators. (This item is color customizable)

name: Chiquita & Zep
description: During Carnaval, everyone comes out to party! Even a certain famous lady with a delicious hat - and her dance partner!

name: Chiral Valley Duke
description: The Lord of Chiral Valley and head of House Vaughn were thronekeepers - leaders of the Kingsguard and the sword of the crown. Rains of fire, ice, and lightning couldn't stop them. The only way to kill a Vaughn is to destroy their head.

name: Chiral Valley Knight
description: Named after the crest of House Vaughn, these Knights protect Chiral Valley. They're said to be nigh-invincible like their Lord, and can only be defeated if you destroy their head.

name: Chiral Valley Noble
description: The stronger a noble's blood ties are to the Vaughns of Chiral Valley, the more terrifying they are in battle. They shun the use of magic, and seek glory in direct combat. No Vaughn has ever lost to a Mage.

name: Chiton
description: Enter the battle arena in secure in the knowledge that you'll look your best a fight your hardest!

name: Chromatic X-Terminator
description: You want to defeat the poison? Better suit up first!

name: Chromium Void ChronoKnight (Armor)
description: While traveling through different timelines, this renegade ChronoKnight came to the attention of Nulgath the Archfiend. He reached into the void and corrupted their time powers creating the Void ChronoKnight.

name: Chrono Assassin Armor (AC)
description: Master time and space like Xeven. Tear through the fabric of time literally as a Chrono Assassin.

name: Chrono Assassin Armor (Merge)
description: Master time and space like Xeven. Tear through the fabric of time literally as a Chrono Assassin.

name: Chrono Chaorruptor Armor
description: Time flies in a straight line, unless its Chaorrupted! You'll never know in which time, or with what powers you'll wind up when you have this armor equipped!

name: Chrono Commandant Armor
description: Command the hours and control the eons… for the very fabric of time is under your power!

name: Chrono DataKnight Armor
description: Battle alongside the Dragons of Time as you attempt to command the universe!

name: Chrono DragonKnight (Armor)
description: The power of a DragonKnight combined with steampunk technology? Look out Lore, here comes awesome.

name: Chrono Ender
description: The Chrono Enders seek to end time and vow to not let the sun rise one more time. If their plans are fulfilled, Lore and all life will be lost forever to a plague of darkness!

name: Chrono Guardians
description: While there are those who seek to end time, the Chrono Guardians serve to protect time and the existence of all life on Lore and in the universe.

name: Chrono Infinity Knight
description: The hour of your victory is upon us! 2016 is the year you shall ascend to mastery!

name: Chrono Paladin Wanderer
description: The power of Time powers these Chronomancers as they travel the length and breadth of Lore, always searching for those in need.

name: Chrono ShadowHunter Armor
description: The beasts lurking in the shadows can not be allowed a foothold in any place or time. Thanks to the Chrono Shadowslayers, dark forests and bloodthirsty creatures are excised from history.

name: Chrono ShadowSlayer (Armor)
description: The beasts lurking in the shadows can not be allowed a foothold in any place or time. Thanks to the Chrono Shadowslayers, dark forests and bloodthirsty creatures are excised from history.

name: Chrono Tripper Armor
description: Make sure you have a spare 1.21 gigawatts to be able to get to your next destination.

name: Chrono Vanguard
description: As a warrior-guardian of the Chronomancer's Academy, you are responsible for ensuring that no laymen interfere with the permanent portals to the timestream.

name: Chrono Vanquisher
description: This type of hero is one that doesn't abide by the laws of time to add to their stories of valor and courage!

name: Chrono Warrior
description: There are those who jump through time, seeking to spread evil and chaos. These are the ones who stand up and fight.

name: ChronoAssassin
description: To take down some of the most notorious criminals, sometimes one must go outside of the law and in this case, outside of time to get the job done!

name: Chronobound Manipulator
description: By collecting and storing the polarized light emitted by the wormholes you discover, you're able to fuel your travels through the timestreams that make up our universe!

name: ChronoCommander Armor
description: Command the hours and control the eons… for the very fabric of time if is under your power!

name: ChronoCorruptor Armor
description: Time flies in a straight line, unless it's Chaorrupted! You'll never know in which time, or with what powers, you'll wind up when you have this armor equipped!

name: ChronoFrost Guard
description: The ChronoFrost Guards protects those frozen in time.

name: ChronoLord Naval Commander
description: The clock be tickin', sailor. All hands on deck 'n all hands on clock as ye turn the tide o' battle as the ChronoLord Naval Commander!

name: Chronomancer Armor
description: As celestial manipulators, Chronomancers alter the flow of time with supernatural divinations and otherwordly expertise. Rather then counting every second in every day, Chronomancers make every second in every day count. Only those with a divine understanding of time may call themselves such.

name: Chronomancer of Air
description: The Chronomancers of Air journeyed to the end of time, where reality folds in on itself, spiraling as all existence is unwound and pulled together. This impossible and powerful maelstrom is best replicated by the element of air by those who have witnessed the final end.

name: Chronomancer of Chaos
description: ﻿Chronomancers tasked with weaving Chaos into the timestream to dominate a familiar foe. This isn't about destruction; it's about taking and conquering all of existence.

name: Chronomancer of D'AWWW
description: Love never dies! The Chronomacers of the strongest force in existence dedicate themselves to studying its raw power and permanence.

name: ChronoMancer of Darkness
description: On the edge of the Timevoid, waves of ephemeral shadows swirl out of an entrance to the Plane of Darkness. Only Chronomancers of Darkness possess the power to survive the combined might of elemental magic mixed with the temporal aether.

name: Chronomancer of Energy
description: On the edge of the Timevoid, rapid lightning strikes light up the aether as they rip through the entrance to the Plane of Energy. Only Chronomancers of Energy possess the power to survive the combined might of elemental magic mixed with the killer currents of electricity they wield.

name: Chronomancer of Fire
description: On the edge of the Timevoid, a molten wall of flame blocks the entrance to the Plane of Fire. Only Chronomancers of Fire are able to survive the combined might of time magic mixed with the Plane's scorching elemental power.

name: Chronomancer of Ice
description: Ice magic carries properties similar to how one would stop time. Everything comes to a halt, preserved as they were for as long as one pleases. These Chronomancers are known to freeze timelines and keep them as living museums.

name: Chronomancer of Light
description: On the edge of the Timevoid, a blinding light shines out of the entrance to the Plane of Light. Only Chronomancers of Light possess the magic to survive the combined might of time magic mixed with radiant beams of elemental power.

name: Chronomancer of Lore
description: Chronomancers who believe that Lore is the center of the universe and the birth of time. They research madly, locked into the theory that Battleon was the start of it all.

name: Chronomancer of Nature
description: On the edge of the Time void, a wave of power rises from beneath your feet. Only Chronomancers of Nature can wield the combined might of Lore's ancient, fundamental magic mixed with the temporal aether that permeates the TimeVoid.

name: Chronomancer of the Void
description: ﻿Chronomancers that made a contract with the Archfiend have been exiled by their peers and teachers. No matter, glory is a selfish pursuit. The immense power of the Void will be their company.

name: Chronomancer of Water
description: ﻿These chronomancers believe that time is a river, and that there are many which run parallel, loop, connect, and split from each other. Their ultimate goal is to find the source, and the resevoir that all of these rivers eventually flow to.

name: Chronomancer of YUMMM
description: Leaping through time can make you peckish. Why is time considered a river of water when it could be a river of chocolate?

name: Chronomancer Paladin
description: The power of Time powers these Chronomancers as they travel the length and breadth of Lore, always searching for those in need.

name: Chronomancer Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: Your port? The Chronospan. Your mission: Sail through the timestream, navigating the swells of spacetime and tidal waves of dark matter.

name: Chronomancer Pirate Captain (AC)
description: Your port? The Chronospan. Your mission: Sail through the timestream, navigating the swells of spacetime and tidal waves of dark matter.

name: Chronomancer Prime Armor
description: As celestial manipulators, Chronomancers alter the flow of time with supernatural divinations and otherwordly expertise.

name: Chrononaut
description: Astronauts from planet Earth travel to space while Chrononauts travel through time AND space! Nice going, Chrononauts—you make our Astronauts look like noobs.

name: ChronoOracle of Misfortune
description: Your fortune reads: You have the power to overcome your own misfortune. Never give up. Always keep fighting." ("Ni you ke'fu kun'nan de li'liang, bie fang'qi, jian'chi dao'di!")

name: Chronophoenix Guardian
description: Each year, as the Chrono-Phoenix bursts into flames, the ChronoPhoenix Guardians go and gather what remains of its old from to use in crafting their armor. They will never be out of time!

name: ChronoReaper
description: Before Drakath's Chaorruption, the TimeReapers shone the blue of pure mana. It is time you saw them in their purest state!

name: Chronostriker (AC)
description: The Eternal Dragon of Time rules over the past, present, and future. The ChronoStriker armor will enable you to strike at your enemies regardless of the timeline they inhabit.

name: ChronoStriker (Special)
description: The Eternal Dragon of Time rules over the past, present, and future. The ChronoStriker armor will enable you to strike at your enemies regardless of the timeline they inhabit.

name: ChronoZ (0 AC)
description: Time is a merciless and inevitable force. One that grinds, rends, and disintigrates the body. That power is yours to accelerate or reverse.

name: ChronoZ (AC)
description: Time is a merciless and inevitable force. One that grinds, rends, and disintigrates the body. That power is yours to accelerate or reverse.

name: Chthonic Fiend Slayer (0 AC)
description: There was an age before the Nation marched across Lore and its Underworld. Other Fiends existed before Nulgath. Nearly all were eliminated, and their remains used to forge the armor of those that will hunt the last survivors.

name: Chthonic Fiend Slayer (AC)
description: There was an age before the Nation marched across Lore and its Underworld. Other Fiends existed before Nulgath. Nearly all were eliminated, and their remains used to forge the armor of those that will hunt the last survivors.

name: Chuckles' Rolling Head
description: The laughs just keep rolling! He is pretty funny… you know… for a dead guy!

name: Chunin Armor
description: A chunin is a ninja field commander. Highly trained to attack from stealth but focusing on strength and power rather than agility and speed.

name: Churrrrrpy
description: I go tweet.

name: Cinderclaw Armor
description: You've tamed Cinderclaw and won his armor as a prize, does this mean you will swear alliance to the Mother of Monsters too?

name: Citrinitas Elemental (Armor)
description: These Fire Elementals touched the Flame of Citrinitas, severing their ties to Fiamme. Though they've begun walking their own path, the Elementals can't leave the mountain. Their golden fire is coveted by those who can't understand it.

name: Classic Alpha Pirate Armor
description: A commemorative armor reminding us of the infamous day where the pirate Captain Rhubarb seized control of that database.

name: Classic Barber Armor (Armor)
description: Hair today, gone tomorrow! Be a barber and control the destiny of your friends and neighbors.

name: Classic Blood Paladin
description: In the midst of fighting the darkness and undead, it's not uncommon to come across live foes. They're treated all the same by severe hero's hand.

name: Classic Broncolich Gear (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Classic Broncolich Gear (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Classic Chunin
description: A chunin is a ninja field commander. Highly trained to attack from stealth but focusing on strength and power rather than agility and speed.

name: Classic Dark Caster
description: Sought after for ages, the Dark Caster finally emerges to celebrate the Dark Lord's 21,000th birthday. Although there are many followers who claim to be a part of the Undead Legion, Dark Casters are unmistakably the most dedicated and commend.

name: Classic Hollowborn DoomKnight (Armor)
description: The Hollowborn DoomKnight shows little sympathy for the living… or the dead! Not even death can stop your destructive rampage. May the Shadowfiend guide your path.

name: Classic Hollowborn Paladin Armor
description: Even in death, a paladin never loses their faith and sense of justice. If these two things are strong enough, one may rise as a Hollowborn Paladin. A light that shines even in the darkest days.

name: Classic Loyalist Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Classic Loyalist Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football players!

name: Classic Miners Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Classic Miners Team (Legend)
description: Go team! Go! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Classic Pirate (Armor)
description: Yarrr! Avast me hearty, this be not an armor for ye lily-livered land lubbers.

name: Classic Scarecrow
description: The best way to sneak up on your enemy is to blend in with your environment.

name: Classic School Uniform (AC)
description: It seems that you're a seemingly normal student with a seemingly normal lifestyle; but once this school uniform comes off, you become the world's greatest hero… or villain!

name: Classic School Uniform (Legend)
description: It seems that you're a seemingly normal student with a seemingly normal lifestyle; but once this school uniform comes off, you become the world's greatest hero… or villain!

name: Classic Seahorcs Gear (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Classic Seahorcs Gear (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Classier Rabbit
description: Grenwog is a great time to show off your wardrobe. Dress up!

name: Classy Bunny
description: Hoppy Grenwog!

name: Classy Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Sometimes simple is the most classy, y'know?

name: Classy Naval Commander (AC)
description: Sometimes simple is the most classy, y'know?

name: Classy Windsor Wedding
description: Congratulations to Prince William and his bride Kate! May your marriage be as long and fruitful as your reign!

name: ClawSuit Armor (Armor)
description: The giftbox unwraps to reveal the secrets of devastating holiday power. Make a list and obliterate it twice.

name: Clawsuit Guardian
description: When the 12 years pass, the festive and golden Clawsuit Guardian is born! Merry Frostval!

name: Clawsuit of Krampus
description: You're what's keeping the kids good this holiday season. Granted, you'll have to fight every other nasty Frostval entity to keep your title as the Naughty List's Worst Nightmare.

name: Clawsuit of Madness
description: The giftbox unwraps to reveal a form of eldritch horror… and devastating holiday power. Perfect to /SLAY all year long!

name: Clawsuit Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: Clawsuit Pirate Captains sail around the edges of the frozen arctic seas spreading more damage than cheer. They are a HO HO HO-rrifying sight to behold!

name: Clawsuit Pirate Captain (AC)
description: Clawsuit Pirate Captains sail around the edges of the frozen arctic seas spreading more damage than cheer. They are a HO HO HO-rrifying sight to behold!

name: Cleric Of Nulgath
description: In the Mirror Realm, the ArchFiend is your best friend… and YOU are his cleric!

name: Cleric Of Time
description: It's said "Time heals all wounds", wise words for a Cleric.

name: Cloaked Deathwalker (0 AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Cloaked Deathwalker (AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Cloaked GL-24K
description: Fashioned with a gilded chassis, these droids are the perfect attendants and bodyguards. Some even grow an ego and strike out on their own.

name: Cloaked Seraphic Fourth Order
description: Seraphic Fourth Order members are enhanced with cybernetics. They are the sheathes of their own weapons, becoming one with the Fourth themselves.

name: Clockwork Doll (AC)
description: Because Memet likes automatons, that's why.

name: Clockwork Doll (Legend)
description: Because Memet likes automatons, that's why.

name: Cloud Rider
description: A type of wind ninja that is on cloud nine. Why are they so happy? Sneak attacks from the sky give them the full advantage of the element surprise too.

name: Clovercraft
description: HAVE YOU EVER WANTED TO FLY? Well with the Clovercraft now you can! All rainbow power, this baby hovers a GOOD five maybe six feet off the ground. Sneevil made so it's guaranteed!

name: Cloverfield Stalker
description: A large suit of gold plate with a green raiment underneath. Who needs luck when you've got massive plate armor?

name: Clucky Moo (Armor)
description: Don't hold it against them.

name: Coast Rocker
description: ﻿Keep rocking, even when the tide swallows the speakers!

name: Coastal Raider
description: Menaces that even have vikings standing on guard. These career criminals will gut you for half a coin of gold on land, and mince you for the sharks in the sea.

name: Cobalt Iron Warrior
description: Remember: in a fantasy game, it's always a good idea to bring a Blaster Beam to a blade fight, so become the Iron Warrior you never expected to be!

name: Cockatrice Hunter
description: Fortunately, cockatrices don't like to bite arms or legs. They go straight for the chest.

name: Code of the Origins
description: WHOA! I know Kung fu…

name: Coffeemancer
description: Coffee runs hot in your veins and the bleary-eyed commoners beg for your charity.

name: Coin Collector
description: Sent from a distant galaxy, this traveler is hunting the most dangerous prey of all… The chocolate coin.

name: Cold Bones Armor
description: Cold as frostbite, thin as ice, this armor will help you through those cold winter nights. How? Well, how else would walking around as an iced skeleton help? You blend in…

name: Cold Playa
description: Oh Snap! All you need is a sundial around your neck to show what type of playa you are!

name: Cold Steel Armor (0 AC)
description: "Aye, Cold Steel is what it's called. Metalwork forged with the breath of a Frost Dragon. The blue flame the beast breathes tempers the metal to act like no other. Never to dull, never to break, never to be bested."

name: Cold Steel Armor (AC)
description: "Aye, Cold Steel is what it's called. Metalwork forged with the breath of a frost dragon. The blue flame the beast breathes tempers the metal to act like no other. Never to dull, never to break, never to be bested."

name: ColdSteel Guardian
description: Real heroes know when you're up against a fire dragon, you don't fight fire with fire, you use cold, sharp steel.

name: Collared Fiend
description: All who see you shall obey. It would be death to look away from the power blazing from your eyes!

name: Collector Armor
description: Last time you beat the Collector, now you are him! Bigger in the inside dome sold separately.

name: Color Custom Zhoom
description: After raiding Zhoom's closet,you'll be rockin' in this color-custom Ranger Armor.

name: Colorful Akiban Hanfu
description: Gong Xi Fa Cai! May your presence bring luck and prosperity when you don this suit! Also, now you are able to choose your own lucky colours!

name: Colorful ChickencowMancer
description: The power of the Chickencow compels you… to battle! Now with more color!

name: Colorful Claws Suit
description: Tis the season to be jolly… and color custom! Show your Frostval spirit with this suit and holiday /cheer!

name: Colorful Giftbox Armor 2021
description: Happy Frostval 2021! These giftboxes will NOT open. (CC to Base and Trim)

name: Colorful Grenwog Garb
description: Pink and Blue are lucky colors during the year of the Rabbit! (You're very fortunate, because this item will ALSO drop as a reward from the Grenwog itself.)

name: Colorful Undead Champion
description: Unaffected by emotions and impervious to remorse, Champions pledge their full allegiance to the Undead Legion. The glow on this armor is color customizable.

name: Colorful Waterpolo Suit
description: Remember, waterpolo is played in a pool without horses. We don't want to repart of LAST year…

name: Colorless Pumpkin Armor
description: This is Mogloween, Pumpking screams in the dead of the night.

name: Combat Cupid
description: Unlike ordinary cupids who guide people through their love lives, these are a totally different league of cupids who would fight for love at any cost, even if it means to lose themselves to hatred.

name: Combat Engineer
description: To battle more efficiently, teach yourself combat engineering!

name: Combat Sage (0 AC)
description: After ages of rigorous training and meditation, these Sages are enlightened in the art of war. All who oppose the Legion are swiftly incapacitated by these skilled masters.

name: Combat Sage (AC)
description: After ages of rigorous training and meditation, these Sages are enlightened in the art of war. All who oppose the Legion are swiftly incapacitated by these skilled masters.

name: Combo Breaker (Armor)
description: C-c-c-c-COMBO BREAKER! You unlocked the Combo Breaker set when you bought an Artix Game Card from Gamestop. Game On!

name: Commander of Cerberus
description: No longer fresh meat, but not yet a General. Why work your to top when you can take out superiors? It can't be wrong if Dage did it.

name: Commodore Core (Armor)
description: This heinous villain will stop at nothing to ruin the beauty of Lore with lies and propaganda. Don't listen to him!

name: Composer Armor
description: Orchestrate your own band of terror in Lore's first Composer Armor!

name: Concert Glow Armor
description: Ripped jeans, check. Chains, check. Wristband, check. Glowsticks, check. Ready for the concert? CHECK!

name: Concert Hoodie Outfit
description: Gotta wear a hoodie in case it gets cold.

name: Conqueror of Shadow
description: Shrouded in darkness, the infamous conquerors are armed in heavily plates forged by shadow matter. The Conquerors of Shadow have been the natural enemy to the Wardens of Light since Lore's first nightfall.

name: Contented Spectator Armor (AC)
description: ﻿Not bad, not bad. No monsters are attacking, no squires are dropping the ball in the latest football match… Life is pretty good right now.

name: Contented Spectator Armor (Legend)
description: ﻿Not bad, not bad. No monsters are attacking, no squires are dropping the ball in the latest football match… Life is pretty good right now.

name: Continuum Chronomancer (Armor)
description: For as long as heroes have existed, Chronomancers have traversed space and time. Continuum Chronomancers have mastered the ability to cross between universes and ages.

name: Contract Enforcer of Nulgath
description: Malakai is known for being the relentless enforcer of the Archfiend's contracts. His service is so valued that it isn't wasted on mere traitorous filth. He waits in Nulgath's shadow for a chance to be unleashed.

name: ContractKeeper of Nulgath (Armor)
description: If you break your contract with Nulgath, it is the Contract Keepers that will be sent after you.

name: ContractReaper of Nulgath
description: If you break your contract with Nulgath, it is the Contract Reapers that will be sent after you.

name: Convict Nulgath (Temp)
description: You have become Nulgath.

name: Cool Crystallis Yukata
description: A Crystallis edition of Akiba's popular traditional cotton Yukata, with the sleeves rolled up.

name: Cool Girl
description: Because she represents ice. She's chill, easy going but if you make her mad, she can be very cold.

name: Cool Neighbor
description: Your whole deal is that you're chill, and lowkey don't care about much.

name: Cool Onsen Yukata
description: A very popular garment, worn by onsen goers in Future Akiba, with the sleeves rolled up.

name: Cool PinkSlayer
description: You battle the shadows, but that doesn't mean you have to dress like them!

name: Cooler Love Bard
description: Music can be so romantic, don't you think?

name: Coolest Invisible Ninja +5
description: Ninjas are acclaimed for their stealth… and you, oh great ninja, have finally mastered the art of invisibility! Your enemies will never see you coming. Nor will your friends. Not even you yourself! This item gives you 5% more XP when equipped.

name: Coolest Summer Suit
description: Grab your SPF 9000 and hit the sands of Lore, beach bunnies and surfer dudes.

name: Coolmint Twist
description: Do the twist, the peppermint twist!

name: Copper Golem Commander
description: These swashbucklers comandeered a forge from the mountains of Dwarfhold and installed it into a ship. Controlling a crew of metal men, the captain commands a vessel that can tear the sea from above and below.

name: Copper Rainment of the Black Dragon
description: Harderned by strife and battle, this living armor shows its true colors when the right Hero puts it on. Build the confidence of your allies and yourself, while tearing down the confidences of the enemy.

name: Copper Void ChronoKnight
description: While traveling through different timelines, this renegade Chronomancer came to the attention of Nulgath the Archfiend. He reached into the void and corrupted their time powers creating the Void Chronomancer.

name: Cor Mortis Champion
description: Even creatures of the night need to look classy.

name: Core Manipulator
description: Your proximity to the Mana Core has transmuted your form into a half-human, half-mana elemental!

name: Coronaviridae
description: You suddenly crave glycoproteins! this squishy morph is one of the germs that cause the common cold.

name: Corpo-Seco (Armor)
description: A man so evil that the earth would not rot its flesh and the devil would return his soul. Condemned to wander fruitlessly the earth until the judgment day.

name: Corpse Knight
description: Corpse Knights wander the forest of DoomWood defeating opponents in mortal combat then adding to their armor using the bones of the fallen.

name: Corrupt Draconic Paragon Plate
description: Not many dragons exist in the Underworld but a few must be wrangled by the most fierce dragon warriors.

name: Corrupt Sentinel
description: *No description*

name: Corrupted BattleMage
description: These tattered and beastly robes once belonged to an insane warmage who served Escherion before he croaked. The rags feel awfully cold and starved, implying that they were somehow… alive?

name: Corrupted Chronomancer (Armor)
description: Time flows, curves and circles back on itself. Corrupted Chronomancers introduce flaws into the stream to better manipulate it.

name: Corrupted Druid
description: Not all poison kills you. Sometimes it changes you, corrupts who you are, gives you power but takes away a part of who you are. You are changed. Forever.

name: Corrupted Druid Armor
description: These Druids once served Brightoak, but now they've been corrupted and wish to see it's destruction.

name: Corrupted Forest Fairy
description: Led astray from the path of righteousness, such fairies could only wrought destruction instead of guidance.

name: Corrupted Mana Guardian
description: The Mana Core contains the most pure magic available. But with Malgor's corruption… no one can predict what will happen now. Mages around the world wait, fearful, for the outcome of even the most basic spells

name: Corrupted Skyguard Captain
description: Hate and malice flows through you after failing to earn the status of Captain of SkyGuard. But don't worry, a single thrust of your blade into your superior's heart will change that…EVIL takes to the air!

name: Corrupted Yokai Warrior
description: To become the warrior you were truly meant to be, you must tap into otherworldly forces. Only then will you be able to unlock the power you need to achieve greatness!

name: Corruption of Aranx
description: Follower of Dage the Evil, Aranx leads the scout team of the Legion in their quest to seize control of the Underworld and to smite Nulgath!

name: Corvus Corax
description: Although normally considered as an ill omen, these Magi see the raven as a symbol of powerful magic. There is nothing common about this raven.

name: Cosmic Bounty Biker
description: Cosmic Bounty Hunters never forget a face… or a debt. If you're lucky, they'll consider the thrill of hunting you down to be enough to settle what you owe. (Item is CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Cosmic Bounty Hunter (Armor)
description: Cosmic Bounty Hunters never forget a face… or a debt. If you're lucky, they'll consider the thrill of hunting you down to be enough to settle what you owe. (Item is CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Cosmic Dragon
description: Their claws can tear through the fabrics of space, and from their breath comes newborn stars. These Astral Dragons were born deep in the cosmos, fated to serve a sovereign who has yet to claim their crown.CC to Trim, Accessory)

name: Cosmic Frost Omen
description: The looming threat that gazes down from the cosmos. There will always be a threat, which you can choose to become… but what you will do with that power remains to be seen.

name: Cosmic Genesis Magus
description: ﻿These Magi are searching from the beginning of all existence. Having mastered spells and magic Lore has to offer, they now seek the the birthplace of Mana itself. Could it be out there in the stars? Or perhaps something else lurks deep in space.

name: Cosmic Genesis Philosopher
description: These Magi searched tirelessly for the birthplace of existence and found it in their home. Having mastered all that the stars have to offer, they look inward and draw power from the cosmos that sleeps in their souls.

name: Cosmic Void of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Mortals of strict discipline and focused minds are asked to meditate in the hostile depths of the Fiend's Void. Their bodies dissolve in an excruciatingly painful process, but what emerges is a cosmic body of near-limitless strength.

name: Cosmic Void of Nulgath (AC)
description: Mortals of strict discipline and focused minds are asked to meditate in the hostile depths of the Fiend's Void. Their bodies dissolve in an excruciatingly painful process, but what emerges is a cosmic body of near-limitless strength.

name: Cosmic Void of Nulgath (Legend)
description: Mortals of strict discipline and focused minds are asked to meditate in the hostile depths of the Fiend's Void. Their bodies dissolve in an excruciatingly painful process, but what emerges is a cosmic body of near limitless strength.

name: Count of the Red Sea (0 AC)
description: The Count of the Red Sea may stand and dress sophisticated, but their hunger knows no bounds. The drained carcasses of whales and sea serpents lay in their wake. Their ship is their castle, and the ocean is their oyster.

name: Count of the Red Sea (AC)
description: The Count of the Red Sea may stand and dress sophisticated, but their hunger knows no bounds. The drained carcasses of whales and sea serpents lay in their wake. Their ship is their castle, and the ocean is their oyster.

name: CountDown Disaster
description: Taunting is an age old fighting technique. In modern times, trash talking has been the bulk of this technique. Why do any talking at all, when your armor can do it for you? Stride into an area and let the ominous red flashing numbers let everyone know how much time they have…

name: Courage Armor
description: Look inside yourself. Embrace the strength and courage that lie within. You ARE a hero, and this is the armor which will see you to victory!

name: Court Finery
description: Planning on attending a royal event? You'll need the right threads.

name: Court Jester (Armor)
description: Just keep smiling. They'll never know where you hid the bodies.

name: Court of Huangdi
description: Proper dress for the imperial court of the Water Serpent Emperor.

name: Courtier of Radiance
description: The Angel on your shoulder takes over. A righteous heart will shine bright, becoming a beacon to guide the lost. So, you'll let them take over, right? The choice comes with pretty clothes!

name: Courtier of Ruin
description: The Devil on your shoulder takes over. You deserve the world, so why not take it? Are you on the fence because that'd be mean? Don't be nervous. Being your worst self is a lot of fun!

name: Courtly Mana Scholar
description: Scholars who wish to unearth ancient spells of Lore’s original gods, believing that Lore’s loyalty doesn’t belong to the Avatars. The walk the leylines, searching for the origin of magic. Their knowledge is often the target of dark ambition.

name: Couture Astravian Formal Outfit (0 AC)
description: Greenguard and Astravian designers collaborated to create a high-fashion outfit to shock and awe the guests of the Frostval Gala. You'll be all the Nobles can think of in the year to come.

name: Couture Astravian Formal Outfit (AC)
description: Greenguard and Astravian designers collaborated to create a high-fashion outfit to shock and awe the guests of the Frostval Gala. You'll be all the Nobles can think of in the year to come.

name: Covenant Wetsuit
description: Light yet durable, this wetsuit's sure to catch eyes. The scarlet and slightly wicked aesthetic quite popular. You'll have to use wits and charm to stand out even more.

name: Covert Death Scholar
description: A strange book fell on to the Scholar's lap one day, and changed their life forever. Its spine had teeth, and the cover felt like burned skin. Every name written into its pages crumbled to dust.

name: Covert Falcon Ranger
description: Swift and precise, your prey won't know that you're circling them until it's too late.

name: Coward Armor
description: An armor for the fearful, this garb has extra padding and spells woven in to protect the weak of heart. Equip it if you're a bit too scared to take on the opponents that roaming in Lore.

name: Cr1tikal Hero
description: Hey. I’m Charlie. Wait. Am I 2D now? WOOO! YEAH BABY! THAT'S WHAT I'VE BEEN WAITING FOR!

name: Crab Costume
description: *No description*

name: Crafter Battlemage
description: Magic crafting is a core magic abillity since it is always helpful to apply magical properties to items. Need a stick a moglin to a wall? We have a spell for that.

name: Crash Player
description: No matter how fast your enemies (or their plugins) are, they can't beat… the CRASH PLAYER!

name: Crazy Clown (Armor)
description: People suffering from coulrophobia are going to just love you…

name: Creature 10
description: This Creature was the result of an experiment that fused two different beings. The closer the original components were to each other, the deadlier and sharper the end result becomes.

name: Creature 83 Hoodie
description: A group of Creature 83 is often called a "fluffle" in parts of Northern Lore. It makes them the perfect inspiration for this comfy hoodie sleepwear set.

name: Creeper Skin
description: You are very brave to have crawled inside the exoskeleton of a Cadaverous Creeper. May you always spread fears throughout your travels.

name: Creeping Memories
description: A living nightmare wrenched into reality. Creeping memories and dormant fears have come to life. They propogate by spreading terror, facilitating the emergence of new horrors from the depths of the mind.

name: Creepy Clockwork Doll
description: Am I just to be like a clockwork doll?

name: Creepy Cutthroat
description: No bones about it, you're one unlucky Hero. Happy Unlucky Day 2015, you're going to need it.

name: Cretaceous Champion
description: Curious as to what made the dinosaurs extinct? …Look no further than the Cretaceous Champion, clad in the prehistoric remains of every beast they have slain.

name: Crimson Archer
description: A type of assassin that can stand on ceilings without losing its balance when taking a step.

name: Crimson BoneLord
description: Your foes will a bone to pick with you when you wear such a sophisticated attire, which has been knitted from the bones of the fallen.
