name: Crimson Captain (0 AC)
description: Red may be the Captain's favorite color but gold is the one all pirates seek out.

name: Crimson Captain (AC)
description: Red may be the Captain's favorite color but gold is the one all pirates seek out.

name: Crimson Crewmember (0 AC)
description: New matey's need to earn respect so get busy swabbin' the deck!

name: Crimson Crewmember (AC)
description: New matey's need to earn respect so get busy swabbin' the deck!

name: Crimson Cryptlord Armor
description: Made from the finest Darkovian silk, This elegant suit is worn by the vampires who are reign over their crypts.

name: Crimson Dark Lord Armor
description: Crimson Dark Lords channel the power of the Fourth to further their goal of taking over the universe for the dark side. (And they have cookies!)

name: Crimson Darkness
description: In the darkness, every color is crimson. or black. Mostly black. Design suggested by AQW player xHAKOx!

name: Crimson DeathKnight
description: Wreck the halls as you slay your way through any who would oppose you.

name: Crimson Destructor1337
description: Sent Back in time from the year 20122013 to bring about the annihilation of Lore. Also they heard that it was someone's birthday, time to crash it! NO ONE SHALL CELEBRATE A BIRTHDAY!

name: Crimson Dragoon
description: Stealthy, powerful and effactive, this armor will aid in your ability to not only get in face of your enemy without detection, but protect you when the hardest hit comes down on your back.

name: Crimson Eveningwear
description: Somewhere in the dark, there's a party that's been going on since the first act of evil was made on Lore. Invites are exlusive to the most wicked of souls.

name: Crimson Fiend
description: You stalk the night, taking down prey before they even know you're there. And you look FANTASTIC doing it!

name: Crimson Gladiator
description: It is said that the crimson gladiator was a legendary fighter, whose white armor was drenched in the blood of all who opposed him. That's just a rumor though… Right?

name: Crimson Glory Mage
description: This time of year is magical, and your powers bring glory to you and those you love!

name: Crimson Grand Inquisitor Armor
description: The arbitors presiding over those who judge. Exploitation and abuse is inexcusable, no matter the reason. Unless, you have decided that it's necessary.

name: Crimson Knight
description: Crimson Knights do not fear, nor pain, nor defeat. They will fight as long blood flows in them.

name: Crimson Knight and Shield
description: Crimson Knights do not fear, nor pain, nor defeat. They will fight as long blood flows in them.

name: Crimson Knight Commander
description: As night falls, a valiant group of warriors take up their arms to defend all who require it. The famed Crimson Knight Commanders rise to any challenge, their reputation is known to all.

name: Crimson Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Stained red from all the blood spilled into the seven seas, these Commanders do not fear death.

name: Crimson Naval Commander (AC)
description: Stained red from all the blood spilled into the seven seas, these Commanders do not fear death.

name: Crimson Paladin Armor
description: This red plate armor will awe your opponent with it's bold color. You can only purchase this armor if you have earned the Paladin Class, not if you bought it.

name: Crimson Party Outfit
description: Light up the night with this glittering outfit as you ring in the new year!

name: Crimson Peony Grenwog Garb
description: Red is joy and fortune, or it could be a symbol of passion. An industrious grenwog can cover it all!

name: Crimson Pirate Mage
description: Pirates or privateers that practice magic in their daily lives fare slightly better out in the sea than those who do not. They carry elegant red tomes that contain every spell they need to effectively survive anything from raging storms to Kathool Adepts.

name: Crimson Plate of Nulgath
description: Nulgath taints this armor with his power.

name: Crimson Royalty
description: A gleaming battle suit forged in the glory and dedication of the late King Alteon. Lineage is nothing when you receive the high honor of commanding your own division of good. Long live the King!

name: Crimson Scourge Overlord
description: Dimension travelers that have perfected their complex abilities are granted the rare privilege to have their bodies dissolve into part-nebula. Their only command is to wipe out their foes in the name of Caden.

name: Crimson SpitFire
description: Pitted against the Azure Spitfire clan, the Crimson Spitfire mercenaries use ruthless tactics to cash in on bounties posted by the Deathshead Destroyers.

name: Crimson Wrath
description: They say that the berries that hang from the boughs of holly came because blood dyed the original white to the now crimson hue. Dare we wonder about this armour armor?

name: CrimsonFlame Fanatic
description: The CrimsonFlame Fanatics are a small but powerful sect of fire magic users. They travel the land, "purifying" evildoers that cross their paths.

name: Crocadile Dundoo
description: If you want to master the outback you need the right clothes, mate! Featuring dusty dungarees, Croc skin vest and boots and a real crocadile tooth necklace.

name: Crown of the Den
description: As a royal member of the Onslaught Army, it's your duty to plan out the line of defenses against the forces of Evil and Chaos. No one will ever again oppose General Lionfang and his Golden Onslaught Army!

name: Crownsreach Dandy
description: A stylish, textile coat that is fit for a sophisticated party.

name: Crows Away Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Crows Away Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Crows Rush Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Crows Rush Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Crows Team (AC)
description: Go team! Go! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Crows Team (Legend)
description: Go team! Go! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Crows Varsity Team
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Cruise Captain
description: I'm on a boat! I'm on boat! Wait..wait… I'M A CAPTAIN OF A BOAT!

name: Crusader Armor
description: Crusaders make vigorous and aggressive movements for the defense or advancement of an idea. In this case, it's the eradication of magic!

name: Crusader of the Light
description: Crusaders are the next up the Good rank! You're moving your way towards the Light!

name: Cryo Assassin of Nulgath (AC)
description: Open wide. One bite delivers a lasting, but nasty chill that puts the opponent on the brink of a slow death. Could it be that another phantom dwells inside?

name: Cryo Assassin of Nulgath (Legend)
description: Open wide. One bite delivers a lasting, but nasty chill that puts the opponent on the brink of a slow death. Could it be that another phantom dwells inside?

name: Cryo Chronomancer (Armor)
description: Scourges of the distant past, perilous present, and fearful future. They freeze time, grinding everything to a harsh halt. Nothing lives, nothing dies, and silence prevails. The Cryo Chronomancer claims this frozen waste as their Empire.

name: Cryo-Frozen Arabesque (0 AC)
description: The style and dress of a lost culture of fae. Or perhaps they were elves. Their magic arts and combat style where sharp, but unique to each member, like the fractals of snowflakes.

name: Cryo-Frozen Arabesque (AC)
description: The style and dress of a lost culture of fae. Or perhaps they were elves. Their magic arts and combat style where sharp, but unique to each member, like the fractals of snowflakes.

name: CryoArts Monastery Monk
description: Deep in the frigid halls of a mountaintop monastery, monks train and meditate until all earthly thoughts leave their body. In solitude and silence, they master the cold.

name: Cryomagus (0 AC)
description: A Cryomagus embodies the gentle and myserious facet of snowfall. Their magic and wisdom is as ancient and vast as the aurora that only appears before ice.

name: Cryomagus (AC)
description: A Cryomagus embodies the gentle and myserious facet of snowfall. Their magic and wisdom is as ancient and vast as the aurora that only appears before ice.

name: Cryomancer Arcana (0 AC)
description: The cryomancer robes of the mage, Arcana. This garb was created to enhance her ice magic as she went in search of the origin of all cryomancy.

name: Cryomancer Arcana (AC)
description: The cryomancer robes of the mage, Arcana. This garb was created to enhance her ice magic as she went in search of the origin of all cryomancy.

name: Cryomancer Armor (AC)
description: Unleash the power of ice and snow! Freeze your enemies on the spot, making them shiver in fear. Let it go since the cold never bothered you anyways.

name: Cryomancer Armor (Merge)
description: Unleash the power of ice and snow! Freeze your enemies on the spot, making them shiver in fear. Let it go since the cold never bothered you anyways.

name: Cryomancer Drakonnan
description: Instead of fire, this Drakonnan wields the power of ice. Now isn't that cool?

name: Cryomancer Knight
description: Cryomancer Knights are charged with defending the farthest reaches of the Frozen Northlands, using their magic, melee, and might to protect and defend from any enemies.

name: Cryostorm Crusader (AC)
description: Forged from the core of the Ice Titan himself, this pristine armor belongs to the Champion of Ice. With every step you take, the world grows colder

name: Cryostorm Crusader (Merge)
description: Forged from the core of the Ice Titan himself, this pristine armor belongs to the Champion of Ice. With every step you take, the world grows colder

name: Cryostorm Troll
description: Don't be bummed out if your stuck as an ice troll. You won't have to bundle up anymore and cavefishing just got more exciting.

name: Cryostorm Warrior
description: Forged from the core of the Ice Titan itself, this pristine armor belongs to the Champion of Ice. With every step you take, the world grows colder.

name: Cryostorm Wolf Rider (Armor)
description: Arctic wolves like this one can sprint through snow without rest and are ruthless hunters that could wipe a single lake clean of fish. Nearly impossible to tame, to mount an arctic wolf is a huge achievement in one's lifetime.

name: Cryostorm Wolf Warrior
description: Wolf pelts aren't needed when self-heating metal will better endure through the harshest winters in the Northlands. Luckily, the plate does not burn the skin as long as the interior leather doesn't peel off.

name: Cryozen's Dragonlord
description: The armor of Vilmor, Dragonlord and partner of the Great Ice Dragon, Cryozen. The Legendary Pair, celebrated and envied, became the gold standard of partnerships.

name: Crypt Knight
description: Haaaaaahhhhhh… You will die slowly, mortal! Nulgath the ArchFiend will have your soul. FOREVER.

name: Crypt Rogue
description: Your gold or your life? Your choice. One way or another, you'll give your fair share to Nulgath the ArchFiend.

name: Crypt Samurai
description: A samurai should always be prepared for death - whether his own or someone else's.

name: Crypt Soldier
description: Haaaaaahhhhhh… You will die slowly, mortal! Nulgath the ArchFiend will have your soul. FOREVER.

name: Cryptborg
description: Some are chosen to undergo even further changes - the Deadtech has taken almost full hold of them. Who knows how much more they can handle.

name: Cryptic
description: Cryptics are Atealan illusionists whose minds are their most powerful weapons. The only limit to their abilities is their imagination.

name: Crypto Collector
description: How do you collect that which does not exist… except in cyberspace?

name: Crypto Creator
description: Cryptoknights vow allegiance to the Crypto alliance. They swear by the Elemental Fire, an anancient force from before your time; and holographic technology. (Eyes not CC)

name: Crystal Dragonborn Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: The glowing and color-changing parts of this elegant outfit were made from the scales of the rare Crystal Dragon. The crystals themselves are even harder since the only way to get them is by fighting and hope enough of the beautiful stones survive the fight to be used.

name: Crystal Dragonborn Naval Commander (AC)
description: The glowing and color-changing parts of this elegant outfit were made from the scales of the rare Crystal Dragon. The crystals themselves are even harder since the only way to get them is by fighting and hope enough of the beautiful stones survive the fight to be used.

name: Crystal Roses & Royalty (0 AC)
description: Those bound to rule the Northlands possess a cold heart and crystalline strength, ancient, and unshakeable as the glaciers.

name: Crystal Roses & Royalty (AC)
description: Those bound to rule the Northlands possess a cold heart and crystalline strength, ancient, and unshakeable as the glaciers.

name: Crystal Singer
description: Craft your own dreams! Life is an illusion, follow the clues and your dreams!

name: Crystal Void of Nulgath
description: Created by Nulgath to infiltrate icy zones of Lore without being detected, the Crystal Void blends right in with the ice.

name: Crystallis Adjudicator
description: There are many who choose to defy the rules of the Crystallis administration. These citizens roam the streets, breaking curfews and windows. They will soon be… re-educated.

name: Crystallis Admin
description: This suit has been authorized for use by Crystallis Administration, rank T1 C or higher.

name: Crystallis Admiral (0 AC)
description: The Archivist has sent up the Crystallis Admirals out to head up the search for what belongs to her.

name: Crystallis Admiral (AC)
description: The Archivist has sent up the Crystallis Admirals out to head up the search for what belongs to her.

name: Crystallis Boardwalk Outfit (AC)
description: Keep cool and look cool while you battle down the boardwalk on your way to the Convenient Store.

name: Crystallis Boardwalk Outfit (Legend)
description: Keep cool and look cool while you battle down the boardwalk on your way to the Convenient Store.

name: Crystallis Canoneer (0 AC)
description: The Archivist has assigned the Crystallis Admiral to reclaim what belongs to her…What could she have lost?

name: Crystallis Canoneer (AC)
description: The Archivist has assigned the Crystallis Admiral to reclaim what belongs to her…What could she have lost?

name: Crystallis Canoneer (Legend)
description: The Archivist has assigned the Crystallis Admiral to reclaim what belongs to her…What could she have lost?

name: Crystallis Casual Outfit
description: When you just need to run out to the Convenient Store, this is the perfect outfit to get in, get out, and get back into battle.

name: Crystallis Casual Rescuer (0 AC)
description: The design of this official off-duty Citizen Lifeguard gear has been approved by the Department of Outfit Inspection and Couture Correction. (This item is color-customizable to trim and accessory)

name: Crystallis Casual Rescuer (AC)
description: The design of this official off-duty Citizen Lifeguard gear has been approved by the Department of Outfit Inspection and Couture Correction. (This item is color-customizable to trim and accessory)

name: Crystallis Citizen Pants
description: When you just need to run out to the Convenient Store, this is the perfect outfit to get in, get out, and get back into battle.

name: Crystallis Citizen's Coat
description: On the cold streets of the Shinkansen, it helps to have a long coat. No one knows what you're concealing in your pockets until it's too late.

name: Crystallis Conductor
description: The Crystallis administration recruits only the most talented and upstanding citizens to conduct passengers on the Shinkansen.

name: Crystallis Dark Citizen Pants
description: When you just need to run out to the Convenient Store, this is the perfect outfit to get in, get out, and get back into battle.

name: Crystallis Gymwear
description: The streets need order, and you can't keep order if you're slacking at the gym.

name: Crystallis Heart of Kotaro
description: This armor seems to replicate Kotaro's abilities. It phases in and out throught multi-dimensions whilst maintaining solidity. A very goold ability indeed if you'd like to challenge destiny.

name: Crystallis Jinbei
description: A light version of the Crystallis Onsen pajamas known commonly in future Akiba as 'Jinbei'.

name: Crystallis Manager
description: This suit has been authorized for use by Crystallis Administration, rank T1 F or higher.

name: Crystallis ProtoAssassin (0 AC)
description: Crystallis ProtoAssassins exist only in rumors and the shadows… right up until their blades are pressed against your throat.

name: Crystallis ProtoAssassin (AC)
description: Crystallis ProtoAssassins exist only in rumors and the shadows… right up until their blades are pressed against your throat.

name: Crystallis ProtoHunter (0 AC)
description: Crystallis ProtoHunters stalk their prey across space and time. You will never know one is on your trail until the knife is in your back.

name: Crystallis ProtoHunter (AC)
description: Crystallis ProtoHunters stalk their prey across space and time. You will never know one is on your trail until the knife is in your back.

name: Crystallis Shopping Shorts
description: When you just need to run out to the Convenient Store, this is the perfect outfit to get in, get out, and get back into battle.

name: Crystallis Soldier (Armor)
description: The Crystallis administration recruits only the most skilled and loyal citizens to guard and serve. Are YOU worthy to join?

name: Crystallis Sovereign
description: Once a guardian of Eden’s equilibrium, now a hollow vessel of ‘perfect order,’ the Crystallis Sovereign's purity has been corrupted by an… Anomaly. Their radiance remains, but its glare hides immaculate poise and a merciless heart. A fitting vessel to serve the Administration's highest purpose.

name: Crystallis Street Wear
description: Citizens of the Crystallis administration are free to wander the streets at will… as long as they adhere to stated laws and procedures.

name: Crystallis Summer Rescuer (0 AC)
description: Citizens Lifeguards are encouraged by the Crystallis Administration to follow all stated rules and procedures before attempting rescue. Failure to comply will result in censure or sanctioning.

name: Crystallis Summer Rescuer (AC)
description: Citizens Lifeguards are encouraged by the Crystallis Administration to follow all stated rules and procedures before attempting rescue. Failure to comply will result in censure or sanctioning.

name: Crystallis Summer Rescuer (Legend)
description: Citizens Lifeguards are encouraged by the Crystallis Administration to follow all stated rules and procedures before attempting rescue. Failure to comply will result in censure or sanctioning.

name: Crystallis Summer Wear (0 AC)
description: It's summertime, and those who know of Crystallis show that they know how to party!

name: Crystallis Summer Wear (AC)
description: It's summertime, and those who know of Crystallis show that they know how to party!

name: Crystallis Summer Wear (Legend)
description: It's summertime, and those who know of Crystallis show that they know how to party!

name: Crystallis VoidSlayer (AC)
description: Through Kotaro's research, Crystallis has managed to forge an armor capable of manipulating the properties of void entities within Nulgath's Nation. description: I heart rock 'n' roll, so put a piece of gold in this jukebox, baby! I heart rock 'n' roll, so come equip this armor and /dance with me!

name: Dark Rogue
description: Slip in and out of the shadows and grab that deal before anyone else even sees it!

name: Dark Romantic
description: Svelte and serious, make an impression on an enemy today. Show a darker side to love while wielding your weapon of choice. AE is not liable for random spouting of Shakespeare.

name: Dark Royalty
description: A gleaming battle suit forged in the glory and dedication of the late King Alteon. Lineage is nothing when you receive the high honor of commanding your own division of good. Long live the King!

name: Dark Ruler's Streetwear
description: Intimidation's part of the job, and you might as well look good while you're doing it. Gravelyn won't say it but she's satisfied by how much you're going to match her.

name: Dark Scientist J6 (0 AC)
description: All robots know that a mastery of DARK SCIENCE is a requirement!

name: Dark Scientist J6 (AC)
description: All robots know that a mastery of DARK SCIENCE is a requirement!

name: Dark Scientist J6 (Legend)
description: All robots know that a mastery of DARK SCIENCE is a requirement!

name: Dark Sea Corsair
description: YARRRR! Ye an' yer crew rule the Dark Seas, an' all who are cursed enough to cross yer path will rue th' day… assumin' they survive it.

name: Dark Sea Fleet Captain
description: Tempted by the lure of wealth, power, and more loot than in Swordhaven's treasure house, you agreed to conquer the Dark Seas in Malgor the ShadowFlame's name.

name: Dark Seas Ruler (Armor)
description: When your heart is as black as a stormy sea in the darkness of the night, you would not be reluctant to get just as rough in battle to ensure your rule is absolute.

name: Dark Shadowscythe Shirt
description: 103% Cotton-poly blend Artix Ent shirts will NOT protect you from the following: Stab wounds. Slice wounds. Shankings. Beatings. Maulings. Acid. Fire. The pure unrelenting fury of an old lady on a mission. Biting. Crushing. The full weight of you heart breaking into a million tiny fragments that will take a lifetime to piece together. Dads. Moms. Paper cuts. Wind. Rain. Other shirts.

name: Dark Shadowslayer A (0 AC)
description: Don these super-shady garments to sneak into your local inn shop and grab your anticipated items without paying a large piggy bank.

name: Dark ShadowSlayer A (AC)
description: Don't these super-shady garments to sneak into your local inn shop and grab your anticipated items without paying a large piggy bank.

name: Dark ShadowSlayer A (Legend)
description: Don't these super-shady garments to sneak into your local inn shop and grab your anticipated items without paying a large piggy bank.

name: Dark ShadowSlayer Z (0 AC)
description: Don these super-shady garments to sneak into your local inn shop and grab your anticipated items without paying a large piggy bank.

name: Dark ShadowSlayer Z (AC)
description: Don't these super-shady garments to sneak into your local inn shop and grab your anticipated items without paying a large piggy bank.

name: Dark ShadowSlayer Z (Legend)
description: Don't these super-shady garments to sneak into your local inn shop and grab your anticipated items without paying a large piggy bank.

name: Dark Shogun (Armor)
description: These former rulers aren't ready to concede yet. Their undying pledge to defend their lands goes beyond life itself.

name: Dark SkyGuard Rifleman (0 AC)
description: All you have to do is show up and everyone quickly disperses. Rifleman are notoriously good at what they do and when one doesn't miss the target, he or she becomes legendary. Be legendary, clad in black.

name: Dark SkyGuard Rifleman (AC)
description: All you have to do is show up and everyone quickly disperses. Rifleman are notoriously good at what they do and when one doesn't miss the target, he or she becomes legendary. Be legendary, clad in black.

name: Dark SkyGuard Rifleman (Legend)
description: All you have to do is show up and everyone quickly disperses. Rifleman are notoriously good at what they do and when one doesn't miss the target, he or she becomes legendary. Be legendary.

name: Dark Skyguard Uniform
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment.

name: Dark SnowAngel (0 AC)
description: No matter how dark the night or black the feathers, the purity of a snow angel's spirit shines brighter than the North Star.

name: Dark SnowAngel (AC)
description: No matter how dark the night or black the feathers, the purity of a snow angel's spirit shines brighter than the North Star.

name: Dark Snuggle Bear
description: Bear it all in this fuzzy wuzzy Snuggle Bear Armor! Cuddly soft and oh-so warm, friend and foe alike will want to give you a great big hug.

name: Dark Sorcerer
description: Fear and darkness are your allies. You live to crush the Good of the Mirror Realm and bring forth eternal Dark.

name: Dark Sorceress
description: Dark Forest Sorcerers heavily favor the shadows as if it is a companion, which is why they often keep to themselves. They remain neutral in any conflict occurring in the world unless their homelands were threatened by war.

name: Dark Stalker (1)
description: Once a peaceful race lived under the Forest of Chaos, in attempts to avoid the waging wars. Over the years, the faeries men who dwelt there were corrupted by Chaos. Some pledged their allegiance to the menacing force.

name: Dark Stalker (2)
description: Winter is coming and the Dark Stalkers are ready to take over the world!

name: Dark StarkCaster
description: I know nothing, Hero, except that… I am the StarkCaster in the darkness. Night gathers, and now my eternal watch begins. It shall not end until my death. I shall always serve the Undead Legion.

name: Dark Summer Lounger (0 AC)
description: Every now and then, you come out of the dark to show off. How else will anyone see your ink? (This item is color-customizable to Trim.)

name: Dark Summer Lounger (AC)
description: Every now and then, you come out of the dark to show off. How else will anyone see your ink? (This item is color-customizable to Trim.)

name: Dark Summoner
description: Laced with lethal threads-Blood Summoners don't bend the elements, they bend the will of foes surrounding them.

name: Dark Sun Mage
description: The Dark Sun Magi can use their powers not necessarily for Evil but they do not fight for Good.

name: Dark Sworn Legion Sovereign
description: The Underworld has one Lord, and it's Dage the Evil…should he ever need someone to watch his throne, he forged a worthy regalia for a sovereign he knows more than his own blood. The legions kneels to them without question.

name: Dark Tempest Soldier
description: When a Tempest Soldier moves so far into the Darker side that they are beyond cookies… they get awarded the Dark Tempest Soldier gear.

name: Dark Thief Armor
description: As his way of expressing thanks for dealing with the Black Hole Sun, Anubyx has given you the opportunity to learn how to control the direction of the sun's rays. Doing so is a highly risky skill to develop, though.

name: Dark Thunder Master
description: The Dark Thunder Master placed a storm over Skye that blocked out the sun for generations. Their lightning, as dark as the bitterness in their heart, could reach the stars.

name: Dark-tic DragonSlayer (0 AC)
description: Living in the far reaches of the Northlands, these DragonSlayers use the colors of the Aurora to brighten up their stark armor.

name: Dark-tic DragonSlayer (AC)
description: Living in the far reaches of the Northlands, these DragonSlayers use the colors of the Aurora to brighten up their stark armor.

name: Dark TideWalker (0 AC)
description: Nulgath not only holds dominion over the land, but also the sea. These TideWalkers have morphed into human form in order to hide among us, Sowing dissent in order to promote Nulgath's Nation.

name: Dark TideWalker (AC)
description: Nulgath not only holds dominion over the land, but also the sea. These TideWalkers have morphed into human form in order to hide among us, sowing dissent in order to promote Nulgath's Nation.

name: Dark Tithe Chevalier
description: A suit of armor once belonging to chevaliers that wielded Darkness in the name of their Kings and Queens. They and the High Elves that served the Light fought for dominion until Greenguard became rife with humankind.

name: Dark Ultra OmniNight Armor
description: You've fought enemies across multiple different universes, learned to harness the unstable energies from their worlds required to stop them, and earned the right to call yourself an Ultra OmniKnight!

name: Dark Undead Assassin
description: Word of your murderous deeds have reached the ears of the Dark Lord. The Undead Legion would like to hire you to do its bidding, because if you are already undead, you have nothing else to lose…

name: Dark Undead Leader (0 AC)
description: The dead don't sleep. They await the day a worthy and creatively cruel leader beckons them to wake.

name: Dark Undead Leader (AC)
description: The dead don't sleep. They await the day a worthy and creatively cruel leader beckons them to wake.

name: Dark UndeadSlayer
description: Arooooooewwwwww… Arrrooo?! (The undead cannot talk, but this undead undeadslayer would be singing… "Isn't it ironic… don't you think?)

name: Dark Vampire
description: The life of a vampire doesn't get much better than this. Being this bad never felt this good!

name: Dark Vampire Queen
description: The heroes of AdventureQuest Worlds voted to choose an NPC to receive a Black Friday version, and Safiria the Vampire Queen was one of the winners!

name: Dark Vampire Slayer (AC)
description: A good slayer doesn't just stake the sparkly ones, they go after all vampire kind. You're not just some crazy person, you're the slayer!

name: Dark Vampire Slayer (Non-AC)
description: A good slayer doesn't just stake the sparkly ones, they go after all vampire kind. You're not just some crazy person, you're the slayer!

name: Dark Virtual Criminal
description: The best virtual criminals never assume they'll get away unscathed… they always have a backup plan and NEVER jinx themselves by being overconfident.

name: Dark Void Knight (0 AC)
description: Let's hope you don't find one of these guys at the end of the rainbow.

name: Dark Void Knight (AC)
description: Let's hope you don't find one of these guys at the end of the rainbow.

name: Dark Void Monk (0 AC)
description: Let's hope you don't find one of these guys at the end of the rainbow.

name: Dark Void Monk (AC)
description: Let's hope you don't find one of these guys at the end of the rainbow.

name: Dark Void Of Revontheus
description: Once you signed your life away to Revontheus, you were given tremendous power. But how long will it last?

name: Dark Warlic Armor
description: As a follower of the Black Mage, you have access to powers the likes of which Lore has not yet seen. Use your newfound abilities to fight for virtue and justice, because darkness will flee at very sight of your righteous light! (Sora wanted this for Black Friday)

name: Dark Warrior
description: For fighting your way through the crowds waiting to get that 3D TV for $100…

name: Dark Water
description: The spirit of the Waters made a deal to be darker and stronger. This armor is a memory of the day it all happened. If you can handle it, then take it. Otherwise, run for your life.

name: Dark Water Dragon Summoner
description: Deep below the waves lives a nation of sea dragons. Masters of aquatic elemental magic, these ancient and powerful creatures have never been known to interact with the humans of Lore… until now. (This item is color-customizable to base, trim, and accessory.)

name: Dark Water Lord +10
description: Those who challenge Charon do so at peril of their soul. The Boatman's wrath is not to be tempted…. Does 10% more damage against Undead!

name: Dark Winter Warlock (0 AC)
description: Channel the power of blizzards and black ice to destroy your enemies!

name: Dark Winter Warlock (AC)
description: Channel the power of blizzards and black ice to destroy your enemies!

name: Dark & Witchy
description: The one time of year when people don't look askance at your wonderful dark and witchy outfits.

name: Dark Wolf Marauder
description: The Dark Wolf Bandits were once led by the exiled Prince Drakath. They would have been a menace on the open seas, if more of them knew how to swim. Drakath stopped tossing them into the waves when their numbers dwindled too low.

name: Dark Wolf Pirate
description: The Dark Wolf Bandits were once led by the exiled Prince Drakath. They would have been a menace on the open seas, if more of them knew how to swim. Drakath stopped tossing them into the waves when their numbers dwindled too low.

name: Dark Zenobyte
description: This order of magical creatures comes from a dark dimension.

name: Darkblood Assassin
description: Make no mistake, if your their next mark, you will die. The sooner you come to accept this, the better off you will be. Resistance is futile!

name: DarkBlood Berserker
description: The darkblood are no strangers to using brute force and the berserkers in their ranks take it to an entirely extreme level.

name: DarkBlood BlazeBinder
description: The marks burned into Darkblood pyromancer's show their devotion to the craft.

name: Darkblood Champion
description: During the occasional downtime within the Falguard Dreadwatch army, the Darkbloods love to pit their own kind against each other in a battle to the death. Those victorious in battle shall reap rewards of monetary value, while those who lose are given the gift of their very own coffin.

name: Darkblood Crafter
description: The Darkblood who are blacksmiths have to work with a tremendous amount of tainted, toxic material without losing their minds in the process. Because their lineage is traced to the QoM, their tolerance to such a poison is powerful than most creatures.

name: Darkblood Eviscerator
description: The Darkblood have dwelled behind the walls surrounding the city of Falguard for centuries, but there are those who venture beyond these walls. Those that do journey to the outside world are just looking for one thing and two things only… Punishment and Suffering! To operate these arm blades click the top of the hilt to extend the blade and click the bottom of the blade to access its magical glyphs.

name: Darkblood Guards
description: Lieutenant in the Dreadwatch army, these high-ranking guards patrol the watchtower and are the first line of defense if anyone tries gain access to the city of Falguard. Only those of who share the same bloodline as the Carkbloods shall be permitted inside the city walls.

name: Darkblood LoreKeeper
description: The Darkblood, particularly the loremasters, have a darker perspective on how they see the world. The tomes they write express a great deal of pity for the QoM.

name: Darkblood of Nulgath
description: A new nation bows to Nulgath… and an army of Darkblood Warriors battle in the name of the Archfiend!

name: Darkblood Paragon Knight
description: These knights gave more than just their souls for their cause.

name: Darkblood Peasant
description: Cut off from the outside world, the folks dwelling in Falguard are't all warriors. To maintain a prosperous culture, supply gathering, weapon forging, and food preparation are just a few of the tasks that the town peasants are tasked with performing. This armor is color custom.

name: DarkBlood Pit Warrior
description: You've been cast into the Death Pits to endure infinite torture. Can you prove victorious despite your own kins' ruthless betrayal?

name: Darkblood Priest-Mage
description: Darkbloods wield a special brand of magic, they pay respect to their land and their gods.

name: Darkblood Savages
description: When the wisest elders from several of the Darkblood tribes came together and brokered peace between the others, a group of Darkbloods didn't agree in the beliefs of the terms. Since then, this group, while still opposed to the idea of Falguard and the Deathwatch, have banned together to remind Lore who it should fear when it sleeps.

name: Darkblood StormKing Armor (AC)
description: The Darkblood have always lived beneath the constant roiling storm that covers Thunderforge. It’s no surprise that they managed to magically harness the full fury and power of the storm.

name: Darkblood StormKing Armor (Non-AC)
description: The Darkblood have always lived beneath the constant roiling storm that covers Thunderforge. It’s no surprise that they managed to magically harness the full fury and power of the storm.

name: Darkblood Symbiotic Armor
description: Deep within the Blackhorn Tomb, the Darkblood parasite dwells. The parasite latches onto a host and protects them from anyone and anything that wishes to do harm. The only problem is that when the parasite basks the light, it beings to reproduce at an exponential rate. DO NOT LET IT LEAVE THE TOMB!

name: Darkblood Warrior
description: Defend the gates and don't let anyone inside Falguard! Lore should be as afraid of us as they are of the Evil that lurks in the night.

name: Darkblood Zealot
description: Those who pledge themselves to Kolyaban, the first Darkblood.

name: DarkCaster
description: Not for you! Wahhaa!

name: DarkCaster Evolution
description: The DarkCaster has finally evolved, emerging only to celebrate the birthday of Dage the Evil. Many claim to follow the path of the Undead Legion, yet Evolved DarkCasters are the most dedicated and commended of them all.

name: Darken
description: His was a long fall and it just keeps going and going… and getting darker and darker… The Seraphic Paladins may not even recognize him anymore.

name: Darker Caster X (0 AC)
description: Your foes will not be able to see you coming as the shadows hide your every move.

name: Darker Caster X (AC)
description: Your foes will not be able to see you coming as the shadows hide your every move.

name: Darker CryptLord Armor (0 AC)
description: Made from the finest Darkovian silk, This elegant suit is worn by the vampires who are reign over their crypts.

name: Darker Cryptlord Armor (AC)
description: Made from the finest Darkovian silk, This elegant suit is worn by the vampires who are reign over their crypts.

name: Darker Fiend
description: You've morphed into an even Darker Fiend, able to rip your opponents limb from limb with your claws.

name: Darker Side of the Crescent
description: As the moments tick away that make up a dull day, they will be there in the night to reclaim what is theirs!

name: Darkest BladeMaster Assassin (0 AC)
description: With harsh lifestyles, they can overcome any punishment to them. While being swift and nimble, they also do massive amount of damage when on the brink of death.

name: Darkest BladeMaster Assassin (AC)
description: With harsh lifestyles, they can overcome any punishment to them. While being swift and nimble, they also do massive amount of damage when on the brink of death.

name: Darkest Caster Evolution (0 AC)
description: Staying in the shadows is the best place to find the best battles.

name: Darkest Caster Evolution (AC)
description: Staying in the shadows is the best place to find the best battles.

name: DarkFrost Dragon Commander
description: Deep in the heart of the frozen Northlands, the DarkFrost Dragons stalk their prey. Only those ruthless enough, and cold-hearted enough, to tame these beasts will make it home alive.

name: DarkIce Cryomancer
description: Dark ice is the deadliest ice, so it stands to reason mages who wield the power of dark ice would be even cooler than normal!

name: Darkiphant
description: The Beast Maker sure puts Cthulhu's parents to shame in creating the foulest looking creature!

name: DarkLord PaladinSlayer
description: THIS PALADINSLAYER IS A FLAWLESS CREATION OF THE FIFTH EMPIRE. NO PALADIN, MOGWOK, OR DROID WILL ESCAPE. THEIR SKULLS ARE…DO DROIDS NOT HAVE SKULLS? METAL SHAPED LIKE A SKULL IS PASSABLE.

name: Darkness (Armor)
description: Your have blended the magical energy of emeralds with the Darkness! Those who gaze at the viridian silk of your robes get entranced by the tendrils of darkness which they can feel, but never see.

name: Darknight Stalker (Armor)
description: An undead scout often seen around Mt. Neverest that either side with Dage or Vokun when they are needed to carry out tasks within the Frozen Northlands. It doesn't mind getting lost as long as the icy winters are no big deal.

name: Darkon's Casual Wear
description: A tailor made outfit for the gallivanting Crown Prince of Astravia. It's meant to blend in with the common folk. Aurola didn't want the budget Darkon gave her to go to waste, choosing an ensemble that was a bit flashy. Regulus and Titania helped her convince Darkon to keep it.

name: Darkon's Debris 1
description: The former Crown Prince's new body was created at the very beginning of his lonely journey. Darkon went on to successfully fulfil his family's promise with the Arcana. The circle is closed. Dust returns to dust. Alprecha's child fades to the nothingness he was born from.

name: Darkon's Debris 180
description: You hear a stomach grumbling… but it definitely isn't yours.

name: Darkon's Debris 66.1
description: That's a nice suit you've got there.

name: Darkon's Debris 66.2
description: Now your suit is battle ready!

name: Darkon's Debris 66.3
description: You know.. It's not much of a suit now. More like an armor.

name: Darkon's Debris 92.1
description: The most dangerous demons are born in the hearts of mortals.

name: Darkon's Debris 92.2
description: This armor was made to kill beasts and lovers yet, the man on the obsidian throne welcomed them as a dear friend.

name: Darkon's Debris 92.3
description: Hey guys, refried beans were on sale.

name: Darkon's Outfit (Temp)
description: A tailor made outfit for the gallivanting Crown Prince of Astravia. It's meant to blend in with the common folk. Aurola didn't want the budget Darkon gave her to go to waste, choosing an ensemble that was a bit flashy. Regulus and Titania helped her convince Darkon to keep it.

name: Darkon's Wetsuit
description: Astravia is situated in the cold north and the pockets of liquid that could pass as lakes in The Garden are nowhere near jacuzzi temperature. Wetsuits are the norm for Darkon. He makes sure to let his abs breathe when he's relaxing on the island.

name: Darkon (Temp)
description: *No description*

name: Darkovian Beach Attendant
description: You'd think hitting the Darkovian beach would turn you into a bloody mess, but that's where the fun is!

name: Darkovian Hunger of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Nulgath's reach stretches across the length and breadth of Lore, even into the deepest reaches of Darkovia. There, the Hunger await.

name: Darkovian Hunger of Nulgath (AC)
description: Nulgath's reach stretches across the length and breadth of Lore, even into the deepest reaches of Darkovia. There, the Hunger await.

name: Darkovian Hunter
description: A sellsword that hunts the creatures of the night, so long as the gold keeps flowing. Some have made a business out of isolating vulnerable villages, and charging exorbitant prices for protection.

name: Darkovian Noble
description: As a member of Vampire Queen Safiria's royal blood court, all nobles are expected to serve with absolute loyalty, ruthlessness, and in consummate style.

name: Darkovian Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: What is undead can never die, and what was born of two worlds, and rejected by both… will NEVER forgive and NEVER forget. Werepyrates will RULE Darkovia and the Midnight Seas!

name: Darkovian Pirate Captain (AC)
description: What is undead can never die, and what was born of two worlds, and rejected by both… will NEVER forgive and NEVER forget. Werepyrates will RULE Darkovia and the Midnight Seas!

name: Darkside Armor
description: Recommended enhancement: Wizard. Vader Darkside wished that the Cheezburger changed into a farming based, pet class in-game and thus the Darkside Class was born! (Must have minion summoned or battle pet equipped for skills to work)

name: Darkside Ascension Armor (0 AC)
description: Once, heroes joined the Darkside for cookies. It is the pure, intoxicating power of the shadows that keeps them here.

name: Darkside Ascension Armor (AC)
description: Once, heroes joined the Darkside for cookies. It is the pure, intoxicating power of the shadows that keeps them here.

name: Darkside Trooper
description: Ohh, you think darkness is your ally, hmm? Well in this case it is. Go stab something with a glowy sword, you.

name: Darkstar Fae
description: A shadow has come over the Fae, some have turned against their ways and wandered far from the Grove.

name: Darkwave Dancer
description: Show your admiration for the special guest band for Mogloween 2015, Cruxshadows!

name: Darkwave Outfit
description: Show your admiration for the special guest band for Mogloween 2015, Cruxshadows!

name: Darkwolf Bandit (Armor)
description: Congratulations, you've joined the ranks of lackey for the King.

name: Darling Chinchilla
description: Your friends can't resist you. Your enemies can't help but pick you up, and stare in awe. This is your peak heroic form.

name: Darrgoross
description: The Darrgoross armor was crafted with by blackknightgod from both light and dark rituals, performed simultaneously while the metal was being forged. The result was golden armor with an ominous black trimming.

name: Data Runner
description: The grid couldn't hold you any longer!

name: Datahawk Runner
description: RuneHawk's students are hungry for mystery and discovery. Some will push themselves to the very limit in pursuit of the universe's secrets. Their determination yielded results. They run Forbidden Code that can change the nature of reality.

name: Dauntless Willbreaker (0 AC)
description: "Dauntless Willbreaker" is just a fancy title for the Legion's top torture masters. Though they excel in battle, their real purpose is to make the prisoners of the Underworld suffer until they forget how to speak.

name: Dauntless Willbreaker (AC)
description: "Dauntless Willbreaker" is just a fancy title for the Legion's top torture masters. Though they excel in battle, their real purpose is to make the prisoners of the Underworld suffer until they forget how to speak.

name: Dauntless Willbreaker (Legend)
description: "Dauntless Willbreaker" is just a fancy title for the Legion's top torture masters. Though they excel in battle, their real purpose is to make the prisoners of the Underworld suffer until they forget how to speak.

name: Dawn Archmage
description: Control the dawn, control the world!

name: Dawn Duelist
description: As the sun rises over the mountains, a condor calls the warriors to battle. The Dawn Duelists prepare to defend their home. They will give their life for the land and people they love so much.

name: Dawn Vindicator Archer
description: The archers of the Dawn Vindicators stand close with their soldier counterparts. They nimbly evade the chaos of battle, and their arrows are guided by the light of their illustrious leader.

name: Dawn Vindicator Captain
description: As they move up the ranks, Lieutenants become Vindicator Captains, showing their ever-increasing knowledge of the Vindicators.

name: Dawn Vindicator General
description: The Dawn Vindicator Generals are warriors and advisors, trusted by their Leader to spread his light wherever he is absent. Darkness flees, infernals burn, and evil doers cower in their celestial light.

name: Dawn Vindicator Inquisitor
description: The Vindicators seek to purge beasts of all forms from Lore. When the last of the fiends fall, the world will finally become the sacred garden it was meant to be. A garden for the human race.

name: Dawn Vindicator Lieutenant
description: As they move up the ranks, recruits become Vindicator Lieutenants, showing their ever-increasing knowledge of the Vindicators.

name: Dawn Vindicator Recruit
description: As a recruit gains more knowledge, they are able to move up a rank and wear the Dawn Vindicator gear.

name: Dawn Vindicator's Chosen
description: In a certain outcome, the Hollowborn Vindicator was forced into being, and was taken by the Celestials. Gramiel offered them to his Creator, who took them as a vessel. The Divine Being that emerged was beyond comprehension.

name: Dawn Vindicator Soldier (Armor)
description: As a recruit gains more knowledge, they are able to move up a rank and wear the Dawn Vindicator gear.

name: Day of the Undead Suit
description: Celebrate the dearly departed with laughter, loud music, and dance. The Marigolds sway to the beat of your music.

name: Dayak Warrior
description: Ancestors of the Dayak warriors once lived in the Celestial Realm, but now make the island of Nunsatara their home. They protect their people and the land they've come to love

name: Ddog's Sea Serpent Armor
description: Nulgath says, this armor was forged from the power of the Great Sea Serpent. This armor is a relative of the sword counterpart.

name: Dead Knight
description: Recruitment posters all over DoomWood read: Join the horde of dark-hearted warriors rallying under the banner of the Slayer! Be one with the Darkness; submit to the evil that hardens your heart and rules your life. Become… a Dead Knight!

name: Dead Moglinster
description: Time to morph into the DeadMog!!

name: Deadfly's Armor
description: What better way to commemorate Friday the 13th than by wearing Deadfly's armor? Be careful that it doesn't take over your life.

name: Deadfly's Hollowborn Armor
description: When Deadfly tries to sneak through the Underworld, he puts on the colors of the Hollowborn. I don't think he'll actually fool anyone…

name: Deadlands Necromantress
description: Gwen, your guide to adventure in the Akumi Wars Deadlands, is determined to learn necromancy. She WILL find and save her brother, no matter what.

name: Deadly Jester (AC)
description: These jesters are no fools. Frolicking around entertaining isn't for them, these prefer jumping out scaring the living daylights out of people. It's fun, right puddin'?

name: Deadly Jester (Legend)
description: These jesters are no fools. Frolicking around entertaining isn't for them, these prefer jumping out scaring the living daylights out of people. It's fun, right puddin'?

name: Deadly Krampus (0 AC)
description: You'd better watch out, you'd better not cry, and you'd REALLY better not have misbehaved during the year…or Krampus will come for you.

name: Deadly Krampus (AC)
description: You'd better watch out, you'd better not cry, and you'd REALLY better not have misbehaved during the year…or Krampus will come for you.

name: Deadly Krampus (Legend)
description: You'd better watch out, you'd better not cry, and you'd REALLY better not have misbehaved during the year…or Krampus will come for you.

name: Deadly Wolfhound Warrior
description: Wolfhounds are the most loyal warriors in the kingdom. Wearing the Wolf's Head sigil shows that you can be trusted above all else.

name: Deadman Ghoul (AC)
description: With armor this ghoulish, you'll fit right in at a carnival of corpses.

name: Deadman Ghoul (Legend)
description: With armor this ghoulish, you'll fit right in at a carnival of corpses.

name: DeadTech Knight 2.0
description: Using Shadowscythe technology, defeated allies are converted into mindless undead cyborgs. Defiance is futile; supremacy is inevitable. (Shadow series gen 2)

name: Deadtech Lich
description: Using Shadowscythe technology, defeated allies are converted into mindless undead cyborgs. Defiance is futile; supremacy is inevitable. (Shadow series gen 3)

name: Deadtech Necromancer
description: Using Shadowscythe technology, defeated allies are converted into mindless undead cyborgs. Defiance is futile; supremacy is inevitable. (Shadow series gen 2)

name: DeadTech Warrior 2.0
description: Using Shadowscythe technology, defeated allies are converted into mindless undead cyborgs. Defiance is futile; supremacy is inevitable. (Shadow series gen 2)

name: Deady Bear Body Morph
description: Your body is morphed into the deadly Deady Bear.

name: Dearling's Garb
description: Ahh, Heroes Heart Day. The season of love and all things pink.

name: Death Alive (Armor)
description: Are you dead? Are you alive? Are you some kind of amalgam of the two?

name: Death Alive Trophy Armor
description: Don't fear the reaper. Note: Armor Shoulder Glow is CC to Eye color.

name: Death Caster (0 AC)
description: If you glimpse into the empty eyes of a Death Caster then your fate has been sealed.

name: Death Caster (AC)
description: If you glimpse into the empty eyes of a Death Caster then your fate has been sealed.

name: Death Dealer
description: In your deck, death is always a wild card.

name: Death Pit Adversary
description: The Death Pits hunger for fresh DarkBlood. Unless you are willing to appease the Pits, gear up in the ultimate DarkBlood Death Pit Adversary armor and fight for you life!

name: Death Pit Survivor
description: It's rare, but it did happen. Some very determined Darkblood managed to battle their way out of the Death Pits armed with nothing but their iron will.

name: Death Pit Warrior
description: Do YOU have what it takes to survive the DarkBlood Death Pits? You only have one chance to at victory… yet an endless supply of death and destruction await those who place second…

name: Death's Apprentice (Permanent)
description: Though he can never die or retire, Death saw it fit to appoint an apprentice incase of his absence. You will learn about the circle of life and death, and one day you will be the one to escort the recently living to their final resting place.

name: Death's Apprentice (Temporary)
description: Though he can never die or retire, Death saw it fit to appoint an apprentice incase of his absence. You will learn about the circle of life and death, and one day you will be able to escort the recently living to their final resting place.

name: Death's Custom Apprentice
description: Though he can never die or retire, Death saw it fit to appoint an apprentice in case of his absence. You will learn about the circle of life and death, and one day you will be the one to escort the recently living to their final resting place. This armor is color custom.

name: Death's Hand Armor
description: Designed by _Aegis_, this armor epitomizes the UnderWorld. Terrify you your opponents with thoughts of descending into the Darkness, never to return again!

name: Death Stalker (0 AC)
description: The only thing worse than a Death Rider with road rage… And NO BIKE!

name: Death Stalker (AC)
description: The only thing worse than a Death Rider whit road rage… And NO BIKE!

name: Death Stalker (Rare)
description: The only thing worse than a Death Rider with road rage… and NO BIKE!

name: DeathBlood Warrior (AC)
description: Join the ranks of the DeathBlood Warriors as you prepare to face the Death Pits!

name: DeathBlood Warrior (Legend)
description: Join the ranks of the DeathBlood Warriors as you prepare to face the Death Pits!

name: Deathbound Knight
description: Doomwood's original knights refuse to rest in peace. Immortalized in gold, their will persists. Though their names are lost to time and death, they destroy any who would dare plant a flag in their territory.

name: Deathbound Oraculi
description: In the limbo between the realm of the living, the Underworld, and the path to resurrection, scholars whisper about knowledge and philosophy. Cloaked in humble darkness, the Oraculi welcome curious souls and their questions.

name: Deathfiend of Nulgath
description: Members of Nulgath's Army, these sorcerers use dark magic to carry out thy master's bidding!

name: Deathgazer Irismancer
description: The eyes were plucked right from the Deathgazer to adorn the Irismancer's robes. Their gazet travels far, seeing all. But, they need to be treated frequently with eyedrops. They start to smell if they're allowed to dry out.

name: DeathKnight (Armor)
description: A DeathKnight is a mockery of all that the Paladin Order stand for. Where paladins stand for light and life, DeathKnights represent only darkness and decay. A DeathKnight is one of the most feared creatures in all of reality.

name: DeathKnight Blood Lord
description: Bound to duty as well as to the Castle of Bone these undead Knights serve for eternity.

name: DeathKnight Class Armor
description: Have you been pulled from the cold comfort of death to serve a new master or has your own will pulled you back to the land of the living to continue fighting?

name: DeathKnight Lord Armor
description: Bound to duty as well as to the Castle of Bone these undead Knights serve for eternity.

name: DeathKnight Overlord (Armor)
description: After slaying countless armies, no King or Emperor is willing to lose more men to your mighty blade.

name: Deathless Caster
description: If you are courageous enough to stare into the gaze of a Deathless Caster be warned, many who tried went mad.

name: DeathLord Malifact
description: A former Paladin that forsook the Light, and swore themselves to the finality of Death. Gold and glory won't last, and they have become a reminder and executor of this unbreakable law.

name: DeathLord's Enchanted Armor
description: To ascend to the greatness you deserve, many sacrifices will be required:

name: DeathLord's Enchanted Knight
description: To ascend to the greatness you deserve, many sacrifices will be required:

name: DeathLord's Enchanted Wight
description: To ascend to the greatness you deserve, many sacrifices will be required:

name: Deathmonger
description: Only those who have been trained by the ruthless horc Deathmongers my hope to ever call themselves one. You have learned from the best—and now the time has come to dominate the battlefield!

name: DeathRider (0 AC)
description: The only thing worse than a Death Rider is a Rider with road rage.

name: DeathRider (AC)
description: The only thing worse than a Death Rider is a Rider with road rage.

name: DeathRipper
description: Madness and death often go hand in hand. /Equip this armor to defeat both!

name: Deathshead Destroyer
description: Just like a king bets on a sports team, The Deathshead Destroyers have pitted the Spitfire clans against each other for centuries. Though the prospect of fortune and never endding power wait for the victory, to the Deathshead Destroyers… it is all just a game!

name: DeathSworn DoomKnight
description: A former Paladin that forsook the Light and swore themselves to the finality of Death. Their pursuit of power brought them to the ShadowScythe, promising loyalty in exchange for the erasure of weakness.

name: DeathSworn Knight
description: A former Paladin that forsook the Light and swore themselves to the finality of Death. No longer loyal to any mortal cause, they're in an endless pursuit of power - soon to be as feared as the force that took their humanity.

name: Deathwalker (0 AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deathwalker (AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deathwave Necrostar
description: Lone riders that strike on their own, rising from the underworld to remind the living that nothing born now or ever will match the melodies that resonates with the forever dead.

name: Debris 297 Armor
description: Do you know what true emptiness is? There is no light. Not even a space for the darkness to fill the sun's absence. Will you trust in fate, or take control of your own destiny? The choice is yours.

name: Debris Death Scholar
description: A strange book fell on to the Scholar's lap one day, and changed their life forever. Its spine had teeth, and the cover felt like burned skin. Every name written into its pages crumbled to dust.

name: Debris Designated Bear
description: A creation made by someone who won't claim ownership. It fell out of the Garden when everything ended, and secretly moves into inns where there are lots of birthdays.

name: Debris Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye, cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture.

name: Debris Naval Commander (AC)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye, cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture.

name: Debris Party Bear
description: A creation made by someone who won't claim ownership. It fell out of the Garden when everything ended, and secretly moves into inns where there are lots of birthdays.

name: Debris Volleyball Jersey (0 AC)
description: Get ready to game in your Debris Volleyball Jersey!

name: Debris Volleyball Jersey (AC)
description: Get ready to game in your Debris Volleyball Jersey!

name: DeckMaster
description: Carry out the Captain's order or they be havin' you walk the plank!

name: Decorated Akiban Hanfu
description: Gong Xi Fa Cai! May your presence bring luck and prosperity when you don this suit!

name: Decorated Colorful Akiban Hanfu
description: Gong Xi Fa Cai! May your presence bring luck and prosperity when you don this suit! Also, now you are able to choose your own lucky colours!

name: Deep Dragon Surfer
description: Surf your way across Lolosia Bay and hang ten with the braken!

name: Deep Fried Mecha
description: Mmm. Crispy, crunchy and oh, so good.

name: Deep Miner
description: In their pursuit for unmined gems and raw minerals, dwakel and human engineers combined forces to build this single person, redstone powered mining suit.

name: Deep Space Paladin
description: In space no one can hear you slay.

name: Deep Void Berserker
description: (Gender Lock) The beasts that crawl out of the Void are slowly getting bigger and bigger. These are the berserkers who were bound in iron that restricted their raw strength. Even then, the Nation couldn't control them.

name: Deep Void Marauder
description: The beasts that crawl out of the Void are slowly getting bigger and bigger. These are the berserkers who were bound in iron that restricted their raw strength. Even then, the Nation couldn't control them.

name: DeepDweller Pirate
description: Aye, the sails are set for R'lyeh! The Great Old One waits. Cthulhu fhtagn.

name: DeepSea Acolyte
description: Deep below the waves, down in the depths where no light shines, your Master waits. Your role: to serve the ancient, eldritch god who steals hearts and souls of heroes, binding them to its will. (This item is color customizable)

name: DeepSea Defender
description: Deep below the waves, down in the depths where no light shines, your Master waits. Your role: to protect the ancient, eldritch god who steals hearts and souls of heroes, binding them to its will. (This item is color-customizable)

name: DeepSea Hunter
description: At the root of it all, pirates are just the Treasure Hunters of the sea.

name: DeepSea Scourge
description: At the root of it all, pirates are just the Treasure Hunters of the sea.

name: DeepSea Star Pirate
description: DeepSea Star Pirates study the creatures found only in the brightest seas and the darkest of abyssal waters. They vow to use their power to protect all of the creatures that make the trenches their home. (Item is CC to Base)

name: DeepSpace Cyborg
description: Proud member of the Mighty Morphin Necro Rangers! (Item gives 20% more XP and Class Points when equipped.)

name: Deepspace Sniper
description: You can hit an alien in the snagblort from 2 millon Astronomical Units.

name: DeepSpace Warrior
description: Being trapped on a deserted vessel through the confines of the galaxy gives the phrase "personal space" a whole new meaning. (Item gives 20% more XP and Class Points when equipped.)

name: DeepWater Drow
description: ﻿The ocean Drow are considered a sibling clan to the Ashray and other Water groups. Each individual Drow prefers to journey alone. Their bioluminescent glow illuminates the darkness of the abyss, luring terrifying beasts to hunt with their tridents.

name: Deer Morph
description: The druids used to know the secrets of wild places of this world. They would take shapes to better interact with the world around them. Now that they're gone, who better to take their place than you?

name: Deer Morph Dark
description: You know so much. Too much. This world is beautiful and terrifying. You are the keeper of it's secrets now. You've seen the darker places where the predators lurk, and they're beginning to rub off on you.

name: Defender Armor
description: Defenders understand the sacrifices one must make during combat. Loyal to their brethren, Defenders will see to it that what they start ends in victory.

name: Defender Of Balemorale
description: The knights of Lord Granville, who was given Balemorale Castle as a gift for taking Alteon’s side during the rebellion. They’re his elites, trusted to protect Queen Victoria and her court.

name: Delinquent Leader's Garb
description: There are many who choose to defy the rules of the Crystallis administration. These citizens roam the streets, breaking curfews and windows. They will soon be… re-educated.

name: Delinquent of Crystallis
description: There are many who choose to defy the rules of the Crystallis administration. These citizens roam the streets, breaking curfews and windows. They will soon be… re-educated.

name: Deluge Dracolich Armor
description: The tide-like breath of a water dracolich could kill instantly or slowly suffocate the life out of its victim. These types of dracoliches are commonly found on coastlines, resting in forbidden dunes.

name: Demonic Nemesis
description: Encased in steel-hard bone, the fire fueling this armor is so hot it's cold. As cold as the blood in your veins as you face down foe after foe. Designed by Ninjudo.

name: Den of Nightmares
description: Even in yours dreams, you don't want to wander into this den because once you enter…there is no coming back!

name: Density Armor of Dark
description: Use darkness to utmost advantage in this armor. Hunt before you can be hunted.

name: Density Armor of Light
description: Your prey cannot use the power of darkness to hide it if you become a beacon of light!

name: Derp Llama Overlord
description: Beleen's favorite pet Derp Llama, a gift from Jemini, has been off grazing for years. But this year, she wants to give it the freedom… to FLY! (This item requires the Pink Potion + Kitty SkyFighter.)

name: Derp Zombie
description: DERP DRRP …BRAINS!!!!

name: Derpahurpadin
description: Derpahurpadins are the honest and good protectors of… DURRRRRP and HUUURRRRRPP!

name: Derpslayer
description: Your attacks are super effective against DERRRRRP! No…not really. HUUURRR!

name: Desaturated Paintball Uniform
description: Paint the town red! (And blue, green, yellow, purple, pink, black…) this April Fool's Day! Show those bland corporate suits that they can't take away AQW's color!

name: Desaturated Steampunk J6 (0 AC)
description: J6 has always been on the cutting edge of technology, even when it was steam powered!

name: Desaturated Steampunk J6 (AC)
description: J6 has always been on the cutting edge of technology, even when it was steam powered!

name: Desaturated Void of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Nulgath ranks you Void Knight and bestows a portion of his power to you. You are enveloped by sinister magic and become a creature of destruction! And all this for just a small portion of your soul! The part you don't need of course.

name: Desaturated Void of Nulgath (AC)
description: Nulgath ranks you Void Knight and bestows a portion of his power to you. You are enveloped by sinister magic and become a creature of destruction! And all this for just a small portion of your soul! The part you don't need of course.

name: Desaturated Void of Nulgath (Legend)
description: Nulgath ranks you Void Knight and bestows a portion of his power to you. You are enveloped by sinister magic and become a creature of destruction! And all this for just a small portion of your soul! The part you don't need of course.

name: Descendant of the Dragon
description: A full suit of armor designed after the Chinese Dragon. Your battles become a dance of bravery scaring off any who mean you ill.

name: Descended Amadis
description: Trained under the guidance of archangels and principalities, the angelic Amadis descends into the mortal realm, protecting all that is Good and virtuous against the forces of Evil.

name: Desolate Rogue
description: These rogues live in total isolation, not needing the aid of anyone or anything.

name: Detective Suit
description: Nice suit!

name: Detective When
description: Ask yourself: Who? What? When? Where? Why? How?

name: Devorax
description: NOM NOM NOM BRAINFACE

name: Devotee of Carnax
description: The Alpha are a cult of psionic sorcerers whose leader created Carnax in another timeline. Your task is to do whatever you can to protect and defend this creature… no matter where or when it appears.

name: Devourer of Gods
description: No mere mortal would be able to wield the power this suit contains. But you aren't JUST a mortal… are you?

name: Devourer Of Souls (Armor) (0 AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Devourer Of Souls (Armor) (AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Dew Drop's Dress Armor
description: Everyone's favorite Chiral Valley fairy finally has her own armor!

name: Diabolical Admiral
description: Travelling the dark seas requires you to not only take charge of your crew but to prove your worth. Only the most dedicated of the Diabolical fleet are granted the title of Admiral — wear it with pride.

name: Diabolical BeastHunter
description: All beasts, no matter the danger or the odds, must be slain. This unyielding devotion to beast hunting earned the "Executioner of Monsters" the awe of the common folk. (CC to Trim,Accessory)

name: Diabolical Ectomancer
description: These deranged Ectomancers are chasing after their goal of complete control over ectoplasm. Why they chose ectoplasm is unknown but you can always tell them by the gross globs of it on their clothing.

name: Diabolical Exosuit
description: Crafted from melted minerals from the toughest of asteroids, this ornate exosuit will help you traverse the stars and keep your body protected from the worst of any climate.

name: Diabolical Gargoyle
description: Gargoyle statues are built high above cityscapes, watching for any signs of danger. In courtly folklore, they come alive to hunt and feast upon the impure. (CC to base)

name: Diabolical Illusionist
description: These twisted warlocks use visual magic to deceive those who challenge them in combat, leading them to perceive their most horrid fears. It's quite rare to see their garbs in such pristine condition, treat it well.

name: Diabolical Lone Wanderer
description: ﻿Are they a bounty hunter? Maybe they're just someone who goes from place to place looking to do good. Their weapons sure are heavy though, but maybe they're just heavy because they're full of mercy.

name: Diabolical Monk
description: After years of studying bodily detachment, the Diabolical Monks have gained sight past their physical bodies and looked towards the otherworldly parasites for guidance. Their garbs are few in number, so wear it with pride.

name: Diabolical Noble Garb
description: An elegant outfit made for the highest of the Diabolical court. It's quite the showpiece in any ball or formal event; your loyalty is clear with your status symbol of an outfit.

name: Diabolical Officer
description: The Diabolical fleet requires their Officers to be vigilant and to always keep an eye out for anything that may pose a threat. Wear this uniform with pride as you sail the dark seas.

name: Diabolical ShadowHunter
description: Sacred garb sewn with profound care by senior ShadowHunters. They're awarded to those who have overcome countless trials, and impressed the high court.

name: Diabolical Summer Wear
description: Even cults take vacations over summer, wearing this outfit will have you styling in the sun! Be careful, you're wearing black so it will get hot!

name: Diabolical Swimsuit
description: Even cults take vacations over summer, wearing this outfit you should take a dip in the water and go for a swim.

name: Diabolical Techwear
description: ﻿Wearing this will make you the center of attention on any stage. Just try to not get lost in a trance while performing your hypnotic tunes.

name: Diabolical Varsity Uniform
description: Show your support for your favorite definitely not a cult faction by sporting this varsity jacket. Go team Diabolical!

name: Diabolical Volleyball Jersey (0 AC)
description: Get ready to game in your Diabolical Volleyball Jersey!

name: Diabolical Volleyball Jersey (AC)
description: Get ready to game in your Diabolical Volleyball Jersey!

name: Diabolical War Mage
description: Clad in heavy armor and armed with destructive magics, these mages are notorious for annihilating opposing formations on battlefields. They are well versed in spells collected from various sources across Lore.

name: Diabolical Warden
description: Always in an everlasting shift, these overseers will be destined to serve the council and keep their eldritch inmates under control until they take their last breath.

name: Diabolical Witch
description: These demented witches that are alligned with the Diabolical for unknown reasons. Their hexes are known to be quite formidable. (Armor is female art only.)

name: Diabolical Zealot
description: Fanatics, loyal to a fault, these high ranking Diabolical members have proven themselves time and time again that they'll do anything for their cause, no matter how wretched or vile, their actions may be.

name: Diamond Collector of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: A powerful warrior of the Nation, fused with diamonds from the Fiend's Void. Fueld by the crystalized power of the Fiend God, it greedily hunts for more, slowly becoming a walking conduit for the Void. (CC to Accessory)

name: Diamond Collector of Nulgath (AC)
description: A powerful warrior of the Nation, fused with diamonds from the Fiend's Void. Fueld by the crystalized power of the Fiend God, it greedily hunts for more, slowly becoming a walking conduit for the Void. (CC to Accessory)

name: Diamond Dueler
description: Forget Gold… all that glitters is Diamonds! Don the Diamond Dueler armor and show the world how you helped Artix Entertainment recruit 1.3 Million new heroes!

name: Digital ArchFiend DoomLord (Armor)
description: Not even the dark magic of the Shadowscythe is enough to satisfy this soul's lust for power.

name: Digital Dark Caster Armor
description: Channel the power of darkness to unleash your TRUE power!

name: Digital DOOMKnight
description: For those who feel the need to spread digital doom wherever they go!

name: Digital Duality of Nulgath
description: As the General of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you. Whether you choose to use such power for Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: Dilligaf Armor
description: A member of Nulgath's elite executioners, the Dilligafs only seek to add the heads of Dage the Evil's supporters to their collections!

name: Dimensional Champion of Nulgath
description: With this Void Knight breed, all that you know can be changed by jumping through dimensional gates to parallel that hold the reality you prefer! In doing so you can synergize with any element of your choosing! (color custom)

name: Dimmed Falconeer (AC)
description: Can ye hear the song o' the falcons in the dimmed sky, laddie? Ach, course ye can. But can ye sing back? Aye, there's the tricky part.

name: Dimmed Falconeer (Legend)
description: Can ye hear the song o' the falcons in the dimmed sky, laddie? Ach, course ye can. But can ye sing back? Aye, there's the tricky part.

name: Dino Bot
description: It has dinosaurs they said, it'll be fun they said. Boy do I hate being right all the time.

name: DinoMight
description: Barbaric DinoMight warriors explode with a fury of unstoppable vengeance againts the opposition. Word of advice: don't mess with DinoMight!

name: Dire Armor of Na'al
description: You can feel the dark power pulsing off this armor. It is a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Dire Marrowfiend
description: Bones from the monster slayed by Sir Tendeth constructed to form this armor. Marrowfiend's were born from the Tower.

name: Dire Soul Warrior
description: Though you might be able to take a life, the soul will never die!

name: Dire Wolfhound Warrior
description: Wolfhounds are the most loyal warriors in the kingdom. Wearing the Wolf's Head sigil shows that you can be trusted above all else.

name: Dirge Armor
description: Woe unto any who would cross you while wearing this armor! Their families will rend the air with terrible, heart-breaking songs of mouming.

name: Dirt Void of Nulgath
description: Created by Nulgath to infiltrate mountainous zones of Lore without being detected, the Dirt Void blends right in with the rocks.

name: Discarnate Sea Scourge
description: A pirate ship shredded into splinters by cannonfire returns from the great beyond. The crew have lost their taste for gold, seeking to plunder souls from the living.

name: Disciple of Carnax
description: The Alpha are a cult of psionic sorcerers whose leader created Carnax in another timeline. Your task is to do whatever you can to protect and defend this creature… no matter where or when it appears.

name: Discordia Armor
description: Music has the power to change the world. So let's see if it can destroy it, too!

name: Discordian Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Avast! Ye be bettin' out a hearty sea chanty as ye sail, or yer commander will keelhaul you and kick ya out of Discordia's Navy!

name: Discordian Naval Commander (AC)
description: Avast! Ye be bettin' out a hearty sea chanty as ye sail, or yer commander will keelhaul you and kick ya out of Discordia's Navy!

name: Disguised Sepulchure (Temp)
description: *No description*

name: Dishpan Cleric Costume
description: You'll clean up ALL the costume contest rewards in THIS outfit! Cleric Joy would be proud of your commitment to cleanliness and attention to detail.

name: Dissatisfied Corporate Trader Suit
description: ﻿The numbers only go down when it benefits the Chairman. >:D

name: Dissatisfied Trader Hero Suit
description: ﻿﻿Meh. Number go down :(

name: Dissonant Bandmaster
description: Chaotic virtuosos hailing from the same musical pastures as the fallen musical Chaos Lord. Dangerously ambitious, each of these musicians aim to fill the void with their own maddening melodies.

name: Distinguished Royal Weaver
description: Regal and deadly. The look of the Chaos Weaver Queen demands respect. Only those who swear their unwavering alliance are granted such splendor.

name: Divine Guardian Of Aegis
description: Elite wardens of the Celestial Realm, these bright warriors willingly give their lives to defend their people and home. Aegis Guardians must pass a rigorous battery of tests to be allowed entry into this exclusive group.

name: Divine Mantle
description: Mystical threads weave their way through the sublime cloth that surrounds you. Mana energy flows freely in the air around you, and you feel almost… divine.

name: Divine Ocean Nereid (0 AC)
