description: It's easy to mistake these sea spirits for a swimmer visiting the beach. They're denizens of the oceans who protect kind sailors, and ward voracious sea Dragons away.

name: Divine Ocean Nereid (AC)
description: It's easy to mistake these sea spirits for a swimmer visiting the beach. They're denizens of the oceans who protect kind sailors, and ward voracious sea Dragons away.

name: Divine Ox Garments
description: In the Year of the Ox, celebrate diligence, dependability, strength and determination - all the things that make the ox a wonderful creature!

name: Divine Sunstreaker (0 AC)
description: (Owner can click to change and it'll show for everyone else). Elegant swimwear made with soft sunlight. Warmth falls from the sky and seeps into the sea. You are a phoenix gracing the shore.

name: Divine Sunstreaker (AC)
description: (Owner can click to change and it'll show for everyone else). Elegant swimwear made with soft sunlight. Warmth falls from the sky and seeps into the sea. You are a phoenix gracing the shore.

name: Divine Tundra Warlock (0 AC)
description: A mage who made contact with one of the great ancients of the North. Wherever they go, Winter and its bloodthirsty beasts and giants follow. (Fur CC to Accessory)

name: Divine Tundra Warlock (AC)
description: A mage who made contact with one of the great ancients of the North. Wherever they go, Winter and its bloodthirsty beasts and giants follow. (Fur CC to Accessory)

name: Divine Wanderer
description: The bright power emanating from this armor soothes your spirit and renews your flagging energy. It is a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Diviner of Power
description: Holy is the man or woman who can tame the spirits and use them against the enemy. Channel the fury of the spiritual world and wipe out those who stand against you and your allies.

name: Diving Gear
description: A comfortable and durable suit designed to match the colors of the Yuskrtine Coral, you are sure to blend right in. Many hungry eels always stay clear of Yuskrtine Coral. Try not to go swimming with just one flipper. You might end up swimming upside down.

name: Djinn Knight
description: Power and magic… Djinn Knights must possess both if they are to successfully guard the denizens of the Djinn Realm.

name: Djinn Lich
description: Little is known about Zelkur, Lich of the Dream Palace… except that the ShadowHunter desires the Mystic Sapphire he possesses. Rumor has it that the gem contains the essence of his power.

name: Djinn Oracle
description: It is said the oracles of the Djinn Realm can not only SEE into the future, but can also manipulate it. If that is true… do we really control our own fates? It MUST be a rumor.

name: Djinn Realm TechSuit
description: The Pharaoh of the Sandsea commissioned Seabase Undine to develope equipment that would allow his retainers to delve deeper into the Djinn Realm. Amplifying the wearer's magic, the gear routinely purges itself of impurities.

name: Djinn Summoner
description: There are certain individuals who possess power to summon the rare and mighty Djinn. To summon and control a being with such raw strength takes a great amount of power.

name: Djinn Warrior
description: These guardians of the realm serve the Djinn, so they must always present a noble and austere appearance.

name: Doctor Hue
description: RAINBOWS ARE COOL!

name: Doctor What
description: Traveling through space, time, and alternate earths as you defeat your enemies with the power of your unsolvable riddles!

name: Doctor WHOOOOO!
description: Color custom suits are cool!

name: Doctor Why (AC)
description: Question. What happens when a doctor and a master get together? Say something nice to find out.

name: Doctor Why (Legend)
description: Question. What happens when a doctor and a master get together? Say something nice to find out.

name: Dog Dude
description: It is a little known fact that the standard poodle is the dragon's natural enemy.

name: Doom Attendant
description: The mystical feline you serve holds many secrets, and its dragontastic powers may one day save your life! Attend it well and you will be rewarded!

name: Doom Celestial Sandknight
description: The Sandknights are those who devote themselves to the desert and all the life it supports. They maintain order in the lawless desert. Taking up the mantle, you now serve to protect all those who call the Sandsea home.

name: Doom Chaos Symbiote
description: Chaorrupted armor from an unknown origin. The wearer of this armor may not be able to resist the call of Chaos.

name: Doom ClawSuit
description: There's no need to check the list twice when those who are naughty and nice are suffering in the shadows all at once. DOOM for Frostval has arrived!

name: Doom Deadfly
description: Deadfly is always creepin' around the Underworld. When will he figure out that just changing his colors won't fool anyone?

name: Doom Disciple Armor
description: Favored by fans of the ShadowScythe rock group, The Deadly DoomKnights!

name: Doom DragonSlayer
description: These DragonSlayers only work on behalf of the ShadowScythe. If the dragon won't agree to burn on behalf of Empress Gravelyn, they must go!

name: Doom Exosuit Binoku (1)
description: This epically transforming suit will astonish your friends and terrify your foes! Click the different parts of the suit to gain blades, shining runes, or rocky shoulders!

name: Doom Exosuit Binoku (2)
description: This epically transforming suit will astonish your friends and terrify your foes! Click the different parts of the suit to gain blades, shining runes, or rocky shoulders!

name: Doom Genie
description: Embrace the evil within as you assume the form of this corrupted Chaos Djinn!

name: Doom Golden Centurion Armor
description: The Golden Centurions are soldiers from a fabled sunken city. This never before seen armor has been in many battles.

name: Doom Holiday Paragon Plate
description: The jollier side of Dage the Evil. Fond of milk, snickerdoodles, and wrecking the halls.

name: Doom Iced Jester
description: Just because it is cold outside, doesn't mean that we can't have a laugh or two. Of course, that laughter is at the expense of the enemies you take down in this armor.

name: Doom Karma Army
description: Free will is just an illusion, because once you cross paths with the Karma Army, choosing to live with be out of your hands. Hope those "good deeds" that you have been performing finally pays off for you.

name: Doom Lord Drakonnan
description: When a ruler is far from human and possesses an insatiable hunger of the dark arts, their reign of terror lasts forever unless a brave hunter puts them out of their concealed misery.

name: Doom Lord Sepulchure
description: When a ruler is far from human and possesses an insatiable hunger of the dark arts, their reign of terror lasts forever unless a brave hunter puts them out of their concealed mystery.

name: Doom Lord Vaal and Vayle (Legend)
description: When a ruler is far from human and possesses an insatiable hunger of the dark arts, their reign of terror lasts forever unless a brave hunter puts them out of their concealed misery.

name: Doom Lord Vaal and Vayle (Non-Legend)
description: When a ruler is far from human and possesses an insatiable hunger of the dark arts, their reign of terror lasts forever unless a brave hunter puts them out of their concealed misery.

name: Doom Lord Valtrith and Safiria
description: When a ruler is far from human and possesses an insatiable hunger of the dark arts, their reign of terror lasts forever unless a brave hunter puts them out of their concealed misery.

name: Doom Lord Vordred
description: Channel Vordred's endless hatred with this terrifying armor. Who needs more skulls when you have DOOM?

name: Doom Lycan Armor
description: Charroupted creatures don't have fleas, right? Let's hope not… because Aria's Pet Shop is all out of flea collars!

name: Doom Lycan Transformation
description: Purebred Lycans can transform at will. You now harness this amazing power! Simply click to transform between Lycan forms.

name: Doom Madness of Chaos
description: You cannot bring order out of Chaos. Chaos is complete insanity. And that madness has taken you over.

name: Doom Midknightgown
description: Ooo la la! Who says Doom Knights can't be adorable? The Doomknightgown was a gift from our fellow player SUBMEOBI and comes equipped with the pink bunny Slippers of DOOM! Warning: Doomknightgown will give you an hourglass frame no matter your gender!

name: Doom Naval Commander
description: The highest ranking captain of all. Take control of the helm.

name: Doom Necronaut
description: The armor of a Necronaut is the only thing that protects them from the ravages of being alive in the afterlife… it does its job. Sometimes. And sometimes it fails.

name: Doom Ninja Warrior
description: A true Ninja Warrior knows that you only fail when you stop trying.

name: Doom of Lore
description: You are NOT the savior of Lore… you are its DOOM!

name: Doom Phoenix Away Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Doom Phoenix Away Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Doom Phoenix Plate
description: The Swordhaven elite veteran warriors are given the Phoenix Plate when they have shown their acts of heroism time and time again.

name: Doom Phoenix Reborn Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Doom Phoenix Reborn Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Doom Phoenix Rush Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Doom Phoenix Rush Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Doom Phoenix Varsity Team
description: Rah rah rah! Go DoomPhoenix!

name: Doom Pirate Captain
description: Arrrrrrrr… you be the captain of this here ship!

name: Doom Prismatic Composer Armor
description: Orchestrate your own band of terror in a fully color custom Composer Armor! Never miss a beat…down!

name: DOOM Pumpkin Lord
description: Pumpkin lords are evil magical pumpkins that are a lot more menacing than the name suggests. Now with 100% more DOOOOOOM!

name: Doom Realm Guardian
description: You have defended the area outside Swordhaven valiantly! King Alteon the Good thanks you, and wishes to reward you with this armor.

name: Doom Rook
description: Rooks take many forms in this ancient game. Sometimes they were depicted as berserkers. Sometimes, castles. But whatever they're incarnation, they are meant to seem unstoppable.

name: Doom Rotting Naval Commander
description: Dead men tell no tales. Except in this case, where it seems you have managed to escape Davy Jones' Locker. Yaaar!

name: Doom Shadowscythe Mecha Suit
description: So mysterious! So otherworldly! Should this even be here?

name: Doom Shielded Centurion Armor
description: The Golden Centurions are soldiers from a fabled sunken city. Thier shields were said to even withstand even magical arrows.

name: Doom Souleater Warrior
description: These wretched creatures hunt and devour the souls of their enemies which sustains their power. Though they come in many shapes and sizes, their hunger for souls is the same. To become a Souleater is to receive great power but at the cost of becoming a terrible monster. (color custom eyes )

name: Doom Toga
description: Ideal for parties, formal speeches, or ruling an empire.

name: Doom Trislayer
description: This armor shows that you have slain Trigoras, the great three-headed dragon!

name: Doom Vampire Transformation
description: Full-blooded Vampires can transform at will. You now harness this amazing powers! Simply click to transform to Vampiric forms

name: DoomBringer (Armor)
description: Beyond death, beyond destruction, there is… the DoomBringer!

name: DoomBunny
description: Beware, oh beware. For the Bunny of Doom does is very unhoppy with you, Hero!

name: DoomDragon Mount
description: Take to the skies in fiendish style. Only ones who are direct descendants of the DoomDragon Mother can tame these legendary beasts.

name: DoomDragon Rider
description: Take to the skies in fiendish style. Only ones who are direct descendants of the DoomDragon Mother can tame these legendary beasts.

name: DoomDragon's Master Mount
description: I take to the skies in a fiendish style. Only ones who are direct descendants of the DoomDragon Mother can tame these legendary beasts.

name: Doomed Camlan Warden
description: For generations, the High Elves of Camlan were denied their right to power and Lore. Doom seeps into their veins, promising it all and more. They cast aside their loyalty to Light and its Champion to attain crowns for themselves.

name: Doomed DeckStalker
description: Once simple pirates these now cursed souls sail the darkest deeps of the seas looking for souls to harvest.

name: Doomed Dracolich Clawsuit
description: This generous gift giver is willing to give nasty little brats whatever their hearts desire…in exchange for some bones.

name: Doomed Mage
description: This soul-chilling armor has traces of extraterrestrial energy seeping through it, inducing power-hungry desires.

name: Doomed Metamorphosis Knight
description: Dryden gave himself to the Doom Triad, and his flesh was stripped away. The Metamorphosis Maw's cold Shadow envelops him, transforming the young man into its Champion. He has yet to reach his full potential.

name: Doomed Metamorphosis' Loyal Knight
description: Dryden gave himself to the Doom Triad, and his flesh was stripped away. The Metamorphosis Maw's cold Shadow envelops him, transforming the young man into its Champion. He has yet to reach his full potential.

name: DOOMED Monster Lord
description: Only the bravest heroes who have battled and defeated all of Lore's many monsters may called themselves true Monster Lords.

name: Doomed Ranger
description: This soul-chilling armor has traces of extraterrestrial energy seeping through it, inducing power-hungry desires.

name: Doomed Valen (Temp)
description: *No description*

name: Doomed Warrior
description: This soul-chilling armor has traces of extraterrestrial energy seeping through it, inducing power-hungry desires.

name: DoomFiend of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Wrested from the Shadows, these creatures now serve the Archfiend Nulgath. Veins and muscle grew where the Shadows once gnawed, birthing new malicious power.

name: DoomFiend of Nulgath (AC)
description: Wrested from the Shadows, these creatures now serve the Archfiend Nulgath. Veins and muscle grew where the Shadows once gnawed, birthing new malicious power.

name: DoomFiend Overlord of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: DoomFiend Overlords are entrusted by Nulgath to command entire legions of lesser warriors due to their skill, strength, and sheer power.

name: DoomFiend Overlord of Nulgath (AC)
description: DoomFiend Overlords are entrusted by Nulgath to command entire legions of lesser warriors due to their skill, strength, and sheer power.

name: DoomFire Club Shirt
description: Everyone keeps thinking you belong to some sort of baseball team.

name: DOOMFire Guard (Armor)
description: Those sworn to protect the Empress are held in elite status in Shadowfall, they've given their own soul to the Shadowscythe

name: DOOMFire OF Gravelyn
description: A Dark Lord whose strength taps into the Plane of Darkness and possibly the Void are able to keep their armies loyal and strong while they carry absolute power in their legions. Such battle armor is NOT just for scare.

name: DOOMFire Warrior (Armor)
description: As a thanks for your eternal servitude to the Shadowscythe Empire, Gravelyn has rewarded with a replica of her powerful, but venomous armor. You've made her proud!

name: DoomFluffy Rider
description: Take to the skies in fiendish style. Only ones who are direct descendants of the DoomDragon Mother can tame these legendary beasts.

name: DoomKnight Armor
description: The Doomknight shows little sympathy for the living. Not even death could stop your destructive rampage (Requires Rank 10 Evil)

name: Doomknight Battlemage
description: Much like their Royal counterparts, DoomKnight BattleMages are spellswords, enchanting the weapon the use. However, they are not bound by any code and usually appear more as rogue fighters. (3% chance to do shadowburst animation and 15% rep boost)

name: DoomKnight DoomCaster
description: As rarely-seen type of wizards in the Shadowscythe army, Doom Casters are often known for their craft in quickly changing the seasons of the worst to curry their favor. This dangerous power is why only a handful is left to serve their Empress. Suggested by AQW player Lilith!

name: DoomKnight Mech Guard
description: Every mech requires guards to prevent sabotage (and DOOM) from enemies.

name: DoomKnight Naval Commander
description: These bilge rat's fly under the colors of the Shadowscythe. Instead of "shiver me timbers", they cry "LONG BE UN-LIVIN' THE SHADOWSCYTHE!"

name: DoomKnight OverLord Armor
description: You can feel the chill of the armor from across the room. Darkness seems to gather around it. But nothing can prepare you for the FEELING the darkness itself when you put it on.

name: DoomKnight Prime (Armor)
description: Feared throughout the history of time, the Doom Knight shows little remorse for the living. Sympathy is only derived from brute force. (Cannot be sold, unlocks a set of gear in /Camlan)

name: Doomknight Shadowmage
description: Brethren to the DoomKnight BattleMages, the ShadowMage dives deeper into the macabre and otherworldly styles of enchanting. (3% chance to do the smokebomb animation, and 5% XP boost)

name: DoomKnight Titan
description: NO FORCE ON THIS WORLD CAN DESTROY WHAT I AM! LONG UNLIVE THE SHADOWSCYTHE!!!!!!

name: Doomknight Tyrant
description: Devastatingly powerful, a Shadowscythe General of this caliber has the might to test even the former Emperor's authority. Through battle and bloodshed, order is maintained in darkness.

name: DoomKnightgown
description: Ooo la la! Who says Doom Knights can't be adorable? The DoomKnightgown was a gift from our fellow player SUBMEOBI and comes equipped with the Pink Bunny Slippers of DOOM! Warning: DoomKnightgown will give you an hourglass frame no matter your gender!

name: Doomlight Highlord
description: One of the most powerful and high ranking members of Empress Gravelyn’s Lightscythe Army. LONG LIVE THE LIGHTSCYTHE!

name: DoomLord Valtrith and Safiria (0 AC)
description: The battles to lay claim to the dark has endured for centuries. As the Queen of Vampires oversees eternity, the darkness of the mortal soul grows.

name: DoomLord Valtrith and Safiria (AC)
description: The battles to lay claim to the dark has endured for centuries. As the Queen of Vampires oversees eternity, the darkness of the mortal soul grows.

name: DoomMaster
description: Some are chosen to undergo even further changes - the Deadtech has taken almost full hold of them. Who knows how much more they can handle.

name: DoomTech DoomKnight
description: A new generation of DoomKnight emerges from the Empire's forges. The armor grafted to the bodies of the Doomknights doesn't just enhance their power, it whispers and guides blades to brutal victory.

name: DoomTech Fleet Commander
description: YARRRR! Hoist th' Pirate Flags of DOOOOOM and terrify your enemies no matter where you face them: on land, by sea, or sailing the dark waters of the underworld!

name: DoomTech Pirate Commander
description: YARRRR! Hoist th' Pirate Flags of DOOOOOM and terrify your enemies no matter where you face them: on land, by sea, or sailing the dark waters of the underworld!

name: Doomwood Caffiends
description: You know the best thing for keeping your energy up after a long day of football practice? A Trenta Spike Place Dark Roast. (This team's games are sponsored by Scarbucks. Find a store near you in Doomwood's Chopping Maul!)

name: DoomWood DragonKnight (0 AC)
description: This dark creature was a Celestial Dragon Rider, until Necromancers used their dark magic to reanimate the fallen warrior. It joins Vordred the PaladinSlayer as one of Doomwood's deadliest creations.

name: DoomWood DragonKnight (AC)
description: This dark creature was a Celestial Dragon Rider, until Necromancers used their dark magic to reanimate the fallen Warrior. It joins Vordred the PaladinSlayer as one of DoomWood's deadliest creations.

name: Dorian and Dorothy
description: A totally adorable outfit for any young woman trying to find her way back home. Guys can wear this too… but, um that's your own call. I'm not one to judge, I just write the item descriptions.

name: Dr. Dryden Darkwood's Suit
description: The perfect look for a Purveyor of Fine Antiques, and fancy parties too!

name: Dr. Eisenbacke (Armor)
description: Remember, just because you're dressed up like a mad scientist doesn't mean you have to go around freeze-raying people.

name: Dr. When
description: What's this? WHO am I? I'm trapped in between regenerations! Pinstripes are cool.

name: Dr. Why
description: What's this? WHO am I? I'm trapped in between regenerations! Pinstripes are cool.

name: Draco Tenebris
description: These creatures prefer the pitch black to any light source. Found deep in caverns and caves, they are able to surprise any enemy as they hunt in the shadows.

name: DracoGrenwog Slayer
description: Beasts have always evolved, and now they've begun to fuse! Warriors have to evolve with them. The DracoGrenwog Slayers are experienced with Dragons, but are still learning how to pit their fists against the Grenwogs'.

name: Dracolich Destroyer
description: Save them? No the only way to stop the dragons is to destroy the Dragons. We must fight them!

name: Dracolich Kigurumi
description: The Chickenlord knows just how much comfort a costume can bring to young and old alike… though he never says what comfort it brings him. This costume, as opposed to its giant unlife counterpart, stays warm even during the coldest mogloween night.

name: Dracolich Lord (Armor)
description: The Dracolich Lord conquers death alongside their skeletal partner. Rumors say they were one of the first Dragonlords who now lurks in a hidden city ruled by dragons that refuse to pass on.

name: DracolichRider Zorbak
description: Meh. I've been raising and training dracoliches since DragonFable was a thing. It's about time I was able to ride one. Death from above is imminent! Mehehehehe.

name: DracoMori
description: These warriors, loyal to the dragon Gorgorath, craft their armors with the bones of the dragon's prey.

name: Draconic Acolyte
description: Using the fumes deep within the caverns of Lore to enhance their Sight, the Draconic Acolyte's can share glimpses of the future with you.

name: Draconic Chronomancer
description: Draconic Chronomancers control the flow of time, causing it to circle back upon itself to make changes to the past… and future.

name: Draconic Cuirass
description: Sturdy armor intended for jacks of all trades, calling to mind the diverse range of Dragons that exist in Lore. As their steel racks up scars, factions will fight for their attention.

name: Draconic Deacon of Nulgath (AC)
description: Members of the Nation follow different paths of transformation. These disciples will become their Master's dragons, earning might and majesty indicative of invincible beasts.

name: Draconic Deacon of Nulgath (Legend)
description: Members of the Nation follow different paths of transformation. These disciples will become their Master's dragons, earning might and majesty indicative of invincible beasts.

name: Draconic Disciple of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Members of the Nation follow different paths of transformation. These disciples will become their Master's dragons, earning might and majesty indicative of invincible beasts. (Item is CC)

name: Draconic Disciple of Nulgath (AC)
description: Members of the Nation follow different paths of transformation. These disciples will become their Master's dragons, earning might and majesty indicative of invincible beasts. (Item is CC)

name: Draconic DoomKnight (Armor)
description: What can you do to make DoomKnights even cooler than they already are? Add dragons.

name: Draconic Oracle
description: Using the fumes deep within the caverns of Lore to enhance their Sight, the Draconic Oracles can share glimpses of the future with you.

name: Draconic Paragon Plate
description: Not many dragons exist in the Underworld but a few must be wrangled by the most fierce dragon warriors in the Legion.

name: Draconic Warlock
description: Dragons and magic? What could possibly be cooler then that!

name: Draconic Yokai Assassin
description: Members of the jizamural families hidden in the Yokai Isles are assassins that are as fast as the wind, and can be just as invisible. Their inhuman skills come from drinking dragon blood. (Item is CC)

name: Dragao da Independencia
description: Dragao da Independência, unite! Obrigado, Brasil! Happy Brasilian Independence Day!

name: Dragarian
description: Rugged strength just pours forth from this armor. Anyone wearing it will feel the confidence of the greatest warrior permeat his or her body, readying them for combat.

name: Drago's Attire
description: The attire of King Drago. Due to his nature, these white clothes are usually stained red. The maids are very troubled on laundry day.

name: Drago's Cloaked Attire
description: The attire of King Drago. Due to his nature, these white clothes are usually stained red. The maids are very troubled on laundry day.

name: Drago's Royal Guard
description: Traditions have changed since the executions of the former heads of the Royal Guard. With Drago's Ascension, he outfitted his loyalists with gold vambraces, reflecting the decadence of his loyalists.

name: Dragon Admiral
description: The Dragon fleet is one of the most feared fleet in the skies. The fleet earned their name after burning their competition out of the skies with their fame cannons!

name: Dragon Champion (Armor)
description: You are the champion of Dragons… all shall bow before you!

name: Dragon Commander (Armor)
description: You are the commander of Dragons… all shall bow before you!

name: Dragon Disciple Armor
description: Favored by fans of the hit Dragonslayer rock group, DragonCORE!

name: Dragon Emperor (Armor)
description: Lurking in the shadows or concealing yourself in the dark, you're the most dangerous when not visible to others. Armor is color-customizable.

name: Dragon Fiend Ronin (0 AC)
description: Warriors of the Nation that have settled their contract with the ArchFiend. Now, they roam to cut down greater and greater opponents. Their appetite for battle rivals the Void's.

name: Dragon Fiend Ronin (AC)
description: Warriors of the Nation that have settled their contract with the ArchFiend. Now, they roam to cut down greater and greater opponents. Their appetite for battle rivals the Void's.

name: Dragon Floaties Armor
description: Stay afloat and fierce with inflatable dragon wings! Crafted to stay inflated even in the fiery currents of Burning Beach, they're proof you can swim AND slay in style.

name: Dragon Hero Armor
description: The greatest Heroes of Lore embrace the power, strength, and intelligence of the might Dragon race. Channeling the Dragon spirit, they find themselves able to overcome any force that would oppose them!

name: Dragon Hunter (Armor)
description: This dragon fight cannot drag on any longer! Harness the Dragon's imperial power and incomparable strength as you unleash the Dragon Hunter within! Color Customizable to your Base and Trim color, too!

name: Dragon Khan Rider
description: Although not everyone realizes this, the Khan is the dragon, not the little guy riding on his back.

name: Dragon Kigurumi
description: The Chickenlord knows just how much comfort a costume can bring to young and old alike… though he never says what comfort it brings him. In this costume, you can pretend to be a slumbering dragon sleeping atop a hoard of pillows.

name: Dragon Knight (Armor)
description: Battle monsters, break gems, and get ALL the rewards in AQWorlds AND Battle Gems!

name: Dragon Morph (Armor)
description: *No description*

name: Dragon of Light (Armor)
description: Like mortals, dragons drawn to serve the Light are infused with power that can never be overshadowed by the darkness.

name: Dragon of Time Armor
description: The Eternal Dragon of Time is one of the most powerful beings Lore has ever seen. Torn by war, corrupted by Chaos, and reborn anew to walk Lore once more - wield the power wisely.

name: Dragon Priests
description: While there are many who hunt dragons because of fear, fame and fortune, there are these who see these creatures as beautiful and majestic gifts that Lore has to offer. The Dragon Priests still belive that these animals can bring peace and balance to Lore.

name: Dragon Prince
description: The Dragon Princes of the Djinn Realm are feared among all of the draconic species on Lore. They possess a power rarely seen in our world… and not at all understood.

name: Dragon Rider
description: Why ride a horse, hitch a ride on a chariot, or book it on foot when you can ride a DRAGON. Battling just got better, ladies and gentlemen. Much better.

name: Dragon Rogue
description: The malevolent lava dragon Dargon reminds you, if you disobey you'll taste delicious with ketchup.

name: Dragon's Envy Armor
description: When the armor was commissioned, a simple note was left with the designs. "May all those who wear this armor know the might of another's envy, and use envy's power to cut down all that stand in the way."

name: Dragon's Salvation
description: Bestowed only to those who have shown their worth in the protection and preservation of Dragons. Wear this armor proudly, you've shown your allegiance.

name: Dragon Samurai (1)
description: The DarGon Dynasty gave rise to these most noble of warriors.

name: Dragon Samurai (2)
description: An elegant kimono for a more civilized age.

name: Dragon Self
description: After the Embero Spell was cast, it was revealed that your true inner from is that of a red dragon! You have a shining inner spirit and can channel the fury of centuries. Both powerful and wise, heroes fear and admire you.

name: Dragon Shinobi Armor (AC)
description: Ninjas are hailed for their dexterity. Dragons are praised for their strength. And when the Ninja trains in the way of the Dragon, they shall become the Dragon Shinobi, master of brutal warfare!

name: Dragon Shinobi Armor (Merge)
description: Ninjas are hailed for their dexterity. Dragons are praised for their strength. And when the Ninja trains in the way of the Dragon, they shall become the Dragon Shinobi, master of brutal warfare!

name: Dragon Stormrunner
description: Garbed in this armor, you can face a flight of dragons or the fiercest storm without fear or hope of defeat!

name: Dragon Summoner (Armor)
description: There's never a bad time to have a dragon on you and with this armor he's always close by, ready to spring into action. Just make sure you have plenty of food on you.

name: Dragon Summoner of the Oversoul (0 AC)
description: The monstrosities called from the Dark Abyss by these summoners are creations of conquest, meant to devour and replace Lore's ruling predators.

name: Dragon Summoner of the Oversoul (AC)
description: The monstrosities called from the Dark Abyss by these summoners are creations of conquest, meant to devour and replace Lore's ruling predators.

name: Dragon Tamer of Tercessuinotlim (0 AC)
description: The mountains where Nulgath has created his fortress are filled with various Dragons, Wyrms, and assorted other creatures. Unlike the DragonSlayers, these Dragon Tamers do not kill these creatures, but tame them to their will. Probably so they can set them upon all of Nulgath's enemies.

name: Dragon Tamer of Tercessuinotlim (AC)
description: The mountains where Nulgath has created his fortress are filled with various Dragons, Wyrms and assorted other creatures. Unlike the DragonSlayers, these Dragon Tamers do not kill these creatures, but tame them.

name: Dragonbone Necromancer
description: Hiding in the darkness, murmuring spells, these Necromancers combine their power with the souls of Dragons. Truly a force to be reckoned with.

name: DragonClaw Guard
description: Harness the power of the Dragon and unleash your mammoth might upon the world! Victory is yours for the taking as the legendary DragonClaw!

name: DragonCrest Seeker
description: These seekers are former Dragonlords or individuals who couldn't bond with a Dragon. To keep their stories from ending with despair, they're set on a new journey - to find Dragons as lost as they are.

name: DragonFable's Blue Mage
description: Robes of the Blue Mage. Jimmy the Eye sold separately.

name: DragonFable Shirt
description: DragonFable Shirt - 103% Cotton-poly blend Artix Ent shirts will NOT protect you from fire orbs, fluffiness or exiled princes. They WILL protect you from lack of style and bad fashion choices.

name: DragonFiend Rider
description: When riding into battle, the glowing carapace of your dragon's armor lets your enemies know they're about to fight a minion of the Archfiend.

name: DragonFlame Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: RAWWWWR! Ye'll scorch any landlubbers who oppose ye. If'n they don't flee in fear at th' sight o' yer burnin' banner and flamin' cannons.

name: DragonFlame Pirate Captain (AC)
description: RAWWWWR! Ye'll scorch any landlubbers who oppose ye. If'n they don't flee in fear at th' sight o' yer burnin' banner and flamin' cannons.

name: DragonKing Warrior
description: An obsidian, gold-trimmed plate of armor that was crafted in the days of King Slugwrath's reign. It is stylized to treat you as a living weapon against a dragon because swords are sometimes insufficient.

name: DragonKnight
description: Hailing from the land of the dragons, the Dragon Lord Knights protect and serve the people of the land. It's by their blade that anyone who shall try to cause harm will suffer!

name: DragonKnight of Madness
description: Dragons have abandoned Astravia, or were wiped out completely. Astravans who are descendants of the land's ancient Dragonlords sought justice, and gave themselves to madness.

name: Dragonlord Armor
description: Dragonlords are elite warriors who have a strong spiritual bond with their dragon allies. When facing a Dragonlord, you'd better be skilled at dragonslaying too. ( color customizable )

name: DragonLord Grandmaster
description: To become a GrandMaster it takes skill, a cunning eye, a sharp blade and a good fire retardant armor.

name: DragonLord Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Yarrrr! Most landlubbers never hear of th' fleet o' ships the DragonLords command. But with their dragon companions, they be fearsome fighters, on land, sea, AND air.

name: DragonLord Naval Commander (AC)
description: Yarrrr! Most landlubbers never hear of th' fleet o' ships the DragonLords command. But with their dragon companions, they be fearsome fighters, on land, sea, AND air.

name: Dragonlord of Chaos
description: Chaotic Dragonlords are as rare as they are feared. Chaorruption seeps into their partners, becoming poison to competing dragons. Even weak dragons, when blessed with chaos, gain the strength to free themselves from the draconic chain of order.

name: Dragonlord of Evil
description: These Dragonlords and their dragons share a common goal - total domination over their enemies. Greed is drive and wrath is strength. The most dangerous qualities of a fell dragon are shared with their partners.

name: Dragonlord of Good
description: Dragonlords that proudly wear the colors of Swordhaven and carry the legacy of its beloved late Queen. They and their dragons strive to become symbols of hope for the downtrodden and left behind.

name: Dragonlord Original
description: For those that like the old version.

name: DragonLord Prime
description: Dragonlords are elite warriors who have a strong spiritual bond with their dragon allies. When facing a Dragonlord, you'd better be skilled at dragonslaying too. Unlocked by purchasing a Dragon Amulet package in DragonFable.

name: DragonMage of Time
description: Once upon another time, or perhaps in the near future, the Eternal Sovereign's name will both be lauded and held with contempt. The Guards stand against those who seek the silent oblivion.

name: DragonMaster Stonescythe (Armor)
description: Leader of renowned DragonMaster's, you must protect the 12 dragons that the prophet spoke about, or else destructive will arise.

name: DragonRider Twilly
description: Twilly LUVS dragons, and riding them is the BEST THING EVER! Skyhealing 4EVA!

name: DragonRune SpellSmith (AC)
description: It takes deep concentration to harness the elements used to make the weapons for a SpellSmith, do you have what it takes?

name: DragonRune SpellSmith (Legend)
description: It takes deep concentration to harness the elements used to make the weapons for a SpellSmith, do you have what it takes?

name: DragonSkull Warrior
description: A clan of barbaric warriors living in Vasalkar Lair long ago had become fond of the intact dragon skulls found around the caves, and therefore, had used them as gauntlets to treat their blades like dragon fire.

name: Dragonslayer Armor
description: Dragonslay On!

name: DragonSlayer General Armor
description: Be very, very quiet. I'm hunting Dragons!!

name: DragonSlayer Guard
description: With constant attacks from dragons, these guards devote their lives to protecting Ashfall.

name: DragonSlayer Inquisitor
description: Achievement Tracker - 3 Year Membership

name: Dragonslayer LoreMaster
description: These LoreMaster's study everything on dragons so slayers will have all the necessary means to defeat them.

name: DragonSlayer Recruit
description: Hate dragons? Did one burn down your house? Does the name Targaryan cause rage? Then you've joined the right squad!

name: DragonSlayer's Solace
description: Mieteor, a valiant and honest armorer for the Order of DragonSlayers, has design designed this armor to comfort and console the friends of Slayers, who have fallen in battle to those nefarious wyrms.

name: Dragonslayer Slayer
description: The dark depths of pits and shadows come beasts prepared to rip anyone who dares attack dragons. DragonSlayer's consider this a warning.

name: DragonSlaying Gunslinger
description: Slaying dragons… with guns?! Now THAT is a new kind of hero.

name: Dragonsloss Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Yarrr! It be wise t' have a battle-ready companion to guard yer back. If'n ye don't, ye'll need t' rely on yer own battle skills.

name: Dragonsloss Naval Commander (AC)
description: Yarrr! It be wise t' have a battle-ready companion to guard yer back. If'n ye don't, ye'll need t' rely on yer own battle skills.

name: DragonSoul Shinobi (Armor)
description: Ninjas are hailed for their dexterity. Dragons are praised for their strength. And when the Ninja trains in the way of the Dragon, they shall become the Dragon Shinobi, master of brutal warfare!

name: Dragonsworn Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Yarrr! It be wise t' have a battle-ready companion to guard yer back. An' even better if th' creature can breathe fire.

name: Dragonsworn Naval Commander (AC)
description: Yarrr! It be wise t' have a battle-ready companion to guard yer back. An' even better if th' creature can breathe fire.

name: Dragontamer
description: Dragontamer!

name: Dragonwarrior of the Dark
description: Lurking in the shadows or concealing yourself in the dark, you're the most dangerous when not visible to others. Armor is CC.

name: Drakath Armor (Permanent)
description: Chaos reigns?? HAHAHAHAHAAAA! This armor is PROOF you've taken down the Champion of Chaos!

name: Drakath Armor (Temporary)
description: Play AS Drakath to complete his journey to become the Champion of Chaos!

name: Drakath Maul
description: Shunned by Light and Dark, the Sufferer walks te path between in solitude. A force beyond the fourth twisted their ambitions and despair into something truly monstrous.

name: Drakath the Eternal
description: I guess some things ARE fated after all.. it does not matter which shard you visit, Drakath always ends up the same way. The path may be different, but the result remains the same. (Item does 30% more damage to Chaos when equipped)

name: Drakel Chud Armor
description: One of Chud's favorite activities is to squish things whether they animate or not. This past time would eventually stick when he gets competitive and has his eyes for the prize. Anyone who dares to challenge would risk coming home with a memorable splat.

name: Drakel Gall Armor
description: Different from the other challengers, Gall, a rare albino drakel, is more then ready to demonstrate he means business one way or the other and forfeit is never one of them.

name: Drakel Gall Armor (Green)
description: Different from the other challengers, Gall, a rare albino drakel, is more then ready to demonstrate he means business one way or the other and forfeit is never one of them.

name: Drakel Hun'Gar Armor
description: Hun'Gar isn't called the Boulder for nothing. His brutal, inhuman strength could knock his foes off the ground before striking them as if he is an earthquake. With no stone going unturned, none will be safe from this aggressive fighter.

name: Drakel Velm Armor
description: Velm is the type of fighter who would face his foes head-on without a doubt. His enthusiasm for a tough battle never leaves his draconic body.

name: Drakel Warlord Armor
description: If it's a fight to the death you want, then a fight you shall get!

name: Drakel Warmonger
description: Might makes right. A simple tenant the Drakel stand by. The self-proclaimed warmongers are the first to lead a charge, pointing their brethren in the direction with the most bloodshed.

name: Drakon Warmage Armor
description: Drakon Warmages are a very special breed of combatants. Wielding the forces of mighty and mysterious magics, their enemies fear to cross them! Crafted by XDamian.

name: Drakonnan (Armor)
description: The armor of the villainous fiend who caused so much destruction in the Fire War

name: Drakonus Armor
description: These robes once belonged to the forgotten arts of the Quantum Mage. Inspired by player Drakonus.

name: Dramatic Royal Outfit
description: *Sings* Who runs the world? GIR -- *cough*

name: Dravir Armor
description: A scaly armor that has been recreated from samples obtained from the Lore of DragonFable, that was worn by the Dravir Soldiers. These fierce warriors thirst for their enemies flesh!

name: Dread Bounty Hunter
description: The real wild west is out in Doomwood and Darkovia, where silver's a need instead of a luxury. These gunslingers ride after the dead, with the dead, until they're dead.

name: Dread Captain (AC)
description: Being a captain has perks like your own hat, pistol and making crew walk the plank.

name: Dread Captain (Merge)
description: Being a captain has perks like your own hat, pistol and making crew walk the plank.

name: Dread Crewmember (AC)
description: Aye ye scurry landlubber, better get this ship saillin' before the captain makes ye swab the deck or worse.

name: Dread Crewmember (Merge)
description: Are ya scurry landlubber, better get this ship saillin' before the captain makes ye swab the deck or worse.

name: Dread Dead Gunslinger
description: The real wild west is out in Doomwood and Darkovia, where silver's a need instead of a luxury. These gunslingers ride after the dead, with the dead, until they're dead.

name: Dread Dragon Savior
description: The righteous clad in scales of deep ruby. Dragons who stand for the weak and trapped need not live long, but become immortal through the lives they save.

name: Dread Gunslinger
description: The real wild west is out in Doomwood and Darkovia, where silver's a need instead of a luxury. These gunslingers ride after the dead, with the dead, until they're dead.

name: Dread Intruder
description: When law makers want a way to get past their own rules, they dig up the black files. A dreaded weapon for hire to deal with the dirty laundry.

name: Dread Knight Armor
description: When one achieves enough infamy, the dread and fear of the people turn into awe and fascination.

name: Dread Knight of the Underworld (0 AC)
description: Dage the Evil sends his Dark Knights forth to terrorize the good and lure the wicked to his realm. The most skilled may prove strong enough to join the Undead Legion.

name: Dread Knight of the Underworld (AC)
description: Dage the Evil sends his Dark Knights forth to terrorize the good and lure the wicked to his realm. The most skilled may prove strong enough to join the Undead Legion.

name: Dread Leopard Gryphon
description: These majestic Gryphons are the perfect ride for any Hero on land or in the air.

name: Dread Leopard Guard
description: So you want to tame a creature that's half lion half eagle? Only the best get the title of "Rider". Hang on!

name: Dread Leopard Rider
description: These majestic Gryphons are the perfect ride for any Hero.

name: Dread Nachtdurst (0 AC)
description: Night terrors that prey on their fellow beasts. Even the Vampires and Lich fear them. These creatures feed on the risen dead, gaining cursed power with every bone they crunch with their back teeth.

name: Dread Nachtdurst (AC)
description: Night terrors that prey on their fellow beasts. Even the Vampires and Lich fear them. These creatures feed on the risen dead, gaining cursed power with every bone they crunch with their back teeth.

name: Dread Nachtdurst (Legend)
description: Night terrors that prey on their fellow beasts. Even the Vampires and Liches fear them. These creatures feed on the risen dead, gaining cursed power with every bone they crunch with their back teeth.

name: Dread Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: What do you mean I can't sail the seven seas? Inconceivable!

name: Dread Pirate Captain (AC)
description: What do you mean I can't sail the seven seas? Inconceivable!

name: Dread Shadow Pirate
description: Sleep well and do good work as the Dread Shadow Pirate will most likely kill you in the morning.

name: Dread Spirit Hunter
description: These Mysterious SpiritHunters are rumored to be sent from the depths of Bludrut Keep to purge the land of evil entities and to safeguard against supernatural forces that threaten the realm. Even the Shadowscythe fear to travel near Bludrut Keep.

name: Dreaded Dzeza Magus
description: A spore floated across the vast fathoms of the outer void, coming to rest in the palm of a magus living on Lore. Eyes bloomed across their skin, allowing a ravenous god to grant its new follower with eldritch power.

name: Dreadfiend of Nulgath (Armor)
description: When you /equip this armor and battle to serve Nulgath the Archfiend, your enemies hearts will fill with Dread. You are his most fiendish servant and in this gear, you look it!

name: DreadForce Mercenary
description: A new job just came in. Employ a combination of combat skill and proffesional yapping to take down your targets.

name: DreadFrost Cavalry of Nulgath
description: Cold is emptiness. Eventually, everything in the universe will go still. This is a future even the God of Fiends scorns. Nulgath created these Fiends in the Void for a reason. Should he fall, they will emerge from his corpse and ensure that the universe falls with him.

name: Dreadful Gothic Villager
description: Villagers that hide a deadly secret in their hollow hearts. Their cemetery's full, but the coffins are empty.

name: Dreadful Victorian Garb
description: One must be properly attired, even after death. You uphold your family's name and honor in this outfit.

name: Dreadhaven General +5
description: The best of the best. No one messes with you, or they get an axe to the face.

name: Dreadhaven General (Armor)
description: The best of the best. No one messes with you, or they get an axe to the face.

name: Dreadhaven Knight
description: Loyal knights of King Slugwraith. They defend the city of Dreadhaven.

name: Dreadhaven Knight +5
description: Loyal knights of King Slugwraith. They defend the city of Dreadhaven.

name: Dreadhaven Rogue
description: It's simply DREADFUL when you stab people in the back? No? Oh. Right then!

name: Dreadnought
description: A Dreadnought is an unstoppable engine of warfare. Nothing can withstand the force present in the magically reenforced armor. Click on the hand or shoulder to activate rune shields that only you can see!

name: Dream Palace Formal Attire
description: Formal attire fitted for the marriage of a Djinn Realm Guardian and a Princess. When they're together, they're more mesmerizing than the moon.

name: Dream Palace Guard
description: (Female art only)Found only in the Sandsea, these warrior women have become the favored of Zahad, chosen to guard his innermost sanctum.

name: Dream Plate
description: One of the most dreamy armors available, this plate armor exists only to bring help and hope to your allies.

name: Dream Slayer
description: When nightmares become real… they are often seen wearing this armor.

name: DreamEater
description: Inspired by Memet The Nightmare Moglin, the DreamEater is still a force to be reckoned with. Don't feed after midnight. Unless it's tacos.

name: Dreamomancer
description: Music follows you through your dreams and the waking world. The inspiration is never ending.

name: Drenched Monk
description: These monks gain their power from water. I'll bet they live near the coast!

name: Dressy Gothic Beachwear
description: Your dark aesthetic is going to bring some gothic class to the sunny coast.

name: Dricken Morph Armor
description: I FEEL LIKE DRICKEN TONIGHT! LIKE DRICKEN TONIGHT!

name: Drifter's Dark Streetwear (0 AC)
description: Reminiscent of people you may or may not know. One vehemently prefers the former, and the other wore green to blend into the bushes.

name: Drifter's Dark Streetwear (AC)
description: Reminiscent of people you may or may not know. One vehemently prefers the former, and the other wore green to blend into the bushes.

name: Drifter's Streetwear
description: Reminiscent of people you may or may not know. One vehemently prefers the former, and the other wore green to blend into the bushes.

name: Drow Assassin (Armor)
description: Naturally akin to darkness, Drow make one of the most deadly assassins.

name: Drow Eviscerator
description: This armor is covered with blades. It's trimming has been sharpened into keen edges, turning the wearers body into a weapon.

name: Drow Gunslinger
description: For ages, Drow have used Bows and Arrows to hunt down their enemies. As an intrepid Drow Gunslinger, you're armed to the teeth with a much more explosive--and accurate--arsenal.

name: Drow Illusionist
description: Even in civilizations that are under the earth, there will be those who will find new ways to look down on people.

name: Drow Marshal
description: You make the law. You also can break the law. Being a Drow Marshal has so many perks besides the swanky silver-embellished getup.

name: Drow Oathkeeper
description: The Drow who toiled under the tyranny of Dragonlord Vath have abandoned their old lives to take a new oath. Their blades will now be raised to protect the humans and Dwarves who welcomed them into their homes.

name: Druid Battlemage
description: A caster which pulls energy from the terrain itself, you strive to teach others how to live in hermony with everything living being.

name: Druid of the Grove
description: Druids use their magic to protect the flora and fauna across Lore. Grove druids work to create peaceful sanctuaries where nature can flourish… until their charges are threatened. Then beware the force of their power!

name: Druid of the Lake
description: Druids use their magic to protect the flora and fauna across Lore. Lake druids embody their chosen environment: silent and calm until their ire is roused. Then beware the flood of power!

name: Druid Temp
description: Earth Shaman commune with the spirits of the stones and earth around them. They are often as steadfast as the stones they speak with.

name: Druid Warrior
description: Take the form of a Greenguard Druid and help the Elk Clan fight the invading void forces!

name: Druidic Soothsayer
description: Sacrifice is the cost of reading the fates, and those that speak the truth see a dark future. The Druidic Soothsayer has takes life, returns it to nature and bone, and guides the lost towards their destinies.

name: Dryad of the Grove
description: These nymphs of the forest help the plants flourish with their powers. Small seeds suddenly become towering trees in their presence.

name: Duality Deckhand of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Immaculate, blinding light. Enormous, empty darkness. The choice is completely yours to be made.

name: Duality Deckhand of Nulgath (AC)
description: Immaculate, blinding light. Enormous, empty darkness. The choice is completely yours to be made.

name: Duality Mage
description: Are you good? Are you evil? Sometimes it's hard to tell after spending so much time in the Mirror Realm. Click to change your alignment!

name: Duality Mage - Evil
description: Clearly you're an evil mage. But is this really you, or is it you from the Mirror Realm? Argh, it's so confusing!

name: Duality Mage - Good
description: Clearly you're a good mage. But is this really you, or is it you from the Mirror Realm? Argh, it's so confusing!

name: Duality Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power of Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: Duality Naval Commander (AC)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power of Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: Duality of Nulgath
description: As the General of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you. Whether you choose to use such power for Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: Duality Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: A pirates good or evil? Depends on who you ask, and how recently they were looted and/or pillaged!

name: Duality Pirate Captain (AC)
description: A pirates good or evil? Depends on who you ask, and how recently they were looted and/or pillaged!

name: Duality Sorcerer
description: The Duality Sorcerer reaches through Time to gather power from both Good and Chaos in order to power their spells.

name: Ducal Falconer
description: Can ye hear the song o' the falcons, laddie? Ach, course ye can. But can ye sing back? Aye, there's the tricky part.

name: Ducky Naval Commander (AC)
description: Quack-up at this ridiculous naval commander. Duck and waddle around your enemies while having a duckload of fun.

name: Ducky Naval Commander (Legend)
description: Quack-up at this ridiculous naval commander. Duck and waddle around your enemies while having a duckload of fun.

name: Ducky Rubber Suit
description: What's a ducky rubber? You don't think it's rubber made from…oh dear.

name: Dungeon Defender
description: Lascivia loves Killek's DeadChewer's dedication, but for the safety of her entire hoard'em, he must be locked away. Dungeon defenders keep him in… and others OUT!

name: Dungeon Destroyer (AC)
description: No dungeon can hold a hero as mighty as you! Just be careful you do not get stonedust in your eyes as you blast your way through the blocks and bricks.

name: Dungeon Destroyer (Legend)
description: No dungeon can hold a hero as mighty as you! Just be careful you do not get stonedust in your eyes as you blast your way through the blocks and bricks.

name: Dungeon Master
description: Covered in spikes, sharp edges and hooks, the Dungeon Master's armor is a weapon itself.

name: Dungeon Rockstar
description: Show your appreciation of Kimberly and Voltaire with this epic rockstar cosplay gear!

name: DungeonMaster Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: ﻿﻿YARRRR! This floating ship-shaped dungeon was the BEST IDEA EVER… The dungeon goes to the challengers. There is no escape! AHAHAHAHAHAHA!

name: DungeonMaster Naval Commander (AC)
description: ﻿﻿YARRRR! This floating ship-shaped dungeon was the BEST IDEA EVER… The dungeon goes to the challengers. There is no escape! AHAHAHAHAHAHA!

name: Dusk Sunstreaker (0 AC)
description: (Owner can click to change and it'll show for everyone else). Elegant swimwear made with soft sunlight. Warmth falls from the sky and seeps into the sea. You are a phoenix gracing the shore.

name: Dusk Sunstreaker (AC)
description: (Owner can click to change and it'll show for everyone else). Elegant swimwear made with soft sunlight. Warmth falls from the sky and seeps into the sea. You are a phoenix gracing the shore.

name: Dusky Evader
description: The Horcs have trained you in the arts of evasion. They have shown you their secret art of beast lore.

name: Dwakel Warrior (Armor)
description: A mature Dwakel donning a human's armor to try and be the hero of a local village or pretending to be the hero to gain intel on unaware targets.

name: Dwarf Engineer
description: From tables, clocks, and lamps to guns, explosives, and war machines, the Dwarf Engineer can to it all!

name: Dwarf Warrior
description: Standard dwarven armor.

name: Dwarfhold Explorer
description: The caverns that snake through Dwarfhold's mountains hide gold, gems, secret temples, and dangerous dungeons. All these new discoveries are yours to conquer!

name: Dwarlord
description: You can't spell 'dwarf' without 'war', and you can't win a war without Dwarven Warlords!

name: Dwarven Golem
description: Constructed with a combination of clever dwarven clockworks and earth magic, the Dwarven Golems were constructed to be the tireless guardians of Dwarfhold Keep.

name: Dynamo Bunny
description: Like a rabbit, you just go! Go! Go! Nothing can stop you!

name: Dynasty Warrior
description: Made of jade, this armor is more brittle than most. This makes it a status symbol, as the only warriors who can use it are those who are quick enough to not need any armor at all.

name: Dzeza Cultist (Armor)
description: Dzeza the Boundless allows you to break through your limits. You will have the power and strength to write your own destiny. Grow. Evolve. You may look to the stars today, but soon, they'll be ants crawling around your feet.

name: Earth Creeper Morph
description: You've morphed into an Earth Creeper. Although a distant cousin of the more terrifying Red and Dark Fiend, these creatures are peaceful by nature and like to avoid conflict. Their claws enable them to dig great holes in the ground where they live and hide.

name: Earth Dracomancer
description: Warriors of draconic blood. Once upon a time, they cut through clouds and danced on treetops. Now, they're fantastic myths whispered amongst the immortals (Head/Hand/Tail click 2 change)

name: Earth Dragon
description: Mighty, powerful and awesome is the one who can handle the weight of the Earth Dragon's form. If you choose to take the challenge, wear the armor and become the dragon, then be prepared to deal a world of hurt on the opposing side.

name: Earth Dragon Avatar (Armor)
description: Warriors of draconic blood. Once upon a time, they cut through clouds and danced on treetops. Now, they're fantastic myths whispered amongst the immortals

name: Earth Dragon's Guard
description: Warriors of draconic blood. Once upon a time, they cut through clouds and danced on treetops. Now, they're fantastic myths whispered amongst the immortals.

name: Earth Fènnù de Hóuzi
description: They'll be no monkeying around you. To earn your share of banana's one must ape-reicate all living things.

name: Earth Ring
description: Just like the element Earth, you are strong, persistent, and enduring, able to take a punch and deliver one back tenfold.

name: Earth Shaman
description: Earth Shamen commune with the spirits of the stones and earth around them. They are often as steadfast as the stones they speak with.

name: Earth Titan Armor
description: Harness the power of Gaiazor itself with this titanic armor. Who needs a shield when you can be a walking fortress?

name: Earth Weilder
description: A cyborg of combined dwakel and dwarven design, the Earth Wielder can brave the deep, dark underearth without fear of being caught in a magmaflow or cave-in.

name: Earth Zard
description: "Huge, strong, and dumb as a rock. This estranged evolution of frog lizard are being pushed from their natural habitat in the Zamboo region for some unknown reason, making them threats to nearby towns and farms." What an old bestiary passage!

name: Ebil Administrator
description: This suit has been authorized for use by Chairman Platinum. WAY BETTER than the Crystallis Administration.

name: Ebil AI Enforcer
description: A bionic human weapon augmented with state-of-the- art technology and Decision Making Al. In case of violent or deranged behavior, press the Reset button in their left nostril.

name: Ebil Animatronic Armor
description: Don't hold it against them.

name: Ebil Claws (0 AC)
description: They see when you are sleeping…because with that infrared eye, they basically can see everything. And I mean everything…

name: Ebil Claws (AC)
description: They see when you are sleeping…because with that infrared eye, they basically can see everything. And I mean everything…

name: Ebil Claws (Legend)
description: They see when you are sleeping…because with that infrared eye, they basically can see everything. And I mean everything…

name: Ebil Company
description: A subsidiary of EbilCorp that sends workers out to salvage materials for their labs. Don't worry about the people living in the houses you're 'scavenging' from. Who's going to miss a puzzle cube that badly?

name: Ebil Company Scavenger
description: A subsidiary of EbilCorp that sends workers out to salvage materials for their labs. Don't worry about the people living in the houses you're 'scavenging' from. Who's going to miss a puzzle cube that badly?

name: Ebil Dragon Rider
description: After several experiments on captured dragons in lore, EbilCorp developec a line of evil robotic dragons and unleashed them on the local townspeople. No one is safe as EbilCorp's takeover is imminent!

name: Ebil Dread Paladin
description: Artix's choice armor for battling the ebil dread and the armies of dorkness. Chainsaw hand sold separately.

name: Ebil-er Dread Paladin
description: Artix's choice armor for battling the ebil dread and the armies of dorkness… HAS EVOLVED . Chainsaw hand also sold separately.

name: Ebil Genius Armor
description: Trust me. I'm a genius… I mean, Hero!

name: Ebil Kaiju Scientist
description: Made from breathable and resiliant material, able to protect you from all of the safety violations committed in Ebil Corp's Titan research labs. Not teeth, claw, energybeam or pastel paint-proof.

name: Ebil Ninja
description: They may be dressed for a wedding, but they're ready for a fight!

name: Ebil Operative
description: Once a rogue Shadowslayer from the future, these soldiers are now rogue operatives for EbilCorp.

name: Ebil Symbiote
description: A parasitic evil energy latches to your very being. It gives you immense dark power but you are left a shadow of your former self. Who knows what stigma attaches to your soul…

name: EbilCorp Agent
description: Mission #666.D -- Chairman Platinum has ordered you to follow Target EVotS. Objective: observe only. Report all activities.

name: EbilCorp Annihilators
description: Victory is the goal. Chairman Platinum will accept nothing less. (This team's games are sponsored by EbilCorp. Find their headquarters in store near you in Dreadrock Citadel!)

name: EBILCORP Executive
description: Now you are one of the 1%! Occupy THS!

name: Ebilcorp Hitman
description: Mission #357.A -- Chairman Platinum has ordered you to follow Target QV. Objective: observe, execute, report.

name: EbilCorp Prometheus (0 AC)
description: Energy crackles all around you. Power radiates from within. You've become a massive force of unstoppable power. Will you use it to protect those you love, or will you become the next force of evil? The choice is yours.

name: EbilCorp Prometheus (AC)
description: Energy crackles all around you. Power radiates from within. You've become a massive force of unstoppable power. Will you use it to protect those you love, or will you become the next force of evil? The choice is yours.

name: EbilCorp's Muscles
description: These troopers are bred for one thing and one thing… THE DESTRUCTION OF AQW! And keeping people out of EbilCorp! And making sure the children don't take breaks while making products! And making sure that NO ONE buys the Artix toys! And making sure that NO ONE dances! And making sure that NO ONE smiles! But most importantly…making sure that NO ONE CELEBRATES BIRTHDAYS!!!

name: EbilCorp Scalper
description: EbilCorp hires Scalpers to barge into stores and buy out all their stock to create the illusion of high demand. One of them teased a crying child for being too slow, and got a big raise.

name: EbilCorp Shirt
description: Ebilcorp Shirt - 103% Cotton-poly blend Artix Ent shirts will NOT protect you from software crashes, stock crashes, or heroes crashing into your headquarters. They WILL protect you from lack of style and bad fashion choices.

name: EbilCorp Standard Player
description: Disappear into the background as your only hope to be inconspicuous comes in stick form. Play a prank, become a coat rack, or outsmart a baddie with your weirdly entrancing stick figure.

name: EbilCorp Superintendent (0 AC)
description: An executive member of Ebil Corp's elite. They believe that if you want a job done well, do it yourself. This bespoke suit hides bloodstains very well, allowing them to efficiently manage their time between the field and the boardroom.

name: EbilCorp Superintendent (AC)
description: An executive member of Ebil Corp's elite. They believe that if you want a job done well, do it yourself. This bespoke suit hides bloodstains very well, allowing them to efficiently manage their time between the field and the boardroom.

name: EbilCorporate Office Drone
description: You belong to EbilCorp now.

name: EbilNet Agent
description: Partially made of code, these Ebil special agents can sneak into netspace and snoop through your search history.

name: EbilNet Operator
description: EbilCorp's agents are partially made out of code. This lets them sneak into netspace and snoop through your search history.

name: EbilNet Specialist Operator
description: EbilCorp's agents are partially made out of code. This lets them sneak into netspace and snoop through your search history.

name: EbilSneezer Armor
description: I will honour Frostval in my heart, and try to keep it all the year. I will live in the Past, the Present, and the Future. The Spirits of all Three shall strive within me. I will not shut out the lessons that they teach.

name: Ebony Dragon Spirit
description: Merely walking around in this armor sucks the very light from the day, shadowing the sun with the dark cover of night. The shine of your scales will mesmerize, while your claws will rend, creating a storm of beauty and more.

name: Ebony Party Outfit (0 AC)
description: Party all night long in this sparkling ebony outfit!

name: Ebony Party Outfit (AC)
description: Party all night long in this sparkling ebony outfit!

name: Ebony VoidCaster (0 AC)
description: Those who sign Nulgath's contract gain access to the infinite wellspring of arcane energy contained within the void. Be warned, almost everyone who accepts this power find themselves consumed by it.

name: Ebony VoidCaster (AC)
description: Those who sign Nulgath's contract gain access to the infinite wellspring of arcane energy contained within the void. Be warned, almost everyone who accepts this power find themselves consumed by it.

name: EC Mach 6 Soldier Armor
description: You look like a drone, you act like a drone… but only to get to the front of the line!

name: Eclipse Emperor
description: The armor of the Eclipse Emperor. It is believed that this armor was a gift from the Avatars themselves.

name: Ecto Enforcer
description: Enforcers exist for the sole purpose of removing all leftover magic there is. But one of them seems a bit different…

name: Eden Formal Outfit
description: Life in Eden is idyllic for the citizens of the Crystallis Administration, and pleasant distractions abound. Formal events are held regularly for all citizens. Should you be invited, you will require a Protocol Master's assistance.

name: Eden High Formal
description: Life in Eden is idyllic for the citizens of the Crystallis Administration, and pleasant distractions abound. High Formal events are held regularly for the elite. Should you be invited, you will require a Protocol Master's assistance.

name: Eden Tour Guide's Vest
description: Eden City is home to many wonderous things, thanks to the exemplary planning and organization of the Crystallis Administration. As a tour guide, you'll chaperone visitors around and extoll their virtues.

name: Edgy Punk Outfit
description: Flannel is the best material for ANYTHING. Rock on!

name: Edvard/Beulah Outfit
description: The outfit of Edvard the Sparkling Vampire and his lost love, Beulah!

name: Eerie Underworld General (Armor)
description: Down in the deepest depths of the Underworld are warriors so feral and fiendish, those foolish enough to battle them are never seen again.

name: Efreet (Armor)
description: Now you, too, can exude the intimidation and inspire the respect and awe that the Efreet, King of the Djinn, commands!

name: Eggceptional Bunny
description: Hoppy Grenwog!

name: EggHunter Berserker
description: What came first - the bunny or the egg? Did these EggHunters become berserkers because of the egg hunt? Or does the egg hunt call out to berserkers? Who knows…

name: Eggstreme Hunter-Berserker
description: What came first - the bunny or the egg? Did these EggHunters become berserkers because of the egg hunt? Or does the egg hunt call out to berserkers? Who knows…

name: Elaphinos Clan Druid
description: A herd of deer received the blessing of a Nature Spirit long ago, and everywhere they stepped, flora began to grow. Then, they became able to walk on two legs, and spoke to human druids as if they were kin of the same blood.

name: Elder Druid (AC)
description: Take the form of a Greenguard Druid and help the Elk Clan fight the invading void forces!

name: Elder Druid (Legend)
description: Take the form of a Greenguard Druid and help the Elk Clan fight the invading void forces!

description: From out of the depths, a sinister new army rises. They herald the dawn of a darker, deadlier elder deity. BEWARE. (CC to Trim)

name: Eldritch Hypnotist

name: Eldritch Occult Club
description: Mystery enthusiasts obsessed with the secrets of a secluded and advanced civilization. What were their castles built on? Alien wisdom? Eldritch spirits? It's a topic of hot debate!

name: Eldritch Pirate Crewmember (0 AC)
description: ﻿I be ready t' sail into the deepest, darkest, most dangerous seas. It do be good fer confidence, knowin' ye cannot be killed… again.

description: A sip from a fresh coconut would be perfect for a beachside getaway. Being able to bite into them like they're apples is really convenient. (Tan is CC to Base)

name: Electro Biobeast Morph
description: Check out those blade legs! Wicked! This exclusive armor will unlock when the BioBeasts Facebook page reaches 50,000 Thanks for all your support—now, go unleash the beast within! http://biobeasts.artix.com

name: Electrojolt Scholar
description: The Scholars of the Storm Court marry magic to science, aiming to control the heavens with their inventions. In the service of their ruler, they seek to attain power that could overthrow the gods.

name: ElectroMage Armor (0 AC)
description: Cyber Magic flows through the veins of ElectroMages. Mastering their power is vital; the energy even an untrained mage can produce could leven an entire city.

name: ElectroMage Armor (AC)
description: Cyber Magic flows through the veins of ElectroMages. Mastering their power is vital; the energy even an untrained mage can produce could leven an entire city.
