name: Elegaic Mage (AC)
description: From out of the darkness, you hear a whispered chant rise, and fear floods your heart and mind. The Elegaic Mage's power surrounds its victims in the sounds of terror.

name: Elegaic Mage (Legend)
description: From out of the darkness, you hear a whispered chant rise, and fear floods your heart and mind. The Elegaic Mage's power surrounds its victims in the sounds of terror.

name: Elegant AX Swimwear (0 AC)
description: New for 2021 from AX Fashion: you'll look hot enough in this elegant swimwear to /slay your enemies and /stun your friends.

name: Elegant AX Swimwear (AC)
description: New for 2021 from AX Fashion: you'll look hot enough in this elegant swimwear to /slay your enemies and /stun your friends.

name: Elegant Ceremony Outfit
description: Formal wear custom fitted for the most important milestones in someone's life. Tailors weave magic into the needlework to protect their clients from monsters, jealous blades, sudden strikes of lightning, and streaks of bad luck.

name: Elegant Changshan
description: Formal wear modified to allow increased mobility. A mesh of metal is woven into the material, acting as a hidden layer of protection for those experienced in martial arts and swordplay.

name: Elegant Courtly Attire
description: The ornate fashion currently favored by the noble court of Swordhaven. Skilled tailors often create clothes for the nobility first, before the style catches on with the wealthy citizens of the capital.

name: Elegant Doom Toga
description: Ideal for parties, formal speeches, or ruling an empire.

name: Elegant Enchanted Suit
description: "We are but poor circus performers, it is dark and we are lost. We were told there was a village nearby that might enjoy our skills."

name: Elegant Eternal Ice Outfit
description: Ice in its purest form is crystalline and clear. This outfit was inspired by the majesty of this coldly beautiful element.

name: Elegant Frost Suit
description: The frosty colors of Frostval have come together in this elegant set of formal wear.

name: Elegant Frostvale Suit
description: The colors of Frostval have come together in this elegant set of formal wear.

name: Elegant Gothic Valentine
description: All dolled up for Valentines Day.

name: Elegant Gothika
description: OH MY GOTH! We're undead! Undeader than dead!

name: Elegant Kimono
description: Like the name says, this Elegant Kimono is the classic attire for those who wish to classy and sophisticated in a color custom outfit. (color custom base and trim)

name: Elegant Masquerade
description: The Sheevra Masquerade party is the BEST excuse for dressing up.

name: Elegant Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Sometimes you just have to dress up when sailing the seas of Lore. Piracy can be fancy!

name: Elegant Naval Commander (AC)
description: Sometimes you just have to dress up when sailing the seas of Lore. Piracy can be fancy!

name: Elegant Necro Armor
description: Necromancer's love to celebrate Friday the 13th. What better excuse to get all dressed up for a party?

name: Elegant Qipao
description: These are meant to show off. Yue says that this style of dress was originally created to defy uptight rules and manners, so party your heart out!

name: Elegant Siren (0 AC)
description: NO ONE can resist the lure of this siren's call… and when you fall, you'll embrace your fate with open arms.

name: Elegant Siren (AC)
description: NO ONE can resist the lure of this siren's call… and when you fall, you'll embrace your fate with open arms.

name: Elegant Toxic Valentine (AC)
description: All dolled up for Valentine's Day.

name: Elegant Toxic Valentine (Legend)
description: All dolled up for Valentine's Day.

name: Elegant Underworld Courtier (0 AC)
description: There aren't any Nobles in the Underworld. Not in the traditional sense, but everyone in Dage the Evil's close circle gets so many perks, they might as well be called Nobles.

name: Elegant Underworld Courtier (AC)
description: There aren't any Nobles in the Underworld. Not in the traditional sense, but everyone in Dage the Evil's close circle gets so many perks, they might as well be called Nobles.

name: Elegant Vampire
description: Followers of The Unseeing, these Vampires love to hang around and listen to Alice in Chains.

name: Elegant Victorian Garb
description: What a SMASHING outfit! Fit for presentation at Court, if I do say so myself.

name: Elegant Werewolf Armor
description: I just hope you didn't have to lick your coat to keep it looking prim and proper.

name: Elegant Witch
description: Bubble, bubble, toil, and trouble… those Cauldron Sisters have NO style. Or substance.

name: Elemental Battlemage
description: The elements are yours to manipulate and control. You weave them together and against one another.

name: Elemental Chaos Guardian
description: A despised myth that opened new eyes when Chaos returned to Lore. They were ripped from this world despite being made for it. Without Chaos, there is no evolution. How far will you evolve before you stop being yourself?

name: Elemental Dissonance
description: Heavy laden and strategically crafted, this armor gives you everything you need to harness the elements and use them for your own bidding. Take advantage of all that they have to offer.

name: Elemental Dracolich Destroyer
description: Summon the power of the elements. Wind blows… Fire Burns… Water Falls…

name: Elemental Dracomancer Armor (AC)
description: Terrifyingly large and in charge, this armor will drive the weak from you and bring the true villains to your feet. Take your weapon, Hero, and lay waste to those who stand against you.

name: Elemental Dracomancer Armor (Non-AC)
description: Terrifyingly large and in charge, this armor will drive the weak from you and bring the true villains to your feet. Take your weapon, Hero, and lay waste to those who stand against you.

name: Elemental DragonSlayer
description: A little-known type of dragonslayer that hail from the Land of the Four Seasons that have been trained to control all primal elements should a powerful draconian titan similar to Desoloth strike once more.

name: Elemental Kyrios
description: A well studied and trained master of elemental arcane spells. In tune with the forces that shaped Lore, the Kyrios wields their magic to connect the world of mortals to the world of the Avatars.

name: Elemental Summoner
description: Those who have been extensively enlightenment by all eight elemental planes are gifted with the power to call forth a single legendary dragon associated with each respective element.

name: Elemental Walker
description: When you take the elements into yourself, when you BECOME the elements, then - and only then - can you walk amongst them without fear.

name: Elementary Student Uniform
description: This uniform is worn by elementary school age students in Swordhaven's Hero Academy when they aren't in combat training.

name: Elite Asgardian
description: An electric armor forged by the gods who cast all their rage into making it. Strike down your foes.

name: Elite AX Swimwear (0 AC)
description: AX Fashion exclusive: you'll look hot enough in this elite swimwear to /slay your enemies and /stun your friends.

name: Elite AX Swimwear (AC)
description: AX Fashion exclusive: you'll look hot enough in this elite swimwear to /slay your enemies and /stun your friends.

name: Elite Beastmaster
description: A cut above the rest, Elite Beastmaster have existed for ages, passing their knowledge down from generation to generation.

name: Elite Guncraft Shadowslayer
description: Each of your guns is specially made to bring down the myriad monstrosities that lurk in the dark. Bring in the light by riddling the shadows with holes.

name: Elite Ice Assassin (0 AC)
description: Belonging to a clan of elite ice enchanted assassins this ninja garb will send a chill down your spine.

name: Elite Ice Assassin (AC)
description: Belonging to a clan of elite ice enchanted assassins this ninja garb will send a chill down your spine.

name: Elite Ice Assassin (Legend)
description: Belonging to a clan of elite ice enchanted assassins this ninja garb will send a chill down your spine.

name: Elite Phoenix Hunter
description: Trolls bestow this armor to the Hero for helping and never forget the sacrifices made.

name: Elite ShadowReaver (0 AC)
description: Only the most elite ShadowReavers are allowed to receive the Jagged Lightning tattoo, by order of the Empress Gravelyn.

name: Elite ShadowReaver (AC)
description: Only the most elite ShadowReavers are allowed to receive the Jagged Lightning tattoo, by order of the Empress Gravelyn.

name: Elite Shadowslayer
description: When you are royalty, yet wish to be a Shadowslayer… you dress the part!

name: Elite Underworld SoulSeeker
description: The SoulSeekers roam the Underworld in solitude, held under their Lord's sway yet reviled by their fellow Legionnaires. Little remains of themselves, as they have been twisted by devouring the souls of great monsters.

name: Elite Void
description: Those who Nulgath calls Elite must be true fiends. The Archfiend does not bestow this name on just any Void in his Nation.

name: Elite Warden
description: The price of haloed glory and reverence is a short life made up of brutal encounters. But your name will far outlive your body.

name: Elite Zardic Swordmaster
description: Masters of the blade that tempered their skills in the wilds, learning from the adaptability and savagery of the Zards.

name: Elk Clan Warrior
description: Take the form of a Greenguard Druid and help the Elk Clan fight the invading void forces!

name: Elven Duelist
description: The only way prove one's honor is to duel… and duel we shall!

name: Elven Heritage Guardian
description: Countless elven clans and courts are divided, spread across the far reaches of Lore. The Elven Guardian holds no affiliation, always read with sword in hand to rescue kin in need of aid.

name: Elven Heritage Ranger
description: Due to their seclusion, elf clans can disappear without a whisper. With no one left to search for them, the Elven Heritage Ranger takes up this duty, and explores the far reaches for kin in need of aid.

name: Elven Mystique
description: Earthy tones, the smell of loamy soil, the anonymity of nature's bounty… Wrap yourself in the naturalistic energies and qualities of they very earth you walk upon. Use its solidarity and steafastness as your defense against the numerous enemies you have to battle.

name: Elvish Yukata
description: A summer yukata that recalls the quiet dawn in a deep green forest. Dapples of sunlight seep through the leaves. Its a design is popular with Elven visitors, and reminds them of home.

name: EmberFlame DragonKin
description: The EmberFlame Dragonkin have willingly given themselves up to serve dragons who have allied with Malgor and his ShadowFlame army.

name: Embersea Overlord
description: The volcanoes that ring Embersea burn with an elemental fury. Only the strongest rulers can survive reigning over this land.

name: Embersea Uma Senshi
description: "Do you know? Hope is the same as despair. Those who fail will fall into despair. Those who fight will make their hopes a reality. Or so I heard during my battles in Embersea with Tyndarius…"

name: Emblazoned Pyromancer
description: These robes are kind worn by the ancient Shurpu Masters of Flame. The modern Pyromancer robes are patternd after them, but these colors signify both your impressive skills with fire magic and your adherence to the Laws of Fire as laid down by the ancient Shurpu Masters.

name: Embodiment of Permafrost
description: Ice, alive in tumult, gazing at the flow of time, always moving and always so noisy. Their paradise silent and cold, where anything that dares to disturb the peace is frozen solid, unable to live or die.

name: Emerald Acolyte
description: This is the armor of the Acolytes of the Generals of the great Viridian Dynasty, the Emperor's most trusted defenders.

name: Emerald Arcanist Robes
description: Hunt zombies for the green dye needed to turn the Arcanist Robes into Emerald Arcanist Robes.

name: Emerald Dragonhealer Robes
description: Healers of Etherstorm are one with the Dragons and elements. These healers draw their power from the Earth.

name: Emerald Dragonhealer Wanderer
description: These roaming Priests of Etherstorm are attuned to the land and the Dragons, helping those in need. These priests draw strength from the Earth.

name: Emerald Druid
description: The beautiful greens of Nature re-appear when pollution is defeated!

name: Emerald Earth Mage
description: These magi are one with the natural surroundings, gaining their mage from everything living creature.

name: Emerald Emperor's General
description: Generals of the great Viridian Dynasty, these were the Emperor's most trusted defender.

name: Emerald Fairy
description: During Lucky Day all of the Fairies come out to celebrate with their friends. The Emerald Fairies enjoy the woods, and can often be found in forests.

name: Emerald Glory Mage
description: This time of the year is magical, and your power brings glory to those you love!

name: Emerald Party Outfit
description: Party all night long in this sparking emerald outfit!

name: Emerald Sea Mage
description: The sea speaks to you as you harness its magical energy.

name: Emerald Yokai Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: Empress Ai no Miko rules over Yokai Isle, and we serve her best by patrolling the seven seas, defending her people and homeland. For the honor of the Thousand Years throne, we sail on!

name: Emerald Yokai Pirate Captain (AC)
description: Empress Ai no Miko rules over Yokai Isle, and we serve her best by patrolling the seven seas, defending her people and homeland. For the honor of the Thousand Years throne, we sail on!

name: Emissary of Melqart
description: Even those who reside in the realm of Death hold courtesy and oaths in high regard. Welcome them as you would any other guest, and they'll see that your wars and stars move favorably. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Emo Rocker
description: I heart rock 'n roll, so put a piece of gold in the jukebox, baby! I heart rock and roll, so come on and /dance with me!

name: Emo Shocker (AC)
description: I heart 'lectricity, so put a few more hertz in the generator, baby! I heart 'lectricity, so come equip this armor and shock out with me!

name: Emo Shocker (Legend)
description: I heart 'lectricity, so put a few more hertz in the generator, baby! I heart 'lectricity, so come equip this armor and shock out with me!

name: Empire Bloodguard
description: Stop, wait, and listen for the raking of claws on stone. Lurking under the Shadowscythe's wings, the bloodguard have made a name for themselves. They

name: Empire Rocker
description: Considered punks even by their own Empire. Their concerts are very underground, but the crashing sounds, growls, and screams will shake you in your grave.

name: Empowered BladeMaster
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. Once in a great while Dage finds a living with the inhuman skill, speed and stealth to serve as a Living BladeMaster.

name: Empowered Chaos Avenger Armor
description: In one timeline, The Hero managed to defeat Drakath and get a hold of their Chaos Amulet. Instead of becoming the Slayer who tried to destroy Lore, The Hero became the Avenger that saved it. (Item does 50% more damage to Chaos monsters when equipped)

name: Empowered Dark Caster
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. Sought after for ages, the Dark Caster finally emerges to celebrate the Dark Lord's 21,000th birthday. Although there are many followers who claim to be a part of the Undead Legion, Dark Casters are unmistakably the most dedicated and commend.

name: Empowered Darkon's Debris 1
description: The former Crown Prince's new body was created at the very beginning of his lonely journey. Darkon went on to successfully fulfil his family's promise with the Arcana. The circle is closed. Dust returns to dust. Alprecha's child fades to the nothingness he was born from. (Gives 35% more damage to monsters and 25% more Gold/XP/CP/Rep when equipped.)

name: Empowered Drakath Armor
description: Chaos reigns?? HAHAHAHAHAAAA! This armor is PROOF you've taken down the Champion of Chaos! (Item does 50% more damage to Chaos monsters when equipped)

name: Empowered Evolved Blood
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. Courtesy of Zee, Nulgath has empowered his oldest and most devoted Fiend's to further shape his very image. There is no purity left in their veins.

name: Empowered Evolved Fiend
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. After years of powering up, Nulgath's Fiend has evolved!

name: Empowered Evolved Hex
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. Courtesy of Zee, Nulgath has empowered his oldest and most devoted Fiend's to further shape his very image. There is no purity left in their veins.

name: Empowered Evolved Shadow
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. Courtesy of Zee, Nulgath has empowered his oldest and most devoted Fiend's to further shape his very image. There is no purity left in their veins.

name: Empowered Evolved Void
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. After years of powering up, Nulgath's Fiend has evolved!

name: Empowered Forge Spawn
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. Unbreakable walking armors filled with thousands of human, monster, evil, and even cursed souls. All merged together as one only consciousness. Loyal to Dage the Evil, they will show no mercy.

name: Empowered Grandmaster Gramiel
description: The garb of a Celestial who wanted a simple life. Trickery robbed him of his wish. Gramiel dedicated his entire existence to destroying all beasts, and vindicating his lost love.

name: Empowered Legacy of Nulgath
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. No one knows who this armor belonged to before Nulgath came into power. But it still holds a sinister aura! Given to his loyal followers for victory in the Summer of Evil war! (Color custom)

name: Empowered Lich King
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. Being the ultimate lich king is no easy task. You need to work your way up from lich peasant, this can take a while.

name: Empowered Original Drakath Armor
description: Chaos reigns?? HAHAHAHAHAAAA! This armor is PROOF you've taken down the Champion of Chaos! (Item does 50% more damage to Chaos monsters when equipped)

name: Empowered Paragon Plate
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. This armor is riddled with the faces of it's last victims. If you listen closely, you can still hear their cries of those slain in the Dage vs Nulgath war. Now that Nulgath has left the Underworld to Dage, what will the Evil One do?

name: Empowered Prismatic Paragon
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. This armor is riddled with the faces of it's last victims. if you listen closely, you can still hear their cries… AHHHH!

name: Empowered Undead Champion
description: This item does 50% more damage to Undead monsters when equipped. Unaffected by emotions and impervious to remorse, Champions pledge their full allegiance to the Undead Legion. Showing mercy is a sign of weakness, and weakness is not tolerated.

name: Empowered Underworld Evoker
description: Just because you've entered the Underworld doesn't mean you have to sacrifice your epic fashion sense.

name: Empowered Vordred's Armor
description: WEARING THIS ARMOR GIVES YOU THE URGE TO TALK IN ALL CAPS!

name: Empowered Worshipper of Nulgath
description: This item does 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. Any mortal who has devoted their soul to the obedience of Nulgath.

name: Empress Gravelyn (Temp)
description: *No description*

name: Empyrean Chronomancer Armor
description: Empyrean Chronomancers seem to have simply always existed. Their bodies transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence. To tap into this strength requires particular insight though.

name: Empyrean Tiger Kimono
description: The formal garb of those who walk the White Tiger's path at the Shrine of the Four Cardinal Directions. Their stars have trusted them with guardianship of the Yokai Isles' West as well as the Yokai Realm's West.

name: Empyrean Tiger Rider
description: The garb of those who walk the White Tiger's path at the Shrine of the Four Cardinal Directions. Their stars have trusted them with guardianship of the Yokai Isles' West as well as the Yokai Realm's West.

name: Empyrean Void (0 AC)
description: The Empyrean Voids are among the most highly-revered of Nulgath's Nation. To ascend to their ranks, one must prove their worth in battle and blood for centuries.

name: Empyrean Void (AC)
description: The Empyrean Voids are among the most highly-revered of Nulgath's Nation. To ascend to their ranks, one must prove their worth in battle and blood for centuries.

name: Encanto Sambista Armor
description: Vamos, Sambista: é hora de dançar, festejar, lutar! Força!

name: Enchanted Akiba-kei Outfit
description: Carve out your own style any way you want. (Color-customizable to Base, Trim, Accessory.)

name: Enchanted Akiban Shogun
description: Elaborate armor worn by only the highest level of Akiban defenders. Rank is denoted by the symbols on your chest. (Item is CC)

name: Enchanted Akiban Warrior
description: With perseverance and study, you too can become an Akiban Warrior. It is their duty to keep the inhabitants of Akiba safe. (Item is CC)

name: Enchanted Arcadia Soloblade
description: Can love bloom on the battlefield? These adventurers hold a masquerade every year where they mingle, cross blades, and decide on a worthy partner - or return to their passion for battle.

name: Enchanted Armor of Awe
description: This insanely AWE-some armor is for the few, the proud, the colorful… those who stand up, draw their weapons and yell BattleOn! Gives 25% more rep, gold, XP, and class points when equipped.

name: Enchanted Attendant (AC)

name: Enchanted Unfowled BeastMaster

description: Vampire Lords rule over their sanguine servants and, feasting on the blood of mortals, they can live forever. Don't show one a mirror though, or you might not like what you don't see.

name: Enchanted Vanguard Of Nulgath

name: Enchanted Varsity Gear

name: Enchanted Varsity Outfit
description: Show off your true colors as you /cheer for your favorite team! (Stripes are customizable to base, accessory, and trim)

name: Enchanted Void Monk of Nulgath

description: A title and role given to the second born of Skye's Ruler, tasked with executing the will of the crown. They strike faster than lightning, silencing any threat to their homeland's harmony.

name: Ender's Knight

name: Endgame Upset Gear
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players! (This armor will return each year.)

name: Endless Seas Helmsman (0 AC)
description: The guide of the Underworld will find you no matter where you are, and point you towards destiny. Even Lord Dage must answer the call. But if Vergil’s going to hop on a boat, the left arm’s gotta go. That hook hand is very real.

name: Enraged Pyromancer

name: Envenomed Ice Symbiote
description: What better way to survive the winter-long battles than to merge with the ice itself. Take in the cold, the frost, the bitter, biting winds and feel the cold seep into your spirit. And just when you think it can't get any better, an icy venom pierces your heart, enhancing your power.

name: Envoy of Kyanos
description: The Envoys of Kyanos have very special gear to help handle the cold as they battle through the icy lands of Glacera.

name: Eternal Battlestar

Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence. To tap into this strength requires particular insight though.

description: Once upon another time, or perhaps in the near future, the Eternal Sovereign's name will both be lauded and held with contempt. The Guards stand against those who seek the silent oblivion.

name: Eternal Inversionist (Armor)
description: Once worn by temple priests in the northern Sandsea, frequent mishaps by mischievous spirits forced them to abandon their sacred values to tame them. They have been slaying spirits since, but their gilded attire is all that remain of who they once were.

name: Eternal Juggernaut
description: Like the Warriors of the Shadowflame army vow to follow Malgor, the Eternal Juggernauts await the ultimate victory… and their rewards. Their control over the galaxies contained in their armor is shown by the ability to change their colors.

name: Eternal Manifestation (Armor)

name: Eternal Rocker (Armor)

name: Ethereal Wanderer

name: Evacuation Protocol Suit
description: Able bodied members of Seabase Undine have the important duty of leading its personnel through emergencies. The hardest part of the job is being able to tell a real person from a hallucination created by Kathool's influence.

name: EvaderOrc Armor
description: Pay homage to the horcs have trained you in the arts of evasion.

name: Eventide Sorcerer
description: Moonflowers and magic that can only bloom in the dark of the night. Your mystical mastery is a hushed secret shared between months and datura.

description: Some of the refugees cursed by the cold-blooded Queen were restored to normal over the course of the year, but not completely. They can still deliver a chilling scratch that can freeze the body of their targets.

name: Evil Abada Outfit

name: Evil Archmage

name: Evil Bunny Suit
description: Here comes Peter Cottontail, hopping down the… OMG WHAT IS THAT!

name: Evil Casual Wear
description: Rep your favorite faction as you /rest after battle. EVIL!

name: Evil ChaosLord Prime

name: Evil Dread
description: This is one groovy armor.

name: Evil Hero of Balance
description: Centuries before Drakath's favorite minions, Xing and Xang, their ancestors fought to preserve Order, to bring balance, and to save the world from the Queen of Monsters.

name: Evil J-Sixth Lord
description: "It is not necessary to lie to achieve anything of value. A skilled Sixth-Lord is nearly impossible to defeat."

name: Evil Symbiote
description: A parasitic evil energy latches to your very being. It gives you immense dark power but you are left a shadow of your former self. Who knows what stigma attaches to your soul…

name: Evil Undeadslayer
description: The Evil Undead are coming, but you're well-prepared! Because the only undead YOU want to slay are the EVIL ONES! Let your chainsaws rip!

name: Evil Underworld Lounger (0 AC)
description: The Legion is spoiled for choice when it comes to leisure. Want an ice bath in the Cocytus? How about a lava soak in the Phlegethon? Or maybe you'd like to scrub unwanted memories out in the Lethe?

name: Evil Underworld Lounger (AC)
description: The Legion is spoiled for choice when it comes to leisure. Want an ice bath in the Cocytus? How about a lava soak in the Phlegethon? Or maybe you'd like to scrub unwanted memories out in the Lethe?

name: Evil Varsity Uniform
description: Rah rah rah! #Team Evil! (Requires Rank 10 Evil)

name: Evolution of Escherion
description: The first Chaos Lord has evolved… and granted you the gift of his newest form!

name: Evolved BladeMaster
description: Your training is complete! Bring me the head of Nulgath and you will become the true Blade Master!

name: Evolved Blood of Nulgath
description: Courtesy of Zee, Nulgath has empowered his oldest and most devoted Fiend's to further shape his very image. There is no purity left in their veins.

name: Evolved Bunny Berserker
description: This year's Bunny Berserker armor is as fierce as it is fuzzy! Find the Magical Marshmallow Cheep, The Gold-Foil Chocolate Bunny, and the Basketful of Dyed Eggs dropping off of the bosses in Greenguard forest and use them in Cabdury's merge shop. Happy Grenwog!

name: Evolved Carnage of Nulgath
description: The Original Blood Void of Nulgath, elevated to the Archfiend's inner circle. Countless rituals and battles bore fruit, creating the most vicious of the Nation's Generals.

name: Evolved Champion of Order
description: Behold the Champion of Order armor!

name: Evolved Chronomancer
description: Shape the forces of time itself to destroy your enemies and SAVE THE WORLD!

name: Evolved Clawsuit Armor
description: The Evolved Clawsuit is an unexpected (and unwanted) gift to all the naughty beings of the world. You spread more damage than cheer — and are incredibly good at it.

name: Evolved Conqueror of Shadows
description: Shrouded in darkness, the infamous conquerors are armed in heavy plates forged by shadow matter. The Conquerors of Shadow have been the natural enemy to the Wardens of Light since Lore's first nightfall.

name: Evolved Crimson Plate of Nulgath
description: Nulgath taints this armor with a power he strengthened in a realm beyond ours.

name: Evolved Dark Caster Armor

name: Evolved Fiend Of Nulgath

name: Evolved Grenadier
description: This time you're the one yelling "Bombs Away!"

name: Evolved LightCaster (Armor)
description: Shine on, Celestial Hero! This armor unlocks the LightMage Class.

name: Evolved Ogre's Armor

name: Evolved Paragon (Armor)

description: Divine guardians of the Light are armed in impenetrable steel plates strengthened by the sun. Wardens have been the natural enemy to the Conquerors of Shadow since the dawn of Lore.

name: Evolved Warlord of Nulgath
description: Courtesy of Zee, Nulgath has empowered his strongest and most devoted warriors to further shape his very image. There is no purity left in their veins.

name: Evolved Worshipper of Nulgath
description: The Evolved Worshippers of Nulgath aspire to become fiends in Nulgath's service. They will do his bidding, even though they will always remain… just human.

name: Ewer Clothing
description: Traditionally made of straw, Ewer clothing and accessories are worn by the men and women of Western Nunsantara for ceremonies.

name: Exalted Drakath
description: As the Champion of Chaos, you are a force to be reckoned with. Upon reaching your exalted status, the world trembled in the face of your might and power.

name: Exalted Golden Guardian
description: Guided by Aranx the Celestine, these loyal followers of the Celestial Realm work endlessly to keep the balance and prevent the beasts of the Infernal Realm from destroying their home.

name: Exalted Knight of Fate
description: The protector of fate, sworn to shield and deliver those destined to change the world. They've sworn themselves to Kings and knelt to aspiring heroines, shielding them in every storm. (CC to Trim)

name: Exalted Legion Champion (Armor)
description: Only the greatest members of the Undead Legion can equip the Legion Champion armor!

name: Exalted MindBreaker Aviator (0 AC)
description: Members of the MindBreaker Guard that have been chosen to ride the Wyverns into battle, the MindBreaker Aviators can attack the foe from the air.

name: Exalted MindBreaker Aviator (AC)
description: Members of the MindBreaker Guard that have been chosen to ride the Wyverns into battle, the MindBreaker Aviators can attack the foe from the air.

name: Exalted Shield Knight of Fate
description: The protector of fate, sworn to shield and deliver those destined to change the world. They've sworn themselves to Kings and knelt to aspiring heroines, shielding them in every storm.

name: Excavated Pilot Armor
description: The protective suit worn by an ancient pilot found by Ghost in his travels.

name: Exctinction Survivor
description: These government issue clothes only come in sets of 13, but be careful, the last two sets tend to be defective.

name: Executioner Of Grimskull
description: The dungeon needed a final challenge, so you answered the call. When he saw yo, Grimskull pointed, and yelled "Now THIS is a finisher! Final Boss material!" before scrambling off to compose you a new heavy-metal theme song.

name: Executioner of the Gods
description: What cannot be bound or conquered must be destroyed.

name: Executive Asst. Vordred
description: YOU'RE FIRED! YOUR SKULL IS FIRED!

name: Exile Officer Armor (AC)
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PVP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Exile Officer Armor (Legend)
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PVP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Exodus Guardian (Armor)
description: The Exodus Titan is an awe-insiring mystery. They once served a higher purpose, one of divine ambition. To this day, they spread terror with reckless abandon, until one of their own was defeated by a fateful encounter with a certain Dragonlord.

name: ExoSkeletal Warrior (AC)
description: Initially acting as scouts to Laken the Good, exoskeletal troopers swore off his cause once they tasted the cold flavors of the Undead Legion. Now they act as double agents to opposing sides in order to plant seeds of distrust onto them.

name: ExoSkeletal Warrior (Legend)
description: Initially acting as scouts to Laken the Good, exoskeletal troopers swore off his cause once they tasted the cold flavors of the Undead Legion. Now they act as double agents to opposing sides in order to plant seeds of distrust onto them.

name: ExoSkin
description: Constructed by the infamous armor-crafter, Reddy, this Exo Skin will be sure to scare the sweet bejoneses out of any enemies you come across.

name: Exosuit Binoku
description: This epically transforming suit will astonish your friends and terrify your foes! Click the different parts of the suit to gain blades, shining runes, or rocky shoulders!

name: Expendable Rogue (Armor)
description: *No description*

name: Explorer Naval Commander
description: Weigh anchor and set sail, mateys! Keelhaul ye enemies with this class maroonin' them to an island where they be need'd sea turtles to escape!

name: Extraterreptile
description: Dinosaurs once ruled our world. Extraterreptiles currently rule another.

name: Fa's Attire
description: Fa's letting you borrow her clothes, as a thank you for all the errands you've run.

name: Fa's Bunny Girl Attire
description: Re gave Fa this costume as a gift for Grenwog day, but it's not the typical type of attire meant for that celebration. She was likely looking for an excuse to get Fa to wear something cute.

name: Fa's Casual Ensemble
description: ﻿Fa's family left Astravia to find a new home. Having recieved amnesty from the Swordhaven Crown, she reluctantly took up construction work to take some of the load off of Song and Mi's shoulders. During off hours, she sleeps, games, and forgets to eat. (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Fa's Casual Wear
description: Fa's comfy sweater. Perfect for a gaming night.

name: Fa's Sleeveless Wear
description: Fa's comfy sleeveless sweater. Perfect for a fighting-game night.

name: Fa's Swimsuit
description: Fa is too busy clearing summer events on her mobile games, so Re has to be the one picking out her swimsuit.

name: Fabled Doomknight
description: An armor that seeps into your being, twists your flesh, and taints your soul. A small price to pay for power, survival, and claiming your fate.

name: Fabyo Loso's Look
description: "You actually thought that I, Fabyo Loso, wouldn't let you steal my look?" ~ Fabyo Loso

name: Faceless Knight
description: Sometimes you have to do what’s right. Even if it means stabbing someone in the back.

name: Fae and Daz Morphs
description: Now become one of the Magi of Za'nar!

name: Fae (Armor)
description: Faes are perhaps the most nobles of all woodland pixies, praised for their wisdom and playfulness and revered for their magic and herbalism. Faes only appear during the Spring, and are thought to be one of the rarest faries in all of Lore.

name: Fae Gunslinger
description: For ages, Drow have used Bows and Arrows to hunt down their prey and have taught their techniques to the Humans. As a Fae Gunslinger, you're armed to the teeth with a much more explosive--and accurate--arsenal.

name: Fae's Fable Kitty Dress
description: The cutest form Fae could ever turn into. You better not sneeze!

name: Faerie Grove Sentinel
description: This magical guardian's garb is woven from enchanted moonlight and faerie wings, worn by the sworn protectcors of Chiral Valley's harmony.

name: Faerie Guardian
description: The Faeries of Greenguard Forest are known to keep butterflies as pets, and craft many of their outfits based on the colorful patterns of the Monarch Butterfly's wings.

name: Fairy Attendant
description: Thank you all for the support,take this item as my gesture of gratitude. - Neihi, the Dream Fairy

name: Fairy Leprechaun
description: Feeling the Lucky Day fun in this festive fairy armor!

name: Fairy Tale Romance Dress
description: Remember, we're aiming for a happily ever fairy tale romance! Shakesperean is off the menu! (Item is CC)

name: Fairy Tale Romance Garb
description: Remember, we're aiming for a happily ever fairy tale romance! Shakesperean is off the menu! (Item is CC)

name: Fairy Tale Wanderer
description: Join the guild and prepare for amazing adventures with your fellow wanderers!

name: FairyTale Royalty
description: Be our guest and celebrate Stryche and Amarelle's fairytale wedding!

name: FairyTale Wedding
description: Be our guest and celebrate Stryche and Amarelle's fairytale wedding!

name: Faken
description: There can only be ONE Laken, but it couldn't hurt to have an army of FAKENs running around slaying things. So here you go!

name: Falcon Ranger
description: Swift and precise, your prey won't know that you're circling them until it's too late.

name: FalconLord Armor
description: The FalconLord Guardians that protect the tower are among Falconreach's fiercest, most skilled warriors. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Fall Fae Assassin
description: The blades of the Fall Fae Court are mixed-blood Changelings. Though their ruler may shun them, they loyally serve their kin and dispatch those who would insult their throne.

name: Fall Fae Ruler
description: The Kings and Queens of the Fall Court dress modestly, bearing flowers and gentle smiles. They welcome their prey with open arms, dragging them deep under the dying leaves.

name: Fall Fighter
description: Ward off brittle oak leaves! Equip heavy cloth armor and boots! Prepare your palate for a sugary buttery overload! Fall has arrived, and the time has come for you to become a Fall Fighter!

name: Fall Forest Traveler
description: A cozy ensemble designed for fall foragers. Charmed strings are laced into this outfit to protect you from the dangers lurking in the crisp chill and vibrant leaves. Go mushroom and cranberry picking to your heart's content.

name: Fall ScareCrow
description: The best way to sneak up on your enemy is to blend in with your environment. During Harvest, what better camouflage than as a scarecrow?

name: Fall Uniform
description: A wise hero knows that no matter what season it is, there is always more to learn.

name: Fallen Amadis
description: When the wings of the archangel are ripped from his back and he plummets from the heavens, the darkness that is the Underworld consumes his being, transforming him into the Fallen Amadis.

name: Fallen Arthelyn (Armor)
description: The Archangel of Stoicism fought her fate valiantly, but The Bright One's will is absolute. Until her brethren are freed, the Celestials and Infernals can do nothing but obey and fall.

name: Fallen Champion
description: What happens when a champion of good goes bad? Well, there's only one way to find out.

name: Fallen Darkblood (Armor)
description: These bones rose from the Death Pits. Vici called upon them in the name of duty. They are to guard the prison of their ancestor, ensuring that the Darkdweller will remain in shadows forevermore.

name: Fallen DeathKnight (Armor)
description: Once they served the Celestial Realm but these DeathKnights now follow Ivoliss.

name: Fallen Frostspawn Warrior
description: Glacera is a harsh land, twisting those who chosse into monstrous shadows of their former selves.

name: Fallen Guardian
description: Cast from the Celestial Realm a millennia ago, these divine beings have lived in the Infernal Realm waiting, waiting for a time to retake the world they were exiled from.

name: Fallen Minion
description: Beasts of the lower Infernal Realm, destined for a life of suffering.

name: Fallen MonsterHunter
description: Sometimes an adventurer may fall. That is a risk you take in hunting monsters. But a HERO will always rise back up and continue the battle.

name: Fallen Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Once a servant of the Light, this navy fell into the Underworld, where it now sails restlessly through the Stygian waters.

name: Fallen Naval Commander (AC)
description: Once a servant of the Light, this navy fell into the Underworld, where it now sails restlessly through the Stygian waters.

name: Fallen Shaman Warrior
description: Once revered for their acts, these Shaman have been shunned. Only they know the reasons and those who they tell do not live to repeat the tail.

name: Fallen SoulBreaker (0 AC)
description: These fierce and furious warriors are souls who flew too close to the sun, and fell to violence. The Lord of the Underworld took them from the Seven Circles, and refined their bodies into calm, elegant, killers.

name: Fallen SoulBreaker (AC)
description: These fierce and furious warriors are souls who flew too close to the sun, and fell to violence. The Lord of the Underworld took them from the Seven Circles, and refined their bodies into calm, elegant, killers.

name: Fallen Wanderer (AC)
description: Cold? Bah! Who's cold with all this armor on? You think you have the guts to wander the Northlands? Well bring on the cold!

name: Fallen Wanderer (Special)
description: Cold? Bah! Who's cold with all this armor on? You think you have the guts to wander the Northlands? Well bring on the cold!

name: Fallen Warlord (Armor)
description: Falling from the heights only lends you the power to shine even brighter!

name: FallenFire Mage
description: Fire infuses your veins, wrapping around your hands so when danger approaches you are ready to strike.

name: Fancy Awards Show Tux
description: Walk the red carpet in this stylish frock while rocking to the Zardile Rock!

name: Fancy Corvus
description: Crows and ravens abound at this time of year… celebrate them along with the Moon!(cc to Accessory)

name: Fancy Dress
description: You know you're looking good when you rock this dress, no matter how fancy the /party or how chill the evening hangout.

name: Fancy Finery
description: You always want to look your best when you're with the one you love. Now, you will!

name: Fancy Goth Suit
description: Formalwear for all your fanciest Mogloween parties.

name: Fancy Gothic Suit (AC)
description: When you're wandering through a strange new realm, looking good means feeling confident. And confidence makes you a less attractive target for enemies.

name: Fancy Gothic Suit (Legend)
description: When you're wandering through a strange new realm, looking good means feeling confident. And confidence makes you a less attractive target for enemies.

name: Fancy Love Formal Wear
description: Sometimes it can be fun to dress up for a formal Heroes Heart Day occasion.

name: Fancy Villager Armor
description: You are the creme de la creme of Little Etherstorm's society! The rich of the rich. Everyone wants to be you.

name: Fantasia Fairy
description: The Fantasia Fae are born immaculately from new flower buds, or the reflection of stars on pond water. They attract eyes and wishes, fated to create a Fae cout of their own.

name: Fantasy Bard
description: Become the literal meaning of a fantastic bard! You are a poet and you didn't even know it. Until now.

name: Fantasy Warrior
description: Forged by Impactor for the Fantasy player in all of us, this armor embodies the essence of fantasy and the will of a warrior. Fully protected and ready for battle, you should be on your way to victory in no time.

name: far0mancer
description: Only during this month of the year, far0 presents you one of his greatest creations, made for his most loyal fanatics! far0 further blesses this exquisite armor so you could customize its colour to your personal tastes.

name: Faraday Suit
description: Become one with the LIGHTNING! (Faraday suit is one size fits all.)

name: Fat Panda
description: Only YOU can make panda this fat. Vote for Fat Panda! —Team Fat Pandas

name: Fate's Archer
description: Transcendent armor capable of bestowing the wielder with unremarkable power.

name: Faustian Plague Doctor
description: Doctors who hunt for the cure to the most dangerous of diseases. Whether it's Lycanthropy, Vampirism, or corruption of evil origin - they must be eradicated by any means necessary.

name: Favored of Kyanos
description: The Favored of Kyanos have very special gear to help handle the cold as they battle through the icy lands of Glacera.

name: Fear's Garb
description: Fear is something you control. You are the master of your fears. And when you equip this armor,you'll become the master of everyone else's fears, as well, when they weep with fright just from looking at you.

name: Fellow Gamer
description: How do you do, fellow AdventureQuest Worlders?

name: Fellow Player
description: How do you do, fellow AdventureQuest Worlders?

name: Fenrir Legion Armor
description: You are the top dogs when it comes to Legion rankings!

name: Feral Fiend of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: This isn't a Fiend anyone in the Nation recognizes. Is this trickster a creature from the Void? With enough magic and wit to get past the Archfiend's watchful gaze, they have to be a personification of the Void's duplicitousness itself.

name: Feral Fiend of Nulgath (AC)
description: This isn't a Fiend anyone in the Nation recognizes. Is this trickster a creature from the Void? With enough magic and wit to get past the Archfiend's watchful gaze, they have to be a personification of the Void's duplicitousness itself.

name: Fest-EBIL Terminator (0 AC)
description: Offensive systems have activated. Objective set to "Equalize." No one's going to get more presents than you are.

name: Fest-EBIL Terminator (AC)
description: Offensive systems have activated. Objective set to "Equalize." No one's going to get more presents than you are.

name: Festa da Fierce
description: Look fierce for the Festa! The power of the Jaguar envelopes you as you festa on to victory!

name: Festa das Cores (AC)
description: Get ready to /party! The Festa das Cores is the perfect gear to wear when you want to show off at Carnaval.

name: Festa das Cores (Legend)
description: Get ready to /party! The Festa das Cores is the perfect gear to wear when you want to show off at Carnaval.

description: The merriest of the merry men (and women) of Greenguard Forest!

description: The merriest of the merry men (and women) of Greenguard Forest!

description: He's making a list but no need to check it twice since Jimmy already did. Santa Warlic's coming to town!

name: Festive ArchMage Armor (0 AC)
description: Have a holly jolly Frostval! It's the most magical time of the year!

description: Have a holly jolly Frostval! It's the most magical time of the year!

description: Poor Elf! Who knows how long the outfits have been stuck inside Giefurious!

name: Festive Brutalcorn
description: o/~ Tis the season to be brutal, huhuhuhuhuh huh huh huh huuuuuh o/~

name: Festive Caroler
description: Wow your neighbors with your outfit and ability to hit the high notes. Just remember to turn the actual magic off when you sing. A stun spell laced into a song isn't very festive.

name: Festive Cheer Suit
description: Now you're ready for the Frostval spirit!

name: Festive Cheers Sweater
description: Clink your mugs of hot cocoa and dive into the holiday spirit!

name: Festive DoomKnight
description: Feared throughout the history of time, the Doom Knight shows little remorse for the living, even during Frostval. Sympathy is only derived from brute force.

name: Festive Fae (AC)
description: Faes are perhaps the most noble of all woodland pixies, praised for their wisdom and playfulness and revered for their magic and herbalism. Pink fae only appear during the Spring, and are thought to be one of the rarest faeries in all of Lore.

name: Festive Fae (Legend)
description: Faes are perhaps the most noble of all woodland pixies, praised for their wisdom and playfulness and revered for their magic and herbalism. Pink fae only appear during the Spring, and are thought to be one of the rarest faeries in all of Lore.

name: Festive Frostval Elf
description: Poor Elf! Who knows how long the outfits have been stuck inside Giefurious!

name: Festive Frostval Suit (0 AC)
description: You can still be goth and festive. Rock on.

name: Festive Frostval Suit (AC)
description: You can still be goth and festive. Rock on.

name: Festive Giefury Armor
description: Bro, do you even gift?

name: Festive Giftbearer
description: When delivering Frostval gifts, it's always a good idea to dress the part!

name: Festive Globetrotter (0 AC)
description: Classes are out for the holidays, and there's way too much to see out there! This is the perfect time for sightseeing, festive party-going, and casual street fights.

name: Festive Globetrotter (AC)
description: Classes are out for the holidays, and there's way too much to see out there! This is the perfect time for sightseeing, festive party-going, and casual street fights.

name: Festive Inaba Oni
description: Most Oni are painted with a single brutal, and bloody brush. In reality, there are several independent clans. One revels in festivities and attend tournaments to show off their strength, dressed in merry-making garb.

name: Festive New Year Gear
description: May this new year be filled with happiness, prosperity, and many precious moments with your loved ones. Happy Lunar New Year!

name: Festive Party Outfit
description: A fun party outfit in which to celebrate the Bright Lights Festival! (Color Custom)

name: Festive Punk Elf
description: It's a punk rock Frostval, and the Frostval trees are decorated with safety pins.

name: Festive Sled Racer
description: Warm garb worn by sled racers for the traditional yearly race. The red colors aren't just festive. They're easy to spot if you happen to get lost in an avalanche.

name: Festive Snowman
description: Don't worry about the summer sun melting this snowman!

name: Festive Sweater Weather
description: Weather the snowy festive season with a cozy sweater, cup of hot moglinberry juice, and a warm spirit.

name: Festive Symbiote
description: Even a parasite can get into the holiday spirit right? Behold the power of Frostval!

name: Festive Usagi Oni
description: Most Oni are painted with a single brutal, and bloody brush. In reality, there are several indepedent clans. One revels in festivities and attend tournaments to show off their strength, dressed in merry-making garbs.

name: Festive Weaponsmith
description: The Mad Weaponsmith's holly jolly cheer outfit! You better watch out! you better watch out! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT, YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! Cysero Clause is coming. He's coming.

name: Festive Yulgar Outfit
description: That gift box might be possessed, but it still holds a lot of awesome loot! Happy Frostval!

name: Fianna Rebel
description: The people of Skye have had enough tyranny. They will weather the storm, and free their homeland and children from another century of sorrow.

name: Field Guardian (Armor)
description: Field Guardians scare a lot more than just crows…

name: Fieldy's Outfit
description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as Fieldy!

name: Fiend Carapace Armor
description: You've fashioned armor out of discarded Fiend skin. Ewwww… but kind of cool.

name: Fiend Champion of Adimonde
description: The Fiend Champion contains a small amount of Adimonde's power, given via the Fiend Shard. As they grow in power, so does Adimonde.

name: Fiend Mauler
description: You may think I am evil. I am not. I am the MOST EVIL.

name: Fiend Minion
description: Small but fierce, this being is known for having a high quantity of Void Energy. Even though its rank is low, it can still compensate with its endurance and its constant evolving power.

name: Fiend of Light
description: Fiends who have fallen but still try to uphold the power of the Light. Keeping the forces of Darkness away while fighting not to succumb to it's grasp.

name: Fiend of Love
description: Happy birthday to our favorite Pink Scribe, Beleen! May all your writings be cheerful.

name: Fiend of Nulgath
description: Nulgath says, "Perhaps a more straight forward but powerful approach is more your style. Naturally armored, Fiends Voids are savage breed in my army. They are primal beasts that have no fear. Charging into the front lines of the enemy, they can thrash the ranks into disarray."

name: Fiend of Nulgath (Rare)
description: Nulgath says, "Perhaps a more straight forward but powerful approach is more your style. Naturally armored, Fiends Voids are savage breed in my army. They are primal beasts that have no fear. Charging into the front lines of the enemy, they can thrash the ranks into disarray."

name: Fiend of the Underworld
description: In the eternal war for domination of the Underworld, Dage and Nulgath both vie for the same souls and warriors. Which master did this warrior serve first? Only the darkness knows.

name: Fiend Of Voracity (Armor)
description: One of the many discarded clones the Nation experimented on to turn the Archfiend into a weapon that can slay the God of Fiends. This creature is Nulgath with every part of his identity stripped away. What remained was mindless hunger.

name: Fiend Warrior
description: Savage and thirsty, this being is the second in charge of the Archfiend army. High level training and a massive natural Void Energy merged into a monstruous warrior.

name: Fiendish Abomination (0 AC)
description: Certain Nation pact bearers bond so well to the Fiend's Void that their bodies mutate out of control. Their muscles and spines keep growing and growing. Soon, they'll be the Archfiend's own titans.

name: Fiendish Abomination (AC)
description: Certain Nation pact bearers bond so well to the Fiend's Void that their bodies mutate out of control. Their muscles and spines keep growing and growing. Soon, they'll be the Archfiend's own titans.

name: Fiendish Arachnomancer
description: These Arachnomancers the most fearsome cannibals in Nulgath's Nation. Their venom, unbridled violence, and the hunters' own fear of arachnids are enough to turn them into the hunted.

name: Fiendish Beast Master (0 AC)
description: An unfathomable number of beasts have been submerged in the Fiend's Void, emerging as uncontrollable mutated monsters. The Nation's Beast Master is tasked with taming and training them for the Archfiend's needs.

name: Fiendish Beast Master (AC)
description: An unfathomable number of beasts have been submerged in the Fiend's Void, emerging as uncontrollable mutated monsters. The Nation's Beast Master is tasked with taming and training them for the Archfiend's needs.

name: Fiendish Cyber Shinobi (0 AC)
description: The dangers of the dark cyberworld are deaddlier than they seem. Those who try to shine light on the shinobi's master's secrets vanish without a trace.

name: Fiendish Cyber Shinobi (AC)
description: The dangers of the dark cyberworld are deaddlier than they seem. Those who try to shine light on the shinobi's master's secrets vanish without a trace.

name: Fiendish Darkness
description: Following Oblivion's departure from the Elemental Plane of Darkness, others of his kind followed suit. The Fiend's Void gave them power they would never see from their Avatar.

name: Fiendish Devourer of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Though their contracts have long since settled, these Fiends continue to feast on the Nation's enemies. Embodying a ceaseless hunger, Nulgath keeps them in cages until the war horns sound.

name: Fiendish Devourer of Nulgath (AC)
description: Though their contracts have long since settled, these Fiends continue to feast on the Nation's enemies. Embodying a ceaseless hunger, Nulgath keeps them in cages until the war horns sound.

name: Fiendish DoomKnight
description: Not even the dark magic of the Shadowscythe is enough to satisfy this soul's lust for power. If the Archfiend's power is still not enough, there's no telling what is. Suggested by Ferozakh.

name: Fiendish DoomKnight of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Fallen DoomKnights who join with Nulgath the ArchFiend are among the most feared in the Nation.

name: Fiendish DoomKnight of Nulgath (AC)
description: Fallen DoomKnights who join with Nulgath the ArchFiend are among the most feared in the Nation.

name: Fiendish Dracomancer
description: Upon obtaining a Dragon bone from the Shadowscythe Empire's fortress, Nulgath used it to create his Fiendish Dracomancers. Their mutations are unpredictable, but allow them to harness the original Dragon's glorious might.

name: Fiendish DragonKnight (0 AC)
description: Fiendish DragonKnights have tamed the fiercesome wyrms of Tercessuinotlim, and have proven their ability to ride into battle and emerge victorious! (Click on robe to show/hide fabric)

name: Fiendish DragonKnight (AC)
description: Fiendish DragonKnights have tamed the fiercesome wyrms of Tercessuinotlim, and have proven their ability to ride into battle and emerge victorious! (Click on robe to show/hide fabric)

name: Fiendish Loremaster
description: The more you know… the better you can serve the Master!

name: Fiendish Monkey King (AC)
description: A warrior who honed their martial arts in the harsh depths of the Fiend's Void. Prideful and arrogant, they spread destruction and havoc wherever they wander.

name: Fiendish Monkey King (Legend)
description: A warrior who honed their martial arts in the harsh depths of the Fiend's Void. Prideful and arrogant, they spread destruction and havoc wherever they wander.

name: Fiendish Outlaw
description: Any outlaw willing to serve and obey the orders of Nulgath the ArchFiend is welcome in the Nation. But beware… the price for betrayal is eternal suffering.

name: Fiendish VoidCaster
description: Those who sign Nulgath's contract gain access to the infinite wellspring of arcane energy contained within the void. Be warned, almost everyone who accepts this power find themselves consumed by it.

name: Fierce Pie-Rate
description: Avast! Captain Rhubarb has been Artix Entertainment's favorite programming pirate for 10 years! /cheer! Here's to many more years keeping AE sailing in the right course!

name: Fierce Pink Pie-Rate (AC)
description: Even Captain Rhubarb has fallen prey to Beleen's love of pink!

name: Fierce Pink Pie-Rate (Legend)
description: Even Captain Rhubarb has fallen prey to Beleen's love of pink!

name: Fierce Scientist J6 (0 AC)
description: All robots know that a mastery of GLAMOUR SCIENCE is a requirement!

name: Fierce Scientist J6 (AC)
description: All robots know that a mastery of GLAMOUR SCIENCE is a requirement!

name: Fierce Scientist J6 (Legend)
description: All robots know that a mastery of GLAMOUR SCIENCE is a requirement!

name: Fiery BrightPyre Warrior
description: The gift of fire was one a rare gift that could turn vicious if not handled with respect. BrightPyre Warriors traveled far and wide to hone their craft and teach others. They still traverse Lore, lending their craft to those left in the cold.

name: Fiery Fenix Plume (AC)

description: He sees you when you're frozen, he knows when you have thawed, he brings you gifts and cheer and gear, so much that you'll be awed!

name: Frostval Barbarian Armor (AC)
description: During Frostval these nomadic wanderers from the north travel from town to town giving gifts and protecting those in need. You don't want to be on their naughty list though, else be on the receiving end of their most infamous gift - their pure rage.

name: Frostval Barbarian Armor (Legend)
description: During Frostval these nomadic wanderers from the north travel from town to town giving gifts and protecting those in need. You don't want to be on their naughty list though, else be on the receiving end of their most infamous gift - their pure rage.

description: The moglins of Frostvale wish you warm nights, loving family, and cheerful companions. Merry Frostval!

name: Frostval Blessing Armor (AC)
description: The moglins of Frostvale wish you warm nights, loving family, and cheerful companions. Merry Frostval!

name: Frostval Caroler
description: To get the warm fuzzies, you need to dress warm and fuzzy! Stroll those winter streets, and sing a carol or two in a coat that feels like a bear hug!

name: Frostval Cheermaker
description: Jingle bells pinned to festive red lapels. Twinkling stars and special moments written into a memoir. The holidays are only once a year. Put your whole heart into it!

name: Frostval Deer Suit
description: The perfect suit to help the big guy on Frostval Eve.

name: Frostval DragonSlayer
description: RAAAAWR! Even DragonSlayers like to look festive during the holidays.

name: Frostval Fa (0 AC)
description: Fa already wears sweaters, so this isn't anything new. But getting new games, a bunch of days off, and gorging on Ti's spiced Turkey stuffing? She could get used to this.

name: Frostval Fa (AC)
description: Fa already wears sweaters, so this isn't anything new. But getting new games, a bunch of days off, and gorging on Ti's spiced Turkey stuffing? She could get used to this.

name: Frostval Fiend
description: He's making a list he's checking it twice, going to find out who's naughty and give them all the presents since this is Nulgath we're talking about.

name: Frostval Ice Blessing Outfit
description: That gift box might be possessed, but it still holds a lot of awesome loot! Happy Frostval!

name: Frostval Naval CommanDEER
description: If the seven seas freeze over, it's not the end of the world… it just means celebrating Frostval out on the open waters. Dress to match the season.

name: Frostval NutCracker
description: This festive symbol of luck also wards off evil spirits, so ghost of Frostval past beware!

name: Frostval Trissa Armor
description: (Female Only) Trissa always has the best outfits… now you can dress up just like her!

name: Frostval Valencia Armor
description: (Female Only) Valencia always has the best outfits… now you can dress up just like her!

name: Frostval Villager Armor
description: In the little town of Snowsheart Peak, the villagers know you have to depend on each other, because the world is cold and dark and scary. But by helping each other, everything -- and everyone -- will be alright.

name: Frostvale Envoy
description: As the official Envoy of Frostvale one must always dress on the appropriate festive attire. Everyone will be awaiting the Dragon King Festival!

name: Frostvale Healer
description: Their mana is the spirit of Frostval itself, so these holiday Mages are always in a good mood!

name: Frostvale Mage
description: Their mana is the spirit of Frostval itself, so these holiday Mages are always in a good mood!

name: Frostvale Robina
description: It's Frostvale, and Robina has changed her gear so that she blends in!

name: Frosty Armor
description: It's Frosty, the warrior… If you want to block out the cold, why not try using armor and ice? Its all the rage in Frostvale this year.

name: Frosty Cheerleader
description: Gimme an 'H', gimme an 'A', gimme a 'P' 'P' 'Y'. breathe Gimme an 'N' 'E' 'W'! Gimme a 'Y' 'E' 'A' 'R'!!! Happy New Year!

name: Frosty Moglinster
description: Fro-stee the moglin was…not very jolly or happy.

name: Frosty the Polar-din
description: Frosty the Polar-din was a bright good-hearted knight! He was made of snow and as children know, he shone bright in the winter light!

name: Frozen Arabesque (0 AC)
description: The style and dress of a lost culture of fae. Or perhaps they were elves. Their magic arts and combat style where sharp, but unique to each member, like the fractals of snowflakes.

name: Frozen Arabesque (AC)
description: The style and dress of a lost culture of fae. Or perhaps they were elves. Their magic arts and combat style where sharp, but unique to each member, like the fractals of snowflakes.

name: Frozen Dawn Battlemage
description: Shine like a winters morning among the snowy mountains.

name: Frozen DeathKnight
description: The Frost and Frozen DeathKnights are two contingents of the icy army set to ward the Northlands and any other area where ice reigns supreme.

name: Frozen Dracolich Lord (Armor)
description: The Northlands are a ruthless tundra and chain of mountains, where people are scattered and worship a menagerie of gods. A dragonlord flew into the blizzards to feed these gods to their dragon, and became something deadly.

name: Frozen Fury
description: The enchanted ice built onto this armor helps keep the cold of the Northlands at bay.

name: Frozen Hatred
description: The North Mountain isn't for everyone, if you wish to seek out it's riches then make sure to dress for the elements, for they are unforgiving.

name: Frozen in Time
description: They came in the cold of the night and took everyone…

name: Frozen Pyromancer (Armor)
description: You're on FIRE!

name: Frozen Royalty
description: Monarchs that love the winter and crystals in frost have hearts as frozen as their power. Devoid of happiness, timidity, and anger, they carry out their schemes without ever feeling guilty of their doing.

name: Frozen Soul Knight
description: After the fall of man, during the battle for the Northlands, a sorcerer resurrected the souls every every knight that passed. Now they are on a mission to finish what they started a long time ago. How do you kill that which has already been killed?

name: Frozen Warlock Robe
description: Wargoth, the Frozen Mage, rules a chilling vision of the future to come… unless YOU save the day!

name: FrozenDawn Herald
description: As the first rays of the sun rise over the Northlands, the FrozenDawn Herald calls out with joy to welcome the start of the Frostval in July holiday!

name: Frozenfire BeastTamer (0 AC)
description: ﻿This BeastTamer freezes the magma flows pouring out of active volcanoes, trapping the beasts slumbering inside. It is one of the only surefire ways to gain enough time to tame them.

name: Frozenfire BeastTamer (AC)
description: ﻿This BeastTamer freezes the magma flows pouring out of active volcanoes, trapping the beasts slumbering inside. It is one of the only surefire ways to gain enough time to tame them.

name: FrozenShard Courtier (0 AC)
description: Nature is cold, wet, hard and unforgiving. As are these courtiers.

name: FrozenShard Courtier (AC)
description: Nature is cold, wet, hard and unforgiving. As are these courtiers.

description: Deep in the frozen Northlands, high-pitched giggles ring out,and all shudder, knowing that the Chaos Twins are near… and trouble isn't far behind.

description: Deep in the heart of the frozen Northlands, Chaos power lays dormant, trapped under dark ice… waiting for its Champion to return and unleash it.

name: Fryin Man
description: This particular hero would come save the day if promised one or more strips of bacon in return to maintain control over its acrobatic feline abilities and because it has a strong bacon craving.

name: Full Body Flames
description: Grab your SPF 9000 and hit the sands of Lore, beach bunnies and surfer dudes… because covering your body with flames doesn't make you immune to the sun!

name: Full Moon Buccaneer (0 AC)
description: Werewolves who chased the moon into the seas. Ships sail warily under the night sky, listening for howls. Any merchant vessel or single dinghy can turn into a flurry of claws and teeth.

name: Full Moon Buccaneer (AC)
description: Werewolves who chased the moon into the seas. Ships sail warily under the night sky, listening for howls. Any merchant vessel or single dinghy can turn into a flurry of claws and teeth.

name: Fully Transparent Ninja
description: … Being fully transparent, I can't tell if anyone's there.

name: Furred Frostlorn Rogue
description: The shoulder-cape of the Frostlorn Rogue protects from the cold while still allowing total arm movement for fighting or pick-pocketing.

name: Furred Ice Giant
description: Legend has it that these giants roam the hills outside of Frostval. While you've never seen a live one, you have found their clothing… so you can dress like one!

name: Furry Symbiote
description: Even a parasite can get into the holiday spirit right? Behold the power of Frostval!

name: Fury Fiend of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: These fiends are fueled by the fires of Nulgath's fury at any who would oppose him.

name: Fury Fiend of Nulgath (AC)
description: These fiends are fueled by the fires of Nulgath's fury at any who would oppose him.

name: Fusion Hero
description: You are a legend formed before, during, and after the fusion of 3 very different worlds, and their elements and timelines. Your fate is in your hands… what will you do with it?

name: Fusion Rider
description: You are a legend formed before, during, and after the fusion of 3 very different worlds, and their elements and timelines. Your fate is in your hands… what will you do with it?

description: Dage's Undead Legion will rule over everything. Will YOU fight for your future?

name: FutureParagon Mk 1 CannonHand
description: Dage's Undead Legion will rule over everything. Will YOU fight for your future?

name: Fyreborn Mauler
description: Mauler's have adapted well to the harsh conditions of Embersea.

name: Fyreborn TigerMaster (AC)
description: I knew this other feline master that didn't play fair, he was such a cheetah.

name: Fyreborn TigerMaster Guard armor (AC)
description: Still pretty tough without your tiger.

name: Fyreborn TigerMaster Guard armor (Special)
description: Still pretty tough without your tiger.

name: Fyreborn TigerMaster (Special)
description: I knew this other feline master that didn't play fair, he was such a cheetah.

name: Gaian Warrior
description: Gaian's appreciate nature and all it gives us. They go to great lengths to protect every living thing.

name: Galactic Assassin
description: Walk through the void known as time, but be wary of what lies at the end.

name: Galactic Battle Pilot
description: Soar through air and space defending those who cannot fight for themselves. Pet cat not included.

name: Galactic BattleMage (0 AC)
description: You've wandered the stars in search of new spells and fighting techniques. Your adventurers have made you a master of manipulating space and time. The future is yours!

name: Galactic BattleMage (AC)
description: You've wandered the stars in search of new spells and fighting techniques. Your adventurers have made you a master of manipulating space and time. The future is yours!
