description: Soar through air and space defending those who cannot fight for themselves.

name: Galactic Cheerleader
description: Now you can /cheer for your favorite superstars, no matter where in the universe you are!

name: Galactic Chronomancer (Armor)
description: The source of your magic flows in rivers between worlds, between timestreams. Tapping it requires a power very few mortals possess.

name: Galactic Commander (Armor)
description: In the depths of the unknown space, you are own ruler for galactic obstackles do not hold you back.

name: Galactic Defender (Armor)
description: In the depths of unknown space, you are own ruler for galactic obstackles do not hold you back.

name: Galactic Destroyer
description: The hands of this armor glow with an awesome power; its burning grip tells you to defeat your enemies!

name: Galactic Eviscerator
description: To infinity and beyond…the grave!

name: Galactic Gladinster
description: Former gladiators that escaped from Moglinster arenas. They use the skills they learned from the bloodsport to become deadly hired muscle and eventually get even with their former captors.

name: Galactic Imperator (Armor)
description: Galactic Imperators are not always super villains looking to control the galactic void, but when they ARE… they do all their conquering without leaving their thrones.

name: Galactic Infantry
description: Everything in space is meant to eliminate life. Then the best way to survive is to adapt to your surroundings. Become as dangerous as the yawning void.

name: Galactic Mage
description: The stars and nebulas that coat the underside the robes are spitting images of a more peaceful part of the galaxy. Aranx must've done a lot of space traveling and amethyst hunting to get this to become the latest space fashion friend.

name: Galactic Mech
description: After combining rich and exclusive resources taken from the Lore of MechQuest, this mech armor is unlike anything the people of AQW have ever seen…at least up to this point in time!

name: Galactic NaNdroid General
description: The Galactic NaNdroid General is noted for their ruthlessness in battle. The very name strikes fear into the heart of those who travel through the lands of the Galactic Federation.

name: Galactic Naval Commander
description: Ye always be sayin' how pirates be out of this world… 'n now ye can shoot for the stars 'n plunder the planets as the Galactic Naval Commander!

name: Galactic Paladin Commander
description: Another typical day of a Paladin fighting against the undead, except this time IN SPACE!

name: Galactic Pirate Commander (Armor)
description: Sail to the ends of the universe. Stop at the restaurant or pillage it. You're a galactic pirate go where the solar winds take you.

name: Galactic Shadow Commander (Armor)
description: Support the ShadowScythe Empire… in space!

name: Galactic Shadow Trooper
description: May the Fourth be with you… and help your aim!

name: Galactic Treasure Hunter
description: Strap on your boots, we're going treasure hunting… through time!

name: Galactic Warrior Monk
description: Galactic Warrior Monks are considered to be among the most respected warriors of the Crystallis administration, and serve as ambassadors to the Galactic Federation.

name: Galanoth's Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Sea dragons are nothing like their counterparts in the skies. Galanoth gears up in the heaviest garb he can find, diving into the perilous depths to slay massive ocean terrors.

name: Galanoth's Naval Commander (AC)
description: Sea dragons are nothing like their counterparts in the skies. Galanoth gears up in the heaviest garb he can find, diving into the perilous depths to slay massive ocean terrors.

name: Galatea Mech (AC)
description: Galatea's formidable mech. What are you waiting for? Go! Go! Fight the power!

name: Galatea Mech (Legend)
description: Galatea's formidable mech. What are you waiting for? Go! Go! Fight the power!

name: Galaxy Hunters
description: No bounty is to small for you to capitalize on. There's no dark corner of the galaxy that you won't visit to hunt for your bounties.

name: Galaxy Outfit (AC)
description: Check out my totally righteous tank top, dude. It's like, got stars on it and stuff. Woah.

name: Galaxy Outfit (Legend)
description: Check out my totally righteous tank top, dude. It's like, got stars on it and stuff. Woah.

name: Galaxy Witch
description: You look simply out of this world!

name: Galleon Crewmember
description: Man t' wheel as you and your hearties turn t' gears on your ship as you venture for treasure and adventure on t' open sea!

name: Game On Referee
description: It's your game, and your call. Make the right one, Hero!

name: Garaja Armor
description: The garb worn by the ice mage Garaja. Mastery over the art of snowglobe crafting is rare indeed.

name: Gargantuan Golem
description: As large as they are brainless, Golems have a history of working the dirty jobs. Every once in a while though, a Golem develops a soul. This poses many complex questions as to their use as work horses.

name: Garth Maul
description: When the thunder /rolls, and the lightning strikes (critically), Garth Maul is to blame, for all the sleepless knights.

name: Gate Keeper
description: No one knows what gate this fiendish wraith is guarding… but no one has been brave enough to ever find out. The runes are color custom to match your devious soul. Inspired by your fellow player, Revontheus!

name: GateKeeper of Vokun
description: To guard the gate is a life long commitment and maybe even beyond that…

name: Gatorguy
description: A most ferocious armor that strikes fear into your opponents. And by opponents, I mean prey.

name: Gatotkaca
description: Through your courage, strength, and humility, truth and justice will spread throughout the land.

name: Gearslinger
description: Bullets, lasers, jetpacks, you've got it all!

name: General Chud's Armor
description: One of Chud's favorite activities is to squish things whether they animate or not. This past time would eventually stick when he gets competitive and has his eyes for the prize. Anyone who dares to challenge would risk coming home with a memorable splat.

name: General Gall's Armor
description: Different from the other challengers, Gall, a rare albino drakel, is more then ready to demonstrate he means business one way or the other and forfeit is never one of them.

name: General Hun'Gar's Armor
description: Hun'Gar isn't called the Boulder for nothing. His brutal, inhuman strength could knock his foes off the ground before striking them as if he is an earthquake. With no stone going unturned, none will be safe from this aggressive fighter.

name: General Neesha (0 AC)
description: General Neesha is a wicked and fearsome warrior loyal to the Archfiend. Considered a veteran and the most loyal of Nulgath's followers, the lower echelons kneel in her presence. (Female Only)

name: General Neesha (AC)
description: General Neesha is a wicked and fearsome warrior loyal to the Archfiend. Considered a veteran and the most loyal of Nulgath's followers, the lower echelons kneel in her presence. (Female Only)

name: General Nevanna
description: She who defends Brightoak should take caution, lest she becomes the very general that will destroy it.

name: General of Cerberus
description: Grrberus bows only 2 heads to you. Even at your highest level, he will never see you as superior.

name: General Velm's Armor
description: Velm is the type of fighter who would face his foes head-on without a doubt. His enthusiasm for a tough battle never leaves his draconian body.

name: Generals of the Ignited Ones
description: The Order of the Ignited Ones have been under attack for many centuries finding the need for militaristic strategies. Their generals might be warm blooded but their cold hearts make for calculated yet vicious strikes.

name: Genesis of Revontheus
description: (Color Custom) Heavens ripped open, cries of angels in despair. When time was not yet know, and when worlds yet to exist. Revontheus, the true Revontheus, before his fall to the abyss, created this being whos power was known to tame time…he gave this being to those who managed to persist, the deceitfully dark abyss…

name: Geodic Warrior (0 AC)
description: By the strength of the stones that shape their bones, Geodic Warriors are bound to server the Avatar of Earth.

name: Geodic Warrior (AC)
description: By the strength of the stones that shape their bones, Geodic Warriors are bound to server the Avatar of Earth.

name: Geomancer
description: Your mastery of elemental earth magic has taken your magic to powerful new depths.

name: Geomancer Armor
description: Druids say that there is power in the very land - in all living things. As a Geomancer, you can use that power to keep the world safe.

name: Ghastly Avenger
description: Why aren't you just the coolest ghoul around?

name: Ghost's Wanderer Gear
description: The travel-worn gear of the spectral dragonlord.

name: Ghostly Moglin Suit
description: You might be dead, gray, and full of regret, but that won't stop you from being cute.

name: Ghostly Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: No one knows exactly what turned these one spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they want far below Davy Jone's locker.

name: Ghostly Naval Commander (AC)
description: No one knows exactly what turned these one spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they want far below Davy Jone's locker.

name: Ghostly Reception Garb
description: Dance through the night - and beyond time - in this Ghostly reception wear.

name: Ghostly Spirit Mage
description: When you transcend the living world and become one with the spirit, you have truly achieved Spirit Mage.

name: Ghostly Wedding Garb
description: Dance through the night - and beyond time - in this Ghostly reception wear.

name: GI J6 (Armor)
description: GI J6: The Real AQWorlds Hero!

name: Giant Warrior
description: Giant boots and giant shoulders pads made for giant warriors.

name: Giefurious Armor
description: Bro, do you even gift?

name: Giefury Armor
description: Bro do you even gift?

description: *No description*

description: A gift from Tinsel, it will be unwrapped in the New Year!

name: GiftHunter
description: Dashing through the snow, giving gifts to one and all.  Over the fields we go, Frostval is a ball!

name: GigaShadowslayer
description: ﻿You are the ULTIMATE ShadowSlayer. So fierce and feared that no shirt can contain your dark power.

name: GilDead Gunslinger
description: The real wild west is out in Doomwood and Darkovia, where silver's a need instead of a luxury. These gunslingers ride after the dead, with the dead, until they're dead.

name: Gilded Blood Warlord
description: A legendary warlord of gold and blood. They served no crown or throne. Their loyalty laid with the thrill of battle. A warrior like that can't have been human, or stayed human after lifetimes of bloodshed.

name: Gilded Bounty Hunter
description: The real wild west is out in Doomwood and Darkovia, where silver's a need instead of a luxury. These gunslingers ride after the dead, with the dead, until they're dead.

name: Gilded Champion
description: Pretty decoration does not always equal combat readiness. With this armor, you can have both.

name: Gilded Cupid's Toga
description: Love is in the air… and in the coliseum… and the museum… love is everywhere!

name: Gilded Defender of Battleon
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Gilded Draco Knight
description: A Knight blessed with the magic of Dragons and golden armor. Wielding fire and might, they're proof of the deep connection between Human and Dragonkind.

name: Gilded Dragonlord
description: Xergon's gold corrupting curse definitely has its aesthetic perks.

name: Gilded Dwarfhold Prospector
description: It is customary to craft this honored armor from the gold mined in the heart of the Dwarves mountain home. It's a symbol of how they emerged from the depths without being swallowed by their own greed.

name: Gilded Fallen Angel
description: This armor is reserved for disgraced warriors who were exiled from the sky kingdoms.

name: Gilded Gladiator
description: Your fame is well deserved, your name is Gladiator. Require Gladiator Warrior armor + other drops.

name: Gilded Gunslinger
description: The real wild west is out in Doomwood and Darkovia, where silver's a need instead of a luxury. These gunslingers ride after the dead, with the dead, until they're dead.

name: Gilded Knight Armor
description: An armor that, over time, was gilded gold through the accomplishments of its wearer.

name: Gilded Love Formal Wear
description: (Color Custom) Sometimes it can be fun to dress up for a formal Heroes Heart Day occasion.

name: Gilded Magistrate
description: After proving lotalty to the magistracy time and time again, you are awarded with a more decorative armor for your efforts.

name: Gilded Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Gold be the only treasure worth searching for! Show your bounty by dressing in this fancy swag.

name: Gilded Naval Commander (AC)
description: Don't get yourself caught in this commander's web, it'll be the last thing ye ever do!

name: Gilded Victor of Battleon
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Gingerbread Claws Suit
description: Festive Frostval 2019! These giftboxes will open on January 1st, 2020 to reveal your EPIC Frostval set!

name: Girly Girl
description: She's so Bubbly!

name: Gjappy's Celestial Armor
description: Founded by Bido and Seth Juron, then blessed by Gjappy, those who wear this celestial armor are forever the loyal supporter of paladins.

name: GL-1ST
description: An older and grittier droid model that had all of its gold and glamor stripped off. They've long outlived their warranty.

name: GL-24K (Armor)
description: Fashioned with a gilded chassis, these droids are the perfect attendants and bodyguards. Some even grow an ego and strike out on their own.

name: Glacial Berserker (Armor) (AC)
description: Tranquility and rambunctious behavior don't mix in berserkers, but the psyche of a Glacial Berserker is cool enough to balance both conflicting qualities. They are one "chill" group of warriors.

name: Glacial Berserker (Armor) (Non-AC)
description: Tranquility and rambunctious behavior don't mix in berserkers, but the psyche of a Glacial Berserker is cool enough to balance both conflicting qualities. They are one "chill" group of warriors.

name: Glacial Commander
description: Forged from the core of the Ice Titan himself, this pristine armor belongs to the Champion of Ice. With every step you take, the world grows colder.

name: Glacial Destroyer
description: We shall make angels in the snow and use the icy coldness as our armor!

name: Glacial DreadKnight
description: It's cold, it's icy - what better time of year to be a living embodiment of ice?

name: Glacial Elf Lord's Robes
description: Ice Elf royalty ruled a golden ice age where their people flourished, and wielded great might. Those of the North danced with Dragons and embodied Winter. Those of the South sung songs to keep their gods asleep.

name: Glacial Elven Armor (0 AC)
description: The ancestors of the Ice Elves of the Northlands left when the golden city of Camlan became too small. The frost welcomed their presence and became their protection.

name: Glacial Elven Armor (AC)
description: The ancestors of the Ice Elves of the Northlands left when the golden city of Camlan became too small. The frost welcomed their presence and became their protection.

name: Glacial FrostElf Royalty
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This ceremonial regalia is worn for the Winter Moon celebration.

name: Glacial FrostScythe
description: Even the worst ice and snow is no match for these warriors!

name: Glacial Knight
description: These knights sparkle and shine under the glow of the New Years ball when it drops.

name: Glacial Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Th' frozen seas of the icy northlands be your huntin' grounds. An' no cold-hearted corsair can escape th' reach of your razor-sharp-rapier.

name: Glacial Naval Commander (AC)
description: Th' frozen seas of the icy northlands be your huntin' grounds. An' no cold-hearted corsair can escape th' reach of your razor-sharp-rapier.

name: Glacial Summoner
description: With snow comes new beginnings. Those who are lost, search for a fresh start, visit the Glacial Summoners, who cover up their past mistakes and lead them into the light of spring.

name: Glacial Swimwear (0 AC)
description: Beat the heat with frosty magic from the Northlands. Warning: other beachgoers are going to see you as a walking drink cooler.

name: Glacial Swimwear (AC)
description: Beat the heat with frosty magic from the Northlands. Warning: other beachgoers are going to see you as a walking drink cooler.

name: Glacial Troll Armor
description: Roaming in the frozen north lands, Glacial Trolls blend in well with their surroundings making them hard to spot and even harder to slay.

name: Glacial Walker
description: Once a refugee fleeing the chaos on the mainland, you've fallen to the FrostSpawn Horde. Will you serve the Queen of Monsters and Karok the Fallen?

name: Glacial Warlord Armor (AC)
description: Embrace the power of the glacier… and CRUSH YOUR ENEMIES! They will soon know the cold grasp of the grave thanks to the power you wield!

name: Glacial Warlord Armor (Special)
description: Embrace the power of the glacier… and CRUSH YOUR ENEMIES! They will soon know the cold grasp of the grave thanks to the power you wield!

name: Glacial Warrior (0 AC)
description: Mesmerized by the crystalline beauty of their icy home, Glacial Warriors have vowed to serve the Avatar of Ice.

name: Glacial Warrior (AC)
description: Mesmerized by the crystalline beauty of their icy home, Glacial Warriors have vowed to serve the Avatar of Ice.

name: Glacier Garment
description: Carved out from the remainder of an iceberg, this frozen-solid armor guarantees instant popularity—it's just that cool!

name: Glacier Lord
description: Ice runs through your veins with this bone-chilling armor. Perfect for hunting in the Northlands, enemies will not stand a chance against your frigid attack.

name: Gladiator of Circumstance
description: Ready your battle stance as the Gladiator of Circumstance! Are you not impressed by the sharpness of my blade? Perhaps you would like a demonstration?

name: Gladiator of Consequence
description: Forget the rules! Forget the consequences! Battle on to victory and embrace whatever consequences are thrown your way!

name: Gladiator Powerhouse
description: Herculisa is not to be confused with Hercubart. Hercules, however, is the manliest Hero EVER!

name: Gladiator Warrior
description: Your fame is well deserved, your name is Gladiator. Require Gladiator Warrior armor + other drops.

name: Glamour Ghoul
description: Shut UP, Lenny!

name: Glaucus Mystic
description: The Glaucus Mystics are gifted with visions extending across the silent sea and magic that could fell a Titan. A fitting reward for daring to bathe in the remains of a fallen Avatar, and surviving a poison that almost sunk Lore into the Age of the Devouring Sea.

name: Glaucus Sage
description: The Glaucus dove into the waves where a calamity claimed the mind of an Avatar Mystic becomes a Sage over time, as their bodies slowly take on the form of a blue sea dragon. A deadly and mind-altering poison oozes from their pores, rendering them untouchable.

name: Glitter Moon Mariner
description: In the name of the glittering night, I'm gonna make you see stars!

name: GlitterFrost Fairy
description: Fairies are notoriously misjudged. They're actually wicked-fierce in battle, with sharp razor teeth and razor claws. All that glitter and sparkle is an extremely effective distraction for their enemies. TEE HEE!

name: Globlin Jammies
description: What's a better way for getting ready for a slumber party then fluffy Globlin slippers!

name: Gloomcaster
description: On, Mogloween, the tricksters come out to play. The Gloomcasters keep the ghouls and evil creatures at bay. Their magic wielding skills are far beyond any that has been seen before on Lore.

name: Glorified Spellsword of Light
description: After serving for quite some time, a Spellsword is granted the ability to choose his own banner and armor color to set himself apart from the rabble.

name: Glorious Savior of Battleon
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Glory Of Aranx
description: Wear theGlory of Aranx proudly and celebrate Aranx and all of his glory! Just remember AOLF (Aranx Only Lives…Forever)!!!

name: Glory of the Den
description: As a captain of the Golden Onslaught army, lead your forces against the all that is Evil and Chaotic in Lore. Long Live General Lionfang and the Golden Onslaught Army!

name: Glowdragon Morph
description: Being a dragon is just not enough You gotta GLOW!

name: Glutton Armor
description: Mmmmm, SO HUNGRY!

name: GMO Brutalcorn
description: What happens when you were too busy thinking about if you could do it, no one asked if we should do it. This item has a chance to do the One Million Gold Showers animation each time you auto-attack!

name: Gobble Slayer
description: What better way to infiltrate the Gobble Clan then dressing up as one!

name: Goblin Disguise (Permanent)
description: Somehow I don't think they'll be fooled…

name: Goblin Disguise (Temporary)
description: Somehow I don't think they'll be fooled…

name: Goblin King's Formalwear
description: Let the music and magic of the Black Labyrinth entice you. Give in to the spell the Goblin King weaves. Your fate is in his hands.

name: Goblin King's Mirrored Outfit
description: In the mirror realm, all things are reversed. Let the music and magic of the Black Labyrinth entice you. Give in to the spell the Goblin King weaves. Your fate is in his hands.

name: God of Storms
description: Ice and lightning rain down from the sky, tearing into the earth like teeth and claws. The Druids that worship the God of Storms caught these cold bolts in their palms, and their scars became etchings of power.

name: Goddess of Love
description: Love is a battlefield. To win, you need to have the power of a goddness on your side!

name: Goddess Of War
description: War, where the dreams of mice and men are ground into the mud. Only the mighty, those who can forge a new age for Lore, will rise from the carnage. The Goddess of War stokes the flames of the worthy with divine inspiration.

name: Godmode GamerArmor
description: An armor made out of all your favorite game consoles. You'd be a hit at parties. I hope you have enough controllers for everyone.

name: Gold and Roses (AC)
description: A spiteful fight at an the upper class ball caused the guest who whore this attire to fall into a fountain, bleaching its red color until it is as white as the clouds. At least, it's still decent to wear at parties. (Suggested by Kitkat_AE)

name: Gold and Roses (Legend)
description: Battlemages focus on taking down their opponents as quickly as possible. They are capable of focusing greater amounts of mana into each spell for the maximum effect. They specialize in wearing heavy armor for defense in order to spend all of their mana on offensive spells.

name: Gold Coronation Dragonlord (0 AC)
description: Dragons covet their partner Dragonlords as much as gold. This set of armor is given to a Dragonlord when they achieve feats of valor, strengthening the bond between dragonkind and humankind.

name: Gold Coronation Dragonlord (AC)
description: Dragons covet their partner Dragonlords as much as gold. This set of armor is given to a Dragonlord when they achieve feats of valor, strengthening the bond between dragonkind and humankind.

name: Gold DoomKnight Armor
description: Not all DoomKnights are completely Evil—some follow the Golden Rule. You must have one of the more pure souls.

name: Gold Dragonborn Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: What's a pirates favorite color? Why it be the gleaming shine of gold! Now ye can wear the color and sparkle like the rich.

name: Gold Dragonborn Naval Commander (AC)
description: What's a pirates favorite color? Why it be the gleaming shine of gold! Now ye can wear the color and sparkle like the rich.

name: Gold Exalted Paladin
description: Had Trolle'din had the improved version of this armor, it is doubtful that he would have perished. Then again, this IS Trolle'din we are talking about. He probably would have fallen for the same trick. This item does 20% more damage to undead monsters, and provides 15% more gold when equipped.

name: Gold Infinity Knight
description: The hour of your victory is upon us! 2016 is the year you shall ascend to mastery!

name: Gold Parade Costume
description: Pick your favorite color and join the New Year parade!

name: Gold Party Outfit
description: Party all night long in this sparkling golden outfit!

name: Gold Pony Star Warrior
description: Leave the fields behind and frolic in the stars like you were meant to.

name: Gold Rainment of the Black Dragon
description: Harderned by strife and battle, this living armor shows its true colors when the right Hero puts it on. Build the confidence of your allies and yourself, while tearing down the confidences of the enemy.

name: Gold Serpent Qi Pao
description: An outfit styled with the image of the calm and refined snake. Yokai Isle residents treat this garb with special respect because their beloved Empress is a descendant of the Jade Serpent. (CC To Base, Accessory)

name: Gold ShadowFire Lord
description: Civilization in the Shadowlands is centered around one thing - protect the Lords. When you wear this gear, none will dare cross you.

name: Golden Anjou Duke
description: The Lord of Chiral Valley and head of House Vaughn were Thronekeepers - leaders of the Kingsguard and the sword of the crown. Rains of fire, ice, and lightning couldn't stop them. The only way to kill a Vaughn is to destroy their head.

name: Golden Anjou Knight
description: Named after the crest of House Vaughn, these Knights protect Chiral Valley. They're said to be nigh-invincible like their Lord, and can only be defeated if you destroy their head.

name: Golden Anjou Noble
description: The stronger a noble's blood ties are to the Vaughns of Chiral Valley, the more terrifying they are in battle. They shun the use of magic, and seek glory in direct combat. No Vaughn has ever lost to a Mage.

name: Golden Anubyx Warrior
description: Throughout an average dog's lifetime, they are owned and cared for by a human master. In a human's afterlife, the tables have turned. Now the dog owns and cares for it.

name: Golden Armor of War
description: Hunt monsters in Brightfall for the gold dye needed to turn the Armor of War into the Golden Armor of War!

name: Golden Brightscythe Warrior
description: Guardians of the Mirror Realm, these gilded warriors try to preserve justice by fighting against Alteon the Imbalanced.

name: Golden Celestial Warrior
description: *No description*

name: Golden Centurion Armor
description: The Golden Centurions are soldiers from a fabled sunken city. This never before seen armor has been in many battles.

name: Golden Chrono DragonKnight
description: The power of a DragonKnight combined with steampunk technology? Look out Lore, here comes awesome.

name: Golden DeathKnight Lord
description: This armor once belonged to the infamous Yurrod the Gold, a nice piece of metal work from that "swanky jerk".

name: Golden Defiance Armor
description: "I will rise against thee and take thy land for my own!" He screamed while yelling towards the skies…

name: Golden Dragon of Time (0 AC)
description: The Eternal Sovereign, noble in gold, is rarely seen in this form. Their loyal Speakers dutifully adorn them in this armor when threats of cosmic proportions threaten all of existence.

name: Golden Dragon of Time (AC)
description: The Eternal Sovereign, noble in gold, is rarely seen in this form. Their loyal Speakers dutifully adorn them in this armor when threats of cosmic proportions threaten all of existence.

name: Golden Dragon's Plate (0 AC)
description: The noble vesture of a Golden Dragon that has watch history being made since the dawn of time. The future innocently robs us of our past and present, but is filled with endless potential.

name: Golden Dragon's Plate (AC)
description: The noble vesture of a Golden Dragon that has watch history being made since the dawn of time. The future innocently robs us of our past and present, but is filled with endless potential.

name: Golden Dragonborn Warrior (0 AC)
description: Warriors who boast of their draconic lineage, tracing back to a golden Dragon that was born when the sun first shined on Lore. Even their fiery breaths burn as hot as a trueblood's - which is to say, a regular Dragon.

name: Golden Dragonborn Warrior (AC)
description: Warriors who boast of their draconic lineage, tracing back to a golden Dragon that was born when the sun first shined on Lore. Even their fiery breaths burn as hot as a trueblood's - which is to say, a regular Dragon.

name: Golden DragonLord Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Yarrrr! Most landlubbers never hear of th' fleet o' ships the DragonLords command. But with their dragon companions, they be fearsome fighters, on land, sea, AND air.

name: Golden DragonLord Naval Commander (AC)
description: Yarrrr! Most landlubbers never hear of th' fleet o' ships the DragonLords command. But with their dragon companions, they be fearsome fighters, on land, sea, AND air.

name: Golden Dragoon
description: Power. Glory. Finesse. All words that describe the incredible golden dragoon armor. The legacy that this armor bears is almost too much for any day-to-day hero to take upon his or her shoulders.

name: Golden Dream Guardian
description: There are many creatures that stalk the lands of the Djinn Realm, and the Guardians of the Dream Palace protect all who dwell within. Golden versions of the Guardian's uniform are awarded to those who have saved the lives of those who dwell in the realm.

name: Golden Enchanted Pyromancer
description: AHAHAH! BURN THE WORLD! BURN IT ALL DOWN! NO REMORSE NO REGRET JUST FIRE! AHAHAHA (This item is color customizable.)

name: Golden Falcon Commander
description: Much like a falcon, those that uphold the brightest, positive aspect of this predator are wise, honest, resilient, and unafraid to get into the spirit of fighting for one's freedom if need be.

name: Golden Fiend Warrior (0 AC)
description: Even the evillest Fiend takes a moment to shine his brightest armor to celebrate the holidays.

name: Golden Fiend Warrior (AC)
description: Even the evillest Fiend takes a moment to shine his brightest armor to celebrate the holidays.

name: Golden Firestorm Knight
description: Firestorm Knights! Ready your breakfast and eat hearty… For tonight, we dine at Yulgars!

name: Golden FrostElf Royalty
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This ceremonial regalia is worn for winter court audiences. (The fabric on this item is color-customizable.)

name: Golden Fury (Armor)
description: Channel the fury inside you to control ANY enemy who opposes you! Rule over the other heroes, warlords, and adventurers who battle though Lore!

name: Golden Gladiator
description: If intervening in important battles was an olympic sport, Golden Gladiators would win the gold meddle.

name: Golden Glory Healer
description: The heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS be where they are needed. Some fight for gold. Some fight for glory. But ALL will emerge victorious when we fight together.

name: Golden Guardian

description: The golden champion only lives to serve Nulgath and punish those who do not agree.

description: As a Hyperium Guard, you can move through Lore with enhanced senses, pinpoint-accuracy, and the knowledge that you alone are what keep thieves from getting close to J6.

name: Golden Inquisitor of ShadowFall
description: After succumbing to the lure of Gravelyn's darkness, former members of the Citadel Inquisitors are ready to answer Gravelyn's call to battle at any time, day or night. Though they may die, they know they will always return in her service.

name: Golden Leprechaun
description: Ye may not be a true Leprechaun there, lads and lassies but ye still be lucky today!

name: Golden Mage
description: The heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS be where they are needed. Some fight for gold. Some fight for glory. But ALL will emerge victorious when we fight together.

name: Golden Moglin Brawler
description: 'Twas the Knight before Frostval, a Hero so brawn was clad in new gold armor, and cried out, "Battle On!"

name: Golden Moglin Suit
description: Morph into the spirit of Frostval and become a moglin of gold!

name: Golden Monster Lord
description: Only the bravest heroes who have battled and defeated all of Lore's many monster may called themselves true Monster Lords.

name: Golden Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Gold be the only treasure worth searching for! Show your bounty by dressing in this fancy swag.

name: Golden Naval Commander (AC)
description: Gold be the only treasure worth searching for! Show your bounty by dressing in this fancy swag.

name: Golden Ox Hakama
description: May this new year be filled with happiness, prosperity, and many precious moments with your loved ones. Happy Lunar New Year 2021!

name: Golden Paladin Titan
description: If you don't fight, you can't win. For the Light… For Good… BATTLEON!

name: Golden Pirate Captain
description: This stylish uniform is made from melted gold by some pirates to cut down on excessive loot earned from their travels. It's still quite deadly, though.

name: Golden Pisces Maestro
description: Picses, the mutable water sign. Those born under its sign are compassionate, artistic, and wise. Their thoughs and feelings are carried in their songs, and touch the heart.

name: Golden Plate
description: Forged from the gold acquired in battles and journeys, only those who don this armor decide to show off their wealth on their gauntlets.

name: Golden Plate of the North
description: This is a replica of ceremonial armor worn by the High Kings of the North. Few can bear the weight of its golden plate. Fewer still can bear the responsibility of their crown.

name: Golden Raider (Armor)
description: Avast! The seven seas need plunderin' and set sail from Lolosia and fight the mighty kracken while searchin' for treasure!

name: Golden Reconstructor1337
description: Sent back in time from the year 20122013 to prevent the annihilation of Lore and preserve the future. Also they heard that it was someone's birthday!!!

name: Golden Rogue

name: Golden Savior of Battleon

description: Those who fight under Swordhaven's banner do not stop at defending Greenguard. Wherever evil strikes, no matter who pleads for aid, these defenders will always extend their hands. (CC to Base,Trim)

name: Golden Symbiote
description: You have become the dark and the light. You embody King Alteon's choice to ally with Empress Gravelyn to form the Alliance against Chaos!

name: Golden UndeadSlayer
description: All undead enemies are just dying to get a glimpse of this armor.

name: Golden Valentine Warrior
description: Will you be my Valentine? No? Well, at least I've got this shiny armor

name: Golden Warrior (Armor) (1)
description: These warriors are merciless guardians and wielders of light. Evil and Good alike must beware their wrath!

name: Golden Warrior (Armor) (2)
description: The heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS be where they are needed. Some fight for gold. Some fight for glory. But ALL will emerge victorious when we fight together.

name: Golden Warrior of Flame
description: Burning with the intensity of a thousand suns, these warriors fight for Tyndarius and the Queen. Their loyalty shines as brightly as they do.

name: Golden Wedding Guest
description: One must ALWAYS dress one's best when attending the wedding of one's creator!

name: Golden Yang Armor
description: The Sheep is a symbol of luck and this armor is sure to bring anyone who has it good fortune for this year. Happy Chinese New Year!

name: GoldenStag Warrior Chief (0 AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the GoldenStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: GoldenStag Warrior Chief (AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the GoldenStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

description: You can now wear the stone skin of the golem you just defeated.

name: Golf Suit
description: The motive behind golf attire remains a mystery. Regardless, those pants are pretty rad!

name: Gong Ji Zhanshi
description: Some fight some bleed, it's the way of the samurai from sun up to sun down, it's their battle cry.

name: Good Abada Outfit
description: /Cheer for the Good Block and celebrate Carnaval in style!

name: Good ChaosLord Prime
description: Centuries after the Queen of Monsters was sealed away, Xing and Xang were corrupted and combined by Chaos, reborn as ChaosLord Xiang. Had Xang stayed separate, she would have been raised up as ChaosLord Xang!

name: Good Hero of Balance
description: Centuries before Drakath's favorite minions, Xing and Xang, their ancestors fought to preserve Order, to bring balance, and to save the world from the Queen of Monsters.

name: Good Varsity Uniform
description: Rah rah rah! #Team Good! (Requires Rank 10 Good)

name: Gorillaphant Self
description: After the Embero Spell was cast, it was revealed that your true inner form is that of a gorillaphant! You possess strength, a keen affinity for nature, and a coat of fur that society matrons envy!

name: Goth Musician
description: Smells like scene spirit.

name: Goth Pirate Musician
description: You know there's GOT to be some spooky tale if I'm back on Lore. And if we're going to save the townspeople under attack, we'll need to do it… in style.

name: Goth Rocker
description: Rock on!

name: Gothic Alchemist
description: Recruited by Big Daddy, these alchemists are entrusted to brew handmade love potions …until they accidentally picked the wrong ingredients.

name: Gothic Altar Tender
description: Acting as professionals who protect the sanctity of bonds, an Altar Tender's work is fraught with danger and insane mishaps. When couples prefer a certain darker aesthetic, they don attire perfect for such an occasion.

name: Gothic Beach Loungewear
description: Your dark aesthetic is going to bring some gothic class to the sunny coast.

name: Gothic Decorator

name: Gothic Formal Wear
description: When you're wandering through a strange new realm, looking good means feeling confident. And confidence makes you a less attractive target for enemies.

name: Gothic Frostval Suit (0 AC)
description: You can still be goth and festive. Rock on.

name: Gothic Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: A moody pirate who sails on dark seas. There are so many that like embodying this archetype that if they gathered in a fleet, you'd be able to see the black spot from space.

name: Gothic Naval Commander (AC)
description: A moody pirate who sails on dark seas. There are so many that like embodying this archetype that if they gathered in a fleet, you'd be able to see the black spot from space.

name: Gothic Neko Guise
description: Is this an amusing costume, or was the cat in the alley more than they seemed?

name: Gothic Pirate Captain
description: Avast ye lubbers and gangway for the Gothic Pirate Captain. If ye don't be steppin' aside… ye'll become fish bait. Aye, that be a sailor's promise.

description: Your dark aesthetic is going to bring some gothic class to the sunny coast.

name: Gothic Thief
description: Steal quietly into the shadows, and be prepared to run at any time. Mysterious Johnson is not kind to those who take his wares.

name: Gothic Vampire
description: To truly experience the life of a Vampire, one must dress the part.

name: Gothika
description: Step outside the ordinary and embrace the Gothik in this armor crafted by Laken which emphasizes the exotic in a way Lore has never seen before!

name: Gothika Vogue
description: OH MY GOTH! We're undead! Undeader than dead!

name: Gothy Girl
description: She's just misunderstood.

name: Gourdello Armor
description: When you really, really love Pumpkin Spice.

name: Gourdian
description: As the greatest protectors of the pumpkin patch, Gourdians are skilled in the fine art of hand-to-hand carving combat. They squash all who get in their way.

name: Grand Inquisitor Armor
description: The Grand Inquisitor kneels defeated before you. His armor is now yours!

name: Grand Master Ironcrusher
description: These massive warriors are the most hardened veterans of the Dwarf battalions. They are the ones on the front line fearlessly withstanding the brunt of an enemies attacks. Extremely strong and stout they are highly resistant to the damage and magic. Plus, Dwarves can see really well in the dark after living underground for so long.

name: Grand Necromancer (0 AC)
description: You have done the near impossible… mastered the arts of necromancy and ascended to the rank of Grand Necromancer. All without losing your mortality. For now.

name: Grand Necromancer (AC)
description: You have done the near impossible… mastered the arts of necromancy and ascended to the rank of Grand Necromancer. All without losing your mortality. For now.

name: Grand Pirate King (Armor) (0 AC)
description: A master of the seas, regardless of whether they were a Hero or a Villain, is adored by its waves. Their deeds give the oceans their beauty, or spread its power and terror. Pirates from around Lore call them King.

name: Grand Pirate King (Armor) (AC)
description: A master of the seas, regardless of whether they were a Hero or a Villain, is adored by its waves. Their deeds give the oceans their beauty, or spread its power and terror. Pirates from around Lore call them King.

name: Grandmaster Gramiel (Armor)
description: The garb of a Celestial who wanted a simple life. Trickery robbed him of his wish. Gramiel dedicated his entire existence to destroying all beasts, and vindicating his lost love.

name: GrandMaster Trainer
description: After defeating the esteemed Training Golem, you've earned the right to call yourself a… Master Trainer! Enjoy your reward. (This item gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.)

name: Granite Dracolich Armor
description: The death of an earth dragon marks its return to the element it manipulated. Upon it's reawakening, it is no longer bound to the earth, but to its cursed soul.

name: Granville Knight (Armor)
description: House Granville has the great honor of protecting the sea of trees that surrounds Swordhaven. Though they let this go to their heads, none can deny their martial capabilty. They yearn for a golden age of war and glory.

name: Gravefang Armor
description: Lich Wolfs are more concerned with their bite than bark. Be wary, these beasts are quick as a whip and ready to be on an enemy's or ally's throat at a moment's notice.

name: Gravelyn's Champion
description: Loyal to the TRUE ruler and to Shadowfall. Dedicated champions of the Empress and the Shadowscythe. (5% chance to do the Meteor Shower attack animation, 15% XP boost non-stackable)

name: Gravelyn's Doom Gift
description: Emperor Sepulchure can't remove his own armor, but the design of this set is nostalgic somehow. His daughter was the one who designed and comissioned it, sharing Sepulchure's dream of their proud and secure future.

name: Gravelyn's Dragon Armor
description: The Empress's Dragon Armor infuses with will of the Shadowscythe with the power of dragons.

name: Gravelyn's Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Gravelyn's Naval Commander (AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Gravelyn's Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Gravelyn's Pirate Captain (AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Gravelyn (Temporary)
description: Firestorm Knights! Ready your breakfast and eat hearty… For tonight, we dine at Yulgars!

name: Gravity Overlord
description: This armor actually manipulates gravity itself! This armor was inspired by art created by your fellow player Gsog.

name: Great Dragon Armor
description: This armor is as much as a symbol of honor as it is a symbol of greatness and protection. Only the bravest of heroes may adom themselves in these crimson scales.

name: Great Thief Armor
description: As his way of expressing thanks for dealing with the Black Hole Sun, Anubyx has given you the opportunity to learn how to control the direction of the sun's rays. Doing so is a highly risky skill to develop, though.

name: Great White Shark Diver
description: ﻿Sleek swimwear made from and made to emulate the apex predators of the sea. Your only weakness is mistaking seals for fellow surfers.

name: Greater Chaos Myconian
description: Chaos has infected all things - even the fungi! Be very careful when ingesting mushrooms… who knows what effect they will have.

name: Greater Monstrous Zealot (0 AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters' most zealous, loyal defenders have reshaped themselves in her image.

name: Greater Monstrous Zealot (AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters' most zealous, loyal defenders have reshaped themselves in her image.

name: Green Draconian
description: Draconians aren't known for their skilled fighting techniques but rather for their ferocity and brute strength in battle.

name: Green Dragon Armor (1)
description: May the great dragon within you only heat your hamburgers, rather than burn your buns.

name: Green Dragon Armor 11
description: May the great dragon within you only heat your hamburgers, rather than burn your buns.

name: Green Dragon Armor (2)
description: The power of the Green dragon flows within this armor made from the scales of fallen dragons. I wouldn't wear this around Galanoth though. Just to be safe.

name: Green Dragon PJs
description: Fight like a Dragon, and sleep like one too.

name: Green Dragon Slayer
description: Green Dragons have long been known to ally with evil, and are the favorite target of DragonSlayers. But when our world is under attack from an even greater threat, old rivalries must be put aside.

name: Green Dragonborn Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Ye mates will go green with more than scurvy when they see these green goodies!

name: Green Dragonborn Naval Commander (AC)
description: Ye mates will go green with more than scurvy when they see these green goodies!

name: Green Jolly Frostval Attire
description: Dress for the season! Spruce and pine are festive colors! Frost Moglins have warm hearts but VERY cold paws. Make sure you dress warmly before receiving Frostval hugs!

name: Green Kirin Parade Costume
description: Your head may be covered by a gigantic kirin mask, but there's no reason the rest of you can't be looking your best!

name: Green L.O.S.E.R.
description: It's changing time! Honey Badger!

name: Green Screamer (Armor)
description: …and when I stand in front of this green wall, you totally can't see me! Ha!

name: Green Space Crew Shirt
description: You've got a good chance of surviving the away party.

name: Green Space Paladin
description: Let's boldly go where no other Paladins have gone before!

name: Green Wedding Guest
description: One must ALWAYS dress one's best when attending the wedding of one's creator!

name: Greenguard Druid
description: Because the forest is a holy place to many, Greenguard Druids do there best to keep it healthy and clean for all those who dwell in it.

name: Greenguard Knight
description: Keeping the natural beauty of Greenguard safe for all!

name: Greenguard Ranger
description: Skulking through Greenguard Forest, the Greenguard Rangers are stealthy, wealthy, and wise to the ways of their opponents.

name: Greenguard Shaman
description: The druids are gone, and they have taken their magical arts with them. However, nature herself has been known to reveal her secrets to humans who she deems pure.

name: Greenguard Shamans
description: Never underestimate the power of nature… or those who wield it. (This team's games are sponsored by the Shaman Collective of Greenguard Forest. Find a grove near you in Greenguard East or West.)

name: Grenwog Fur Hoodie
description: New, from EbilCorp's Killer Couture line: the 100% organic Grenwog Fur Hoodie! (For heroes who want to wear their victories proudly.)

name: Grenwog Guardian Warrior
description: Heroes across Lore challenge the Grenwog each year. But a very few see that the Grenwog is a beast to be admired and respected. As its Guardian, it is your duty to ensure the Grenwog's safety.

name: Grenwog Slayer
description: You have beaten the beast! Slain the unslayable! Ground down the Grenwog! Eggcellent job!

name: Grenwog Worshipper
description: All hail the Grenwog!

name: Grey Tidal Tiger Warrior
description: Tidal Tiger Warriors are benevolent and cheerful fighters trained in the ferocious martial art of the Akiban Tigers, and they keep Yokai Isle a safe haven of roaring prosperity!

name: Greywolf Commander (Armor)
description: The rugged rogues of the Greywolf Brigade roam the upper forests of the Dwarfhold Mountains, looting and pillaging. Their commander must be strong, hardy, and able to keep a rowdy crew in line!

name: Grid Armor
description: Wait a second, wasn't I just sitting at my computer?!?!

name: Grid Iron Death Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Grid Iron Death Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Gridiron Game Gear
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players! (This armor will return each year.)

name: Gridiron Gear
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players! (This armor will return each year.)

name: Grief Armor (AC)
description: Those who have gone through life feeling nothing, but sadness and despair, end up never looking for joy in the afterlife. And sometimes, that fate just couldn't be helped. (Female look only)

name: Grief Armor (Legend)
description: Those who have gone through life feeling nothing, but sadness and despair, end up never looking for joy in the afterlife. And sometimes, that fate just couldn't be helped. (Female look only)

name: Grievous Fiend (Armor)
description: The Nation has spread to the void beyond the stars, bringing distant planets and their dark ambitions into the Archfiend's fold. Fiendish features grow the moment the contract is signed.

name: Grim Dungeon Guard
description: These poor souls are former heroes who couldn't escape the endless Pit of Doom and so enthralled Grimskull as he watched he decided just to keep them…forever.

name: Grim Dungeon Master (AC)
description: The fell and grim are infesting every cave and crevice in Lore. Those who follow in Grimskull's few footsteps branched out to build their own dungeons of terror.

name: Grim Dungeon Master (Legend)
description: The fell and grim are infesting every cave and crevice in Lore. Those who follow in Grimskull's few footsteps branched out to build their own dungeons of terror.

name: Grim Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: These Naval Commanders won't let a little think thing like DEATH get in the way of plunder!

name: Grim Naval Commander (AC)
description: These Naval Commanders won't let a little think thing like DEATH get in the way of plunder!

name: Grim Necromancer (Armor)
description: When one ascends beyond the mere raising of bones, then one can be called Evolved.

name: Grim Yukata
description: The Empress' oracle has read your horoscope and declares: this will be a VERY dark and destructive year for you, no matter what sign you were born under.

name: GrimBlight Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: ﻿﻿YARRRR! This floating ship-shaped dungeon was the BEST IDEA EVER… The dungeon goes to the challengers. There is no escape! AHAHAHAHAHAHA!

name: GrimBlight Naval Commander (AC)
description: ﻿﻿YARRRR! This floating ship-shaped dungeon was the BEST IDEA EVER… The dungeon goes to the challengers. There is no escape! AHAHAHAHAHAHA!

name: GrimDark
description: Congratulations hero! You've farmed enough to get the personal set of fellow player Doom Reign Doom!

name: Grimfaxe Archfoe (0 AC)
description: (Scarf is color-customizable to Base.)

name: Grimfaxe Archfoe (AC)
description: (Scarf is color-customizable to Base.)

name: Grimlord of Nulgath
description: (Fully Color Custom) Nulgath's most faithful champions are the Grimlords. Adorning their masters face on their armor allows them to truly wield the power of Nulgath and devour the souls of their enemies!

name: Grimskull Beach Lounger (0 AC)
description: Are you beach lounging, or are you going to dig a hole in the sand? You're supposed to be relaxing! Not setting up spike pits and surprise piranha pools!

name: Grimskull Beach Lounger (AC)
description: Are you beach lounging, or are you going to dig a hole in the sand? You're supposed to be relaxing! Not setting up spike pits and surprise piranha pools!

name: Grimskull Psychophant
description: A rare few are allowed to learn from Grimskull directly, acting as his assistant architects. They have to be savagely creative, which means all of them are completely out of their minds.

name: Grimskull Ragged Rogue
description: This is the armor of the rogue who didn't survive the dungeon.

name: GrimStalker
description: What can be burned cannot be turned further towards the darkness! Stalk the creatures of the night, slay the witches, and save your city!

name: Groglurk Knight
description: Defenders of the Mirrors these poor souls now wander through Bludrut wondering what happened to their Scarletta.

name: Groom
description: *No description*

name: Groundforce Uniform
description: Patrolling the valleys below the kingdom of Swordhaven, the groundforce are elite members of Evil King Alteon's standing army. Much more than just a job, the GroundForce is a life-long commitment

name: Grunge Gear
description: They call it grunge, we call it AWESOME. You and your flannel will have a blast at any concert.

name: Grunge-Z
description: Shadowslayer Z dresses to impress… and blend in!

name: Gryphon Master
description: The Gryphon Master of Swordhaven connects the realm of Greenguard through the skies. Their loyal Gryphon companions are like family, willing to ride through war and disaster to save innocents in need.

name: Gryphon Rider
description: The airborne brigade of the Swordhaven military, AKA: the Gryphon Riders. These flyboys (and girls!) are known for their flying prowess and devil-may-care attitude.

name: GryphonClaw Knight
description: Upon ascending to the rank of Knight, members of the Order of the GryphonClaw swear a third oath: In recognition of the fact that humans cannot lie in the prescence of a Gryphon, Knights vow never to lie. This makes them trusted anywhere they may travel.

name: GryphonClaw Warrior
description: A warrior must swear several oaths upon joining the martial Order of the Gryphon Claw. The first two are: 1) To defend and protect any creature in danger. 2) To be as brave as a lion and as loyal as an eagle.

name: Guard Armor
description: Standard issue inquisitor guard armor.

name: Guard of Vokun
description: Guard Vokun with your life!

name: Guardiã do Ipiranga
description: In the brook of the red river, its guardian remembers the resounding shout of a heroic people. The sun of liberty shines on their home. From now to forever, they will protect their freedom.

name: Guardian Armor
description: The elite armor of Guardians. Guardians live to serve and protect. (Color customization available at Yulgar's Inn)

name: Guardian o' Sláinte
description: May your victories outnumber the shamrocks that grow, and may rare items find you wherever you go! Happy Lucky Day, Guardian of Good Health and Fortune!

name: Guardian of Darkness
description: The deep sense of dread and darkness flows within the threads of these menacing robes.

name: Guardian of Energy (Armor)
description: Mortals drawn to the Plane of Energy can tap into its power at will. The most skilled may become a Guardian of Energy, and serve only their Plane's Champion.

name: Guardian Of Grimskull
description: The dungeon needed a final challenge, so you answered the call. When he saw yo, Grimskull pointed, and yelled "Now THIS is a finisher! Final Boss material!" before scrambling off to compose you a new heavy-metal theme song.

name: Guardian of Light
description: Let the power of the Light flow through you giving you the power to crush the darkness!

name: Guardian Of Love
description: Set to the task of protecting all royal romances.

name: Guardian Original
description: For those who like the old ways.

name: Guardian Prime (1)
description: The elite armor of Guardians. Guardians live to serve and protect. Unlocked by purchasing a Guardian package in the original AdventureQuest.

name: Guardian Prime (2)
description: For those who fight for Good and protect the Guardian Tower from the forces of evil.

name: Guardian's Overseer (AC)
description: Feeling extremely elegant and loyal while dressed in white.

name: Guardian's Overseer (Non-AC)
description: Feeling extremely elegant and loyal while dressed in white.

name: Guardian Spirit (Armor)
description: Powerless after a defeat at the hands of a purple sorceress, a tainted spirit fled to one of Brightoak's swamps and possessed some of the vines beneath the muddy water. All it took was that spirit for the plants to form into a beast that dwelled in that terrain since.

name: Guardian Vokun
description: Tasked with guarding the Forgotten Tombs, the Dark Lord Vokun barely escaped the tombs after an earthquake decimated it's grounds. Escaping with several armors, weapons, and helms, Vokun has now seen it fit to release these epic items to his loyal followers.

name: Guardians of the Moon
description: You are Lore's first source of protection from forces that attack from the sky!

name: Guerreira do Ipiranga
description: In the brook of the red river, its guardian remembers the resounding shout of a heroic people. The sun of liberty shines on their home. From now to forever, the will protect their freedom.

name: Guerreiro Alegre
description: Bring The Joy to Carnaval! Obrigado for supporting AQWorlds through Paymentez!

name: Gummi Bear Suit
description: Watch your back because your enemies might just eat it!

name: Guncraft Beast
description: A beast as well as an artillery of firepower. Those bandoliers are actually restraints that hold back feral power. The real fun starts when the Guncraft Beast runs out of bullets.

name: Guncraft Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Yarrr! Ye be likin the cut of yer jib in this fancy swag. A pirate always be needin their pistol at the ready!

name: Guncraft Naval Commander (AC)
description: Yarrr! Ye be likin the cut of yer jib in this fancy swag. A pirate always be needin their pistol at the ready!

name: Guncraft Shadowslayer
description: Each of your guns is specially made to bring down the myriad monstrosities that lurk in the dark. Bring in the light by riddling the shadows with holes.

name: Gunslinger From The West
description: They rode into town from the west, on the heels of a dust storm. The first night they were here, they took out the toughhest outlaw our town has ever seen, and then they were gone - as mysteriously as the came.

name: Gymnast Gear
description: You'll want to buff your DEX before equipping THIS gear if you want to battle on balance beams or backflip over the baddies!

name: Hamster Server
description: This hamster will SERVE you up a whole new type of PAIN!

name: Hand-Drawn J6 Armor
description: All armor ideas are sketched out first. Some armor ideas never go any further.

name: Hand of Destiny
description: You are the right hand of all that is good in the world. When the world burns you will be the one to fight and rebuild it.

name: Hand of Destruction (Armor)
description: You are the right hand of all that is evil in the world. When the world burns you will look to see how you can benefit from its destruction.

name: Harbinger Armor
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PVP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Harbinger of Hollowmoor
description: An autumn spirit who can conjure prophetic nightmares, or bring comfort to the lost. Witches call on the Harbinger's wisdom, and travelers look over their shoulder to make sure it isn't watching.

name: Hard Rocker
description: Get ready to mosh!

name: Hardcore Heartbreaker
description: Someone like this will break your heart and laugh about it, but you can't help but give them your everything anyway.

name: Hardcore Rocker Hoodie (0 AC)
description: Get ready to mosh!

name: Hardcore Rocker Hoodie (AC)
description: Get ready to mosh!

name: Harlequin Fool
description: The unmistakable attire of Piddie Fool yoinked from another world. This inaugural Harlequin edition of Piddie the Fool is here to bring joy to many with clever pranks and a wicked sense of humor.

name: Harlequin Warrior
description: If you want Heroes to respect you, show them you're serious.  Blow something up!

name: HarleQuint
description: Want to be the life of the party without dancing in a bikini? Dress like a HarleQuint!

name: Harmonic Libra Savant
description: Libra, the cardinal air sign. Those born under its sign are balanced, embodying sharp intellectualism and artisic romanticism. Their words are magic, able to move the soul.

name: Harpies Away Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Harpies Away Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Harpies Varsity Team
description: Rah rah rah! Go Harpies!

name: HarpyHunter
description: The harpy can't face the music when YOU show up!

name: Harvest Assassin
description: Turkill or not Turkill that is the question…

name: Harvest Hunter
description: Brings the phrase scrounging for food to a whole new level. These Hunters explore Greenguard for food.

name: Hashashin Armor
description: An elusive sect of assassins, the Hashashin Armor was built for stealth and designed by your fellow player, Rohan!

name: Hate Weaver
description: PLAYER SUGGESTION: Repel your next victim with a loathing based armor by Memet. Weave a web of hate and lies around the good guy before reminding it who is boss.

name: Hatsukoi Yukata
description: It is a wonderous thing, when Yokai New Year and Hero's Heart Day are celebrated at the same time! Wear this yukata as you stroll through Akiba with your true love.

name: Havoc Sage (0 AC)
description: After ages of rigorous training and meditation, these Sages are enlightened in the art of war. All who oppose the Legion are swiftly incapacitated by these skilled masters.

name: Havoc Sage (AC)
description: After ages of rigorous training and meditation, these Sages are enlightened in the art of war. All who oppose the Legion are swiftly incapacitated by these skilled masters.

name: Havokrun Recruiter
description: For Chaos! You fought against the forces of Good and Evil inflicting Chaos over Lore and fighting for Drakath!

name: Hawberry Grenwog Garb
description: Pink rabbits are the stuff of sweet legends.

name: Hazardous BioBeast Morph
description: How very very beastly! This special armor will unlock when the BioBeasts Facebook page reaches 50,000 Likes. Thanks for all support… even if you are a terrifying monster! http://biobeasts.artix.com

name: Hazmat Suit
description: Protection all sorts of vile nasty liquids and smells, though sadly Cysero's sock is not affected by it.

name: Hazmat Suit (Temp)
description: *No description*

name: Head's Outfit
description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as Head!

name: Headless Knight Armor
description: The Thronekeeper's best, brought back from the dead without their heads. You can only kill a Vaughn if you destroy their head…so now what?

name: Headless Pumpkin
description: Ne'er-do-wells using the darkness of all hallow's eve as cover will never escape your gaze, or lack there of. Don't forget your head at home.

name: Headtaking Headless Horseman
description: You have no head! @_@ Does 25% more damage to humans when equipped.

name: Healer Armor
description: Healers are servants of good who use their powers to aid the sick, weak, and injured. Their powerful healing magic is often the difference between a groups victory or doom.

name: Healer of Time
description: Healers that have the power to dose the wounds of the body, the mind, and the soul. As the saying goes, time heals all wounds. Some say, the Dragon that gave them this power once walked alongside mortals.

name: Heart of Fire
description: The heart of fire gives these beings their power. Their everlasting heat will burn down their enemies.

name: Heart Streamer
description: Wear this during your next Let's Play stream and your followers will love you! (And your subs will skyrocket.)

name: Heartbeat Festa Dancer
description: The theme of this year's Carnaval was about true love, reunion, and the fight to defy all the odds! Get your heart racing and dance it out on the promenade! (Click on Shoulders)

name: Heartbroken Combat Cupid
description: Even during the worst of breakups and rejections, they will never give up helping people get their rightful loved ones!

name: Heartless Cross Berserker
description: Once a healer and a fighter both, the maker of this armor has forsaken his call as a champion of justice. Now, heartless, he roams the land dueling and fighting any battles he comes across. He was originally known as DarkonDrago, and now his armor is yours.

name: HeartThrob
description: Just because you wear your heart on your sleeve doesn't mean you will go down easily! What monster wouldn't hesitate when it sees your bold proclamation.

name: Heavy Metal Mercenary
description: Yeah yeeeaaaahh! You're one bad Mercenary. Nuff said.

name: Heavy Metal Necromancer
description: What's more metal than a rock concert full of head-banging undead? A necromancer who can bind their spirits and control them. FOREVER. (This item is color customizable)

name: Heavy Metal Rockstar Armor
description: Heavy Metal Rockstars are a force to be reckoned with in a mosh pit. Like the band, they're die hard fans of, they utilize their deathly riffs, mighty voices, and necromantic abilities to crush their foes into submissions.

name: HeavyBlader
description: Every party needs a tank. And in this armor, you won't be anything but!

name: Hedgie Kigu
description: Cuddly and soft, you don't have to worry about sticking anyone with your spines.

name: Hei Gong Ji (AC)
description: The feathers that make up these robes are from the legendary Sriracha Holycud. These feathers are a symbol of one's flaming passion. They also help you keep warm in the Northlands!

name: Hei Gong Ji (Legend)
description: The feathers that make up these robes are from the legendary Sriracha Holycud. These feathers are a symbol of one's flaming passion. They also help you keep warm in the Northlands!

name: Hel Fö In Officio
description: A Hollowborn Judge, Hel Fo is ready to put her convictions to the test. Her fragile body supported by invincible equipment, she prepares for judgment.

name: Hel Fö's Armor
description: A Hollowborn Judge, Hel Fo is ready to put her convictions to the test. Her fragile body supported by invincible equipment, she prepares for judgment.

name: Helicobacter
description: …sometimes its best not to know where certain germs originate from…

name: Hellion Beast Rider (0 AC)
description: Riders who pursue the most infamous of prey be they beast, man, Evil, or Good. The ground rumbles as their mounts begin their charge.

description: Riders who pursue the most infamous of prey be they beast, man, Evil, or Good. The ground rumbles as their mounts begin their charge.
