description: Helsgrove Guardians protect their mistress, Helsdottir, as she hunts down fools trying to outrun her retribution.

name: Herald of Stalagbite
description: The Chaotic Dragon has chosen you as his Herald. Serve him well or you might end up as lunch.

name: Heretic
description: Because of your strength and power, most of lore views you as a threat. Can you convince them you are fighting FOR them, and not against them?

name: Hero at Home
description: When you're not BEING TOTALLY NORMAL outside the house, you can wear this. You look cute. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Hero Hunter (AC)
description: The heroes of Lore are out in force. The Hunt is on and your prey is near… but if you aren't careful, you just might become the hunted!

name: Hero Hunter (Special)
description: The heroes of Lore are out in force. The Hunt is on and your prey is near… but if you aren't careful, you just might become the hunted!

name: Hero of Gold
description: This set is 100% gold. Literally. Made out of the many gold coins you've saved up while adventuring. Talk about a status symbol!

name: Hero of Sponsors
description: Only a hero that is knowledgeable about all products will become a true Champion of Everlasting Omnipotence.. aka the CEO!

name: Hero of Steel (Armor) (AC)
description: These colors! They make me feel so… heroic!

name: Hero of Steel (Armor) (Legend)
description: These colors! They make me feel so… heroic!

name: Hero's Lavaflame Swimsuit
description: Who wants to fight fire with fire when you can soak up the sun on the super-heated sands of the Burning Beach?

name: Hero's Pyromancer's Swimsuit
description: Who wants to fight fire with fire when you can soak up the sun on the super-heated sands of the Burning Beach?

name: Heroic Atlas Lion Warrior
description: A legendary warrior honored by ancient prophecies. The Atlas Lion is destined to shoulder the weight of the world, and destroy all Evil. Their utopia is their pride, and will stand the test of time.

name: Heroic Berserker
description: These Berserkers fight Chaos wherever and whenever they come across it. For Humanity!

name: Heroic Horror
description: A mad doctor's creation rises in the night!

name: Heroic Titan
description: Even in moments of deepest despair, we can still find hope. No matter how messed up things get, YOU have the power to save the day.

name: Heroic Titan (temp)
description: Even in moments of deepest despair, we can still find hope. No matter how messed up things get, YOU have the power to save the day.

name: Heroic ZombieSlayer Armor
description: The undead walk the land slain and reborn by Sepulchure's toxic fog. It is up to you to save the innocent, rescue the weak, and slay those who would tear down the home you have defended so valiantly. You are the Zombie Killer!

name: HeroMart Shirt
description: HeroMart Shirt - 103% Cotton-poly blend Artix Ent shirts will NOT protect you from Stryche-ing blows and jealous customs agents. They WILL protect you from lack of style and bad fashion choices.

name: HeroSmash Shirt
description: HeroSmash Shirt - 103% Cotton-poly blend Artix Ent shirts will NOT protect you from feeling SUPER. They WILL protect you from lack of style and bad fashion choices.

name: Hex of NOOOO-Gasp!
description: Beleen's love of pink can overcome even the strongest of beings - even Nulgath! She's turned his Hex.. Pink!

name: Hex of Nulgath (Rare)
description: Nulgath says, "Perhaps wielding the arcane is more your style. Lightly armored, Hex Voids are the mystic breeds in my legion. They can decimate my enemies with black magic, elements, and curses." (Rare)

name: Hexosuit OH NO U-
description: This epicly transforming suit will astonish your friends and terrify your foes… because now it's MAGIC! Click the different parts of the suit to gain blades, shining runes, or rocky shoulders!

name: Hidden Chaos Rogue
description: Chaos has a way of sneaking up on people. Now that you're a Chaos Rogue, YOU will be delivering the Chaos! Chaotically customize your whole look with color custom base, trim, and accessory!

name: High Celestial Priest (Armor)
description: Shine on, Celestial Hero!

name: High Celestial Protector
description: ﻿Only the most skilled of the Celestial Realm's Guardians ascend to the ranks of the High Celestial Protectors. It is one of the realm's highest honors.

name: High Crusader
description: Crusaders are the next up the Good rank! You're moving your way towards the Light!

name: High Cycloptic Horrorshow
description: Eye can't imagine an opponent would enjoy the sight of you in this terrifying battlegear.

name: High Infernal General
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿High Infernal Generals command legions of Dark Infernal Defenders. Their power has been known to decimate entire armies… until today.

name: High Legion Champion
description: Only the greatest members of the Undead Legion can equip the Legion Champion armor!

name: High Mage
description: The Troll High Magi have taught you well. Strict discipline and earnest passion towards the magical arts sets you apart from the others—you have earned the right to call yourself a High Mage.

name: High MageLord (0 AC)
description: High MageLords of the Nation obey without … channeling all their magical strength into fulfilling Nulgath the ArchFiend's commands.

name: High MageLord (AC)
description: High MageLords of the Nation obey without … channeling all their magical strength into fulfilling Nulgath the ArchFiend's commands.

name: High Octane Agility Racer
description: You're on a ride that packs a hundred horsepower, and takes up way less space than a stable.

name: High Octane Race-Fan
description: You're a professional that handles rides packing over a hundred horsepower, and take up way less space than a stable.

name: High Priestess of Monsters
description: Many worship the Queen of Monsters, but few are called to serve in her castle. The High Priest and Priestess of Monsters - once Generals of Nulgath the ArchFiend --  have now sworn eternal obedience and absolute loyalty.

name: High School SweetHearts
description: Sweet memories of days gone by.

name: High ShadowScythe Mage
description: Adding the Deadtech Node seems to have removed all color from this armor. How strange.

name: High ShadowScythe Rogue
description: Adding the Deadtech Node seems to have removed all color from the armor. How strange.

name: High ShadowScythe Trooper
description: Adding the Deadtech Node seems to have removed all color from the armor. How strange.

name: High VoidCaster (0 AC)
description: Those who sign Nulgath's contract gain access to the infinite wellspring of arcane energy contained within the void. Those who ascend find themselves consumed by the power.

name: High VoidCaster (AC)
description: Those who sign Nulgath's contract gain access to the infinite wellspring of arcane energy contained within the void. Those who ascend find themselves consumed by the power.

name: Highborn Necromancer
description: Defectors of courtly decadence that preferred a darker calling. They took their riches, class, and decorated history with them. Death will not excuse their retainers from service.

name: Highland Savage
description: Protect the plains from invading armies and take to the Highlands of Lore in this armor.

name: Highway Bounty Hunter
description: On the roadways of space, be careful who you come across. One just might be ready to claim that bounty on your head.

name: Hikari no Akuma
description: Do not let the name fool you. They may be driven by the light but these Akuma still have deep dark powers.

name: Hillbilly Overalls
description: Whoooooo-weeeeee, now ain't that a kicker, y'all! Gussy up yer look with a sweet set of overalls that makes the cityfolk look like flowers. Only the most rugged people can pull this here look off. Is 'at you?

name: Hipster Sweatervest (AC)
description: "I was a fan of Dage when he was still underground!"

name: Hipster Sweatervest (Legend)
description: "I was a fan of Dage when he was still underground!"

name: HitchGreen's Costume
description: Despite Alfred Hitchgreen's prominent girth, this outfit seems to fit you perfectly! All of your friends will be green with envy!

name: Hoarfrost Aure Knight
description: A stoic knight of legend who achieved valiant feats of heroism in the name of their homeland. As time passed, mountains moved and oceans shifted. The Kingdom they served sunk into the nether, and the knight followed, loyal to the end.

name: Hobo Highlord (Armor)
description: Comes with a sign that says ''Will work for souls''.

name: Hockey Star Captain
description: "Great moments are born from great opportunities." - the legendary hockey hero, Herb Brooks. Hit the ice and slam the puck home, then celebrate your victory in the Icestorm Cup finals!

name: Holey Warrior Armor
description: You are the holiest warrior around! Unfortunately, because you're clumsiest warrior around, you're also the holey-est! But having lived trough Vordred turning the world into an undead wasteland, I think people will understand your dented, holey armor.

name: Holiday ArchPaladin
description: Artix the UndeadSlaying Paladin is getting into the Frostval Spirit, and the BEST way he can do is free any last spirits trapped inside Vordred the Paladin Slayer.

name: Holiday Bard (0 AC)
description: As Frostval approaches, the bards of Mythsong adorn themselves with red coats and white furs. They journey to the far reaches of the continent, spreading holiday cheer. You might even hear one singing outside your window.

name: Holiday Bard (AC)
description: As Frostval approaches, the bards of Mythsong adorn themselves with red coats and white furs. They journey to the far reaches of the continent, spreading holiday cheer. You might even hear one singing outside your window.

name: Holiday Caster
description: Frostval is the most magical time of the year. Harness that power and put it to good use!

name: Holiday Classic Robina
description: Merry Frostval from Classic Robina!

name: Holiday Courier (0 AC)
description: In the crisp hours of the morning, packages of holiday cheer are delivered to each doorstep. Thick green jackets and red boots are suited to escort gifts from far off friends.

name: Holiday Courier (AC)
description: In the crisp hours of the morning, packages of holiday cheer are delivered to each doorstep. Thick green jackets and red boots are suited to escort gifts from far off friends.

name: Holiday Enchanter (0 AC)
description: As Frostval approaches, the bards of Mythsong adorn themselves with red coats and white furs. They journey to the far reaches of the continent, spreading holiday cheer. You might even hear one singing outside your window.

name: Holiday Enchanter (AC)
description: As Frostval approaches, the bards of Mythsong adorn themselves with red coats and white furs. They journey to the far reaches of the continent, spreading holiday cheer. You might even hear one singing outside your window.

name: Holiday Enforcer
description: Deck the halls… and elementals… and monsters… and the guy that started the brawl last night… Defend the occasion in this smartly designed armor that will leave your badly beaten enemy with a smile on his face. Who can resist those holiday colors?

name: Holiday Jester
description: Happy Frostval! Now you can jingle while you battle!

name: Holiday Paragon of Light
description: Members of the Bright Legion love Frostval… the sun shining on their armor and snow blinds their enemies and makes them look even MORE Good.

name: Holiday Ritz!
description: When fighting in a regular armor just won't do, pull this number on and walk the streets with your head held high and your weapon ready for action. Ermine accents and a luxurious black cotton-metal mesh will protect you no matter what. Hack-and-slash in style, baby.

name: Holiday Swordhaven Ally
description: Geared up for the holidays, but never on vacation from doing good.

name: Hollow Revenant
description: You have taken on the appearance of one of the lost souls Wandering the Hallow Halls of Hollowsoul. Let's just hope this is an illusion and not… *gulp*…

name: Hollow Zerker
description: According to legend, Hollowsoul Castle was so large that even the bravest Knights got lost and died within its walls. The only thing found "living" in the Hollow Halls were Hollow Zerkers, half knight and half wraith.

name: Hollowborn Abada Outfit
description: /Cheer for the Hollowborn Block and celebrate Carnaval in style!

name: Hollowborn Adept
description: Always searching for ways to obtain more power, the Hollowborn Adept studies all types of combat. May the Shadow Fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Alchemist
description: Expert transmutationists, Hollowborn Alchemists are the masters of mutable magic. Their power lies in transforming objects into new states of being. The Shadow Fiend has granted them the ability to change the very nature of reality.

name: Hollowborn Battlemage
description: The fervor these Generals felt for the cause of the Dawn Vindicators was so strong that it overcame the trials of the Shadow Fiend. As Hollowborn Battlemages, they continue to serve the light from the shadows.

name: Hollowborn Beach Lounger (0 AC)
description: Life is precious, and having a second chance at it gives you a new appreciation for the sun, the waves, and the sea breeze. (This item is color-customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn Beach Lounger (AC)
description: Life is precious, and having a second chance at it gives you a new appreciation for the sun, the waves, and the sea breeze. (This item is color-customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn Beast Tamer
description: The true form of the Dawn Vindicator's Beast Tamer, and an associate of of the Hollowborn Minx. They passed the Shadow Fiend's test before the birth of civilization. Beasts see them as one of their own.

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster (0 AC)
description: Rumor has it that the Hollowborn BeastMaster not only tamed one of its dread harbingers, but overcame Death itself. Triumphing over the Shadow Fiend's trial, they continue to hunt the creatures of Death. (Glow is customizable to eye color. Weapon changes at random.)

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster (AC)
description: Rumor has it that the Hollowborn BeastMaster not only tamed one of its dread harbingers, but overcame Death itself. Triumphing over the Shadow Fiend's trial, they continue to hunt the creatures of Death. (Glow is customizable to eye color. Weapon changes at random.)

name: Hollowborn BeastTamer (0 AC)
description: Under the gaze of the Shadow Fiend this Hollowborn BeastTamer rode astride their shadowborn mount to best a harbinger of death. Together, they'll roam Lore in a quest to conquer even greater challenges. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn BeastTamer (AC)
description: Under the gaze of the Shadow Fiend this Hollowborn BeastTamer rode astride their shadowborn mount to best a harbinger of death. Together, they'll roam Lore in a quest to conquer even greater challenges. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn Benevolent
description: Centuries after the Queen of Monsters was sealed away, Xing and Xang were corrupted and combined by Chaos, reborn as ChaosLord Xiang. Now the shadows have finally adopted the aspect of Good itself.

name: Hollowborn Bodyguard
description: Lae forged an enchanted suit of armor that can move and make decisions on its own. Its intended purpose was to act as Edden's bodyguard, but if it fits you and your tastes, perfect! The armor knows you're more than worthy of wearing it.

name: Hollowborn Centaur
description: A Hollowborn warrior, part of a fallen branch of Darkblood ancestry. Their progenitor committed a grave sin, and as a result, Darkbloods who walk on four legs are rarely ever seen.

name: Hollowborn Chained Guard
description: Trained specially to fight strong infernal creatures, the Fiend Reaper traps the enemy with his chains. Incapable of moving, the fiend is burnt by the flames coming from the chains. Only his exoskeleton survives, but the chains won't let his soul to leave the body.

name: Hollowborn Chained Reaper
description: Trained specially to fight strong infernal creaures, the Fiend Reaper traps the enemy with his chains. Incapable of moving, the fiend is burnt by the flames coming from the chains. Only his exoskeleton survives, but the chains won't let his soul to leave the body.

name: Hollowborn Chaos Warrior
description: There are those who are controlled by Chaos and those who control it! You have BECOME Chaos, fighting to further the shadows cause!

name: Hollowborn Creator
description: The limitations of a mortal life are no longer an issue. Grow beyond the confines placed on the other visionless scientists. With all the time in the world, you can become a Creator.

name: Hollowborn Darkblood
description: These Darkbloods were willing to die for their people, and proved it. They returned from the Shadow Fiend's trial victorious, celebrated by their mortal kin. But they were duty bound to leave. Now, their Hollowborn brethren need them.

name: Hollowborn DoomKnight (Armor)
description: Even AFTER death… Sepulchure's harrowing legacy lives on forever. You have proven to the Shadowfiend how terrifying and dedicated you are. Now you shall do Sepulchure's bidding as Lore's most terrifying Hollowborn Doomknight!

name: Hollowborn DoomKnight (IoDA)
description: Even AFTER death… Sepulchure's harrowing legacy lives on forever. You have proven to the Shadowfiend how terrifying and dedicated you are. Now you shall do Sepulchure's bidding as Lore's most terrifying Hollowborn DoomKnight!

name: Hollowborn Draconian (Armor)
description: Long have the Draconians been used as minions and fodder by their greater kin. Thousands have been slain, but a select few became Hollow. Their will to live is directly tied to hatred of their so-called betters.

name: Hollowborn DragonBerserker
description: Awakening from a flurry of blood, talons, and flame, a Dragonlord’s body became Hollow- but their mind was lost to the Shadow Fiend’s abyss. With Draconic strength, they tear through any that stand in the way of their blind rage.

name: Hollowborn DragonBulwark
description: Awakening from a flurry of blood, talons, and flame, a Dragonlord’s body became Hollow- but their mind was lost to the Shadow Fiend’s abyss. With Draconic strength, they tear through any that stand in the way of their blind rage.

name: Hollowborn DragonKnight
description: DragonKnights who have yet to partner with a Dragon continue their search as a Hollowborn. isn't unusual to see Hollowborn Dragons who have lost their Dragonlords partner with these warriors.

name: Hollowborn Dragonlord
description: It is exceedingly rare for a Dragonlord and their Dragon to become Hollowborn together. Only the strongest of bonds can pass the Shadow Fiend's test.

name: Hollowborn DragonSlayer
description: To control a dragon takes strength. To control a dragon without it knowing you are the puppetmaster takes skill, stealth, and subterfuge.

name: Hollowborn DragonWrath
description: ﻿Awakening from a flurry of blood, talons, and flame, a Dragonlord's body became Hollow-but their mind was lost to the Shadow Fiend's abyss. With Draconic strength, they tear through any that stand in the way of their blind rage.

name: Hollowborn DreamWalker
description: Some DreamWalkers can send their minds through dreams and dimensions to get information or watch their enemies, but Hollowborn DreamWalkers are able to go there personally if needed. Though it is a gift from the Shadow Fiend to do such thing, it comes with a  price.

name: Hollowborn Druid
description: The Hollowborn Druid is a taboo subject amongst their former brothers and sisters. They defied the cycle of nature, changed their destiny, and the fates of others.

name: Hollowborn Envoy of Chaos
description: Chaos reigns again??? Maybe. This armor is proof the Champion of Chaos has had another chance from the shadows…

name: HollowBorn Evoker (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: HollowBorn Evoker (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Executioner
description: Always searching for ways to obtain more power, the Hollowborn Executioner has mastered all types of combat. May the Shadow Fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Fiend Guard
description: As a puppetmaster, the Fiend Reaper controls the fiend's

name: Hollowborn Fiend Reaper
description: As a puppetmaster, the Fiend Reaper controls the fiend's

name: Hollowborn Frost King (0 AC)
description: A different outcome, a different time, with no one to save you. Your rebirth means the end of a world that did you wrong.

name: Hollowborn Frost King (AC)
description: A different outcome, a different time, with no one to save you. Your rebirth means the end of a world that did you wrong.

name: Hollowborn Frost Queen (0 AC)
description: A different outcome, a different time, with no one to save you. Your rebirth means the end of a world that did you wrong.

name: Hollowborn Frost Queen (AC)
description: A different outcome, a different time, with no one to save you. Your rebirth means the end of a world that did you wrong.

name: Hollowborn GateKeeper
description: You're certainly gifted, and your efforts have been recognized. The Gatekeeper title is not entrusted to ordinary beings, and you are no exception, Hollowborn.

name: Hollowborn Judge (Armor)
description: The Hollowborn Judge remains in a state of frailty caused by past trauma and her rebirth as a Hollowborn. These robes represent the highest virtues of Justice.

name: Hollowborn Judge In Officio
description: The Hollowborn Judge remains in a state of frailty caused by past trauma and her rebirth as a Hollowborn. These robes represent the highest virtues of Justice.

name: Hollowborn Keeper
description: The Hollowborn Keeper is duty bound to by purpose and bond. Great beasts and vile sinners are kept shackled by their chains. This is a punishment, and a mercy. Prisoners must find comfort in darkness, for there will be no escape.

name: Hollowborn Legion Champion
description: Unaffected by emotions and impervious to remorse, Champion pledge their full allegiance to the Undead Legion. Yet, it was the passion to serve their Lord that allowed them to become Hollowborn when they were pushed to the brink.

name: Hollowborn Lich King
description: The Hollowborn and the Legion. The indomitable will to live versus the embracing of death's terror and might. They sound like opposites, but neither are willing to go gentle into the night.

name: Hollowborn Lich King's Pride
description: The Hollowborn and the Legion. The indomitable will to live versus the embracing of death's terror and might. They sound like opposites, but neither are willing to go gentle into the night.

name: Hollowborn LoveCaster (AC)
description: Have you ever thought about what it would feel like to live without feeling love? If you don't want to find out firsthand, then don't make enemies with a Love Caster. The line between love and its opposite is much thinner than you may think…

name: Hollowborn LoveCaster (Merge)
description: Have you ever thought about what it would feel like to live without feeling love? If you don't want to find out firsthand, then don't make enemies with a Love Caster. The line between love and its opposite is much thinner than you may think…

name: Hollowborn Lycan (Armor)
description: Triumphing over the trial of the Shadow Fiend granted these werewolves new lives and an immunity to silver. Their pack howled to the moon, rejoicing as their kin returned to life stronger than ever before.

name: Hollowborn Malignant
description: Centuries after the Queen of Monsters was sealed away, Xing and Xang were corrupted and combined by Chaos, reborn as ChaosLord Xiang. Now the shadows have finally adopted the aspect of Evil itself.

name: Hollowborn Nightmare (Armor)
description: Some DreamWalkers can send their minds through dreams and dimensions to get information or watch their enemies, but Hollowborn DreamWalkers are able to go there personally if needed. Though it is a gift from the Shadow Fiend to do such thing, it comes with a  price.

name: Hollowborn OniSlayer
description: Oni are bloodthirsty man eaters. Violence and depravity are in their nature. The OniSlayers are warriors trusted to hunt these monsters. But, one day, Oni blood will seep into their veins…or a far more fantastic creature will make them Hollow.

name: Hollowborn Paladin
description: Even in death, a paladin never loses their faith and sense of justice. if these two things are strong enough, one may rise as a Hollowborn Paladin. A light that shines even in the darkest days.

name: HollowBorn Paragon (0 AC)
description: The Paragon is back with color custom detailing, darker, and more brutal than ever! (This item is color customizable and will return for Dage's 2024 Birthday Collection + rares shop before going perma-rare. )

name: HollowBorn Paragon (AC)
description: The Paragon is back with color custom detailing, darker, and more brutal than ever! (This item is color customizable and will return for Dage's 2024 Birthday Collection + rares shop before going perma-rare. )

name: Hollowborn Ranger
description: Upon death, the Dawn Vindicator Archer refused to die. Their arrows still needed to fly for the cause. It was the Shadow Fiend that turned them into a Hollowborn Ranger, and became the reason they were hunted by the soldiers that once protected them.

name: Hollowborn Raven (0 AC)
description: Once the companions of frost, these infamous rogues roam frigid wastes of their own accord. Where they linger, those who face death are given a second chance.

name: Hollowborn Raven (AC)
description: Once the companions of frost, these infamous rogues roam frigid wastes of their own accord. Where they linger, those who face death are given a second chance.

name: Hollowborn Sentinel (Armor)
description: Fallen warriors under Kasebel's orders. Guarding the fortress and its secrets, the Hollowborn Sentinels are the closest things from an army you may see around Shadow Realm. They're often seen in groups, though a couple of them might be in the shadows waiting for you…

name: Hollowborn Shadow Shaper (AC)
description: A fallen mage, now in servitude of the darkness and what lies there … A shadow manipulator who fuses them with his own mana, able to create and shape unique weapons, and strangely resistant minions. It is not common to see him in daylight, but hope never to find him in the darkness of night.

name: Hollowborn Shadow Shaper (Legend)
description: A fallen mage, now in servitude of the darkness and what lies there … A shadow manipulator who fuses them with his own mana, able to create and shape unique weapons, and strangely resistant minions. It is not common to see him in daylight, but hope never to find him in the darkness of night.

name: Hollowborn ShadowRaptor Rider
description: Known for training hundreds of armies, this warrior spent most of the life as someone's master. Knights, Tamers… Now as a Hollowborn, the Trainer wishes to keep on preparing new generations of fighters. May the Shadow Fiend, and the creature named "Vex" show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Shadowslayer
description: These Shadowslayers draw strength from pain and anguish. Their path to greater power is rife with endless struggles and adversity.

name: Hollowborn Summoner
description: OniSlayers can become summoners by defeating Yokai, and making them Shikigami. In the world of wild, man-eating Yokai - might makes right. Only the strong are worthy of being their masters.

name: Hollowborn Tamer (Armor)
description: Expert hunters, the Hollowborn Tamers are constantly looking for a task. Their master, the Hollowborn Trainer, may guide them through their new life. May the Shadow Fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Tester
description: No Hollowborn Class got enough Grace like that. That's rare.

name: Hollowborn Thorn Assassin
description: ﻿Assaassins that once recieved their blessings and names from Nature have stolen it for themselves. They broke free from Nature's rule of paying for life with death. The titles of Castor and Sumac will never be passed on from their Holloborn owners.

name: Hollowborn Thunderlord
description: The power of thunder and lightning is a difficult one to wield - one that only the most determined of Hollowborn can master.

name: Hollowborn Trainer
description: Known for training hundreds of armies, this warrior spent most of the life as someone's master. Knights, Tamers… Now as a Hollowborn, the Trainer wishes to keep on preparing new generations of fighters. May the Shadow Fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Treasure Hunter
description: Seldom seen by their own brethren, these Hollowborn pursue the unknown. They prefer travelling alone, relishing more in the challenge of seeking treasure than using it for themselves.

name: Hollowborn Undead Warrior
description: A wrathful warrior of the Legion. Their barbarism is famed, even more so after they became Hollowborn. Empowered by their master as well as the Shadow Fiend, they became unstoppable.

name: HollowBorn Valkyrie
description: Without darkness, light cannot truly shine.

name: Hollowborn Vampire (Armor)
description: Death (well, UNdeath) helps to provide power to the Hollowborn Vampire. Who knows what they are going to use that power for…

name: Hollowborn Vampire Knight
description: ﻿Knights once loyal to Vampire Queen Safiria suffered from a mysterious disease. They were reborn with new vampiric powers laden with the same disease they succumbed to.

name: Hollowborn Vampire Lord
description: The lords were not as immortal as they thought. It was their thirst for blood and vengeance that won them a second chance at immortality and power. Every ounce of blood will be wrought from the veins of their killers.

name: Hollowborn Varsity Uniform
description: Rah rah rah! #Team Hollowborn! (Requires Rank 10 Hollowborn)

name: Hollowborn Vindicator Armor
description: In another time and space, the Hero became the Hollowborn Vindicator, the last stand against a Celestial deity. If Shadows linger after the end, that means there's still enough light to cast them.

name: Hollowborn Vine Rogue
description: A rogue that has met death and overcame it themselves. Poison isn't just their trade anymore. It seeps out of their pores, kills, and satiates the hollowness in death's realm left by their absense.

name: Hollowborn Volleyball Jersey (0 AC)
description: Get ready to game in your Hollowborn Volleyball Jersey! (CC to eye)

name: Hollowborn Volleyball Jersey (AC)
description: Get ready to game in your Hollowborn Volleyball Jersey! (CC to eye)

name: Hollowborn Warden
description: The Hollowborn Warden is bound to their duty by purpose and bond. Great beasts and vile sinners are kept shackled by their chains. This is a punishment, and a mercy. Prisoners must find comfort in darkness, for there will be no escape.

name: Hollowborn Witch
description: Passing the Shadow Fiend's test, the Hollowborn Witches return, empowered by incredibly powerful magic. The Witch Hunters will come to regret what they've done.(Female only)

name: Hollowborn WyvernSlayer
description: The horrors inflicted by the worst of Dragonkind make their enemies stronger. From ashes and crushed bone, the Slayers rise as Hollowborn.

name: Hollowink Garb
description: Crafted in honor of legendary designer iTeka's birthday, made from a rare, highly desirable inky-black fabric with mysterious powers.

name: HollowNight Pumpkin Knight
description: Picked at the dark of the moon, these gourds are not recommended for eating… but for wearing!

name: HollowNight Pumpkin Lord
description: Picked at the dark of the moon, these gourds are not recommended for eating… but for wearing!

name: Hollowsoul Ghoul
description: The Hollowsoul Ghouls roam the halls of Hollowsoul Castle, but lately have been spotted roaming the shadows of MystCroft. It is too early to tell what kind of omen this may be.

name: Hollowsoul Knight
description: According to legend, an ancient order of knights once protected an impenetrable castle belonging to Duke Ellington. After Hollowsoul's collapse, the order was disbanded and to this day, have rarely been seen again.

name: Hollowsoul Knight Captain
description: The Hollowsoul Ghouls roam the halls of Hollowsoul Castle, but lately have been spotted roaming the shadows of MystCroft. It is too early to tell what kind of omen this may be.

name: Hollowsoul Wraith (Armor)
description: The only thing worse than living without a soul is living with a hollowed one.

name: Holly Jolly Elf
description: No one throughout Lore has more holiday spirit than you! Great job not letting the weather bring you down as you shared holiday cheer throughout Lore 12 days in a row!

name: Holo DataKnight Armor
description: Battle alongside the Dragons of Time as you attempt to command the universe!

name: Holy Healer
description: A little ice and snow won't be enough to stop these healers. Armed with metal toughness and powers to match you'll find them on the front lines helping those most in need.

name: Hometown Hero Cheer
description: It's 2021 and what better year to update your look! Go Corsairs!

name: Hometown Hero Varsity
description: It's 2021 and what better year to update your look! Go Corsairs!

name: Honor Battle Guard
description: I fight the never ending battle for truth, justice, and the loreican way!

name: Honor Guard
description: I fight the never ending battle for truth, justice, and the Loreican way!

name: Honor of Onslaught
description: There are those who take pride in a swift kill, then there are those who take pride in a violent attack.

name: Honorable Koi Ningyo
description: The aquatic nations which dwell under the Seven Seas of Yokai must defeat a ningyo in battle before they can be considered warriors. Legend also has it that eating a a ningyo's flesh may grant immortality… but no one has proven it true. Yet.

name: Honorable Ninja
description: When one follows the code of the ninja, one must sacrifice everything for the greated good, only then can you achieve this level of honor.

name: Honorbound Darkblood
description: Bound by the truth. Bound by the righteous. Bound by honor. They fight for Lore. Parts of this armor are color custom.

name: Honored Oni Hatamoto
description: In the tradition of Yokai Isles warriors, the Hakamoto are bannerman that are expected to lay their lives down for their Lords and people. Even the yokai themselves will protect any and all that call the Isles their home.

name: Honored Sandsea Guest
description: The Sandsea persists and thrives under a tacit understanding that this is only possible through cooperation. Travelers are recieved with hospitality no matter where they go.

name: Honra Selvagem
description: The Carnaval brings out the wild side of everyone but you can still show your honor and heritage in this armor.

name: Hooked Metal Mog
description: It's reported that spending 1 night with this equipped will give you some… interesting visions. Violent visions. Spend any longer than 5 nights and you begin to lose your memory of who you are… Only the urges to extinguish life.

name: Hoptimus Prime
description: A mecha battle frame, renamed from its original designation "Jebunny" to appeal to a wider audience. You're supposed to see its fight capabilities as 'long range hopping.'

name: Horc Armor (Permanent)
description: Me make fur and metal look GOOD.

name: Horc Armor (Temporary)
description: Me make fur and metal look GOOD.

name: Horc Deathmonger
description: Horc Deathmongers show no mercy. The Horcs' unforgiving and ruthless fighting style dominate the battlefield while being protected with intricate battle armor forged from obsidian stone.

name: Horc Evader Armor
description: The Horcs have trained you in the arts of evasion. They have shown you their secret art of beast lore.

name: Horc Glory Armor
description: You be strong. You deserve strong armor that shine like sun. Everyone know you big deal.

name: Horc Grunt
description: The backbone of the Horc forces.

name: Horc Peacekeeper
description: Trolls say Horcs savage. Peacekeepers use strength to keep fighting at minimum.

name: Horc Warrior Thok
description: A gift from old comrades. Juvania mistook it for a costume tucked away on a shelf. Thok doesn't go trick- or-treating, but these clothes shouldn't be left to collect dust either. It's time to return to the glory days.

name: HorcCraft Commander
description: An elite version of a breed of Horcs discovered after Bloodtusk Ravine was scarred by chaos. They are more abrasive and protective of their tribes. And it's always for the Horcs!

name: Horcish Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Horc Commanders may sail on the sea, but are still like mountain — hard, tough, loyal. We keep the seas a near Bloodtusk Ravine free and strong, defending from Chaos.

name: Horcish Naval Commander (AC)
description: Horc Commanders may sail on the sea, but are still like mountain — hard, tough, loyal. We keep the seas a near Bloodtusk Ravine free and strong, defending from Chaos.

name: Horrified Keeper
description: Not someone you'd want to meet in a dark alley. Or a lit alley for that matter

name: Horselord Guardian
description: Centaur warriors have long been some of Lore's fiercest and fastest fighters. With 4 hooves and as many blades as they can carry, they are a force to be reckoned with.

name: Hot Girl
description: Because she represents fire. She is full of passion, excitement, and drama!

name: Howling Wizard of Haven
description: You caught a falling star. In your castle, journey far. Just stay true to who you are.

name: Howling Wizard's Formal
description: You caught a falling star. In your castle, journey far. Just stay true to who you are.

name: Huaso's Atuendo Elegante
description: Free and unfettered, the skilled horseman is a master of the open plains, the hills, and the valleys. When not overseeing their flocks and fields, many Chilean Huaso and Huasa can be found ruling the rodeo and /dancing at celebrations.

name: Huaso's Atuendo Escabroso
description: Free and unfettered, the skilled horseman is a master of the open plains, the hills, and the valleys. When not overseeing their flocks and fields, many Chilean Huaso and Huasa can be found ruling the rodeo and /dancing at celebrations.

name: Huaso's Atuendo Festejo
description: Free and unfettered, the skilled horseman is a master of the open plains, the hills, and the valleys. When not overseeing their flocks and fields, many Chilean Huaso and Huasa can be found ruling the rodeo and /dancing at celebrations.

name: Huaso's Atuendo Oscuro
description: Free and unfettered, the skilled horseman is a master of the open plains, the hills, and the valleys. When not overseeing their flocks and fields, many Chilean Huaso and Huasa can be found ruling the rodeo and /dancing at celebrations.

name: Hunter
description: Be at your most threatening in this armor. Your prey shall never stand a chance.

name: Hunters Moon Warrior
description: These warriors fight against the Mooncursed Beast, Marchosias to save their village.

name: Huomaren Zhanshi
description: "Do you know? Hope is the same as despair. Those who fail will fall into despair. Those who fight will make their hopes a reality. Or so I heard during my battles in Embersea with Tyndarius…"

name: Hybrid Manticore
description: The deadly poison of the manticore mixed with the unpredictable nature of chaos has transformed you into a manticore hydrid!

name: Hydra Armor
description: This armor is crafted and enchanted by the power of the Hydra.

name: Hydra Hunter
description: Legend says that 2 heads are better than 1… but when you retrieve the 3 heads of the Hydra, you will become the Number 1 Hydra Hunter!

name: Hydra's Hark Crewman
description: ﻿Deckhands and technicians of the renegade pirate ship, the Hydra's Hark. They followed Commander Gallaeon to a watery grave, and returned to dye the seas and skies red.

name: HydraCaster
description: The HydraCaster Order sprang from an early off-shoot of the Sisterhood of the Dishpan Hands. They focus on using their water magic to wash away all the ills of the world leaving battlefields clean and pure enough to become farmlands.

name: HypeFiend of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Nulgath! Nulgath! Yayyyy Nulgath! This item gives 15% more gold when equipped.

name: HypeFiend of Nulgath (AC)
description: Nulgath! Nulgath! Yayyyy Nulgath! This item gives 15% more gold when equipped.

name: HypeFiend of Nulgath (Merge)
description: Nulgath! Nulgath! Yayyyy Nulgath!

name: Hyper Suit of Dark
description: Less bulky, and crafted for agility, this suit enhances your strength to ensure your enemies will never see you before they are eliminated.

name: Hyper Suit of Light
description: This hyper suit enhances your agility to nearly lightspeed. Surpass the spectrum, Hero, and vanquish all your enemies!

name: Hyperborean Blues
description: Nod at the passerbys as they rush along their way. You may look good, but they also know you are not to be messed with. This armor screams "Don't mess with Tex!"

name: Hyperium Guard
description: As a Hyperium Guard, you can move through Lore with enhanced senses, pinpoint-accuracy, and the knowledge that you alone are what keep thieves from getting close to J6.

name: Hyperspace Marine
description: In space, no one can hear you.. oh, GROSS, what was THAT goo?

name: Iadoa (Armor)
description: Iadoa fought Chaos for many months in order to teach you what you need to know to discover his destiny. Pay homage to his trials by donning his armor!

name: Iara's Acolyte
description: (Gives 30% more XP, gold, class points, and rep when equipped.) They tried to drown her, yet she was saved. Those who work to prevent this from ever happening again wear this armor.

name: Iara's Armor
description: Your will was tested, and you prevailed. You can prove it to any who ask by wearing a version of Iara's armor.

name: Iaste Armor
description: *No description*

name: Ice Beast
description: After leaving there home in the Northland in search of fresh food and drinkable water, the Ice Beasts scour the land of Lore, battling all that stand in the way of their next meal.

name: Ice Claw (Armor)
description: When left out in the cold, those who have no where to turn…turn on each other!

name: Ice Cold Hero Gear (0 AC)
description: Some say the world will end in fire, some say in ice. From what I've seen of battles dire, I hold with those who favor fire. But if I had to perish twice, I think I know enough of hate to prefer ice.

name: Ice Cold Hero Gear (AC)
description: Some say the world will end in fire, some say in ice. From what I've seen of battles dire, I hold with those who favor fire. But if I had to perish twice, I think I know enough of hate to prefer ice.

name: Ice Dragon Armor
description: The power of the Ice dragon flows within this armor made from the scales of fallen dragons. I wouldn't wear this around Galanoth though. Just to be safe.

name: Ice Elf General
description: When the Avatar of Ice made his presence known, the Northlands became ravaged by war. The pureblooded Ice Elves fought Kyanos' first Champion ferociously. Some say, they're still frozen in battle somewhere in the Tundra.

name: Ice Giant (Armor)
description: The raiders in the Northlands have descended upon Battleon and Northpointe… but you're a friendly one, right?

name: Ice King
description: A high-ranking soldier in the ranks of Queen Aisha's army if that soldier is actually human, but there's little to worry about for her. The bright ice actually contains a fraction of her power that causes the user to be distant from others until they succumb to her unquestioned loyalty.

name: Ice Lord Guardian Armor
description: Only a fool would battle against these frozen warriors of the North. Ice runs deep in their veins giving them the upper hand.

name: Ice Protector
description: During the long winter nights of Frostval, they come in search of destruction. The Ice Protectors defend the weak and the innocent when all hope seems to be lost.

name: Ice Rogue
description: Some of the refugees cursed by the cold-blooded Queen were restored to normal over the course of the year, but not completely. They can still deliver a chilling scratch that can freeze the body of their targets.

name: Ice Storm Invoker
description: Let hail and lightning tear apart the land and rip the seas open. These elite magi strangled the light of the sun with their storms. The stronger they became, the faster they transformed.

name: Ice Symbiote (Armor)
description: What better way to survive the winter-long battles than to merge with the ice itself. Take in the cold, the frost, the bitter, biting winds and feel the cold seep into your spirit. Embrace the ice and become a formidable foe.

name: Ice Warrior
description: Embrace the ice and become a formidable foe!

name: Ice Wizard (1)
description: Just as easy as turning water into….ice!

name: Ice Wizard (2)
description: These elemental wizards gain their power from Ice, which is why you mostly see them in the winter months… especially around Frostval.

name: IceBreaker Mage
description: Your enemies will freeze in fear when you step onto the battlefield!

name: IceBreaker Warrior
description: On the frozen battlefield, a warrior will rise up and set a blaze to those who wish to do harm. You shall know this warrior's bitter wrath!

name: Iced Jester
description: Just because it is cold outside, doesn't mean that we can't have a laugh or two. Of course, that laughter is at the expense of the enemies you take down in this armor.

name: IceRise Keep BeastMaster (0 AC)
description: The formalwear of an elite BeastMaster. They train and tend to exotic creatures from the cold tundras. Routinely finding themselves in the employ of royals enchanted by their 'pets,' they attend winter galas in style.

name: IceRise Keep BeastMaster (AC)
description: The formalwear of an elite BeastMaster. They train and tend to exotic creatures from the cold tundras. Routinely finding themselves in the employ of royals enchanted by their 'pets,' they attend winter galas in style.

name: Icestorm Eagle Rider (0 AC)
description: Adapted to the cold and snow of the North, these riders will face any adversary.

name: IceStorm Eagle Rider (AC)
description: Adapted to the cold and snow of the North, these riders will face any adversary.

name: Icestorm Warlord (0 AC)
description: The frozen Northlands builds the fiercest warriors. No amount of cold will stop these generals from conquering.

name: Icestorm Warlord (AC)
description: The frozen Northlands builds the fiercest warriors. No amount of cold will stop these generals from conquering.

name: IceTen Space Armor
description: After that last job, you did say something about wanting more office space… Why not a whole galaxy?

name: Icewild Hunter
description: Headstrong ice harvesters in the Cryostorm Tundra, the growing threat of the Queen of Monsters have caused the hunters to take on taming ice elementals. Therefore, they began to wear frost-covered clothing to adapt to harsher winters during their voyages.

name: Ichneumon Dragonslayer
description: Upon his travels, Shadowslayer Rei came across the tribe of Ichneumon Dragonslayers. Ichneumons are legendary hunters known for their stealth, who utilize the element of earth to strike down even the mightiest dragons of Lore. The Ichneumon tribe wear the bones of their fallen foes, a sign of respect for their draconian adversaries.

name: Icy Barbarian
description: Warriors of the tundra, brute strength and determination give these barbarians a clear advantage in the battle.

name: Icy Claws Suit (AC)
description: You must have been very, very cold this year…

name: Icy Claws Suit (Legend)
description: You must have been very, very cold this year…

name: Icy Infernal
description: Hidden from sight for centuries, lurking below the frozen depths, these infernals now reek havoc on villagers and heroes.

name: Icy Naval Commander
description: Shiver me timbers! It be thee Icy Naval Commander! A pirate cap'n this cool freezes over.

name: Idle Hollowborn Envoy of Chaos
description: Chaos reigns again??? Maybe. This armor is proof the Champion of Chaos has had another chance from the shadows…

name: Igneus Assassin
description: You've got the eye of the tiger in this stealth assassin armor. Always on the prowl, the cat-like reflexes of the Igneus Assassin are those of legends.

name: Ignited Flame Guardian
description: There is a certain passion which ignites in those who server to defend Lore. The flame is never extinguished for these noble warriors.

name: Ignus Warrior (0 AC)
description: "Fire to strengthen, fire to blind, fire to scorch the unwary mind…" Ignus warriors draw strength from the barely-tamed molten trapped inside cooled lava rock.

name: Ignus Warrior (AC)
description: "Fire to strengthen, fire to blind, fire to scorch the unwary mind…" Ignus warriors draw strength from the barely-tamed molten trapped inside cooled lava rock.

name: Illusionist
description: They'll be no foolish wand waving for this skilled magic users. Their arcane powers fool the eye and confuse the spectator.

name: Illustrious Savior of Battleon
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Immortal Chronomancer Armor (AC)
description: Immortal Chronomancers transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence.

name: Immortal Chronomancer Armor (Special)
description: These intrepid, timely explorers can step into a shadow in one time-stream and emerge from a completely different shadow in another time stream. Immortal Chronomancers transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence.

name: Immortal Crusader
description: As long as you stand together with your compatriots, you will NEVER be defeated! Your motto: Libertad O Muerte!

name: Immortal Dark Caster Armor (0 AC)
description: Dage's promise fulfilled to his Undead Legion.

name: Immortal Dark Caster Armor (AC)
description: Recommended enhancement: Wizard. Dage's promise fulfilled to his Undead Legion.

name: Immortal Edge
description: Royal bronze maroon trimmed long coat with intricate designs and gold embroidery, this is the uniform of the Immortal Edge Pirate.

name: Immortal Lich King (Armor) (0 AC)
description: Kingdoms of the undead, be they underground, spread across poison swamps, or lurking in dark clouds, are found all over Lore. They wage wars with the living, and each other to reach the same heights the Lord of the Legion achieved.

name: Immortal Lich King (Armor) (AC)
description: Kingdoms of the undead, be they underground, spread across poison swamps, or lurking in dark clouds, are found all over Lore. They wage wars with the living, and each other to reach the same heights the Lord of the Legion achieved.

name: Immortal Lich King's Gift (0 AC)
description: Kingdoms of the undead, be they underground, spread across poison swamps, or lurking in dark clouds, are found all over Lore. They wage wars with the living, and each other to reach the same heights the Lord of the Legion achieved.

name: Immortal Lich King's Gift (AC)
description: Kingdoms of the undead, be they underground, spread across poison swamps, or lurking in dark clouds, are found all over Lore. They wage wars with the living, and each other to reach the same heights the Lord of the Legion achieved.

name: Immortal LionSlayer (0 AC)
description: A warrior's will isn't so easily killed. It forges on, prowling in the darkness like a lion. Death can not protect the vile from its rage.

name: Immortal LionSlayer (AC)
description: A warrior's will isn't so easily killed. It forges on, prowling in the darkness like a lion. Death can not protect the vile from its rage.

name: Immortal LionSlayer (Legend)
description: A warrior's will isn't so easily killed. It forges on, prowling in the darkness like a lion. Death can not protect the vile from its rage.

name: Immortal Sacrificer (0 AC)
description: Warriors who have forsaken the Sun and their people to flood the Underworld with blood. They sacrifice the living and the dead to Lore itself, believing it to be a beast that will one day awaken and devour the stars.

name: Immortal Sacrificer (AC)
description: Warriors who have forsaken the Sun and their people to flood the Underworld with blood. They sacrifice the living and the dead to Lore itself, believing it to be a beast that will one day awaken and devour the stars.

name: Immortal Seraphim (0 AC)
description: Often mistaken for Celestials, these members of the Undead Legion achieved new forms as their Lord grew in power and influence. Their wings represent greater purpose, and the sanctity of death.

name: Immortal Seraphim (AC)
description: Often mistaken for Celestials, these members of the Undead Legion achieved new forms as their Lord grew in power and influence. Their wings represent greater purpose, and the sanctity of death.

name: Immortal Summoner (0 AC)
description: Practicing necromancy for so long eroded their flesh and bones. What remains is purely a conduit to summon abominations from the Underworld.

name: Immortal Summoner (AC)
description: Practicing necromancy for so long eroded their flesh and bones. What remains is purely a conduit to summon abominations from the Underworld.

name: Immortal Void General (0 AC)
description: Regardless of origin, the abyss will seep into all. The weak are dissolved but the strong become closer to the Archfiend than any other. They stand as an example of true Nation might.

name: Immortal Void General (AC)
description: Regardless of origin, the abyss will seep into all. The weak are dissolved but the strong become closer to the Archfiend than any other. They stand as an example of true Nation might.

name: Immortalis Magus
description: By the power of blood, breath, and bone, these dark magic users seek the ultimate prize: immortality… and they do not care who they must hurt to achieve it.

name: Imperial Assassin of Skye
description: The Imperial Assassins of Skye were employed by the First Champion of Energy and his kin. When they waged war, lightning fell like rain from dark raging storms. The seas and mountains were split apart by their might.

name: Imperial Chunin Armor
description: A chunin is a ninja field commander. Highly trained to attack from stealth but focusing on strength and power rather than agility and speed.

name: Imperial Doomknight (Armor)
description: The Doomknights who serve the Shadowscythe Empire, tasked with watching the throne. Total domination lies in the path forward, and they will let no one stray from this grand destiny.

name: Imperial Infantry
description: Although the Empire is known for its impressive airborne unit, the infantry is an indispensable portion of the Imperial military. The coordinated aerial and ground-based maneuvers makes the Empire a force to be reckoned with.

name: Imperial Lich Lord (0 AC)
description: Beasts amongst monsters, and pawns struggling against the chains of the Legion. These creations were made from the souls of individuals that had the potential to be the Lord of the Legion's rivals.

name: Imperial Lich Lord (AC)
description: Beasts amongst monsters, and pawns struggling against the chains of the Legion. These creations were made from the souls of individuals that had the potential to be the Lord of the Legion's rivals.

name: Imperial Lightscythe
description: The glorious armor of the leader of the Lightscythe Army, based in Brightfall.

name: Imperial Lightscythe in Shadow (0 AC)
description: The glorious armor of the leader of the Lightscythe Army… given over to the shadows.

name: Imperial Lightscythe in Shadow (AC)
description: The glorious armor of the leader of the Lightscythe Army… given over to the shadows.

name: Imperial Noxus (Armor)
description: Noxus' latest body is a triumphant retum to his lauded roots. He casts dark spells, lifting cities of Undead from their graves. The bones move elegantly, deliberately letting Noxus believe that he's in full control.

name: Imperial Plate Armor
description: This is quality armor crafted from the finest minerals in the land of Lore. Veterans like this armor because it can stand the test of time!

name: Imperium Leo
description: This armor belongs to high ranking officers of the Aegis imperial guard. As a warrior of justice, you've chosen to follow in their footsteps and earned the right to stand among their ranks.

name: Inaba Oni
description: Most Oni are painted with a single brutal, and bloody brush. In reality, there are several independent clans. One revels in festivities and attend tournaments to show off their strength, dressed in merry-making garb.

name: Inbunche (Armor)
description: The Inbunche is a stange, horrific beast commonly found guarding the cave of warlocks and various dark magi. Although no one is sure where the Inbunche originated from no one dares to ever find out.

name: Incarnation Of Madness
description: Have I gone mad? I'm afraid so, but let me tell you something, the best people usually are.

name: Indigo Paladin
description: "By land or sea, I will protect thee."

name: Infernal ArchFiend
description: Infernals who serve the Nation discover that the Fiend's Void offers even greater power. Nulgath recreates them, and aims to rule over all who call themselves Infernal. (Scarf CC to Trim)

name: Infernal Blood Caster
description: Mages who derive power from forming pacts with Evil entities are shunned and derided. The same isn't said for those who have their blood blessed by bright beings - yet both wield the same magic.

name: Infernal Cyber Doomknight
description: Sometimes neon lighting and the microscopic cybernetics can cause a DoomKnight to become more threatening than they appear. The radiant bright colors are a subtle, but severe warning to one who is unfortunate enough to encounter them.

name: Infernal Dark Lord
description: Infernal Generals infused with the Queen's power are the main source of the Infernal Army's victories. Their immense intellect and enhanced strength show that they're not to be taken lightly.

name: Infernal Flame Guardian
description: Fire - what some perceive to be one of the deadliest of elements is also one of the most necessary. Without fire, there is no warmth in the cold, no light in the darkness. The Infernal Flame Guardians keep watch over an Eternal Flame - to ensure that Lore is never plunged into darkness.

name: Infernal Flame Guardian (2)
description: A fire burns within every Celestial, slowly burning through their feathers to reveal the Infernal beneath. This power will grow and flare until it catches the enemy of their Creator.

name: Infernal Flame Pyromancer
description: The fire raging inside you has made you unstoppable… channel it and sear your way to victory! (35% damage boost, 25% boost to gold, exp, rep and class points)

name: Infernal Grim Stalker
description: Don't mess with something that walks around on claws…and looks like a spider…

name: Infernal Harbinger (Armor)
description: The fires of the Underworld have turned you into an Infernal Deathbringer. All who see you will fear.

name: Infernal Invoker (Armor)
description: The flames of magic and power rise within you. Lite the embers and ignite your enemies!

name: Infernal Knight (Armor)
description: There is only darkness around you. Light has no meaning to you. Hatred and power courses through your once proud armor. Now it is a horrific reminder of what has happened that made you this way. No one felt pity for the monster you became.

name: Infernal Lieutenant
description: This soul-chilling armor has traces of extraterrestial energy seeping through it, inducing power-hungry desires.

name: Infernal Mage (Armor)
description: This soul-chilling armor has traces of extraterrestial energy seeping through it, inducing power-hungry desires.

name: Infernal Naval Commander (Armor)
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they went far below Davy Jones's locker.

name: Infernal Pactagonal Knight
description: Fighting the Infernal army sure is hard on the armor. Good thing you've been able to grab some pieces of Infernal armor to replace replace some of the broken parts!

name: Infernal Pirate Captain (Armor)
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they went far below Davy Jones's locker.

name: Infernal Ranger
description: This soul-chilling armor has traces of extraterrestial energy seeping through it, inducing power-hungry desires.

name: Infernal Revenger (Armor) (0 AC)
description: The twisted Infernals who follow Evil Archmage Brentan in the Mmirror Realm love two things best. Fire, and dealing pain to their enemies.

name: Infernal Revenger (Armor) (AC)
description: The twisted Infernals who follow Evil Archmage Brentan in the Mmirror Realm love two things best. Fire, and dealing pain to their enemies.

name: Infernal Scryer
description: Swamp infernos are capable of using pointy plants to create a deadly array of weapons, causing them to be a dangerous sub-species.

name: Infernal Shadow Warlord
description: An elite corps of Underworld Battlemages, the Infernal Shadow Warlords can summon infernal creatures from the place between worlds.

name: Infernal Slayer
description: Charged by the Light, these warriors start a never ending quest to rid the world of evil and all its beings

name: Infernal Symbiote
description: Infernal blood sets your veins ablaze. It seeps into your flesh, holding you like a grudge.

name: Infernal Trigger Forme
description: The darkness of night falls around my soul, and the Infernal within loses control.

name: Infernal Underworld Apprentice
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Infernal Underworld Lord
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Infernal Underworld Slayer
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Infernal Wanderer
description: The Bright One can not escape. Like their progenitor, Azalith, the Infernal Wanderers are on an endless hunt for the power of Creation - and an answer. If the Bright One is so powerful, why did it allow Celestials to fall?

name: Infernal Warrior (Armor) (1)
description: Dage the Evil, in his dark wisdom, has allowed you to acquire the Infernal Warrior armor set from the Wheel of Doom!

name: Infernal Warrior (Armor) (2)
description: This soul-chilling armor has traces of extraterrestial energy seeping through it, inducing power-hungry desires.

name: Infernalfiend of Nulgath
description: A general in Nulgath's Army, the Infernalfiend is willing to do WHATEVER it takes to please his master and lead his armies to victory!

name: Inferno
description: This armor is hot, hot, HOT! Fire is the only element responsible for life and death simultaneously. Inspired by player KittiKataklysm.

name: Inferno Dracolich Armor
description: If you thought a bad burning could break apart the bones, think again. A fire dragon's bones are extremely heat-resistant even in its afterlife.

name: Inferno Dragon Warrior
description: These warriors will always rise up from the ashes to fight!

name: Inferno Soul Samurai (0 AC)
description: These samurai mastered fiery arcane magic. Their blades burn as hot as their soul, blessing them with the power to set the sky ablaze at the cost of shortening their lives. To perish in the flames of battle. What a glorious death!

name: Inferno Soul Samurai (AC)
description: These samurai mastered fiery arcane magic. Their blades burn as hot as their soul, blessing them with the power to set the sky ablaze at the cost of shortening their lives. To perish in the flames of battle. What a glorious death!

name: Inferno Stalker
description: Deep in the depths of the most vicious volcanos, a clan of warriors is said to feed of its power.

name: Infernus Guardian
description: Infernus Guardians are charged with protecting the entrance to the Plane of Fire by the Avatar of Fire, Fiamme. Fueled by the fires of dedication and loyalty, they are incorruptible.

name: Infested Undead Dreadspider
description: A monstrosity born from Arachnomancy and Necromancy, serving as a nest for a horde of undead spiders. It is a mindless beast of pure violence that cannibalizes its own arachnid brethren.

name: Infiltrator

name: Ivoryfall Dragonblood
description: The descendants of Ice Dragons, mightier than their forebears because of mixed blood. Though they had no scales of their own, they wore hide gifted to them by their Draconic kin.

name: Jack Rabbit
description: Don't let the fur fool you. Claw, spit, rip and tear your way through the bad guys. Fight dirty and be proud of it! No one will ever see it coming. I mean, come on, who ever suspects the bunny?

name: Jackpot Winner
description: YOU WON THE BEST PRIZE! (But now you have to carry it everywhere you go. I hope you buffed your STR!)

description: Hard as dragon scales and just as sharp, these magi of the Jade Dragon continue their conquest knowledge.

name: Jade Rabbit Pirate

name: Jade Samurai (Armor)
description: An upper echelon of the warrior class, the Jade Samurai defends the land from evil in the name of honor. When crossing the path of the Samurai, you first must cross paths with their blade.

name: Jade Yokai Dragonguard
description: The warriors who left the Wuji Empire with General Zheng have sworn loyalty to his beloved Granddaughter, the Empress of the Yokai Isles. They boast several lifetimes of experience.

name: Jade Yokai Dragonguard Plate
description: The warriors who left the Wuji Empire with General Zheng have sworn loyalty to his beloved Granddaughter, the Empress of the Yokai Isles. They boast several lifetimes of experience.

name: Jaded Villager
description: Garb yourself in this lovely green ensemble. It will brighten your day as you go about town!

name: Jafar Armor
description: The most noble, but also the most ambitious, of the Guardians, Jafar's heart burns with the passion of his mission -- to keep the Djinn Realms safe.

description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as JD!

description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as Jerry!

description: Pirates ships be needin' a special kind o' cruelty, why not one what has a few giggles t' spare? NOW BACK TO THE GOOD PART!

name: Jester Outfit
description: April Fools! 2009.

name: Jiangshi
description: Little is known about these ancient undead, said to only exist before Wuji's era of eternity. Legends say that these rise feed on qi, angered that part of their soul was barred from the afterlife. (Necklace CC to Accessory)

name: Jin Gong Ji
description: The feathers that make up these robes are from the legendary Sriracha Holycud. These feathers are a symbol of one's flaming passion. They also help you keep warm in the Northlands!

name: Jingling Armor Giftbox 12
description: A present shaped like an armor! Someone did a phenomenal job at wrapping this gift. You can't equip this YET, but make sure to keep it's cuz it will magically open at the start of the new year. And no peeking!

name: Jolly Frostval Attire
description: Dress for the season! Frost Moglins have warm hearts but VERY cold paws. Make sure you dress warmly before receiving Frostval hugs!

name: Jolly Frostval Caster
description: Mages who originated from the Northstar Village in Frostval, they are tasked to spread the spirit of giving and cheering regardless of friend and foe. After Garaja's defeat, these mages are now considered urban legends among Frostval.

name: Jolly Frostval Suit (0 AC)
description: Frostval is a time to spend with family and friends before you go off on your next adventure. Wear your warmest coat and your brightest smile! (This item is color customizable.)

description: Frostval is a time to spend with family and friends before you go off on your next adventure. Wear your warmest coat and your brightest smile! (This item is color customizable.)

name: Jouster

name: Joy Explorer

description: Live a life full of color, happiness, joy, and pride. Battle On!

description: Celebrate the return of the light / Deck your home with its greenery / And ribbons of red, green and gold shining bright!

name: Jurassic Raptor Rider
description: Terrify your opponents when you charge into battle on the back of a raging raptor!

name: Jus Divinum Lieutenant
description: Once a member of the secretive Jus Divinum Order has proven their valor in battle and their tactical prowess in the war-room, they may be promoted to the rank of Lieutenant.

name: Jus Divinum Major
description: This armor once belonged to a high ranking member of the secret Jus Divinum.

name: Justicar
description: The Justicars of Doomwood ensure that justice is received by ALL who seek it!

name: Justice Warrior
description: Fight for truth, justice, and equality!

name: JVI
description: All hail the brave, noble, and mighty JVI! Long live JVI!

name: K.I.S.S. Armor
description: A heavy metal armor belonging to the Knights In the Shadowscythe Service - K.I.S.S for short. You are now a Rock n' Roll Knight who battles everyday!

name: Kabasaran
description: Warriors adorned in red, masters of their own unique martial art, swords, spears, and war dances. Their red garb invokes the crimson birds that that duel through the seasons for honor.

name: Kahn of Dragons Barbarian
description: This armor will protect you while hunting for fire-breathing beasts that roam the skies!

name: Kaiju Cannoneer (Armor)
description: Kaiju cannoneers follow the call of Klashex.

name: Kaiju Naval Commander (Armor)
description: These scurvy dogs serve the Kaiju, they be rotten to the core.

name: Kaiju Pirate Captain
description: In honor of the beasts that fought OMGZilla eons ago, these captains were these Kaiju uniforms to intimidate the poor saps they plunder from.

name: Kakarotting Zombie
description: You're kakaROTTING! Ahahahahahaha!

name: Kalayaan Warrior
description: Maligayang Araw ng Kalayaan sa lahat ng manlalaro sa Pilipinas.

name: Kalestri Worshiper (Armor)
description: Sprouting a new pair of arms, you've become an entity of great power, bringing doom to all you face. There is no limit to what your power can change. …plus you can eat two sandwiches at the same time!

name: Kaminari Void (0 AC)
description: The lightning that pierces the Abyss. These Fiends were tasked with delving into the Void, tearing it asunder to claim it for their Master.

description: The lightning that pierces the Abyss. These Fiends were tasked with delving into the Void, tearing it asunder to claim it for their Master.

description: The Kanataka Warriors are an elite fighting force which patrol the skies over Yokai Island. They are prepared to slay - or sacrifice - whatever is necessary in order to fulfill their duty.

name: Kanga Onesie
description: Aussie Aussie Aussie, Oi Oi Oi! (Ok, this is not the best thing to shout before bed. You'll scatter the sheep you need to count.)

name: Karkinos Champion Clasher
description: These warriors were created to humble champions when they become arrogant enough to think they can conquer the sea. Their armors are near impenetrable and move swiftly in the crushing waves.

name: Karma Army
description: Free will is just an illusions, because once you cross paths with the Karma Armor, choosing to live with be out of your hands. Hope those "good deeds" that you have been performing finally pays off for you.

name: Kat Burglar
description: You've heard of cat burglars… but not the Kat Burglar! Sleek and stealthy, able to jump to high places - and fall from them (without getting hurt) too!

name: Kathool Acolyte
description: The Acolyte is only just beginning to learn and transform. Those tendrils clinging to their bodies will begin to fuse with their flesh as their knowledge of the forbidden deepens in the depths.

name: Kathool Adept
description: A recreating of an armor found in Cysero's Superstore of Savings, that MAY make you go mad. But before it does, you'll have access to a wide range of Water Darkness, and Evil skills with which to annihilate your enemies!

name: Kathool Annihilator
description: Land or sea, it doesn't matter where we will battle because we will be victorious!

name: Kathool Kultist (Armor)
description: The Kultists of Kathool hear the call of the Depths. Joy, sorrow, rage, and regret is enlightenment to those who lurk in the deep. The Kultists are invited to feed on them, take their power, and become one. Together. Survive. Thrive.

name: Kawaii School Uniform (AC)
description: It seems that you're a seemingly normal student with a seemingly normal lifestyle; but once this school uniform comes off, you become the world's greatest hero… or villain!

name: Kawaii School Uniform (Legend)
description: It seems that you're a seemingly normal student with a seemingly normal lifestyle; but once this school uniform comes off, you become the world's greatest hero… or villain!

name: Kawaii Vixen Maid
description: Oh, fur fox sake! Truly kawaii vixens aren't born… they're maid.

name: Kezeroth's Armor 13 (Rare)
description: Bring about the destruction of Lore and seeing your destiny come to fruition while donning this monstrosity of an armor.

name: Kezeroth's Armor (Legend)
description: Bring about the destruction of Lore and seeing your destiny come to fruition while donning this monstrosity of an armor.

name: Kezeroth's Armor (Non-Legend)
description: Bring about the destruction of Lore and seeing your destiny come to fruition while donning this monstrosity of an armor.

name: Kezeroth the Worldsaver (AC)
description: Lore will not fall… as long as a Hero with Kezeroth the Worldsaver's loyalty and honor still battles in Lore!

name: Kezeroth the Worldsaver (Legend)
description: Lore will not fall… as long as a Hero with Kezeroth the Worldsaver's loyalty and honor still battles in Lore!

name: Killek BoneBreaker (Armor)
description: Killek Bonebreaker was kicked out the Bonebreaker Bandit Brigade for snacking on weaker recruits. He'll need to find a new home, and a new overlord to serve.

name: Kind of Brave
description: Just as easy as turning water into….ice!

name: Kindred's Valiance Armor
description: Courage of the moment is bound within the simple weave of this relic. With study and focus, it seeks to lend aid to strike the foe at their weakest, but miss by just a hair, and the force is lost. Words spoken by another from the AdventureQuest timeline.

name: King and Queen of Hearts
description: This majestic armor is worn by the happy go lucky romancers in never fail in finding new mates to play a game of cards with the risks of the two competitors spending the rest of their lives with each other or not.

name: King Coal's Armor
description: King Coal was a merry ol' soul and a merry ol' armor had he. You fought with your might and gave him a fright, and now you wear his armor with glee!

name: King Dethrix's Armor
description: You DARE look me in the eye? Bow before your rightful sovereign. - King Dethrix Drakath

name: King Klunk Follower
description: Only those who address themselves in the 3rd person can appreciate Klunk's use of language. King Klunk, the Word Smith.

name: King of the Dark (Armor)
description: Fear of the unknown ruled Lore in an era long past, when mana and magic were still a mystery. The King of the Dark was a living calamity of Fire, Ice, Light, and Darkness. He fed on beasts, and preyed on mankind, a ruler of this dark age.

name: Kirin's Avatar
description: This armor is worn by those chosen to be avatars of the kirin guardian spirit of Yokai.

name: Kitsune Commander (0 AC)
description: The fox spirit guides these pirates to riches beyond the shores of Yokai island.

name: Kitsune Commander (AC)
description: The fox spirit guides these pirates to riches beyond the shores of Yokai island.

name: Kittarian Burglar
description: Kittarians are naturally silent, effective burglars because of their ability to sneak around unnoticed and grab their bounty before anyone is the wiser.

name: Kitteh Warriorz
description: Teh scratchin post wont be an obstacle nomore 4 u!

name: Kitty Clown
description: From the shores of Nope in the village of NoWay comes the fabled Uh-Uh Sorry.

name: Kitty Kawaii Outfit
description: For cat fans or people as capricious as a kitten. Yesterday's favorite toy is today's boring torn up ball of fluff, but you can't not love this wardrobe!

name: Kitty SkyFighter
description: That mouse behind the large jar of sardines on the top shelf I couldn't get to for so long is finally mine. No more fruitless jumping and tired legs for me.

name: Klawaii Prisoner
description: I bet you regret trying to fit inside the KotaPon GachaPon machine now, hunh?

name: Knight Armor
description: The classic knight, straight out of a fairy tale or chivalric legend, are hard to come by these days.

name: Knight Errant's Plate
description: This armor has seen some action. For who or what is anyone's guess. All that matters is that it's still holding together.

name: Knight of Lichens (Armor)
description: The armor of the Knight of Thorns - the Prickly Flower of the South.

name: Knight of Light
description: The royal guardians of Queen Lynaria, the defend all who pose a threat.

name: Knight of Light +5
description: Ooo shiny. Gold and silver very noble. Wonder how this would look in red? Doesn't matter, because THIS version gives you 5% more damage against undead monsters AND 5% more gold!

name: Knight of Love
description: Knight in Shining armor, meet your competition, Love Knight! Style, grace and a massive desire to make all the wrongs, right, encapsulate the man or woman who chooses to wear the colors of love.

name: Knight of Noelle
description: The protectors of House Noelle and the wardens of the Yew Mountain Chain. Not only are they skilled fighters, but each Knight is personally thought alchemy and magic by their Lady.

name: Knight of Roses
description: To protect beauty, love, and passion - the Knights of Roses aim to uphold chivalry and heroism. They'll come to the rescue, even if you don't need them to!

name: Knight of Shadows
