description: Serve your Empress well and one day, you too may command a full legion of Shadowscythe!

name: Knight of the Fallen
description: There is only darkness around you. Light has no meaning to you. Hatred and power courses through your once proud armor. Now is a horrific reminder of what has happened that made you this way. No one felt pity for the monster you became.

name: Knight of the Grid
description: Those who cross Lore shall be derezzed!

name: Knight of the Leviasea
description: They say that the Leviasea is the greatest mystery on the face of Lore. Unable to be seen, but undeniable in its power, only those few chosen humans who have been blessed by it can truly comprehend its gifts.

name: Knight of the Shining Armor
description: This armor designed by Coolboypai will bring hope to all of those that are lost in the cold dark night. Just remember to look to the north star and there you will find a faint shimmering sign that all hope isn't lost yet.

name: Knight of Thorns (Armor)
description: This armor of the Knight of Thorns - the Prickly Flower of the South.

name: Knight Terror
description: In the realm of nightmares, your only shot at survival is to fight fear with fear. Once you don this armor forged by solidified terror, your enemies will have nightmares about you.

name: Koibito Yukata
description: It is a wonderous thing, when Yokai New Year and Hero's Heart Day are celebrated at the same time! Wear this yukata as you stroll through Akiba with your true love.

name: Korn Logo T-shirt
description: *No description*

name: KotaMart Replica
description: KotaMart's 26th special edition gear! It hasn't even reached the shelves yet! I wonder how Kotaro managed to get his hands on-wait a minute…

name: KotaPon Prize A
description: Oooh! You've won an Anamalous Armor from the KotaPon GachaPon machine!

name: Kotaro's PJs
description: I love to fell feel comfortable 24/7. However, when I head to bed, there's another particular type of comfort which I just have to achieve. Comfort which transcends the very laws of time and space!

name: Krampus (1)
description: There is a myth that the Loremasters speak of. Magic was not always as it is now. In the days of old, druids would channel the power of nature, using their bodies as conduits. But that's only a myth. Right?

name: Krampus (2)
description: Is Krampus a Claus or a killer? Only time will tell.

name: Kyoki's Rage DragonSlayer
description: With a shriek of rage and mourning, the ancient dragon departs, leaving wreckage in its wake. We may never know what was lost… or what has been gained. (Color-customizable to Trim, Accessory)

name: La Forlorna
description: Beware of La Forlorna, for misfortune follows all who see this spirit.

name: La's Armor
description: The Captain of the Royal Guard started out as a street urchin who snuck into the castle, meeting the Prince long before she received her armor from him. La doesn't like how her story is described as a rags to riches tale. The knights and royals serve the people, not the other way around.

name: La's Brawling Gear
description: La was an unconventional knight for her time, accompanying the Crown Prince on his incognito trips through the city. He described her as humble and wise beyond her years. That comment was made when she launched a mugger ten feet into the air with a well-aimed strike.

name: La's Casual Armor
description: The Captain of the Royal Guard started out as a street urchin who snuck into the castle, meeting the Prince long before she received her armor from him. La doesn't like how her story is described as a rags to riches tale. The knights and royals serve the people, not the other way around.

name: La's Sleeveless Brawling Gear (AC)
description: La was an unconventional knight for her time, accompanying the Crown Prince on his incognito trips through the city. He described her as humble and wise beyond her years. That comment was made when she launched a mugger ten feet into the air with a well-aimed strike.

name: La's Sleeveless Brawling Gear (Legend)
description: La was an unconventional knight for her time, accompanying the Crown Prince on his incognito trips through the city. He described her as humble and wise beyond her years. That comment was made when she launched a mugger ten feet into the air with a well-aimed strike.

name: La's Swimsuit
description: La has chosen this swimsuit for it's lightweight material, but due to her forgetting to apply sunblock, it has left her with funny tanlines.

name: Lady Lua (Armor)
description: Lady Lua hails from a region of Yokai Isle famed for its white tigers and black bamboo. She rules her ancestral lands with a blend of wisdom and tigerish ferocity. (Female art only.)

name: Lady Sora's Gown
description: The perfect gown to wear to any ball, any time of the year!

name: Lady Sora's Midnight Gown
description: The perfect gown to wear to any ball, any time of the year!

name: Lady Vayle Costume
description: Dressing up like Lady Vayle is so much fun! You'd better hope she doens't catch you, though…

name: Lae + Thay Wedding Attire
description: Matching attire to elegantly waltz in the shadows, diligently stitched by the loving pair's fellow Hollowborn.

name: Lae + Thay Wedding Guest Attire
description: The Hollowborn were waiting for an appropriate occasion to break out their darkest shades of black.

name: Lagomorph TechWear
description: When rabbits go rabid, it's time to bust out the hammers! Hey, no hate! Have you seen a Grenwog go mad? It's not cute, and you definitely need them busted. Just don't catch their rabies.

name: Laken Adherent
description: You will follow Laken the Good… or else.

name: Laken Armor
description: A Legion member from the future, who has returned to aid his master!

name: Laken Formal Suit
description: Hand-crafted by Laken himself, this formal attire is well suited for special occasions and epic boss battles.

name: Laken's Personal Armor
description: You have battled Laken, and how his armor is yours to have for all time! (Merge this into the Laken the Seraphic Paladin Armor for free storage.)

name: Laken Temporary Armor
description: The time is now, Dage must fall and you will be part of the battle!

name: Laken the Evil (AC)
description: There can only be one Laken, but he may have TWO different states. This is the Evil version of the Laken the Good NPC.

name: Laken the Evil (Legend)
description: There can only be one Laken, but he may have TWO different states. This is the Evil version of the Laken the Good NPC.

name: Laken the Seraphic Paladin
description: You have battled Laken, and now his armor is yours to have for all time!

name: Lán sè Shu Ninja
description: It is the Year of the Rat, and these Ninja are celebrating!

name: Lanz the Golden Champion
description: *No description*

name: LaRosa Toga
description: This isn't madness, this is PINKNESS!

name: Late-Afternoon Wolfy
description: You have transcended the lore of wolves and are able to change without the light of the full moon. You are very good looking so at the end of the day, it doesn't matter if you break the rules of werewolves. Though the rumor is, you are ballin' on the basketball courts!

name: Lava Guard (Armor)
description: Molten golems created from magma, their sole purpose is to guard the deepest, hottest depths of Battleunder from potential trespassers.

name: Lava Warrior
description: Skin of magma and bones made of obsidian, your might spreads through the land like a wildfire!

name: Lavaflame Swimsuit
description: Who wants to fight fire with fire when you can soak up the sun on the super-heated sands of the Burning Beach?

name: Lavamancer Blaster
description: FIRE FROM ABOVE! Makin' it rain. Forecast for tonight? Meteor showers!

name: Lavamancer Robes
description: You must have the Lavamancer Blaster robes to unleash the power of FIRE!

name: Lavamorphosis
description: Embrace the heat by doning this armor made out of lava rocks found underneath BattleOn.

name: Lavarock BeastTamer (0 AC)
description: ﻿﻿Dread beasts sleep in the bowels of volcanoes and magma caverns. These BeastTamers hunt them as they emerge, and battle them until they come to heel.

name: Lavarock BeastTamer (AC)
description: ﻿﻿Dread beasts sleep in the bowels of volcanoes and magma caverns. These BeastTamers hunt them as they emerge, and battle them until they come to heel.

name: Lavarock Destroyer (0 AC)
description: These are the sharks that lurk in the lava flows, awakened by the eruption of volcanos. They come from an age long past with a purpose long scorned, seeking to scorch the land anew.

name: Lavarock Destroyer (AC)
description: These are the sharks that lurk in the lava flows, awakened by the eruption of volcanos. They come from an age long past with a purpose long scorned, seeking to scorch the land anew.

name: Lavarock Guardian
description: Kalayo has been awoken by an intruder, and the Lavarock Guardians must return them to slumber. That you have won the duel with Kalayo proves that you are worth the title of Lavarock Guardian.

name: Lavastorm Lord
description: A blazing inferno burns in the heart of those who wear this. You're perfectly comfortable near volcanoes as the scorching heat feels like home.

name: LavaSurge Summoner (0 AC)
description: When the Avatars of Fire and Water clashed, lava flows and white waves crashed against each other. In this hostile environment, extreme lifeforms emerged. These Summoners call on the power of those

name: LavaSurge Summoner (AC)
description: When the Avatars of Fire and Water clashed, lava flows and white waves crashed against each other. In this hostile environment, extreme lifeforms emerged. These Summoners call on the power of those

name: Lavitz Viking Armor
description: This armor once belonged to a powerful Norse Viking. Pairs nicely with the Horned Helm. Made by Lavitz, your fellow player.

name: Lawful Evil Hero
description: Lawful Evil heroes will always take what they need to achieve their goals. They rely on strength, intimidation, and POWER. Their intellect, ruthlessness, and ability to command the weak drive their success.

name: Lawful Good Hero
description: Lawful Good heroes will always be guided by what is right and just and fair. They are the saviors, and stand between the common people of Lore and the dark and deadly evils of the world.

name: Lazy Summertime
description: For those days when you aren't saving the world. Even a Hero needs a break every now and then.

name: League Competitor's Emblazoned Garb (AC)
description: The look of survivor, and most importantly, a winner.

name: League Competitor's Emblazoned Garb (Legend)
description: The look of survivor, and most importantly, a winner.

name: League Competitor's Garb (AC)
description: The look of survivor, and most importantly, a winner.

name: League Competitor's Garb (Non-AC)
description: The look of survivor, and most importantly, a winner.

name: Leanan Sidhe (Armor)
description: ﻿Leanan Sidhe is a fairy that preys on artists, poets, and heroes. She inspires them, guiding her darlings to fame and fortune. In return, she devours their lifeforce. Brilliant stars die young and beautiful.

name: Ledgermayne (Armor)
description: Using some of the remains of Ledgermayne's uncontrollable magic, you created an illusion spell to turn yourself into it! Just be careful, those teeth can actually hurt, for some reason. I guess that's why it was "uncontrollable."

name: Left Half Legion Paladin
description: Slash to the left, slash to the right. Right foot two kicks, left foot two kicks. Chop off their knees, chop off their knees.

name: Legacy of Nulgath
description: No one knows who this armor belonged to before Nulgath came into power. But it still holds a sinister aura! Given to his loyal followers for victory in the Summer of Evil war! (Color custom)

name: Legend
description: Crimson for the blood that has been shed, silver for the sheer magnitude of your reputation, and the shine to proclaim your prowess, this armor designed by Aranx is nothing short of a declaration of your tenacity and worth.

name: Legend Armor
description: You are truly one of Lore's greatest heroes! Because of your support and efforts in battle, the world will be saved!

name: Legend Shirt
description: Love being a Legend? Wear this shirt with pride and let the world see what you love!

name: Legendary BeastMaster
description: Come forth those who wish to master the beast of the land and birds of the air, for now you have that chance!

name: Legendary Bride and Groom
description: As long as we both shall live. Possibly even longer.

name: Legendary Broodfiend of Nulgath
description: Infect the world with Nulgath's darkness and bring strength and victory to the Nation!

name: Legendary Chaos Destroyer
description: Wanna destroy Chaos? You're gonna need some heavy duty armor. Wanna destroy Chaos in style? You're gonna need some color custom armor. Good thing you've got both covered!

name: Legendary Chaos Healer
description: Chaos Healers are servants of chaos who use their powers to effect the sick, weak, and injured and either heal or kill them. Their insane healing magic is often the difference between a groups victory or doom, but you can never tell which.

name: Legendary Chaos Mage
description: Chaos courses through you veins. Your arcane powers enable you to cast unpredictably dangerous spells.

name: Legendary Chaos Rogue
description: Chaos Rogues follow their own set of rules. with a combination of stealth, madness and chaoruption, you take your enemies by surprise.

name: Legendary Chaos Warrior
description: The heart of a chaos warrior is filled with rage and insanity. Your skills with weapons in close combat makes you an unpredictable force on the battle field.

name: Legendary Creationist
description: Archonist Creationists, known as the Elite AC Squad, play a vital role in the ongoing development of our digital universe by controlling the dark matter that directs the flow of the mainstream.

name: Legendary Dark BattleMage Armor 13
description: This is the one you'll ant to be wearing when you decide to brave the toy store.

name: Legendary Darker Fiend
description: You've morphed into an even Darker Fiend, able to rip your opponents limb from limb with your claws.

name: Legendary Dragon Spirit
description: Look like the spirits of an old, and if you are lucky, carry with you their wisdom and knowledge. Wearing this homage to the Legendary Dragons will give you what you need to be the one tells stories about when warming by the fire.

name: Legendary Frostguard Commander
description: Deck the halls before Dage the Evil wreck the halls! Defend the town of Frostvale and all Lore as a Frostguard Commander!

name: Legendary Knight
description: These brave soldiers swear to defend King Alteon, Queen Lynaria and all of Swordhaven from any danger.

name: Legendary Member Armor
description: This item, featuring the Membership symbol, will show the world that you have supported AdventureQuest Worlds. Thank you for being legendary!

name: Legendary Prime Dominus
description: Prime's godly armor. We are not sure what type of energy it runs off of, though.

name: Legendary Shinobi
description: More firm, for those who want to be a skilled pizza eating shinobi but not a Kappa.

name: Legendary Wedding Usher
description: Being an usher at a battle wedding requires some very heavy armor.

name: Legion Arcane Dark Caster
description: You have mastered every form of the arcane. Even among the Dark Casters, you are a legend. There is no higher honor.

name: Legion Archer Armor
description: Archers of the Legion are among the best equipped undead that serve under Dage. As such, not anyone can be accepted into this elite unit.

name: Legion Blacksmith (Armor)
description: Dage worked this poor blacksmith to death, then reanimated them to continue working.

name: Legion BladeMaster Assassin Armor
description: With harsh lifestyles, they can overcome any punishment to them. While being swift and nimble, they also do massive amount of damage when on the brink of death.

name: Legion Conqueror
description: Before the Legion Conqueror met their untimely end, they spread fear and terror across the land. Now, they do the same for Dage the Evil. (Item is color customizable.)

name: Legion DarkBlood Eviscerater
description: Even the DarkBloods recognize the immense power of the Undead Legion. Evil knows no bounds, and no being--living or undead--would be foolish enough to pass up such potential.

name: Legion DeathFiend
description: Legion DeathFiends are sworn body and soul to Dage the Evil's Undead Legion. They stalk the edges of the Underworld looking for unwary victims. (Click shoulder to activate animation)

name: Legion Devastator (0 AC)
description: Beasts that roam the night and devour the light. They terrorized the land long before Dage the Evil came to be. The Lord of the Legion took those legends, peeled their hide, and adorned his most beastly mauraders with their pelts and claws.

name: Legion Devastator (AC)
description: Beasts that roam the night and devour the light. They terrorized the land long before Dage the Evil came to be. The Lord of the Legion took those legends, peeled their hide, and adorned his most beastly mauraders with their pelts and claws.

name: Legion Devourer (0 AC)
description: FEED UPON THE SOULS OF THE FALLEN.

name: Legion Devourer (AC)
description: FEED UPON THE SOULS OF THE FALLEN.

name: Legion DoomKnight Armor (AC)
description: Even DoomKnights swear their service to, or are made to serve Dage. Their soul's have been claimed by both Dage and Doom. (Has a chance to do the Shadowburst animation when equipped)

name: Legion DoomKnight Armor (Merge)
description: Even DoomKnights swear their service to, or are made to serve Dage. Their soul's have been claimed by both Dage and Doom. (Has a chance to do the Shadowburst animation when equipped)

name: Legion DoomNightie
description: What's a better way for getting ready for a slumber party then fluffy Legion slippers!

name: Legion Dread Knight (Armor)
description: Dage the Evil sends his Dark Knights forth to terrorize the good and lure the wicked to his realm. The most skilled may prove strong enough to join the Undead Legion.

name: Legion Dreadmarch (AC)
description: Trained in light and heavy weapons and even in the riding of Legion Drakes, the Dreadmarch are some of Dage's most versatile foot-soldiers.

name: Legion Dreadmarch (Quest)
description: Trained in light and heavy weapons and even in the riding of Legion Drakes, the Dreadmarch are some of Dage's most versatile foot-soldiers.

name: Legion DreadRider
description: The DreadRider serves as the elite calvary for Dage's Undead Legion.

name: Legion Eternal Seraph (0 AC)
description: Often mistaken for Celestials, these members of the Undead Legion achieved new forms as their Lord grew in power and influence. Their wings represent greater purpose, and the sanctity of death.

name: Legion Eternal Seraph (AC)
description: Often mistaken for Celestials, these members of the Undead Legion achieved new forms as their Lord grew in power and influence. Their wings represent greater purpose, and the sanctity of death.

name: Legion Evocator (0 AC)
description: The Legion Evocator's magic and unique craft call to bone and flesh. Their spells rot those materials into a more meldable form, lending to truly horrifying feats of the Legion's ancient arcane.

name: Legion Evocator (AC)
description: The Legion Evocator's magic and unique craft call to bone and flesh. Their spells rot those materials into a more meldable form, lending to truly horrifying feats of the Legion's ancient arcane.

name: Legion Evocatus (0 AC)
description: The Evocatus are loyal Legionnaires who voluntarily choose to serve Lord Dage after the end of their mortal lives. Eternal servitude to their lord is the greatest honor in undeath.

name: Legion Evocatus (AC)
description: The Evocatus are loyal Legionnaires who voluntarily choose to serve Lord Darge after the end of their mortal lives. Eternal servitude to their lord is the greatest honor in undeath.

name: Legion Evolved Dark Caster (Armor)
description: Channel the power of darkness to unleash your TRUE power, and serve the Legion to the best of your ability!

name: Legion FiendHunter (0 AC)
description: Being the strongest combat knights of the Undead Legion, these warlords have possessed the DNA of a normal Void Fiend which some.. other Legionnaire extracted from a dead Nation Fiend back in the war between the Legion and Nation many years ago. They have been proven to be insanely agile and fast, even in bulky armor.

name: Legion FiendHunter (AC)
description: Being the strongest combat knights of the Undead Legion, these warlords have possessed the DNA of a normal Void Fiend which some.. other Legionnaire extracted from a dead Nation Fiend back in the war between the Legion and Nation many years ago. They have been proven to be insanely agile and fast, even in bulky armor.

name: Legion Fighter (Armor)
description: "And we fight for our lord and fight to bring Nation to their knees!"

name: Legion Forge Spawn
description: This item does 25% more damage to all monsters when equipped. Unbreakable walking armors filled with thousands of human, monster, evil, and even cursed souls. All merged together as one only consciousness. Loyal to Dage the Evil, they will show no mercy.

name: Legion Holiday Paragon Plate
description: The jollier side of Dage the Evil. Fond of milk, snickerdoodles, and wrecking the halls.

name: Legion Jolly Roger Armor
description: Pirate Captains are notorious for wanting more than they have. The original owner of his armor was not satisfied by the booty available on land OR the seas. He ventured into the Underworld and was ensnared in the Legion! Now he is doomed to sail obsidian seas for all Eternity.

name: Legion Judge
description: The time for judgement has come. The Legion Judge will determine the fate of those who cower beneath its harrowing reverence.

name: Legion KingSlayer (0 AC)
description: This eldritch warrior feeds on those of royal blood, stealing their innate power and gifts.

name: Legion KingSlayer (AC)
description: This eldritch warrior feeds on those of royal blood, stealing their innate power and gifts.

name: Legion Lich Lord (Armor)
description: Delve deeply into the forbidden world of Dage and Necromancy and become the embodiment of it.

name: Legion Lich Lord + Staff
description: Delve deeply into the forbidden world of Dage and Necromancy and become the embodiment of it.

name: Legion Loremaster
description: The Legion’s Lorekeepers have shadowed their Lord since the march’s earliest days. Dedicated to chronicling its past and present, they reach into the future as Soothsayers to reveal dark fates.

name: Legion Marauder
description: The first in line to bash through and ask questions later.

name: Legion Mercenary
description: Mercenaries found within Dage's legion, this elite group takes the contracts that no one else will. This time, the contract happens to be on any of Nulgath's followers.

name: Legion Minister
description: Long Unlive the Legion! The Legion Minister are the apex generals within the Undead Legion's ranks, and are known to be Dage's most loyal figures.

name: Legion MonsterHunter
description: Not even death can stop the most legendary heroes from hunting down their enemies once they join the Undead Legion.

name: Legion Naval Commander
description: Teal Naval Commanders be Cap'n Dage's faithful pirate crew. Ye be in real teal trouble if ye be messin' wit' these here Naval Commanders, matey.

name: Legion Necromancer
description: The most ambitious of the Legion seek to follow in their Lord's footsteps. Necromancers, through lifetimes of service and study, can earn a peek at Dage the Evil's knowledge. It allows them control over their fellow Legionnaires.

name: Legion Nightmare
description: Legion Nightmares stalk the earth, carving fear into the hearts of men.

name: Legion Obsidian Assassin
description: Your targets can't see your obsidian form in the dark, but with those 3 glowing eyes you'll definitely see them.

name: Legion Officer Armor
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PVP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Legion Operative
description: Legion Operatives move stealthily through the shadows, carrying out Dage the Evil's dark work in silence.

name: Legion Paladin Armor
description: Legion Paladins are the dishonest and evil protectors of… DAGE and DAGENESS! Heh, but really… You used to be a Paladin and now you're the undead minion of a seemingly invincible armored lich. Use your skill in both light and darkness to strike down all who oppose.. Whatever you believe you're fighting for.

name: Legion Paragon Fiend Rider
description: Now you can ride along with Death and all of his friends while harvesting souls for Dage.

name: Legion Pirate Lieutenant
description: Maybe one day you will be a Pirate Captain…

name: Legion Priest
description: Not the kind of priest that save souls, but they do want yours.

name: Legion ProtoParagon X1
description: Supercharge the darkness with the Protoparagon X1 and dominate the Legion!

name: Legion Pumpking Overlord
description: Harder to see in the shadows, the Legion Pumpking screams in the dead of night.

name: Legion PumpkinLord
description: Pumpkin lords are evil magical pumpkins that are a lot more menacing than the name suggests, and even more after they've joined Dage's Legion.

name: Legion Pyromancer (Armor)
description: Legion Pyromancers don't play around with normal fire. Their blue flames come deep with the underworld.

name: Legion Raven
description: The Legion Raven roams the halls, scavenging and feeding off of the lost souls left in Pandinus Insane Asylum.

name: Legion Recruit
description: Wear this armor, made in honor of Rand Ravenson, sole survivor of the attack on Ravenscar village, with pride!

name: Legion Revenant Armor
description: Steeped in darkness, Legion Revenants derive their power from the essence responsible for the Legion's un-death. The Legion flows through them, and they are the Legion.

name: Legion's Fiend
description: Sometime's a fiend's gotta do what a fiend's gotta do… you know. Join the Legion!

name: Legion's Letumortis
description: The dead are meant to crawl, sink into the earth, and sleep. When the dead walk, clinging to the stirring dark- the world will crack open. Its yolk belonging to the Lord of the Undead.

name: Legion Scout
description: The first in line to bash through and ask questions later.

name: Legion Sergeant (Armor)
description: Dage wants YOU to join the Undead Legion!

name: Legion ShadowCats Armor (AC)
description: *No description*

name: Legion ShadowCats Armor (Legend)
description: *No description*

name: Legion Shielded War Wraith (0 AC)
description: The War Wraiths march over the lands of the living that have succumbed to the thrall of Dage the Evil. For as long as they stand watch, those fields belong to the Underworld.

name: Legion Shielded War Wraith (AC)
description: The War Wraiths march over the lands of the living that have succumbed to the thrall of Dage the Evil. For as long as they stand watch, those fields belong to the Underworld.

name: Legion SkullSeeker
description: An uncontrollable urge to collect skulls consumes your soul. You are an Undead Legion SkullSeeker, destined to prove your worth to Dage the Evil himself.

name: Legion Soulstealer
description: Soulstealer's with affinity to the Undead Legion can weave more than just souls. They can freeze their hearts and any emotion without remorse, rendering these souls as empty as their bodies. This is done to make recruiting easier.

name: Legion Sovereign
description: The Underworld has one Lord, and it's Dage the Evil…should he ever need someone to watch his throne, he forged worthy regalia for a sovereign he knows more than his own blood. The Legion kneels to them without question.

name: Legion Spellcaster
description: These casters aide the Legion by summoning ower and keeping the minions energized during battles.

name: Legion Symbiote
description: The parasite infecting this armor was created especially for Dage's Legion. Now truly be one with the Dark Lord.

name: Legion Titan
description: You have chosen your path. There is no going back now. As a Titan, you have sacrificed--nay, invested--your soul to the Undead Legion. Your committed dedication has earned you the right to don this title. Unleash the power of the almighty Legion Titan!

name: Legion Undead Spawn
description: Long last warrior corrupted by the Eternal flames in the underworld. It is said they still struggle to control their strength, as their almost human minds limit them. Loyal to Dage the Evil, they will show no mercy.

name: Legion Vampire
description: After sacrificing their undying souls to the Undead Legion, the Dark Lord transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. A new breed of Vampire has surfaced, and the world of Lore will soon witness the power of His chosen disciples…

name: Legion Varsity Uniform
description: Rah rah rah! #Team Legion! (Requires Rank 10 Evil)

name: Legion Viking
description: Destroy your enemies in the name of Dage the Evil, for YOU are a Legion Viking, and your enemies cower when they hear your battlecry!

name: Legion War Wraith (0 AC)
description: The War Wraiths march over the lands of the living that have succumbed to the thrall of Dage the Evil. For as long as they stand watch, those fields belong to the Underworld.

name: Legion War Wraith (AC)
description: The War Wraiths march over the lands of the living that have succumbed to the thrall of Dage the Evil. For as long as they stand watch, those fields belong to the Underworld.

name: Legion WarSeeker (AC)
description: The war cry for these crusading Legionnaires is "For power! For combat! For Dage!"

name: Legion WarSeeker (Special)
description: The war cry for these crusading Legionnaires is "For power! For combat! For Dage!"

name: Legion Wedding Outfit
description: Congratulations Dage and Faith! The Lord of the Underworld and the Beast Mastahhh have started the next quest of their journey. Join the celebration!

name: Legion Wolf (0 AC)
description: Even wolves want to be members of Dage's Legion.

name: Legion Wolf (AC)
description: Even wolves want to be members of Dage's Legion.

name: Legion Wolf (Merge)
description: Even wolves want to be members of Dage's Legion.

name: Legionator (Armor)
description: These part-undead, part-robot monstrosities are a part of a task force created by Dage the Evil to hunt down and finish off dissidents in the Legion, incuding those that he currently wants, but could not have.

name: Lemonade Sarong
description: Do you have to go on a LemonRAID to get this outfit? (Oooo. Sour pun. :X )

name: Lengjing's Armor
description: Water, being essential to finding peace in oneself, serves as a key component in rejoicing the sunset of the old year. Shui dancers mimic the flow of the river during annual night parades to embrace this symbol.

name: Leonides Guard Captain (0 AC)
description: The Lionisters of Swordhaven are an ancient and noble family. Their Frostval celebrations are legendarily gilded. Hear them ROAR!

name: Leonides Guard Captain (AC)
description: The Lionisters of Swordhaven are an ancient and noble family. Their Frostval celebrations are legendarily gilded. Hear them ROAR!

name: Leonides Guard Captain (Legend)
description: The Lionisters of Swordhaven are an ancient and noble family. Their Frostval celebrations are legendarily gilded. Hear them ROAR!

name: Leonides Lord Commander (0 AC)
description: The Lionisters of Swordhaven are an ancient and noble family. Their Frostval celebrations are legendarily gilded. Hear them ROAR!

name: Leonides Lord Commander (AC)
description: The Lionisters of Swordhaven are an ancient and noble family. Their Frostval celebrations are legendarily gilded. Hear them ROAR!

name: Leonides Lord Commander (Legend)
description: The Lionisters of Swordhaven are an ancient and noble family. Their Frostval celebrations are legendarily gilded. Hear them ROAR!

name: Leonine Regalia
description: Ruled by the Sun, heroes who were born and battle under the Leo's star sign are recognized everywhere as passionate and creative. But much like the lion that represents them, they can be fiercely prideful when attacked.

name: Leonine Storm
description: Lions rage and lions roar as the storm breaks overhead! Join them in screaming your defiance of nature!

name: Leopard Armorz
description: Dis armor iz given 2 only teh mightest kittehs in da land!

name: LeoSpire Royalty
description: The lion symbolises three of LeoSpire's greatest national values: courage, excellence and strength. May you always embody these as you battle through Lore!

name: Leprechaun Armor
description: The Leprechaun suit is the luckiest armor. It has earned many awards including the blue diamond, the purple horseshoes… Irish you a Happy Lucky Day!

name: Leprechaun Ranger
description: A bit o' luck will always stand a ranger in good stead as they battle.

name: Less Dazzling Villager
description: You are looking nice. Where are you headed? To a village? That's THE perfect look for you! It's just missing a little…sparkle.

name: Lethe Of Vokun
description: Covered in rusty chains that slash and ensnare their foes, these deadly minions of Vokun send anyone who crosses them to oblivion.

name: Lethe Wraith (Armor)
description: Everyone has their limits, even the greats and the terrors. Some of the oldest and most powerful members of the Legion threw themselves in the Lethe to seek rest. They've returned to witness the endless beginning.

name: Leviathan of Forgotten Tongues (0 AC)
description: Dive far enough into the deep, and the Depths will begin to speak. Its monstrous denizens possess vast knowledge and cruel truths. Their voice alone is fatal, but their raw power could split the seas.

name: Leviathan of Forgotten Tongues (AC)
description: Dive far enough into the deep, and the Depths will begin to speak. Its monstrous denizens possess vast knowledge and cruel truths. Their voice alone is fatal, but their raw power could split the seas.

name: Leviathan Warrior
description: These leviathan patrol the deeps making sure that none enter their most sacred spaces.

name: leZard Man (Armor)
description: The leZard Men can only come out when the sun is in eclipse, or they will be burnt where they stand. This rarely-seen race is one of the most mysterious on Lore.

name: Liar's Curse
description: You are the bane of liars everywhere and you know that in time, even the best liars lie once too often. You punish the wicked and pathetic who hide behind untruth and claim the glory of other people's hard work as their own.

name: Lich (Armor)
description: Have you been dieting? It seems as though you have transformed into an undead Lich!

name: Lich General
description: Armed to the teeth with a taste for revenge, a Lich General knows no concept of personal casualties, only victory and defeat.

name: Lich Lord (Armor)
description: Delve deeply into the forbidden world of Necromancy and become the embodiment of it.

name: Lich Mantle
description: Only in death can you truly embrace the darkness that lies within you. Channel it to raise an army of the dead and lead an assault across Lore. The darkest power is now yours!

name: Lich Necromantress
description: Ever loyal and determined, Gwen, your guide to adventure in the Akumi Wars Deadlands, sacrificed her life learning necromancy. But by becoming a lich, she gained the power to save her brother. Love never dies… and she is proof of that.

name: Lich Of The Stone (Armor)
description: Your corpse has been reanimated into the Arch Lich of Darkovia!

name: LichKing's Minion
description: With an army of undead, you can destroy the world… all you need to do is create it!

name: LichLord
description: Elaborate, dark and completely in any right mind, only a great and powerful fighter of magic will be able to tame the arts and become a LichLord. Make someone's day…

name: Licorice Twist (Armor)
description: Do the twist, the spearmint twist!

name: Life Taker
description: Deal with the cards you're dealt and take the lives that fall into your hands.

name: LifeGuard
description: When you hang out by the beach, it's always safest when the LifeGuard are around!

name: Light Auriladae
description: Magi who channel the light have become stuck in the animal forms they assume… good thing they chose a panda!

name: Light BattleMage
description: A certain sect of Mages have blood ties to Celestial Light trains in secrecy. All are fated to fall, and their successors are tasked with dispelling the shadows they became.

name: Light ChronoWeaver
description: The Eternal Hero was destined to create and destroy in an endless cycle. Their impact on our universe will shine forevermore.

name: Light Mage
description: These magi illuminate their surroundings with peace and light. Loyal to Good, they are definitely the brightest of their class. Though, they are unrelated to the LightMage class, which wield the powers of light in the celestial realm.

name: Light Void Reverent
description: The Light was consumed by a Void, giving form to a new and rare species of Fiend. Their mission is to grow brighter - to devour light until they can outshine the sun and stars that made them. (Item is color-custom to Eye.)

name: Light Witch
description: Channel the power of the light and all shall know that you are a force to be reckoned with!

name: Lightblade Master of Shadows (0 AC)
description: The BladeMasters of the Future Legion honor their predecessors by preserving tradition. Though they live and die by the sword, their bodies are slowly consumed by Legion steel.

name: Lightblade Master of Shadows (AC)
description: The BladeMasters of the Future Legion honor their predecessors by preserving tradition. Though they live and die by the sword, their bodies are slowly consumed by Legion steel.

name: Lightbringer Armor
description: "And Lo, the Void, the Great Outside, grew jealous of Mother Gaia and her children. And as the Void spawn crept onto Gaia, who rose to meet them but the Lightbringers!" -Book of Light, 1st chapter, lines 5-7

name: LightCaster (Armor) (AC)
description: The Order of the LightCasters formed to support the Champion of Light, and need every mage available to fight the battle against Chaos!

name: LightCaster (Armor) (Special)
description: The Order of the LightCasters formed to support the Champion of Light, and need every mage available to fight the battle against Chaos!

name: Lightning ClawSuit (AC)
description: When you want to shine as bright as the Frostval star but also need to rip apart your enemies.

name: Lightning ClawSuit (Legend)
description: When you want to shine as bright as the Frostval star but also need to rip apart your enemeies.

name: Lightning Dragonsworn Champion
description: Warriors of the Dragonsworn defend and protect the ancient dragons. Those who serve Krenos were gifted with this armor.

name: Lightning Dragonsworn Warrior
description: Warriors of the Dragonsworn defend and protect the ancient dragons. Those who serve Krenos were gifted with thisearmor.

name: Lightning Emperor
description: Command the lightning and summon thunder to terrify your foes when you ascend to the throne of the Lightning Emperor!

name: Lightning Lich Emperor (AC)
description: "Good is a point of view, Hero."

name: Lightning Lich Emperor (Special)
description: "Good is a point of view, Hero."

name: Lightning Mage
description: Seize the power of lightning from the sky! Using electrical magic hamess the bolts and from them into weapons.

name: Lightning Necromancer
description: Channeling elemental energy siphoned from the storms that tear through the peaks of Thunderfang Spire, the Lightning Necromancers that rule there terrify all who oppose them. Their threat? Unleashing the NecroStorm!

name: Lightning Pirate
description: When ye sail the seas, ye get the storms. Lightnin' crashes and suddenly yer electric!

name: LightningLord
description: LightningLords collect the power of lightning, and store it in special gems scattered across their robes for use in battle. ZZZap!

name: LightScythe Ruler (0 AC)
description: The Lightscythe and their allies will keep freedom and justice alive at all costs. Want to spend a day in Brightfall's throne? They'd be honored to receive your tutelage.

name: LightScythe Ruler (AC)
description: The Lightscythe and their allies will keep freedom and justice alive at all costs. Want to spend a day in Brightfall's throne? They'd be honored to receive your tutelage.

name: Lightstrike Commander (Armor)
description: LightStrike Commanders fight for what is right… fight with the light. Keep your goal in sight and the Queen of Monsters will never be able to rule our world!

name: Lightweaver Armor
description: Light, venerated as a symbol of divinity and justice, runs through the veins of those chosen by the rays of the sun. Legends say that the Lightweavers were called upon to protect the Plane of Light during ancient wars.

name: Lightwielder's Plate
description: Don the holy armor of the Lightwielders, an elite order of Zombie slayers.

name: Linda Carnaval Armor
description: The homemade drapes that make up this illuminating outfit is fireproof and durable under extreme conditions, allowing dancers to perform diligently uninterrupted.

name: Lion's Bane
description: Take great pride in the pelt upon thy shoulders, it is of a beast that would make Nemean Lion blood tremble.

name: Lion's Pride Paladin
description: The strength of a lion's pride helps these Paladins during battle. Who wouldn't want a lion backing you up!

name: Litch Knight
description: Just because you're a knight doesn't mean you can't take pride in your appearance!

name: Little Green Alien
description: It's easy being green!

name: Living Baron Sunday
description: Party like an undead voodoo dude!

name: Living BladeMaster
description: Once in a while Dage finds a living with the inhuman skill, speed and stealth to serve as a Living BladeMaster.

name: Living Ice (Armor)
description: This armor is actually a symbiotic ice elemental. Once bonded to its host, it forms a protective ice layer between them and the dangerous world outside.

name: Living Mana
description: In high enough concentrations, mana can become an animated substance, distilling itself from the air to take shape. Only specially trained mages can create and harness this living mana.

name: Living Shadow Assassin
description: Only the most elite assassins may be a part of the Shadowscythe. Do not disappoint the Empress. Sneaky coat included. HAS SHADOW ANIMATION

name: Living Tree Titan (Permanent)
description: Never EVER anger the trees; they'll guarantee this breath is your last.

name: Living Tree Titan (Temporary)
description: You are now a Living Tree Titan!

name: Living Yogurt Warrior
description: Cysero made an armor out of schnozzberry yogurt. This does not look safe, but on the plus side, if a monster eats you, you'll be EXTRA delicious!

name: Livyatan Mer-Unit
description: Marine tech designed to help you cut through the deep seas. It's deceptively light, allowing for sharp evasive movements, yet durable enough to withstand a shark's bite.

name: Loco Costume
description: Loco caused mayhem around Battleon pretending to be you. Now you can disguise yourself as Loco to turn the tables since someone has recreated this mischief armor from AdventureQuest.

name: Logash's Rainment
description: Something as simple as death cannot stop the DarkBlood. A Darkblood will only rest once their mission is fulfilled… yet the specifics of such missions are only revealed after completion…

name: Loki Mecha
description: Wom by Loki the jester, a guardian of jokes and tricks in the AdventureQuest timeline, this armor is perfect for those who see life as one big laughing matter.

name: Lolosian Corsair Varsity Team
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Lolosian Corsairs (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Lolosian Corsairs Away Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Lolosian Corsairs Away Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Lolosian Corsairs (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Lolosian Corsairs Rush Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Lolosian Corsairs Rush Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Looter's Raiment
description: Amazing how people think a pirate must look shabby and ill-kept. A pirate's heart secretly desires to look good while kicking butt. So if you got it, flaunt it. There's nothing wrong with a little style while taking the high seas.

name: Lord Brentan (Armor)
description: The armor of noble Lord Brenton.

name: Lord/Lady GoGo Armor
description: Oolala! A slimming armor that will have you rockin' with the best of them! Just be careful not to start a bad romance with any monsters.

name: Lord of Bones
description: Crafted by barbarians from darkened minerals as cold as ice, Dage provided countless shadow elementals these old armors to give them a physical form and to use them to chase after "special" targets.

name: Lord of Broken Bones
description: Crafted by barbarians from darkened minerals as cold as ice, Dage provided countless shadow elementals these old armors to give them a physical form and to use them to chase after "special" targets.

name: Lord of Exalted Light
description: Malgor of the Mirror Realm is Hope personified. Lauded and adored, the Lord of Exalted Light is the guardian of all. Even if only one heart beats, Malgor will never give into despair. He will protect them to the very end.

name: Lord Of Order Armor (0 AC)
description: The best line of defense against the corrupt forces of Chaos. They work to achieve Order and balance in the Mirror Realm.

name: Lord Of Order Armor (AC)
description: The best line of defense against the corrupt forces of Chaos. They work to achieve Order and balance in the Mirror Realm.

name: Lord Of Order Armor (Quest)
description: The best line of defense against the corrupt forces of Chaos. They work to achieve Order and balance in the Mirror Realm.

name: Lord of Order Escherion
description: I protect and serve the people of Chiral Valley.

name: Lord of Order Iadoa
description: I protect and serve all the races of all the timestreams.

name: Lord of Order Khasaanda
description: I protect and serve the people of Bloodtusk. /salute

name: Lord of Order Kimberly
description: I protect and serve the people of Mythsong.

name: Lord of Order King Alteon
description: I protect and serve the people of Swordhaven. /salute

name: Lord of Order Kitsune
description: I protect and serve the people of Yokai Isle. /salute

name: Lord of Order Ledgermayne
description: I protect and serve the people of Arcangrove. /salute

name: Lord of Order Lionfang
description: I protect and serve all, no matter their alignment.

name: Lord of Order Tibicenas
description: I protect and serve all the races of the Djinn Realm.

name: Lord of Order Vath (Quest)
description: I protect and serve the people of Dwarfhold. /salute

name: Lord of Order Vath (Special)
description: I protect and serve the people of Dwarfhold. /salute

name: Lord of Order Wolfwing
description: I protect and serve the people of Darkovia. /salute

name: Lord of Order Xang
description: TEE HEE! *Giggle* (Skin is not color custom)

name: Lord of Order Xing
description: TEE HEE! *Giggle*

name: Lord of the Dead
description: The loss of something precious to you is too great a burden to bear even for a single jungle tribe. In order to cope, they applied opals to their obsidian uniforms so the souls of those they lost can pass on safely.

name: Lord of the Endless Hour
description: A noble from a bygone era, when time circled in on itself. They are content to stand back and watch the world grow again, imparting wisdom when mistakes are about to be repeated.

name: Lord of Time
description: Oh so you're a Hero of Lore? Well I'm the Lord of Time. (Time travelling box not included).

name: Lords of the Shadow
description: Shadows tremble in the wake of their lords!

name: Lore Golem (Armor)
description: Sometimes - very, very rarely, if you hit a Lore Golem hard enough you can gather up enough parts from him to make your very own rock/mud/elephant/lizard thing armor!

name: Lore's Champion
description: Carved marks illustrate the suffering Lore has gone through. As its Champion, nothing shall stop you in returning Lore to its glory!

name: Lore's Conservator
description: This is the official uniform of Lore's Conservators, modelled after our late founder's. If you want to earn one for yourself then you'll have to prove you're a capable treasure hunter.

name: Lorekeeper of the Moon
description: Dwarfhold's Lunar Lorekeepers specialize in studying the history of Frostmane, the Steed of Night.

name: Lorekeeper of the Sun
description: Dwarfhold's Solar Lorekeepers specialize in studying the history of Embermane, the Steed of Day.

name: LoreMaster
description: Nothing is so dangerous that it can't be conquered and controlled.

name: Loremaster Disciple Armor
description: Favored by fans of hit Battleon rock group, NPCs!

name: Loremaster-In-Training
description: If you want to be a Loremaster, you must know all there is to know about Lore. Yes, that's right. You must know Lore's lore. Until then, wear this to show your status as Loremaster in training!

name: Lorosian Hunter
description: Capable of hunting the most devious of bounties, the Lorosian Hunters were feared all through the Galaxy.

name: Loshe's Suit
description: The suit of Loshe Allen. May you find the truth.

name: Lost Soul (Armor)
description: Once alive and swinging and their sword on the battlefield, they now walk those lonely plains, in search of their lifeless bodies that they once inhabited.

name: Lost Warrior
description: This brave warrior was killed in battle with the Sludgelord long ago, and now wanders the sewers trying to find a way back to the surface.

name: Lotus Armor
description: This armor's elegance is only trumped by the beauty of the butt-kicking martial arts it begets!

name: Love Bard
description: Music can be so romantic, don't you think?

name: Love Caster (Armor)
description: Dage may be Evil, but what Beleen has done to his beloved Dark Caster armor is even more Evil… yet totally awesome! THIS ITEM CAN BE SOLD.

name: Love Caster XOXO (0 AC)
description: I AM THE LOVELIEST UNHOLY ONE! At least I look the part!

name: Love Caster XOXO (AC)
description: I AM THE LOVELIEST UNHOLY ONE! At least I look the part!

name: Love Commander
description: The sophisticated and courteous knights always wear the most polished armors their people ever laid their eyes upon. It's like an old child's tale has come to life.

name: Love Hunter
description: The real purpose of love hunting is uncertain, however, their green getup is an outward resemblance to their ironically loveless nature.

name: Love Hurts (Armor)
description: I'M ONLY GONNA BREAK BREAK YOUR BREAK BREAK YOUR HEART.

name: Love Kitty Sweater
description: Pink and pretty, and kyuuute as a kitty <3

name: Love Knight (Armor)
description: Have fun storming the castle!

name: Love of Rouge
description: Who loves the color red? YOU DO!

name: Love Thyself Outfit
description: Loving oneself is as important a love as caring for others. In your hands, perhaps philautia can be fully realized.

name: Love Weaver
description: PLAYER SUGGESTION: Woo your next victim with a romance based armor by Ganloth Revontheus. Weave a web of love and trust around the bad guy before reminding it who is boss.

name: LoveBringer
description: The LoveBringer appears in Lore every Heroes Heart Day to help spread the feelings of Love and Happiness throughout the world.

name: Lovely Celtic Warrior
description: Celtic tribespeople are raised to be warriors from childhood. Some tribes would paint their bodies before running into battle. This year, they chose pink.

name: Lovely Deity
description: There are many types of love, but one of the purest forms is for one friend to another. Spread the power and beauty of friendship and love to help make the world a better place.

name: Lovely Dorian and Dorothy (AC)
description: A totally wicked outfit for any young woman trying to find her way back home in the dark. Guys can wear this too… because when you follow the shadow brick road, you just need to do what you do.

name: Lovely Dorian and Dorothy (Non-AC)
description: A totally wicked outfit for any young woman trying to find her way back home in the dark. Guys can wear this too… because when you follow the shadow brick road, you just need to do what you do.

name: Lovely Jester (AC)
description: Just because it is cold outside, doesn't mean that we can't have a laugh or two. Of course, that laughter is at the expense of the enemies you take down in this armor.

name: Lovely Jester (Non-AC)
description: Just because it is cold outside, doesn't mean that we can't have a laugh or two. Of course, that laughter is at the expense of the enemies you take down in this armor.

name: Lovely Lionfang (0 AC)
description: Once a general in the king's service, Lionfang has struck out against the forces of Good. This rendition of is armor was created by a supporter who felt that his stance would be more striking whislt decked in pink.

name: Lovely Lionfang (AC)
description: Once a general in the king's service, Lionfang has struck out against the forces of Good. This rendition of is armor was created by a supporter who felt that his stance would be more striking whislt decked in pink.

name: Lovely Nightmare Plate (0 AC)
description: One of the most nightmarish armors available, this plate armor exists only to bring retribution to your foes.

name: Lovely Nightmare Plate (AC)
description: One of the most nightmarish armors available, this plate armor exists only to bring retribution to your foes.

name: Lovely Zilla Witch
description: A witch with mastery over great monsters, able to summon them as familiars or in rare instances, take on the mighty forms of ancient beasts through magicial transformation. (Female only).

name: Lover's Gown
description: In all this world, you might be happy, genuinely happy. Not one couple in a century has that chance.

name: Lover's Rogue
description: A rogue of love? Show your sweetheart that even the most thievish hearts can be won.

name: Loveseeker Robes
description: Til Death do us part? No! Live a life without me? Never!

name: Lovesworn Soloblade
description: Can love bloom on the battlefield? These adventurers hold a masquerade every year where they mingle, cross blades, and decide on a worthy partner - or return to their passion for battle.

name: Loyalist Away Gear (AC)
description: *No description*

name: Loyalist Away Gear (Legend)
description: *No description*

name: Loyalist Away Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Loyalist Away Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Loyalist Rush Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Loyalist Rush Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Loyalist Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players

name: Loyalist Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Loyalist Varsity Team
description: Rah rah rah! Go Loyalists!

name: Luchadwarf
description: Luchadwarves are hand to hand warriors from the color southern regions of the Dwarfhold mountains.

name: Luck's Champion
description: Playing card games requires a lot of skill, but also a lot of luck. With this armor, luck will always be on your side!

name: Luck's Hero
description: Playing card games requires a lot of skill, but also a lot of luck. With this armor, luck will always be on your side!

name: Lucky 2k17
description: Grab your moglinberry juice and your four-leaf clover, the ides of Lucky Day have once again arrived!

name: Lucky DragonSlayer
description: This armor is worn by only the loyalest Dragonslayers! Crafted in honor of Galanoth the DragonSlayers lifelong battle against dragons.

name: Lucky Foot
description: Lucky doesn't begin to describe this armor. Yes, you may get things to go your way. Yes, it may feel as if the enemy is just throwing themselves at your feet. And yes, you are just that awesome.

name: Lucky Jester Mime
description: You'll be the life of all undead parties with your trapped in a box routine.

name: Lucky Knight
description: Go forth and shine, brave hero. May the four leaf clover bring you luck and the gold of a thousand leprechaun pots fortify your resolve and strength.

name: Lucky Looter
description: At around Lucky Day, pickpocketers could easily gain the upper hand since luck is in their favor. It's Lucky Day, and what better way to celebrate than wearing this AWESOME gold-boosting armor!

name: Lucky Mercenary
description: Being a mercenary is a dangerous job and every sellsword could use a little extra luck!

name: Lucky Paragon Plate (AC)
description: Top o' the morning to ya Legion gombeens. Feeling lucky today?

name: Lucky Paragon Plate (Merge)
description: Top o' the morning to ya Legion gombeens. Feeling lucky today?

name: Lumberjack Turkey
description: He's a lumberjack and he don't care.

name: Lumen Ritualist
description: The robes of those who bring salvation with their Light. They wish to spread the influence of their Lady, existing for her praise. The Ritualists heal the sick, protect the weak, and fight Darkness to prove that the Light is pure and right.

name: Lumenomancer
description: As a wielder of the light, you hold the power to absolve even the darkest soul. No foe shall withstand the power of our cleansing light!

name: Lumina Mage
description: The day is filled with the magic and you are the shaper and protector of that magic.

name: Luminary White Knight
description: The armor of pure-hearted Knights who protect the innocent with steel and Light. Many were villagers motivated to help others when they were rescued by the Luminary Coalition. Kindness for its own sake tends to come full circle.

name: Luminomancer
description: Light brings life, and with it power. Luminomancers combine their lifeforce with that bright power to shine more brightly than any other elemental mage!

name: Luminous Armor
description: Only donned by members of the royal paladin families.

name: Luminous Dragonknight
description: Lord SlayR took the power and might of the dragon and infused it with the light of the moon to give you a potent protection in the midst of battle. His suggestion is illuminated, powerful and enlightened.

name: Luminous Warrior (0 AC)
description: Illuminated by the love and loyalty they feel for their Lord, Luminous Warriors are shining examples of what it means to serve the Avatar of Light.

name: Luminous Warrior (AC)
description: Illuminated by the love and loyalty they feel for their Lord, Luminous Warriors are shining examples of what it means to serve the Avatar of Light.

name: Lunam Domini Seeker (0 AC)
description: When the Sun sets, the ship known as the Sol Dominus becomes the Lunam Domini. The harsh rays of its light softens to a gentle glow. Under the night's moon, the ship pacifies the waves of the sea.

name: Lunam Domini Seeker (AC)
description: When the Sun sets, the ship known as the Sol Dominus becomes the Lunam Domini. The harsh rays of its light softens to a gentle glow. Under the night's moon, the ship pacifies the waves of the sea.

name: Lunar Beach Loungewear (0 AC)
description: Nothing beats a night on the beach. With moonlight in your pocket, there's no way you'll get lost.

name: Lunar Beach Loungewear (AC)
description: Nothing beats a night on the beach. With moonlight in your pocket, there's no way you'll get lost.

name: Lunar BlazeBinder (Armor)
description: Command the powers of night as the light of the moon shines down upon you! This ceremonial set was made to worship Nox, goddess of night, under the full moon.

name: Lunar Corvus
description: Crows and ravens abound at this time of year… celebrate them along with the Moon!

name: Lunar Gothic Beachwear (0 AC)
description: Your dark aesthetic is going to bring some gothic class to the sunny coast.

name: Lunar Gothic Beachwear (AC)
description: Your dark aesthetic is going to bring some gothic class to the sunny coast.

name: Lunar Gothic Beachwear and Umbrella (0 AC)
description: Your dark aesthetic is going to bring some gothic class to the sunny coast.

name: Lunar Gothic Beachwear and Umbrella (AC)
description: Your dark aesthetic is going to bring some gothic class to the sunny coast.

name: Lunar Pirate Captain
description: The mysterious textile that is used to produce this glistening uniform was also used to make tribal curtains to ward off shadow elementals sensitive to the moonlight.

name: Lunar Sand Knight (AC)
description: They say the desert gets cold at night - there's no better way to stay warm than in this awesome glowing armor!

name: Lunar Sand Knight (Legend)
description: They say the desert gets cold at night - there's no better way to stay warm than in this awesome glowing armor!

name: Lunar Witch + Warlock
description: Lunar Witches and Warlocks are one of the most popular mage sects in Mystcroft, gaining strength from the ever present moonlight. With so much to draw on, their power is almost unrivaled.

name: Lunarian Astromancer
description: Legends speak of rabbits living on the Moon. Some even say that the Moon is a rabbit! Then best play it safe and dress to appeal to those lunar bunnies. The Astromancers' craft seems to deepen when they're motivated like this.

name: Lunarian Astromancer Trainee
description: An Astromancer training to learn the ways of the Moon. The best way to do that is to get as close to that big hunk of cheese as possible.

name: Lunaris Redeemer
description: The Lunaris are members of a clan that worship the moon. Redeemers do not partake in the hunt for Sol and Luna. They seek to capture members of the Solaris to commit them to darkness.

name: Lunaris Sentinel
description: The Lunaris Sentinels are a clan that worship the moon and darkness. Their nemesis, the Solaris, have been rivals since the beginning of time. Both fight in the struggle to obtain the powerful artifacts Sol and Luna.

name: Lunarmancer
description: As a Lunarmancer your power waxes and wanes with the phases of the Moon. But when the moon is full your potential is unmatched! Just remember to focus!

name: Lusè Shu Ninja
description: It is the Year of the Rat, and these Ninja are celebrating!

name: LuxTech Streamer
description: Wear this during your next Let's Play stream and your followers will love you! (And your subs will skyrocket.)

name: Luxuria of the Legion
description: Luxuria's TRUE desire is to possess, then destroy.

name: Lycan Armor
description: So.. Who let the dogs out? Oh. You ARE the dog?… I sure hope your bark is worse than your bite.

name: Lycan Costume
description: This costume looks so real you won't just be lycan it… you'll be LOVIN' it!

name: Lycan Knight (Armor)
description: Aaaaroooo! You have been morphed into a buff Lycan Knight. Experience your true powers during the full moon!

name: Lycan Lunar Blazebinder
description: Command the powers of night as the light of the moon shines down upon you! Lycan Lunar Blazebinders use very powerful fire magic, strengthened by the moon.

name: Lycan Of Nulgath (AC)
description: Nulgath the ArchAngel welcomes the guardians of all species, races, and creeds…as long as they vow to fight for the good of the Mirror Realm!

name: Lycan Of Nulgath (Legend)
description: Nulgath the Archangel welcomes guardians of all species, races, and creeds… as long as they vow to fight for the good of the Mirror Realm!

name: Lycan Shadowstalker
description: So.. Who let the dogs out? Oh. You ARE the dog?… I sure hope your bark is worse than your bite.

name: Lycan Shaman (Armor)
description: These shamans use their wits to avenge their fallen brothers and sisters whom those blood drinkers killed. Lycans will win!

name: Lycan Shinobi
description: Merely the stuff of legends for centuries, whispers of this nomadic cult have resurfaced now that Vampirates have invaded.

name: Lycan Stalker (AC)
description: The wolves of Lore roam the forest, ready to attack the harvesters. The hunt os on and your prey is near…

name: Lycan Stalker (Special)
description: The wolves of Lore roam the forest, ready to attack the harvesters. The hunt is on and your prey is near…

name: Lycan Transformation
description: Purebred Lycans can transform at will. You now harness this amazing power! Simply click to transform between Lycan forms.

name: Lycan Warrior Of Nulgath
description: Nulgath the ArchAngel welcomes guardians of all species, races, and creeds… as long as they vow to fight for the good of the Mirror Realm!

name: Lynaria Armor (Temp)
description: *No description*

name: M4tr1x Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Tales tell that these pirates be unlucking flying under the colors of Cyber Monday but no one has found their booty yet. So who's really the unlucky one?

name: M4tr1x Naval Commander (AC)
description: Tales tell that these pirates be unlucking flying under the colors of Cyber Monday but no one has found their booty yet. So who's really the unlucky one?

name: M4trix SkyGuard Uniform (0 AC)
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment.

name: M4trix SkyGuard Uniform (AC)
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment.

name: Maah-na's Robes
description: Even if their wings were broken, even if Infernal blood burns and overflows - the Bright One is always with them as a constant promise, and an eternal regret.

name: Macabre Meat Horror
description: Oh, no. Ew. OW. Whyyyyy? What fresh horror is this?!

name: Mad Chronosmith
description: Running out of time? Don't turn the clock back. Just make some more! Seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years…not very exciting. How about we invent a whole new way to stretch time?

name: Mad Doctor
description: They have an M.D. in member dismemberment!

name: Mad Magic Manawalker
description: Is this armor made from the magic dripping out of Cysero's personal sock stash? Yes, yes it is. EW.

name: Mad Scientist (Armor)
description: AHAHAHAHAHA! SCIENCE!!!

name: Mad Ubear Conductor
description: All aboard The First Ubear demo run. Can I have your Ubear Token, please?

name: Mad Weaponsmith
description: The personal armor of the Mad, Magical Weaponsmith himself. Smells like a friendly smile. And bacon.

name: Madness of Chaos
description: You cannot bring order out of Chaos. Chaos is complete insanity. And that madness has taken over you.

name: Mage Armor
description: Magic courses through your veins. Your arcane powers enable you to cast powerful spells.

name: Mage Disciple Armor
description: Show your love of mages!

name: Mage of Chaos
description: Do you wish to ally with Chaos? Can you wield mana as easily as others do a blade? Then perhaps YOU will choose to become a Mage of Chaos!

name: Mage of Cinders
description: During the expedition to Fotia, new and fascinating ways to work with lava and magma were discovered. Cinder mages explore these new avenues of magic.

name: Mage of the Ignited Ones
description: Only true fire wielders are able to learn the ancient secrets from the scrolls that the Priest of the Ignited Ones are sworn to protect. When evil is not around to threaten the order's existence, the mages become the town jesters during the Fire in the Sky celebration!

name: Mage of Time
description: Mages emerged from the unceasing rivers of time. They peer into the endless altemates to study and ponder different forms of magic. Some say, the Dragon that gave them this power once walked alongside mortals.

name: Magelord
description: A set of regal robes that reflect your expertise in the ever-expanding field of magic. Only true magi have the honor of wearing such an armor.

name: Magenta's Costume
description: This striking pink outfit will dazzle friends and foes alike… but keep away from undead-slaying Paladins!

name: Magenta Void Defender Armor
description: The Darkness Dragon has waited long enough to return to our world… he did not anticipate that when he did, his defender would turn bright pink!

name: Magentity
description: Raw mana has taken on the form of the human body in love, completely encompassing you in a self-existing para-elemental plane of hug magic. (This item requires a Pink Potion + the Astral Entity armor)

name: Magical Blossoming Bush
description: When you equip this armor, your enemies can beat around the bush for hours, but will never guess you're right there, ready to strike!

name: Magical DeepSea Star Pirate
description: DeepSea Star Pirates study the creatures found only in the brightest seas and the darkest of abyssal waters. They vow to use their power to protect all of the creatures that make the trenches their home. (Item is CC to Base)

name: Magical Johnson
description: MYSTERIOUS! (CC to Base/Accessory)

name: Magical Mariner
description: Fighting evil in sunlight,

name: Magical Mariner Arcana
description: Frills? Bows? Strange poses and chants? Not really Arcana's style, but it's fun to dress up for Mogloween. How did it go again? "In the name of the sun, I'll obliterate you! ARCANA BEAAAAAM!"

name: Magical Mariner Of Time (0 AC)
description: The center of the universe is your home. Its magic is timeless, and belongs only to you - the hidden Sovereign Eternal.

name: Magical Mariner Of Time (AC)
description: The center of the universe is your home. Its magic is timeless, and belongs only to you - the hidden Sovereign Eternal.

name: Magical Mermariner (AC)
description: In the name of the glittering sea, I'm gonna make you see stars!

name: Magical MerMariner (Legend)
description: In the name of the glittering sea, I'm gonna make you see stars!

name: Magical PopStar
description: Channel your mana into being the biggest brightest best popstar in all of Lore!

name: Magical Streetwear
description: Power is a responsibity, duty, yada yada yada. This is an outfit for the one cheat day you get once a week.

name: Magical Superstar (AC)
description: Crafted by superstar artist, Neihi, to celebrate her real-life birthday, this gear is so awesome it'll make you SING with joy! (This item is color customizable)

name: Magical Superstar (Legend)
description: Crafted by superstar artist, Neihi, to celebrate her real-life birthday, this gear is so awesome it'll make you SING with joy! (This item is color customizable)

name: Magistral Aeromancer
description: These Aeromancers gain power from the very air around them. Wind power!

name: Magistrate Armor
description: When people need help from the law, they come to you. A magistrate is a master of law.

name: Magitech Dragon of Time (0 AC)
description: The magical revolution is here. This is the garb of the Eternal Dragon of Time…or a mechanism created by mad engineers who desired to take control of the universe.

name: Magitech Dragon of Time (AC)
description: The magical revolution is here. This is the garb of the Eternal Dragon of Time…or a mechanism created by mad engineers who desired to take control of the universe.

name: Magitech Plating
description: "I am a wielder Magietechnology. The warriors call me a coward. After they lie twitching in the dust, I find that I am able to make transcend this insult. They call me Coward. So be it." -Coward, Magitechnician

name: Magma Armor
description: Not many mortals live to tell the tale of their misfortunes on Mount Mafic. Third degree burns are the newest fashion statement.

name: Magma BlazeBeard (Armor)
description: Blazebeard, known as "the dread pirate of Drakonus," is the most notorious pirate to sail the Seven Seas. But with the Magmanacles, he is now strong enough to expand his control BEYOND the water.

name: Magma Claw
description: When left to burn, those who have no where to turn…turn on each other!

name: Magma Protector
description: “Forged from fire and fury, those righteous in the sight of the Frozen Flame will rise up and banish the darkness with the light of their blaze.” – Ancient Fotian Chant

name: Magmamancer
description: A specially trained mage who has seamlessly woven their knowledge of elemental earth magic and elemental fire magic together to control the molten rock flowing beneath the planet's crust.

name: Magnetic Plate
description: In the near future, symbiotes forge their armor out of bits and pieces of magnetized scrap metal. This literal literally attractive armor was inspired by your fellow player, Reddy!

name: Magus of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Power hunger individuals who seek to follow the Nulgath path to supremacy temper their souls in the Fiend's Void. Most are dissolved, but the truly worthy become masters of the Void's properties.

name: Magus of Nulgath (AC)
description: Power hunger individuals who seek to follow the Nulgath path to supremacy temper their souls in the Fiend's Void. Most are dissolved, but the truly worthy become masters of the Void's properties.

name: Mahorc-Uraga
description: Legends from far flung Horc wanderers tell of a peerless warrior, who will only serve those who pass ten dark trials. No one has ever won their cursed respect.

name: Mahorc-Uraga Acolyte
description: Legends from far flung Horc wanderers tell of a peerless warrior, who will only serve those who pass their ten dark trials. No one has ever won their cursed respect.

name: Maid Lilim Raiment
description: Loyal and diligent, the Maid Lilim is the embodiment of impeccable service. Their abilities are well lauded throughout the Underworld where they keep the palaces of the dead pristine.

name: Maiden of Doom
description: Sometimes the Deadtech makes someone all-the-way-dead… this is what they end up like. No-one is really sure why.

name: Mail of The Fallen
description: EVIL WILL FALL AS YOU RISE FROM THE ASHES! As a member of The Fallen, you laugh in the face of your enemies as you finish them off with a single swipe of your blade! This armor is color custom.

name: Maizelord
description: My Lord, your husk is too tough. You vibe is too corny. Your maize is too bad. They'll butter you up and kill you!

name: Majestic Marine Dragon (0 AC)
description: Marine Dragons traded their wings for fins, and disguise themselves as humans to make sure land dwellers continue to respect the sea.

name: Majestic Marine Dragon (AC)
description: Marine Dragons traded their wings for fins, and disguise themselves as humans to make sure land dwellers continue to respect the sea.

name: Majestic Marine Royalty (0 AC)
description: Sparkling in the sea's pristine and clear waters is a Kingdom of pearls and plenty. It's Kings and Queens welcome all to a paradise free from hunger and predation. It's a fairytale told by Water Elves across the world.

name: Majestic Marine Royalty (AC)
description: Sparkling in the sea's pristine and clear waters is a Kingdom of pearls and plenty. It's Kings and Queens welcome all to a paradise free from hunger and predation. It's a fairytale told by Water Elves across the world.

name: Makai Fan
description: Dark Makai are some of the most under-appreciated creatures on Lore… until now. Let the #MakaiMadness begin!

name: Makeshift Mage
description: Hey, tuition can be hard to pay sometimes! Thankfully, talent shows itself at the Wizard University, no matter what sort of means you come from.

name: Malachite Merc
description: Green is a traditional color of calm and soothing, which is not what you will be when wearing this armor to fight the monsters that lurk in Lore. Beneath this cool as a cucumber exterior lies a fighter waiting for action.

name: Malani Warrior
description: These horse-riding knights gallop across the desert sands, bounding over dunes and rock-strewn valleys, racing towards glory with scimitars drawn and their battle-cries rising on the wind.

name: Maledictus Magum
description: The most maleficent of mages.

name: Malevolent Harbinger
description: The fires of the underworld have turned you into an Infernal Deathbringer. All who see you will fear.(Color Custom)

name: Malevolent Marauder
description: Under a black flag we sail and the sea shall be our empire! No ship be safe from our guns, an' glory an' gold be the treasure we seek.

name: Malevolent Scarecrow
description: The crow-pecked rags of a scarecrow. They look suspiciously similar to a missing neighbor favorite pair of overalls.

name: Malevolent Werepyre Armor
description: The terrible combination of vampire and werewolf, these loners never truly fit in with either race making them outcasts and dangerous to all creatures of the night.

name: Malgor the ShadowLord
description: The armor of the Shadowlord, the origin of the Shadowflame that scorched Lore to its core. As for where Malgor himself came from…that is a secret best kept until the world and its creator are ready.

name: Malignant Doomknight
description: Doom, born in the Plane of Darkness that spited its birth. In a moment meant to be erased from memory, a Doomknight was chosen to be the first Champion of Darkness, turning Voidstar into the mightiest of the Avatars.

name: Mammoth Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Mammoth Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football players!

name: Man of Steal (AC)
description: Only the finest supervillains can steal enough to /equip this armor!

name: Man of Steal (Legend)
description: Only the finest supervillains can steal enough to /equip this armor!

name: Mana Fenix Plume
description: With the feathers of the frozen jungle parrot to keep warmth, it's not likely to overheat during times the temperature drops during Carnaval celebration. Talk about a feasible winter coat.

name: Mana Guardian
description: The Mana Core contains the most pure magic available. Any mage drawing from the Core would be flooded with pure magic, overcome in a deluge of power which would burn through their physical, mental, and magical veins. It MUST be guarded to protect our world.

name: Mana Solace Paladin
description: Students of Lady Celestia and the Blue Mage, these Paladins wield the light of their souls to protect the innocent, and maintain the balance of Lore. Even in starless nights, their valor will shine through and vanquish fear.

name: Mana Solace Paladin w/ Shield
description: Students of Lady Celestia and the Blue Mage, these Paladins wield the light of their souls to protect the innocent, and maintain the balance of Lore. Even in starless nights, their valor will shine through and vanquish fear.

name: Manashaper Mage
description: Not even fire will defrost these ice wielding winter mages. Their frigid power are equally as devastating as their stares.
