name: Manticore Assassin
description: Much can be learned from the manticore’s hunting styles. Nature’s perfect assassin.

name: Manticore Trainer
description: The mad prince of the Venom Vaults once wore this garb to train his pet manticores.

name: Marauder Legionary
description: These former comrades of Kyron are heck bent on undermining his position as General and bringing havoc to the Steppes.

name: Marauder Scout
description: These former comrades of Kyron are heck bent on undermining his position as General and bringing havoc to the Steppes.

name: Mariachi Armor
description: Wear this charro and start your own mariachi band. All you need is three violins, two trumpets, one guitarron, and if you are going all-out, consider adding a harp! Happy Cinco de Mayo!

name: Mariachi Hero
description: All I wanted was to be a nightmare, like my ancestors. But the dream I thought would bring me luck, brought only a curse. I lost my moglin, my mustache, and my maracas.

name: ¡Mariartix! Charro Outfit
description: Mariachero Paladins bring joy and light to the lives of the people in Doomwood. They drive out the darkness with the power of their music, and buff the courage of all those around them.

name: Mark of the Warrior
description: They do not fight for fame or glory. All they know is that deep down inside, their heart belongs on the battlefield… unless they are riding the skies atop their dragon companions!

name: Marrowfiend
description: Bones from the monster slayed by Sir Tendeth constructed to form this armor. Marrowfiend's were born from the Tower.

name: Martial Artist Armor
description: A master of the martial arts, whose punches and kicks fly with the force of the land's greatest beasts. They drift across land and sea, honing their skills to perfection, and bow to no one but their own code of honor.

name: Martial Artist's Gi
description: Ryoku started with Karate, then chased after masteries in Tae Kwon Do, Tang Soo Do, Aikido, Muay Thai Kickboxing, Krav Maga, Kung Fu, Jujitsu, and even Ninjutsu. This gi has been worn since the beginning of that journey, and is only cleaned by stints of training under waterfalls.

name: Marvel-ous Wetsuit (0 AC)
description: This armor was originally going to be called the WidowMaker Dual Photon Blades before EbilCorp's legal team intervened.

name: Marvel-ous Wetsuit (AC)
description: This armor was originally going to be called the WidowMaker Dual Photon Blades before EbilCorp's legal team intervened.

name: Mascarada de Muertos
description: Celebrate the feast of the dead! You really should too, you look like you could use something to eat.

name: Masque of Red Death (AC)
description: Your armor is dabbled in blood and besprinkled with the scarlet horror

name: Masque of Red Death (Legend)
description: Your armor is dabbled in blood and besprinkled with the scarlet horror

name: Masquerade Vesture
description: A marvelously elaborate outfit that is as stunning as it is festive, perfect for pageants and balls and dragon-slaying.

name: Master Falconer
description: Command your own army, slay the Undead, catch the early worms, or just look your best in a Master Falconer Armor.

name: Master Martial Artist (Armor) (0 AC)
description: A master of the martial arts, whose punches and kicks fly with the force of the land's greatest beasts. They drift across land and sea, honing their skills to perfection, and bow to no one but their own code of honor. (Item is color-customizable)

name: Master Martial Artist (Armor) (AC)
description: A master of the martial arts, whose punches and kicks fly with the force of the land's greatest beasts. They drift across land and sea, honing their skills to perfection, and bow to no one but their own code of honor. (Item is color-customizable)

name: Master Of Memes
description: You think the meme is your ally? You merely equipped it. I was born into it, molded by it.

name: Master of Moglins (Armor)
description: The Master of Moglins battles alongside a crew of the cutest, fiercest moglins Lore has ever seen!

name: Master Phoenix Hunter
description: Horc's give Hero armor for helping. Free and Strong. Do not taint it with Troll stink.

name: Master Punk
description: You'll lose yourself to dance in this snappy suit.

name: Master Ranger Armor
description: Rangers are stealthy, wealthy and wise to the ways of their opponents. Able to take down tyrants without blinking an eye or breaking a bowstring!

name: Master's Gi
description: You've reached the pinnacle of mastery over all forms of martial arts. Joining tournaments you know you'll win is a bit trivial. This could be a good time to look into street fighting.

name: Master Terror Guard
description: This relic gives off a very otherworldly aura. Warlic says it comes from another timeline… one very similar - but significantly different - than ours. (This item is fully color customizable.)

name: Master Trainer
description: After defeating the esteemed Training Golem, you've earned the right to call yourself a… Master Trainer! Enjoy your reward. (This item gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.)

name: Matchless Dawn Duelist
description: As the sun rises over the mountains, a condor calls the warriors to battle. The Dawn Duelists prepare to defend their home. They will give their life for the land and people they love so much.

name: Matrix Hanzo Void (AC)
description: You are devoid of all emotion. You are death, bloody destruction. Go forth from the Matrix and server your master.

name: Matrix Hanzo Void (Legend)
description: You are devoid of all emotion. You are death, bloody destruction. Go forth from the Matrix and server your master.

name: Maugs Slayer
description: The great beast has awakened… the dragon awaits! But one does not simply SLAY Maugs… one must defeat him honorably.

name: Maximillian Arctic Armor
description: The leader of the Golden Onslaught had this artic garb crafted for leading his insane crusade in frozen climates. Thanks to you, he'll never get the chance to wear it.

name: Maximillian Armor
description: Wear this armor with pride! Gilt entirely in gold and embellished with gemeralds, Maximillian's armor is everything except cowardly.

name: May Tricks Outfit
description: Don't THINK you are a Hero. KNOW you are a Hero.

name: Maya's Winter Gear
description: It's a holly, jolly Frostval, and Maya wants to dress to commemorate the season. Now you can too!

name: Mazumi (Armor)
description: Lore's own Ninja trainer!

name: Meanest Bully
description: On Wednesdays we wear pink. On Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, Mondays, and Tuesdays, we wear WHATEVER ELSE WE WANT. Who's going to stop us? YOU? Pffft. As if.

name: Meanest Girl (Armor)
description: On Wednesdays, we wear pink.

name: Meatlab Worker
description: So, you want to work for Memet, do you? I'd be careful if I were you, who KNOWS what she will ask you to do.

name: Mecha Defender (Armor)
description: This bio-mech mobile suit is especially designed to increase your strength by 250%. It was originally manufactured for risky, labor-intensive work, however it was only a matter of time before its… military uses became a higher priority.

name: Mecha Dragon Commander
description: You are the commander of Mecha Dragons… all shall bow before you! (Item is customizable to base and accessory.)

name: Mecha Gear: Mediator (AC)
description: Mecha Gear, an integrated system linking man and machine together. The Mediator's sleek design boasts great speed. Arm yourself with this Mecha Gear, rise above physical limitations, and bring a swift end to all conflicts.

name: Mecha Gear: Mediator (Legend)
description: Mecha Gear, an integrated system linking man and machine together. The Mediator's sleek design boasts great speed. Arm yourself with this Mecha Gear, rise above physical limitations, and bring a swift end to all conflicts.

name: Mecha Leprechaun Shield Suit
description: The future is now and your mecha suit and shield are primed for combat. Do ya feel LUCKY?! (Color-customizable to accessory)

name: Mecha Leprechaun Suit (AC)
description: The future is now and your mecha suit is primed for combat. Do ya feel LUCKY?! (Color-customizable to accessory)

name: Mecha Leprechaun Suit (Legend)
description: The future is now and your mecha suit is primed for combat. Do ya feel LUCKY?! (Color-customizable to accessory)

name: Mechachillid Armor
description: Forged in the mines of Delta V, this dense exoskeleton offers excellent protection from all the hazards of daily life…if your daily life is diving for shiny rocks in face-meltingly hot magma.

name: Mechalodon Prime
description: A high-speed mech that hunts sea monsters and battleships. Once there's blood in the water, combat mode activates, and turns you into an apex predator.

name: Mechanical Naval Commander
description: A costly war that Ruwa Village sailors fought in have sadly lost their arms to a secret weapon their captain's nemesis kept by his side. These sailors got their arms replaced by a stainless cybernetic arm that comes with a retractable blade. On the bright side, they'll never forget their weapons again.

name: MechFiend of Nulgath
description: Voids can always be upgraded, we can do it, we have the technology.

name: Medieval Shadow
description: Medieval Shadow-shapers used this armor to curse knights of lesser houses from stealing the glory of their lords. Perhaps Dudulokinho was one once?

name: Medium Rare Warrior
description: For those who like their steak a little more cooked…

name: Mega Warrior (0 AC)
description: This armor is a return to the roots, grown brand new at the start of another grand adventure.

name: Mega Warrior (AC)
description: This armor is a return to the roots, grown brand new at the start of another grand adventure.

name: MegaDead Morph Armor
description: You are the MegaDEADLIEST monster on the battlefield! /rock

name: Mehgan The Merciless Armor
description: An Infernal General that was born fallen. She's considered one of the first to exist without having known the light of The Bright One.

name: Mel de Abelha Outfit
description: Tão doce quanto Mel de Abelha para o Carnaval.

name: Melee Mosher
description: Available for a limited time during the Battle Concert featuring Alice in Chains!

name: Melodia's Uniform (1)
description: Be careful! Try not to get captured by an evil villain and imprisoned in their awful lair… again…

name: Melodia's Uniform (2)
description: Be careful! Try not to get captured by an evil villain and imprisoned in their awful lair… again…

name: Melon Harbinger (0 AC)
description: WATER your enemies going to do when you charge into battle like this? Run away in fear.

name: Melon Harbinger (AC)
description: WATER your enemies going to do when you charge into battle like this? Run away in fear.

name: Memeat Formalwear
description: Sure, it's a little uncomfortable. But on the plus side, it tastes good.

name: Memet Animatronic Armor
description: Don't hold it against them.

name: Memet Kigu (AC)
description: PSA: No Memets were harmed in the making of this set. Memet is the one who does the harming.

name: Memet Kigu (Legend)
description: PSA: No Memets were harmed in the making of this set. Memet is the one who does the harming.

name: Mennacing Armor
description: When you /equip this armor, everyone will flee in the face of your Mennacing aura. Aura's intensity is lessened if you acquire cake or gummy were-bears.

name: Merchant Mariner
description: ﻿Though Ashray itself is a quiet collection of wooden shacks, the villagers take pride in their home. Well-versed in trade and blade tricks, these mariners can go toe to toe with bloodthirsty pirates, all while carrying a tune.

name: Merpyre Transformation
description: A Siren dragged an exiled Vampire into the dark depths of the sea. The curse stole her song, and sentenced her to an eternity in the dark. (Female only)

name: Merry Frostvale Outfit
description: Poor Elf! Who knows how long the outfits have been stuck inside Giefurious!

name: MerWarrior
description: The spirit of battle runs deep, almost as deep as Davey Jones' locker. Suit up, grab a weapon, and ready yourself for battle. Wet or dry, you are going to cause a few headaches. Hmmm, maybe your battle spirit does run deeper than Jones' locker.

name: Messenger Of Abaddon (0 AC)
description: From the abyss comes a message. Perhaps you are the receiver, of your pieces will be a message to the many that scoff at the power of the Archfiend.

name: Messenger Of Abaddon (AC)
description: From the abyss comes a message. Perhaps you are the receiver, of your pieces will be a message to the many that scoff at the power of the Archfiend.

name: Messina Mirage Corsair
description: The Messina Mirage uses illusions to survive and conquer sea monster infested waters. With grace and dexterity, beasts are diced into cubes before they realize that they're stuck in a dream. (Item is Color Customizable)

name: Metal Mog
description: It's reported that spending 1 night with this equipped will give you some… interesting visions. Violent visions. Spend any longer than 5 nights and you begin to lose your memory of who you are… Only the urges to extinguish life.

name: Metal NecroRocker
description: Their rock music is banned anywhere the sun still touches, but even the paladin order can't stop their fans from rushing to their doomed stages.

name: Metamorphosis Maw's Knight
description: Dryden gave himself to the Doom Triad, and his flesh was stripped away. The Metamorphosis Maw's cold Shadow envelops him, transforming the young man into its Champion. He has yet to reach his full potential.

name: Metamorphosis Maw's Loyal Knight
description: Dryden gave himself to the Doom Triad, and his flesh was stripped away. The Metamorphosis Maw's cold Shadow envelops him, transforming the young man into its Champion. He has yet to reach his full potential.

name: Meteoric Celestial Centurion
description: A civilization locked black holes into the bodies of once valiant and noble Centurions, setting them loose into the space. Who weaponized them, and why give them free reign to choose what to obliterate? It's a mystery that'll go unsolved.

name: Meteoric Centaur Gargantua
description: A civilization locked black holes into the bodies of once valiant and noble centaurs, setting them loose into the space. Who weaponized them, and why give them free reign to choose what to obliterate? It's a mystery that'll go unsolved.

name: Meteoric Centaurion Sentinel
description: A civilization locked black holes into the bodies of once valiant and noble centaurs, setting them loose into the space. Who weaponized them, and why give them free reign to choose what to obliterate? It's a mystery that'll go unsolved.

name: Metrea's Crimson Presence
description: Metrea taught Dragonrune Hall's students basic physical self defence for a day. In a gesture of gratitude, they invited her to the Frostval Feast, but she was sadly sidetracked. The rogue had to settle a vendetta in festive holly jolly red.

name: Metrea's Garb
description: The rogues in Metrea's posse are all over Battleon, but scarcely seen. Their creed is stealth, secrecy, and survival. Honor among thieves is only considered if everything else is assured.

name: Mi's Attire
description: Mi received their attire as a gift when they joined the Scale. It took a while for them to feel comfortable pulling their hood down, even with friends. Gives the wearer frizzly hood hair if it doesn't get messy from head pats first.

name: Mi's Casual Ensemble
description: ﻿﻿Mi's family left Astravia to find a new home. Having received amnesty from the Swordhaven Crown, they began work as a counsellor to help others in need. Every now and then, they perform music at the Seaview Inn. (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Mi's Frostval Ensemble
description: That little smile shows that everything is right in the world for this one little moment. Cherish it, and know that you are loved by your family and friends.

name: Mi's Sleeveless Attire
description: Mi received their attire as a gift when they joined the Scale. It took a while for them to feel comfortable pulling their hood down, even with friends. Gives the wearer frizzly hood hair if it doesn't get messy from head pats first.

name: Mi's Swimsuit
description: Normally, Mi is very self-conscious about their body. They were the subject of curiosity for cold scientist or outright sadistic low-lives. Mi is only comfortable wearing this swimsuit with people close to them. One day, they'll look in the mirror and love what they see as much as their family does.

name: Midnight Archmage
description: Control the night, control the world!

name: Midnight Assassin (Armor)
description: *No description*

name: Midnight Beach Party Outfit (0 AC)
description: Keep it cool at your next beach party… even when things heat up!

name: Midnight Beach Party Outfit (AC)
description: Keep it cool at your next beach party… even when things heat up!

name: Midnight Cheerleader
description: Gimme an 'H', gimme an 'A', gimme a 'P' 'P' 'Y'. *breathe* Gimme an 'N' 'E' 'W'! Gimme a 'Y' 'E' 'A' 'R'!!! Happy New Year!

name: Midnight Fiend of Nulgath
description: Named after the midnight hour for their ability to completely blend into darkness, this Fiend roams like silent stalkers. Once they have your scent, you will never again know sleep.

name: Midnight Glaucus Mystic
description: The longer a Glaucus lives, the deadlier their poison becomes. They bathed in the sea where gods fought, and must return to prevent themselves from tainting the land. As they sink beneath the waves in solitude, their poisonous frills begin to glow with sacred power.

name: Midnight Glaucus Sage
description: Those who have become Glaucus Mystics must eventually return to the sea that gifted and poisoned their bodies. There, where a dragon felled an unworthy Avatar, the Glaucus become Sages. Their transformation into a great blue dragon will soon be complete.

name: Midnight Hanzo Void (AC)
description: Midnight signals the dawn of a new day. You decide who gets to be apart of it.

name: Midnight Hanzo Void (Legend)
description: Midnight signals the dawn of a new day. You decide who gets to be apart of it.

name: Midnight Kat Burglar
description: Kittarians are naturally silent, effective burglars because of their ability to sneak around unnoticed and grab their bounty before anyone is the wiser.

name: Midnight Masquerade
description: Trying to find a costume for a masquerade can be difficult.. but not anymore! Keep this outfit in your closet for all your masquerade needs - no matter what time of year!

name: Midnight Northlands Ranger (0 AC)
description: The Northlands Rangers travel the frozen wastes in search of Good heroes to reward with silver, gold, and treasure beyond compare… ensuring a most joyful winter season!

name: Midnight Northlands Ranger (AC)
description: The Northlands Rangers travel the frozen wastes in search of Good heroes to reward with silver, gold, and treasure beyond compare… ensuring a most joyful winter season!

name: Midnight Nutcracker (AC)
description: This festive symbol of luck also wards off evil spirits, so ghost of Frostval past beware!

name: Midnight Nutcracker (Legend)
description: This festive symbol of luck also wards off evil spirits, so ghost of Frostval past beware!

name: Midnight Plate of the North
description: This is a replica of battle armor worn by the High Kings of the North. Few can bear the weight of its plate. Fewer still can bear the weight in battle.

name: Midnight Sand Golem
description: Formed from the essence of your darkest dreams, the Midnight Sand Golem has come to life to inhabit your waking world.

name: Midnight Sea Commander (Armor)
description: The original bearer of the Midnight Crown, who claimed a misty island for the denizens of the night. This Pirate Captain had no equal, be they Vampire or Lycan, and set sail for parts unknown when their nights became too quiet.

name: Midnight Storm Void
description: The Tempest Voids are responsible for the countless storms blasting through Tercessuinotlim! A distant cousin to the Hex Voids, they are proven to be very resilient even in the worst environmental conditions.

name: Midnight Zilla Witch
description: A witch with mastery over great monsters, able to summon them as familiars or in rare instances, take on the mighty forms of ancient beasts through magicial transformation. (Female Only).

name: Midwinter Cheermaker
description: Jingle bells pinned to festive lapels. Twinkling stars and special moments written into a memoir. The holidays are only once a year. Put your whole heart into it!

name: Mights Vision
description: Knights of the dark By player: Alder Priest

name: Mighty Undead Infantry Armor
description: You've turned into an undead soldier! (Gives 5% more gold when equipped.)

name: Mighty Warlord Armor
description: War has sharpened your battle skills but also made you merciless. This is so much more mighty than the Savage Warlord Armor. 10% more damage to Humans (plus +5 gold and +5 exp!).

name: Mike's Outfit
description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as Mike!

name: MindBreaker Armor
description: You have honed your psychic abilities to work in unision with your weapons to create the ultimate psionic warrior! Thanks for your Membership support and enjoy your AdventureCoins!

name: MindBreaker Aviator (0 AC)
description: Members of the MindBreaker Guard that have been chosen to ride the Wyverns into battle, the MindBreaker Aviators can attack the foe from the air.

name: MindBreaker Aviator (AC)
description: Members of the MindBreaker Guard that have been chosen to ride the Wyverns into battle, the MindBreaker Aviators can attack the foe from the air.

name: MindBreaker Halberdier
description: These halberdiers are responsible for the short-ranged defense of Somnia.

name: MindBreaker Knight
description: The strongest of all the defenders of Somnia, the MindBreaker Knights are the final line of defense in the battle against the Nightmare Realm.

name: MindBreaker Paladin
description: Mind and Soul. One can not master one without knowing the other. The Mana Solace Paladins who sought to perfect mastery over magic and light looked inward, gaining psychic abilities.

name: MindBreaker Paladin w/ Shield
description: Students of Lady Celestia and the Blue Mage, these Paladins wield the light of their souls to protect the innocent, and maintain the balance of Lore. Even in starless nights, their valor will shine through and vanquish fear.

name: MindBreaker Psion Justiciar
description: The MindBreaker Psion are a sect dedicated to protecting the peace and justice of Somnia and the Nightmare realms. The Justiciars are the supreme judges of Somnia.

name: MindBreaker Psion Peacekeeper
description: The MindBreaker Psion are a sect dedicated to protecting the peace and justice of Somnia and the Nightmare realms.

name: MindBreaker WyvernRider (0 AC)
description: Members of the MindBreaker Guard that have been chosen to ride the Wyverns into battle, the MindBreaker Wyvern Riders can attack the foe from the air.

name: MindBreaker WyvernRider (AC)
description: Members of the MindBreaker Guard that have been chosen to ride the Wyverns into battle, the MindBreaker Wyvern Riders can attack the foe from the air.

name: Miners Away Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Miners Away Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Miners Rush Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Miners Rush Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Miners Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Miners Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Miners Varsity Team
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Minion of Skudly
description: When you're fighting the villain but you gotta be at the opera by 7pm.

name: Minotaur of War! (AC)
description: The Minotaurs of War will only yield to the might of Nulgath. And that's no bull.

name: Minotaur of War! (Legend)
description: The Minotaurs of War will only yield to the might of Nulgath. And that's no bull.

name: Minotaur Slayer
description: Defeat the Beast, then wear this trophy armor to prove YOU are the Minotaur Slayer! Victory is yours!

name: Miranda and William Outfits
description: William and Miranda together forever.

name: Mirror BladeMaster
description: A stealthy ally in the fight against Chaos.

name: Mirror Drakath (Armor)
description: As the Champion of Order, Drakath in the Mirror Realm stands for everything righteous and good. Only a select few are worthy enough to wear such a prestigious suit of armor.

name: Mirror Gravelyn Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: Gravelyn the Good doesn't condone the actions of pirates or any other underhanded rapscallions, but it sure is fun to dress up and pretend. Now, if only she could expertly pretend she knew how to swim.

name: Mirror Gravelyn Pirate Captain (AC)
description: Gravelyn the Good doesn't condone the actions of pirates or any other underhanded rapscallions, but it sure is fun to dress up and pretend. Now, if only she could expertly pretend she knew how to swim.

name: Mirror Knight (Armor)
description: The reflecting light that brightens the metallic silver that comprises this regal suit acts as a mirror, but what it reveals cannot be seen in plain mind, but rather by a sharp minded subconscious.

name: Mirror Mage Apprentice
description: Formerly worn by acolytes of Scarletta before her transformation, their purpose is to scoop as much sand as possible to create glass needed to make new mirrors in case one vanishes. Now the power in these robes is used for convenient mirrorsmithing.

name: Mirror Vordred
description: From the celestial heavens, the souls of ascended heroes merged and became a singular guardian of the innocent and downtrodden. Softspoken, they see to their duties in secret.

name: Mirrored Duality Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power of Good or Evil is completely up to you… (Gender is reversed)

name: Mirrored Duality Naval Commander (AC)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power of Good or Evil is completely up to you… (Gender is reversed)

name: Mirrored Eternal Dragon Celebration Outfit (AC)
description: The formal regalia of the Eternal, the sovereign of time who proudly walks shoulder to shoulder with friends. Few beings trapped up high can celebrate such an honor.

name: Mirrored Eternal Dragon Celebration Outfit (Legend)
description: The formal regalia of the Eternal, the sovereign of time who proudly walks shoulder to shoulder with friends. Few beings trapped up high can celebrate such an honor.

name: Mirrored Golden Dragon's Plate (0 AC)
description: The noble vesture of a Golden Dragon that has watch history being made since the dawn of time. The future innocently robs us of our past and present, but is filled with endless potential.

name: Mirrored Golden Dragon's Plate (AC)
description: The noble vesture of a Golden Dragon that has watch history being made since the dawn of time. The future innocently robs us of our past and present, but is filled with endless potential.

name: Mirrored Obsidian Dragon's Plate (0 AC)
description: The noble vesture of a Golden Dragon that has watched history being made since the dawn of time. The future innocently robs us of our past and present, but is filled with endless potential.

name: Mirrored Obsidian Dragon's Plate (AC)
description: The noble vesture of a Golden Dragon that has watched history being made since the dawn of time. The future innocently robs us of our past and present, but is filled with endless potential.

name: Mirrored Wellmet Baron and Baroness
description: Only the finest barons and baronesses of Wellmet can afford to wear mirroed finery to the Duchess' court! It changes according to their will.

name: Missile-Toe Mech
description: This is one missile toe you don't want to be standing under, because you won't be kissed… you'll be CRUSHED!

name: Mistfall Lich (0 AC)
description: Burdened by an impossible mission, a great warrior and their army was sent into an endless blizzard to die. They were raised by vengeful kin to march on corrupt ground.

name: Mistfall Lich (AC)
description: Burdened by an impossible mission, a great warrior and their army was sent into an endless blizzard to die. They were raised by vengeful kin to march on corrupt ground.

name: Mobius Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Many have heard of the Bermuda Triangle. But on Lore, stare too deeply into the heart of the Runix Cube and you'll be mesmerized, doomed to sail off into the unknown, never to return again.

name: Mobius Naval Commander (AC)
description: Many have heard of the Bermuda Triangle. But on Lore, stare too deeply into the heart of the Runix Cube and you'll be mesmerized, doomed to sail off into the unknown, never to return again.

name: MockingSlayer (AC)
description: The citizens of Lore need a symbol. It is your job to keep hope alive.

name: MockingSlayer (Legend)
description: The citizens of Lore need a symbol. It is your job to keep hope alive.

name: Moglin Defender
description: Harness the power of the moglin! Moglin Defenders are a select sect of skilled warriors who have dedicated themselves to protecting lore and her inhabitants.

name: Moglin Self
description: After the Embero Spell was cast, it was revealed that your true inner form is that of a magical moglin! You possess the capacity for loyalty, skill at healing and magic, and a nature which can be trusted (whether it should be or not).

name: MogliTech (AC)
description: Battlenator 7: Rise of the MOGBOTs.

name: MogliTech (Legend)
description: Battlenator 7: Rise of the MOGBOTs.

name: Moglokuma Armor
description: I've prepared a VERY SPECIAL TREAT for you! Mehehehe!

name: Moglotron
description: "Your scientists were so preoccupied with whether or not they could that they didn't stop to think if they should."

name: Molten Dragon Plate
description: Dragonscale Plate Armor is one of the toughest armors known but THIS is crafted with Lava Dragon Scales, making it more heavy but nearly twice as heavy as standard Dragonscale Plate.

name: Molten Monarch
description: You'll never fall victim to the head of the summer once you can control the flames!

name: Molten Robe
description: Scarlet flames encompass these robes and which are the garb of choice of fire elementalists. Fire emblazes this robe with power of infernos.

name: Monochromancer
description: Paint the town red! (And blue, green, yellow, purple, pink, black…) this is April Fool's Day! Show these bland corporate suits that they can't take away AQW's color!

name: Monster BladeMaster Armor
description: One of the most featured creatures in the land, and because of its beautiful face. No, more like its uncanny skill with a blade

name: Monster Hunter
description: Nothing is so dangerous that it can't be conquered and controlled.

name: Monster Mummy
description: Not all the dwellers of the great pyramids in the Sandsea rest peacefully.

name: Monster Queen's Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: If'n ye are smarter than ye look, ye'll jump to obey when th' Monster Queen commands. Else she'll be destroyin' ye, me, an' th' rest o' th' world.

name: Monster Queen's Naval Commander (AC)
description: If'n ye are smarter than ye look, ye'll jump to obey when th' Monster Queen commands. Else she'll be destroyin' ye, me, an' th' rest o' th' world.

name: MonsterLord Drakath
description: In a different world, a different timeline, Drakath -- Champion of Chaos -- would have been the MonsterLord, heir to the Queen of Monsters. But this is not that world, and he has seized his own power, and his own destiny.

name: Monstrous Cuca
description: One of the main legends of Brazilian folklore, Cuca watches out for disobedient children. If she finds them, she then transforms into a monstrous creature and spirits them away.

name: Monstrous Fa
description: Fa despised her true appearance, and carved at it until it resembled something that was human and could be loved. This red glow is what hides under her disguise, one step away from a truly despicable form.

name: Monstrous Pirate
description: Not all pirates are monsters, but then again some truly are.

name: Monstrous Royal Chaos Garb (0 AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters knows all. Sees all. Destroys all… Except those followers who prove worthy. Will you be one of them?

name: Monstrous Royal Chaos Garb (AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters knows all. Sees all. Destroys all… Except those followers who prove worthy. Will you be one of them?

name: Monstrous Zealot (0 AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters' most zealous, loyal defenders have reshaped themselves in her image.

name: Monstrous Zealot (AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters' most zealous, loyal defenders have reshaped themselves in her image.

name: Montresor Jester (Permanent)
description: Just keep smiling. They'll never know you hid the bodies.

name: Montresor Jester (Temporary)
description: Just keep smiling. They'll never know you hid the bodies.

name: Moon Bow Ninja
description: Legend says that the maker of this armor actually captured moonlight and wove it into the threads, giving this a haunting glow.

name: Moon Girl
description: For those who like the night moon!

name: Moon Lab Scientist
description: Dangerous experiments? Bio infections? Not your typical day at the lab unless you're on the moon!

name: Moonborn Guardian
description: The purity of the moon, gleaming from the light of the sun gives life to the Moonborn Guardians. Legends say that they descend to Lore during new moons, and perish when a cycle ends, leaving behind their armor and armaments.

name: Moonlight Hunter
description: The power of the Moon keeps these hunters warm and guides their way on every mission.

name: Moonlit Couture
description: The wind whispers through the trees as you walk through a moonlit graveyard, arm-in-arm with your one true love… forver. Love is forever when one can never die.

name: Moonridge Villager
description: This outfit was fashionable in Moonridge decades ago, and still is now. The times barely when the rest of the world wants little to do with your spooky end of the woods.

name: Moonstone Cultist
description: Members of the Moonstone Cult and followers of Rowan, these powerful Casters follow their Cult Leader's loose moral code, and seek to bring nothing but unwavering justice to Lore…whatever the cost may be.

name: Moonwalker
description: This special armor was designed to celebrate the 40th anniversary of humanity's first steps on the moon!

name: Mort's PJs
description: Mogloween is the best time to break out all of the onesies that have been in your closet. Dress up like Mort!

name: Mortal Doom Captain (0 AC)
description: A forsaken voyager, doomed to spread terror across the seas. Though they sail for the Empire, their greed is all that's left of what once made them human.

name: Mortal Doom Captain (AC)
description: A forsaken voyager, doomed to spread terror across the seas. Though they sail for the Empire, their greed is all that's left of what once made them human.

name: Mortal Executioner
description: What cannot be bound or conquered must be destroyed.

name: Mortal Oracle of Misfortune
description: Your fortune reads: You have the power to overcome your own misfortune. Never give up. Always keep fighting." ("Ni you ke'fu kun'nan de li'liang, bie fang'qi, jian'chi dao'di!")

name: Mortal Painsaw Man
description: The evils of the world have been consumed by the Painsaw Beast. By signing a contract with the foul fiend, you have merged into a mortal-infernal hybrid anad unlocked the ability to wield his dreaded Painsaw Blade.

name: Mortal Sea King Gravefang
description: The fiercest sea dogs sail in Sea King Gravefang's fleet. They prowl the seas to plunder blood instead of gold. The Abyssal Horde continues to grow, turning every ship they can find into one of their own.

name: Mortality of Revontheus
description: Thought a contract has been signed and a soul has been lost, the feel of the cold still lingers on skin that has been frosted over. The only sense of warmth found in the Underworld is this cloak.

name: Mortis Phantasm Chronomancer
description: A phantom executioner, feared by Chronomancers who attempt to evade death. They reclaim time, draining their quarry of their temporal powers. No one is exempt from the natural order of the universe.

name: Mosh Pit Metal Armor
description: Spikes on your shoulders might help makes sure that people give you a little more space in the Mosh Pit!

name: Mountain Breaker
description: In case anyone needs a mountain reduced to a pile of rocks. A lot of rocks.

name: Mountaineer
description: A slim-fitting down-filled armor favored by fashion-savvy mountaineers. Take that, Old Man Winter!

name: Mr. Strawberry Sparkle Suit
description: Bydis' little plushie is somehow a lot bigger now.

name: Mud Minion
description: Your skin must be really soft, with that constantly covered in mud thing. Oh, that IS your skin?… Oh.

name: Muenster Monsters Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Muenster Monsters Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football players!

name: Multiverse Overdrive Traveller (0 AC)
description: You exist in a multitude of dimensions. Travel between them requires the approval of the Archivist, leader of the Crystallis. Maintaining order and harmony between the realities requires a skill only she possesses. It is said her power rivals that of Kotaro.

name: Multiverse Overdrive Traveller (AC)
description: You exist in a multitude of dimensions. Travel between them requires the approval of the Archivist, leader of the Crystallis. Maintaining order and harmony between the realities requires a skill only she possesses. It is said her power rivals that of Kotaro.

name: Mummy (Armor)
description: That's a wrap! Your body has been perfectly preserved. Won't your mummy be proud? This is a Mogloween 2013 Seasonal Rare!

name: Munchkin Pumpkin
description: Those little legs better be quick! You're so cute and definetely tasty, those Mogloween Ghouls are going to gobble you up.

name: Munky's Outfit
description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as Munky!

name: Music Pirate Garb
description: It be a treasure cove of plundered arrrrrrrmors!! Fashion piracy is where it be! Randomly changes your appearance each time you equip it.

name: Mustard's Costume
description: Pardon me, is your outfit made of Grey Poupon? I suggest staying away from hot dog vendors while wearing this.

name: Mutant Pumpkin Lord (AC)
description: It's time to reap your harvest. The world is ripe for the talking taking. (This item will return every Halloween.)

name: Mutant Pumpkin Lord (Legend)
description: It's time to reap your harvest. The world is ripe for the talking taking.

name: Muusa's Swimwear
description: An elegant swimsuit fitted one of the most respected Lorekeepers in the world. It's hard for Muusa to get her mind off of history, but she makes her best effort to speak of the pleasant present.

name: My Dashing Pirate Commander
description: Never fear! Your dashing Pirate Commander is here!

name: My Magical Pirate Commander
description: I've learned that bein' a Magical Pirate Commander isn't always easy, but there's no doubt it's worth fighting for! YARRR!

name: Mystcroft Disciple
description: Treat your tricky enemies with the deadliest threat they'll ever see… the LAST thing they'll ever see.

name: Mystcroft Witch
description: Witches in Mystcroft have plenty of opportunity (and cauldrons) to make potions and plots!

name: Mysterious Johnson (Armor)
description: MYSTERIOUS!

name: Mysterious Sprites
description: Will you succumb to Darkness? Do you think that, by embracing it, you will be safe from what comes?

name: Mystic Adventurer
description: On All Moglo's Eve, creatures roam Lore again, in search of their lost souls. The Mystic Adventurer makes sure that these creatures never find those souls again. For if they do, it will mean the end of LORE!!!!! (BAHAHAHAHA)

name: Mystic Aries Castigator
description: Aries, the cardina fire sign. Those born under the constellation are fiery, adventurous, and honest. Their strong will carries the burdens of wronged and misunderstood souls, who power their magic.

name: Mystic Dragon Conqueror
description: The sea is rough and there will always be obstacles, but the water-based elemental power flowing in the icy gems will come of aid for sure when braving the waves of oppression.

name: Mystic DragonCaller (Armor)
description: Mystic DragonCaller's are sorcerers with the capability of manipulating the very force of mana itself, granting them a deeper sensitivity to the Para-Elemental Plane than most magic users are.

name: Mystic Healer
description: Healers are servants of Good who use their powers to aid the sick, weak, and injured. Their powerful healing magic is often the difference between a group's victory or defeat.

name: Mystic Moonlighter
description: What's better than a thief with nimble fingers? A thief with nimble fingers and magic! Welcome to the world of magical thievery. Just put your mind to it and all will come up diamonds for you in the end.

name: Mystic Ocean Nereid (0 AC)
description: It's easy to mistake these sea spirits for a swimmer visiting the beach. They're denizens of the oceans who protect kind sailors, and ward voracious sea Dragons away.

name: Mystic Ocean Nereid (AC)
description: It's easy to mistake these sea spirits for a swimmer visiting the beach. They're denizens of the oceans who protect kind sailors, and ward voracious sea Dragons away.

name: Mystic Underworld Warrior (0 AC)
description: These warriors have truly become one with the Underworld, showing their full allegiance to Dage the Evil.

name: Mystic Underworld Warrior (AC)
description: These warriors have truly become one with the Underworld, showing their full allegiance to Dage the Evil.

name: Mystic Witch Caster
description: Look deep inside yourself to channel the incredible power you hold this Mogloween… and EVERY day!

name: Mystical Acolyte
description: Some of the most sensitive mage and priests believe that they have heard the heart of our world whispering to them. These Mystical Acolytes believe a being lives inside the Mana Core itself. They are not — yet — a cult.

name: Mystical Ascended SoulWeaver
description: To become a SoulWeaver you must bond with an Elemental Spirit partner. Together, using the Spirit Looms you have forged, you may weave wonderful cloth that cannot be destroyed. (Animated Gauntlets)

name: Mystical Beast Master
description: Control the beasts with the power of your magic!

name: Mystical Cosmic Void (0 AC)
description: Mortals of strict discipline and focused minds are asked to meditate in the hostile depths of the Fiend's Void. Their bodies dissolve in an excruciatingly painful process, but what emerges is a cosmic body of near-limitless strength.

name: Mystical Cosmic Void (AC)
description: Mortals of strict discipline and focused minds are asked to meditate in the hostile depths of the Fiend's Void. Their bodies dissolve in an excruciatingly painful process, but what emerges is a cosmic body of near-limitless strength.

name: Mystical Devotee of Mana
description: Formless. The mystical arts of Mana are nothing and everything at once. True devotees know Mana as an endless well of possibility, and harness the power of the infinite.

name: Mystical DragonPlane Guardian
description: A self-proclaimed Guardian of Draconic blood. In truth, they're a sorcerer that channeled the spirit of a Dragon into their body. Intense envy transforms into unshakable pride. They fully believe they've become a Dragon.

name: Mystical FrostBlood Guard
description: The FrostBlood gave themselves to the north, allowing their hearts to be frozen, and ice to spread through their veins. A mere sigh can bring winter to the desert. (This item is color-customizable to Base, Trim, and Accessory.)

name: Mystical FrostBlood Titan
description: The FrostBlood gave themselves to the north, allowing their hearts to be frozen, and ice to spread through their veins. A mere sigh can bring winter to the desert. (This item is color-customizable to Base, Trim, and Accessory.)

name: Mystical Holiday Jester (0 AC)
description: (Item is color-custom to Base, CC, Trim, and Eye)

name: Mystical Holiday Jester (AC)
description: (Item is color-custom to Base, CC, Trim, and Eye)

name: Mystical HydraSlayer Plate
description: This armor was crafted from the remains of a fallen HydraSlayer found on the shores of Mobius Lake. (Item is CC)

name: Mystical Ice Acolyte
description: Ice Acolytes worship the elemental avatar of Ice. They know their deity is the … COOLEST!

name: Mystical SoulWeaver Prime
description: To become a SoulWeaver you must bond with an Elemental Spirit partner. Together, using the Spirit Looms you have forged, you may weave wonderful cloth that cannot be destroyed. (Animated Gauntlets)

name: Mystical Underworld Sorceress (0 AC)
description: Covens of Witches convene under the moon of Walpurgisnacht to summon the daemons of the Underworld. Through their fell arcane arts, the Legion is brought to the realm of the living in new, fearsome forms. (Female art only)

name: Mystical Underworld Sorceress (AC)
description: Covens of Witches convene under the moon of Walpurgisnacht to summon the daemons of the Underworld. Through their fell arcane arts, the Legion is brought to the realm of the living in new, fearsome forms. (Female art only)

name: Mystical Villager
description: You are looking nice. Where are you headed? To a village? That's THE perfect look for you!

name: Mystical Void of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Mortals of strict discipline and focused minds are asked to meditate in the hostile depths of the Fiend's Void. Their bodies dissolve in an excruciatingly painful process, but what emerges is a cosmic body of near-limitless strength.

name: Mystical Void of Nulgath (AC)
description: Mortals of strict discipline and focused minds are asked to meditate in the hostile depths of the Fiend's Void. Their bodies dissolve in an excruciatingly painful process, but what emerges is a cosmic body of near-limitless strength.

name: Mystical Warrior
description: Harnessing the power of magic and might, this magical warriors command the field and destroy enemies!

name: Mystical Yokai Warrior
description: To become the warrior you were truly meant to be, you must tap into otherworldly forces. Only then will you be able to unlock the power you need to achieve greatness!

name: Mystraven
description: Flying under the radar, the members of the Mystraven House are much like the assassins in the Lore of MechQuest's timeline. Though immature at times, the house either to goes with the flow or uses stealth tactics to reach their goal learn what is behind the Mystraven door.

name: Mystraven Shirt
description: Are you a fan of Mystraven? Wear this shirt with pride and represent your favorite house!

name: Mythic DragonMaster (Armor)
description: Dragon BattleMage's are sorcerers with the capability of manipulating the very forces of mana itself, granting them a deeper sensitivity to the Para-Elemental Plane that most magic users are.

name: Mythic Elemental Guardian
description: Complete mastery over the Elements, fused together in harmonic order and evolving through chaos. You've become a world of your own.

name: Na'al Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: The Lord of the Scarred Barrens was the first Champion of the Infernal Arena. In the sea, where life is rare and salt is abundant, monsters like Naal and his pact bearers thrive.

name: Na'al Naval Commander (AC)
description: The Lord of the Scarred Barrens was the first Champion of the Infernal Arena. In the sea, where life is rare and salt is abundant, monsters like Naal and his pact bearers thrive.

name: Nagami Armor
description: You've slain the mythical sea monster, your prize is his own incarnation.

name: Nagavanshi Kimono
description: Naga claiming to be descendants of Orochi swore loyalty to the descendent of the Jade Serpent. Though their origins are questionable, the ferocity in which they protect the royal family is unquestionable.

name: Nakhiir Armor
description: This spawn of a curse void has roamed the lowest caverns of Lore for thousands of years but rarely have they been seen.

name: Nameless Warrior
description: The Nameless shall rule the world. They are your friends, your neighbors. Your brother and son.

name: Narakan Fiend
description: Having risen from the deepest dethos of the Underworld, the Narakan Fiend has allied with Nulgath to destroy the Undead Legion.

name: NarwhalSlayer Admiral (0 AC)
description: Lurking in seas where 'whales' grow horns as sharp as blades, kingdoms trust the bravest of seafarers to keep those unknowable monsters from spreading the sea.

name: NarwhalSlayer Admiral (AC)
description: Lurking in seas where 'whales' grow horns as sharp as blades, Kingdoms trust the bravaest of seafarers to keep those unknowable monsters from spreading the sea.

name: Nascent ChronoWeaver
description: The Eternal Hero was destined to create and destroy in an endless cycle.

name: Nation Advocatus
description: The ArchFiend entrusts the Nation's most destructive magic to his inner circle. Those given the title Advocatus harness the power of Void, able to instigate the inescapable Event Horizon of the Fiend God's Feast.

name: Nation Arachnomancer
description: These Arachnomancers the most fearsome cannibals in Nulgath's Nation. Their venom, unbridled violence, and the hunters' own fear of arachnids are enough to turn them into the hunted.

name: Nation Bounty Hunter
description: Fiends are destruction incarnate, and because of this nature, they lack purpose. The Archfiend's will and ambitions were what led him to rise beyond mindless carnage. This armor is reminiscent of his mortal beginnings and rise.

name: Nation Caster (Armor)
description: The arcane practices of the Nation are impossible to master in one lifetime. The Ritualists circumvent this obstacle by engraving spells into their very being. They exchange individuality for magnificent power.

name: Nation Healer
description: Someone has to be the healer. The Nation's Fiends are petty, looking down on dainty clerics no matter who they are. They'll come to regret it when their guts have splattered on the ceiling. That's when the Nation's Healers tell them to beg.

name: Nation Jolly Roger (0 AC)
description: Nulgath says "I have troops above ground, I have troops underground, i have troops underwater… and now I have troops ON the water! I am UNSTOPPABLE! Muahahaahaha!"

name: Nation Jolly Roger (AC)
description: Nulgath says "I have troops above ground, I have troops underground, i have troops underwater… and now I have troops ON the water! I am UNSTOPPABLE! Muahahaahaha!"

name: Nation Lancer Phalanx (0 AC)
description: There is an unspoken need for defense and a steady hand. The Phalanx is a full platoon in one, with enough experience to reign in the reckless and foolish of the newer recruits.

name: Nation Lancer Phalanx (AC)
description: There is an unspoken need for defense and a steady hand. The Phalanx is a full platoon in one, with enough experience to reign in the reckless and foolish of the newer recruits.

name: Nation Rogue
description: A simple knife is all this Rogue needs to fulfil their end of the contract. After that, they stay with the Nation for the perks. There's a lot of blood out there, and it's easier to hunt when you're a Fiend.

name: Nation's Draconic Soldier (0 AC)
description: Adorned in the visage of the Abyss, they only bow to the Great Fiend himself. Their existence mocks the pride of Lore's lowly dragons.

description: Adorned in the visage of the Abyss, they only bow to the Great Fiend himself. Their existence mocks the pride of Lore's lowly dragons.

description: Adorned in the visage of the Abyss, they only bow to the Great Fiend himself. Their existence mocks the pride of Lore's lowly dragons.

name: Nation Slugfit Fiend (0 AC)
description: The remains of the monster Slugfit were dipped into the Fiend's Void, and mutated until creatures crawled out of the abyss. Their chaotic nature makes them difficult to control, but the potential for this vile combination is…

name: Nation Slugfit Fiend (AC)
description: The remains of the monster Slugfit were dipped into the Fiend's Void, and mutated until creatures crawled out of the abyss. Their chaotic nature makes them difficult to control, but the potential for this vile combination is…

name: Nation Soulstealer
description: Soulstealer's with affinity to the Nulgath Nation can weave more than just souls. They can bend them into raw thread, eradicating the soul's existence entirely and fueling their black hearts.

name: Nation Thaumaturge
description: A member of the Nation that gave up their soul to become a Mage, Alchemist, and Soothsayer rolled into one. They mutate everything around them, not unlike the Fiend's Void.

name: Nation Vampire (0 AC)
description: Dage the Evil transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. But during the first War for the Underworld, a cadre of them fell under the ArchFiend's power, and defected to his side.

name: Nation Vampire (AC)
description: Dage the Evil transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. But during the first War for the Underworld, a cadre of them fell under the ArchFiend's power, and defected to his side.

name: Nation Varsity Uniform
description: Rah rah rah! #Team Fiend Nation! (Requires Rank 10 Evil)

name: Nation Warrior
description: The blood in the Nation's veins, keeping it alive and raging. Each Nation Warrior aspires to grow and break through their mortal limits, becoming greater Fiends themselves.

name: Native Turkey Hunter
description: You are a hunter by nature. And of nature. Hunt the elusive turkey and bring pride—and a feast! —to your family.

name: Native Warrior
description: Give thanks this Harvest season by going back to your Native roots! (color custom: accessory and trim)

name: Natural Druid (AC)
description: Take the form of a Greenguard Druid and help the Elk Clan fight the invading void forces!

name: Natural Druid (Legend)
description: Take the form of a Greenguard Druid and help the Elk Clan fight the invading void forces!

name: Naturalist Mage
description: Druids beseech the earth for their power. Those silly fools. The earth only responds to someone who is powerful enough to take control, instead of asking for it.

name: Nautican Knight
description: *No description*

name: Naval Commander (Armor)
description: The highest ranking captain of all. Take control of the helm.

name: Naval Commander Noxus (0 AC)
description: Noxus grabbed the skeleton of a broad-shouldered pirate captain, and knocked its skull off to take it for himself. He'll make himself a naval army of Undead minions…after he figures out a way around their inability to swim.

name: Naval Commander Noxus (AC)
description: Noxus grabbed the skeleton of a broad-shouldered pirate captain, and knocked its skull off to take it for himself. He'll make himself a naval army of Undead minions…after he figures out a way around their inability to swim.

name: Naval Commander of Conquest (0 AC)
description: Conquest and control of the seas is a feat no Kingdom of Man has ever truly achieved. On a seaborne steed, the Horseman of Conquest tests those who dare brave nature, and sinks them into a worthy, watery grave.

name: Naval Commander of Conquest (AC)
description: Conquest and control of the seas is a feat no Kingdom of Man has ever truly achieved. On a seaborne steed, the Horseman of Conquest tests those who dare brave nature, and sinks them into a worthy, watery grave.

name: Naval Commander of Death (0 AC)
description: Death, a sailor's closest companion on the open seas. When he dons this garb, his steed becomes the ocean itself. The planet will run out of lives before the sea runs out of space.

name: Naval Commander of Death (AC)
description: Death, a sailor's closest companion on the open seas. When he dons this garb, his steed becomes the ocean itself. The planet will run out of lives before the sea runs out of space.

name: Naval Commander of Famine (0 AC)
description: The seas are an endless bounty of wealth and food, but the people still starve. The Horseman of Famine adores both outlaw pirates and noble admirals. They take and take, making Famine known across every horizon. (Click to change form)

name: Naval Commander of Famine (AC)
description: The seas are an endless bounty of wealth and food, but the people still starve. The Horseman of Famine adores both outlaw pirates and noble admirals. They take and take, making Famine known across every horizon. (Click to change form)

name: Naval Commander of War (0 AC)
description: Wars waged on the open seas inspire a special kind of savagery. When the waters turn red, and beasts come to feed, everyone changes into a monster. The Horseman of War laughs, riding on a steed of shrapnel and obsession.

name: Naval Commander Of War (AC)
description: Wars waged on the open seas inspire a special kind of savagery. When the waters turn red, and beasts come to feed, everyone changes into a monster. The Horseman of War laughs, riding on a steed of shrapnel and obssesion.

name: Naval Commander Scarletta (0 AC)
description: Sirens and Nereids beware. Scarletta has taken to the seas to turn them into her personal mirrors. Her power and beauty will be known from coast to coast. (Eyes not CC)

name: Naval Commander Scarletta (AC)
description: Sirens and Nereids beware. Scarletta has taken to the seas to turn them into her personal mirrors. Her power and beauty will be known from coast to coast. (Eyes not CC)

name: Naval Cow-mander
description: It looks like these Naval Commanders got all-new duds… made of chickencow leather?! OH DAIRY! O_o

name: Naval Guard
description: YARRR! It's more fun to be a pirate than to join th' navy… but ye'll be more successful at inflitratin' other crews if'n they think ye're a legit Naval Guard.

name: Naval Navigator (0 AC)
description: A simple navigator who lost their soul to an uneasing urge to spread and take. There's nothing left of them, save for the unknowable spirits who inherited their corpse.

name: Naval Navigator (AC)
description: A simple navigator who lost their soul to an uneasing urge to spread and take. There's nothing left of them, save for the unknowable spirits who inherited their corpse.

name: Naval Reaper (Armor)
description: Avast! The seven seas need plunderin' and set sail from Lolosia and fight the mighty kraken while searchin' for treasure!

name: Navel Commander
description: I told them that shirts that show off your navel could be hot… I think they misunderstood.

name: Nax's Robes
description: These are the enchanted, frost-resistant robes worn by the very sane cryomancer himself.

name: Nebula Dragonslayer (0 AC)
description: Dragons will one day take to the stars. Be one step ahead of the enemy. Click hand for an effect.

name: Nebula Dragonslayer (AC)
description: Dragons will one day take to the stars. Be one step ahead of the enemy. Click hand for an effect.

name: Nebula Dragonslayer (Legend)
description: Dragons will one day take to the stars. Be one step ahead of the enemy. Click hand for an effect.

name: Nebula Paladin
description: To punfinity… and BEYOND!

name: Necho Tech V2
description: Necho Tech gear is a fusion of paladinum and Zorba's patented VantaBak metallic coating. It is strong enough to withstand any force… or fourth.

name: NechoTech
description: The nanotechnology that flourish on the fabric causes improved dexterity and heightened awareness of an object's trajectory. Once the suit is equipped, these enhanced abilities transfer over to you.

name: NechoTech V2
description: Necho Tech gear is a fusion of paladinum and Zorba's patented VantaBak metallic coating. It is strong enough to withstand any force… or fourth.

name: Nechronomancer Armor
description: Time and death, two things a dragon thought it would never fear.

name: Necrayaya Armor
description: Celebrate Cinco de Mayo! When the band is made up of undead mariachi musicians, the /party will NEVER stop!

name: Necro Battlemage
description: Not quite a lich but that doesn't mean you won't jump at the chance to command an army of undead.

name: Necro Deadfly
description: Deadfly is always creepin' around the Underworld. When will he figure out that just changing his colors won't fool anyone?

name: Necro Paragon (0 AC)
description: Are you ready to fulfill your destiny and join Dage in the fight for souls and the glory of the Underworld? It's not like you have a choice though.

name: Necro Paragon (AC)
description: Are you ready to fulfill your destiny and join Dage in the fight for souls and the glory of the Underworld? It's not like you have a choice though.

name: Necro Snake Armor
description: Legs are overrated.

name: Necro U Cheerleader
description: Necro U! Necro U! This is what you need to do! Raise your minions HIGH! Drop your minions LOW! Doom them, Doom them, GO GO GO!

name: Necro University Sorcerer
description: Do not ask what this Necro University Sorcerer had to do to get to head of the class…. O_O (Item is color-customizable.)

name: Necrobard
description: Music echoes through the crypts. Though the songs of the Necrobard seep into the souls of the dead, the decadent living are entranced by their forbidden music. Many find themselves with rich and disgustingly powerful patrons.

name: Necrodrone Mage
description: These mages have undergone very specific modifications. I wonder what it does to their powers…

name: Necrodrone Rogue
description: These Rogues have undergone very specific modifications. I wonder if it makes them any sneakier?

name: Necrodrone Trooper
description: These Troopers have undergone very specific modifications. I wonder if they are stronger?

name: Necrolock
description: Terrify your foes, but try not to scare your own pet too much with this dark and sinister armor.

name: NecROMANCE (Armor)
description: Love is never dead with a NecROMANCEr around.

name: Necromancer Armor
description: Embrace the Darkness that lies within you. Channel it to control the Undead that surround you. The darkest Power can be yours!

name: Necromancer Emperor
description: The Necromancer Emperor is a term used to describe an adept of the order. Emperor's usually hold positions of power and leadership in these cults.

name: Necromancer Fiend (AC)
description: When Nulgath takes souls the bodies are left to the Necromancer Fiends. Just what they do with the bodies remains a mystery.

name: Necromancer Fiend (Legend)
description: When Nulgath takes souls the bodies are left to the Necromancer Fiends. Just what they do with the bodies remains a mystery.

name: Necromancer Rising
description: The murmur of low chanting fills the air, the ground begins to breakaway. Undead crawl from their tombs ready to bow before their master. This is the power of the Necromancer!

name: Necronaut (Armor)
description: The armor of a Necronaut is the only thing that protects them from the ravages of being alive in the afterlife… it does its job. Sometimes.

name: Necronus Redeemer
description: In space, no one can hear you scream. That is because death has already parted those who had descended upon Planet Necronus and assimilated into its infamous team of bounty hunters.

name: Necronyancer
description: Just nine lives? That would neowver be enough! Raise your feline brethren and show the foolish humans who the real pets are!

name: NecroStorm Lich (Armor)
description: Channeling elemental energy siphoned from the storms that tear through the peaks of Thunderfang Spire, the Lightning Necromancers that rule there terrify all who oppose them. Their threat? Unleashing the NecroStorm!

name: NecroTech Knight (Armor)
description: Using Shadowscythe technology, defeated allies are converted into mindless undead cyborgs. Defiance is futile; supremacy is inevitable. (Shadow series gen 1)

name: NecroTech Warrior
description: Using Shadowscythe technology, defeated allies are converted into mindless undead cyborgs. Defiance is futile; supremacy is inevitable. (Shadow series gen 1)

name: Necrotic Caster
description: Rising from the depths of graveyards, these unholy caster's help their Lich masters with ceremonies of the dead and decaying.

name: Necrotic Chronomancer Armor
description: Time and death, two things a dragon thought it would never fear.

name: Necrotic Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: So this is what a Grim Naval Commander looks like before they become undead…

name: Necrotic Naval Commander (AC)
description: So this is what a Grim Naval Commander looks like before they become undead…

name: Necrotic Pirate Commander (Armor)
description: Unlife is cruel. But sail with a good crew and yer afterlife will be richer than your mortal life ever was!

name: Necrotic ShadowFlame Warrior
description: The ShadowFlame is known to consume all who are willing to give their lives for it. Are you bold enough to join in their ranks?

name: Necrotized Warrior
description: Embrace death and channel it to dominate your challengers and increase your battle prowess!

name: NecroVoid Lich
description: The Void disguises itself with the remains of the dead. All life came from nothing, and it will return to nothing. If you plunge into an endless fall, the cycle of life and death will never find you again.

name: Nega Anubyx Warrior
description: In the darkness of night within Sekt's domain, the only light illuminated within the pitch black corridors is a white canine spirit, posing as a savior when it is actually baiting trespassers to certain doom. Looks can, indeed, be deceptive.

name: Nega Mummy (Armor)
description: Your expertise in geometry won't be under wraps when inside the fourth dimension. Instead of hunger for brains, you'll be hungry for shapes.

name: Nekomancer (Armor)
description: A finicky feline nekomancer is the purrrrrrfect mage, well unless you're a mouse.

name: Nekoyasha Robe
description: What a puuurrrrrfect outfit!

name: Neo Necromantress
description: TEE HEE! I *HEART* UNDEAD PEOPLE.

name: NeoBattleon Runner
description: In Battleon's distant future, the face of war and strife have changed. Metal and tech have drilled into both its soil and its people.

name: NeoChaos DoomKnight
description: Individually, the powers of Doom and Chaos could shake the foundations of our world. Combined into one ultra-powerful Hero… we could destroy it entirely!

name: NeoFiend of Revontheus
description: Technology is constantly evolving. Revontheus sent these beings of the future to anhilate legionaires and terminate Dage the Evil himself.

name: Neon Blue Shadow
description: You'll be the hottest thing at any New Year's celebration!

name: Neon Red Shadow
description: You'll be the hottest thing at any New Year's celebration!

name: Neon Sage of Revontheus (0 AC)
description: Worn by the Sage of Revontheus, these robes act as a boarding pass into the Underworld.

name: Neon Sage of Revontheus (AC)
description: Worn by the Sage of Revontheus, these robes act as a boarding pass into the Underworld.

name: Neon Spectrum Shadow
description: You'll be the hottest thing at any New Year's celebration!

name: Neon Yellow Shadow
description: You'll be the hottest thing at any New Year's celebration!

name: NeOni CyberSuit (0 AC)
description: It is in an Oni's nature to pillage, kill, and eat humans. This is their past, and will be their future. As terrifying as they are, they've found like-minded people to tear through the neon streets with. The city best be prepared.

name: NeOni CyberSuit (AC)
description: It is in an Oni's nature to pillage, kill, and eat humans. This is their past, and will be their future. As terrifying as they are, they've found like-minded people to tear through the neon streets with. The city best be prepared.

description: It is in an Oni's nature to pillage, kill, and eat humans. This is their past, and will be their future. As terrifying as they are, they've found like-minded people to tear through the neon streets with. The city best be prepared.
