name: NeoReaper Armor
description: Neoreaper13 has crafted this color-customizable set for you in honor of your victories across Lore!

name: Nerdly Royalty
description: Wear the armor of Zach Storch to show your support for him as he competes to become King of the Nerds!

name: Nethermage (Armor)
description: The question isn't how to become a Nethermage, it's at what cost is your soul worth in the long run.

name: Netherworld Comedian
description: The Nether's least favorite surprise celebrity guest. Even thinking about their name too much invites their grody jokes in.

name: Nevanna Armor
description: She who defends Brightoak should take caution, lest she becomes the very general that will destroy it.

name: Neverborn Necromancer
description: Darkness based necromancy is the pinnacle of the art. The Neverborn Necromancer has mastered a cruel and terrifying specialty. They're studies enabled to raise undead from souls in limbo, those that have yet to experience life.

name: Neverland Attire
description: Remember not to travel too far away from home or you'll end up in Neverland.

name: NeverMore
description: When the moon is high and the children have all gone to be on Mogloween Eve, the NeverMore swoop down on black wings and walk the earth searching for mourning hearts.

name: NEVERomancer
description: Death cannot stop our true love. All it can do is delay it for a while.

name: New Minion Armor
description: You need guts to serve the Shadow Lich Lord, thankfully yours are showing.

name: Newbatron Prime (Armor)
description: Though it easily jams and goes stiff, that's what gives it character! It's reminiscent of early engineering, and most look back on that time fondly.

name: Newbie Armor
description: You look confused…

name: NibbleOn Guardian
description: You've been given the task to defend NibbleOn!

name: Night Hunter
description: Feel honored, you have proven yourself to be one of the elite Night Hunter. The hunters were created though samples of the Shadowslayer from the Lore in Adventure Quest.

name: Night Masquerade
description: After the hunt, it's traditional to celebrate with a masquerade ball.

name: Nightborn Drak
description: Creatures of the night are no like you and I. Those from the Rift are even more alien. Beware… oh, beware!

name: Nightborn RiftBreaker
description: Heroes dedicated to protecting Lore from the monsters spewing out of the rift don this armor to blend in with the monsters in order to strike down any leader like monsters in an attempt to break the chain of command.

name: Nightelf Shadowstalker
description: Some northern elves don't bundle up before traveling to the Northlands. All they need to do is blend in with the enormous ice and snow.

name: Nightelf Snowstalker (Armor)
description: Some northern elves don't bundle up before traveling to the Northlands. All they need to do is blend in with the enormous ice and snow.

name: Nightfall of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Born from mutation and destiny, this new breed of Fiend is the second generation of Nulgath's Nation bearing the same feathers as Revontheus. The children of his loyalists are hybrids without limits, but the only way they can achieve greater heights is by slaying their predecessors.

name: Nightfall of Nulgath (AC)
description: Born from mutation and destiny, this new breed of Fiend is the second generation of Nulgath's Nation bearing the same feathers as Revontheus. The children of his loyalists are hybrids without limits, but the only way they can achieve greater heights is by slaying their predecessors.

name: NightFrost Elf
description: Elves are some of the most resourceful beings in Lore. Even the colds of the Northlands cannot keep these skilled warriors away.

name: Nightmare Carnax Devotee
description: Carnax, a beast that is nearly immortal, has appeared in the Nightmare Queen’s realm. It retains its power to dominate all life but is now even MORE monstrous than before.

name: Nightmare Carnax Disciple
description: Carnax, a beast that is nearly immortal, has appeared in the Nightmare Queen’s realm. It retains its power to dominate all life but is now even MORE monstrous than before.

name: Nightmare ClawSuit
description: Festive Frostvale 2016! These giftboxes will open on January 1st, 2017 to reveal your EPIC Frostval set!

name: Nightmare Fiend (0 AC)
description: There are those gifted with the power to walk through dreams. The Nation coverts these individuals, seeking them out from contracts. The Fiend's Void can transform them into a special breed of monster.

name: Nightmare Fiend (AC)
description: There are those gifted with the power to walk through dreams. The Nation coverts these individuals, seeking them out from contracts. The Fiend's Void can transform them into a special breed of monster.

name: Nightmare Hula
description: What better way to crash a freaky tiki party then in your own skull adorned hula skirt!

name: Nightmare Hunter
description: Your most spine-chilling fear-inducing nightmare have enveloped your reality! Storm onto the battlefield as the Nightmare Hunter as you leave your enemies wondering if this is only a bad dream or a terrible circumstance…

name: Nightmare Plate
description: One of the most nightmarish armors available, this plate armor exists only to bring retribution to your foes.

name: Nightmare Pumpkin Knight
description: Harvest time is when the best gourds are found… and sometimes you can wear them!

name: Nightmare Pumpkin Lord
description: Harvest time is when the best gourds are found… and sometimes you can wear them!

name: Nightmare Queen (Armor)
description: The Nightmare Queen rules the land of Horror, where thoughts beget matter and dreams become a reality.

name: Nightmares of Malice
description: One sight of you with this armor equipped and your enemies will NEVER sleep peacefully again. Mission accomplished.

name: Nightshade Bounty Hunter
description: Fear the night. Hunt the light. Make them scream in Fright!

name: Nightshade Thorn Assasasin
description: Nightshade, the poison of the belladonna wreathed in thorns. Assassins known as Nightshade have seen the last breaths of many a Lord. For a time, this name served the interests of the elven folk, until it lost its master. It awaits another to take up its barbs.

name: Nightstalker
description: Stalk the night to rule the light! Those who never know you're near will still be made to run in fear.

name: NightStalker's Guise
description: Stalking the shadows of the Black Labyrinth, the NightStalker is one of the terrors that waits to prey on those foolish enough to believe they can come out alive.

name: Nightwatch Samurai (AC)
description: Samurai are those who serve in close attendance to the nobility.

name: Nightwatch Samurai (Legend)
description: Samurai are those who serve in close attendance to the nobility.

name: Nightwyvern (Armor)
description: This armor has all sorts of clever little compartments. And the utility belt! OH the utility belt!

name: Ninja Armor
description: Ninjas are masters of stealth and the deadly arts!

name: Ninja Disciple Armor
description: Favored by fans of the Shadow of the Wind Village rock group, BloodMetal Ninjas!

name: Ninja Warrior Armor
description: A true Ninja Warrior knows that you only fail when you stop trying.

name: NO BOTS Armor
description: Take a stand against botting - show the world of Lore that you believe in playing the right way!

name: No Hollowborn Class
description: Being Hollowborn means pursuing your own goals without hesitation. The Shadow Fiend isn't going to hold your hand. You're going to have to figure this out on your own.

name: Noble Anubian Overseer
description: The Anubian Overseers were once mortals who loyally served a worthy Pharaoh in life. In death, they took on a noble form, and accompany the Guardians of the Sandseas should they be called upon again.

name: Noble Arcanist
description: The halls of Swordhaven whisper with the remnants of the spells you weave.

name: Noble Courtier
description: Frilly clothes, shiny shoes, condescending smile… Yep, you're nobility, alright. You were made to wield a silver tongue, but no one says you can't be just as adept at wielding a blade.

name: Noble Falconer
description: A popular sport amongst Swordhaven's nobility, these skilled hunters bring down their prey with trained falcons.

name: Noble Garb
description: Welcome to the 1%! First order of business: gather all of you're money in a single swimming pool and dive in. Proceed to bemoan how lazy poor people are. You are now truly a noble.

name: Noble Hollowborn DragonKnight
description: The soul of the Hollowborn DragonKnight manifests as noble wings, as well as a glow in the darkness of their eyes. Perhaps the Shadow Fiend took them before they could reincarnate as a true Dragon.

name: Noble Hollowborn Dragonlord
description: The soul of the Hollowborn DragonLord manifests as noble wings as well as a glow in the darkness of their eyes. Perhaps the Shadow Fiend took them before they could reincarnate as a true Dragon.

name: Noble Leo Scion
description: Lions are an admired symbol of nobility, courage, and valour. Few can live up to what it represents, and fewer can stomach how much blood the lion needs to roar.

name: Noble Leprechaun
description: Ye may not be a true Leprechaun there, lads and lassies but ye still be lucky today!

name: Noble Mage Armor
description: Magic courses through your veins. Your arcane powers enable you to cast powerful spells.

name: Noble Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: A seafarer with blood as blue as the sea. The Noble Naval Commander sails and conquers in the name of a crown, which is the only thing that separates them from pirates.

name: Noble Naval Commander (AC)
description: A seafarer with blood as blue as the sea. The Noble Naval Commander sails and conquers in the name of a crown, which is the only thing that separates them from pirates.

name: Noble of Radiance
description: The Angel on your shoulder takes over. A righteous heart will shine bright, becoming a beacon to guide the lost. So, you'll let them take over, right? The choice comes with some pretty clothes!

name: Noble of Ruin
description: The Devil on your shoulder takes over. You deserve the world, so why not take it? Are you on the fence because that'd be mean? Don't be nervous. Being your worst self is a lot of fun!

name: Noble Shadowscythe Visionary
description: Following the dissolution of the Alliance, a number of Swordhaven's Knights forsook their vows. With their true nature revealed, these Visionaries have gone on to become some of the Shadowscythe’s greatest warriors.

name: Noble Sterling Dragonlord
description: A Dragonlord of noble spirit who just recieved their wings. Under the tutelege of great heroes and wise teachers, they and their Dragon fight to protect the innocent.

name: Noble Swordhaven Pendragon
description: The epitome of nobility and chivalry, the Swordhaven Pendragons are the perfect image of a pure knight. Upholding their ideals isn't easy. It requires complete dedication, and the sacrifice of all selfish wishes.

name: Noble Vampire Emissary
description: The trust and respect of an ancient Vampire clan is priceless. Your eternal loyalty, gratitude, and service to them is the price.

name: Noble Wedding Garb
description: Congratz, Alina and Rolith! No potion mix could have made these two fall more in love with each other!

name: NobleHeart Mage
description: Don't need mana. Don't need fame. Don't need a pyromancer's burning flame. You're strong and you're loving, not cruel anytime. You'll always save a life. That's the power of LOVE!

name: Nocturan Acolyte
description: After the dusk settles, there are those who come out at night only to cause terror. the Nocturan will be there to protect and serve.

name: Nocturan Adept
description: After the dusk settles, there are those who come out at night only to cause terror. The Nocturan will be there to protect and serve.

name: Noel Maurader (0 AC)
description: Swathed in heavy armor and festive fur, you're ready to thrown down for that last mug of moglinberry juice.

name: Noel Maurader (AC)
description: Swathed in heavy armor and festive fur, you're ready to thrown down for that last mug of moglinberry juice.

name: Noel Maurader (Legend)
description: Swathed in heavy armor and festive fur, you're ready to thrown down for that last mug of moglinberry juice.

name: Non-GMO BrutalCorn (Armor)
description: The normal natural non-modified yet still terrifying version.

name: North Lights Juvania (0 AC)
description: The aurora of the North radiates with magic that affects the mind and body. Juvania traveled in these robes to reach out to those lights, attempting to harness that power to help others.

name: North Lights Juvania (AC)
description: The aurora of the North radiates with magic that affects the mind and body. Juvania traveled in these robes to reach out to those lights, attempting to harness that power to help others.

name: Northern Aura
description: New Year's Eve moves towards New Year's Day as night moves towards day. For those who cannot decide if they like the colors of twilight or dawn better.(click to transform between looks)

name: Northern Aurora (AC)
description: New Year's Eve moves towards New Year's Day as night moves towards day. It is inevitable, but the colors of dawn make for wonderful party gear!

name: Northern Aurora (Legend)
description: New Year's Eve moves towards New Year's Day as night moves towards day. It is inevitable, but the colors of dawn make for wonderful party gear!

name: Northern BoneBreaker Barbarian
description: The skulls these Barbarians wear on their belts are glorious war trophies. They've come to Battleon seeking even greater challenges. Would they be satisfied with slaying the Undead, or will the skulls of great Heroes join their collections?

name: Northern Lights Wanderer
description: Spin tales of dreams whispered from the night when only the lights of the aurora keeps you company.

name: Northern Twilight (AC)
description: New Year's Eve moves towards New Year's Day as night moves towards day. It is inevitable, but the colors of twilight make for wonderful party gear!

name: Northern Twilight (Legend)
description: New Year's Eve moves towards New Year's Day as night moves towards day. It is inevitable, but the colors of twilight make for wonderful party gear!

name: Northern Wanderer (AC)
description: Cold? Bah! Who's cold with all this armor on? You think you have the guts to wander the Northlands? Well bring on the cold!

name: Northern Wanderer (Special)
description: Cold? Bah! Who's cold with all this armor on? You think you have the guts to wander the Northlands? Well bring on the cold!

name: Northern Warlord
description: A legendary warlord of steel and iron. They served no crown or throne. Their loyalty laid with the thrill of battle. A warrior like that can't have been human, or stayed human after lifetimes of bloodshed.

name: Northland Seas Raider (0 AC)
description: Only the most bloodthirsty and brutal raiders of Lore's seas dare breach the Northlands' frigid waters. It isn't gold they're after. The wonders of the north will eat your heart raw, but dragging them back alive will turn your crew into legends.

name: Northland Seas Raider (AC)
description: Only the most bloodthirsty and brutal raiders of Lore's seas dare breach the Northlands' frigid waters. It isn't gold they're after. The wonders of the north will eat your heart raw, but dragging them back alive will turn your crew into legends.

name: Northland Slasher
description: All the debonair rogue slasher's still have to look good.

name: Northlands BeastHunter
description: Northlands BeastHunters are rarely seen in town; they are too focused on the vital task of patrolling the snowy plains and valleys. Ever watchful, they defend their homes and people.

name: Northlands Defender
description: A breed of crystalline ice elemental golems that oftentimes keep to themselves, but anytime rising temperatures threaten the Northlands, they band together to keep their region's temperatures freezing but refreshing.

name: Northlands Dire Wolf Warden
description: By facing the spirits of the Northlands' long lost beasts, warriors earn the right to wear their pelts. The souls of both hunters fuse, creating a perfect warrior of the unforgiving tundras.

name: Northlands Dragonsworn
description: Those who call themselves Dragonsworn promised to defend Dragons with their lives. The Northlands buried blood under mountains of snow, but these defenders will never forget.

name: Northlands FrostBlood Titan
description: The FrostBlood gave themselves to the north, allowing their hearts to be frozen, and ice to spread through their veins. A mere sigh can bring winter to the desert.

name: Northlands Giftbox Armor 2017
description: Tinsel says "Happy Frostval, Hero!" Keep cosmically fancy in a gorgeous nebula wrapped giftbox this holiday season! (Does NOT transform)

name: Northlands Guardian
description: The defenders of presents and present-givers everywhere, the Northlands Guardian gear is yours to protect… and wear!

name: Northlands Holiday Hoodie
description: Shipped straight from an all inclusive Northlands resort - the cozy Snowview Inn! Enjoy sled races, skiing, and holiday feasting in warm and festive gear!

name: Northlands LightCaster
description: Pursuing the auroras of the north, these LightCasters risk their lives to save those lost in the cold dark. They are a beacon in the frozen wastes, and a lure to those that would prey on the pure.

name: Northlands Monk Armor (0 AC)
description: Deep in the frozen mountains of the Northlands live a sect of Monks who derive all their power from the ice around them.

name: Northlands Monk Armor (AC)
description: Deep in the frozen mountains of the Northlands live a sect of Monks who derive all their power from the ice around them.

name: Northlands Monk (Armor) (Merge)
description: Deep in the frozen mountains of the Northlands live a sect of Monks who derive all their power from the ice around them.

name: Northlands Necromancer (0 AC)
description: The Northlands are littered with frozen bones, just waiting for an ambitious necromancer to come along and make use of them.

name: Northlands Necromancer (AC)
description: The Northlands are littered with frozen bones, just waiting for an ambitious necromancer to come along and make use of them.

name: Northlands Paladin
description: Battling undead through the frozen wastes, you draw strength from the otherworldly, shimmering light of the aurora borealis.

name: Northlands Ranger
description: The Northlands Ranger travel the frozen wastes in search of Good heroes to reward with silver, gold, and treasure beyond compare… ensuring a most joyful winter season!

name: Northlands SoulWeaver
description: Artisans who weave garments of incredible quality. These Soulweavers made a name for themselves in the Northlands, but locals whisper rumors about them receiving visions from the frozen dead. They aren't wrong…

name: Northlands SpiritHunter
description: That bitter chill you feel is NOT coming from the frigid Northlands wind… it's the icy aura of the invisible spirits surrounding you. Watching… waiting… Will they strike first? Or will you?

name: Northlands Worshipper
description: The elder gods walk the frozen forests of the Northlands. Only their devoted warrior-priests know the ritual to summon them. But once they do… BEWARE!

name: Northpointe BrightRogue
description: Northpointe Rogues must choose between Light and Dark. The Bright Rogues rely on stealth to get the job done.

name: Northpointe Guardmage
description: Northpointe Magi must choose between the Light and the Dark. Both must work together. As a Guard Mage keeping the Light from doom is your goal.

name: Northpointe Shadowmage
description: Northpointe Magi must choose between the Light and the Dark. Both must work together. As a Shadow Mage sometimes to keep from failure you must walk in Darkness.

name: Northpointe ShadowRogue
description: Northpointe Rogues must choose between Light and Dark. The Shadow Rogues stay to the shade, keeping guard from afar.

name: NOT A MOD ARMOR
description: You're not a mod. You don't have any special powers. Sure, you're a pretty good swimmer and you whistle through your nose but it takes more than that to be an AQW Moderator.

name: Not Quite Chaos Shape
description: You need to work on your shapeshifting a little more… but you are so close!

name: Not Quite Dread Shape
description: You need to work on your shapeshifting a little more… but you are so close!

name: Not So Invisible Ninja
description: Might want to work on that Kage jitsu there.

name: NOTruto Garb
description: You're definitely NOT who people might think you could be.

name: Nova Striker
description: Nova Strikers, so named for their craving to kill stars. And they must kill these celestial bodies, or they and their devestating power will fade as quickly as a shooting star. (This item is color customizable to base, accessory, trim.)

name: Novac Sal Pirate
description: "New money" pirates who set sail for gold on a whim. No one knows their flag or their names. It's sink or swim for these scallywags. Salt and chipped steel will toughen them into real pirates, or send them to depths.

name: Novac Sal Privateer
description: "New money" pirates who set sail for gold on a whim. No one knows their flag or their names. It's sink or swim for these scallywags. Salt and chipped steel will toughen them into real pirates, or send them to depths.

name: Noxious Symbiote
description: It's not easy being green. Especially when you're noxious as well. Which is why you're NOT. You're orange. (Gives 20% rep and 10% class points boost when equipped)

name: Noxus Armor
description: Who's the baddest necromancer in all of Lore? NOXUS! You're dannnnnng right.

name: Noxus Psychophant
description: Of Noxus' students, only the most fanatical can be considered Psychophants. They've mastered everything their mentor had to offer, and secretly aim to take everything else he has for themselves.

name: Nugget Man Suit
description: Everyone knows you as the nugget man… or Woman! Avoid honey-mustard attacks at all costs.

name: Nulgath Armor
description: This new form of the Abyss General disturbs you. You know something is amiss. But the new armor also imbues you with new energy…

name: Nulgath (Armor) (AC)
description: The Archfiend is ready to reshape you to be better… stronger… EVILLER! Are you ready?!

name: Nulgath (Armor) (Legend)
description: The Archfiend is ready to reshape you to be better… stronger… EVILLER! Are you ready?!

name: Nulgath Nation Lounger (0 AC)
description: Your contract stipulates that you're entitled to a generous amount of vacation time. For an Archfiend, Nulgath isn't half bad.

name: Nulgath Nation Lounger (AC)
description: Your contract stipulates that you're entitled to a generous amount of vacation time. For an Archfiend, Nulgath isn't half bad.

name: Nulgath Navy
description: These naval soldiers appointed by Nulgath are highly-skilled sea militants who excel in ship raids, recon missions and specifically trained to take down Legionnaires.

name: Nulgath's Fiend of Ozul
description: One of the Archfiend's oldest creations. Time has eroded their mind, and all that remains is bloodthirsty loyalty. Soon, even more of their original mortality will wear away, carving out a perfect living weapon.

name: Nulgath's Fiend of Ralzic
description: One of Nulgath's Nation fiends, more comfortable in the shadows.

name: Nulgath's Paladin of Souls (0 AC)
description: Drawn here from the Oversoul, these Paladins believe they are fighting for the Light, but they are fighting for Nulgath. Who is right?

name: Nulgath's Paladin of Souls (AC)
description: Drawn here from the Oversoul, these Paladins believe they are fighting for the Light, but they are fighting for Nulgath. Who is right?

name: Nulgath's Shielded Paladin of Souls (0 AC)
description: Drawn here from the Oversoul, these Paladins believe they are fighting for the Light, but they are fighting for Nulgath. Who is right?

name: Nulgath's Shielded Paladin of Souls (AC)
description: Drawn here from the Oversoul, these Paladins believe they are fighting for the Light, but they are fighting for Nulgath. Who is right?

name: Nulgath's Void Rider
description: Nulgath voided his check to pay for this bad boy. An Archfiend doesn't buy what he can steal.

name: Nulgathinator 9000
description: You could take the form of any being you want, but why change from this rocking bod?

name: NULLb0rg (0 AC)
description: An armor fashioned in the likeness of the Archfiend, using materials and technology in collaboration with Nation allies. Where the materials came from is privy only to the Archfiend.

name: NULLb0rg (AC)
description: An armor fashioned in the likeness of the Archfend, using materials and technology in collaboration with Nation allies. Where the materials carne from is privy only to the Archfend.

name: Nully Claws (Armor) (AC)
description: He's making a list he's checking it twice, going to find out who's naughty and give them all the presents since this is Nulgath we're talking about.

name: Nully Claws (Armor) (Legend)
description: He's making a list he's checking it twice, going to find out who's naughty and give them all the presents since this is Nulgath we're talking about.

name: NulyClaws Suit
description: Wreck the Halls for Master Nully, FA LOL LOL LOL LOL LOL LOL LOL LOOOOOOL

name: Number 13 - Beacon Hunter
description: The garb of a Beacon Hunter operative. This lightweight armor makes tracking down heads of lettuce through space and time a breeze.

name: Nyi Roro Kidul Regalia
description: The ceremonial attire of the Sea Queen herself, radiating beauty, mystery, and divine authority.

name: O Holly Knight
description: O holly knight, the stats are brightly shining, you are the knight of the dear Frostval spirit.

name: OakHeart Guardian
description: OakHearts are the magical Guardians of the Forest--the esteemed messengers of the Guardian Dragon. Whoever said "his bark is worse than his bite" never met the OakHeart in battle!

name: Oathbreaker Pirate
description: Some of the fiercest and deadliest pirates to sail the straights of Lore. You do not want to fall onto their bad side, those who have took a long walk off a shod plank.

name: Oathkeeper
description: Have you ever wondered what it is that nightmares are made of? Have you ever given thought to the main component of fear? Look into the darkness of Oathkeeper. Now you know.

name: Oblivion Armor
description: Now you, too, can appear as humble as a true servant of Nulgath should.

name: Oblivion of Revontheus
description: Like his master,Nulgath, Revontheus managed to create a being through the powers of eternal darkness…Just remember, when you walk this path of eternal darkness, there is no turning back.

name: Observer Void Brawler of Nulgath
description: A Fiend of brutish strength that seeks impossible challenges and deadly enemies. The runes enscribed into their armor keeps their power restrained. Once released, limbs and muscles will grow out of control, starving for violence.

name: Obsessor Captain
description: The deep dark hides even more dangers. Eventually, they'll spill out like an overfilled goblet of smoke.

name: Obsessor Commander
description: The deep dark hides even more dangers. Eventually, they'll spill out like an overfilled goblet of smoke.

name: Obsidia Necromancer (Armor) (AC)
description: The quarrels of men only fuel your fire. Let their fallen build your empire.

name: Obsidia Necromancer (Armor) (Special)
description: The quarrels of men only fuel your fire. Let their fallen build your empire.

name: Obsidian Aerodux WarMage (0 AC)
description: For you to master the use of Air, one must feel free of any restrictions armor imposes on them. This armor is made of the lightest feathers on Lore. The golden parts are for the little extra protection one needs.

name: Obsidian Aerodux WarMage (AC)
description: For you to master the use of Air, one must feel free of any restrictions armor imposes on them. This armor is made of the lightest feathers on Lore. The golden parts are for the little extra protection one needs.

name: Obsidian Aerodux WarMage (Legend)
description: For you to master the use of Air, one must feel free of any restrictions armor imposes on them. This armor is made of the lightest feathers on Lore. The obsidian parts are for the little extra protection one needs.

name: Obsidian Apocalyptic Warlord (0 AC)
description: First fire reigned from the sky. Then they came. That's when the real terror began.

name: Obsidian Apocalyptic Warlord (AC)
description: First fire reigned from the sky. Then they came. That's when the real terror began.

name: Obsidian ArchPaladin
description: As a warrior in one of the Paladin Order’s highest ranks, you have access to powers the likes of which Lore has not yet seen. Use your newfound abilities to fight for virtue and justice, because darkness will flee at the very sight of your righteous light!

name: Obsidian Assassin
description: Your targets can't see your obsidian form in the dark, but with those 3 glowing eyes you'll definitely see them.

name: Obsidian BladeMaster (AC)
description: Your training is complete! Bring me the head of Nulgath and you will become the true Blade Master!

name: Obsidian BladeMaster (Merge)
description: Your training is complete! Bring me the head of Nulgath and you will become the true Blade Master!

name: Obsidian Celestial Guardian (0 AC)
description: The black and gold regalia of the Obsidian Celestial Guardian is a mark of distinction for its bearer, signaling their supreme skill.

name: Obsidian Celestial Guardian (AC)
description: The black and gold regalia of the Obsidian Celestial Guardian is a mark of distinction for its bearer, signaling their supreme skill.

name: Obsidian Celestial Protector (0 AC)
description: Only the most skilled of the Celestial Realm's Guardians ascend to the ranks of the High Celestial Protectors. It is one of the realm's highest honors.

name: Obsidian Celestial Protector (AC)
description: Only the most skilled of the Celestial Realm's Guardians ascend to the ranks of the High Celestial Protectors. It is one of the realm's highest honors.

name: Obsidian Centaur Lord (0 AC)
description: Centaur warriors have long been some of Lore's fiercest and fastest fighters. With 4 hooves and as many blades as they can carry, they are a force to be reckoned with.

name: Obsidian Centaur Lord (AC)
description: Centaur warriors have long been some of Lore's fiercest and fastest fighters. With 4 hooves and as many blades as they can carry, they are a force to be reckoned with.

name: Obsidian Centurion (0 AC)
description: The Obsidian Centurions are soldiers from a fabled sunken city. This never before seen armor has been in many battles.

name: Obsidian Centurion (AC)
description: The Obsidian Centurions are soldiers from a fabled sunken city. This never before seen armor has been in many battles.

name: Obsidian Cryomancer (0 AC)
description: Unleash the power of dark ice and snow! Freeze your enemies on the spot, making them shiver in fear. Let it go since the cold never bothered you anyways.

name: Obsidian Cryomancer (AC)
description: Unleash the power of dark ice and snow! Freeze your enemies on the spot, making them shiver in fear. Let it go since the cold never bothered you anyways.

name: Obsidian Darkblood of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: A new nation bows to Nulgath… and an army of Darkblood Warriors battle in the name of the Archfiend!

name: Obsidian Darkblood of Nulgath (AC)
description: A new nation bows to Nulgath… and an army of Darkblood Warriors battle in the name of the Archfiend!

name: Obsidian Demon Samurai
description: These samurai lost their souls thousands of years ago to a vengeful Maou who enslaved them for his mazoku army.

name: Obsidian Dragon Knight (0 AC)
description: Battle monsters, break gems, and get ALL the rewards in AQWorlds AND Battle Gems!

name: Obsidian Dragon Knight (AC)
description: Battle monsters, break gems, and get ALL the rewards in AQWorlds AND Battle Gems!

name: Obsidian Dragon Ronin of Oversoul (0 AC)
description: Warriors of the Nation that have settled their contract with the ArchFiend. Now, they roam to cut down greater and greater opponents. Their appetite for battle rivals the Void's.

name: Obsidian Dragon Ronin Of Oversoul (AC)
description: Warriors of the Nation that have settled their contract with the ArchFiend. Now, they roam to cut down greater and greater opponents. Their appetite for battle rivals the Void's.

name: Obsidian Dragon's Plate (0 AC)
description: The noble vesture of a Golden Dragon that has watched history being made since the dawn of time. The future innocently robs us of our past and present, but is filled with endless potential.

name: Obsidian Dragon's Plate (AC)
description: The noble vesture of a Golden Dragon that has watched history being made since the dawn of time. The future innocently robs us of our past and present, but is filled with endless potential.

name: Obsidian DragonSlayer (Armor)
description: Feared by dragons, wyverns, basilisks, and hydra, and serpents across the land, DragonSlayers are among Lore's most-skilled warriors and known for their unparalleled courage in battle.

name: Obsidian Empyrean Void (0 AC)
description: The Empyrean Voids are among the most highly-revered of Nulgath's Nation. To ascend to their ranks, one must prove their worth in battle and blood for centuries.

name: Obsidian Empyrean Void (AC)
description: The Empyrean Voids are among the most highly-revered of Nulgath's Nation. To ascend to their ranks, one must prove their worth in battle and blood for centuries.

name: Obsidian Fury (0 AC)
description: Channel the fury inside you to control ANY enemy who opposes you! Rule over the other heroes, warlords, and adventurers who battle though Lore!

name: Obsidian Fury (AC)
description: Channel the fury inside you to control ANY enemy who opposes you! Rule over the other heroes, warlords, and adventurers who battle though Lore!

name: Obsidian Grovebreaker Armor
description: The Grovebreak Tribe is a proud group of elves that believe trees hold a supernatural significance. The bronze-like bark that make up this armor come from one of their sacred trees. Suggested by fellow AQW hero, Xelsear, this year, and many others in the past.

name: Obsidian Highlord (0 AC)
description: One of the most powerful and high ranking members of Empress Gravelyn's Lightscythe Army. LONG LIVE THE LIGHTSCYTHE!

name: Obsidian Highlord (AC)
description: One of the most powerful and high ranking members of Empress Gravelyn's Lightscythe Army. LONG LIVE THE LIGHTSCYTHE!

name: Obsidian Icemancer (AC)
description: Before today's Cryomancers harnessed the power of Ice, Ancient Cryomancers already knew its power.

name: Obsidian Icemancer (Legend)
description: Before today's Cryomancers harnessed the power of Ice, Ancient Cryomancers already knew its power.

name: Obsidian Legion Vampire
description: After sacrificing their undying souls to the Undead Legion, the Dark Lord transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. A new breed of Vampire has surfaced, and the world of Lore will soon witness the power of His chosen disciples…

name: Obsidian Naval Commander
description: Naval commanders that the or the paladin code of honor and persevere even through a voyage where the destination is uncertain have set themselves on a path to righteousness. Inspired by a suggestion from fellow hero, Chic_Wingz!

name: Obsidian Paladin Chronomancer (Armor)
description: Stopping time does not halt the corrosion of the soul. Obsidian Paladin Chronomancers are the result of an eternity on duty. The blackened armor is a symbol of honor and sacrifice.

name: Obsidian Paladin Commander (0 AC)
description: A DeathKnight that has redeemed itself without going too far into the shadows is given the honor to lead a guild of paladins, but they still retain traces of their former power that recedes over time.

name: Obsidian Paladin Commander (AC)
description: A DeathKnight that has redeemed itself without going too far into the shadows is given the honor to lead a guild of paladins, but they still retain traces of their former power that recedes over time.

name: Obsidian Pandy Hoodie (0 AC)
description: You suddenly have a craving for the blackest bamboo.

name: Obsidian Pandy Hoodie (AC)
description: You suddenly have a craving for the blackest bamboo.

name: Obsidian Peasant
description: Recommended enhancement: Fighter. You may have heard of a rebel without a clue… well you are a player without a class! Painted black at the suggestion of fellow AQW hero, TheUrce!

name: Obsidian Pirate Mage
description: Pirates or privateers that practice magic in their daily lives fare slightly better out in the sea than those who do not. They carry elegant red tomes that contain every spell they need to effectively survive anything from raging storms to Kathool Adepts.

name: Obsidian Samurai (AC)
description: Yokai's Royal family has had a long time of samurai warriors to defend and protect them in times of battle.

name: Obsidian Samurai (Special)
description: Yokai's Royal family has had a long time of samurai warriors to defend and protect them in times of battle.

name: Obsidian Serpent Knight
description: These sssssslithery sssserpents guard the entrances to some of the vast underground for fortunes of the sssssandsea.

name: Obsidian ShadowFlame DragonLord (0 AC)
description: Sometimes a DragonLord falls victim to the Shadow, no matter how hard they fight it. This is the result.

name: Obsidian ShadowFlame DragonLord (AC)
description: Sometimes a DragonLord falls victim to the Shadow, no matter how hard they fight it. This is the result.

name: Obsidian Sorceress

description: It's greed and bloodthirst that possesses this restless pirate.

description: YEEEEEE-HAW! The post-apocalypse is wilder than the old West. The perfect for a desperado with a few morals and fast horse to find (or steal) success.

name: Potato Sack
description: Yeah it's a lot of gold for a used potato sack. But this is formal attire for a food fighting event.

name: Powder Monkey
description: An explosives expert that can fire a canon underwater. They're high in demand, and a dangerous foe that'll blast out your eardrums if they miss blasting you to smithereens.

name: Prepared Casual Wayfarer (0 AC)
description: Those aren't juice cans. This has to be some sort of crime. Who or what is in your cooler!? (This item is color customizable)

name: Prepared Casual Wayfarer (AC)
description: Those aren't juice cans. This has to be some sort of crime. Who or what is in your cooler!? (This item is color customizable)

name: Presence of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: The veterans of the Nation don't need pomp and circumstance. Their simple presence alone rallies armies of Fiends to gather and revel in destruction.

name: Presence of Nulgath (AC)
description: The veterans of the Nation don't need pomp and circumstance. Their simple presence alone rallies armies of Fiends to gather and revel in destruction.

name: Pretty DOOMFire Warrior
description: As a thanks for your eternal servitude to the Shadowscythe Empire, Beleen has dyed your DoomFire Warrior armor pink! (Requires DoomFire Warrior from 400k AC Achievement Badge Shop)

name: Pretty in Pink DoomKnight
description: It's soooo pink! It is said that this shall burn the eyes of the Paladin Artix.

name: Pretty Pinkie Pirate Captain
description: Pinker than the best cupcakes, you're the delight of the sea!

name: Pretty Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: You can't be the pirate captain and not take the opportunity to be cute about it.

name: Pretty Pirate Captain (AC)
description: You can't be the pirate captain and not take the opportunity to be cute about it.

name: Pretty Sailor Mate
description: All hands on deck! What is a ship without it's crew? A large sea dwelling vessel - that's what!

name: Pride of Chaos
description: Glory to Chaos! Strike fear into those, who follow the path of order and good, while donning this royal armor. Only Chaos will survive and Lore shall fall!

name: Pride of Panthera
description: Strength, courage, and honor… characteristic that a warrior must abide by if they wish to become a true champion!

name: Pride of the Kingdom
description: Strike fear into your enemies' eyes while donning this royal armor.Only the strong will survive in the jungle..and in Lore!

name: Priest of Holy Flame
description: Command fire, rain down upon your enemy fire and brimstone, reveling in the smell of sulfur and ash as those who stand against you burn. There is nothing more terrifying than someone with fire in their eyes and at their fingertips.

name: Priest of the Ashes
description: What is a conflagration but ashes to be? Take this new form, and herald your foe’s imminent combustion!

name: Priest of the Black Sun
description: The Fourth Dimensional Pyramid will always be a resting place for the Priests and Priestesses of the Black Hole Sun!

name: Priest of the Ignited Ones
description: Anointed by the Order of the Ignited Ones, this priest has been charged to protect their ancient scrolls since the dawn of time. The Summer months are a period of intense celebration and re-confirmation of their.

name: Priestess of Monsters
description: Many worship the Queen of Monsters, but few are called to serve in her castle. The High Priest and Priestess of Monsters - once Generals of Nulgath the ArchFiend --  have now sworn eternal obedience and absolute loyalty.

name: Priests of the Scorpion
description: The highest members in the Cult of the Scorpions, these priests are able to cast spells only found in the sacred scrolls of their cult. Ranging from plagues to infestations, this priests aid their armies in with their magical creations.

name: Primal Hanzo Void
description: These imperial Voids of Nulgath's army possess qualities that normal primal Voids do not have, hence why they are prized by the ArchFiend.

name: Primal Tiger
description: The tiger is as mighty as it is majestic, but it does not forsake brains for brawn. A warrior who fights alone, draped in a tiger's stripes, are cunning in their ways.

name: Primal Void Tiger
description: After swearing allegiance to Nulgath the ArchFiend, if a Void Beast hunts for too long., they can lose themselves in bloodlust. They evolve further, achieving heights and lows unimaginable.

name: Primal Wraith
description: A living embodiment of hatred and famine. The Primal Wraith often appears during the Harvest to reap all of the food gathered by everyone.

name: Primaris Paladin
description: No matter how vast your enemies, shielded by the symbol of your order, you battle without fear. Your current mission: to guard the guardians fighting to defend Battleon from the Titans.

name: Prime Champion Of Order
description: Drakath's the Good personal armor is filled with Good and Light as he works to extinguish the forces of Chaos.

name: Prime Chaos Dragon Of Time
description: As the Eternal Dragon of Time, you possess a power unrivaled by almost any entity in our universe. Even the Elemental Lords marvel at what you are capable of. Combined with the power of Chaos… you are unpredictable AND unstoppable.

name: Prime Corrupted Paragon Plate (0 AC)
description: Not many dragons exist in the Underworld but a few must be wrangled by the most fierce dragon warriors.

name: Prime Corrupted Paragon Plate (AC)
description: Not many dragons exist in the Underworld but a few must be wrangled by the most fierce dragon warriors.

name: Prime Dominus (Armor)
description: Prime's godly armor. We are not sure what type of energy it runs off of, though.

name: Prime Draconic Paragon Plate (0 AC)
description: Not many dragons exist in the Underworld but a few must be wrangled by the most fierce dragon warriors in the Legion.

name: Prime Draconic Paragon Plate (AC)
description: Not many dragons exist in the Underworld but a few must be wrangled by the most fierce dragon warriors in the Legion.

name: Prime ProtoParagon WarForge
description: The Legion's most devoted warriors laid their bodies on the Soul Forge, and were remade into paragons of excellence. Or…were they actually traitors and enemies, their sins forgiven under Lord Dage's knives?

name: Prime ProtoParagon WF 26
description: The Legion's most devoted warriors laid their bodies on the Soul Forge, and were remade into paragons of excellence. Or…were they actually traitors and enemies, their sins forgiven under Lord Dage's knives?

name: Primordial Mahorc-Uraga
description: Legends from far flung Horc wanderers tell of a peerless warrior, who will only serve those who pass their ten dark trials. No one has ever won their cursed respect. (Skin is not CC)

name: Prince Darkon's Armor
description: Darkon was never fully comfortable with wearing the color that set the royalty apart from the people who adored them. He refrained from wearing gloves, wishing to experience everything Lore had to offer.

name: Prince Darkon's Casual Armor
description: Darkon was never fully comfortable with wearing the color that set the royalty apart from the people who adored them. He refrained from wearing gloves, wishing to experience everything Lore had to offer.

name: Prince Drago's Attire
description: The formal suit is ironed and starched meticulously every morning. Drago, bored by the dull luxury of his lifestyle, would intentionally wrinkle or stain his outfit. Then, he’d enjoy an afternoon punishing the ‘incompetent’ servants.

name: Prince Drago's Dark Attire
description: The formal suit is ironed and starched meticulously every morning. Drago, bored by the dull luxury of his lifestyle, would intentionally wrinkle or stain his outfit. Then, he’d enjoy an afternoon punishing the ‘incompetent’ servants.

name: Prince Drago's Royal Attire
description: The formal suit is ironed and starched meticulously every morning. Drago, bored by the dull luxury of his lifestyle, would intentionally wrinkle or stain his outfit. Then, he’d enjoy an afternoon punishing the ‘incompetent’ servants.

name: Prince Drago's Royal Dark Attire
description: The formal suit is ironed and starched meticulously every morning. Drago, bored by the dull luxury of his lifestyle, would intentionally wrinkle or stain his outfit. Then, he’d enjoy an afternoon punishing the ‘incompetent’ servants.

name: Prince of Dragons
description: A silver-trimmed plate of armor that was crafted in the days of King Slugwrath's reign. It is stylized to treat you as a living weapon against a dragon because swords are sometimes insufficient.

name: Prince of Vegetables
description: Where did all that speed and power come from? You are UNSTOPPABLE!

name: Princess Brittany's Dress
description: A royal blue dress tailored for the wise and elegant crown princess of Swordhaven. Brittany's down-to-earth nature charmed both nobles and commoners. This calm charisma is reminiscent of her father, King Alteon.

name: Princess Suki's Armor
description: Black is worn by the common folk of Astravia. They were forbidden from wearing white unless they served the royalty directly. Suki made the decision to keep wearing black, the colour of the most important people in the Kingdom. The sea of Astravian subjects churned with cheers, and fears.

name: Prisma Guard
description: A sleek plugsuit that shifts mesmerisingly between colours.

name: Prisma Pop (0 AC)
description: The best part of summer is being able to blow shimmering bubbles outside!

name: Prisma Pop (AC)
description: The best part of summer is being able to blow shimmering bubbles outside!

name: Prisma Pop (Legend)
description: The best part of summer is being able to blow shimmering bubbles outside!

name: Prisma Ram Marauder
description: The rage of beasts that once lived as cattle, mindlessly festered in the echoing chasms of the abyss. The raider's armor was imbued with these souls, and cruel horns sprouted from steel. (CC to Base)

name: Prisma Ram Raider
description: The rage of beasts that once lived as cattle, mindlessly festered in the echoing chasms of the abyss. The raider's armor was imbued with these souls, and cruel horns sprouted from steel. (CC to Base)

name: Prisma Unarmored Serpent Soldier
description: A master of stealth that lurks in silence and darkness, waiting to strike. They won't give their lives for honor, but they'll give it to…the right cause.

name: PrismaStealth Serpent Soldier
description: A master of stealth that lurks in silence and darkness, waiting to strike. They won't give their lives for honor, but they'll give it to…the right cause.

name: Prismatic Archfiend's Transcendence
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: Prismatic BabyDoll Slayer
description: Tossed aside like so many broken toys…

name: Prismatic Blossom Bush
description: When you equip this armor, your enemies can beat around the bush for hours, but will never guess you're right there, ready to strike!

name: Prismatic Blossom Kimono
description: Sakura blossoms

name: Prismatic Chaotic Evil Knight
description: With THAT many adjectives in the name, you can be sure that this armor is cool.

name: Prismatic Chiton
description: Enter the battle arena secure in the knowledge that you'll look your best and fight your hardest! The trim on this chiton is color-custom!

name: Prismatic ClawSuit (Armor)
description: The Prismatic Clawsuit is an unexpected (and unwanted) gift to all the naughty beings of the world. You spread more damage than cheer — and are incredibly good at it. Merry Frostval!

name: Prismatic Cloud Rider
description: A type of wind ninja that is on cloud nine. Why are they so happy? Sneak attacks from the sky give them the full advantage of the element of surprise too.

name: Prismatic Composer Armor
description: Orchestrate your own band of terror in a fully color custom Composer Armor! Never miss a beat…down!

name: Prismatic Dark Fairie
description: Long ago in the forest above Shattersword, the Dark Faerie Enclave lived bringing nature’s brutal judgement to all who violated the sacred woods.

name: Prismatic Dark Lord Armor
description: Just because you are a Dark Lord who channels the Fourth to try and take over the universe for the Dark Side doesn't mean you have to hate color! (And you still love cookies!) This item gives 20% more class points and rep when equipped.

name: Prismatic Doom Attendant
description: The mystical feline you serve holds many secrets, and its dragontastic powers may one day save your life! It has also granted you a prismatic armor that changes colors whenever you wish.

name: Prismatic Draconian
description: This magical armors clothes you in the image of a Draconian of your desired color!

name: Prismatic Dragon Morph (Armor)
description: How to train your Dragon? More like how to style your Dragon!

name: Prismatic Dragon Samurai
description: An elegant kimono for a more civilized age. (This armor is color-customizable)

name: Prismatic Dragonrune Mage
description: Now no one at Dragonrune can argue how colorful of a character you are.

name: Prismatic Drow Eviscerator
description: This armor is covered with blades. It's trimming has been sharpened into keen edges, turning the wearers body into a weapon.

name: Prismatic Dunestalker
description: Rule the dunes as you stalk your enemies with your color-changing tattoos! Track them, slay them and take all they own! Victory is yours!

name: Prismatic Ebil Operative
description: Once rogue Shadowslayers from the future, these soldiers are now operatives for EbilCorp. (CC to Trim)

name: Prismatic Elementalist
description: Wield the shifting power of the elementas as you garb yourself in this prismatic armor. This color custom armor will enhance your appearance just as it protects you in battle!

name: Prismatic Elf
description: No one throughout Lore has more holiday spirit than you! Great job not letting the weather bring you down as you shared holiday cheer throughout Lore 12 days in a row!

name: Prismatic Evolved DragonSlayer
description: This color-customizable armor is worn by elite DragonSlayers! Crafted in honor of Galanoth the DragonSlayers lifelong battle against dragons.

name: Prismatic Fall Fighter
description: Prismatic Fall Fighters attune themselves with the autumn foliage, making a fashion statement wherever they roam while being able to camouflage themselves if danger should arise.

name: Prismatic Galactic Mech
description: After combining rich and exslusive resources taken from the Lore of MechQuest, this color custom mech armor is unlike anything the people of AQW here ever seen…at least up to this point in time!

name: Prismatic Gamer
description: A stylish and comfortable look for hobbyists and professionals.

name: Prismatic Giant Dwarf
description: Awesome on the battlefield - yet even more awesome in color coordination! Throw down in the ring and knock out your oponents while knocking in some fashion sense.

name: Prismatic Kahn of Dragons Barbarian
description: This color-custom armor will protect you while hunting for fire-breathing beasts that roam the skies!

name: Prismatic Karategi
description: Made of light canvas cloth, the gi maximizes mobility and speed. Color customizable for the true Karate Sensei!

name: Prismatic L.O.S.E.R.
description: It's changing time! Chameleon!

name: Prismatic LightningLord
description: LightningLords collect the power of lightning, and store it in special gems scattered across their robes for use in battle. ZZZap!

name: Prismatic Luchadwarf
description: Luchadwarves are hand to hand warriors from the color southern regions of the Dwarfhold montains. You can dress in any 2 color combinations you like in this color custom outfit.

name: Prismatic Lucky Rogue
description: You wander the land of Lore facing the most ferocious beasts without a scratch!

name: Prismatic Magi Robes
description: Only the highest ranking magi of Arcangrove have the honor of adorning themselves in fully color customizable wizard robes. You possess so many magical attributes that you seemingly float across the terrain.

name: Prismatic Magus (0 AC)
description: Powerful wielders of light magic, as well as skilled illusionists. The Prismatic Magi are story tellers in times of peace, and sewers of confusion and discord during war. The Light plays tricks, bringing forth visions of sacred wishes and lost loves.

name: Prismatic Magus (AC)
description: Powerful wielders of light magic, as well as skilled illusionists. The Prismatic Magi are story tellers in times of peace, and sewers of confusion and discord during war. The Light plays tricks, bringing forth visions of sacred wishes and lost loves.

name: Prismatic Maugs Slayer
description: The great beast has awakened… the dragon awaits! But one does not simply SLAY Maugs… one must defeat him honorably. This item is color-customizable.

name: Prismatic Necromancer (1)
description: Just because you're a Necromancer doesn't mean you don't like color!

name: Prismatic Necromancer (2)
description: The quarrels of men only fuel your fire. Let their fallen build your empire.

name: Prismatic Neon Shadow (AC)
description: You'll be the hottest thing at any New Year's celebration!

name: Prismatic Neon Shadow (Legend)
description: You'll be the hottest thing at any New Year's celebration!

name: Prismatic Paragon Plate
description: This armor is riddled with the faces of it's last victims. if you listen closely, you can still hear their cries… AHHHH!

name: Prismatic Poisonmaker's Apprentice
description: You wish to understand the diabolical powers behind alchemy. And training under a skilled Poisonmaker is going to be a challenge - but you're up for the challenge. Features color custom robes.

name: Prismatic Pride Outfit
description: Live a life full of color, happiness, joy, and pride. Battle On! (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Prismatic Rainbowtheus Armor
description: Rainbowtheus has wandered over from OverSoul to paint the town so everything is ready for Lucky Day.

name: Prismatic Shogunslinger
description: The gun is mightier than a blade but they both get the job done

name: Prismatic SkyGuard Warrior
description: As a member of the boarding party, you are the grunt of the SkyGuard. That doesn't mean though that you can't hold your own in the heat of battle.

name: Prismatic SnowStalker
description: A warm outfit to wear when out for a stroll in the Frostval wonder land.

name: Prismatic Starry Swimsuit (0 AC)
description: As you stare across the water, stars reflect on its surface, an ocean of diamond-like points of light. This suit lets you capture the magic of that moment. (This armor is color-customizable to base)

name: Prismatic Starry Swimsuit (AC)
description: As you stare across the water, stars reflect on its surface, an ocean of diamond-like points of light. This suit lets you capture the magic of that moment. (This armor is color-customizable to base)

name: Prismatic Starry Swimwear (0 AC)
description: As you stare across the water, stars reflect on its surface, an ocean of diamond-like points of light. This suit lets you capture the magic of that moment. (This armor is color-customizable to base)

name: Prismatic Starry Swimwear (AC)
description: As you stare across the water, stars reflect on its surface, an ocean of diamond-like points of light. This suit lets you capture the magic of that moment. (This armor is color-customizable to base)

name: Prismatic Summer Rave
description: For all those nights dancing at the beach.

name: Prismatic Sun God Titan
description: Azura the Sun God demands vengeance. Pay homage to his power with the blood of your enemies, and you will prosper in his service. (Tattoo is CC to trim, armor pieces CC to base)

name: Prismatic Sun God Warrior
description: Azura the Sun God demands vengeance. Pay homage to his power with the blood of your enemies, and you will prosper in his service. (Tattoo is CC to trim, armor pieces CC to base)

name: Prismatic Techno Vampire (0 AC)
description: Dage wasn't happy with just regular Legion Vampires so he took the next step.

name: Prismatic Techno Vampire (AC)
description: Dage wasn't happy with just regular Legion Vampires so he took the next step.

name: Prismatic Thorn of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: The Thorns of Nulgath are a silent, deadly, almost invisible corps of elite assassins. You do not know they are hunting you until you feel their blade pierce through your side. (This item is color customizable)

name: Prismatic Thorn of Nulgath (AC)
description: The Thorns of Nulgath are a silent, deadly, almost invisible corps of elite assassins. You do not know they are hunting you until you feel their blade pierce through your side. (This item is color customizable)

name: Prismatic WardKeeper's Armor
description: A celestial battlesuit drenched with blessed water is worn by Wardkeepers of the Southern Dawn Citadel. Their purpose is to fend off the combined darkness drawn from the likes of the Legion and Nation.

name: Prismatic Water Snake
description: COLOR CUSTOM ARMOR: This is The Year of The Snake and this year's elemental is water. The Water snake is careful, smart and manages others well. The perfect leader when going into combat.

name: Prismodian Guard
description: The colorfully elite unit of the Shadowscythe Army, used mostly for guarding VIPs or putting down rebellions.

name: Pristine Blades of Order
description: The Blades of Order have guarded the Amberheart Tower for millennia, watching and waiting to protect the Land from any foul creatures….till now. When off duty, they must still remain on high alert.

name: Prometheus
description: Energy crackles all around you. Power radiates from within. You've become a massive force of unstoppable power. Will you use it to protect those you love, or will you become the next force of evil? The choice is yours.

name: Promised Dark Legion Sovereign
description: The Underworld has one Lord, and it's Dage the Evil…should he ever need someone to watch his throne, he forged worthy regalia for a sovereign he knows more than his own blood. The Legion kneels to them without question.

name: Promised Legion Sovereign
description: The Underworld has one Lord, and it's Dage the Evil…should he ever need someone to watch his throne, he forged worthy regalia for a sovereign he knows more than his own blood. The Legion kneels to them without question.

name: Promised Underworld Sovereign (0 AC)
description: The Underworld has one Lord, and it's Dage the Evil…should he ever need someone to watch his throne, he forged worthy regalia for a sovereign he knows more than his own blood. The Legion kneels to them without question.

name: Promised Underworld Sovereign (AC)
description: The Underworld has one Lord, and it's Dage the Evil…should he ever need someone to watch his throne, he forged worthy regalia for a sovereign he knows more than his own blood. The Legion kneels to them without question.

name: Proper Victorian Garb
description: I say, this outfit looks DELIGHTFUL on you!

name: Prosperity Qipao
description: These are meant to show off. Yue says that this style of dress was originally created to defy uptight rules and manners, so party your heart out!

name: Protector Armor
description: Alien symbiotes from the world of Protus fused with the body of a Hero you've never met, but would know well. It was recreated from a sample obtained in the Lore of AdventureQuest's timeline.

name: Protector of Lore
description: The Queen has arisen! Calling all Heroes, we need you now more than ever. We must protect our world from the apocalypse.

name: Proto-Champion of Monsters
description: Aeons before Drakath, this bestial warrior served the Queen of Monsters with a loyalty that could not be shattered.

name: Proto Dark Caster (0 AC)
description: The arcane dark arts have existed since before the march of the Legion. Their craft has since been sharpened by Dage the Evil, bringing ancient forbidden knowledge into a new age.

name: Proto Dark Caster (AC)
description: The arcane dark arts have existed since before the march of the Legion. Their craft has since been sharpened by Dage the Evil, bringing ancient forbidden knowledge into a new age.

description: The arcane dark arts have existed since before the march of the Legion. Their craft has since been sharpened by Dage the Evil, bringing ancient forbidden knowledge into a new age.

description: The arcane dark arts have existed since before the march of the Legion. Their craft has since been sharpened by Dage the Evil, bringing ancient forbidden knowledge into a new age.

name: Proto Legion Dark Caster (Merge)
description: The arcane dark arts have existed since before the march of the Legion. Their craft has since been sharpened by Dage the Evil, bringing ancient forbidden knowledge into a new age.

name: Proto-Paragon Armor
description: BEFORE Dage the Evil created the Paragon armor, he made this. Only his most devoted fans will ever be able to /equip this gear… and it looks like YOU are up for the challenge! Serve the Evil One well, warrior!

name: ProtoBlaster Armor
description: Fight for the future! And that future is Dage and the Legion!

name: ProtoParagon 3017
description: The Undead Legion demands everything of its soldiers… and any hero skilled enough to equip the ProtoParagon 3017 becomes one of its deadliest weapons.

name: ProtoParagon MK 3
description: The Undead Legion demands everything of its soldiers… and any hero skilled enough to equip the ProtoParagon 3017 becomes one of its deadliest weapons.

name: ProtoParagon MK 3 V2
description: The Undead Legion demands everything of its soldiers… and any hero skilled enough to equip the ProtoParagon 3017 becomes one of its deadliest weapons.

name: ProtoParagon WarForge (Armor)
description: The Legion's most devoted warriors laid their bodies on the Soul Forge, and were remade into paragons of excellence. Or…were they actually traitors and enemies, their sins forgiven under Lord Dage's knives?

name: ProtoParagon WF 26
description: The Legion's most devoted warriors laid their bodies on the Soul Forge, and were remade into paragons of excellence. Or…were they actually traitors and enemies, their sins forgiven under Lord Dage's knives?

name: ProtoParagon X1
description: A digital paragon of Dage intended for use in the datastream

name: ProtoSartorium (Armor)
description: A mechanical marvel utilizing heat and steam to enhance your natural abilities as well as providing exceptional defenses.

name: Psionic Mindbreaker Armor
description: An exceptionally well trained MindBreaker, skilled in the art of psionic manipulation. You bend mental energy within yourself and your opponents to your will.

name: Psyche of Love
description: This is love given form. When a story of two lovers ends in tragedy, the Gods of Arcadia can't wrench their eyes away. They take the broken pieces, fit them back together, and give it life. Grateful, the Psyches become attendants of Love.

name: Ptolomea Necromancer
description: Necromancers who seek to harness the most vile of souls. Their heinous creations spread fear to even the darkest corners of the Underworld.

name: Pukasnooze Suit
description: Hehehe… I'm a pukasnooze!

name: Pukasnooze Suit (Temp)
description: Hehehe… I'm a Pukasnooze!

name: Pulsar Manipulator
description: By collecting and storing the electromagnetic radiation pulses emitted by neutron stars, you're able to fuel your travels through space and time!

name: Pumpkin Lord Armor (AC)
description: The Great Pumpkin Lord Armor! Happy Mogloween!

name: Pumpkin Lord Armor (Legend)
description: The Great Pumpkin Lord Armor! Happy Mogloween!

name: Pumpkin Magus
description: The Pumpkin Magi serve at the court of the Harvest Queen and Great Pumpking. Their magic is mighty, and they can squash an enemy with a single blast. Their gourd works are known throughout the land.

name: Pumpkin Paragon
description: This gear was made so the Undead Legion could… SQUASH… the competition.

name: Pumpkin Warlock
description: A fanciful practitioner of magic and trickery. Villages welcome them and their silly pumpkin familiars, unaware that these powerful warlocks trap ghosts, powerful spirits, and dark entities in squash.

name: Pumpkin Witch
description: The only member of the squash family that makes any waves is the pumpkin. That shade of orange is so iconic, it's magic and makes you magic.

name: Pumpking Overlord
description: This is Mogloween, Pumpking screams in the dead of the night.

name: PUNisher
description: Prepare for PUN-ishment!

name: Punk Coal Elf
description: It's a punk rock Frostval, and the Frostval trees are decorated with safety pins.

name: Pure Ao Dai
description: ﻿The Ao Dai is a form-fitting garment that covers all bases, yet hides nothing. Though it invokes gentleness and nostalgia, it represents strong people who will always perservere through hardship with grace.

name: Pure Apocalyptic Darkblood
description: Darkblood revered and feared by their kinder brethren. They seek a new beginning by pursuing the end. Hard truths forced them to turn their backs on The Mother.

name: Purified ArchFiend Warrior (0 AC)
description: Even the darkest, most fiendish warrior can be turned to the light.

name: Purified ArchFiend Warrior (AC)
description: Even the darkest, most fiendish warrior can be turned to the light.

name: Purified BeastMaster
description: These warriors use their power to help and protect nature, while using the native beasts of the area.

name: Purified Chrononomancer (0 AC)
description: Every Chronomancer begins as a young adventurer before their ultimate power is unlocked. They’re untrained and unadorned, but ready to set out on a path that - eventually- will see them become LEGENDARY. (CC to Accessory)

name: Purified Chrononomancer (AC)
description: Every Chronomancer begins as a young adventurer before their ultimate power is unlocked. They’re untrained and unadorned, but ready to set out on a path that - eventually- will see them become LEGENDARY. (CC to Accessory)

name: Purified Crystallis Soldier
description: Darkness must give way to light. It is the eternal struggle for balance and equilibrium.

name: Purified HydraSlayer Plate
description: This armor was crafted from the remains of a fallen HydraSlayer found on the shores of Mobius Lake.

name: Purified SoulBinder
description: SoulBinders are able to harness the magical energy of souls without the aid of a Soul ally. SoulWeavers have questioned the ethics of this practice, believing the SoulBinders to be manipulating soul against their will.

name: Purifier
description: Only those pure of heart shall be protected!

name: Purple Dragonborn Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Yeah sure, Drakath was defeated years ago, but that doesn't mean his right hand woman, Cemaros hasn't stopped having "fun" with the dragons she's captured.

name: Purple Dragonborn Naval Commander (AC)
description: Yeah sure, Drakath was defeated years ago, but that doesn't mean his right hand woman, Cemaros hasn't stopped having "fun" with the dragons she's captured.

name: Purple Dragonpriest Robes
description: Healers of Etherstorm are one with Dragons and the elements. These healers draw their power from the wind.

name: Purple Hibiscus Sarong
description: Combined with SPF 9000 this armor will protect you on the hottest beaches in Lore.

name: Purple Space Crew Shirt
description: You've got a good chance of surviving the away party.

name: Purple Space Paladin
description: Let's boldly go where no other Paladins have gone before!

name: Purple Wedding Garb
description: Every noble needs a good wedding outfit!

name: Putty Person
description: Some kids make zards from their putty. Not the little empress…

name: Pyrewatch Warrior
description: Things can get a little hot at Pyrewatch Peak, good thing what this armor lacks in fashion it makes up for in fire resistance.
