name: Revontheus Legacy (0 AC)
description: As faitful subordinates to Nulgath, the Revontheus don't see themselves as slaves but rather loyal to their master!

name: Revontheus Legacy (AC)
description: As faitful subordinates to Nulgath, the Revonlheus don't see themselves as slaves but rather loyal to their master!

name: Revontheus the Good (Armor)
description: Subordinate to ArchBeing Nulgath, he serves his master and aids Dage the Good in stopping Alteon the Imbalanced.

name: Rhapsodic Bandmaster
description: ﻿﻿Bandmasters that lend their talents to the court and armies of the Shadowscythe Empire. As they march with instruments in hand, they destroy the morale of the enemy and wrench rebellious soldiers back into formation.

name: Rift Warden
description: The armor of the Rift Wardens - Those who guard any holes between the fabrics of reality.

name: RiftBreaker
description: Heroes dedicated to protecting Lore from the monsters spewing out of the rift don this armor to blend in with the monsters in order to strike down any leader like monsters in an attempt to break the chain of command.

name: Riftwalker
description: Riftwalkers are Atealan warriors who can cut reality with a single slash, and shatter dimensions with a single punch. Powerful Riftwalkers can flash through reality with a single swing of their blade.

name: RiftWalker Warrior
description: Riftwalkers travel between worlds, journeying from plane to plane as they battle through many realities.

name: Right Half Legion Paladin
description: Slash to the left, slash to the right. Right foot two kicks, left foot two kicks. Chop off their knees, chop off their knees.

name: Rigor Mortis Repo Agent
description: Under the cover of Darkness, the Rigor Mortis Repo Agents steal into graveyards and… repossess resources for aspiring Necromancers throughout DoomWood. They are crafty corps. Working outside the law, they know they will be hunted whenever they are discovered.

name: Rimeblossom Enchanter (0 AC)
description: The regal rimeblossom is a fragile flower yet it grows in the harshest of environments. Your spells are enchanting as they are unforgivingly cold.

name: Rimeblossom Enchanter (AC)
description: The regal rimeblossom is a fragile flower yet it grows in the harshest of environments. Your spells are enchanting as they are unforgivingly cold.

name: Rimeblossom Kitsune (0 AC)
description: When snow falls in the Yokai Isles, a shrine appears to those seeking an audience with its Rimeblossom Kistune. Their sword dance flies elegantly across frozen flowers. Not a petal falls from their nimble performance.

name: Rimeblossom Kitsune (AC)
description: When snow falls in the Yokai Isles, a shrine appears to those seeking an audience with its Rimeblossom Kistune. Their sword dance flies elegantly across frozen flowers. Not a petal falls from their nimble performance.

name: Rimeblossom Kitsune Tsukesage (0 AC)
description: When snow falls in the Yokal Isles, a shrine appears to those seeking an audience with its Permafrost Kistune. Their sword dance is as enchanting as the moon, and the foxes eager to share their skills.

name: Rimeblossom Kitsune Tsukesage (AC)
description: When snow falls in the Yokal Isles, a shrine appears to those seeking an audience with its Permafrost Kistune. Their sword dance is as enchanting as the moon, and the foxes eager to share their skills.

name: Rimeblossom Sidhe (0 AC)
description: The Court of the Winter glitter as brightly as the stars in the night sky. Best remember that the Fae who dance with the snowflakes are as Unseelie as they come. Their touch welcomes a cold and humiliating death.

name: Rimeblossom Sidhe (AC)
description: The Court of the Winter glitter as brightly as the stars in the night sky. Best remember that the Fae who dance with the snowflakes are as Unseelie as they come. Their touch welcomes a cold and humiliating death.

name: RimeScale Dragon Warrior (0 AC)
description: The Dragons of Queen Khione's court took on more humanoid forms to mingle at the balls of their Ice Elf companions. Gowns and robes made from glittering, auroral crystals drifted through the castles' halls like mist.

name: RimeScale Dragon Warrior (AC)
description: The Dragons of Queen Khione's court took on more humanoid forms to mingle at the balls of their Ice Elf companions. Gowns and robes made from glittering, auroral crystals drifted through the castles' halls like mist.

name: RimeScale Dragonborn (0 AC)
description: The Dragons of Queen Khione's court took on more humanoid forms to mingle at the balls of their Ice Elf companions. Gowns and robes made from glittering, auroral crystals drifted through the castles' halls like mist.

name: RimeScale Dragonborn (AC)
description: The Dragons of Queen Khione's court took on more humanoid forms to mingle at the balls of their Ice Elf companions. Gowns and robes made from glittering, auroral crystals drifted through the castles' halls like mist.

name: Ringermaster Zazul
description: The Purgatorio Ringmaster.

name: Ripped Denim Concert Gear
description: Denim is the best thing to wear to concerts.

name: Riptide Helicoprion
description: The denizens of the depths attained deadly beauty by embracing those swallowed by the sea. Appearing humanoid, they're deadly hunters of cold, sacrosanct blood. Once they begin to feed, there will be nothing left behind.

name: Riptide Helicoprion Adept
description: The denizens of the depths attained deadly beauty by embracing those swallowed by the sea. Appearing as alluring Sirens, they're deadly hunters of cold, sacrosanct blood. Once they begin to feed, there will be nothing left behind.

name: Riqueza Purpura
description: Dance until the sun falls out of the sky, and light up the streets until they outshine the stars!

name: Rise of a Dragon Slayer
description: If you can slay a dragon bare-chested, you've gotta be tough!

name: Risen Sun Ninja
description: Legend says that the maker of this armor actually captured sunlight and wove it into the threads, giving this a radiant glow.

name: Rising Shadows
description: Embrace the shadows but beware… the light of the celestial realm can harm you!

name: Risk Taker
description: You feel an urge to make risky decisions while wearing this armor.

name: Risu Shinobi
description: *No description*

name: Roaming Spacer
description: Surely you've heard of me.

name: Robe of Knowledge
description: This robe makes you look so smart. It's because you ARE so smart! +10 to Intelligence IRL. (Color customizable)

name: Robe of the Arcane
description: Tapping into arcane energy is dangerous business indeed. Those that come close to mastering it are rewarded with unimaginable power.

name: Robed Evolved Legion Vampire (AC)
description: Well done, Legion member! This armor will serve you well as you stalk the shadows.

name: Robed Evolved Legion Vampire (Merge)
description: Cannot be sold until Monday. December 9th, 2014. On that day, it will gives 10% more class points when equipped.

name: Robes of Rayst
description: These are the robes of Rayst, the master of Arcangrove Tower. Much like the Robes of the Arcane in design but only magi of the highest order are allowed to wear them.

name: Robina Armor
description: *No description*

name: Robot Parade Chassis
description: There's electric cars, there's electric trains, and with this chassis, you'd be a robotic hero with electric brains!

name: Rocker Hoodie
description: Get ready to mosh!

name: RockScar
description: The age of metal is upon us! Thou shall rise and mosh! We will only stop once the music stops!

name: Rockstar
description: The beat was going strong. Playing my favorite song. I love rock and roll! (5% gold boost when equipped)

name: Rockstar Rogue
description: Rock was born on the road, rehearsed in empty cemeteries, and shredded metal so hard the audience thought it was fiendish. These Rockstars are musical wanderers, returning to their roots.

name: Rogue Armor
description: Rogues follow their own set of rules. With a combination of speed, cunning and poisons, you take your enemies by surprise.

name: Rogue Fiend of Nulgath (AC)
description: Trained in the art of stealth and silent kill, fiends like these are an elite division in the Nulgath nation sent to eliminate opponents deemed as a traitors or serious threats to the nation. Those who like to hide and blend in make the best recruits for this division.

name: Rogue Fiend of Nulgath (Legend)
description: Trained in the art of stealth and silent kill, fiends like these are an elite division in the Nulgath nation sent to eliminate opponents deemed as a traitors or serious threats to the nation. Those who like to hide and blend in make the best recruits for this division.

name: Rogue Leather
description: Rogue fighters prefer leather armor because it provides moderate protection without restricting their movement the way plate armor might.

name: Rogue Magicale
description: Dark as shadow, quick as lightning, you will be able to slip into the darkest of places and steal anything your heart desires. Your enemies will know this truth once you steal their lives from them. Don't get too greedy though…

name: Rogue of Love
description: Rogues get what they want in battle… AND in love!

name: Rogue of Time
description: Rogues emerged from the unceasing rivers of time. They move through its flow as easily as they weave through enemies unseen. Some say, the Dragon that gave them this power once walked alongside mortals.

name: Romantic Heart
description: Smart and focused, this armor will serve you well, protecting your heart and the heart of he or she that you admire. Guaranteed to keep the enemy at bay, this armor will leave a lasting impression.

name: Ronin Hunter
description: For glory! For honor! And for hoards of glorious gold! Trained in the way of the Samurai, Ronin Hunters are quick-witted quick swordsmen who can camouflage into nature using their Color Custom abilities while relying on their agility to land the final blow.

name: Root of Chaos
description: The root of all that is evil starts with a little Chaos!

name: Rose Ebil Ninja
description: They may be dressed for a wedding, but they're ready for a fight!

name: Rose Petal Attire
description: Celebrate the Season of Love with this gorgeous outfit seemingly made of red rose petals.

name: Rose Royal Shadowslayer
description: When you are royalty, yet wish to be a Shadowslayer… you dress the part!

name: Rosenschwert Knight
description: Knights loved by Nature are blessed by its blooms, and protected by its thorns. They promise their blades to Lady Terrane's flowers, her beloved Champions.

name: Rosy AUS Rugby Armor! (AC)
description: You'll be on the ball when you /equip this AUS-some rugby armor! Crowds of your /party members will /cheer as your crit-ically score against your enemies!

name: Rosy AUS Rugby Armor! (Non-AC)
description: You'll be on the ball when you /equip this AUS-some rugby armor! Crowds of your /party members will /cheer as your crit-ically score against your enemies!

name: Rosy Legion Vampire (0 AC)
description: After sacrificing their undying souls to the Undead Legion, the Dark Lord transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. A new breed of Vampire has surfaced, and the world of Lore will soon witness the power of His chosen disciples…

name: Rosy Legion Vampire (AC)
description: After sacrificing their undying souls to the Undead Legion, the Dark Lord transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. A new breed of Vampire has surfaced, and the world of Lore will soon witness the power of His chosen disciples…

name: Rosy Royal Wedding Garb (AC)
description: Happy birthday to our favorite Pink Scribe, Beleen! May all your writings be cheerful.

name: Rosy Royal Wedding Garb (Legend)
description: Happy birthday to our favorite Pink Scribe, Beleen! May all your writings be cheerful.

name: Rotting Lich General
description: Looking a little worse for the wear, a Rotting Lich General now knows when to sit back and watch battles from afar.

name: Rotting Naval Commander
description: Dead men tell no tales. Except in this case, where it seems you have managed to escape Davy Jones' Locker. Yaaar!

name: Rouge Armor
description: "Rouge" Definition: any of various red cosmetics for coloring the cheeks or lips

name: Rouge Lord and Lady
description: This attire is nice to wear to a wedding… not a purple or red one though. A pink one. (Suggested by King Brentan)

name: Rouge Raider
description: You killed them, killed them all. They're dead, every single one of them. All of the enemies threatening your home. In the setting sunlight, the sands are tinted pink and gold with all their blood.

name: Rougeweaver
description: This type of soulstealer does not hoard any souls for his/herself. They color them pink so they look like a "black sheep" in the afterlife. After all, pink is the new black. (Suggested by Zee)

name: Royal Alchemist
description: Conjuring Potions and Elixirs has never looked so cool!

name: Royal Arachna Robes
description: Regal and deadly. The looks of the Chaos Weaver Queen demands respect. Only those who swear their unwavering alliance are granted such splendor.

name: Royal Astravian Celebration Outfit (0 AC)
description: Greenguard and Astravian designers collaborated to create a high-fashion outfit to shock and awe the guests of the Frostval Gala. You'll be all the Nobles can think of in the year to come.

name: Royal Astravian Celebration Outfit (AC)
description: Greenguard and Astravian designers collaborated to create a high-fashion outfit to shock and awe the guests of the Frostval Gala. You'll be all the Nobles can think of in the year to come.

name: Royal Attendant
description: A servant with extreme tolerance obedience from their masters and keep their charms in the face of dissatisfaction are difficult to hire, but a dragon's hoard can guarantee that they won't be fashionably late to attend to their strict and strenuous duties.

name: Royal Battle Herald
description: Wear this armor proudly as a herald of Swordhaven.

name: Royal Centurion
description: Many serve Lascivia in her Hoard'em. This is the armor worn by those who serve as Royal Guards.

name: Royal Commander (Armor)
description: You unlocked this armor and the rest of the Royal Commander set when you become one of the Lore’s greatest Heroes with a 1 month upgrade!

name: Royal Dancer
description: A disciplined and collected entertainer that treats dancing as a tool of expression and charm. Their hidden smiles and eagerness to please an audience can tame even a power-hungry dragon.

name: Royal Deathbringer
description: Whenever comes a time when Death is missing in action, a notorious death bringer covers for him, but sometimes they get greedy and add the fallen to their own collection of souls harvested

name: Royal Doom Lords
description: When a ruler is far from human and possesses an insatiable hunger of the dark arts, their reign of terror lasts forever unless a brave hunter puts them out of their concealed misery.

name: Royal Dragon Armor
description: All hail the benevolent Royal Dragon! Representing wisdom, power, and magic, only those with royal bloodlines may don this regal armor.

name: Royal DragonSlayer
description: Feared by dragons, wyverns, basilisks, and hydra, and serpents across the land, DragonSlayers are among Lore's most-skilled warriors and known for their unparalleled courage in battle.

name: Royal Dragoon
description: Your only goal is to protect the children of the dragon, the members of Swordhaven't royal family!

name: Royal Electrojolt Scholar
description: The Scholars of the Storrm Court in Skye, who serve their Queen directly. Their mission is to conquer the heavens, paving the way for the ascension of all Skye Elves.

name: Royal Electrowave Scholar
description: The Scholars of the Storm Court in Skye, who serve their Queen directly. Their mission is to conquer the heavens, paving the way for the ascension of all Skye Elves.

name: Royal Equine Vanguard
description: This company of soldiers personally guards Descendants of the Jade Stallion Prince. They’re expert equestrians, able to cross 1,000 li in a single day. As tensions rose across Lore, the vanguard lent their speed to the entire Royal Family.

name: Royal Exalted ShadowSlayer
description: When you are royalty, yet wish to be a Shadowslayer… you dress the part!

name: Royal Fang Armor
description: This regal armor embodies the savage ferocity of the wolves that roam Lore. Forged by Royal Knight, the Royal Fang Armor offers great protection while giving your enemies something to howl about!

name: Royal GrenwogSlayer
description: Even royalty wants to get in on the GrenwogSlaying fun!

name: Royal Honor ShadowSlayer
description: When you are royalty, yet wish to be a Shadowslayer… you dress the part!

name: Royal Justicar
description: You're a respected officer of King Alteon's court! Well, at least you're dressed like one.

name: Royal Knight of Swordhaven
description: The Royal Guard of Swordhaven swear only one vow: to protect the royal family with their swords, shields, and lives. It is an honor to serve Good.

name: Royal Legion Vampire (0 AC)
description: After sacrificing their undying souls to the Undead Legion, the Dark Lord transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. A new breed of Vampire has surfaced, and the world of Lore will soon witness the power of His chosen disciples…

name: Royal Legion Vampire (AC)
description: After sacrificing their undying souls to the Undead Legion, the Dark Lord transformed his most devoted followers into Legion Vampires. A new breed of Vampire has surfaced, and the world of Lore will soon witness the power of His chosen disciples…

name: Royal Magus
description: Magus are spellswords, who's specialties lie in crafting and enchanting armor and weaponry. A Magus is bound by a strict code that they themselves write. They almost never deviate from this code.

name: Royal Mummy (Armor)
description: The royalty of the Sandsea, desecrated by rage. Their names were erased by Sek-Duat when he conquered their lands, cursing them to an eternity lost in the dark.

name: Royal Paladin
description: The title of Royal Paladin is only bestowed on the most powerful and loyal of the Order.

name: Royal PermaFrost Enchanter (0 AC)
description: The rimeblossom is a fragile flower yet it grows in the harshest of environments. Your spells are enchanting as they are unforgivingly cold.

name: Royal PermaFrost Enchanter (AC)
description: The rimeblossom is a fragile flower yet it grows in the harshest of environments. Your spells are enchanting as they are unforgivingly cold.

name: Royal Raider (Armor)
description: Some pirates or muggers that steal enough gold often treat themselves to resemble royalty either to decorate their ships with extravagant riches or pass themselves off as upper class citizens to trick individuals into giving them a majority of their wealth willingly.

name: Royal Rimeblossom Enchanter (AC)
description: The rimeblossom is a fragile flower yet it grows in the harshest of environments. Your spells are enchanting as they are unforgivingly cold.

name: Royal Role Reversal Garb
description: Sometimes, you gotta save a dragon from a princess. What can ya do?

name: Royal Romance Garb
description: Undisputed proof that true love really does exist. Wear this armor to celebrate the love between Prince Jim and Princess Pam!

name: Royal Sandsea Guardian
description: The Pharaoh of the Sandsea's personal guards, honored with gold and white silk. Their skills in combat and magic are unmatched, and trusted to protect those Pharaoh Zhoom cares deeply for.

name: Royal Sandsea Guest
description: A noble guest from afar. The bands and factions of the Sandsea were distant for a time, but have come together to celebrate and protect life once more. (Color-customizable to Base, Accessory, Trim)

name: Royal Serpent Qi Pao
description: An outfit styled with the image of the calm and refined snake. Yokai Isle residents treat this garb with special respect because their beloved Empress is a descendant of the Jade Serpent. (CC To Base, Trim)

name: Royal Shadowscythe Visionary
description: Following the dissolution of the Alliance, a number of Swordhaven's Knights forsook their vows. With their true nature revealed, these Visionaries have gone on to become some of the Shadowscythe’s greatest warriors.

name: Royal Shadowslayer
description: When you are royalty, yet wish to be a Shadowslayer… you dress the part!

name: Royal Shockwave Scholar
description: The Scholars of the Storm Court marry magic to science, aiming to control the heavens with their inventions. In the service of their ruler, they seek to attain power that could overthrow the gods.

name: Royal Suit
description: The good sometimes like to dress up for special occasions… like battling the forces of EVIL!

name: Royal Summer Dream
description: A favorite outfit for young Swordhaven royals on summer break from Skyguard Academy.

name: Royal Summer Memory
description: A favorite outfit for young Swordhaven royals on summer break from Skyguard Academy.

name: Royal Swordhaven Adept
description: If you want to use the power of your magic for Good, the best place to study is with the Royal Swordhaven Mages. Learn all you can to protect Swordhaven and fight for Good!

name: Royal Swordhaven Guard
description: The Royal Guard of Swordhaven swear only one vow: to protect the royal family with their swords, shields, and lives. It is an honor to serve Good.

name: Royal Swordhaven Novice
description: If you want to use the power of your magic for Good, the best place to study is with the Royal Swordhaven Mages. Learn all you can to protect Swordhaven and fight for Good!

name: Royal Swordhaven Pendragon
description: The epitome of nobility and chivalry, the Swordhaven Pendragons are the perfect image of a pure knight. Upholding their ideals isn't easy. It requires complete dedication, and the sacrifice of all selfish wishes.

name: Royal Vampire Guard
description: They may have to keep an eye on the Elegant Vampires, but that doesn't mean they can't rock out to Alice in Chains too!

name: Royal Vampire Lord (Armor) (AC)
description: Vampire Lords rule over their sanguine servants and, feasting on the blood of mortals, they can live forever. Don't show one a mirror though, or you might not like what you don't see.

name: Royal Vampire Lord (Armor) (Merge)
description: Vampire Lords rule over their sanguine servants and, feasting on the blood of mortals, they can live forever. Don't show one a mirror though, or you might not like what you don't see.

name: Royal Vampire Renegade (0 AC)
description: When Vampires want a bit of flair in their wardrobe.

name: Royal Vampire Renegade (AC)
description: When Vampires want a bit of flair in their wardrobe.

name: Royal Warder
description: Defend the royal family with your blade… and your life!

name: Royal Wedding (Armor)
description: Can't look like a peasant when you're attending a royal wedding!

name: Royal Winter Paladin
description: These paladins traverse snowy wastelands to rescue those threatened by the unbearably long nights. Starlight and Avalanche are their weapons, and their people are their hope.

name: Royal Winter Shield Paladin
description: These paladins traverse snowy wastelands to rescue those threatened by the unbearably long nights. Starlight and Avalanche are their weapons, and their people are their hope.

name: Royal Yukata
description: The Empress' oracle has read your horoscope and declares: a benevolent ruler will seek your aid this year. A malevolent ruler will seek to destroy you. Be on guard.

name: Royalty of the Dunes
description: These regal nomads roam the Sandsea, seeking treasure where others have given up.

name: Rubro Forest Warrior
description: You unlocked this badge by purchasing an upgrade through Paymentez! Battle On!

name: Ruby Dragonhealer's Robes
description: Healers of Etherstorm are one with the Dragons and elements. These healers draw their power from Fire.

name: Ruby Dragonhealer Wanderer
description: These roaming Priests of Etherstorm are attuned to the land and the Dragons, helping those in need. These priests draw strength from Fire.

name: Ruby DragonTamer
description: Dark and mysterious, the Ruby DragonTamers are most at home in the dark fire lands where the slyest of dragons make their homes.

name: Ruby Kitsune Duelist
description: Before Chaos took over his mind, Lord Kitsune was a friend of the Yokai Isles' royalty. On rare occassions, he would teach his skills to worthy humans. With his fall, shame has retired most of his students.

name: Ruby Kitsune Duelist Plate
description: Before Chaos took over his mind, Lord Kitsune was a friend of the Yokai Isles' royalty. On rare occassions, he would teach his skills to worthy humans. With his fall, shame has retired most of his students.

name: Ruby SpellBlade
description: The heart of the flame burns brightest in those mages willing to sacrifice everything for their power.

name: Ruby Yokai Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: Empress Ai no Miko rules over Yokai Isle, and we serve her best by patrolling the seven seas, defending her people and homeland. For the honor of the Thousand Years throne, we sail on!

name: Ruby Yokai Pirate Captain (AC)
description: Empress Ai no Miko rules over Yokai Isle, and we serve her best by patrolling the seven seas, defending her people and homeland. For the honor of the Thousand Years throne, we sail on!

name: Rugged Shield Mercenary
description: A shield for hire, able to wield a sword if the client provides one. A drifter's life is rough but it tempers skill. This merc can crush a ten-man bandit attack to a pulpy mess.

name: Rugged Sword for Hire
description: A shield for hire, able to wield a sword if the client provides one. A drifter's life is rough but it tempers skill. This merc can crush a ten-man bandit attack to a pulpy mess.

name: Rugged Thief
description: Passersby will give you a wide berth. The cold glint in your eyes will frighten off children and young moglins.

name: Ruler of Darkness Armor
description: Once Heroes these beings fell into darkness never to come out.

name: Ruler Of The Deep
description: Waves crash and sea creatures obey the almighty Ruler of the Deep!

name: Rune Lord
description: Pay homage to the lord of the Northlands Warriors. He is the Spear Shaker, the Shield Breaker, and all who do battle honor him in this life… and (if they are worthy) in the next.

name: Rune Thief
description: Stealing has its charms. It's not a life for the fainthearted, nor the person not willing to work. You have to be willing to live on the street, eat what you can find and take what you need. But, it's a good life at times.

name: Runed Knight
description: You recovered this mysterious, runed armor after defeating Lord Reignolds in his lair. It pulses with a strange, unsettling power.

name: Runed Master Angler
description: Gritty, rugged and prepared for anything, this armor packs a punch on the most skilled fisherman's level. Need a hook? Got that. Need line? Got that too. Need muscle? Definitely got that…

name: Runehawk
description: A recreation of the uniforms worn by the members of the Runehawk's house. Full of wisdown, the mages of MechQuest search to learn what has happened to the dragons in their timeline.

name: Runehawk Shirt
description: Are you a fan of Runehawk? Wear this shirt with pride and represent your favorite house!

name: Rust Man
description: This once prestigious suit of heavy armor has fallen apart to the bare basics. Rust slowly consumes what is left. But rust cannot effect the heart of a true warrior!

name: Rustbucket Armor
description: For those times when you feel like a bucket of bolts.

name: Ryoku (Armor)
description: Now you look like a super… martial artist! Nothing can stop you now!

name: Ryuuji
description: The outfit Ryuuji wore on his wedding day. It's elegant enough for an elf and dignified enough for a dragon…and it makes a perfect fit if you're part of both!

name: S.S. Doom Captain (0 AC)
description: A forsaken voyager, doomed to spread terror across the seas. Though they sail for the Empire, their greed is all that's left of what once made them human.

name: S.S. Doom Captain (AC)
description: A forsaken voyager, doomed to spread terror across the seas. Though they sail for the Empire, their greed is all that's left of what once made them human.

name: S.S. Phantom Blood Captain (0 AC)
description: An elegant pirate from a bygone golden age. They sail a massive ship that should have been sunk by the collective effort of several navies. But, ghosts can't die.

name: S.S. Phantom Blood Captain (AC)
description: An elegant pirate from a bygone golden age. They sail a massive ship that should have been sunk by the collective effort of several navies. But, ghosts can't die.

name: Saci's Human Form
description: Usually seen as a one-legged human or within a tornado, Saci is a trickster who usually targets farms.

name: Sacred Forest Dragon
description: This is a humanoid form taken by Sacred Forest Dragons to communicate with druids and promising adventurers. They bestow blessings of abundance on those who respect and revere Nature.

name: Sael and Klyde Morphs
description: Journey through the planetary system of Za'nar as Sael or Klyde, two of the Za'narian Magi from Zack Storch's novel "Za'nar: Impossibility"!

name: Safety Swim Suit (0 AC)
description: Slip into Summer safely with the Safety swim suit armor. It's got a real a-PEEL.

name: Safety Swim Suit (AC)
description: Slip into Summer safely with the Safety swim suit armor. It's got a real a-PEEL.

name: Safiria Rose Tribute Armor
description: Safiria is the queen of all vampires and she has no problems adding you to her army.

name: Safiria Tribute Armor
description: Safiria is the queen of all vampires and she has no problems adding you to her army.

name: Sage Armor
description: Threads that have recreated from samples obtained from the Lore of Adventure Quest. A color customizable robe, this outfit was once worn by Sage Uldor, a blind swindler whose tactics and treachery are infamous throughout the Lore of AQ.

name: Sage of Revontheus
description: Worn by the Sage of Revontheus, those robes act as a boarding pass into the Underworld.

name: Sailor Mate
description: All hands on deck! What is a ship without its crew? A large sea dwelling vessel - thats what!

name: Sakura Blossom Attire
description: Celebrate the Season of Love with this gorgeous outfit seemingly made of cherry blossoms.

name: Sakura Blossom Kimono
description: Sakura blossoms

name: Sakura Cryomancer (Armor)
description: The pink never bothered you anyway. (And to everyone who rolled their eyes reading this, let it go.) (Inspired by fellow AQW hero, Penolia)

name: Sakura Dragon Spirit
description: Dragons symbolize honour, strength, power, and good fortune. Dragons are divine creatures of myth and legend, and are as brave as they are fearless. The pink Dragon Spirit is said to represent Samurai warriors who fell in battle.

name: Sakura Dragonborn Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: What, you've never seen a dragon this pink and kawaii before? Where have you been living for the past 9 years? This bold an brash color is Beleen approved!

name: Sakura Dragonborn Naval Commander (AC)
description: What, you've never seen a dragon this pink and kawaii before? Where have you been living for the past 9 years? This bold an brash color is Beleen approved!

name: Sakura Fairy in Shadow

name: Sakura Kimono
description: Float on the wind like the sakura blossom… drift into the hearts of your enemies as gently as the breeze. Then slay them when they aren't looking!

name: Sakura Sorceress
description: So scarlet red isn't your color? Well thankfully the Sorceress had some other colors made.

name: Salek Lifeform
description: The doctor doesn't know what's causing it, but your blood pressure's through the roof!

name: Samarian
description: Krom! These barbarians work as mercenaries and look to create their own kingdom. Their loyalties lie with no one but their own.

name: Sambista Armor
description: Vamos, Sambista: é hora de dançar, festejar, lutar! Força!

name: Samurai Abaddon Fiend (0 AC)
description: A samurai need only conduct themselves honorably for their master. The Archfiend's defnition of honor is destructive and merciless. As long as the terms of the contract are upheld, anything goes.

name: Samurai Abaddon Fiend (AC)
description: A samurai need only conduct themselves honorably for their master. The Archfiend's defnition of honor is destructive and merciless. As long as the terms of the contract are upheld, anything goes.

name: Samurai Armor
description: This is the armor of a legendary warrior, whose faith, dedication and honor changed the way a whole nation thinks. Armor design inspired by RedWolf EADS.

name: Samurai Lagomorph
description: Honour-bound and ready to go, this lagomorph armor is perfect for living up to the expectation that every battle is one-sided… yours! Make your enemies regret being on the wrong side.

name: Samurai Panda
description: Strange things happen on Yokai Isle… Even the pandas can become Samuari!

name: Samurai Seraph
description: These sword bearing warriors of the Seraph both honor and respect Laken to the end.

name: Sanctified Arbiter
description: Paladins are known to be good, trustworthy, and fair. The Sanctified Arbiters are an corps of Paladins who travel the land dispensing justice and righting wrongs.

name: Sanctified Armor
description: This armor has fallen from the gilded sky kingdoms.

name: Sand Bandit
description: The bandits roaming the endless dunes of the Sandsea desert are fierce, deadly, and mortal enemies of the SandSea Guardians!

name: Sand Golem
description: Formed from the essence of your dreams, the Sand Golem has come to life to inhabit your waking world.

name: Sandrunner
description: Knavish by nature, Sandrunners are quick and stealthy warriors who know the endless desert sands better than anyone else.

name: Sandsea Blaster Bandit
description: You fight when the necessity arises. No matter the mood, the monster, or mission.

name: Sandsea Ceremonial Attire
description: Formal attire fitted for the marriage of a Djinn Realm Guardian and a Princess. When they're together, they shine brighter than the sun.

name: Sandsea Dune Strider
description: Pumpkin spice can only be found deep beneath the desert dunes of the Sandsea. Striders are tasked with recovering it and ensuring the supply continues to flow to the rest of Lore.

name: Sandsea Enchanter (AC)
description: These sleek sorcerer's of the Sandsea will cast a spell on you using their enchantments.

name: Sandsea Enchanter (Legend)
description: These sleek sorcerer's of the Sandsea will cast a spell on you using their enchantments.

name: Sandsea General's Armor
description: Charged with overseeing the defense of the Sandsea, the Sandsea Generals are the highest ranking of the Sandsea military.

name: SandSea Guardian
description: The Sandsea Guardian is a member of the elite Oasis Defense Force. Their armor helms helps them blend in with the dunes, making attacking their enemies much easier.

name: Sandsea HarpySlayer
description: A special unit of assassins answering only to the Sandsea Generals, these HarpySlayer's are sent after only the most difficult of foes.

name: Sandsea Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: You would not expect the Sandsea to have a Navy, but you would be wrong! Sail over sand dunes on magic carpets sail as you track down pirates burying their loot… then strike, steal, and savor your victory!

name: Sandsea Naval Commander (AC)
description: You would not expect the Sandsea to have a Navy, but you would be wrong! Sail over sand dunes on magic carpets sail as you track down pirates burying their loot… then strike, steal, and savor your victory!

name: SandStalker (Armor)
description: Become one of the SandStalkers – ferocious warriors of the Desert.

name: Sandy Chic Swimwear (AC)
description: Fashion forward and safety conscious! What more could a hero ask for from their swimgear?

name: Sanguine's Armor
description: The high-ranking armor of the Charroupted Vampiric Knights. You no longer experience fear, for how can anyone kill that which is immortal?

name: Sanguine Shield
description: The Sanguine Shields serve royal bodyguards for Vampire Queen Safiria. They are some of her most loyal devotees.

name: Sanguine Vampire (AC)

name: Sanguine Vampire (Legend)
description: To truly experience the life of a Vampire, one must dress the part.

description: The vindication continues… even across the seven seas!

description: The sorcerer's scarlet flames' burn is enduring. It could be reduced to a smouldering ember, stamped on over and over, but never be snuffed out. Once they light a fire, it will burn forever.

name: Scarlet Sorceress Armor (0 AC)

description: All robots know that a mastery of SCIENCE is a requirement!

description: ﻿This disgraced pyromancer became the bane and worst fear of their venerated lineage.

description: A horrifying fate that could've come to be if you didn't save Warlic. Normally, fire couldn't hurt the Blue Mage. These flames, fueled by the ashes of dead gods, were ignited solely to kill the both of you.

description: A lovely gold and red armor fitting for the Archer's of Pyrewatch

name: Scotty Sneevil (Armor)
description: Don't hold it against them.

description: There are certain times of year when the need to SCREAM (and make others do it too) is totally ok!

name: Scroll Keeper (Armor)
description: Found in the lair of the saurian Scroll Keepers deep in Maloth's Labyrinth, this seems to indicate that either the Scroll Keepers weren't always just Draconian… or that they've morphed over time. Interesting!

name: Scrooge Mcluck
description: Dressed up and everywhere to be, this dapper armor will not only make you feel important, but look the part as you dismantle every enemy that comes your way. Who said you can't look good while fighting?

name: Scrooged Warrior
description: NO ONE will receive a gift I was deemed "naughty" by some overweight frosted jerk!

name: SCUBA Paladin
description: The path to success is full of unseen pools of failure. Winners just strap their scuba gear on and use their time underwater to find new opportunities to succeed!

description: Don't be fooled by all those "good for you" organic warning labels on your food (and enemies). Seedspitters are proof that nature can AND WILL kill.

name: Sek-Duat (Armor)
description: The royal armors and dressings of the Pharaoh are now yours. I just hope these bandages are new ones and not the ones he was already wearing. Eeeeew.

name: Sentinel of Destiny (AC)
description: Forged from brilliant gold and radiant stell, you are bound to fight for Good, and to ensure the whole Realm knows that Destiny is not chosen… it is enforced.

name: Sepulchure's DoomKnight Armor

description: The time is now, Dage must fall and you will be part of the battle!

description: Seraphic Fourth Order members are enhanced with cybernetics. They are the sheathes of their own weapons, becoming one with the Fourth themselves.

name: Seraphic Grave Digger
description: Just because ones name is associated with celestial beings doens't always mean one acts that way. The best ones really dig their jobs.

description: Sly gunmen devoted to Laken don't need a dime; only their leader's loyalty and stolen Legion treasures in exchange for their services.

description: Sly gunmen devoted to Laken don't need a dime; only their leader's loyalty and stolen Legion treasures in exchange for their services.

description: Ahoy! Crewmates in Lolosia have waited seven years for the Seven Seas Naval Commander to arrive. Take care around this commander, or you'll need to walk the plank.

description: Live a life full of color, happiness, joy, and pride. Battle On!

name: Shadow Brawler
description: You are a warrior specializing in close quarters combat hidden under the veil of night.

description: Those who study the magics of the ShadowFlame slowly begin to become one with them.

name: Shadowflame Warrior (Armor) (1)
description: Warriors of the Shadowflame army vow to follow Malgor, the ShadowFlame, into the darkness and through time and eternity. They await the ultimate victory… and their rewards.

name: ShadowFlame Warrior (Armor) (2)
description: Malgor's darkness has spread and totally corrupted this once-proud and independent warrior.

name: Shadowforce Commander (Armor)
description: The power of darkness will ensure our victory. With it, the Queen of Monsters cannot take over our world!

name: ShadowKage
description: The ShadowKage have the power to coalesce lightning from the air around them.

name: ShadowKage Hero
description: The ShadowKage have the power to coalesce lightning from the air around them.

name: ShadowLord Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Through fire and flame, you sail the streams of time and space, looting, pillaging, and enforcing your will upon this world… and ALL the worlds!

name: ShadowLord Naval Commander (AC)
description: Through fire and flame, you sail the streams of time and space, looting, pillaging, and enforcing your will upon this world… and ALL the worlds!

name: Shadowmage Assassin
description: Can you still be an assassin if you're clad in heavy armor and are still clearly visible? I suppose if they kill the target, an assassin can wear whatever they want to.

name: ShadowMech BattleSuit (0 AC)
description: Graduates of GEARS University would save for YEARS in order to afford a ShadowMech BattleSuit and its accoutrements. The schematics of the great were thought lost… until now.

name: ShadowMech BattleSuit (AC)
description: Graduates of GEARS University would save for YEARS in order to afford a ShadowMech BattleSuit and its accoutrements. The schematics of the great were thought lost… until now.

name: ShadowMummy
description: *No description*

name: ShadowRender
description: The battle for control of the Underworld has awoken things previously not seen in Lore. The ShadowRenders appeared after Gravelyn used the Doomblade to break free of the shadows. From where, we are not sure…

name: ShadowRipper
description: The battle for control of the Underworld has awoken things previously not seen in Lore. The ShadowRippers appeared after Gravelyn used the Doomblade to break free of the shadows. From where, we are not sure…

name: Shadowrise Tower Guard
description: For the Shadowscythe! You fought against the forces of Good and Chaos so the Empress Gravelyn may rule Lore!

name: ShadowScale Street Brawler
description: Slithering through the shadowy back alleys of Akiba, the rogues of the ShadowSnake Clan live outside the law… but remain loyal to the Empress, a descendent of the Jade Serpent Prince.

name: Shadowscythe Admiral
description: ﻿Dead men tell tale of the Shadowscythe's naval fleet, dragging bones out of their watery graves and into the ranks of the Empire.

name: Shadowscythe Assassin
description: Only the most elite assassins may be a part of the Shadowscythe. Do not disappoint the Empress.

name: ShadowScythe BattleMage (1)
description: A terrifying battlesuit worn by elite but scorned BattleMage's that set out on multiple conquests across Lore to wreak destruction and mayhem on the homes of innocent lives.

name: Shadowscythe Battlemage (2)
description: Using spells calling on the Shadow, these Battlemages are feared throughout the lighter parts of Lore

name: ShadowScythe BladeMaster
description: Shadowy Assassins of the Shadowssythe. Said to have trained under Empress Gravelyn and honed their skills with the Undead Legion's generals. They're faster than the flickers of Shadow, feared even by the immortal.

name: Shadowscythe Cannoneer
description: Use your mecha power to slay the Chaorrupted creatures of Lore!

name: ShadowScythe DIE Fighter
description: Support the ShadowScythe Empire… in space! (Suggestion: for best screenshots, unequip helm and choose 'bald' hair option)

name: ShadowScythe DoomLord
description: You like DOOM? I heard you like DOOM. Get your maximum DOOOOOM with the DoomLord, and LONG UN-LIVE THE SHADOWSCYTHE! Warning: Contains DOOM

name: ShadowScythe Dragonlord
description: To be ShadowScythe AND a Dragonlord is truly an accomplishment not many can accomplish.

name: ShadowScythe Empire Lounger (0 AC)
description: The elite of the Shadowscythe Empire are treated well. They get their own private beach to kick back, relax, and make low-performing minions fetch coconuts.

name: ShadowScythe Empire Lounger (AC)
description: The elite of the Shadowscythe Empire are treated well. They get their own private beach to kick back, relax, and make low-performing minions fetch coconuts.

name: ShadowScythe Fiend of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: No Doomknight had ever garnered the Archfiend's respect until the present day. Born from the Nation and Shadowscythe's mutual respect were warriors who rend Light and command the Shadows.

name: ShadowScythe Fiend of Nulgath (AC)
description: No Doomknight had ever garnered the Archfiend's respect until the present day. Born from the Nation and Shadowscythe's mutual respect were warriors who rend Light and command the Shadows.

name: ShadowScythe Fleet Commander
description: YARRRR! Hoist th' Pirate Flags of DOOOOOM and terrify your enemies no matter where you face them: on land, by sea, or sailing the dark waters of the underworld!

name: ShadowScythe General Armor
description: By the power of Noxus, you have been reborn as an Undead General! Paladins, Lightcasters and even High Lords tremble at your dark presence.

name: Shadowscythe General (Armor) (AC)
description: By the power of Noxus, you have been reborn as an Undead General! Paladins, Lightcasters and even High Lords tremble at your dark presence.

name: Shadowscythe Gryphon (Armor)
description: These majestic Gryphons are the perfect ride for any Shadowscythe on land or in the air.

name: Shadowscythe Guard (Armor)
description: So you want to tame a creature that's half lion half eagle? Only the best get the title of "Rider". Hang on!

name: ShadowScythe Healer
description: These Healers have chosen to follow the ShadowScythe. Standing back from the front lines, they will ensure those fighting in the name of Darkness are able to battle as long as possible. For the ShadowScythe!

name: ShadowScythe Knight
description: A terrifying battlesuit worn by elite but scorned knights that set out on multiple conquests across Lore to wreak destruction and mayhem on the homes of innocent lives.

name: ShadowScythe Mage
description: These Mages have chosen to follow the ShadowScythe. Standing back from the front lines, they will use anything in their power to get the job done. For the ShadowScythe!

name: Shadowscythe Mecha suit
description: So mysterious! So otherworldly! Should this even be here?

name: ShadowScythe Paragon
description: I am neither Dage nor Sepulchure! I am the one who will defeat you… and everyone else that stands in my way!

name: ShadowScythe Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: Some of Gravelyn's soldiers have stolen away to a life of piracy on the high seas! Avast!

name: ShadowScythe Pirate Captain (AC)
description: Some of Gravelyn's soldiers have stolen away to a life of piracy on the high seas! Avast!

name: ShadowScythe Pirate Commander
description: YARRRR! Hoist th' Pirate Flags of DOOOOOM and terrify your enemies no matter where you face them: on land, by sea, or sailing the dark waters of the underworld!

name: Shadowscythe Reaver (1)
description: These are the elite shock troopers of the Shadowscythe. Fearless in battle, they wreak havoc upon the front line of any army who dares stand against their might.

name: Shadowscythe Reaver (2)
description: After the "death" of Sepulchure these warrior were left without a master. Now they stand to bring glory back to Shadowfall.

name: Shadowscythe Rocker
description: Considered punks even by their own Empire. Their concerts are very underground, but the crashing sounds, growls, and screams will shake you in your grave.

name: ShadowScythe Rogue
description: These Rogues have chosen to follow the ShadowScythe. Sneaking around the shadows, they will do anything to get the job done. For the ShadowScythe!

name: ShadowScythe Ruler (0 AC)
description: Long Unlive the Shadowscythe! Their Ruler will dominate the Shadows and conquer the Light! Why not wear this and play on the throne for a day? You've got enough good (evil) will to get Gravelyn's permission.

name: ShadowScythe Ruler (AC)
description: Long Unlive the Shadowscythe! Their Ruler will dominate the Shadows and conquer the Light! Why not wear this and play on the throne for a day? You've got enough good (evil) will to get Gravelyn's permission.

name: ShadowScythe Seer
description: The ShadowScythe Seer uses their powers only for evil, to ensure that Gravelyn's Empire remains unbroken.

name: Shadowscythe Shirt
description: 103% Cotton-poly blend Artix Ent shirts will NOT protect you from bad puns, dad jokes or geese in a fowl mood. They WILL protect you from lack of style and bad fashion choices.

name: Shadowscythe Sorcerer
description: Sorcerers who support the Shadowscythe are among the deadliest in Lore. Hiding their faces, they move among the rest of the army without anyone knowing who they are.

name: Shadowscythe Stranger
description: Who is this stranger? They only appear near Father's Day… I wonder if Sepulchure has anything to do with this.

name: Shadowscythe Surfer
description: Surf your way across Lolosia Bay and hang ten with the braken!

name: Shadowscythe Templar
description: Sworn to protect Shadowfall at all costs, these distinguished warriors are held to the highest standard.

name: Shadowscythe Trooper
description: Warriors of Lore who have turned to Evil have become the Shadowscythe Troopers. These are the first into battle, and will take devastating losses to get the job done. For the ShadowScythe!

name: Shadowscythe Visionary
description: Following the dissolution of the Alliance, a number of Swordhaven's Knights forsook their vows. With their true nature revealed, these Visionaries have gone on to become some of the Shadowscythe’s greatest warriors.

name: ShadowScythe Warlock
description: Using the power of the Shadows, these mages serve Gravelyn and the ShadowScythe in the battle against Malgor.

name: ShadowScythe Warrior (Armor)
description: Ever wondered what it would be like to serve Gravelyn and the ShadowScythe? Wonder no more! You're now a warrior and will spend an eternity serving.

name: Shadowslasher Warrior
description: Harness the power of the shadows to dim the shine on your armor. Sneak up on your opponents and crush them before they can attack you first!

name: ShadowSlayer Adept
description: ShadowSlayers that have been on the hunt for over a decade are given the title of Adept. The life expectancy of anyone in their profession is ruefully short. They've gone beyond, and became the Death that preys on Darkness.

name: Shadowslayer Armor
description: Only those select few who have proven themselves to Shadowslayer elites may wear these clothes. You should be honored!

name: ShadowSlayer Leathers
description: This tasteful armor combines locally-tanned leather with shadow-tempered steel, offering protection and stealth for those guarding the feast from lurking darkness.

name: ShadowSlayer Mendicant
description: ShadowSlayers who dedicate themselves to seeking cures as well as the hunt. If Vampirism and Lycanthropy can be eradicated, the Darkness will recede. That future, however, is a long journey away.

name: ShadowSlayer's Apprentice
description: You've proven to ShadowSlayer K that you have the skill and tenacity to become a ShadowSlayer's Apprentice. Maybe one day you will be a full ShadowSlayer.

name: Shadowsleigher
description: SLAY bells ring, are you listenin'? (Your opponnents are, because it means you're here, and they're DOOMED!)

name: Shadowslicer Rogue
description: Slide through the shadows stealithy to cut your enemies down before they even know you're there!

name: ShadowSnake Rider
description: Slithering through the shadowy back alleys of Akiba, the rogues of the ShadowSnake Clan live outside the law… but remain loyal to the Empress, a descendent of the Jade Serpent Prince.

name: ShadowSnake Streetwear
description: Slithering through the shadows of Akiba City, the rogues of the ShadowSnake Clan roam the streets, seeking out those who would harm their royal mistress.

name: ShadowSnow Warrior
description: Lingering in the shadows, the ShadowSnow Warriors are ready to feast upon your cold and lifeless bodies.

name: Shadowsong Rocker
description: Rock out while keeping Mythsong free of invaders!

name: Shadowspace Crewman
description: ﻿Travelling outside the bounds of Lore to the unknown is a dangerous, yet it calls to the adventurous and ambitious. They risk everything to seek what treasures lay where no soul has trodden.

name: Shadowspace Empire Crewman
description: ﻿In service of the Shadowscythe, the crewman embark on a conquest of the unknown outside the bounds of Lore. Their souls belong to the Empire, even when lost drifting in rifts.

name: Shadowspawn Warrior (Armor)
description: Steal through the shadows to be the first to grab the loot… just make sure you earn it first!

name: ShadowStalker of Time (Armor)
description: What IS a ShadoStalker ShadowStalker of Time, you ask? Good question! These intrepid, timely explorers can step into a shadow in one time-stream and emerge from a completely different shadow in another time stream.

name: ShadowStealer
description: Helpful for sneaking through the shadows in Ebonslate.

name: ShadowSteel Paragon Mk 3025 (0 AC)
description: Fight for the future! And that future is Dage and the Legion!

name: ShadowSteel Paragon Mk 3025 (AC)
description: Fight for the future! And that future is Dage and the Legion!

name: ShadowStrike Champion
description: When there's not enough excitement in Ryostiff, then there comes a time when a black knight takes its stead, makes some mischief, and avoid getting caught.

name: ShadowStrike General
description: When there's not enough excitement in Ryostiff, then there comes a time when a black knight takes its stead, makes some mischief, and avoid getting caught.

name: ShadowStrike Guard
description: When there's not enough excitement in Ryostiff, then there comes a time when a black knight takes its stead, makes some mischief, and avoid getting caught.

name: Shadowstrike Mystic (0 AC)
description: These Mystics were once monks who pursued ascension through tranquility and peace, releasing all worldly connections. Striding upon the path of death, though reviled and scorned, they achieved their goal.

name: Shadowstrike Mystic (AC)
description: These Mystics were once monks who pursued ascension through tranquility and peace, releasing all worldly connections. Striding upon the path of death, though reviled and scorned, they achieved their goal.

name: ShadowStrike Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Through fire and flame, you sail the streams of time and space, looting, pillaging, and enforcing your will upon this world… and ALL the worlds! (CC to Trim)

name: ShadowStrike Naval Commander (AC)
description: Through fire and flame, you sail the streams of time and space, looting, pillaging, and enforcing your will upon this world… and ALL the worlds! (CC to Trim)

name: ShadowWalker of Time (Armor)
description: A mysterious chronomage is never too early or too late to deal with their affairs; they always arive right on time.

name: ShadowWeaver of Time Armor
description: These intrepid, timely explorers can step into a shadow in one time-stream and emerge from a completely different shadow in another time stream.

name: Shadowy Dark Gunner
description: Gun down your opponent in style with the Shadowed Dark Gunner! (All other heroes in the room can see the transformation!)

name: Shadowy Fiend Costume
description: You stalk the night, taking down prey before they even know you're there. And you look FANTASTIC doing it!

name: Shadowy Mad Scientist (0 AC)
description: AHAHAHAHAHA! SHADOW SCIENCE!!!

name: Shadowy Mad Scientist (AC)
description: AHAHAHAHAHA! SHADOW SCIENCE!!!

name: Shadowy Swank Valentine (0 AC)
description: Black tie affair? How elegant! You command attention at every party rocking this classy tux.

name: Shadowy Swank Valentine (AC)
description: Black tie affair? How elegant! You command attention at every party rocking this classy tux.

name: ShadowZard Mount Armor (AC)
description: Protect Shadowfall and the Empress as you ride into battle on your ShadowScythe Zard!

name: ShadowZard Mount Armor (Special)
description: Protect Shadowfall and the Empress as you ride into battle on your Shadowscythe Zard!

name: ShadowZard Rider (AC)
description: Protect Shadowfall and the Empress as you ride into battle.

name: ShadowZard Rider (Special)
description: Protect Shadowfall and the Empress as you ride into battle.

name: Shaman Armor
description: Shamans share a deep connection with Lore's four main Elements, enabling their robes to be completely color customizable. Commanding their primal instincts in battle leads these magic mavens to victory.

name: Shaman Slayer of Gibazil
description: Using part of YOUR OWN data and soul, Gibazil generates a true copy of Gi Zeba-Zu's robes for you. Are you prepared to start an assassination game against Arcangrove's shamans?

name: Shamanic Summoner
description: The vast wild is the cheapest boutique you can find anytime, anywhere. Not only are there so many leaves to choose from, but different colors of mud make neat tattoos.

name: Shark Bait's Armor
description: Get chummy with your friends in this shark bait armor! Not recommended for in-home aquarium use.

name: SharkCaster
description: Leeeee gionnnnn shark doo doo doo doo doo doo Legion shark doo doo doo doo doo doo Legion shark doo doo doo doo doo doo Legion shark!

name: Sharkless Pirate Angler
description: Nothing is sadder than a pirate angler who hasn’t caught a shark.

name: Sheevra Armor
description: What better way to blend in at the Sheevra Masquerade party than dressing like a Scriptkeeper?

name: Sheevra Masquerade
description: Mogloween Dress-Up done fancy.

name: Sheng Chi Guardian (Armor)
description: A healthy flow of chi is as vital to the body as food and water.

name: Sheng Long Guardian (Armor)
description: You are the master of storms and bringer of drought, those around are careful not to offend you.

name: Shielded Centurion
description: The weak will be crushed and the strong will prevail.

name: Shielded Centurion Armor
description: The Golden Centurions are soldiers from a fabled sunken city. Their shields were said to even withstand magical arrows.

name: Shielded DragonKnight
description: The knights are special, they command dragons along with hamessing all the power that Nulgath bestows on his Voids.

name: Shielded DragonLord
description: The power of the Voids along with harnessing the strength of dragons given to DragonLords? Now that is a combination straight out of the Void.

name: Shielded Obsidian Paladin Chronomancer
description: Stopping time does not halt the corrosion of the soul. Obsidian Paladin Chronomancers are the result of an eternity on duty. The blackened armor is a symbol of honor and sacrifice.

name: Shielded Paladin Chronomancer
description: With their mighty hammer and shield in hand, Paladin Chronomancers lead the charge into battle, vowing to protect all who fight alongside them.

name: Shielded Primal Hanzo Void
description: These imperial Voids of Nulgath's army possess qualities that normal primal Voids do not have, hence why they are prized by the ArchFiend.

name: Shielded Sentinel of Destiny (0 AC)
description: Forged from brilliant gold and radiant stell, you are bound to fight for Good, and to ensure the whole Realm knows that Destiny is not chosen… it is enforced.

name: Shielded Sentinel of Destiny (AC)
description: Forged from brilliant gold and radiant stell, you are bound to fight for Good, and to ensure the whole Realm knows that Destiny is not chosen… it is enforced.

name: Shielded Shadow Knight (0 AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Shielded Shadow Knight (AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Shielded Void Awakening (AC)
description: The final stage of the Void. Stronger, more powerful, these fiends of the nation have final awoken their true form.

name: Shielded Void Awakening (Special)
description: The final stage of the Void. Stronger, more powerful, these fiends of the nation have final awoken their true form.

name: Shielded Void Rebirth (AC)
description: Witness the rebirth of the Void!

name: Shielded Void Rebirth (Special)
description: Witness the rebirth of the Void!

name: Shimazu's Guard
description: Shimazu the Defiler was awakened by Malgor, but has proven to be no match for your might!

name: Shimazu's Warrior
description: Shimazu the Defiler was awakened by Malgor, but has proven to be no match for your might!

name: Shimmer Moon Mariner
description: In the name of the shimmering night, I'm gonna make you see stars! (Item is color customizable)

name: Shimmering Mirror Mage
description: Formerly worn by acolytes of Scarletta before her transformation, their purpose is to scoop as much sand as possible to create glass needed to make new mirrors in case one vanishes. Now the power in these robes is used for convenient mirrorsmithing.

name: Shining Champion
description: The reflecting light that brightens the metallic silver that comprises this regal suit acts as a mirror, but what it reveals cannot be seen in plain mind, but rather by a sharp minded subconscious.

name: Shinobi Armor
description: Elite Ninja warriors wear raiment that allows them to move freely in any direction - so you never know from where they will attack!

name: Shinobi Pirate Master
description: Depending on who's paying, they should be on royal Yokai Isles business, or looking to make gold off of family feuds. Either way, you'll never see them or their ship until you're blinded by your own blood.

name: Shinobi Senshi (AC)
description: Ninjas have evolved! The Shinobi Senshi are an elite sect of ninja warriors who are known — and feared — for their unmatched stealth and speed combined with their brutal battle tactics.

name: Shinobi Senshi (Legend)
description: Ninjas have evolved! The Shinobi Senshi are an elite sect of ninja warriors who are known — and feared — for their unmatched stealth and speed combined with their brutal battle tactics.

name: Shinobi X
description: Elite Ninja warriors wear raiment that allows them to move freely in any direction - so you never know from where they will attack!

name: Shipwrecked Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: Once Captains of the great ships that now lay at the bottom of Davy Jones' locker these pirates now be looking for turtles to strap to their feet.

name: Shipwrecked Pirate Captain (AC)
description: Once Captains of the great ships that now lay at the bottom of Davy Jones' locker these pirates now be looking for turtles to strap to their feet.

name: Shockwave Scholar
description: The Scholars of the Storm Court marry magic to science, aiming to control the heavens with their inventions. In the service of their ruler, they seek to attain power that could overthrow the gods.

name: Shogun of Shadows
description: Fade into the night, these stealthy warrors lurk in the shadows.

name: ShoGunslinger
description: *No description*

name: Shrade Armor
description: You can dress up just like Mort and Swaggy did!

name: ShroomKnight
description: Most heroes believe the ShroomKnight shows little sympathy for humans. But once you get to know him, he's really a fungi.

name: Shub Thalassarath Pirate (0 AC)
description: ﻿﻿Pirates who appear when the sunset flashes green. Feared and reviled, they are said to carry a piece of a wrathful undead sea monster's heart in their chest. It spreads as the pirate's greed eats the sea.

name: Shub Thalassarath Pirate (AC)
description: ﻿﻿Pirates who appear when the sunset flashes green. Feared and reviled, they are said to carry a piece of a wrathful undead sea monster's heart in their chest. It spreads as the pirate's greed eats the sea.

name: Sidhe of the Shadows (0 AC)
description: Leanan Sidhe is a fairy that preys on artists, poets, and heroes. She inspires them, guiding her darlings to fame and fortune. In return, she devours their lifeforce. Brilliant stars die young and beautiful.

name: Sidhe of the Shadows (AC)
description: Leanan Sidhe is a fairy that preys on artists, poets, and heroes. She inspires them, guiding her darlings to fame and fortune. In return, she devours their lifeforce. Brilliant stars die young and beautiful.

name: Sidhe's Brigand Devotee
description: How did a lowly sailor suddenly commandeer a fleet of ships, and rule the seas for ten deadly years? Swords and cannon fire couldn't do them in. Their legend ended with them wasting away, listening to sweet nothings.

name: Sidhe's Devotee (Armor)
description: Ordinary people given a glance by Leanan Sidhe are blessed with inspiration and unlimited potential. They will die young, and be remembered forever.

name: Silent Angel of Revontheus (0 AC)
description: A collector of broken and mangled souls who are unable to pass on through natural means. No one knows if they're mortals with dark inclinations, or servants of a greater force.

name: Silent Angel of Revontheus (AC)
description: A collector of broken and mangled souls who are unable to pass on through natural means. No one knows if they're mortals with dark inclinations, or servants of a greater force.

name: Silent Angel of Revontheus (Legend)
description: A collector of broken and mangled souls who are unable to pass on through natural means. No one knows if they're mortals with dark inclinations, or servants of a greater force.

name: Silent Sentinel
description: Standing resolute and waiting, the Silent Sentinel has the discipline to wait for the most opportune time to strike. Just… don't walk in front of the Hero that wears this armor and make funny faces to try and distract him or her. We can't be held liable for what ensues.

name: Silent Wanderer
description: Hands safe in their kimonos, these wanderers drift through Yokai offering cutting comments on your hairs… while blindfolded. No Thanks!

name: Silent Water
description: The spirit of the Waters made a deal to be darker and stronger. This armor is a memory of the day it all happened. If you can handle it, then take it. Otherwise, run for your life.

name: Silly Karrot (Armor)
description: Sometimes life is too uncertain to have regrets. That's why ordinary people depend on heroes like you.

name: Silphium Alchemist
description: Don't underestimate the power of love. Spells and potions that deal with matters of the heart can build civilizations, or destroy them. The Silphium Alchemist specializes in this ancient magic, and has the charm to match.

name: Silver Azurite Armor
description: If you have to fight,you fight in style. Take this armor for a spin and just see how incredibly wonderful you are while kicking butt and taking names. Watch your enemies fa—— Oh! Shiny! *chases*

name: Silver ChronoGuardian
description: A strange voice whispers in your head… Tempora mutantur et nos mutamur in illis.

name: Silver Cyborg Monk
description: Individuals enhanced by cybernetics that have mastered multiple martial arts. This form does not need rest or sustenance. It exists to achieve the highest of physical peaks.

name: Silver DeathKnight Lord
description: This armor once belonged to the infamous Flester the Silver. Keep a bottle of polish on hand though.

name: Silver Dream Guardian
description: There are many creatures that stalk the lands of the Djinn Realm, and the Guardians of the Dream Palace protect all who dwell within.

name: Silver Enchanted Pyromancer
description: AHAHAH! BURN THE WORLD! BURN IT ALL DOWN! NO REMORSE NO REGRET JUST FIRE! AHAHAHA (This item is color customizable.)

name: Silver Exalted Paladin
description: Unfortunately, Trolle'din died when a foe told him his shoelace was untied. Down he looked, to double-check, and his enemy took off his head - at the neck!

name: Silver Falcon Commander
description: Much like a falcon, those that uphold the darkest, negative aspect of this predator are stubborn, deceitful, sly, and cowardly to dive head-on into the spirit of the most dangerous of battles.

name: Silver GunSmith
description: Thanks to enven, You'll be a knight in shining platemail when you equip this awesome silver armor! All you need is a white charger and a steel blade before you're ready to rescue damsels- or dudes- in distress!

name: Silver Iron Warrior
description: Remember: in a fantasy game, it’s always a good idea to bring a Blaster Beam to a blade fight, so become the Iron Warrior you never expected to be!

name: Silver Party Outfit
description: Party all night long in this sparkling silver outfit!

name: Silver Pisces Maestro
description: Picses, the mutable water sign. Those born under its sign are compassionate, artistic, and wise. Their thoughs and feelings are carried in their songs, and touch the heart.

name: Silver Rainment of the Black Dragon
description: Harderned by strife and battle, this living armor shows its true colors when the right Hero puts it on. Build the confidence of your allies and yourself, while tearing down the confidences of the enemy.

name: Silver Savior of Battleon
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Silver Serpent Qi Pao
description: An outfit styled with the image of the calm and refined snake. Yokai Isle residents treat this garb with special respect because their beloved Empress is a descendant of the Jade Serpent. (CC To Base, Accessory)

name: Silver Swashbuckler
description: These swashbucklers comandeered a forge from the mountains of Dwarfhold and installed it into a ship. Controlling a crew of metal men, the captain commands a vessel that can tear the sea from above and below.

name: Silver Valentine Warrior
description: Sterling silver armor fit only for the most romantic of knights!

name: Silver Vindicator Recruit
description: The lowest rank, recruits have just started learning the way of the Vindicator. As conscripts, they are eligible to wear the Silver Vindicator Gear.

name: Silver Vindicator Soldier
description: As they move up the ranks, these conscripted recruits become full Vindicator Soldiers, showing their ever-increasing knowledge of the Vindicators.

name: Silver Wedding Guest
description: One must ALWAYS dress one's best when attending the wedding of one's creator!

name: Silver Xmas Cutie
description: Now you're ready for the Frostval spirit!

name: SilverStag Warrior (0 AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: SilverStag Warrior (AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: Simple Green Healer's Robe
description: For the healers that like green!

name: Simple Robe
description: Robe for Healers.

name: Sinister Black Knight
description: The darkest knights stalk the dark night. But will they conquer the darkness? Only time will tell.

name: Sinister Brute
description: Design suggested by AQW player Mieteor, this armor is NOT subtle. It screams brute force.

name: Sinister Clown
description: When clowns from Ryostiff insist on telling a joke and a victim refuses to listen, that clown can go to extremes to get them to pay attention or else face their worst nightmares on Mogloween night.

name: Sinister Shadow Sorcerer
description: Control the shadows as a Shadow Sorcerer, and make your enemies weep… with fear of you AND the darkness!

name: Sinister Summer Leisure Wear (0 AC)
description: Take your villanous vacation in style. Being at rest doesn't mean you're allowed to stop worrying about appearances. Arrogance and posturing makes up about ninety percent of evil activity.

name: Sinister Summer Leisure Wear (AC)
description: Take your villanous vacation in style. Being at rest doesn't mean you're allowed to stop worrying about appearances. Arrogance and posturing makes up about ninety percent of evil activity.

name: Sinister Summer Tattoos (0 AC)
description: Take your villanous vacation in style. Being at rest doesn't mean you're allowed to stop worrying about appearances. Arrogance and posturing makes up about ninety percent of evil activity.

name: Sinister Summer Tattoos (AC)
description: Take your villanous vacation in style. Being at rest doesn't mean you're allowed to stop worrying about appearances. Arrogance and posturing makes up about ninety percent of evil activity.

name: Sir Roderick (Armor)
description: Sometimes you have to do what's right. Even if it means stabbing someone in the back.

name: Sir Valence's Armor
description: Custom made armor for the sneakiest of the Pactogonal Knights. May your eyes be ever keen and your sight never clouded.

name: SkeleCommander
description: You have assumed the identity of a Comander of Noxus's forces. Pray your undercover work doesn't become a reality!

name: SkeleOnesie
description: Mogloween is the best time to break out all of the onesies that have been in your closet. Dress up like a skeleton!

name: Skeletal Apocalyptic Darkblood
description: Darkblood revered and feared by their kinder brethren. They seek a new beginning by pursuing the end. Hard truths forced them to turn their backs on The Mother.

name: Skeletal Mage Armor
description: For the eternally-overworked mage who specializes in grave consequences. (Color is CC to trim)

name: Skeletal Sacrificer
description: Warriors who have forsaken the Sun and their people to flood the Underworld with blood. They sacrifice the living and the dead to Lore itself, believing it to be a beast that will one day awaken and devour the stars.

name: Skelly Jamz
description: "GET HIM A BODY BAG, JOHNNY, YYEEEAAAAHHHH!"

name: Sketchy Pirate
description: This pirate looks pretty sketchy to me. Make sure he doesn't draw a gun on you! ( But then, what would you expect from someone hanging out side a Sketchy Dragon?)

name: Skew Robe
description: By Nation standards, Skew is hardly worth a second look on his own. But paired with you, his strength was bolstered. Is he sapping your power? Oh, he'll pay for that later.

name: Skin of Druuz
description: You wear skin, you absorb Druuz power and skill. Druuz live on in you. Respect.

name: Skin of Rawg
description: You wear skin, you absorb Rawg power and skill. Rawg live on in you. Respect.

name: SkinWalker Druid
description: With the ability to turn into any animal at all, SkinWalkers have been around for thousands of years, lurking in the shadows of the forest.

name: SkinWalker Warrior
description: With the ability to turn into any animal at all, SkinWalkers have been around for thousands of years, lurking in the shadows of the forest.

name: Skudly Suit
description: When you're fighting the Hero but you gotta be a the opera by 7pm.

name: Skull Crusher Armor
description: *No description*

name: Skullbound Assassin (0 AC)
description: You gained the ability to move through the darkness as silently as a shadow when your soul was stripped from you, twisted, and bound back into you by Dage the Evil's magic.

name: Skullbound Assassin (AC)
description: You gained the ability to move through the darkness as silently as a shadow when your soul was stripped from you, twisted, and bound back into you by Dage the Evil's magic.

name: Skullbreaker Knight (Armor)
description: YOU ARE A SKULLBREAKER KNIGHT, TRAINED BY PALADINSLAYER VORDRED. IT TOOK MUCH SKILL AND MANY BROKEN SKULLS TO GAIN HIS APPROVAL. NOW GO BREAK MORE. MORE SKULLS.

name: SkullCrusher Naval Commander (Armor)
description: YOUR FLAG IS MADE OF BLOOD. YOUR CREW IS MADE OF BONES. YOUR ENEMIES' SKULLS… WILL BE CRUSHED.

name: Skuller of Vokun
description: It has skulls, need I say more?

name: Skulls of the Necromancer
description: This nefarious armor is infused with the skulls of the corpse that riddle the battlefields across Doomwood. Only the necromancer has the conjuring ability to merge the bones with the plating to protect against the forces of Light.

name: Sky Frost Armor
description: As if some otherworldly dream manifested itself in Lore, this armor will provide you with not only a sleek, futuristic look, but give you what you need to conquer the enemies scattered through the land.

name: Sky Pirate
description: Plundering the skies requires a slightly different sort of pirate gear.

name: SkyBorg
description: You are just one of many drones working for the SkyGuard.

name: Skye Cailleach (Armor)
description: The mages of Skye are hand-picked by their Queen. They're given the privilege of mastering spells from the dawn of Elemental magic. Like the lightning they wield, their lives are short yet brilliant.

name: Skye Emissary
description: A liason loyal to the ruler of Skye. Typically human, an Emissary was easily satisfied with gold and feasts…until one was dismantled. Slyer hands pulled strings to win the vacant position, and poison the system from within.

name: Skye Executor (Armor)
description: The Executors of Skye's will, and the personal guards of the ruler's secondborn. They have been tasked with the realm's worst deeds, consoled by the promise that Lord Haeos' storms will wash their hands clean.

name: Skye Warden of the East
description: The Warden of the East is a title given to the eldest child of Skye's Ruler, marking them as heir. They are warriors skilled in combat and magic, tasked with protecting the sacred hill of coronation.

name: Skye Warden of the South
description: The strongest mage in Skye is given the title Warden of the South. Their magic permeates the air, electrifying it with the threat of death. Typically, the youngest of the ruler's children would strive to become its premier Cailleach.

name: Skye Warden of the West
description: A title and role given to the second born of Skye's Ruler, tasked with executing the will of the crown. They strike faster than lightning, silencing any threat to their homeland's harmony.

name: Skye Warrior (Armor)
description: Peerless warriors who loyally serve Skye and royal house Lothian. They are the pesonal guards of the ruler and their eldest child. Lightning strikes them on the battlefield, empowering them, and obliterating their enemies.

name: Skyguard Armored Trooper
description: Skyguard Techno-Energized Assault Machine or S.T.E.A.M., is the perfect soldier for those heavy resistances. Just a handful of these can turn the tide of battle.

name: Skyguard Commander (0 AC)
description: Yarrr! Ye be the captain of a Skyship, and yer main goal is to launch serial attacks against th' forces of Chaos. For King, for crown, for SWORDHAVEN!
