name: Skyguard Commander (AC)
description: Yarrr! Ye be the captain of a Skyship, and yer main goal is to launch serial attacks against th' forces of Chaos. For King, for crown, for SWORDHAVEN!

name: SkyGuard Diplomat
description: "Speak the language when spoken to, but listen above all else", These are the words that the Skyguard Diplomats live by. These specially trained men and women represent the Skyguard forces at political.

name: SkyGuard Grenadier Armor
description: Grenadiers are specially trained to lead special assault teams. They pride themselves on being the first person through the hole they just blew through the wall of an enemy fortress.

name: Skyguard Gunner
description: Man the guns, Skyguard! Rip through your enemy airships, guns blazing, and make sure those SkyPirates know that they are NO match for Swordhaven's elite aero-martial force!

name: Skyguard Helmsman
description: Helmsman are the navigators of the skies. Without you, Skyguard Airship will not reach their destinations. You are vital member of the crew, and without your knowledge and skill, ships would be lost among the vast blue expanse of the sky!

name: Skyguard Infernal Hunter (AC)
description: A certain platoon of the Skyguard is dedicated to hunting Infernals. Through rigorous training, they pursue their quarry at a near fanatical level.

name: Skyguard Infernal Hunter (Legend)
description: A certain platoon of the Skyguard is dedicated to hunting Infernals. Through rigorous training, they pursue their quarry at a near fanatical level.

name: SkyGuard Mech Armor
description: Get away from her, you cloudsucker!

name: SkyGuard Medic
description: With the ability to heal others, on and off of the battlefield, the Skyguard medics are trained with medicine and self-defense.

name: SkyGuard MP
description: The Skyguard Military Police operates as a seperate entity within alteon's Skyguard forces. They are solely responsible for policing the activities of the Skyguard from within thei ranks.

name: Skyguard Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Yarrr! Ye be the captain of a Skyship, and yer main goal is to launch serial attacks against th' forces of Chaos. For King, for crown, for SWORDHAVEN!

name: Skyguard Naval Commander (AC)
description: Yarrr! Ye be the captain of a Skyship, and yer main goal is to launch serial attacks against th' forces of Chaos. For King, for crown, for SWORDHAVEN!

name: Skyguard Private
description: A uniform given to everyone when they first join the skyguard. Through valor, distinction, and ambition, you will soon find it decorated with medals of honor. Make King Alteon proud!

name: Skyguard Private (Temp)
description: A uniform given to everyone when they first join the skyguard. Through valor, distinction, and ambition, you will soon find it decorated with medals of honor. Make King Alteon proud!

name: SkyGuard Rifleman
description: All you have to do is show up and everyone quickly disperses. Rifleman are notoriously good at what they do and when one doesn't miss the target, he or she becomes legendary. Be legendary.

name: Skyguard Solar Colonel
description: A high ranking member of the Skyguard authorized to change the weather at will. It takes extensive knowledge and experience to wield fire magic in order to clear the skies.

name: Skyguard SWAT
description: Join the SkyGuard SWAT team - the premiere Security Wipeout and Takedown unit in lore!

name: Skyguard Uniform
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment.

name: Skyguard Warrior
description: As a member of the boarding party, you are the grunt of the SkyGuard. That doesn't mean though that you can't hold your own in the heat of battle.

name: SkyHunter
description: When the Skyguard need something done quick, and done right, they call in one of the most reliable squads in the land: the Skyhunters.

name: SkySciencer
description: As a scholar in the SkyGuard, you are the brains rather that than the brawns in the SkyGuard faction. The pen is mightier than the broadsword, but the screwdriver reigns supreme!

name: Slammin' Swimwear
description: This cute little sentient dino float wants to go swimming with you. It just comes to show that you're never too old to take a little buddy out for a swim. Note that he is not guaranteed to help you stay afloat.

name: Slayer Armor
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to help celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PVP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Sleek Concert Outfit
description: Black shirt, black jeans, classic!

name: Sleek Waterpolo Suit
description: Remember, waterpolo is played in a pool without horses. We don't want a repeat of LAST year…

name: Sleezter Bunny (Armor)
description: It's not enough to DEFEAT Sleezter Bunny! To truly understand a villain, you must BECOME him!

name: Slime Dragon Rogue
description: Followers of Ektorax must be able to deal with whatever comes at them, and slime…lots of slime.

name: Slime Follower
description: Pledge your allegiance to the Slime Aliens!

name: Slithering Shadowslayer
description: Don these shady garments to slither into your local shop and grab your anticipated items without paying a large piggy bank.

name: Slovak Kroj
description: The villagers who dwell deep in the mountains of Dwarfhold are a proud people. They fend for themselves against all enemies, and respect those who come to them in good faith with an open heart.

name: SlugButter Armor
description: But why though?

name: Slugfit Fiend
description: The remains of the monster Slugfit were dipped into the Fiend's Void, and mutated until creatures crawled out of the abyss. Their chaotic nature makes them difficult to control, but the potential for this vile combination is…

name: Sly Fox Suit
description: You are a tricky and untrustworthy fox. You have little friends, but it does not discourage you. Who needs a group when you can achieve goals through deception or is it your secretly need a real friend?

name: Smooth Billionaire Suit (AC)
description: A beautifully cut bespoke suit for your swankiest Mogloween parties.

name: Smooth Billionaire Suit (Legend)
description: A beautifully cut bespoke suit for your swankiest Mogloween parties.

name: Smuggler's Raiment
description: A privateer with a suspiciously strict code. They plunder and steal like any other corsair, but their swordplay's a little too sharp. Rumors about undercover Greenguard Knights are abound.

name: Sneevil BOOMBox Pilot
description: Sneevil Pilots frequently fly in formations of 2-4 C-80X jets to box their aerial opponents in. Their motto: "We are the things that make you go BOOM!"

name: Sneeviltron (Armor)
description: You are now a Mini Sneevil War Machine!

name: Snow Golem (Armor)
description: Cold-Blooded like Snow Golems? Interested in cryogenic freezing? If so, this Morph is perfect for you!

name: Snow Leopard Skinwalker
description: Wear the hides of the beasts you've slain to channel their fierce spirits.

name: Snowborn Fae (0 AC)
description: Enchanted by the fairies in the Northlands, though this doesn't appear warm, you will never grow cold in it.

name: Snowborn Fae (AC)
description: Enchanted by the fairies in the Northlands, though this doesn't appear warm, you will never grow cold in it.

name: Snowman Armor
description: There must have been some magic in that old slik helm you found, for when you equipped it on your head, you began to /dance around! You are the Snowman, and alive as you could be, and the heroes say you can /laugh and slay just the same as you and me!

name: Snowshade Raven (0 AC)
description: Said to be the companions of a cold death. These infamous rogues roam frigid wastes of their own accord. Bones disappear from the snow, and the Ravens steal their names.

name: Snowshade Raven (AC)
description: Said to be the companions of a cold death. These infamous rogues roam frigid wastes of their own accord. Bones disappear from the snow, and the Ravens steal their names.

name: SnowStalker
description: If you go down the woods today, you're in for a big surprise. These hunters come out during the icy months to track prey that only comes out during winter.

name: Snowstorm
description: Gompa, reknowned battle-armorer, crafted this cunning and decidedly chill-resistant armor to keep the cold out in the midst of even the most heated battles!

name: Snowsuit
description: Wanna keep your phalanges frost-bite free? Better put this not-so-fashionable-but-completely-warm-and-fuzzy snowsuit!

name: Snowvers' Onesie
description: meow meow meow

name: Snowview Innkeeper
description: Spread the cheer and joy! A warm hearth is kept by a warm heart. The Snowview Inn's Keeper is charged with keeping the lights on, and torching the trash.

name: Snowy Caroler
description: Wow your neighbors with your outfit and ability to hit the high notes. Just remember to turn the actual magic off when you sing. A stun spell laced into a song isn't very festive.

name: Snuggle Bear
description: Bear it all in this fuzzy wuzzy Snuggle Bear Armor! Cuddly soft and oh-so warm, friend and foe alike will want to give you a great big hug.

name: Snuggle Berserker
description: No one expects the cutest heroes to be the deadliest.

name: So's Student Uniform
description: The standard safety garb for students studying medicine at one of Astravia's top academies. Song Rivale often used it as a blanket after hours assisting her mentors during exhausting surgeries.

name: So's Swimsuit
description: Originally, So had stuffed her bag full of books and didn't pack a swimsuit for the trip. Her fellow Scale members, who will not be named, yanked on her arm. "You aren't going to the beach looking like that!" they said. They're the real Heroes.

name: Sol Dominus Seeker (0 AC)
description: The pirates of the ship Sol Dominus chases the sun to the ends of the treacherous sea. Once students of the Light's servants, they now harness the sun's power to make themselves as gold as its rays.

name: Sol Dominus Seeker (AC)
description: The pirates of the ship Sol Dominus chases the sun to the ends of the treacherous sea. Once students of the Light's servants, they now harness the sun's power to make themselves as gold as its rays.

name: Sol Invictus Champion
description: All will return to ash, and lay still. The fires of the Infernal Champion arrives to harken the end of joy, sorrow, and wretched life.

name: Solar Beach Loungewear (0 AC)
description: Summer sun's not hot enough for you? Then turn up the heat and light up the beach!

name: Solar Beach Loungewear (AC)
description: Summer sun's not hot enough for you? Then turn up the heat and light up the beach!

name: Solar Entity (AC)
description: Some of the solar flares form amazing shapes and lines that take the form of a monk's robes. Most human beings are unable to cope with the heat composing the flares, allowing fire spirits to wear these shapes.

name: Solar Entity (Legend)
description: Some of the solar flares form amazing shapes and lines that take the form of a monk's robes. Most human beings are unable to cope with the heat composing the flares, allowing fire spirits to wear these shapes.

name: Solar Flare Beach Loungewear (0 AC)
description: Summer sun's not hot enough for you? Then turn up the heat and light up the beach!

name: Solar Flare Beach Loungewear (AC)
description: Summer sun's not hot enough for you? Then turn up the heat and light up the beach!

name: Solar Flux
description: A master armorsmith by trade, Reddy has crafted an armor like no other. Capturing and solidifying the flames of a star, this armor burns all who attempt to strike you, leaving their weapons and their hands scorched.

name: Solar Naval Commander
description: Solarmancers usually wear this illuminating uniform to light their way through a dark storm when setting sail at night. Some say that the sunlight coming from the uniform can lead its wearer to safety in a situation that seems inescapable.

name: Solar Pirate Commander
description: Sail to the ends of the universe. Stop at the restaurant or pillage it. You're a Solar pirate go where those winds take you.

name: Solar Protector
description: The history of this armor is shrouded in mystery - even the name is not fully understood. Was it created to protect the Sun… or to protect you FROM the Sun?

name: Solar Witch + Warlock
description: Solar Witches and Warlocks are rare, but they are among the most powerful mages to walk the dark paths winding through Mystcroft. The light they shine can blind or cure.

name: Solarflare Mystic
description: Each of these mystics are born under a personal star. It gazes down upon them, and stengthens their magic. In exchange, the Mystics make it their lifelong goal to grow their star into a blazing sun.

name: Solaris Knight
description: The Solaris Knights are a clan that worship the sun and the light. Their nemesis, the Lunaris, have been rivals since the beginning of time. Both fight in the struggle to obtain the powerful artifacts Sol and Luna.

name: Solaris Redeemer
description: The Solaris are members of a clan that worship the sun. Redeemers do not partake in the hunt for Sol and Luna. They seek to capture members of the Lunaris to make them see the real Light.

name: Soldados Brasileiros
description: For those who fight to maintain the beauty of the rainforest.

name: Solid Shadow Pumpkin Witch (0 AC)
description: That shade of black is so iconic, it's magic and makes you magic. (Displayed art is the same for all heroes.)

name: Solid Shadow Pumpkin Witch (AC)
description: That shade of black is so iconic, it's magic and makes you magic. (Displayed art is the same for all heroes.)

name: Solo Ship Captain
description: You are the master of your fate. You are the captain of your solo ship.

name: Solrac Devoid
description: Open Search engine> Query hard drive for "Humanity"> Searching > Searching> Error 404: File not found

name: Solrac Legacy
description: This armor speaks of death and power. One look at those claws will make the opposition run in terror. Imagine what a swipe would do to them.

name: Solrac V2
description: Deleting extraneous models. More efficiency. More power. Solrac is out of beta.

name: Somnian Bard
description: The music of the celestial spheres is translated into modern music by the Somnian Bards.

name: Sooty Steamed Punk (0 AC)
description: You don't have to be a world reknown inventor to wear the garb that gets the job done. Even a young go-getter with a mind full of possibilities need something to keep them safe from those wanting to steal their ideas. Show them whose boss with your own mechanization!

name: Sooty Steamed Punk (AC)
description: You don't have to be a world reknown inventor to wear the garb that gets the job done. Even a young go-getter with a mind full of possibilities need something to keep them safe from those wanting to steal their ideas. Show them whose boss with your own mechanization!

name: Sorcerer Armor
description: Mage base class upgrade! (Requires Mage Class)

name: Soul Admired
description: Someone admires you. Someone looks at you an thinks you a warrior. Show them the power dwelling within you.

name: Soul Banisher
description: A recreation of the Soul Banisher's armor, found in Adventure Quest, will make your enemies tremble in fear as they stand before a leader of the Exodus forces.

name: Soul Harvester
description: Long ago, the key to immortality was discovered and Death was forced to wage war against the living immortals. Their souls have become a debt that it still unpaid. Become one of Death's servants and reap the harvest of souls.

name: Soul Of A Hero
description: Everyone knows it's not what you look like, but what is inside you that makes a hero. Still… doesn't hurt to look the part.

name: Soul of Chaos Armor
description: Chaos. Shadows. Impenetrable. These are the words of what will reach out to you and take over your soul. And once they have taken that, they will reach out for more. Always reaching. Always taking…

name: Soul of Chaos Human Armor
description: Chaos. Shadows. Impenetrable. These are the words of what will reach out to you and take over your soul. And once they have taken that, they will reach out for more. Always reaching. Always taking…

name: Soul of the Darkness
description: Most will never know what it's like to have to battle while surrounded by complete darkness, unless you were already born in the heart of it….

name: Soul Scorned
description: Scorn: Verb. To reject or refuse with derision. But who needs acceptance when you have power?

name: Soul Starved Jiangshi
description: Little is known about these ancient undead, said to only exist before Wuji's era of eternity. Legends say that they rise and feed on qi, angered that part of their soul was barred from the afterlife. (Necklace CC to Accessory)

name: Soul Taker of Darkness
description: *No description*

name: SoulBinder
description: SoulBinders are able to harness the magical energy of souls without the aid of a Soul Ally. SoulWeavers have questioned the ethics of this practice, believing the SoulBinders to be manipulating souls against their will.

name: Soulblade Master of Shadows
description: The BladeMasters of the Future Legion honor their predecessors by preserving tradition. Though they live and die by the sword, their bodies are slowly consumed by Legion steel.

name: SoulDevourer of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: No one knows where these mysterious warriors come from. When the oracles try to divine their origins, all their scrying glasses will show is a flood of tears and a single word: Valoria.

name: SoulDevourer of Nulgath (AC)
description: No one knows where these mysterious warriors come from. When the oracles try to divine their origins, all their scrying glasses will show is a flood of tears and a single word: Valoria.

name: Souleater Warrior
description: These wretched creatures hunt and devour the souls of their enemies which sustains their power. Though they come in many shapes and sizes, their hunger for souls is the same. To become a Souleater is to receive great power at the cost of becoming a terrible monster. (color custom eyes)

name: Soulfire Blademaster
description: Dage the Evil's SoulForge requires constant sacrifice and labor to keep its flames bright. The unworthy become fuel for the forge, while the fire of victory burns in the hearts of those called to serve the Legion.

name: Soulfire Warmonger
description: Dage the Evil's SoulForge requires constant sacrifice and labor to keep its flames bright. The unworthy become fuel for the forge, while the fire of victory burns in the hearts of those called to serve the Legion.

name: SoulKnight
description: Fused with your spirit orb, this armor is intended to keep you safe while fueling your war-rage, making you a much more effective warrior. Designed by soulsyth.

name: SoulKnight of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: The glowing orbs encased in a SoulKnight's battlegear are made of pure, stolen spirit energy, and are only entrusted to Nulgath's most loyal and skilled followers.

name: SoulKnight of Nulgath (AC)
description: The glowing orbs encased in a SoulKnight's battlegear are made of pure, stolen spirit energy, and are only entrusted to Nulgath's most loyal and skilled followers.

name: Soulsworn of Eos
description: Sorrow, oh great sorrow form of Eos. The Soulsworn are devoted to a memory they can't recall. They vow to make a mountain of bodies to reach the sun, and tear it down.

name: SoulWeaver Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: To become a SoulWeaver you must bond with an Elemental Spirit partner; SoulWeaver Naval Commanders always choose a water, air, or storm elemental.

name: SoulWeaver Naval Commander (AC)
description: To become a SoulWeaver you must bond with an Elemental Spirit partner; SoulWeaver Naval Commanders always choose a water, air, or storm elemental.

name: SoulWeaver Prime
description: To become a SoulWeaver you must bond with an Elemental Spirit partner. Together, using the Spirit Looms you have forged, you may weave wonderful cloth that cannot be destroyed.

name: SoulWeaver Prime Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: To become a SoulWeaver you must bond with an Elemental Spirit partner; SoulWeaver Naval Commanders always choose a water, air, or storm elemental.

name: SoulWeaver Prime Naval Commander (AC)
description: To become a SoulWeaver you must bond with an Elemental Spirit partner; SoulWeaver Naval Commanders always choose a water, air, or storm elemental.

name: Space-Mage Armor
description: Taking spell casting to the final frontier.

name: Space Marine (AC)
description: Exploring only the farthest reaches of empty space, these marines may think they've seen it all however…

name: Space Marine (Legend)
description: Exploring only the farthest reaches of empty space, these marines may think they've seen it all however…

name: Space Voyager
description: There are multiple uncharted territories is space. You're apart of an elite group tasked with mapping these regions. What lies ahead of you is truly the unknown.

name: Space Voyager Twig (AC)
description: In space, no one gives you fwish and ice cream!

name: Space Voyager Twig (Legend)
description: In space, no one gives you fwish and ice cream!

name: Space Voyager Twilly (AC)
description: In space, you can't heal anyone if they scream!

name: Space Voyager Twilly (Non-AC)
description: In space, you can't heal anyone if they scream!

name: Space Voyager Zorbak (0 AC)
description: In space, no one can hear you MEHEHEHE!

name: Space Voyager Zorbak (AC)
description: In space, no one can hear you MEHEHEHE!

name: SpaceFighter
description: An exoskeleton suit made to keep your skin from exposure to the black abyss.

name: Sparkling Royalty
description: Monarchs that love the winter and crystals in frost have hearts as frozen as their power. Devoid of happiness, timidity, and anger, they carry out their schemes without ever feeling guilty of their doing.

name: Sparkly IceCream (0 AC)
description: It's amazing what doesn't melt in the summer sun… when you treat it properly.

name: Sparkly IceCream (AC)
description: It's amazing what doesn't melt in the summer sun… when you treat it properly.

name: Sparring Suit
description: It's time to spar!

name: Spartan Warrior
description: Get 299 of your closest friends to equip this armor and head to the hot gates! This… is….. AQWORLDS!!!!!! (color customizable )

name: Spearhead Mech
description: The Shining Spearhead Mech. Your spear is the spear that will pierce the heavens!

name: Spearmint Twist
description: Do the twist, the spearmint twist!

name: Special Infantry Legion
description: As a high ranking members in Dage the Evil's legion, this special infantry utilize their shield against heavy projectiles.

name: Spectral Lycan
description: Even the soul of an underhanded coward can take on the form of a relentless beast if steeped in enough curses and anguish. Death becomes a new beginning.

name: Spectral Sea Scourge
description: A pirate ship shredded into splinters by cannonfire returns from the great beyond. The crew have lost their taste for gold, seeking to plunder souls from the living.

name: Spectre Techsuit
description: This armor is a part of the Spectre Set. A wonder of technology, this armor can enhance strength, speed, endurance and your senses. It might even add a few senses you never had before.

name: Speedy Hare Suit
description: Rabbits aren't always soft, cute and cuddly in human eyes. You are swift and fast, able to escape danger at a moment's notice. In this care, your enemy would need better DEX to halt your speed.

name: SpellFrost Mage
description: SpellFrost Mages are known for their mastery of Cryomancy. They are among the most skilled mages of the Northlands, and the sapphire gems they wear are made of crystallized skyfire.

name: Spellraiser
description: To summon: Open the strange little box left sitting in the Underworld. Nothing bad could possibly come from it…

name: Spellsword Artifact Hunter
description: Who collects the elements and artifacts the Spellswords need to create these weapons? The Artifact Hunters!

name: Spellsword of Light
description: Spellswords of Light serve in Empress Gravelyn's court. This class is usually pursued by dark but noble undead warriors, as it is considered one of the most graceful arts of combat.

name: SpellSword's Apprentice
description: These young SpellSword's must learn the concentration and technique needed to become masters one day.

name: Sphinx Sentinel
description: The Sentinels only served and guarded those worthy enough to be called Pharaoh of the Sandseas. Their golden clan gleamed in an era of heroes and legends, before disappearing into the desert.

name: Spicelord (Mem)
description: This is the perfect armor to add a little spice to your life. Just remember that too much salt is bad for you.

name: Spicy Samurai
description: *No description*

name: Spicy Town
description: Let the Fiery Dude take you all the way to Spicy Town!

name: Spidataur
description: Spidataur, Spidataur, spider legs to let you crawl. Spidataur, Spidataur, eats your face with it's spider claws… LOOK OOOOUT HERE COMES THE SPIDATAUR!

name: Spider Witch (AC)
description: SpiderWitch. SpiderWitch. Does whatever a SpiderWitch does.

name: Spider Witch (Legend)
description: SpiderWitch. SpiderWitch. Does whatever a SpiderWitch does.

name: Spiders & Sorcery
description: According to necromancer lore, a girl named Monica got creative with various arachnids lost in history. A pair of giant spider's legs still feels rather ominously warm, suggesting the souls of these eight-eyed fiends might possess these remains.

name: Spiked Rebel
description: No one will DARE bother you in battle, not when you're wearing THIS armor!

name: Spirit Harvester
description: It's the time of year when all things are harvested… including spirits!

name: Spirit of Air Armor
description: Djinn take on many forms, these things embrace all things involving air.

name: Spirit of Autumn
description: In times of hardship, these heralds of nature were known as Knights of the Fall. Now, in a gentler present where mortals are warmed by coloful leaves, they're the Spirits of Autumn.

name: Spirit of Conquest (AC)
description: The spirit of the Horseman of Conquest has possessed your body and lent you his strength and power.

name: Spirit of Conquest (Legend)
description: The spirit of the Horseman of Conquest has possessed your body and lent you his strength and power.

name: Spirit of Death (AC)
description: The spirit of the Horseman of Death has possessed your body. Ride in on your pale horse and extinguish the life from everything you pass.

name: Spirit of Death (Legend)
description: The spirit of the Horseman of Death has possessed your body. Ride in on your pale horse and extinguish the life from everything you pass.

name: Spirit of Earth Armor
description: Djinn take on many forms, these things embrace all things involving terra.

name: Spirit of Famine (AC)
description: The spirit of the Horseman of Famine has possessed you. This means we are all blaming you for the fruit snack shortage.

name: Spirit of Famine (Legend)
description: The spirit of the Horsemen of Famine has possessed you. This means we are all blaming you for the fruit snack shortage.

name: Spirit of Fire Armor
description: Djinn take on many forms, these embrace all things involving fire.

name: Spirit of Ice (Armor)
description: The spirit of ice gives thes beings their power. Their evertasting chill will freeze their enemies to the core.

name: Spirit of Queen Meresankh
description: The ninth Queen of the Sek-Duat Dynasty. Kind and just in life, vengeful and menacing in death. She was killed by the lich Pharaoh in order to keep the truth hidden. She returned from the dead to curse his bloodline. (Skin is not CC)

name: Spirit of War (AC)
description: The spirit of the Horseman of War possesses your body and lends you his power.

name: Spirit of War (Legend)
description: The spirit of the Horseman of War possesses your body and lends you his power.

name: Spirit of Water Armor
description: Djinn take on many forms, these things embrace all things involving water.

name: Spirit Savior
description: Why aren't you just the coolest ghoul around?

name: Spirit Wolf
description: A new breed of Lycan that is more Human than Wolf, discovered by your fellow player _Aegis_ deep within the Darkovian Forests.

name: SpiritHunter Armor
description: Purely physical armor gives no protection against sprirts. That's why this armor has psychoplasmic spells of anti-attack woven into the material. Wear it well as you send spirits home!

name: Spiritual Chiromancer (0 AC)
description: The path of your fate is etched into your blood. This auger and spiritualist can change the course of your destiny, in exchange for custody of an ancestor. As the chiromancer's familiar, they serve and fight on their behalf.

name: Spiritual Chiromancer (AC)
description: The path of your fate is etched into your blood. This auger and spiritualist can change the course of your destiny, in exchange for custody of an ancestor. As the chiromancer's familiar, they serve and fight on their behalf.

name: Splitfang Mage
description: The Magi of the Golden Onslaught. The Split Fangs are those who have proven their loyalty.

name: Sponzard Slayer
description: The Sponzard is a mighty creature. Slay it and earn incredible rewards!

name: Spookeasy Nightmare (AC)
description: Going to party like it's 1920! Time to scare up some fun.

name: Spookeasy Nightmare (Legend)
description: Going to party like it's 1920! Time to scare up some fun.

name: Spooky Goth Outfit
description: *Spooky music plays as fog creeps through the town.* O_O

name: Spooky Kid
description: *Spooky music plays as fog creeps over the playground* O_O

name: Spooky Skelly Suit
description: Spooooky. But oh, so comfy.

name: Spooky Spirit Hunter
description: These Mysterious SpiritHunters are rumored to be sent from the depths of Bludrut Keep to purge the land of evil entities and to safeguard against supernatural forces that threaten the realm. Even the Shadowscythe fear to travel near Bludrut Keep.

name: Sporkion Garb
description: True ninja can make a weapon out of anything. The Sporkion ninja clan has taken that notion to another level.

name: Sporty AX Swimwear (0 AC)
description: AX Fashion exclusive: you'll look hot enough in this sporty swimwear to /slay your enemies and /stun your friends.

name: Sporty AX Swimwear (AC)
description: AX Fashion exclusive: you'll look hot enough in this sporty swimwear to /slay your enemies and /stun your friends.

name: Spot On Werejaguar
description: A tiger can't change his stripes… but a Werejaguar can change his spots! You are an elite Werejaguar who has the capability to change your sports to match your Accessory Color!

name: Spring Uniform
description: A wise hero knows that no matter what season it is, there is always more to learn.

name: Spruce Sled Racer
description: Warm garb worn by sled racers during practice. Outside of the race, green is a lucky color to wear during shorter journeys.

name: Squire of Heartfelt Sighs
description: The squire must work his way up before becoming the Chevalier of Hearts.

name: Squire of Noelle
description: The protectors of House Noelle and the wardens of the Yew Mountain Chain. Not only are they skilled fighters, but each Knight is personally thought alchemy and magic by their Lady.

name: Squish Game Suit
description: You've already come too far to end this now. VICTORY WILL BE YOURS!

name: Stained Glass Faerie
description: Blue and purple, gold and green,

name: Staphylococcus
description: Monsters and Heroes alike fear the dreaded pathogenic bacterium, Staphylococcus!

name: Star Captain Armor
description: A Star Captain rather than "The Star Captain," though they pretty much all dressed the same. In another time and space, these ace pilots were trained to handle Mecha combat, plasma blade duels, and sometimes, diplomacy.

name: Star Captain Uniform
description: A Star Captain rather than "The Star Captain", though they pretty much all dressed the same. In another time and space, these ace pilots were trained to handle Mecha combat, plasma blade duels, and sometimes, diplomacy.

name: Star Debris Stampeder
description: ﻿Though this is the dark garb of someone inhuman, all they're looking to do is spread some LOVE and PEACE. Please trust that this is true. The stampeder epithet is there because they stampede over evil, bestowed by an empathetic Star.

name: StarBlade Master
description: You're SORtA the biggest hero around. Got it memorized? Whenever things look dark, hide in the strength of friends, and wait for the light.

name: Starborn Mage
description: ﻿Out of the darkness, first one light can be seen, then another, then another, as the Starborn Mage draws upon the power of the celestial bodies that move through the universe.

name: Starbound White Tiger
description: A warrior who trained under the stars at the Shrine of the Four Cardinal Directions. The White Tiger Constellation blessed these devotees with might and ambition. Armed with fists alone, they hunt Dragons.

name: StarCrasher
description: May the Fourth be with you!

name: StarGazer (Armor)
description: May the 4th be with you!

name: StarLord Armor
description: StarLords can withstand massive damage when protected by their ballistic armor. (color customizable)

name: StarLord Original
description: For those that liked the old ways.

name: StarLord Prime
description: StarLords can withstand massive damage when protected by their ballistic armor. Unlocked by purchasing a Star Captain package in MechQuest.

name: StarMaster
description: Surely you've heard of me.

name: Starry Samurai
description: This armor was forged out of spacedust mined from a nearby galaxy and presented by the Royal Astromancer's Society to Empress Miko as a gift for this year's star festival.

name: Starry Swashbuckler
description: Sail to the ends of the universe. Stop at the restaurant or pillage it.

name: Starry Swimsuit (0 AC)
description: As you stare across the water, stars reflect on its surface, an ocean of diamond-like points of light. This suit lets you capture the magic of that moment.

name: Starry Swimsuit (AC)
description: As you stare across the water, stars reflect on its surface, an ocean of diamond-like points of light. This suit lets you capture the magic of that moment.

name: Starry Swimwear (0 AC)
description: As you stare across the water, stars reflect on its surface, an ocean of diamond-like points of light. This suit lets you capture the magic of that moment.

name: Starry Swimwear (AC)
description: As you stare across the water, stars reflect on its surface, an ocean of diamond-like points of light. This suit lets you capture the magic of that moment.

name: Starsword Armor
description: This armor is made up of fragments of dragonstar crystal dust!

name: Static Pyro
description: Plasma Pyros were born from rediscovered ancient technology. They rely on consistent feed of oxygen and shadows, and will stop at nothing to fuel their rage.

name: Steamed Punk
description: You don't have to be a world reknown inventor to wear the garb that gets the job done.Even a young go-getter with a mind full of possibilities need something to keep them safe from those wanting to steal there ideas.

name: SteamGear Armor
description: Tomix personally crafted this steampunk themed armor especially for his AQW fans! It's the style of clothing favored by traveling steampunk tinkerers called SteamGears.

name: SteamKnight
description: Under the power of your own steam, you'll be able to charge into battle fearlessy while wearing THIS armor!

name: Steampunk Clawsuit
description: Merry Frostval and Happy New Year!

name: Steampunk Eggsplorer
description: The yolks on anyone who thinks you won't be the more eggcellent eggsplorer in all of Lore!

name: Steampunk J6
description: J6 has always been on the cutting edge of technology, even when it was steam powered!

name: Steampunk Mage (Armor)
description: These industrious Mages use their power to fuse air and water into steam, spearheading a fantastical revolution, turning towns and castles into well-oiled machines. Their iron gears will conquer the land, sky, sea… and future.

name: SteamPunk Pirate Captain
description: Man t' wheel as you and your hearties turn t' gears on your ship as you venture for teasure and adventure on t' open sea!

name: SteamPunk TreasureHunter
description: Alamonia cowboys love a good duel and can gun down a foolhardy rustler within two miles away. Their leather clothing protects them from the rushing sand, which is what they feel whenever they go sandboarding.

name: Steampunk Valentine
description: Armed with hundreds of arrows, ready to shoot a bolt of love right through your clockwork heart.

name: Steelplate
description: A finely smithed set of steel armor offering moderate protection.

name: Stellar Battlemage (0 AC)
description: You've wandered the stars in search of new spells and fighting techniques. Your adventurers have made you a master of manipulating space and time. The future is yours!

name: Stellar BattleMage (AC)
description: You've wandered the stars in search of new spells and fighting techniques. Your adventurers have made you a master of manipulating space and time. The future is yours!

name: Stellar Royalty
description: With a throne made of stardust, you rule over an endless sea of galaxies. Your brilliance cannot be matched, and your reign will last as long as the stars themselves.

name: Sterling DragonBerserker
description: A Dragonlord suited for direct combat. They're the ones who make the first strike, and their loyal Dragon is more than eager to follow.

name: Sterling DragonBulwark
description: Dragonlords are well-versed in all manner of weapons, including shields. If the need arises, they will protect their Dragons to the end.

name: Sterling Dragonlord
description: A Dragonlord of noble spirit who just recieved their wings. Under the tutelege of great heroes and wise teachers, they and their Dragon fight to protect the innocent.

name: Sterling DragonWrath
description: A Dragonlord suited for direct combat. They're the ones who make the first strike, and their loyal Dragon is more than eager to follow.

name: Sternlord of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: In the Mirror Realm, the Lord Justices of the Nulgath guard the innocent from Evil. Just and fair, their wisdom comes from the spirits of their forebears who reside in their armor. (CC to Eye)

name: Sternlord of Nulgath (AC)
description: In the Mirror Realm, the Lord Justices of the Nulgath guard the innocent from Evil. Just and fair, their wisdom comes from the spirits of their forebears who reside in their armor. (CC to Eye)

name: Stinky Cheese Suit (AC)
description: Summon the powers of stinky cheese to drive your opponents away!

name: Stinky Cheese Suit (Legend)
description: Summon the powers of stinky cheese to drive your opponents away!

name: Stone Guardian
description: Rock solid and dependable to a fault, this armor will not let you down. The strength of the very world beneath your feet flows upwards into this armor, reinforcing an already impossibly strong defense.

name: Stone Morph
description: Through the power of Geopetal, Spirit of Dwarfhold Mountain, you have been transformed into living stone! Your skin is nearly impossible to damage, but you're too heavy to jump on a trampoline now. It's a trade off.

name: Stone Paladin Armor
description: For Freeing the Stone Paladin from his many years of confinement guarding the Temple of DoomWood, he has crafted this armor in thanks. It will protect you in battle because it imbues you with the power of stoneskin!

name: StoneAger
description: The earliest humans hunted, fished, and gathered to eke out a primitive existence. Many things separated them from their prey, but one of the most telling signs of their humanity was the ability to create… Art!

name: Storm
description: The very same outfit worn by the Inter-dimensional Bard of the Multiverse, Storm! But… if you are wearing his clothes… what is he wearing?

name: Storm Drakel Warrior
description: These warriors fight to protect their lands with the progressive ideas the Drakel's gave them.

name: Storm Guard (Armor)
description: Bits and pieces of scrap aluminum foil soldered together make up this armor. Foil your opponents chaotic plans with ease!

name: Storm Kimono
description: This traditional Yokai kimono captures the essence of a storm passing over tranquil isle.

name: Storm Knight
description: He only earns his freedom and his life who takes them every day by storm. (Item does 40% more damage to elemental tagged monsters when equipped.)

name: Storm Ruler
description: You'll never fall victim to the head of the summer when you carry the ice with you!

name: Stormborn Battlegear
description: You'd think that combining lightning and water would be dangerous. Not for the Thunderborn!

name: StormBringer (Armor)
description: Call down the lightning and thunder, for YOU are the ruler of storms!

name: Stormbringer Warlock
description: The Stormbringer Warlock tore a hurricane out of the sky, and captured it in fitting robes and electrified armor. A cataclysmic storm that could have torn a continent asunder now bides its time.

name: Stormslasher (Armor)
description: Stormslasher's often patrol a station in groups to increase their chances of dealing with a potential threat effectively. If one of them is caught alone, it is out of luck and out of sight for them.

name: Stormy Seas Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: The seas around Skye were empty and silent. Its people were trapped, and no one dared approach. The Eye of the Storm was always watching, and lightning would fall on anyone who dared to encroach on Iona's shores.

name: Stormy Seas Pirate Captain (AC)
description: The seas around Skye were empty and silent. Its people were trapped, and no one dared approach. The Eye of the Storm was always watching, and lightning would fall on anyone who dared to encroach on Iona's shores.

name: Straight Jacket
description: You are just to dangerous to be let loose on Lore!

name: Street Mime
description: You'll be the life of all parties with your trapped in a box routine.

name: Street Skater Set
description: Hit the pavement (and the battlefield) in this laid-back, ready-to-roll streetwear. Perfect for skating, gaming, and outshining rivals.

name: Strikeforce Pulsar
description: The Galaxy runs on the flames of courage burning in your chest.

name: Striped Goalie Uniform
description: Run fast. Play hard. Block the GOAAAAAL! (This item is color customizable.)

name: Stripeless VoidCaster
description: Those who sign Nulgath's contract gain access to the infinite wellspring of arcane energy contained within the void. Be warned, almost everyone who accepts this power find themselves consumed by it.

name: Strolling Zombie Killer
description: There's a new sheriff in town and he's laying down the law!

name: Stronger
description: To die on the battlefield would be the greatest honor to you… But today isn't that day!

name: Stygian Pirate Captain
description: The Stygian Pirate Captains are Dage's elite sea thieves who steal and loot treasures, booty and relics from the umbral seas! Superior to the Legion Jolly Rogers, they lead them to raid their victims' ships in the shortest time possible.

name: Stylish Qipao
description: These are meant to show off. Yue says that this style of dress was originally created to defy uptight rules and manners, so party your heart out!

name: Suave Suit of Ebil
description: You make ebil look GOOD! No one can match you for confidence, elegance, and sheer brilliance… and you know it.

name: Sub-Zero Berserker
description: Brrrr! You are an ice-cold killer!

name: Sublimated DragonSlayer
description: Dressing like a DragonSlayer gives you ALL the power!

name: Sublimated Gunslinger
description: Bounty hunting and gunslinging is just so awesome!

name: Sublimated ShadowSlayer
description: Each of us faces a choice in life… do we embrace the Shadow, or choose to battle its creatures? Sublimated ShadowSlayers will always seek to further the causes of the Light.

name: Successful EbilCorp Scalper
description: We were tempted to make this item cost an exorbitant amount of gold, but that just wouldn't be cool.

name: Sugar Sweet Pirate Captain
description: If land horses love sugar cubes, than the sea horses will never get enough of sweet little you!

name: Suit of Flame (Permanent)
description: Use this suit to pass through the heat and fumes of the volcano unharmed.

name: Suit of Flame (Temporary)
description: Use this suit to pass through the heat and fumes of the volcano unharmed.

name: Suit of Misfortune (0 AC)
description: There aren't any Nobles in the Underworld. Not in the traditional sense, but everyone in Dage the Evil's close circle gets so many perks, they might as well be called Nobles.

name: Suit of Misfortune (AC)
description: There aren't any Nobles in the Underworld. Not in the traditional sense, but everyone in Dage the Evil's close circle gets so many perks, they might as well be called Nobles.

name: Suki's Armor
description: This armor used to inspire awe and bring relief to the hearts of the downtrodden. In Astravia, the set invites whispers and sneers. Still, the former paladin protects her new home with her head held high. The most Suki can do is her best.

name: Suki's Armor (Temp)
description: This armor used to inspire awe and bring relief to the hearts of the downtrodden. In Astravia, the set invites whispers and sneers. Still, the former paladin protects her new home with her head held high. The most Suki can do is her best.

name: Suki's Casual Armor
description: This armor used to inspire awe and bring relief to the hearts of the downtrodden. In Astravia, the set invites whispers and sneers. Still, the former paladin protects her new home with her head held high. The most Suki can do is her best.

name: Suki's Seraphic Armor
description: The gold adorning the Seraphic Paladin armor once gleamed so brightly. Suki wore it with pride, showing off the dents and scars she earned from battles against evil. The Darkon she used to know would shake his head, repeatedly taking the armor to the smith to have it fixed.

name: Suki's Wetsuit
description: Suki prefers wetsuits. She wore them while cave diving, hunting for undead that lurked underwater. Casually sharing a story about how she almost drowned in complete darkness instilled a deep fear of cave diving into Darkon, despite how he'd never have to be in that situation.

name: Sullied BladeMaster
description: An undead samurai that has retained its swordsmanship, allowing Axeros to put them to good use.

name: Summer Casual Shirt
description: Life's a beach, and so is this summer outfit!

name: Summer DragonSlayer
description: Summertime is for (dragon) slaying!

name: Summer Rave A
description: For all those nights dancing on the beach.

name: Summer Scarletta and Vaden
description: Even villains can take a break from ways to enjoy some summer fun! This item has a chance to do the Undead Rush animation each time you auto-attack!

name: Summer Sidhe (0 AC)
description: The swimwear of Leanan Sidhe. Kelpies often get into altercations with her when she encroaches on their hunting grounds. Leanan Sidhe retains her charm even during fist fights with horses.

name: Summer Sidhe (AC)
description: The swimwear of Leanan Sidhe. Kelpies often get into altercations with her when she encroaches on their hunting grounds. Leanan Sidhe retains her charm even during fist fights with horses.

name: Summer Sidhe of the Shadows (0 AC)
description: The swimwear of Leanan Sidhe. Kelpies often get into altercations with her when she encroaches on their hunting grounds. Leanan Sidhe retains her charm even during fist fights with horses.

name: Summer Sidhe of the Shadows (AC)
description: The swimwear of Leanan Sidhe. Kelpies often get into altercations with her when she encroaches on their hunting grounds. Leanan Sidhe retains her charm even during fist fights with horses.

name: Summer Style
description: Dudes! Hang 10 in these gnarly suits and catch some waves!

name: Summer Uniform
description: A wise hero knows that no matter what season it is, there is always more to learn.

name: Summer Xeven and Sekt
description: Even villains can take a break from ways to enjoy some summer fun! This item has a chance to do the One Million Gold Showers animation each time you auto-attack.

name: Summer Zilla Swimwear (0 AC)
description: It's time for fun, sun, and a ton of hapless vacationers clearing the beach for Zilla, Queen of Monsters! Huh? What do you mean that name's taken already? (Tan is CC to Base)

name: Summer Zilla Swimwear (AC)
description: It's time for fun, sun, and a ton of hapless vacationers clearing the beach for Zilla, Queen of Monsters! Huh? What do you mean that name's taken already? (Tan is CC to Base)

name: Summoner Mori
description: Literally translated, the Summoner of Death. This highly prized artifact for vampires, lichs, and teenagers going through their goth phases. Ten percent of customers who buy this item, also get item Pink Cuddly Wuddly Kitty Cat Pet!

name: Sun Girl
description: For those that enjoy the sun and daytime!

name: Sun God Titan
description: Azura the Sun God demands vengeance. Pay homage to his power with the blood of your enemies, and you will prosper in his service. (Tattoo is CC to trim)

name: Sun God Warrior
description: Azura the Sun God demands vengeance. Pay homage to his power with the blood of your enemies, and you will prosper in his service. (Tattoo is CC to trim)

name: Sun Lord and Lady (Merge)
description: The sun shines brightly over the island of Yokai, thanks is large part to the patronage of the Sunlord and Sunlady. Show respect to those who renew the light at the beginning of each day!

name: Sun Lord and Lady (Wheel)
description: The sun shines brightly over the island of Yokai, thanks is large part to the patronage of the Sunlord and Sunlady. Show respect to those who renew the light at the beginning of each day!

name: Sunborn Guardian
description: Sunborn Guardians descend from the skies during the searing solstice of each year. They are the sun incarnate, and merely existing on Lore sets the ground alight until it becomes a bed of molten rock.

name: Sunborn Swashbuckler
description: Sail to the ends of the universe. Stop at the restaurant or pillage it.

name: Sunflower Outfit
description: Keepin' it cool in this awesome summery outfit. Sure hope you like flowers!

name: Sunflower Yukata
description: Himawari are what the Yokai Isles call sunflowers, and are symbols of hope and joy. To capture the season, the sun in the azure sky, and the yellow flowers that dot the land were turned into a bright yukata pattern.

name: Sunsuit Romper
description: Get ready to have fun in the sun!

name: Super Kathool Morph
description: It's going to be hard to change into this in a phonebooth.

name: Super Prince of Vegetables
description: Where did all that speed and power come from? You are UNSTOPPABLE!

name: Super Rich Buttermancer
description: There's no margarine for error with Buttermancer's, they melt their enemies. This item has a chance to do the One Million Gold Shower animation each time you auto-attack!

name: Super Scion Ninja
description: Becoming a Super Scion is easy, it's the charging up that takes most of the time. Usually close to half an hour. Plus side is you'll look super cool!

name: Super6 (Permanent)
description: Every bad guy's butt needs a good kickin' sometimes, and this is the gear you want to do it in!

name: Super6 (Temporary)
description: Every bad guy's butt needs a good kickin' sometimes, and this is the gear you want to do it in!

name: Supercharged Timewalker
description: For 13 years, you have battled through AdventureQuest Worlds, a merge of 3 different timelines. You've traveled lightyears already, but our adventures together are far from over!

name: Supernova Fortress Guard (AC)
description: It is sometimes difficult to tell if the Star Core guardians are human or not because of their emotionless exteriors and the metallic structures of their armors. Their intentions are noble but they are quick to jump to conclusions especially when dealing with an intruder. Watch your back!

name: Supernova Fortress Guard (Legend)
description: It is sometimes difficult to tell if the Star Core guardians are human or not because of their emotionless exteriors and the metallic structures of their armors. Their intentions are noble but they are quick to jump to conclusions especially when dealing with an intruder. Watch your back!

name: Supreme Shadowscythe Inquisitor
description: The Supreme Shadowscythe is a shadowy sect behind the powers of the Shadowscythe. The armor may no longer hold real powers, but the memories of the power still holds sway over the Shadowscythe.

name: Surge Disruptor
description: This creation is the culmination of Arcane knowledge and technological advancement. Able to weather hostile environments, they're meant to drag their enemies back into the dark ages.

name: Surtara Myrmidon
description: These knights are loyal servants to the esoteric knowledge from the infinite beyond. By harnessing the power of the sun, they display immeasurable strength and blistering pyromancy.

name: Swamp Beast
description: You have become one with the swamp! Its murky waters now flow through your veins.

name: Swanky Enchanted Suit
description: "We are but poor circus performers, it is dark and we are lost. We were told there was a village nearby that might enjoy our skills."

name: SwarmTrooper
description: SwarmTroopers often patrol a station in groups to increase their chances of dealing with a potential threat effectively. If one of them is caught alone, it is out of luck and out of sight for them.

name: Sweet Gothika
description: (Female Only) Gotta dress up to go to formal Mogloween parties!

name: Sweet Spring Mage
description: Your magic is fueled by the scent of spring flowers, gentle rains, and the strains of sweet songs drifting through sunlit groves.

name: Sweet Summer Suit (0 AC)
description: The perfect outfit for a day at the beach with your favorite battle companion!

name: Sweet Summer Suit (AC)
description: The perfect outfit for a day at the beach with your favorite battle companion!

name: Sweet Summer Wave
description: Summertime.. and the livin' is easy. And fun!

name: Sweet Summer Wedding Guest
description: Celebrate love and new beginnings in a sweet ensemble meant to wow! Everyone's trying to find the designer, but they were last seen scrambling back into Greenguard's forests.

name: Sweet Treat Healer
description: Just a spoonful of sugar helps the medicine go down.. but do you REALLY want to ingest something brewed in Darkovia?! O_O (Female Art Only)

name: Sweetch Gamer
description: This is THE hottest console on Lore right now. If you aren't using one, time to SWEETCH your gaming rig!

name: Sweetish Fish Suit
description: Be the "catch of the day" in this sweet-ish outfit! Gills not included.

name: SwiftShift Knight
description: Don this fashionable armor and protect your allies.

name: Swim Suit
description: Grab your SPF 9000 and hit the sands of Lore, beach bunnies and surfer dudes.

name: Sword Spirit Knight
description: A knightly mage that combines the might of the sword with the finess of astrological magic. They summon the stars and wield them as swords in the service of justice. (CC to Trim,Accessory)

name: Sword Spirit Shield Knight
description: A knightly mage that combines the might of the sword with the finess of astrological magic. They summon the stars and wield them as swords in the service of justice.

name: Swordhaven Adept
description: Champions that are loyal to the King earn the right to don this armor and fight for Swordhaven.

name: Swordhaven Cleric
description: Clerics raised and trained in Swordhaven, a Kingdom that protects the weak and the trapped. They are a welcome sight in every home, castle, and even prisons. Everyone has a right to be healed and live well. (CC to Base, Trim, Accessory)

name: Swordhaven Courtier
description: The garb of nobles that attend to the members of the royal family, whether that be secretarial work or lending an ear. Notably, the new royalty began dressing commoners in these clothes and inviting them to the castle.

name: Swordhaven Courtly Attire
description: The ornate fashion currently favored by the noble court of Swordhaven. Skilled tailors often create clothes for the nobility first, before the style catches on with the wealthy citizens of the capital.

name: Swordhaven Defender
description: The people of Swordhaven trust and depend on your skill in battle to keep them safe.

name: Swordhaven Diplomat
description: Swordhaven is home to more than fish and neutrality. These diplomats enjoy neither candy, nor war, but will take up a blade if ensuring peace requires it.

name: Swordhaven Emissary
description: The Swordhaven Emissary is a diplomatic representative of Swordhaven and by extension, all of Greenguard. They are skilled rangers in their own right, able to protect themselves and important individuals traveling with them.

name: Swordhaven Loyalist
description: Show your true loyalty to Swordhaven in this gilded armor.

name: Swordhaven Master Adept
description: Champions that are loyal to the King earn the right to don this armor and fight for Swordhaven. Does a bit more damage against humans than normal armors.

name: Swordhaven Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: For many years, King Alteon has ruled Swordhaven with a fair and just hand. His fight to defeat Chaos will NEVER stop until all of Lore -- and everyone he loves -- is safe again.

name: Swordhaven Naval Commander (AC)
description: For many years, King Alteon has ruled Swordhaven with a fair and just hand. His fight to defeat Chaos will NEVER stop until all of Lore -- and everyone he loves -- is safe again.

name: Swordhaven Pendragon
description: The epitome of nobility and chivalry, the Swordhaven Pendragons are the perfect image of a pure knight. Upholding their ideals isn't easy. It requires complete dedication, and the sacrifice of all selfish wishes.

name: Swordhaven Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: Avast me hearties! Some of the Knights of Swordhaven have turned to piracy!

name: Swordhaven Pirate Captain (AC)
description: Avast me hearties! Some of the Knights of Swordhaven have turned to piracy!

name: Swordhaven Royalty
description: A gleaming battle suit forged in the glory and dedication of the late King Alteon. Lineage is nothing when you receive the high honor of commanding your own division of good. Long live the King!

name: Swordhaven Scout
description: Greenguard is a vast mosiac of forest and mountains, needing constant and steady patrols. Scouts are a newer member of Swordhaven's forces, recruited from all walks of life. Wherever evil hides, the Scouts will find them.

name: Swordhaven War Caster
description: Mages that serve Swordhaven study tirelessly to protect Greenguard against Evil. In Lore, war is an inevitability. War Casters use a combination of army tactics and magical expertise to help organize soldier formations.

name: SwordMaster Armor
description: With harsh lifestyles, they can overcome any punishment to them. While being swift and nimble, they also do massive amount of damage when on the brink of death.

name: Sworn Legion Sovereign
description: The Underworld has one Lord, and it's Dage the Evil…should he ever need someone to watch his throne, he forged worthy regalia for a sovereign he knows more than his own blood. The Legion kneels to them without question.

name: Sworn Underworld Sovereign (0 AC)
description: The Underworld has one Lord, and it's Dage the Evil…should he ever need someone to watch his throne, he forged worthy regalia for a sovereign he knows more than his own blood. The Legion kneels to them without question.

name: Sworn Underworld Sovereign (AC)
description: The Underworld has one Lord, and it's Dage the Evil…should he ever need someone to watch his throne, he forged worthy regalia for a sovereign he knows more than his own blood. The Legion kneels to them without question.

name: Symphonic Bandmaster
description: ﻿Virtuosos who honed their craft in Mythsong and journeyed to royal courts, vibrant music halls, and even the battlefied. A rousing tune stirs the soul and motivates them to glorious action.

name: Synderes Groupie Armor
description: Show the world that you love Synderes' music by equipping their outfit, then /dance your way through the Forest of Good and Evil!

name: Sys-Zero's Mecha Suit
description: *No description*

name: T-421
description: SkyNet has begun its assault on humanity. All of Earth is doomed! Hasta la vista, Hero.

name: T-Shirt & Tats Outfit
description: Gotta roll up the t-shirt arms to show off the tats!

name: Tacomancer
description: You are what you eat. And if you eat tacos… you are a Tacomancer! May the fates (and arteries) have mercy on us all!

name: Tactical Agent Alpha
description: *No description*

name: Tactical Agent Bravo
description: *No description*

name: Tainted Druid
description: These Druids once served Brightoak, but now they've been corrupted and wish to see it's destruction.

name: Tainted Naval Commander 0 (AC)
description: YARRRR! Th' Archfiend recruits only th' fiercest pirates t' his fiendish crew o' seafarin' thieves. (Click on Nation Shoulder Symbol)

name: Tainted Naval Commander (AC)
description: YARRRR! Th' ArchFiend recruits only th' fiercest pirates t' his fiendish crew o' seafarin' thieves. (Click on Nation Shoulder Symbol)

name: Talisman of Caladbolg Shirt
description: The dead are meant to crawl, sink into the earth, and sleep. When the dead walk, clinging to the stirring dark- the world will crack open. Its yolk belonging to the Lord of the Undead.

name: Talisman of Davey Jones Shirt
description: Bear the crest of the most famous, deadest, pirate.

name: Talisman of ShadowScythe T-Shirt
description: You're Doomed, and that's pretty metal.

name: Tan Space Crew Shirt
description: You've got a good chance of surviving the away party.

name: Tango's Dancin' Armor
description: When you get tired of /samba, you can also try to tango!

name: Tank Mech
description: PEW PEW PEW action hero tank!

name: Tanuki Morph
description: A mascot morph of Tanuki, the prankster Yokai raccoon! Try not to get into too much trouble…

name: Taotie Nopperabo Samurai
description: Ai No Miko commissioned a set of armor made from the hide and eyes of the Perilous Taotie. It fills the wearer with a ceaseless will to fight. If they aren't constantly purified by the Empress, the Samurai will transform into a new Taotie.

name: Tarandus Battle Armor
description: The Tarandus are a race of reindeer people rumored to exist in the coldest, most remote parts of Lore. Their existence is still unconfirmed. Do you believe?

name: Tau Ceti Soldier
description: Constructed by the infamous armor-crafter, Reddy, the Tau Ceti Soldiers hail from the cosmos and bring their thirst for domination with them to the land of Lore!

name: Taurean Defender
description: The armor worn by heroic and compassionate warlord Lu Niu, who protects his people by unleashing his unbridled violence towards enemies.

name: Tech Archer
description: While some use future technology to start a new, the Tech Archer uses technology to improve on the old. Their skills with a bow are uncontested throughout the galaxy.

name: Techno ArchFiend DoomLord (0 AC)
description: Not even the dark magic of the Shadowscythe is enough to satisfy this soul's lust for power.

name: Techno ArchFiend DoomLord (AC)
description: Not even the dark magic of the Shadowscythe is enough to satisfy this soul's lust for power.

name: Techno Champion of Chaos (0 AC)
description: Chaos reigns?? HAHAHAHAHAAAA! This armor is PROOF you've taken down the Champion of Chaos! (Gives 5% more damage against Chaos monsters AND 5% more XP!)

name: Techno Champion of Chaos (AC)
description: Chaos reigns?? HAHAHAHAHAAAA! This armor is PROOF you've taken down the Champion of Chaos! (Gives 5% more damage against Chaos monsters AND 5% more XP!)

name: Techno Mage
description: Wield the power of electricity! Bind it to the mana coursing through your veins! United, the power of music, magic, and SCIENCE! will let you control more power than you ever could have handled before!

name: Techno Paladin Wanderer
description: The power of Time powers these Chronomancers as they travel the length and breadth of Lore, always searching for those in need.

name: Techno SkyGuard Captain's Uniform (0 AC)
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment. (This item is color customizable)

name: Techno SkyGuard Captain's Uniform (AC)
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment. (This item is color customizable)

name: Technomancer Armor
description: Threads of recreated samples obtained from the Lord of DragonFable, the Technomancers possess the ability to control machines. Ah, wouldn't life be so much easier if we didn't have to manually flick a switch?

name: Technomancer Paladin
description: The power of Time powers these Chronomancers as they travel the length and breadth of Lore, always searching for those in need.

name: Techtronic ArchPaladin
description: In the future, paladins fight with the most high-tech light of all -- LASERS! Armor suggested by Gandiral and Venthos!

name: Techtronic Biker (AC)
description: They haven't built a circuit that could hold you!

name: Techtronic Biker (Legend)
description: They haven't built a circuit that could hold you!

name: TechV9
description: After being lost in space during a terrible accident, doctors had to fuse your still functioning organs with machines. You are now an indestructible force to be reckoned with in the galaxy!

name: Teen Slasher
description: Sometimes you have to turn the tables on the monsters.

name: Temp Fox
description: You are a tricky and untrustworthy fox. You have little friends, but it does not discourage you. Who needs a group when you can achieve goals through deception or is it you secretly need a real friend?

name: Temp Owl
description: Fly high above forests and above mountains. You are a mighty owl that never settles for the smaller things. It could take a while to master the palm-sized wings, though.

name: Temp Rabbit
description: Rabbits aren't always soft, cute and cuddly in human eyes. You are swift and fast, able to escape danger at a moment's notice. In this care, your enemy would need better DEX to halt your speed.

name: Tempest Armor
description: The power of the great spring storms has been woven into this armor.

name: Tempest (Armor)
description: Unleash the unforgiving force of weather on your foes, they'll be blown away.

name: Tempest Dracolich Armor
description: Dracoliches bound to the wind and its skies are known to be the most dangerous during hurricane season, making them extremely difficult to destroy properly.

name: Tempest Soldier (Armor)
description: Huge fans of cookies, the Tempest Soldier will follow any orders given just to get more of them.

name: Tempest Void
description: The Tempest Voids are responsible for the countless storms blasting through Tercessuinotlim! A distant cousin to the Hex Voids, they are proven to be very resilient even in the worst environmental conditions.

name: Temporal Agent
description: Temporal Agents are the bane of those who would taint the fabric of our universe. They patrol the timestream, destroying any who would manipulate it for their selfish ends.

name: Temporal Aurora
description: Crafted from chunks of frozen Aurora Borealis mined by Astromancers in the far Northlands, if you look deep into the blue-green material, you may become transfixed.

name: Temporary Sparring Suit
description: It's time to spar!

name: Tempus Mori
description: So many souls, so little time. You're the spirit of death looking for more souls to invite to the afterlife.

name: Tempus Mori Terram
description: So many souls, so little time. You're the spirit of death looking for more souls to invite to the afterlife.

name: Tenebral Warrior
description: Without darkness, there can be no light. Tenebral Warriors know that darkness is not always evil. It is a force of nature as powerful, fundamental, and natural as any other element.

name: Tengu Admiral
description: Monks, peerless in the martial arts, transform into Tengu when they give into their desire for worldy pleasures. One such monk disappeared from a temple by the coast, and now sky and sea fear their silhouette.

name: Tennousei Retainer Kitsune
description: An Emperor won the respect of kitsune that sword danced in the heavens. They descended to hear his poems and became his most fiersome and mysterious warriors.

name: Terno Encantado
description: Todos na cidade vão admirá-lo quando você usar isso. (Everyone in town will admire you when you wear this.) (This item is color customizable.)

name: Terno Rosa
description: A cor rosa deixa todo mundo lindo. Assim como este terno. (The color pink makes everyone look beautiful. So does this suit.)

name: Terra Robe
description: This leafy green mantle is the garb of earth elementalists. Vine trim encircles the outfit that is infused with the power of mother nature.

name: Terran Dragonlord
description: With their partner, the Terran Dragon of Prosperity and Plenty, the Terran Dragonlords have diligently protected their home for generations. The Yokai Isles' fields flourish even in the wake of fires.

name: Terran Dragonlord of Prosperity
description: With their partner, the Terran Dragon of Prosperity and Plenty, the Terran Dragonlords have diligently protected their home for generations. The Yokai Isles' fields flourish even in the wake of fires.

name: Terrifier
description: If you weren't afraid of clowns before… you should be now!

name: Territorial Lion
description: Grrrrrrroaar! You are one territorial lion who does not know the meaning of 'cowardice'.

name: Terror Lord
description: Donning this armor designed by RazzleDazzle gives you an insatiable appetite for the stuff of nightmares. You become what everyone fears, and this pleases you. You are now a TerrorLord, and terror is just what you'll bring!

name: Thanatos (Armor)
description: Not many have seen Thanatos… and even fewer have lived to tell the tale. Only those with an undying (and somewhat insane) dedication to the Undead Legion are worthy of becoming Thanatos. Does 50% more damage to humans.

name: That NightMare Clown
description: That's IT. I quit. I draw the line at creepy clowns.

name: The Beast Below
description: A creature of legend, patrolling the darkened caverns and labyrinths of the world.

name: The Boatman
description: Fear not the Reaper, they are merely a beleaguered guide. Fear Death, who drifts upon the river of time instead of riding a pale horse. (Hourglass sand CC to Base, Click on skull to make it disappear while idle-ing)

name: The Butcher (Armor)
description: At midnight the butcher will rise! Hopefully your not the next bodies draining on his hooks!

name: The Chaos Knight
description: You once served all that is Good. Now you sever all that is Good and Evil as the Chaos Knight!

name: The Collector Armor
description: Last time you beat the Collector, now you are him! Bigger in the inside dome sold separately.

name: The Dark Doctor When
description: The only thing cooler than bowties and pinstripes? Black bowties and pinstripes.

name: The Dark Sun
description: Though the sun gives strength and vitality to most, there are those who wish to harness its power for pure evil!

name: The DracoPlate
description: It's rumored to have been created from the breastplate of an undead male dragon under the control of Dage the Evil.

name: The Dryad
description: As tree nymph, The Dryad is able to communicate with the spirits of the forest. As the forest's protecter, The Dryad will do whatever it takes to stop anyone from harming her home.

name: The Fallen Emperor
description: Once a mighty emperor, rulling over parts of Lore, Luis Henrique Ih fell at the hands of his trusted page. The page thought that he had disposed of the emperor but one thing he didn't check was to see if the emperor took his final breath.

name: The Fallen Mage
description: The Fallen Mage robes match those of Karok the Fallen. For the discerning hero who does not have time to battle Karok to get his gear. Gives 15% more class points when equipped!

name: The Fiending
description: An apprentice cryomancer experienced frostbite for over two months without finding any sign of warmth. The hoarfrost around him fused with his magic, turning his skin to ice crystals that make up the fearsome and strong elemental he became.

name: The First Fallen
description: Once mystical Celestial beings created by Arthelyn, the First Fallen left in search of more power.

name: The First Risen
description: These Celestial beings were the original creations by Arthelyn when she created the realm.

name: The Giant Dwarf
description: A mammoth dwarf! A small giant! Use the best attributes from both races as you throw down in the battle ring.

name: The Giant Red Dwarf
description: You'd rather be lying on a beach, shipwrecked and comatose drinking fresh mango juice… but you live under a mountain.

name: The Greatest Pumpkin
description: It's the Great Pumpkin, [First Name] Hero [Last Name] AQW!

name: The Harvester
description: You roam the Black Labyrinth, harvesting the bodies of fallen creatures for any loot you can find. Some day, your debt will be paid.

name: The Illuminated One
description: To walk the path of light, you must first journey to the darknest depths of Lore and vanquish all that is Evil.

name: The Judged
description: The three judges of the underworld have been at their posts for quite some time. The underworld is ridden with those who have come up short in their eyes.

name: The Light Seekers
description: We bask in the glory of the light it shall give us strength and lead us against the dark forces. If we shall perish, it will calm us as we embrace Death's cold hand. Only the light holds the power of true redemption!

name: The Loop Armor
description: One week… one week… and it'll be the unluckiest week of your life!

name: The Lost Knight
description: This lost knight was once a brave warrior, but could not survive the horrors of… THE SPLATTER REALM! *Cue horror movie sound FX*

name: The Loyalist Armor
description: Are you willing to stay tried-and-true to the cause as you follow your leaders to the ends of the world?

name: The MatchMaker
description: No hero will be able to resist your matchmaking machinations when invite them to join you on your next adventure.

name: The Mischief
description: Only a trickster of disguise wears color customizable clothing.

name: The Neverborn (Armor) (1)
description: Travelling through timespace can color the body with the stars and nebulas that hang around the cosmos in exchange for a split body. That's why timespace travel should be left to professionals.

name: The Neverborn (Armor) (2)
description: Travelling through timespace can color the body with the stars and nebulas that hang around the cosmos in exchange for a split body. That's why timespace travel should be left to professionals.

name: The Nights of Wrath
description: On Mogloween, they come back… TERRORIZING and TORMENTING. Once they are done, all that will be left is a trail of destruction!

name: The Obfuscated One
description: To walk the path of darkness, you must first journey to the brightest heights of Lore and vanquish all that is Good.

name: The Ogre's Armor
description: The armor worn by the Coliseum's Champion Bestiarius, The Ogre. Maybe once you've won a few more matches, he'll let you add all of his trophy embellishments.

name: The Ol Fishin' Garb
description: How many fisherman do you see wearing a full suit of chain mail? I rest my case. Grab your Fishin' Rod and favorite hat and let's catch some grub!

name: The Order of Seeker
description: There are those who try to bring balance to Lore and those who seek out havoc. Which one are you?

name: The Piercer Plate
description: Bones and axes and headstones, oh my!

name: The Point
description: What is it?

name: The Red and Depraved
description: A group of crazy psychopaths, the The Red and Depraved roam the halls of Pandinus Insane Asylum just waiting to condemn its next guests to a living nightmare!

name: The Seekers of Chaos (AC)
description: There are those who try to bring balance to Lore and those who seek out havoc. Which one are you?

name: The Seekers of Chaos (Legend)
description: There are those who try bring balance to Lore and those who seek out havoc. Which one are you?

name: The Shade of Humanity
description: There is a darkness in all of us, these are just the people who have embraced it.

name: The Shadow Manipulator
description: As I walk through the battlefield full of shadow and death, I take a look at the war and realize that there's nothing left. Crafted by Darkon Drago!

name: The Shadow of Death
description: The Shadow of Death clan has no concern for petty conflicts. They rather just fight and watch the world burn.

name: The Spawn
description: Who knows how the battle will go? Guess you'll just have to WING it.

name: The StarWalker (AC)
description: "You can't stop the change, any more than you can stop the time from passing."

name: The StarWalker (Special)
description: "You can't stop the change, any more than you can stop the time from passing."

name: The Ultimate Horror
description: DERP, it's my new obsession. DERP, it's not even a question. DERP, on the lips of your lover. 'Cause DERP is the love you discover.

name: The Unhinged
description: Inside of the Pandinus Insane Asylum, the Unhinged are just one of the many who contain the delusions of grandeur. They might have once been the hero or villain, but now they are the trapped within their own thoughts, waiting to escape…. THAT TIME IS NOW!

name: The Unholy Armor
description: You embody all that is unholy and corrupt in the world!

name: The Unholy of Vokun
description: Those who choose to join the Unity will be forever rewarded… and set apart when they purchase this armor!

name: The Unknown
description: The origins of this otherworldly armor are…well, unknown. But theavenger07 may know!

name: Thermal Lorekeeper of the Moon
description: Because seriously, when you live in the snowy mountains of Dwarfhold, your legs can get really cold!

name: Thermal Lorekeeper of the Sun
description: Because seriously, when you live in the snowy mountains of Dwarfhold, your legs can get really cold!

name: Thermal Titan
description: This Armor is HOT!

name: Thief of Hours Armor
