description: Students of the Way of The Clock style of martial arts, theses monks are trained to manipulate time magic to steal hours from their foes and use them to increase their own time to study and perfect their fighting style.

name: Thin Guy
description: The notes are a trick, you know. No matter what you do, he takes you.

name: Think Pink Cheerleader
description: Give me a P! Give me an I! Give me an N! And give me a K! And what does it spell? PINK! PINK for everybody! (Suggested by Cosmic Boo)

name: Third Armor Shaped Gift
description: A present shaped like an armor! Save this and it will magiclly open at the start of the new year. No peeking!

name: Thok's Tundra Marauder Armor (0 AC)
description: Back when Thok used to be a travelling warrior in seach of greater and greater challenges, he faced the cold. This suit of armor used to be pure steel, but ice began to grow in its crevaces and never melted.

name: Thok's Tundra Marauder Armor (AC)
description: Back when Thok used to be a travelling warrior in seach of greater and greater challenges, he faced the cold. This suit of armor used to be pure steel, but ice began to grow in its crevaces and never melted.

name: Thok's War Armor
description: Thok was once the Warlord of his own clan of Warriors. With that life long behind him, he planted his flag in Battleon, and began wearing its colors. With his leadership, even farmers can become fearless fighters.

name: Thorezek WorldBreaker
description: Kin to Kezeroth the World Ender, Thorezek the World-Breaker knows that where his cousin and Quetzal failed… HE will succeed. When he is through, nothing and no one will be left standing.

name: Thorn of Nulgath (AC)
description: The Thorns of Nulgath are a silent, deadly, almost invisible corps of elite assassins. You do not know they are hunting you until you feel their blade pierce through your side.

name: Thorn of Nulgath (Legend)
description: The Thorns of Nulgath are a silent, deadly, almost invisible corps of elite assassins. You do not know they are hunting you until you feel their blade pierce through your side.

name: Those of the Despair
description: With death always on the horizon, Those of the Despair have come to terms with the fact that can not escape their fate. So they march on, leaving a trail of bodies that even Death has no room for. Only gloom and sorrow will follow in their wake! There is no hope left for you!

name: Thrilling Outfit
description: Zombies are everywhere you look… and suddenly, you are overcome with the urge to moonrun! This is a Mogloween Seasonal Rare!

name: Thug J6
description: Thug life, baby, like a J6.

name: Thug J6 (Temporary)
description: Thug life, baby, like a J6.

name: Thunder Flurry Juvania
description: Juvania designed her own Mogloween costume, and it was inspired by a mythical, divine beast. She prefers to stick to healing, but pretending to be an all-powerful thunder priestess is a lot of fun!

name: ThunderBolt Striker
description: Call down the lightning and summon thunder to terrify your foes with this armor from Twilly's Spring Seasonal 2013 shop!

name: Thunderborn Battlegear
description: You'd think that combining lightning and water would be dangerous. Not for the Thunderborn!

name: Thunderfang Battlemage
description: With your power, lightning never has to strike the same place twice.

name: Thunderlight Pirate
description: In life, different people have different directions to go in order to pursue their ambitions and dreams… make yours count in style! (CC to Base)

name: Thundermoon Mystic
description: They move with the elegance and wonder of the moon. These mystics wield magic that changes based on the face of their heavenly benefactor. Some believe they can even change the phase of the moon with a waltz.

name: Thunderous Zephyr Dragon
description: The sounds of thunder. The heat of lightning. The roar of the winds. The approach of the mighty Zephyr Dragon echos through the air. Even nature will bow before you once you have become the wind dragon. This armor will not only announce your greatness, but defend you to the end.

name: Thundersnow Demigod
description: Power must be paid for. If the Shadows and Storms of Skye had been successfully devoured, and if the Envoy of Ice offered their life willingly - a new demigod would have been born, and ripped open the heavens.

name: Ti's Armor
description: This blackened shell sinks its teeth into its bearer, so make sure to thank La. It took a lot more than a potato peeler to get it off of Ti. Size adjustments included.

name: Ti's Ornate Armor
description: Ti has never worn this armor. "Too decorative" for him.

name: Tibicenas (Armor)
description: Embrace the evil within as you assume the form of this corrupted Djinn!

name: Tidal Byakko Warrior
description: Tidal Tiger Warriors are benevolent and cheerful fighters trained in the ferocious martial art of the Akiban Tigers, and they keep Yokai Isle a safe haven of roaring prosperity!

name: Tidal Tiger Warrior
description: Tidal Tiger Warriors are benevolent and cheerful fighters trained in the ferocious martial art of the Akiban Tigers, and they keep Yokai Isle a safe haven of roaring prosperity!

name: Tidal Warrior of Prosperity
description: Tidal Tiger Warriors are benevolent and cheerful fighters trained in the ferocious martial art of the Akiban Tigers, and they keep Yokai Isle a safe haven of roaring prosperity!

name: Tidebound Maiden
description: The garb of an ocean maiden blessed by the Queen of the Southern Sea, flowing with emerald and gold tides.

name: Tiger Skin
description: And the last known survivor stalks his prey in the night / And he's watchin' us all in the armor of the tiger.

name: TigerClaw Hoodie Outfit
description: New for 2022, the House of Miko presents: the Tiger Hoodie! Look fierce as your ROAR into battle or stalk down the catwalk in Akiba.

name: Tigers Away Team (AC)
description: *No description*

name: Tigers Away Team (Legend)
description: *No description*

name: Tigers Team (AC)
description: *No description*

name: Tigers Team (Legend)
description: *No description*

name: Tigers Varsity Team
description: *No description*

name: Tiki Fun
description: Stylish and nightmarish, you'll be the best looking surfer at the party.

name: Tiki Nightmare
description: Natives give offerings of chocolate mint cookies and hamburgers with pineapple to appease the god Memehano.

name: Timber-Wolferine
description: Hugh Lumberjackmen is the best of the ax-men!

name: Timber-Wolferine Declawed
description: Trying to stay inconspicuous as a Lumberhackman can be difficult sometimes…

name: Time Assassin
description: Walk through the void known as time, but be wary of what lies at the end.

name: Timedragon Warrior (Armor)
description: The time dragon thanks you for your valiant efforts defending its life!

name: TimeKeeper Armor
description: On the battlefield, you give a new meaning to killing time. What time is it? Killing Time! When is it? Always!

name: TimeKiller Armor
description: On the battlefield, you give a new meaning to killing time. What time is it? Killing Time! When is it? Always!

name: Timeless Chronomancer (Armor)
description: Time flows, curves and circles back on itself. Corrupted Chronomancers introduce flaws into the stream to better manipulate it.

name: Timeless Dark Caster Armor (0 AC)
description: You have mastered every form of the arcane. Even among the Dark Casters, you are a legend.

name: Timeless Dark Caster Armor (AC)
description: You have mastered every form of the arcane. Even among the Dark Casters, you are a legend. Recommended enhancement: Wizard

name: TimeReaper
description: Where Drakath goes the TimeReapers follow. Have to help keep the timelines clean!

name: Timeseeker (AC)
description: Only the most skilled Treasurehunters become Timeseekers, questing across the timestreams that make up the fabric of our universe.

name: Timeseeker (Legend)
description: Only the most skilled Treasurehunters become Timeseekers, questing across the timestreams that make up the fabric of our universe.

name: Timestream Ravager
description: Those who can cross between times and worlds are the most dangerous of opponents. You never know where they will run to, or which direction they'll attack!

name: Timewalker
description: For 13 years, you have battled through AdventureQuest Worlds, a merge of 3 different timelines. You've traveled lightyears already, but our adventures together are far from over!

name: Tinsel's Armor Gift
description: Festive Frostval 2019! These giftboxes will open on January 1st, 2020 to reveal your EPIC Frostval set!

name: Tinsel's Second Armor Gift
description: A present shaped like an armor! Save this and it will magiclly open at the start of the new year. No peeking!

name: Titan Attendant
description: The Blood Titan cannot do many things for himself due to his large size. He requires an attendant… and YOU have been selected to help him!

name: Titan Drakath (Armor)
description: Son of the Progenitor, the Queen of monstrous Titans, Drakath has long been her pawn. His ambition and fury will continue to threaten our world… all of our worlds, in all of its times.

name: Titan Hunter
description: Brown, Brawn, and Strong! Titan Hunters strive to slay the most ferocious beasts that no other warrior dare encounter. EpicDuel's Titan had better watch out…

name: Titan of Madness (Armor)
description: Known as Creature 8, this creation was meant to hold a massive amount of power within a small humanoid body. The result is destructive, but extremely unstable.

name: Titan Paladin
description: If you don't fight, you can't win. For the Light… For Good… BATTLEON!

name: Titan Slayer
description: Titans will lay down their arms upon seeing you. Giants will fall before you. The Destroyer of Worlds will tremble at your approach. You ARE the TitanSlayer.

name: Titanic Destroyer (Armor)
description: Remember the terror of being dominated by Drakath's Titans… but remember, too, the hope and joy that came with your victory over them!

name: Titanium FrostElf Royalty
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This battle gear is worn during challenges to take the throne. (The fabric on this item is color-customizable.)

name: Titanium Plate of the North
description: This is a replica of ceremonial armor worn by the High Kings of the North. Few can bear the weight of its titanium plate. Fewer still can bear the responsibility of their crown.

name: Tog Slayer
description: A recreation of an armor, from the Lore of DragonFable, that has been passed down by Rolith and given to those who are good at what they do, and what they do isn't very nice, SLAYING TOGS!

name: Toga
description: Ideal for parties, formal speeches, or ruling an empire.

name: Toil Armor
description: As the eldest of the Cauldron Siblings, Toil is resourceful and creative when it comes to attempting to add new flavors to her candy recipes. By "borrowing" the silk-woven apparel, hopefully you can tolerate spiders. They tend to burrow in the cloth.

name: Tomb Thief
description: You're a sneaky raider who's only goal is to rob the pyramids of their wonderful things.

name: Tombstone Armor
description: So… what do you want on your tombstone? What,there's no pizza in the Wild West,you lily-livered bullet-dodger! Grab your gun and get ready to face off,because my finger's just itching to pull the trigger!

name: Tomix's SoulWeaver
description: Weave with souls… or steal them!

name: Too-Slow Slayer
description: You were an Undead Trophyhunter… until the Evil Undead cheated and defeated you. Now you can spend your unlife hunting the trophyhunters!

name: Top Speed Racer
description: You're on a ride that packs a hundred horsepower, and takes up way less space than a stable.

name: Tora Warrior
description: With perseverance and study, you too can become an Tora Warrior. The more you study, the more you become closer to the tiger.

name: Totally Pink Moglin Morph
description: Need more pink in your life? So did Beleen, so she made a pink-a-licious Moglin armor! Happy Birthday Beleen! =D

name: Tournament Champion
description: Be a Champion in a league all your own.

name: Tower Guardian (Armor)
description: For BattleOn! For the Tower! For Lore!

name: Tower Mystic
description: Only those with a great knowledge in sorcery shall be able to protect the Amberheart Tower from Chaotic creatures.

name: Toxian Strider
description: As they hunt for radioactive material to power their machinery, the Toxian Striders are regarded with awe by Mages and scientists. They're harnessing a dangerous force with potential few understand.

name: Toxic Alchemist
description: Bido's loyal followers don these robes for they are the alchemists who specialize in creating something from nothing. Give them a bit of sand and after awhile they will turn it into gold (We promise).

name: Toxic Alchemist Rogue
description: A subset of the Toxic Alchemists are known to dwell in Greenguard Forest, battling alongside the rogues there as they harvest reagents to craft deadly new gear.

name: Toxic Diviner
description: Bido's loyal Diviners don these robes for they are the warlocks who protect the strange relics that Bido has stashed away.

name: Toxic Fiend of Nulgath
description: A general in Nulgath's army, the Infernalfiend is willing to do WHATEVER it takes to please his master and lead his armies to victory! (Talk to Swindle in /tercessuinotlim to quest for the helm)

name: Toxic Flame Biker
description: Get your mana runnin'. Headin' out of Yulgars. Lookin' for adventure. And whatever enemy come our way. BAAAAATLLLLLE OOOONNNN!

name: Toxic Houndmaster
description: ﻿A peerless hunter and tracker. Though they used to walk amongst brigands and bandits, their experience and skills in taming hounds ready for the hunt found them in the employ of royalty.

name: Toxic Knight Captain
description: While wandering through Lore, Bido came across a set of Knights that had become corrupted by a horrible toxin. Needless to say, he just had to grab their gear!

name: Toxic Mantis
description: Adjusting to an exoskeleton structure is tedious when you've been walking on two limbs for a majority of your life. On the bright side, you won't have to worry about getting poisoned ever again.

name: Toxic Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Avast! Who knows what kind of sludge these pirates sailed into… whatever it was, it was sure toxic!

name: Toxic Naval Commander (AC)
description: Avast! Who knows what kind of sludge these pirates sailed into… whatever it was, it was sure toxic!

name: Toxic Scavenger
description: During the quarterly renewal ceremonies that the Brightoak Druids perform, this creature appears. Sadly this one got scared and ran into Extriki's toxins which ended in it getting tainted.

name: Toxic Spirit
description: This is what happens when the Guardian's become corrupted.

name: Toxic Swank Armor
description: Black tie affair? How boring! Everyone will be green with envy seeing you in this Cysero approved tux.

name: Toxic Symbiote
description: Don't you know that you're toxic? (3% chance to do Toxic breath animation, gives 10% boost to Class Points and XP, plus 15% boost to rep)

name: Toxic Wanderer
description: Though you call the desert home, with your battle skills and intellect, you can find work anywhere… as long as someone is willing to pay.

name: Toxic WyvernSlayer
description: Only a hero immune to a broad spectrum of toxins would be able to survive an encounter with a Venomous Wyvern… or brave enough to wear gems created from its crystallized poison.

name: Toxic X-Terminator
description: You want to defeat the poison? Better suit up first!

name: Toxica Armor
description: Poisons can be very useful in the right hands. Toxic, deadly, but VERY useful. As a practitioner of poisoning, this noxious armor is perfect for you.

name: Transcendent of Tercessuinotlim (0 AC)
description: When you truly distinguish yourself in battle against Nulgath's foes, you may be invited to join the Transcendent. An elite force that can smash thier way through an army.

name: Transcendent of Tercessuinotlim (AC)
description: When you truly distinguish yourself in battle against Nulgath's foes, you may be invited to join the Transcendent. An elite force that can smash thier way through an army.

name: Transcendent of Tercessuinotlim (Quest)
description: When you truly distinguish yourself in battle against Nulgath's foes, you may be invited to join the Transcendent. An elite force that can smash thier way through an army.

name: Traveling Bard
description: If you wish to travel the world as a bard, you have got to look #!

name: Treant Morph
description: Treants are strangely related to humans and trees, combining features of both species… Inspired by player Lightman.

name: Treasured Hero of Gold
description: This set is 100% gold. Literally. Made out of the many gold coins you've saved up while adventuring. Talk about a status symbol!

name: TreasureHunter Kingpin
description: TreasureHunters rich with gold and charisma become hometown tycoons. With a discerning eye and a wealth of skill, nothing can stay hidden for long.

name: TreasureHunter Magnate
description: TreasureHunters rich with gold and charisma become hometown tycoons. With a discerning eye and a wealth of skill, nothing can stay hidden for long.

name: TreasureHunter Tycoon
description: TreasureHunters rich with gold and charisma become hometown tycoons. With a discerning eye and a wealth of skill, nothing can stay hidden for long.

name: TreasureHunter Z
description: For those who seek out treasure danger may be around every corner.

name: Tribal Atlas Lion Warrior
description: A legendary warrior honored by ancient prophecies. The Atlas Lion is destined to shoulder the weight of the world, and destroy all Evil. Their utopia is their pride, and will stand the test of time.

name: Tribal Chieftains Away Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Tribal Chieftains Away Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Tribal Chieftains Rush Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Tribal Chieftains Rush Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Tribal Chieftains Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Tribal Chieftains Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Tribal Chieftains Varsity Team
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Tribal Horc Armor
description: Dance to the music of the Mountain with this armor.

name: Tribal Mummy
description: Not what I'd want to meet in the middle of a pyramid in the middle of the night.

name: Trickster's Apprentice
description: This wandering magician can change one's fortune in the blink of an eye. Their deck plays with souls and fate, even if darker entities think they've won control of them.

name: Trickster Shifter
description: This wandering magician can change one's fortune in the blink of an eye. Their deck plays with souls and fate, even if darker entities think they've won control of them. (Click to change the arm position.)

name: Trislayer Armor
description: This armor shows that you have slain Trigoras, the great three-headed dragon!

name: Troll Armor (Permanent)
description: To perform one's best, one must LOOK one's best! Otherwise, the Trolls in your audience will just laugh at you.

name: Troll Armor (Temporary)
description: To perform one's best, one must LOOK one's best! Otherwise, the Trolls in your audience will just laugh at you.

name: Troll Guardian Armor
description: Join the elite Troll Guardian Fortess!

name: Troll Marksman
description: Besides being strategists beyond compare, you'll find that many Trolls are also excellent marksmen!

name: Troll Spellsmith Armor (1)
description: Pay homage to the trolls who have shown you how to master magic and logic.

name: Troll Spellsmith Armor (2)
description: The Troll SpellSmiths have mastered the magical arts to empower them in combat. Their magic is not just a weapon, its a tool for any situation.

name: Troll Warrior
description: This armor is bestowed only to the most legendary of seasoned Troll Warriors. Songs and epic tales will be told of your adventures!

name: Trollic Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: May ye be free, strong, and wise as ye sail the seven seas huntin' th' Chaos Pirates that still plague yer land. Yer strong arm and loyal heart will keep Bloodtusk Ravine safe!

name: Trollic Naval Commander (AC)
description: May ye be free, strong, and wise as ye sail the seven seas huntin' th' Chaos Pirates that still plague yer land. Yer strong arm and loyal heart will keep Bloodtusk Ravine safe!

name: Trollish High Mage
description: As a troll, magic comes naturally. It's second nature to you, helping to define your clairvoyant charm. You have mastered the magical arts and have earned the right to adorn yourself in High Mage battle robes.

name: Trollok Fan Shirt
description: Trolluk like fans. Fans who like Trolluk like the Trolluk Fan armor!

name: Trophy Hunter (1)
description: Roam the land hunting and exploring. Discover hidden realms and bring back the evidence of your journeys. Take ALL the trophies!

name: Trophy Hunter (2)
description: As you rack up the kills, your armor evolves into an intimidating, yet strangely compelling display of your trophies.

name: Trophy Hunter Advanced
description: As you rack up the kills, your armor evolves into an intimidating, yet strangely compelling display of your trophies.

name: Trophy Hunter Evolved
description: As you rack up the kills, your armor evolves into an intimidating, yet strangely compelling display of your trophies.

name: Troubador of Love (Armor)
description: Ye shall sing the song of Pink, whether people ask you or not… (Suggested by Demi)

name: Trouble Armor
description: The name fits the personal of the middle sibling. Underneath the winged witch into red fashion trends, Trouble has an open-minded side, which powers her intelligence when working with her sisters. You may appear just as stylish when you wear the talisman-covered attire in her likeness.

name: True Doomknight
description: DOOM yearns for supremacy, the domination of its enemies, and the impenetrable void that existed before the beginning of time. Their True Doomknight harnesses limitless power, bringing Lore into a new Age of Shadows.

name: True Neutral Hero
description: True neutral heroes are able to see both sides of an argument, and base their tactics and decisions on pure, unadulterated logic. They are cool and calculating and deadly.

name: Tsukumo-Gami Morph
description: You have been morphed into a Tsukumo-Gami! Who knows what will happen if you unequip and then reequip this…!

name: Tuba Lord Bard (AC)
description: The top brass, harbinger of horns, and the band's bane of banalities. Bards quiver in fear and awe at jazz's final boss.

name: Tuba Lord Bard (Legend)
description: The top brass, harbinger of horns, and the band's bane of banalities. Bards quiver in fear and awe at jazz's final boss.

name: Tumpeng Armor
description: A traditional savory dish widely served during ceremonies and celebrations, characterized by its yellow rice and a wide variety of foods included in it. Now you can wear it like the Palatable Paladin that you are!

name: Tundra Hunter
description: The biting cold will not affect a seasoned hunter like yourself. This armor is covered with the kills of your past, keeping you warm and limber. Take the battle by the horns (fur, skin, claws…) and show your enemy just who is boss.

name: Tundra Stalker (Armor)
description: Tis the perfect season for backstabbing, your victims can't be found until the ice thaws.

name: Tundra Wolf Reveiller (0 AC)
description: The White Wolves, said to have been knights from a Kingdom lost to an ice age. Its warriors remain loyal and gallant to their cold, blank home. One day, their endless hunts will reawaken their King.

name: Tundra Wolf Reveiller (AC)
description: The White Wolves, said to have been knights from a Kingdom lost to an ice age. Its warriors remain loyal and gallant to their cold, blank home. One day, their endless hunts will reawaken their King.

name: TundraWyrm Hunter
description: You've proven to Zoshi how awesome you are. Here is your reward. No monster in Lore stand stands a chance against you now with this armor.

name: Turbulence
description: Take to the wild blue yonder (and accumulate those sky miles) in this jet set dreamed up by Ninjudo!

name: Turdracolich Hunter
description: Harvest has changed. Now the turdraken's don't even have the decency to have anything on their bones. Someone has to keep them line.

name: Turdracolich Stalker
description: Harvest has changed. Now the turdraken's don't even have the decency to have anything on their bones. Someone has to keep them line.

name: Turdraken Hunter
description: Armor made from the bones and feathers of a slain turdraken to mask your scent.

name: Turdraken Scale Armor
description: A sleek and impressive armor forged from the scales and beak of the rare and highly fabled Turdraken. Culinary warriors will bow to you.

name: Turdraken Slayer
description: Go after that Turdraken and make sure there are plenty of leftovers for sandwiches!

name: Turkey Avenger
description: Turkey feathers can't become red with righteous rage for their kin, but the passionate auburn gets the message across just fine.

name: Turkey Suit
description: You didn't really think this armor would have skills did you? What the… not only is it missing skills, it's missing the tail feathers too.

name: TurkeyAssassin
description: TurkeyAssassins stalk their prey by moonlight, relying on their incredible stealth, quick maneuvers, and uncontrollable urge to devour ten pounds of poultry in order to catch elusive turkey.

name: TurkeySlayer
description: Master the culinary arts of Turkey Slaying and make this Thanksgiving a little less foul with a lot more fowl!

name: Turtle Marauder
description: As a turtle, You may be a bit slowpoke on land, but you can swim faster than all your friends put together.

name: Twig Animatronic Armor
description: Don't hold it against them.

name: Twig's BFF Hoodie
description: It's stainproof, so you can roll in all the icecream and fish slime you want.

name: Twig's PJs
description: Mogloween is the best time to break out all of the onesies that have been in your closet. Dress up like Twig!

name: Twilly Animatronic Armor
description: Don't hold it against them.

name: Twilly's BFF Hoodie
description: The hoodie is almost as soft as the real Twilly.

name: Twilly's PJs
description: Mogloween is the best time to break out all of the onesies that have been in your closet. Dress up like Twilly!

name: Twilly Shirt
description: 103% Cotton-poly blend Artix Ent shirts will NOT protect you from warlords, punts or Ebilness. They WILL protect you from lack of style and bad fashion choices.

name: Twisted Eldritch Infernal
description: The deepest depths hide some of the strangest and most dangerous beasts. And some the cutest.

name: Twisted EldritchSlayer
description: The deepest depths hide some of the strangest and most dangerous beasts.

name: Twisted Hunter (Armor)
description: The greedier of Darkovia's sellswords made gold off of trapping and terrorizing isolated villages. Eventually, it became impossible to tell the difference betwen them, and the monsters they once hunted.

name: Twisted Jester
description: You mock my pain! Life is pain, anyone who says otherwise is obviously selling something!

name: Twisted Treeant (Armor)
description: This is carved from a felled Doomwood Treeant. The labor itself must've taken a lifetime of experience and bravery. Even after it's death, the treeant's soul still remains.

name: Tyndarius's Wrath
description: Conqueror of Embersea. Leader of the Firestorm Onslaught. Your worst nightmare. Don't fight the fire, the world is already burned.

name: Typhoon Robe
description: Royal blue in hue, these robes are the raiment of water elementalists. They are complete with white wavy trim and infused with the power of the tides.

name: Uglier Christmas Sweater
description: What better way to stay warm this holiday season than with an UGLY Christmas sweater! Now even uglier!

name: Ugliest Christmas Sweater
description: What better way to stay warm this holiday season than with an UGLY Christmas sweater!

name: Ugly Christmas Sweater
description: What better way to stay warm this holiday season than with an UGLY Christmas sweater!

name: Ultimate AdventureCoin Armor
description: This item, featuring the AdventureCoin symbol, will show the world that you have supported AdventureQuest Worlds. With your help, we are able to make AQWorlds free for all heroes to play!

name: Ultimate Chaos Destroyer
description: Wanna destroy Chaos? You're gonna need some heavy duty armor. Wanna destroy Chaos in style? You're gonna need some color custom armor. Good thing you've got both covered!

name: Ultimate Dark Caster (AC)
description: Celebrate Dage's birthday with this insane Dark Caster armor!

name: Ultimate Dark Caster (Merge)
description: Celebrate Dage's birthday with this insane Dark Caster armor!

name: Ultimate DragonLord
description: The threads of fate are oft woven by the talons and teeth of dragons. Those who ride with dragons will remain forever gold.

name: Ultimate DragonSlayer
description: The dragons will bow down to your wrath!

name: Ultimate Evil Armor
description: The Ultimate Armor of Evil, powered by Modo's essence! Another way for those of true Evil intent to make sure their foes get the point. Points. You know what I mean.

name: Ultimate Evil Prototype
description: Only worn by those of true Evil intent, this will make sure your foe gets the point.

name: Ultimate Good Armor
description: A brilliant platinum armor for those of Good intent. Who knew that teal was the color of Good?

name: Ultimate Good Prototype
description: This is a brilliant platinum armor for those of Good intent. Who knew that teal was the color of Good?

name: Ultimate Lich King (Permanent)
description: Being the ultimate lich king is no easy task. You need to work your way up from lich peasant, this can take a while.

name: Ultimate Lich King (Temporary)
description: *No description*

name: ULTIMATE PALADINSLAYER (0 AC)
description: I AM A MASS GRAVE. THE FINAL DESTINATION OF ALL PALADINS. A TRUE WALKING SEPULCHURE okay, wait. We need to back up a little there.

name: ULTIMATE PALADINSLAYER (AC)
description: I AM A MASS GRAVE. THE FINAL DESTINATION OF ALL PALADINS. A TRUE WALKING SEPULCHURE okay, wait. We need to back up a little there.

name: Ultra Elemental Warrior Armor (Legend)
description: You've wielded the 8 Elementals and are now able to MASTER them as an Ultra Elemental Warrior!

name: Ultra Elemental Warrior Armor (Non-Legend)
description: You've wielded the 8 Elementals and are now able to MASTER them as an Ultra Elemental Warrior!

name: Ultra FiendHunter
description: The armor of one of the most prolific dissidents of the Undead Legion, in its perfected form.

name: Ultra Fierce Outfit
description: Whether you're stalking your enemies on the battlefield or through the halls at school, you'll look so fierce you'll intimidate ANY would-be opponent.

name: Ultra Fiercer Outfit
description: Whether you're stalking your enemies on the battlefield or through the halls at school, you'll look so fierce you'll intimidate ANY would-be opponent.

name: Ultra OmniKnight Armor (AC)
description: You've fought enemies across multiple different universes, learned to harness the unstable energies from their worlds required to stop them, and earned the right to call yourself an Ultra OmniKnight!

name: Ultra OmniKnight Armor (Merge)
description: You've fought enemies across multiple different universes, learned to harness the unstable energies from their worlds required to stop them, and earned the right to call yourself an Ultra OmniKnight!

name: Ultra Revenger
description: What does a hammer, shield, arrow, iron suit, gun, and green monster have in common? None stand a chance against you.

name: Ultra Robo Morpher
description: Well, you said you wanted to be a robot! (Color Custom)

name: Umbraborn Guardian
description: Born in sunspots and in the shadow of the eclipse, these plasma based lifeforms are blessed by darkness instead of light. They are the envy of those born of the Sun, able to exist and guard the shades of Lore.

name: Umbral Fiend
description: Animated demonfire, these fiends want nothing more than to destroy all Celestial beings.

name: Umbral Guard
description: Loyal warriors from a dynasty long dead. They stood by their Pharaoh and her Shadow even when the people abandoned them. Forbidden magic awoke them from their slumber, and the snakes of the Sandsea blessed them with venom.

name: Umbral Warrior (0 AC)
description: From the shadows they came, and to the shadows they will return… Umbral Warrior move in stealth, silence, and secrecy to effect their dark plots.

name: Umbral Warrior (AC)
description: From the shadows they came, and to the shadows they will return… Umbral Warrior move in stealth, silence, and secrecy to effect their dark plots.

name: Unarmored Serpent Soldier
description: A master of stealth that lurks in silence and darkness, waiting to strike. They won't give their lives for honor, but they'll give it to…the right cause.

name: Unbound Necromancer
description: Unleash your dark power but beware… make sure you are its master, or one day, your creations get out of hand… and choose to take control of YOU.

name: Unchained Ascended Voidcaster (0 AC)
description: Those who sign Nulgath's contract gain access to the infinite wellspring of arcane energy contained within the void. Those who ascend find themselves consumed by the power.

name: Unchained Ascended Voidcaster (AC)
description: Those who sign Nulgath's contract gain access to the infinite wellspring of arcane energy contained within the void. Those who ascend find themselves consumed by the power.

name: Unchained Rocker Armor
description: Unchained Rockers are a force to be reckoned with in a mosh pit. Like the band, they're die hard fans of, they utilize their deathly riffs, mighty voices, and necromantic abilities to crush their foes into submissions.

name: Uncowed Hero
description: A hero as strong and as brave as you can rock even the most MOO-ving of prints, and still walk the streets of Battleon head held high, uncowed.

name: Undead Adept (0 AC)
description: Death is only the end for the weak. The Adept follows no master, and rose through its own might. Ambition, vengeance, or even pure spite impels them to prey on the living.

name: Undead Adept (AC)
description: Death is only the end for the weak. The Adept follows no master, and rose through its own might. Ambition, vengeance, or even pure spite impels them to prey on the living.

name: Undead Admiral
description: The original bearer of the Midnight Crown, who claimed a misty island for the denizens of the night. This Pirate Captain had no equal, be they Vampire or Lycan, and set sail for parts unknown when their nights became too quiet. (Item is color-customizable)

name: Undead Assassin
description: Word of your murderous deeds have reached the ears of the Dark Lord. The Undead Legion would like to hire you to do its bidding, because if you are already undead, then you have nothing else to lose…

name: Undead Assault Infantry
description: Any undead that cross your path will be… wait for it… BONED! Released in honor of Artix Entertainment's new mobile game "Undead Assault"

name: Undead Baron Sundae Armor
description: The deliciously menacing Baron Sundae with his magically sweet wares. Careful of the ice cream it might melt.

name: Undead Berserker (Armor)
description: Even in undeath they are berserk! (eyes color custom)

name: Undead Berserker Guard
description: An undead force to be reckoned with!

name: Undead BladeMaster
description: The armor of the wickedly dangerous BladeMaster.

name: Undead Bride and Groom
description: Takes "Til Death Do Us Part" to an entirely new level.

name: Undead Champion (Armor)
description: Unaffected by emotions and impervious to remorse, Champions pledge their full allegiance to the Undead Legion. Showing mercy is a sign of weakness, and weakness is not tolerated.

name: Undead Curse
description: You've been turned into a skeletal undead! Happy Mogloween!

name: Undead Death Guard
description: Those who wish to pay their respects at the Altar may not always like what they find… when it means they DIE! But the altar ALWAYS needs more guards.

name: Undead Dragon
description: For those who always wanted to look like Fluffy, this is the morph for you.

name: Undead Dreadspider
description: A monstrosity born from Arachnomancy and Necromancy, serving as a nest for a horde of undead spiders. It is a mindless beast of pure violence that cannibalizes its own arachnid brethren.

name: Undead Evil Dread
description: Look at their eyes? What happened to their eyes??

name: Undead Fighter Armor
description: Surprisingly strong for something that is just cartilage and calcium. Be careful, though; sticks and stones may break these bones!

name: Undead Fighter (Temporary)
description: Suprisingly strong for somethings that is just cartilage and calcium. Be careful, though: sticks and stones may break these bones!

name: Undead Goat Armor
description: It's so baaaaaaaa'd it's goat.

name: Undead Guardian Prime
description: The armor of guardians who have fallen afoul of the dark energy now inhabiting Valen.

name: Undead Infantry Armor
description: You've been turned into an undead soldier!

name: Undead Infantry (Armor)
description: As a member of Dage the Evil's undead army, your only goal is to serve your master.

name: Undead Leader (0 AC)
description: The dead don't sleep. They await the day a worthy and creatively cruel leader beckons them to wake.

name: Undead Leader (AC)
description: The dead don't sleep. They await the day a worthy and creatively cruel leader beckons them to wake.

name: Undead Legend (Armor)
description: All hope for redemption is gone once you are famous enough to be considered a Legend of the Legion. Donning this armor shows that you embrace that loss.

name: Undead Legion Champion
description: Even in death, the Legion puts their warriors to use.

name: Undead Legion Healer
description: Undead Legion Healers are servants of Dage the Evil, who use their powers to twist and corrupt the healthy.

name: Undead Legion Mage
description: Eldritch magic courses through your cold veins. Your arcane powers enable you to cast powerful spells in service to Dage the Evil's Undead Legion.

name: Undead Legion Naval Commander
description: Blue be the color o' the Undead Legion… 'Nd Blue Legion Naval Commanders be the truest 'n toughest warriors in all the seven seas!

name: Undead Legion OverLord
description: You cannot kill that which is already dead. OverLords willingly serve the Undead Legion for eternity.

name: Undead Legion Rogue
description: With a combination of speed, cunning and poisons, Undead Legion Rogues take their enemies by surprise.

name: Undead Legion Warrior
description: The heart of an Undead Legion warrior is filled with courage and loyalty to the Undead Legion.

name: Undead Lord Chuckles
description: Chuckles is trying out different robes and bodies. This one gives some extra lordly height, and the confidence to reach his own goals. His fellow undead are going to fall over each other trying to bow.

name: Undead Mage Armor
description: Feel stylish in your new undead mage armor. Color custom!

name: Undead Mage (Temporary)
description: Feel stylish in your new undead mage transformation.

name: Undead Minion Rebel
description: Stick and stones will not break your bones while wearing this armor!

name: Undead Moglin (Armor)
description: A scale replica of the internal skeleton structure of Moglins. Happy Mogloween!

name: Undead Moglinmancer
description: Mehehe! All of the creatures of Lore will bow before you… but especially the humans and Moglins!

name: Undead Ninja Armor
description: Try not to groan "BRAAAINS" while sneaking around in the shadows—it's not good for your image. Or your kill count.

name: Undead Octopirate
description: Arr, matey. I been sleepin' down in Davey Jones' Locker. Got mollusks in me blowhole. Ye scurvy dog.

name: Undead Overlord Chuckles
description: Chuckles is trying out different robes and bodies. This one gives some extra lordly height, and the confidence to reach his own goals. His fellow undead are going to fall over each other trying to bow.

name: Undead Paladin (Armor)
description: Paladins are the honest and good protectors of… GOOD and GOODNESS! So… does that mean that Undead Paladins are the protectors of Good and Goodness too? They ARE still Paladins, right?

name: Undead Paladin (Rare)
description: Paladins are the honest and good protectors of… GOOD and GOODNESS! So… does that mean that Undead Paladins are the protectors of Good and Goodness too? They ARE still Paladins, right?

name: Undead Paladinslayer (AC)
description: Grim, grimy, and graven… this Undead Paladinslayer is out to slay ALL who have wronged them.

name: Undead Paladinslayer (Legend)
description: Grim, grimy, and graven… this Undead Paladinslayer is out to slay ALL who have wronged them.

name: Undead Parabellum
description: Death is the universal equalizer and war is the constant that pushes us all further than anything else. The Parabellum embody this adage, prepared to wage war for the Legion, taking it into the dark future.

name: Undead Pirate Curse
description: An undead pirate's life for me!

name: Undead Ringmaster
description: Even in death, you will still follow your passion. You can NEVER escape the center ring under the Big Top.

name: Undead Seraph Warrior
description: After Laken's vow to end the Undead Legion, many Seraphic Paladins saw the threat he posed and defected to Dage's side. You can still see the remnants of their Seraphic robes underneath the armor.

name: Undead Seraphic General
description: After Laken's vow to end the Undead Legion, many of his most trusted Generals saw the threat he posed and defected to Dage's side. To honor them for the choice

name: Undead Spawn Minion
description: Touched by the eternal flames, this undead warrior feels it burning inside. Will you control the flames, or will the flames control you?

name: Undead Survivor
description: You survived the Evil Undead invasion! You should think about joining King Alteon's guards. You've got (survival) skills!

name: Undead (temp)
description: *No description.*

name: Undead Terror Armor
description: You're turned not only into the undead but an undead TERROR!

name: Undead Trophyhunter (AC)
description: The Evil Undead are coming… and for any undead trophyhunters out there, this is the BEST TIME EVER! Collect ALL the bony trophies!

name: Undead Trophyhunter (Legend)
description: The Evil Undead are coming… and for any undead trophyhunters out there, this is the BEST TIME EVER! Collect ALL the bony trophies!

name: Undead UndeadSlayer (Armor)
description: Arooooooewwwwww… Arrrooo?! (The undead cannot talk, but this undead undeadslayer would be singing… "Isn't it ironic… don't you think?)

name: Undead Voltaire Armor
description: YARRRR! Let th' music of th' sea soothe you as you /dance to your vict'ry after defeatin' this beastie.

name: Undead Warrior (Armor)
description: Horrific warrior of the Frozen Legion, this barbaric armor was created by your fellow player, Dage the Evil!

name: Undead Warrior Bruiser
description: An undead force to be reckoned with!

name: Undead Warrior Executioner
description: After declaring verdict on your enemies is complete, then it's time for you to get to work…OFF WITH THEIR HEAD!!!!

name: Undead Warrior Judge
description: Only you have the power to sentence members of Nulgath's nation to a lifetime of PAIN!!!

name: Undead Wizard
description: An Undead Wizard is to a Necromancer as a painting of a Mage is to an artist. But don't flatter yourself—you're not nearly as pretty as a painting.

name: Undead Wretched Stalker
description: Not all stalker's of the dullahan survived but their spirits continue to hunt.

name: Undeadites
description: Join the ranks of the Evil undead as a deadite and you'll never go hungry again! (Because there are so many heroes to feast on!)

name: UndeadSlayer Armor
description: Wield the Light to save those trapped by the Darkness! Face down your foes, knowing that you have the power of Light, Might, and Right on your side!

name: Underglade Scavenger (AC)
description: A highly-evolved form of the Living Rock creatures, the Underglade Scavenger feeds on the fungus in the caves… and any unwary heroes who lose their way.

name: Underglade Scavenger (Legend)
description: A highly-evolved form of the Living Rock creatures, the Underglade Scavenger feeds on the fungus in the caves… and any unwary heroes who lose their way.

name: UnderHammer Armor
description: The UnderHammers were once and elite dwarven fighting force, sworn to defent Dwarfhold from any invading forces. Eventually, their numbers dwindled until they were home but with the threat of Chaos Lord Vath looming, they were reborn.

name: Underworld Adept Assassin (0 AC)
description: Death is only the end for the weak. The Adept does not need their master's power to rise. Ambition, vengeance, or even pure spite impels them to prey on the living.

name: Underworld Adept Assassin (AC)
description: Death is only the end for the weak. The Adept does not need their master's power to rise. Ambition, vengeance, or even pure spite impels them to prey on the living.

name: Underworld Adept Assassin (Legend)
description: Death is only the end for the weak. The Adept does not need their master's power to rise. Ambition, vengeance, or even pure spite impels them to prey on the living.

name: Underworld Archer
description: Underworld Archers are incredibly adept marksmen at night or in dim lighting conditions. That makes sense, though. Some of them are so decayed that they don't even have eyes.

name: Underworld ArchFiend (0 AC)
description: The visage of Dage the Evil as he bided his time in the shadow of his teacher.

name: Underworld ArchFiend (AC)
description: The visage of Dage the Evil as he bided his time in the shadow of his teacher.

name: Underworld Arena Provocator
description: For special occasions, Legionnaires adorn themselves with the armor worn by the most ancient of their brethren. They duel until one is torn to pieces, and the other wins the honor of receiving armor forged by Dage himself.

name: Underworld Asgardian
description: Before the Underworld Asgardian met their untimely end, they spread fear and terror as they invaded land after land with their horde of warriors.

name: Underworld Barbarian Chief
description: Barbarians that terrorized the coast in life continue their voyage in death. They clash against the beasts of the Underworld, and their own brothers in arms. Endless battle is their paradise.

name: Underworld Barbarian Lord
description: Barbarians that terrorized the coast in life continue their voyage in death. They clash against the beasts of the Underworld, and their own brothers in arms. Endless battle is their paradise.

name: Underworld Berserker
description: Manically fiends of the Legion, these creatures take no prisoners in battle. (Item goes rare June 30th, 2020)

name: Underworld Bonelord (0 AC)
description: An amalgam of Legionnaires who, despite falling in battle, can still be used by their superiors. When they aren't being used as mana batteries, the trapped souls serve an aesthetic purpose.

name: Underworld Bonelord (AC)
description: An amalgam of Legionnaires who, despite falling in battle, can still be used by their superiors. When they aren't being used as mana batteries, the trapped souls serve an aesthetic purpose.

name: Underworld Chasm Guardian (0 AC)
description: The depths of the Underworld go farther than anyone can imagine. These Legionnaires are tasked with watching the edge of the abyss. If anything tries to coax them into the deep, the Guardians will silence it.

name: Underworld Chasm Guardian (AC)
description: The depths of the Underworld go farther than anyone can imagine. These Legionnaires are tasked with watching the edge of the abyss. If anything tries to coax them into the deep, the Guardians will silence it.

name: Underworld Chronomancer (Armor)
description: Time holds no meaning deep in the Underworld… unless you are a Chronomancer!

name: Underworld Cleric
description: Denizens of the Underworld must always be ready for an attack by those who would take their power.

name: Underworld Court Noble (0 AC)
description: There aren't any Nobles in the Underworld. Not in the traditional sense, but everyone in Dage the Evil's close circle gets so many perks, they might as well be called Nobles.

name: Underworld Court Noble (AC)
description: There aren't any Nobles in the Underworld. Not in the traditional sense, but everyone in Dage the Evil's close circle gets so many perks, they might as well be called Nobles.

name: Underworld CryoCaster
description: These casters are tasked with the duty of capturing and binding traitors with frigid chains. Their power increases the louder the river shrieks. (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Underworld Cryomancer (0 AC)
description: Cold as ice, silent as death, the Underworld Cryomancers can freeze your heart and shatter your bones with the touch of a single frosty finger.

name: Underworld Cryomancer (AC)
description: Cold as ice, silent as death, the Underworld Cryomancers can freeze your heart and shatter your bones with the touch of a single frosty finger.

name: Underworld Dark Breach Ops
description: The Legion will march beyond the horizon of time. With knowledge smuggled to them from the future, their Lord arms them for warfare that will be immortalized in history to come.

name: Underworld Dark Ops
description: The Legion will march beyond the horizon of time. With knowledge smuggled to them from the future, their Lord arms them for warfare that will be immortalized in history to come.

name: Underworld Dark Wolf Rider (0 AC)
description: Wolves and hounds guard the threshold between life and death. The Lone Wolf, despite their title, is the leader of the pack. A Beastmaster in their own right, their enemies die in a flurry of teeth the moment they hear a calm whistle.

name: Underworld Dark Wolf Rider (AC)
description: Wolves and hounds guard the threshold between life and death. The Lone Wolf, despite their title, is the leader of the pack. A Beastmaster in their own right, their enemies die in a flurry of teeth the moment they hear a calm whistle.

name: Underworld Dark Wolf Warrior (0 AC)
description: Wolves and hounds guard the threshold between life and death. The Lone Wolf, despite their title, is the leader of the pack. A Beastmaster in their own right, their enemies die in a flurry of teeth the moment they hear a calm whistle.

name: Underworld Dark Wolf Warrior (AC)
description: Wolves and hounds guard the threshold between life and death. The Lone Wolf, despite their title, is the leader of the pack. A Beastmaster in their own right, their enemies die in a flurry of teeth the moment they hear a calm whistle.

name: Underworld DeathFiend (0 AC)
description: Underworld DeathFiends are sworn body and soul to Dage the Evil’s Undead Legion. They stalk the edges of the Underworld looking for unwary victims. (Click shoulder to activate animation. This item is color customizable.)

name: Underworld DeathFiend (AC)
description: Underworld DeathFiends are sworn body and soul to Dage the Evil’s Undead Legion. They stalk the edges of the Underworld looking for unwary victims. (Click shoulder to activate animation. This item is color customizable.)

name: Underworld Devotee (0 AC)
description: Some heroes continue to beseech the Elemental Lords even after death. Some day, they may get what they seek.

name: Underworld Devotee (AC)
description: Some heroes continue to beseech the Elemental Lords even after death. Some day, they may get what they seek.

name: Underworld Diviner
description: Masters of the occult, prophecy, and fate. They gave their souls to the Legion to obtain knowledge only privy to the exalted dead. Kings and Queens desire and fear their visions and power.

name: Underworld Dracolich Lord
description: The Underworld Dracollah Lords are Dragonlords who have either refused to break their bond with ther dragon beyond death, or those who sought eternal power in the depths alongside their Dragon.

name: Underworld DragonPlane Guardian
description: Dragons who breathe death and hoard the dead. Are they real or a fantasy? Their Guardians don't think these Dragons are stray Dracoliches. They search the Underworld, believing that Death takes the form of a Dragon. (CC to Accessory)

name: Underworld ElectroMage
description: Cyber Magic flows through the veins of ElectroMages. Mastering their power is vital; the energy even an untrained mage can produce could level an entire city.

name: Underworld Eminence Titan (0 AC)
description: A Behemoth of death and destruction, said to cause Lore to quake each time they awaken. The Legion keeps it chained in the Phlegethon dungeons until they're called upon to bring an end to an era.

name: Underworld Eminence Titan (AC)
description: A Behemoth of death and destruction, said to cause Lore to quake each time they awaken. The Legion keeps them chained in the Phlegethon dungeons until they're called upon to bring an end to an era.

name: Underworld Evoker
description: Just because you've entered the Underworld doesn't mean you have to sacrifice your epic fashion sense.

name: Underworld Executioner (0 AC)
description: Underworld Executioners send a message by executing heroes, and sentence unworthy Legionnaires to the greatest humiliation the Undead can face. To Recognize their value, Dage the Evil forged their armor himself.

name: Underworld Executioner (AC)
description: Underworld Executioners send a message by executing heroes, and sentence unworthy Legionnaires to the greatest humiliation the Undead can face. To recognize their value, Dage the Evil forged their armor himself.

name: Underworld Fifth Master
description: ﻿﻿A powerful fouth wielder that has embraced ambition and greed, leader of the Sunless Sabers. Though they're peerless in skill and cruelty, the Fifth Empire commands them at their own peril. The Sunless sabers ultimately only serve themselves.

name: Underworld FlameMaster (AC)
description: Legend says that a sect of Flame Masters were caught in the underworld during a period of upheaval. With the lack of fire, they pulled the power of the Underworld itself into their bodies. And thus, the Underworld FlameMasters were born.

name: Underworld FlameMaster (Special)
description: Legend says that a sect of Flame Masters were caught in the underworld during a period of upheaval. With the lack of fire, they pulled the power of the Underworld itself into their bodies. And thus, the Underworld FlameMasters were born.

name: Underworld Gatekeeper
description: The depths of the Underworld are Endless, and some corners are even forbidden to its Lord. Gatekeepers were forged by Dage himself to act as keys that unlocks all paths, and unbreakable seals.

name: Underworld General (0 AC)
description: To gain access to the Underworld you must defeat one of the many Generals which roam the forsaken land looking for souls to harvest.

name: Underworld General (AC)
description: To gain access to the Underworld you must defeat one of the many Generals which roam the forsaken land looking for souls to harvest.

name: Underworld Gladiator
description: This gladiator's will was SO strong, they did not even realize when they fell in battle and crossed over into death. Now, they stalk the Underworld looking for new opponents to prove their skill in combat.

name: Underworld Grim Necromancer (AC)
description: Per tradition, when a Necromancer achieves the deepest depths of control over the dead, they can be called "Grim." There's a tendency to eliminate one's peers to make these ranks even more exclusive.

name: Underworld Grim Necromancer (Special)
description: Per tradition, when a Necromancer achieves the deepest depths of control over the dead, they can be called "Grim." There's a tendency to eliminate one's peers to make these ranks even more exclusive.

name: Underworld Heretic (0 AC)
description: They may follow Nulgath, but they don't believe in everything he does.

name: Underworld Heretic (AC)
description: They may follow Nulgath, but they don't believe in everything he does.

name: Underworld Horror
description: Originally outcasts, Dage found these terrors, creating a new species of horror to serve him and his Legion.

name: Underworld Infiltrator
description: Rogues that have mastered the ability to traverse freely between the land of the dead and the land of the living. If a psychopomp goes missing, they're the reason.

name: Underworld Knight (0 AC)
description: Underworld Knights are among the most feared warriors in all seven circles of heck. Cross them at your peril.

name: Underworld Knight (AC)
description: Underworld Knights are among the most feared warriors in all seven circles of heck. Cross them at your peril.

name: Underworld Leviathan Slayer (0 AC)
description: The Leviathan lurks deep beneath the dark waters of the Styx in the Underworld. Rarely has it been seen, and NEVER slain. Until now.

name: Underworld Leviathan Slayer (AC)
description: The Leviathan lurks deep beneath the dark waters of the Styx in the Underworld. Rarely has it been seen, and NEVER slain. Until now.

name: Underworld Leviathan Slayer (Legend)
description: The Leviathan lurks deep beneath the dark waters of the Styx in the Underworld. Rarely has it been seen, and NEVER slain. Until now.

name: Underworld Lich
description: Life withers in the skeletal palms of those who have forsaken their mortal origins. They follow the example of Dage the Evil, carving their names into the cold stone of the Underworld.

name: Underworld Lone Wolf
description: Wolves and hounds guard the threshold between life and death. The Lone Wolf, despite their title, is the leader of the pack. A Beastmaster in their own right, their enemies die in a flurry of teeth the moment they hear a calm whistle.

name: Underworld Lone Wolf Rider (Legend)
description: Wolves and hounds guard the threshold between life and death. The Lone Wolf, despite their title, is the leader of the pack. A Beastmaster in their own right, their enemies die in a flurry of teeth the moment they hear a calm whistle.

name: Underworld Lone Wolf Rider (Non-Legend)
description: Wolves and hounds guard the threshold between life and death. The Lone Wolf, despite their title, is the leader of the pack. A Beastmaster in their own right, their enemies die in a flurry of teeth the moment they hear a calm whistle.

name: Underworld Lorekeeper
description: The Legion's Lorekeepers have shadowed their Lord since the march's earliest days. Dedicated to chronicling its past and present, they reach into the future as Soothsayers to reveal dark fates.

name: Underworld Magia
description: ﻿The Master of the Underworld binds the strongest of magic casters with contracts and promises. Those who show the potential to change the natural order of the world fall to the weakness of their desires, lending their power to the realm of the dead.

name: Underworld Malevolence (0 AC)
description: Equipping this ancient, magically-crafted artifact will ensure that you will be fueled in battle by a malevolent fury strong enough to last beyond death.

name: Underworld Malevolence (AC)
description: Equipping this ancient, magically-crafted artifact will ensure that you will be fueled in battle by a malevolent fury strong enough to last beyond death.

name: Underworld Mechanical Ghoul
description: Former members of the Futuristic Legion Optimization team, Underworld Mecha Ghouls were deployed by Dage the Evil to assault Nulgath's forces.

name: Underworld Nemesis
description: This is one denizen of the Underworld you do NOT want to meet without a battle companion by your side and a blessed blade in your hand.

name: Underworld Oni
description: The Underworld Oni emerges from its dark realm to hunt down and punish the wicked.

name: Underworld Painsaw Man
description: The evils of the world have been consumed by the Painsaw Beast. By signing a contract with the foul fiend, you have merged into a mortal-infernal hybrid anad unlocked the ability to wield his dreaded Painsaw Blade.

name: Underworld Parabellum
description: Death is the universal equalizor and war is the constant that pushes us all further than anything else. The Parabellum embody this addage, prepared to wage war for the Legion, taking it into the dark future.

name: Underworld Pirate Caster (0 AC)
description: So ye be wantin' to join Dage's crew? Better not plunder the Dark Lord's treasure or he be makin' you walk the plank!

name: Underworld Pirate Caster (AC)
description: So ye be wantin' to join Dage's crew? Better not plunder the Dark Lord's treasure or he be makin' you walk the plank!

name: Underworld Prisoner (0 AC)
description: Doomed to eternal imprisonment in the Underworld, no stocks or chains are strong enough to hold this fallen warrior!

name: Underworld Prisoner (AC)
description: Doomed to eternal imprisonment in the Underworld, no stocks or chains are strong enough to hold this fallen warrior!

name: Underworld Proioxis
description: New Legionnaires have to endure pain and destruction to prove their worth. Those given the title Proioxis are tasked with rushing recklessly into battle. They either become cannon fodder, or the last one standing.

name: Underworld Prophet (0 AC)
description: Some heroes are able to receive visions from the Elemental Lords even after death. Heed their warnings.

name: Underworld Prophet (AC)
description: Some heroes are able to receive visions from the Elemental Lords even after death. Heed their warnings.

name: Underworld Psy Operator
description: ﻿﻿A traitor to their own kind, and a master puppeteer. What looks like necromancy is actually psychic and telekenetic powers, turning the living and dead into puppets.

name: Underworld Raven's Fury (0 AC)
description: The Underworld Ravens wear the eyes of a legendary beast that represented retribution. A raven remembers every slight, and balances the scales with an eye for an eye.

name: Underworld Raven's Fury (AC)
description: The Underworld Ravens wear the eyes of a legendary beast that represented retribution. A raven remembers every slight, and balances the scales with an eye for an eye.

name: Underworld Ritualist
description: The Ritualists of the Underworld lurk among the living, and hide with the dead. Their chants can be heard in the umbra of the nether, sealing a cataclysmic threat…or perhaps, they're calling it to wake.

name: Underworld Robber (0 AC)
description: Doomed to imprisonment in the Underworld, this fallen warrior roams free… for now!

name: Underworld Robber (AC)
description: Doomed to imprisonment in the Underworld, this fallen warrior roams free… for now!

name: Underworld Robber (Legend)
description: Doomed to imprisonment in the Underworld, this fallen warrior roams free… for now!

name: Underworld Sacrificer (0 AC)
description: Warriors who have forsaken the Sun and their people to flood the Underworld with blood. They sacrifice the living and the dead to Lore itself, believing it to be a beast that will one day awaken and devour the stars.

name: Underworld Sacrificer (AC)
description: Warriors who have forsaken the Sun and their people to flood the Underworld with blood. They sacrifice the living and the dead to Lore itself, believing it to be a beast that will one day awaken and devour the stars.

name: Underworld Sacrificer (Legend)
description: Warriors who have forsaken the Sun and their people to flood the Underworld with blood. They sacrifice the living and the dead to Lore itself, believing it to be a beast that will one day awaken and devour the stars.

name: Underworld Samurai (0 AC)
description: The Underworld Samurai are warriors who refuse to relinquish their blades, even in death. They hunt for even greater battles in the realm of the dead.

name: Underworld Samurai (AC)
description: The Underworld Samurai are warriors who refuse to relinquish their blades, even in death. They hunt for even greater battles in the realm of the dead.

name: Underworld Scourge
description: Fighting your way through the arena proves you are truly a scourge of the Underworld. Dage will be so proud!

name: Underworld Sentinel
description: The Underworld Sentinels ensure that any mortal soul who finds their way to the land of the dead never leaves. Once they have you in their sights, there's no escape.

name: Underworld ShadowReaver (0 AC)
description: Underworld ShadowReavers serve Empress Gravelyn with complete and unbreakable loyalty. They have NEVER been known to break their vow to the darkness.

name: Underworld ShadowReaver (AC)
description: Underworld ShadowReavers serve Empress Gravelyn with complete and unbreakable loyalty. They have NEVER been known to break their vow to the darkness.

name: Underworld Shrade
description: Shrade now finds himself in Dage's realm.

name: Underworld Sorceress (0 AC)
description: Covens of Witches convene under the moon of Walpurgisnacht to summon the daemons of the Underworld. Through their fell arcane arts, the Legion is brought to the realm of the living in new, fearsome forms. (Female art only)

name: Underworld Sorceress (AC)
description: Covens of Witches convene under the moon of Walpurgisnacht to summon the daemons of the Underworld. Through their fell arcane arts, the Legion is brought to the realm of the living in new, fearsome forms. (Female art only)

name: Underworld Soul Weaver (0 AC)
description: Souls wander throughout the Underworld. Only the most skilled can channel the power that remains, using them for arcane spells and magic.

name: Underworld Soul Weaver (AC)
description: Souls wander throughout the Underworld. Only the most skilled can channel the power that remains, using them for arcane spells and magic.

name: Underworld Soulreaper (0 AC)
description: Dage the Evil has allied with the SoulReapers, a faction of necromancers whose power comes from distilling the energy of stolen souls.

name: Underworld SoulReaper (AC)
description: Dage the Evil has allied with the SoulReapers, a faction of necromancers whose power comes from distilling the energy of stolen souls.

name: Underworld SoulSeeker (Armor)
description: The SoulSeekers roam the Underworld in solitude, held under their Lord's sway yet reviled by their fellow Legionnaires. Little remains of themselves, as they have been twisted by devouring the souls of great monsters.

name: Underworld Sovereign (0 AC)
description: The Underworld has one Lord, and it's Dage the Evil…should he ever need someone to watch his throne, he forged worthy regalia for a sovereign he knows more than his own blood. The Legion kneels to them without question.

name: Underworld Sovereign (AC)
description: The Underworld has one Lord, and it's Dage the Evil…should he ever need someone to watch his throne, he forged worthy regalia for a sovereign he knows more than his own blood. The Legion kneels to them without question.

name: Underworld Spirit Host (0 AC)
description: A walking amalgamation of souls, led by a summoner, or the identity with the strongest will. The more souls gather, the stronger they become.

name: Underworld Spirit Host (AC)
description: A walking amalgamation of souls, led by a summoner, or the identity with the strongest will. The more souls gather, the stronger they become.

name: Underworld Spirit Summoner (0 AC)
description: A walking amalgamation of souls, led by a summoner, or the identity with the strongest will. The more souls gather, the stronger they become.

name: Underworld Spirit Summoner (AC)
description: A walking amalgamation of souls, led by a summoner, or the identity with the strongest will. The more souls gather, the stronger they become.

name: Underworld Stealth Breach Ops (AC)
description: The Legion will march beyond the horizon of time. With knowledge smuggled to them from the future, their Lord arms them for warfare that will be immortalized in history to come.

name: Underworld Stealth Breach Ops (Legend)
description: The Legion will march beyond the horizon of time. With knowledge smuggled to them from the future, their Lord arms them for warfare that will be immortalized in history to come.

name: Underworld Stealth Ops (0 AC)
description: The Legion will march beyond the horizon of time. With knowledge smuggled to them from the future, their Lord arms them for warfare that will be immortalized in history to come. (CC to Accessory)

name: Underworld Stealth Ops (AC)
description: The Legion will march beyond the horizon of time. With knowledge smuggled to them from the future, their Lord arms them for warfare that will be immortalized in history to come. (CC to Accessory)

name: Underworld Thronetaker
description: This was taken from a fallen contender for the throne of the Underworld. It is ancient and pulses with a malevolent power.

name: Underworld Tyrant (Armor)
description: The General of the Acheron may serve the Legion, but the Legionnaires call them a tyrant. They're only released from their chains when their Lord calls for complete annihilation, for this Usurper Lord refuses to tell friend from foe.

name: Underworld Void Vigilante
description: This armor was crafted from a fusion of Void energy from the AdventureQuest timeline and combined with magic Dage imbues into the gear he crafts for the Undead Legion. The dark horror will terrify your opponents, filling with with an otherworldly dread.

name: Underworld Warbringer (0 AC)
description: Lore splits open, revealing the gaping maw of the Underworld. The Legion's Warbringers are heralded by tolling bells. No one will escape. What begins must end with war and fury.

name: Underworld Warbringer (AC)
description: Lore splits open, revealing the gaping maw of the Underworld. The Legion's Warbringers are heralded by tolling bells. No one will escape. What begins must end with war and fury.

name: Underworld Warlock
description: Tap into the darkness that flows through the Underworld to enhance your power and become one of Lore's most powerful magic users!

name: Underworld Warlord
description: Dage the Evil's viciously loyal Warlord raze battlefields until they're barren and cold. They can spot talent and skill, stealing those souls for their Master, preventing them from ever returning to the Light.

name: Underworld Wrangler
description: The Underworld is infested with every nightmare you can think of. Wrangling them isn't a duty so much as it is a dangerously exciting hobby. You're the daring sort, so you'll fit right in with the experts.

name: Undine Defence Director
description: ﻿﻿﻿Members of Seabase Undine's Defense Division, like Dr. Song Rivale, have full access its Midnight Zone and Weapons Labs. For the future of Lore, they strive to do everything and sacrifice everything to protect the realm from Evil.

name: Undine Doctor
description: ﻿﻿﻿Seabase Undine's personnel are split into two teams, the Medical and Defense Division. Medical doctors wear blue armbands, contributing to the development of new cures and surgical methods that tackle injuries healing magic can't. (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Undine Researcher
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿Each researcher was personally invited by Queen Victoria to Seabase Undine. After being forced to helplessly watch as the Mana Crisis tore apart Lore, they banded together under Greenguard's banner to work towards a brighter and safer tomorrow.

name: Unfortunate RingMaster
description: Come one come all down to the unluckiest fair in all of Lore. This Ringmaster will be happy to take all your gold while you test your "luck".

name: UnFowled BeastMaster
description: Zeuster would approve of a hero who cares so much for the members of his flock.

name: Unhallowed Wight (0 AC)
description: Spirits of earth and moonlight created this child to destroy their rivals. These lost Princes and Princesses had their souls taken by their own creators in order to sharpen their focus. Their only purpose is to fight and die.

name: Unhallowed Wight (AC)
description: Spirits of earth and moonlight created this child to destroy their rivals. These lost Princes and Princesses had their souls taken by their own creators in order to sharpen their focus. Their only purpose is to fight and die.

name: Unholy Demon Juggernaut
description: Bound to this armor by barbar4, infernal spirits scream as you battle.

name: Unholy Shadow Burst
description: Even Israil knows to stay away from the shadows as the Unholy Shadow Burst could be waiting and plotting for its next victim. No one will ever know what happened to you when you have gone missing except for Israil…and she knows not to say a word…

name: Unicorn Commander Musician
description: The perfect outfit to wear while riding a black unicorn down an erupting volcano.

name: Universe Armor
description: When you equip this armor, you'll find it's easy to be kind to smaller men.

name: Unknown Undead
description: DO YOU FIND MY DEMISE HUMERUS?!

name: Unleashed Dragon Armor
description: Protect the skies over the lost city of Atlanta during the convention of Dragons!

name: Unluckiest Leperchaun
description: The luck of Moglish has run out for you. Happy Unlucky Day 2015, you're going to need it.

name: Unlucky Farmer
description: Don't worry about all those screams in the next field over. You just keep farming for that new reward you're after. YOU'LL BE FINE.

name: Unlucky Hoodie
description: Who says Friday the 13th and Black Cats are unlucky? Not me!

name: Unlucky Knifewielder
description: What a classy outfit! Be a shame to get it messy!

name: Unlucky Ringmaster
description: Welcome to the unluckiest show in Lore! No refunds.

name: Unparalleled Bounty Hunter
description: Fiends are destruction incarnate, and because of this nature, they lack purpose. The Archfiend's will and ambitions were what led him to rise beyond mindless carnage. This armor is reminiscent of his mortal beginnings and rise.

name: Unseelie Glassbinder
description: Made from fusing shards of mirrors together these who lurks in the depths have a power not yet known to those on the outside.

name: Unsung Ruler
description: The Unsung places their crown on their champion's head, and becomes their eyes. Through this union, the sovereign attains unbound power, and the Shadow learns how to live and breathe.

name: Unundead Goat Armor
description: Maaaa. Baaaa. (Hey it's me again. Looks like we're a goat now. Yum, this grass is delicious, and walking around all day is so much fun. Wow, I just love doing absolutely nothing!

name: Urban Assassin (AC)
description: Whoever said that assassins were restricted to long corridors and dark forests have never met these guys before.

name: Urban Assassin (Special)
description: Whoever said that assassins were restricted to long corridors and dark forests have never met these guys before.

name: Urban Dragon Warrior (0 AC)
description: (This is the 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)This is the humanoid forms the East's dragons choose to wear when they linger among mortals. Their spirits burn as hot as their breath, and their freedom is unfettered.

name: Urban Dragon Warrior (AC)
description: (Alternate 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)

name: Urban Royal Streetwear
description: Those born in the year of the Serpent are known to be orderly, intelligent, and have refined tastes. Ai No Miko wants to honour her fellow serpent friends with this new hip getup! (Click on Chest and Robe)

name: Urban Samurai
description: Keeping the traditions of old doesn't mean you can't look fly.

name: Urban Serpent Streetwear
description: Those born in the year of the Serpent are known to be orderly, intelligent, and have refined tastes. Ai No Miko wants to honour her fellow serpent friends with this new hip getup!

name: Urban Underworld Gear
description: Outside of battle and conquest the Legionnaires continue to sport the symbols of their Lord. A great way to convey their deep disatisfaction with idealized life. Necromancy has always been counter culture.

name: Urban Underworld Outfit
description: Blades for combat that are also used to prep bones and marrow to use as reagents or new mindless minions. Magic is quicker and more efficient, but deeper control can be forged with skilled hands.

name: Usagi Oni
description: Most Oni are painted with a single brutal, and bloody brush. In reality, there are several independent clans. One revels in festivities and attend tournaments to show off their strength, dressed in merry-making garb.

name: UsEGGi Warrior
description: It is only when they are in the middle of battle that the UsEGGi Warrior is truly hoppy!

name: Uw3010
description: The Uw3010 is a fabled mecha race of Undead Legion warriors. No one — not even the Dark Lord himself — knows how exactly these ruthless war machines came to this reality.

name: Uw3017 Blaster (Armor)
description: These part-undead, part-robot monstrosities are a part of a task force created by Dage the Evil to hunt down and finish off dissidents in the Legion, including those that he currently wants, but could not have.

name: Uw3017 Gunner (Armor)
description: These part-undead, part-robot monstrosities are part of a task force created by Dage the Evil to hunt down and finish off dissidents in the Legion, including those that he currently wants, but could not have.

name: UW3017 Shield (AC)
description: These part-undead, part-robot monstrosities are part of a task force created by Dage the Evil to hunt down and finish off dissidents in the Legion, including those that he currently wants, but could not have.

name: UW3017 Shield (Legend)
description: These part-undead, part-robot monstrosities are part of a task force created by Dage the Evil to hunt down and finish off dissidents in the Legion, including those that he currently wants, but could not have.

name: V for Vampire
description: Remember, remember, before it's November

name: Vaden Knight
description: Some serve their masters for all eternity, whether they're given the option or not.

name: Vaderix Carapace
description: Half bug, half weird flurry…you know what, you're creepy and nightmare inducing and that's really all the matters.

name: Vai-Vai Carnaval Armor
description: Samba samba samba your way through Carnaval!

name: Valen and Lynaria Armor
description: A comrade of the late King Alteon is often noble, caring, courageous, and selfless. Both of those have, unfortunately, met a gruesome fate, but are forever rememebered for the scars they left behind.

name: Valen Armor
description: *No description*

name: Valen's Knightly Armor
description: A swordsman and life partner of Alden and Lynaria, Valen once fought to protect Lore from Evil. The moment he was born, a sword was thrust into his hands. His friends were the ones who taught him joy and love.

name: Valentine Warrior
