description: Pink and red armor fit only for the most romantic of knights!

name: Valiant Swordhaven Pendragon
description: The epitome of nobility and chivalry, the Swordhaven Pendragons are the perfect image of a pure knight. Upholding their ideals isn't easy. It requires complete dedication, and the sacrifice of all selfish wishes.

name: Valkyric Glory Armor
description: This color custom armor will show your enemies on battlefield just who reigns supreme. Will you be the one to decide who lives and dies in battle?

name: Vampirate (Armor)
description: Yarrrrr me bloodsuckin' landlubbers, if ye be needin' a crew of pillaging vampires to set sail, ye come to the right place!

name: Vampire Armor (Armor)
description: Vampires enjoy "inner beauty"… just stay away from garlic cloves and wooden stakes! Happy Mogloween!

name: Vampire Bat Costume
description: For the most dead-icated cos-players, this costume will really help you raise the stakes at your next con-vein-tion.

name: Vampire Class Armor
description: Happy Mogloween! This is the 1st Edition released during AQW's first Mogloween 2008!

name: Vampire Emissary
description: The Vampire family now sees you in a different way… about time, too--they looked thirsty. Color custom accessory and trim.

name: Vampire Knight (Armor)
description: Only those aligned with the Vampiric family may have such a name… and such an elaborate honor armor.

name: Vampire Lord (Armor) (1)
description: The life of a vampire doesn't get much better than this. Being this bad never felt this good! (This armor suggested by fellow AQW Hero, Arachne!)

name: Vampire Lord (Armor) (2) (AC)
description: Vampire Lords rule over their sanguine servants and, feasting on the blood of mortals, they can live forever. Don't show one a mirror though, or you might not like what you don't see.

name: Vampire Lord (Armor) (2) (Merge)
description: Vampire Lords rule over their sanguine servants and, feasting on the blood of mortals, they can live forever. Don't show one a mirror though, or you might not like what you don't see.

name: Vampire Lord Incubus
description: Looks like you took one too many bites from the Vampire Lord. Kimberly had it right all along-you're a vampire!

name: Vampire Masquerade (0 AC)
description: When the Blood Moon rises the Masquerade calls.

name: Vampire Masquerade (AC)
description: When the Blood Moon rises the Masquerade calls.

name: Vampire Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Legend tells of pirates for terrifying they transform into malevolent beings who plunder more than just physical treasure. They be after ye blood!

name: Vampire Naval Commander (AC)
description: Legend tells of pirates for terrifying they transform into malevolent beings who plunder more than just physical treasure. They be after ye blood!

name: Vampire of Nulgath
description: Only the taste of Dage the Evil's blood will satisfy their thirst!

name: Vampire of Vokun
description: The Forgotten Tombs are home to many creatures including Vampires. And they do bite.

name: Vampire Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: The captain of a crew loyal to Queen Safiria, chasing after the oceans' moons in her name. They send exiles to nights far from Darkovia's and return with gold to add to their noble court's decadence.

name: Vampire Pirate Captain (AC)
description: The captain of a crew loyal to Queen Safiria, chasing after the oceans' moons in her name. They send exiles to nights far from Darkovia's and return with gold to add to their noble court's decadence.

name: Vampire Shifter (0 AC)
description: Nothing like switching it up at a vampire ball!

name: Vampire Shifter (AC)
description: Nothing like switching it up at a vampire ball!

name: Vampire Slayer
description: A good slayer doesn't just stake the sparkly ones, they go after all vampire kind. You're not just some crazy person, you're the slayer!

name: Vampire Transformation
description: Full-blooded Vampires can transform at will. You now harness this amazing powers! Simply click to transform to Vampiric forms

name: Vampiric Crimson Yukata
description: A sophisticated yet playful design popular with the Yokai Isles' Vampiric visitors. Its thick and luxurious fabric completely blocks out sunlight, allowing its wearer refuge if they lose track of time.

name: Vampiric Gentlefolk
description: Far from noble or gentle, these vampires have given themselves new titles in light of their banishment from Darkovia. They give the gift of the eternal night without restraint.

name: Vampiric Knight (Armor)
description: To a vampire that loves the sky, nothing beats spreading their small or massing wings and taking flight into the dead of the night. Sometimes the excitement makes them feel so alive. Will you be brave enough to join them?

name: Vampiric Midnight Yukata
description: A sophisticated yet playful design popular with the Yokai Isles' Vampiric visitors. Its thick and luxurious fabric completely blocks out sunlight, allowing its wearer refuge if they lose track of time.

name: Vampiric Noble
description: You rule all who enter your domain; their blood, breath, and bones all belong to YOU. And should any choose to challenge you… well, you can always use a new ghoul or two to serve you.

name: Vampiric Void Knight of Nulgath
description: More heavily armored than their un-Knighted breathen, BloodVoid Knights are used to hunt Nulgath the ArchFiend's unluckiest prey. They hide in the shadows, attacking his victims when they least expect it.

name: Vanguard
description: Said to be worn only by a "true" leader… of the darkness. We hope you've enjoyed the world premiere of the Artix and Sepulchure Action Figure video! Coming soon to Heromart.com and Toys R Us!

name: Vanguard Of Nulgath (Armor)
description: Marching proudly at the forefront of Nulgath's Nation, the warriors in his Vanguard are the first to terrify his opponents and recruit soldiers to his army.

name: Vanta BladeMaster
description: These lone blademaster's hide within the shadows, carefully avoiding enemies until their foes least expect it.

name: Vanta Shadow Knight (0 AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Vanta Shadow Knight (AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Vasalkar's Champion
description: The Legendary Red Dragon of Lore has fought against many but a few have fought for him.

name: Vath's Chaotic Dragonlord Armor
description: This Dragonlord armor is tainted by chaos! Only those who have slain Lord Vath can wear this.

name: Vaunted Warrior
description: The heart of a Warrior is filled with courage and strength. Your skill with weapons in close combat make you a powerful force on the battlefield.

name: Vaxen Loremaster
description: Clothed in regal splendor, there's only one person whose lore you need to record: Vaxen's.

name: Veil Nebula Kitsune
description: Long-lived kitsune ascend to the heavens and take on the names and magic of the cosmos. Those of the Veil Nebula are elusive, able to steal light and fire from arrogant gods. Mortals know them as the witch beasts of the night skies.

name: Vengeance
description: Drakonus crafted this armor to be seemingly made of bones. It is in fact made of very powerful and very enchanted metals, found deep underground. It provides superb protection, both physical and magical.

name: Vengeance of Nulgath
description: Warriors who betray Nulgath the ArchFiend have their minds blasted clean. They are rebuilt from the ground up to serve only him, forever, body and mind. The loss of their personality and "self" is Nulgath's ultimate punishment.

name: Vengeance Warrior (0 AC)
description: From the purest desires grow the darkest of grudges. For vegeance, this Warrior will stop at nothing and sacrifice everything.

name: Vengeance Warrior (AC)
description: From the purest desires grow the darkest of grudges. This Warrior will stop and nothing and sacrifice everything for vengeance.

name: Vengeful DragonMage
description: Your future holds fury and flame.

name: Vengeful Shiryo Wukou (0 AC)
description: ﻿﻿Pirates that are drenched in the vengeful flames of cursed spirits. They're the drowned and the cut-down victims of a ruthless crew that uses the power of their hatred as fuel for horrific magic. (CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Vengeful Shiryo Wukou (AC)
description: ﻿﻿Pirates that are drenched in the vengeful flames of cursed spirits. They're the drowned and the cut-down victims of a ruthless crew that uses the power of their hatred as fuel for horrific magic. (CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Verdant Serpent Guard
description: A master of stealth that lurks in silence and darkness, waiting to strike. They won't give their lives for honor, but they'll give it to…the right cause.

name: Verdant Serpent Soldier
description: A master of stealth that lurks in silence and darkness, waiting to strike. They won't give their lives for honor, but they'll give it to…the right cause.

name: Verdant Virgo Changeling
description: Virgo Changelings are childen reared by fae, and sprites raised in human villages. Their sensitivity to nature and the nature of others bleeds into their magic. They manipulate the growth of plants, and the emotions of animals.

name: Verde Forest Warrior
description: You unlocked this badge by purchasing an upgrade through Paymentez! Battle On!

name: Vermilious Necromancer
description: Your animosity show no end when it comes to seeing rivals blood!

name: Vestes da Rainha das Ondas
description: The robes of a kind and protective deity. When her power flooded the rivers and streams, life sprung from the waters and basked in her love.

name: Vestes Encantadas da Rainha das Ondas
description: The robes of a kind and protective deity. When her power flooded the rivers and streams, life sprung from the waters and basked in her love.

name: Victoria Armor
description: The "warrior princess" before she took up her secret identity.

name: Victoria Mágica
description: Celebrate Cinco de Mayo with this epic more colorful dancewear!

name: Victory Swimwear
description: Battle beachy beasties in your all-new Color-Custom swimwear! Work on that tan while you work on Leveling Up!

name: Vile Vulture
description: This outfit is made from 100% natural materials, thus, you are a natural scavenger just like a vulture!

name: Vile Winter Slayer
description: Your detest for all things bitter cold has crept slowly into your soul, freezing it along with the season you fight.

name: Villain of Steel (AC)
description: When a hero goes dark, everything about them changes… even their outfits!

name: Villain of Steel (Legend)
description: When a hero goes dark, everything about them changes… even their outfits!

name: Viltusial
description: These knights of the Celestial guard and protect realm with their lives. The heavenly armor withstands the most brutal attacks from infernals.

name: Vincenzo's Vice
description: Once dead, there is no turning back as with the case of Vincenzo. He could not leave the afterlife because he was bound to it, but he still kept the shadowed, raggy remains that once held his battle armor together.

name: Vindicated Hollowborn Assassin
description: Once a member of the Dawn Vindicator's Elite, they became the same creatures they once hunted. With no one but their own bitterness to devote themselves to, the Assassins seek to undermine other Hollowborn.

name: Vindicated Hollowborn Priest
description: A high ranking commander of the Dawn Vindicators, as well as the bearer of Gramiel's word. Now that they have fallen from grace, the Priests mutter curses towards the shadowy fiend that turned them into monsters.

name: Vindicated Hollowborn Soldier
description: The Hollowborn have lurked in the shadow of the Dawn Vindicators since the organization's inception. Their true alliegiance lays with the Shadow Fiend's supposed Oracle, who leads them towards destiny.

name: Vindicator Assassin (Armor)
description: A member of the Dawn Vindicator's Elite. Their leader sends them on missions to slay liars in power, and eliminate Vindicators who have lost their devotion.

name: Vindicator Beast Tamer
description: The master of the Dawn Vindicator's hounds. Predators become prey. Evil will have nowhere to hide. Once their Beasts catch your scent, your fate is already sealed.

name: Vindicator Captain
description: Captains lead their own teams of Dawn Vindicators. The more evil they destroy, the higher they and their warriors rise in rank, until they earn the honor of basking in their Leader's light at his side.

name: Vindicator Draconian (Armor)
description: Believing themselves to be above all monsters, the prideful Draconians joined the Dawn Vindicators. The rest of Dragonkind will bow, break, and beg.

name: Vindicator of Naval Commanders (0 AC)
description: Through arduous battling and a perilous journey, you defeated all who sailed against you. Your crew and fleet have been vindicated and revenge is YARRRRRS!

name: Vindicator of Naval Commanders (AC)
description: Through arduous battling and a perilous journey, you defeated all who sailed against you. Your crew and fleet have been vindicated and revenge is YARRRRRS!

name: Vindicator Of They Armor (Armor)
description: Through arduous battling and a perilous journey, you defeated the Collector and vindicated They Might Be Giants

name: Vindicator Priest (Armor)
description: A high ranking commander of the Dawn Vindicators, as well as the bearer of Gramiel's word. Every Vindicator-alligned fortress is assigned to one, and they hold the Grace of their compatriots in their hands.

name: Vindicator Scout
description: Scouts of the Dawn Vindicators have only just began their service to Gramiel and justice. As they strike down evil and spread Gramiel's glory, red will stain their gold and white.

name: Vindicator Titan
description: If you don't fight, you can't win. Vindication will be yours! BATTLE ON!

name: Vindicator Titan XL
description: If you don't fight, you can't win. Vindication will be yours! BATTLE ON!

name: Violet Cruise Captain
description: I'm on a boat! I'm on boat! Wait..wait… I'M A CAPTAIN OF A BOAT!

name: Violet Dragonhame Wanderer
description: These roaming Priests of Etherstorm are attuned to the land and the Dragons, helping those in need. These priests draw strength from the Wind.

name: Violet Kirin Parade Costume
description: Your head may be covered by a gigantic kirin mask, but there's no reason the rest of you can't be looking your best!

name: Violet Mayhem Outfit
description: ﻿Between dark goth and and pastel sweetie, you're carving out your own style.

name: Violet Mayhem Streetwear
description: Between dark goth and and pastel sweetie, you're carving out your own style.

name: Violet Paladin
description: Only certain Paladins are about to see the romance in war.

name: Violet Puffed Coat
description: Between dark goth and and pastel sweetie, you're carving out your own style.

name: Violet Tech Suit
description: This suit is airtight, space-tight, and lightweight. And purple!

name: VIP
description: Only the most SUPER of Heroes are eligible to equip this armor! BattleOn! Awarded to anyone who has supported AQW with a 12 month membership since July 21st, 2011 or had an active year membership at the time.

name: VIP Bride and Groom Groupie Armor
description: Now you can look like Kaitlyn and Jesse from the Indie Folk band Bride and Groom currently playing at Yulgar's Inn! This armor will go rare on September 11th, 2015.

name: Virgil of the Legion
description: Virgil, a servant of the former Death, guides souls the dark hopeless prison they find themselves in.

name: Viridian Tech Suit
description: This suit is airtight, space-tight, and lightweight. And green!

name: Virtual Criminal
description: The best virtual criminals never assume they'll get away unscathed… they always have a backup plan and NEVER jinx themselves by being overconfident.

name: Virtual ShoGunslinger
description: The gun is mightier than a blade but they both get the job done.

name: Vivid Mountaineer
description: How do you defeat the winter's chill? By staying this hot, of course! Color customizable is the way to go!

name: Vivid Rugby Armor
description: You'll be on the ball when you /equip this AUS-some rugby armor! Crowds of your /party members will /cheer as your crit-ically score against your enemies!

name: Vivid Snowsuit
description: Functional and fashionable! Color customize your favorite winter attire.

name: Vladic Knight
description: A recreation of an armor worn by Piotr Darkspyre's champion, the Vladic Knight, from the Lore of MechQuest. Why would anyone want to recreate this champion's dreadful armor.

name: Vodarage Tank
description: Destroy wave after wave of undesirables without a splash of sympathy.

name: Void Angel of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Mysterious beings who watch the Fiend's Void with unknowable intent. Those who gaze at them for too long will go blind. Some day they were made to close black holes and erase dying stars.

name: Void Angel of Nulgath (AC)
description: Mysterious beings who watch the Fiend's Void with unknowable intent. Those who gaze at them for too long will go blind. Some day they were made to close black holes and erase dying stars.

name: Void ArchMage of Nulgath
description: Serve your ruler with unyielding power. Cast down those who dare go against Nulgath

name: Void Awakening (AC)
description: The final stage of the Void. Stronger, more powerful, these fiends of the nation have final awoken their true form.

name: Void Awakening (Special)
description: The final stage of the Void. Stronger, more powerful, these fiends of the nation have final awoken their true form.

name: Void BattleMage
description: In the depths of battle against their foes, these elite BattleMage's use dark magic to defeat their many enemies.

name: Void Beastmaster Of Nulgath
description: The Beastmaster controls of all Nulgath's creatures. All of his ferocious creatures.

name: Void Beetle General
description: The inpenetrable exoskeleton hides the unspeakable horrors of the void within.

name: Void Beetle Warlord
description: Duels, scuffles, and occasional battles are no longer enough. The need for the carnage of war festers under their exoskeletons.

name: Void Betrayal Knight
description: Former Fiends of the Nation now roam the outskirts of Lore and the Underworld with chaotic abandon. The trials meant to break their minds backfired, and they spite the Archfiend by weaponizing stolen power. (CC to Accessory)

name: Void Brawler of Nulgath
description: A Fiend of brutish strength that seeks impossible challenges and deadly enemies. The runes enscribed into their armor keeps their power restrained. Once released, limbs and muscles will grow out of control, starving for violence.

name: Void Broodfiend (0 AC)
description: Swarms of Broodfiends fall on the land like an apocalyptic plague. These Nation soldiers were mere insects before the Fiend's Void twisted them into harbingers of starvation and disease.

name: Void Broodfiend (AC)
description: Swarms of Broodfiends fall on the land like an apocalyptic plague. These Nation soldiers were mere insects before the Fiend's Void twisted them into harbingers of starvation and disease.

name: Void Broodfiend (Legend)
description: Swarms of Broodfiends fall on the land like an apocalyptic plague. These Nation soldiers were mere insects before the Fiend's Void twisted them into harbingers of starvation and disease.

name: Void Commander of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: In the war to win eternity, the Void Commanders are one of pinnacles of Nulgath's creations. They will usher their Master to the seat of the Fiend God. (This item gives 25% more XP and Class Points when equipped. Skin is not CC)

name: Void Commander of Nulgath (AC)
description: In the war to win eternity, the Void Commanders are one of pinnacles of Nulgath's creations. They will usher their Master to the seat of the Fiend God. (This item gives 25% more XP and Class Points when equipped. Skin is not CC)

name: Void Cowboy
description: YEEHAW! Yippee-ki-yay, Minons!

name: Void Cryomancer
description: The cold comes from emptiness. Eventually, everything in the universe will go cold, and stop moving. These Cryomancers are a living glimpse of that fate, wielding frigid power that will eventually render them stiller than death.

name: Void Defender Armor
description: The Darkness Dragon has waited long enough to return to Za'nar. However he did not count on the Magi and the Hero battling to keep from regaining his power. So he has dropped his armor in defeat.

name: Void Destroyer
description: Silent and distant, but a brutal class of Nation Loyalists that hail from the Void who destroy anything but their domain.

name: Void Dragon Defender (AC)
description: Warriors of the Void Dragon do not know fear as the Void shows no mercy to those who are faint of heart.

name: Void Dragon Defender (Legend)
description: Warriors of the Void Dragon do not know fear as the Void shows no mercy to those who are faint of heart.

name: Void DragonGuard (Armor)
description: The horror that Tyrath wrought was so profound that some who weren't frightened of him were intrigued. After taking the form of draconians and donning this pointed armor, they became Tyrath's followers.

name: Void DragonSlayer
description: This armor has been tainted by the magic of the void!

name: Void Entity
description: The element of Void does not exist in the world of Lore. Void Entities have only recently been sighted on incredibly rare occasions.

name: Void GateKeeper (0 AC)
description: Only Nulgath's most trusted acolytes are allowed to become Gatekeepers of the Void into the Realm of the OverSoul. Do not betray his trust… or he WILL be displeased.

name: Void GateKeeper (AC)
description: Only Nulgath's most trusted acolytes are allowed to become Gatekeepers of the Void into the Realm of the OverSoul. Do not betray his trust… or he WILL be displeased.

name: Void General
description: The Void General - some of Nulgath's most trusted allies. Or are they…

name: Void Ghost of Nulgath
description: Prior to the events after Vulnios' discharge from the Nulgath Nation, he gathered corpses of the dead Shadow Voids back in the war against the Legion and upgraded them into sentient voids who are also masters of stealth and secrecy.

name: Void Guardian (Armor)
description: Deep in the heart of the Void live creatures that should NEVER enter our world! It's up to the Void Guardians to ensure our safety.

name: Void Highlord Armor
description: Nulgath ranks you a Void Warlord and bestows a portion of his power to you. You are a sinister brute bringing anyone to your knees. Half of your soul has been taken by Nulgath as for the price of this untamed power, use it wisely.

name: Void Jolly Roger (0 AC)
description: Nulgath says "I have troops above ground, I have troops underground, i have troops underwater… and now I have troops ON the water! I am UNSTOPPABLE! Muahahaahaha!"

name: Void Jolly Roger (AC)
description: Nulgath says "I have troops above ground, I have troops underground, i have troops underwater… and now I have troops ON the water! I am UNSTOPPABLE! Muahahaahaha!"

name: Void Kittarian
description: Fiends with razor-sharp senses and an uncanny ability to appear when you least expect it. The Kittarians that signed their souls away can traverse the Fiend's Void easier than most, though this is a trait inherit to all felines.

name: Void Knight (Armor)
description: Knights of the Void were once legendary warriors who fell in battle. Their spirits have been corrupted Void energy, but in return, they receive great power!

name: Void Knight of Nulgath
description: A spiked abyssal fiend that crawled from deep beneath the underworld….in another world. This item gives 25% more XP and Class Points when equipped.

name: Void Monk of Nulgath
description: Not all those who serve Nulgath are vile. These monks practice mediation before ripping their opponents to shreds. (This armor was suggested by fellow AQW Hero, Zobeck!)

name: Void Nation Caster
description: The arcane practices of the Nation are impossible to master in one lifetime. The Ritualists circumvent this obstacle by engraving spells into their very being. They exchange individuality for magnificent power.

name: Void Nation Cheerleader
description: /cheer for your favorite fiend! :::) (Art is female only)

name: Void Nation Ritualist
description: The arcane practices of the Nation are impossible to master in one lifetime. The Ritualists circumvent this obstacle by engraving spells into their very being. They exchange individuality for magnificent power.

name: Void Naval Commander
description: Aye, even the Archfiend has his own fleet! No landlubbers allowed, Nulgath only wants the souls of the best Buccaneers in Lore. Savvy?

name: Void of NOOOO-Gasp!
description: Beleen's love of pink can overcome even the strongest of beings - even Nulgath! She's turned his Voids.. Pink!

name: Void of Nulgath
description: Nulgath ranks you Void Knight and bestows a portion of his power to you. You are enveloped by sinister magic and become a creature of destruction! And all this for just a small portion of your soul! The part you don't need of course. (color custom: eyes, trim, accessory)

name: Void of Nulgath (Rare)
description: Nulgath ranks you Void Knight and bestows a portion of his power to you. You are enveloped by sinister magic and become a creature of destruction! And all this for just a small portion of your soul! The part you don't need of course. (color custom: eyes, trim, accessory) (Rare)

name: Void of Revontheus
description: Only those truly devoted to Nulgath are granted nefarious powers after signing the dotted line.

name: Void Oni Samurai (0 AC)
description: The samurai who have sworn themselves to the Archfiend were once pureblooded Oni. Their bloodthirst and greed increased tenfold. No matter their origins, the Fiend Void takes them all.

name: Void Oni Samurai (AC)
description: The samurai who have sworn themselves to the Archfiend were once pureblooded Oni. Their bloodthirst and greed increased tenfold. No matter their origins, the Fiend Void takes them all.

name: Void Overlord
description: From the depths of Tercessuinotlim, there were always whispers of a Void so powerful, only Nulgath himself knew of their existence. Now they've come out of the shadows.

name: Void Paladin
description: The few paladins that had sworn allegiance to the Nation are ones who lost their light….and never found it again.

name: Void Paladin Slayer (0 AC)
description: AHAHAHAHA! NO ONE CAN DEFEAT YOU WHILE YOU WIELD THE POWER OF THE ARCHFIEND!

name: Void Paladin Slayer (AC)
description: AHAHAHAHA! NO ONE CAN DEFEAT YOU WHILE YOU WIELD THE POWER OF THE ARCHFIEND!

name: Void Pirate (Armor)
description: Whether they sail the Black Seas or the rivers of dark blood flowing through the underworld, the Void Pirates are feared by all.

name: Void Pirate Destroyer
description: Void Pirate Destroyers only have one goal: to find and slay the Void Pirates that sail wherever darkness reigns.

name: Void Pyromancer
description: The Void, or any Void that lurks between the folds of space, is but a kiln. These Pyromancers spark flames in its depths, creating twisted art from destruction.

name: Void Rebirth (AC)
description: Witness the rebirth of the Void!

name: Void Rebirth (Special)
description: Witness the rebirth of the Void!

name: Void Recruit
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend calls only the strongest to serve him. To become a recruit, one must be among Lore's greatest, most evil heroes.

name: Void Ring
description: If anti-matter harvested from the Void was used to craft this armor… and the Void is the opposite of the real world of Lore… is it safe to assume that anti-anti-matter is really made from physical matter… ?!!? *brain explodes!*

name: Void Ripper
description: Those who serve the will of the Archfiend will always be rewarded.

name: Void Santy Claws Suit (0 AC)
description: SLAY bells ring… and the Void is ready to /cheer you on!

name: Void Santy Claws Suit (AC)
description: SLAY bells ring… and the Void is ready to /cheer you on!

name: Void Shogun (Armor)
description: These Void warriors are part of an ancient Shogun empire that ruled thousands of years ago.

name: Void SkinWalker
description: With the ability to turn into any animal at all, SkinWalkers have been around for thousands of years, lurking in the shadows of the forest. However it appears some have met a certain ArchFiend.

name: Void SkinWalker Fiend
description: With the ability to turn into any animal at all, SkinWalkers have been around for thousands of years, lurking in the shadows of the forest. However it appears some have met a certain ArchFiend.

name: Void Sorcerer
description: The sorcerers of Nulgath's army channel a darker power than most mages will ever wield. They dedicate their lives and power to the glory of the ArchFiend!

name: Void Spartan
description: Long ago, there was an ancient civilization with fearsome warriors. A single warrior from their army could wipe out a group of elite assassins alone. Now twisted from their original purpose, they serve Nulgath with a fervor rarely seen in Lore.

name: Void Star-Eater
description: A mass of living darkmatter and bone, an embodiment of hunger alone.They emerge from the Void of space, starving for the Sun and stars.

name: Void TideWalker (0 AC)
description: Nulgath not only holds dominion over the land, but also the sea. These TideWalkers follow behind thier human-seeming brethren, sowing dissent in order to promote Nulgath's Nation.

name: Void TideWalker (AC)
description: Nulgath not only holds dominion over the land, but also the sea. These TideWalkers follow behind thier human-seeming brethren, sowing dissent in order to promote Nulgath's Nation.

name: Void Vampire Guard
description: Vampires from the depths of the Void, these guards will be sure to keep everyone safe. Riiiiight.

name: Void Vigilante of the Legion
description: This armor was crafted from a fusion of Void energy from the AdventureQuest timeline and combined with magic Dage imbues into the gear he crafts for the Undead Legion. The dark horror will terrify your opponents, filling with with an otherworldly dread.

name: Void Walker (AC)
description: To travel between the Void and the real world isn't easy. The Void is filled with treacherous beings awaiting prey.

name: Void Walker (Legend)
description: To travel between the Void and the real world isn't easy. The Void is filled with treacherous beings awaiting prey.

name: Void Wanderer
description: In timespace, no one can hear you scream… until it's too late.

name: Void Warlock
description: Powerful fiend's of magic, nothing will stop these Warlock's from helping their Archfiend conquer his foes.

name: Void Warlord
description: Those who gave parts of their soul to Nulgath will be handsomely rewarded. Warlords rank among the highest of his followers.

name: Void Witch (AC)
description: Even in the Void witches find time to practice their craft.

name: Void Witch (Legend)
description: Even in the Void witches find time to practice their craft.

name: Voidborn of Nulgath (Armor)
description: Deep in the heart of the Void, a race of creatures spawned by Darkness, wait for Nulgath the ArchFiend's command. The Voidborn are his creatures - body, breath, and soul.

name: Voidborn Warlock
description: Voidborn Warlocks draw their power from the dark energies that saturate the place between worlds and times. They can traverse universes in the blink of an eye.

name: VoidCaster
description: Those who sign Nulgath's contract gain access to the infinite wellspring of arcane energy contained within the void. Be warned, almost everyone who accepts this power find themselves consumed by it.

name: VoidFiend BladeMaster (0 AC)
description: These BladeMasters once belonged to the Legion. They were dragged into the Fiend's Void kicking and screaming, but emerged silent. Now, they kill in the Archfiend's name.

name: VoidFiend BladeMaster (AC)
description: These BladeMasters once belonged to the Legion. They were dragged into the Fiend's Void kicking and screaming, but emerged silent. Now, they kill in the Archfiend's name.

name: VoidFiend Outlaw
description: If Nulgath the ArchFiend weren't such a viscious villain, you might just betray him… but you know what fate awaits the foolish rogues that cross him. (CC to Base, Trim)

name: Voidfiend Symbiote (0 AC)
description: The swirling red-orange pattern that pulses through the thin, dark skin of the Voidfiend Symbiote is a sign that the symbiosis with Nulgath's dark energy is complete.

name: Voidfiend Symbiote (AC)
description: The swirling red-orange pattern that pulses through the thin, dark skin of the Voidfiend Symbiote is a sign that the symbiosis with Nulgath's dark energy is complete.

name: Voidfire Vanguard (0 AC)
description: The merciless flames that blackened the bones of the dishonorable dead have taken solid form to better serve their Master, the Archfiend.

name: Voidfire Vanguard (AC)
description: The merciless flames that blackened the bones of the dishonorable dead have taken solid form to better serve their Master, the Archfiend.

name: VoidFrost Revenant of Nulgath (Armor)
description: Cold is emptiness. Eventually, everything in the universe will go still. This is a future even the God of Fiends scorns. Nulgath created these Fiends in the Void for a reason. Should he fall, they will emerge from his corpse and ensure that the universe falls with him.

name: VoidPirate Captain
description: Aye, even the Archfiend has his own fleet! No landlubbers allowed, Nulgath only wants the souls of the best Buccaneers in Lore. Savvy?

name: Voidseeker Armor (0 AC)
description: Warriors who sought out the Archfiend when they realized mortal bodies had their limits. Nulgath was more than happy to twist and mutate them into battle-hungry monsters.

name: Voidseeker Armor (AC)
description: Warriors who sought out the Archfiend when they realized mortal bodies had their limits. Nulgath was more than happy to twist and mutate them into battle-hungry monsters.

name: Vokun's Prismatic Terror
description: Those who look into your eyes will know fear… because they will see the power Vokun as granted you with this armor! The eyes on this armor are color-customizable!

name: Volleyball Captain
description: Life's a beach, no matter which position you play on your team! Bump… Set… SPIKE!

name: Volleyball Hero
description: Life's a beach, no matter which position you play on your team! Bump… Set… SPIKE!

name: Voltabolt Coat
description: Ze coat of ze mad zcientissst and dentissst, Dr. Voltabolt! I vonder vhat havoc you vill cauze!

name: Volutari Hunter
description: What you seek, all desire, But YOU are the only hunter brave enough to reach out and TAKE it!

name: Voodoo Brawler
description: Are you sure this is someone you want to pick a fight with? I know I don't. Designed by Darkxshadowlord!

name: VorDREAD
description: PINK SKULLS ON PINK SKULLS! MOAR PINK SKULLS! PIIIIIINNNNKKKKKKKKK!

name: Vordred's Armor
description: WEARING THIS ARMOR GIVES YOU THE URGE TO TALK IN ALL CAPS!

name: Vordred's Knight
description: YOU ARE A SKULLBREAKER KNIGHT, TRAINED BY PALADINSLAYER VORDRED. IT TOOK MUCH SKILL AND MANY BROKEN SKULLS TO GAIN HIS APPROVAL. NOW GO BREAK MORE. MORE SKULLS. (CC to Base and Accessory)

name: Votari Warrior
description: A bright new day offer new possibilities for everyone, but only the courageous seize their moments in the sun.

name: Wanderer of Nulgath
description: The ronin which wander through tercessuinotlim were cast out by their former masters. They have not sworn allegiance to Nulgath, but choose to slay the creatures who oppose him. Their creed is: "The enemy of my enemy is my friend."

name: Wandering Knight
description: The Swordhaven Military Expeditionary Division (AKA: the Wandering Knights) is not just a bunch of loremasters in pith helmets. No, sometimes new frontiers have to be conquered, not studied.

name: Wandering Onryo (Armor)
description: The Wandering Onryo may have been sent by Malgor, but you now have their gear!

name: Wandering Rockstar
description: Rock was born on the road, rehearsed in empty cemeteries, and shredded metal so hard the audience thought it was fiendish. These Rockstars are musical wanderers, returning to their roots.

name: Wannabe Pally
description: You know you wanna… SLAY THE UNDEAD!

name: Wanton Royal Weaver Armor
description: Regal and deadly. The look of the Chaos Weaver Queen demands respect. Only those who swear their unwavering alliance are granted such splendor.

name: War Cultist (AC)
description: They say war does strange things to you. Turning you into a half human half bio creature is one of them.

name: War Cultist (Special)
description: They say war does strange things to you. Turning you into a half human half bio creature is one of them.

name: War Lycan Armor
description: We are Legion Lycan, hear us ROAR!!!!

name: War Mummy Armor
description: Wrapped up in these bandages, you'll blend in just fine with all the other dessicated denziens who might otherwise want to do you in.

name: War Wolfy
description: Team Edward or Team Jacob…psh. GIVE US TEAM ARTIX!!! To the gallows with said Edward and Jacob!

name: Warden of Hours
description: The slightest hiccup in time could cause a cascade into calamity. The Warden of Hours jumps from one era to the next, quietly fixing destiny into place.

name: Warden of Light
description: Divine guardians of the Light are armed in impenetrable steel plates strengthened by the sun. Wardens have been the natural enemy to the Conquerors of Shadow since the dawn of Lore.

name: Warden of Serket
description: Trained in combat by Pharaoh Zhoom, and taught magic by Lector Crulon, these Wardens are trusted to protect the Palace of Duat. They've attained immunity to poison and venom, while their blood became toxic to evil forces.

name: WardKeeper's Armor
description: A celestial battlesuit drenched with blessed water is worn by Wardkeepers of the Southern Dawn Citadel. Their purpose is to fend off the combined darkness drawn from the likes of the Legion and Nation

name: Warforged IgnisKnight
description: The IgnisKnight takes the form of the Horseman of War…from another time and space. War's name always changes, and always returns. Let the masses gather. Force them to their knees so they'll have the strength to fly.

name: WarFury Elite's Armor
description: As you rise through the ranks of the Warfury your armor reflects your rank.

name: WarFury General's Armor
description: The highest rank of the Warfury army, the General's armor has no equal.

name: WarFury Soldier's Armor
description: Standard gear of the Warfury soldiers. Fully protective, just not very fancy.

name: Warhorses Team (AC)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Warhorses Team (Legend)
description: Go team! GO! Cheerleaders and Football Players!

name: Warlock Adept (Armor)
description: Embrace the power of the Darkness, then go beyond! CONTROL the darkness, the Dragons, and the WORLD, for YOU are a Warlock Adept!

name: Warlock Grand Master (Armor)
description: Embrace the power of the Darkness, then go beyond! CONTROL the darkness, the Dragons, and the WORLD, for YOU are the Warlock Grand master!

name: Warlock of Love
description: In all this world, you might be happy, genuinely happy. Not one couple in a century has that chance, not really, but you could have it.

name: Warlord Armor
description: The armor version of the Warrior base class upgrade.

name: WarLord of Bones
description: Crafted by barbarians from darkened minerals as cold as ice, Dage provided countless shadow elementals these old armors to give them a physical form and to use them to chase after "special" targets.

name: Warlord of Nulgath
description: Bending the dark energies of the void are what these Juggernaut's of Nulgath do best. These champions thrive in times of war and destruction.

name: Warlord of the Undying (0 AC)
description: Death is not an escape. The Warlord of the Undying fly in circles above battlefields, swooping down to steal the dead. Ally or enemy, they're retrieved and rise again. The Warlord has a habit of keeping the best to themselves.

name: Warlord of the Undying (AC)
description: Death is not an escape. The Warlord of the Undying fly in circles above battlefields, swooping down to steal the dead. Ally or enemy, they're retrieved and rise again. The Warlord has a habit of keeping the best to themselves.

name: Warok Warlord
description: Forged in discipline and draped in tradition, this garb channels the unyielding spirit of the Warok leaders who stood at the heart of every Reog performance.

name: Warp Necromancer Armor
description: You have become a Warp Necromancer! When the call to battle against the Desterrat Moya rings out, rise up and reach out to destroy your greatest enemy… in ANY Dimension!

name: WarpForce Heavygunner Armor
description: This is the type of armor worn by the Heavy Gunner class in AdventureQuest WarpForce!

name: WarpForce Shirt
description: Are you a fan of WarpForce? Wear this shirt with pride and let the world see what you love!

name: Warrior Ablaze
description: As the leaves start to turn, so will your foes in the graves. There's a fire in your eyes that can't be contained. Lore will burn in the wake of your destruction.

name: Warrior Armor
description: The heart of a warrior is filled with courage and strength. Your skills with weapons in close combat makes you a powerful force on the battlefield.

name: Warrior of Kyanos
description: The Warriors of Kyanos have very special gear to help handle the cold as they battle through the icy lands of Glacera.

name: Warrior of Lore
description: Thank you for fighting to defend Lore from villains, monsters, and all who would attack the worlds we've built together. For 20 years, you've been Twilly's hero!

name: Warrior of the Clerics
description: After the Sisterhood found a Hero willing to fight the battles for Lore, they presented them with a set of armor, fit for a true champion!

name: Warrior of the Den
description: Take a stand against Evil and Chaos on the battlefield! Long Live General Lionfang and the Golden Onslaught Army!

name: Warrior of the Star
description: May the stars guide you on your way to victory in battle.

name: Warrior of Time
description: Warriors emerged from the unceasing rivers of time. Their strength can reverse its flow, changing fate and the inevitable. Some say, the Dragon that gave them this power once walked alongside mortals.

name: Warrior's Beast Master
description: Control the beasts with the power of your blade!

name: Warriors of The Moon
description: Listen to the whispers in the darkness. They call to you. The night is yours to claim.

name: Warriors of The Sun
description: Bathe in the glory of the light. Sol shines on you, calling to you. Embrace it, claim it, and shine!

name: Watchers of the Dark
description: The only thing to be afraid of are the terrors can't see in the night!

name: Watchtower Sergeant
description: As the Sergeant of Amberheart Tower, you're in charge of alerting Lore of any imminent danger. Be prepared because if this tower falls, Lore may be next!

name: Water Dragon (Armor)
description: Just as water flows wearing down everything around it so shall you when you become the water dragon. Powerful to a fault, this armor will empower you to be one with the dragon, wreaking the same havoc while protecting you with the thick hardened scales of it's hide.

name: Water Dragon Summoner (Armor)
description: Deep below the waves lives a nation of sea dragons. Masters of aquatic elemental magic, these ancient and powerful creatures have never been known to interact with the humans of Lore… until now. (This item is color-customizable to base, trim, and accessory.)

name: Water Fènnù de Hóuzi
description: They'll be no monkeying around you. To earn your share of banana's one must ape-reicate all living things.

name: Water Ring
description: Make a splash on the battlefield! Wash away those horrendous heathens and drown your enemies with a torrential downpour of power!

name: Waterlogged Zombie (Armor)
description: Bones and barnacles and braaaaaiiiinnnns, oh my!

name: Wayward Wolftale's Wanderer
description: Happiness comes from eating, indulging, dancing, and living as much as possible. These wolves are the life, and likely end, of every party. How terrifying. Then again, when's the next time you'll get to dance with the jaws of death?

name: Weaver Mage
description: These Magi draw their power from the ChaosWeavers, they've sworn an oath to the Dark Queen, to protect her at all costs.

name: Wendigo (Armor)
description: The beast inside you awakens! You have been transformed into the devious Wendigo!

name: Were-diver Morph
description: Who said werewolves don't enjoy fun in the sun err moon.

name: Were-Warlock (Armor)
description: You've unlocked the Were-Warlock armor for supporting Dungeon Punks on Humble Bundle. /cheer

name: Werebear
description: Those tainted by the curse must now survive the best they can while hoping to fine a cure.

name: Werejaguar
description: Become one with the Werejaguar! The ancient tribe of Werejaguars, once believed to be extinct, hail from a secret jungle that only Mido can find. Hone in on your Werejaguar instincts and perhaps one day you too will find the elusive Werejaguar clan!

name: Werepyre-ate Captain (0 AC)
description: What is undead can never die, and what was born of two worlds, and rejected by both… will NEVER forgive and NEVER forget. Werepyrates will RULE Darkovia and the Midnight Seas! (This morph armor has the same art for all players.)

name: Werepyre-ate Captain (AC)
description: What is undead can never die, and what was born of two worlds, and rejected by both… will NEVER forgive and NEVER forget. Werepyrates will RULE Darkovia and the Midnight Seas! (This morph armor has the same art for all players.)

name: Werepyre Devotee Pirate
description: Bone-a-fide seadogs, loyal to their patchwork pack. They never flee from battle, and chase the drifting moon with their warships. Their nights never end.

name: Werepyre of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend welcomes warriors of ANY race… especially one as deadly as an enraged werepyre.

name: Werepyre of Nulgath (AC)
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend welcomes warriors of ANY race… especially one as deadly as an enraged werepyre.

name: Werepyre's Guard
description: A new power has arisen in Darkovia - the Cult of the Werepyre. Sometimes humans get sucked into these supernatural cults… to their detriment.

name: Werepyre's Shadow Armor
description: The terrible combination of vampire and werewolf, these loners never truly fit in with either race making them outcasts and dangerous to all creatures of the night.

name: Werepyre Slayer
description: Everyone wants to suit up in this rare armor. Only a select few will ever get the chance. You have shown your worth in PvP combat and shall reap the awards forevermore.

name: Werepyre Warrior
description: Werepyre's don't need fancy schmancy parties to attend. These lone wolves prefer the dark dense forest lighted by mother moon.

name: Werewolf Hunter
description: You're the Alpha Hunter, time to pack from silver and bag some furbags.

name: Wessin Smith
description: The year is blah blah blah blah. In a world where a crime happens like clockwork, Orange, a division of cops found in District 8 1/2 have called on one outlaw to Terminate an uprising empire and bring Serenity back to the people… WESSIN SMITH!!!

name: White Bishop
description: In skilled hands, Bishops become forks of lightening, surgically infiltrating the enemy ranks and wreaking havoc among the back line.

name: White Dragonborn Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Just because pirates are known as pillagers and scallywags doesn't mean they dunna be wantin' to look fancy every now and again.

name: White Dragonborn Naval Commander (AC)
description: Just because pirates are known as pillagers and scallywags doesn't mean they dunna be wantin' to look fancy every now and again.

name: White Karategi
description: Made of light canvas cloth, the gi maximizes mobility and speed. For all levels of karateka.

name: White Knight
description: While often cast as a hero, Knights are just another enchanted piece on the board. Their irregular patterns of movement make them a terror on the field.

name: White Mage
description: The Magi that serve the Lords of Order must be of the purest heart and hence known as a White Mage.

name: White Pawn
description: Pawns, though regarded as expendable, are actually the most powerful pieces in the game. They have the ability to become any other piece, assuming they can reach the other side of the field.

name: White Rabbit Suit
description: Remember… what the doormouse said!

name: White Rook
description: Rooks take many forms in this ancient game. Sometimes they were depicted as berserkers. Sometimes, castles. But whatever they're incarnation, they are meant to seem unstoppable.

name: White Royalty
description: Importance does not mean power. The same is true of the opposite. Nothing illustrates this point better than the necessary King and the unstoppable Queen.

name: White Samurai Robe
description: Samurai are those who serve in close attendance to the nobility.

name: White Shadow Hunter Suit
description: Taking the fight straight into heart of the darkness.

name: White Space Crew Shirt
description: You've got a good chance of surviving the away party.

name: White Space Paladin
description: Let's boldly go where no other Paladins have gone before!

name: White Stalker (Armor)
description: Winter is coming and the White Stalkers are ready to take over the world!

name: White Tailcoat (AC)
description: Nothing on this planet says class like a tailcoat.

name: White Tailcoat (Legend)
description: Nothing on this planet says class like a tailcoat.

name: White Witch and Warlock
description: Redleafchannel has created a protective suit for those magi who are stuffy in their robes. It provides ample protection without being hard to move in. Ideal for traveling; no more hot and sweaty robes for you!

name: Whiteberry's Costume
description: A fashionable outfit that unfortunately attracts stains and dirt like a magnet. Bleach hourly to keep pristine.

name: WhiteTiger Onmyoji
description: You possess a rare power - the ability to summon and control a White Tiger Shikigami! It will serve you loyaly as long as your intent is honorable and your heart pure.

name: Whoops! Armor
description: The Summer art should not have gone live yet. Please sell this replacement art for gold as my way of saying "sorry!" -Alina

name: Wicked Eveningwear
description: Somewhere in the dark, there's a party that's been going on since the first act of evil was made on Lore. Invites are exclusive to the most wicked of souls.

name: Wicked Pumpkin Caster
description: Your spells are made with sugar and Pumpkin Spice! Be careful!

name: Will Armor
description: Whoa dudes, this armor is most excellent.

name: William's Outfit
description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as William!

name: WIN Hero
description: This is THE hottest console on Lore right now. It's in the name. We WIN!

name: Wind Ring
description: You know how to break wind… literally! Smell the sweet scents of VICTORY!

name: Wind Weaver
description: The gentle flow of air, the curl of the wind devil, the ferocity of the tornado, all such glorious aspects of the power of the wind. Imagine standing before a mighty throng, enemies until the end, and weaving the very air into a weapon that would decimate these mighty in a heartbeat, all within the comfort of a wind-infused armor.

name: Window Slayer
description: Well met, rectangular glass piece inside a wall. I am the Window Slayer, and I shall be the one delivering unsurpassed amounts of window pane! Time to kick some GLASS!

name: WindWalker
description: The WindWalkers are a sect of Warrior-Mages that defend and protect the people of Nusantara. They are sworn to serve Garuda the Bird King, and will do anything to keep their home safe.

name: Winter Assassin
description: *No description*

name: Winter Defender Alpha
description: A few feet of snow won't stop these defenders from protecting the frozen streets of BattleOn.

name: Winter Hexer (AC)
description: Channel the power of blizzards and black ice to destroy your enemies!

name: Winter Hexer (Legend)
description: Channel the power of blizzards and black ice to destroy your enemies!

name: Winter Legion Warrior
description: The Winter Legion Warriors are renowned for battling through the darkest night and harshest blizzards. They are so dedicated, they will keep fighting beyond life itself. Those are the most desirable soldiers for the Legion to recruit.

name: Winter Mana Champion (0 AC)
description: The fabric practically blends into the winter's night sky, giving an air of regal whimsy. Tara says that's what she thinks Mana looks like when you use it to wield Ice magic. Try it out! It'll keep you warm even if you're stuck in a glaicer.

name: Winter Mana Champion (AC)
description: The fabric practically blends into the winter's night sky, giving an air of regal whimsy. Tara says that's what she thinks Mana looks like when you use it to wield Ice magic. Try it out! It'll keep you warm even if you're stuck in a glaicer.

name: Winter ShadowSlayer (0 AC)
description: A Shadowslayer who delves into the endless nights of winter to protect the innocent. The 'seasons of death' are a particularly busy time for them. Greater Evils stir in the frigid cold, so the righteous can never rest.

name: Winter ShadowSlayer (AC)
description: A Shadowslayer who delves into the endless nights of winter to protect the innocent. The 'seasons of death' are a particularly busy time for them. Greater Evils stir in the frigid cold, so the righteous can never rest.

name: Winter Solstice SoulWeaver
description: Artisans who weave garments of incredible quality. These Soulweavers made a name for themselves in the Northlands, but locals whisper rumors about them receiving visions from the frozen dead. They aren't wrong…

name: Winter Spirit (0 AC)
description: When the snow comes knocking on your windows in the depths of winter, it may herald the appearance of a Yuki-onna. Be very careful when looking outside.

name: Winter Spirit (AC)
description: When the snow comes knocking on your windows in the depths of winter, it may herald the appearance of a Yuki-onna. Be very careful when looking outside.

name: Winter Uniform
description: A wise hero knows that no matter what season it is, there is always more to learn.

name: Winter Void (0 AC)
description: A fiendish beast literally cut from the bitter cold. The Fiend's Void can mutate and transform anything, even the primeval tundra. Spines grew and eyes opened. New life hungers to snuff out all warmth.

name: Winter Void (AC)
description: A fiendish beast literally cut from the bitter cold. The Fiend's Void can mutate and transform anything, even the primeval tundra. Spines grew and eyes opened. New life hungers to snuff out all warmth.

name: Winters Dark Equinox
description: Jingle bells, the Hero smells, Doom is on the way, Karok attacks behind the Queen's back, now it's time to slay, hey!

name: Winters Dark Solstice
description: For those who want winter to last all year long.

name: WinterWild Warrior
description: Pledge your life and honor to the defense of Coldwind Valley, for this winter and all winters to come.

name: Wintery DoomKnight
description: Feared throughout the history of time, the Doom Knight shows little remorse for the living. Sympathy is only derived from brute force.

name: Wintry Minstrel
description: Hark! Do ye have a festive song for us?

name: Wise Owl Suit
description: Fly high above forests and above mountains. You are a mighty owl that never settles for the smaller things. It could take a while to master the palm-sized wings, though.

name: Wishbone (Armor)
description: The only wish I have is to break your bones and feast on the battlefield!

name: Wisteria Swimwear
description: Made of all-natural, organic fabrics, this swimsuit was inspired by the marsh monster, Wisteria!

name: Witch Armor (Armor)
description: Witches and Warlocks—oh my! You will melt if you get rained on. Happy Mogloween!

name: Witch Class Armor
description: Happy Mogloween! Warning: this class may be suitable for women only! This is the 1st Edition released during AQW's first Mogloween 2008!

name: Witch Doctor Necro Armor
description: Eye of Moglin, scale of a dragon, and foot of a paladin! *POOF* Rise my children! Awaken from your deep slumber!

name: WitchBlade
description: The covens only hold you back. There's more potential and enchantment to be found in a blade you sharpen yourself.

name: Wolf Legend
description: Worn by Wolf, a guardian of the gates in the DragonFable timeline, this armor is perfect for rapid-action attacks in battle. Strap a dagger on and get ready to go!

name: Wolf Lord
description: The Wolf Lord stalks the Northlands, culling the herds and taking those past their prime. Bards still tell the tale of the battle between the Wolf Lord and the Rune Lord, and how the skies shook with their battle cries.

name: Wolf of War
description: As member of the Wolf Clan, you possess cunning skills on the battlefield as well as a thirst for blood like the ferocious wolf. Never alone, you and your pack are never short of numbers and are swift to make that final blow!

name: Wolfblade
description: Modled from the uniforms by the students of the Wolfblade house in the Lore of MechQuest's timeline. As the warriors of G.E.A.R.S. University, honor and courage are your house's values as they continue the quest for the Wolfblade.

name: Wolfblade Shirt
description: Are you a fan of Wolfblade? Wear this shirt with pride and represent your favorite house!

name: Wolfhound Warrior (Armor)
description: Wolfhounds are the most loyal warriors in the kingdom. Wearing the Wolf's Head sigil shows that you can be trusted above all else.

name: Wolfslayer Frostlorn Rogue
description: The half-wrap and hip armor of the Frostlorn Rogue are worked into the hearty arctic wolf leather.

name: Wolfwing Armor
description: Charroupted werepyres don't have fleas, right? Lets Let's hope not… because Aria's Pet Shop pet shop is all out of flea collars!

name: Wood Nymph
description: Nature is your boutique when clothes made of spring leaves are in style. They're eco-friendly too.

name: Woolly Wonder
description: Fleece as white as snow, how you would look so cute with little red bows. This soft and adorable outfit, you'll blend right in with the flock. Just steer clear of petting zoos.

name: Worn Pandy Hoodie
description: You suddenly have a craving for bamboo.

name: Worshipper of Doom
description: Sepulchure's hold strong. These warriors follow the shadows and support their Lord.

name: Worshipper of Nulgath
description: Any mortal who has devoted their soul to the obedience of Nulgath.

name: Woven Knot Outfit
description: Awesome dark red Breaking Benjamin t-shirt!

name: Wraith of Darkness
description: From the darkness you came, and to the darkness you shall return. For the Longest Night approaches, and the undead roam the streets of Mystcroft.

name: Wrath of Legion
description: Play time is over! The wrath of the Legion is upon us!

name: Wrath of the Legion
description: Wrath will make you lose yourself in the fight, lose your humanity. Do not let it overtake you. Keep yourself calm and you will survive this fight.

name: Wrath Void
description: Fiends who embody their Master's wrath, left to fester in the Void until they emerge as evolved beasts. Once they are pointed towards a target, they will not stop until the one who insulted the Archfiend is torn into gibblets.

name: Wrathful Lich
description: The Wrathful Lich was once one of the most powerful magic-wielders in the Celestial Realm. before they were corrupted by darkness. The dark power they've embraced pits them against many of those who were once their allies.

name: Wretched Debris Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture.

name: Wretched Debris Naval Commander (AC)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye, cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture.

name: Wretched Ghoul
description: With armor this ghoulish, you'll fit right in at the carnival of corpses.

name: Wretched Stalker
description: Those who hunt the elusive dullahan must be cunning, quick, and brave.

name: Writhing Thalassarath Pirate (0 AC)
description: ﻿﻿﻿The piece of an undead sea monster's heart hatched in the chest of these bloodthirsty pirates. Their souls and that of the monster's young have fused, becoming hungry for both gold and more flesh.

name: Writhing Thalassarath Pirate (AC)
description: ﻿﻿﻿The piece of an undead sea monster's heart hatched in the chest of these bloodthirsty pirates. Their souls and that of the monster's young have fused, becoming hungry for both gold and more flesh.

name: WyrmTamer Armor
description: You are a taker of chance, a tempter of fate. You want what no one can get. You, oh tamer of Wyrms, oh captor of draconic tales, this is your armor. Only one who boosts intelligence can have this armor.

name: X-Static X-Zilla
description: You might be the King of all Monster but have a breath mint!

name: X-Zilla
description: You might be the King of all Monster but have a breath mint! (This item has a low chance to play an animation when you use a skill AND do more damage against human enemies.)

name: Xan's Robes
description: These are enchanted, fire-resistant robes worn by the insane pyromancer himself.

name: Xavier Lionfang's Armor
description: Xavier Lionfang, the younger brother of Maximilian Lionfang, once was a great leader in King Alteon's army. After his father's dream, Xavier left the military to seek revenge. Starting to believe in his brother's beliefs on the truce and plans to usurp King Alteon, Xavier devised a failed plot to poison King Alteon. Only the thought of revenge keeps Xavier up at night.

name: Xiang Chaos
description: *No description*

name: Xmas Cutie Armor
description: Now you're ready for the Frostval spirit!

name: Xtreme Fishing Jersey
description: You aren't just some weekend-only angler. As a matter of fact, you are so hardcore that the fish jump into your boat because they acknowledge your extreme fishing mojo. The shirt say so.

name: xXGothicXx Pirate Captain (0 AC)
description: What better way to celebrate TLAPD then donning this swag inspired by the original gothic pirate, Voltaire!

name: xXGothicXx Pirate Captain (AC)
description: What better way to celebrate TLAPD then donning this swag inspired by the original gothic pirate, Voltaire!

name: Xyfrag Armor
description: Gross.

name: Yaksha and Kinnaree
description: Yaksha and Kinnaree watch over the well beings of others but also have a deep love of music and dance.

name: Yaksha Shrine Servant
description: Protectors of the Yaksha Shrine, any tresspassers are met with a swift fate.

name: Yami no Akuma
description: Driven by the dark, these warriors seek to extinguish all good in the world.

name: Yami no Ronin (Armor)
description: While others /partied, you studied the blade. While others were training their reputation, you mastered the art of unsheathing and striking. While others wasted their days being AFK in Yulgar, you cultivated inner strength. Now that the world is set aflame and the fiends are at the gates, only you have the power to cut through shadow as if it were steel.

name: Yami no Samurai
description: The dark warriors of Yokai Isle once served a mighty emperor but were driven out after the last dynasty ended. However their vigilance hasn't wavered.

name: Yaomo Armor
description: You've beaten this terrible beast so many times, now you can take its form!

name: YCube Defender
description: YCube? Because it's the BEST Cube!

name: Year of the Rabbit Warrior
description: Your foes will tremble in your sight as you step onto the field of battle in this raiment. Or maybe they're giggling because you're a giant bunny. I can't tell which. The sash is Color Custom.

name: Yellow Coward Armor
description: Yeah, we're calling you yellow. You're in a Coward's armor, what do you expect?

name: Yellow L.O.S.E.R. (Armor)
description: It's changing time! Koala!

name: Yellow Space Crew Shirt
description: You've got a good chance of surviving the away party.

name: Yellow Space Paladin
description: Let's boldly go where no other Paladins have gone before!

name: Yeti Destroyer (0 AC)
description: Allied to one of the more peaceful tribes of Northlands Krampus, the YetiKun Destroyers work with them to guard their friends and family from the bloodthirsty yeti that roam the land.

name: Yeti Destroyer (AC)
description: Allied to one of the more peaceful tribes of Northlands Krampus, the YetiKun Destroyers work with them to guard their friends and family from the bloodthirsty yeti that roam the land.

name: Yeti Destroyer (Legend)
description: Allied to one of the more peaceful tribes of Northlands Krampus, the YetiKun Destroyers work with them to guard their friends and family from the bloodthirsty yeti that roam the land.

name: Yeti Hunter (0 AC)
description: Allied to one of the more peaceful tribes of Northlands Krampus, the YetiKun Hunters work with them to guard their friends and family from the bloodthirsty yeti that roam the land.

name: Yeti Hunter (AC)
description: Allied to one of the more peaceful tribes of Northlands Krampus, the YetiKun Hunters work with them to guard their friends and family from the bloodthirsty yeti that roam the land.

name: Yeti Warrior
description: We wish you a Yeti New Year!

name: Yguazu Warrior
description: The garb of a respected warrior, poised to one day become a wise and just leader. Even the gods glare in jealousy. (click on chest)

name: Yin-Yang Street Wear (AC)
description: Straight outta Yokai island.

name: Yin-Yang Street Wear (Special)
description: Straight outta Yokai island.

name: Yokai Amethyst Noble
description: The Noble Clans of the Yokai Isles were founded by the warriors who originally fought alongside the First Emperor and his brother. Each family has their own combat style.

name: Yokai Amethyst Noble Plate
description: The Noble Clans of the Yokai Isles were founded by the warriors who originally fought alongside the First Emperor and his brother. Each family has their own combat style.

name: Yokai Bandit
description: A troublemaker causing mayhem off the coast of Yokai and beyond. They dream of a bigger and bluer ocean, and to carve their name into the memory of every sailor. No treasure is safe, not even Great Dragon eggs.

name: Yokai Dragonslayer
description: The fated death of Dragons, and bane of the Ayakashi. Yokai Dragonslayers are hunters that bring an end to the everlasting, be it the lives of wretched Dragons, or eras of stagnation.

name: Yokai Hanbok
description: Saehae bok mani badeuseyo! /bows

name: Yokai Jutsu Summoner
description: A Yokai Summoner most be careful when using their power. Spirits may look harmless at times but only an experienced Summoner may exorcise them.

name: Yokai Kimono
description: A Yokai Island inspired Kimono, worn by both males and females for formal arrangements… and informal battles.

name: Yokai Oni Naval Commander (0 AC)
description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

name: Yokai Oni Naval Commander (AC)
description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

name: Yokai Oni Summoner
description: OniSlayers can become summoners by defeating Yokai, and making them Shikigami. In the world of wild, man-eating Yokai - might makes right. Only the strong are worthy of being their masters.

name: Yokai OniSlayer
description: Oni are bloodthirsty man eaters. Violence and depravity are in their nature. The OniSlayers are warriors trusted to hunt these monsters. But, one day, Oni blood will seep into their veins, and make them indistinguishable from their prey.

name: Yokai Senshi
description: The soldiers of Yokai Isle.

name: Yokai Spirit Mage
description: To be a spirit mage one most must possess a strong underlying power to the afterlife. Second sight helps these magic users see and speak to Yokai.

name: Yokai Street Wear (AC)
description: Straight outta Yokai island.

name: Yokai Street Wear (Special)
description: Straight outta Yokai island.

name: Yokai Summoner
description: A Yokai Summoner most be careful when using their power. Spirits may look harmless at times but only an experienced Summoner may exorcise them.

name: Yokai Warrior Mage
description: Infusing magic with the warrior spirit of Yokai, these magi protect the island.

name: Youkono
description: An ancient Yokai spirit made famous for its fox-like appearance and shape-shifting abilities. (color custom: skin)

name: Young Empress' Armor
description: As she grew in both the Shadow and the Light - and became Empress in truth - Empress Gravelyn's armor grew with her.

name: Youngling Armor
description: You're well on your way to training in the Mogi way!

name: Zard Rider
description: You're on a zard, you're on a zard, everybody look at you 'cause you're riding on a zard. WHAT!

name: Zard Self
description: After the Embero Spell was cast, it was revealed that your true inner form is that of a zard! You possess cold, cunning logic, sharp teeth, ad fierce determination to survive.

name: Zardian Pilot
description: Gear made for pilots of Zard kind, not the type you're used to on planet Lore. Humans and other races are welcome to join them and learn how to fly their specialized crafts. So long as you don't treat the Zardians like horses. Not even jokes.

name: Zardic Kinsman
description: Is this what happens when humans live alongside the Zards, or is this the next stage of their evolution? Either way, the kinsmen use adaptability and sharp wit to expand Zard territory. (Skin is not CC)

name: Zardman
description: Zards are such incredible creatures. Their evolutions move in so many directions and at such a rapid pace. From frog and lizard to lizard and man!

name: Zardman Floaties Armor
description: Perfect for splashing around Burning Beach! These inflatable Zard floatie wings may not stop a Lava Guardian, but they'll keep you looking cool while you fight the heat.

name: Zayark's Shadowwalker
description: Crafted for the heroes of Lore by the well-known smith, Zayark, this armor will keep you safe in battle for years to come.

name: Zealith Reaver
description: This armor is an incarnation of Zealith himself, and was made in his image.

name: Zealith Warrior
description: Dissatisfied with the Zealith Reaver, Agyron added some major modifications to truley truly awaken it's its potential. Even Zealith himself would think twice before attacking you.

name: Zealous Aegis Paladin
description: Warriors for Good in the time of Stellaria, these Paladins went fearlessly into battle against the Cryptborg's forces of NecroDrones and NecroMechs. There… they met their fate. Do not let their sacrifice be in vain!

name: Zealous Paladin
description: Warriors for Good in the time of Stellaria, these Paladins went fearlessly into battle against the Cryptborg's forces of NecroDrones and NecroMechs. There… they met their fate. Do not let their sacrifice be in vain!

name: Zeke
description: Ethan built this X-Bot from one of his gaming consoles. Be sure to equip this in a well-ventilated area or else you might overheat.

name: Zellare's Safeguard
description: By assuming the form of a fire dragon minion, you take on the fury of a dragon's fiery breath and the wisdom of the wyrm's ancient age.

name: Zeph'gorog Armor
description: The spirit of Zeph'gorog has infused this armor - it is so strong that all who equip it look the same!

name: Zephyr (Armor)
description: These cloudy grey flowing robes are used to clad air elementalists. Rolling clouds trim this robe and the power of the four winds are infused within.

name: ZEUS Suit
description: An emergency welding suit. Great for repairing holes while atop a speeding train, or chasing down thieving thieves.

name: Zhoom Outfit
description: After raiding Zhoom's closet, you'll be rockin' in this Sandsea Ranger's outfit!

name: Zhu Ronin
description: A ronin is a samurai with no master but these follow the ancient ways of the Zhu.

name: Zilla Maid
description: RAWR GRRRR! (This is the perfect costume for otaku, Kaiju fans, or if you just REALLY love to /clean up on the battlefield.) (Female Only)

name: Zilla Witch
description: ﻿A witch with mastery over great monsters, able to summon them as familiars or in rare instances, take on the mighty forms of ancient beasts through magicial transformation. (Female Only).

name: Zio a Go Go
description: You are Lore's Hero, and the safety of all our universes and timelines depend up YOU. Fight for evil, and defend our worlds from those that would harm it.

name: Zombie Caesar
description: Worn by an infamously deceased general, this toga was stolen from the grave on his 2,055th birthday! His spirit and military prowess will be with you as you lead the shambling army of walking undead to victory!

name: Zombie Formal Suit
description: Hand-crafted by Laken himself, this formal attire is well suited for eating brains and epic brain-eating.

name: Zombie Guardian
description: Most Guardians protected the land of Lore. Zombie Guardians don't care about any of that—they just want to protect their fridges full of brains.

name: Zombie Gunslinger
description: Some people say fashion is dead. In this outfit, fashion is UNDEAD.

name: Zombie Hunter Hunter
description: How many Zombie Hunters would a Zombie Hunter Hunter hunt if a Zombie Hunter Hunter could hunt Zombie Hunters?

name: Zombie Leperchaun
description: There's lucky, there's unlucky and then there's un-dead-ky. You're the third. (Only available during Friday the 13th / Lucky Day crossover events)

name: Zombie Light Warrior
description: The order of Paladins is famous for its righteous hatred of the undead. As a result, Zombie Paladins are not known for high self-esteem.

name: Zombie Pirate
description: Blimey! I be a scallywag in search of BRAINS!!!

name: Zombie Platinum Knight
description: Reserved for the highest rank of undead, the Platinum Armor is an outward symbol of your shambling, vaguely smelly half-sentience.

name: Zombie Renegade
description: You were once a merry man but now you are a hunger man…FOR BRAINS!!!

name: Zombie Trophyhunter
description: This armor has GOT to stink after a couple weeks in the battlefield…

name: Zombie Villager
description: Just another group of innocent bystandards in the Zombie War!

name: ZombieSlayer Armor
description: The undead walk the land slain and reborn by Sepulchure's toxic fog. It is up to you to save the innocent, rescue the weak, and slay those who would tear down the home you have defended so valiantly. You are the Zombie Killer!

name: Zombification
description: Everyone knew it would happen sooner or later. Better to just accept it and move on. Slowly. With a staggered pace. While chanting: BRAAAAIIINNNS!

name: Zoo Keeper
description: If yer gonna wrangle critters in an outback zoo, ya need the proper gear!

name: Zorbak Animatronic Armor
description: Don't hold it against them.

name: Zorbak Armor
description: 'Cause you know you want to be just like Zorbak.

name: Zorbak's BFF Hoodie
description: Make an absolute power move by leading an army of undead in this.

name: Zorbak's PJs
description: Mogloween is the best time to break out all of the onesies that have been in your closet. Dress up like Zorbak!

name: Zorbak Shirt (Armor)
description: 103% Cotton-poly blend Artix Ent shirts will NOT protect you from rainbows, unicorns or tutorial Moglins. They WILL protect you from lack of style and bad fashion choices.
